##### FILE: ./app/(app)/account/security/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  compare,
  hash,
} from "bcryptjs";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  auth,
  signOut,
} from "@/auth";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  validatePasswordPolicy,
} from "@/lib/auth/password-policy";

import {
  logAccountSecurityEvent,
} from "@/lib/security/account-events";


async function requireCurrentUserId(): Promise<string> {
  const session =
    await auth();


  const directId =
    (
      session?.user as
        | {
            id?:
              string;
          }
        | undefined
    )?.id;


  if (
    directId
  ) {
    return directId;
  }


  const email =
    session?.user
      ?.email;


  if (
    !email
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/login",
    );
  }


  const user =
    await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: {
        email,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !user
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/login",
    );
  }


  return user.id;
}


function value(
  formData:
    FormData,
  key:
    string,
): string {
  const candidate =
    formData.get(
      key,
    );


  return (
    typeof candidate ===
      "string"
      ?
        candidate
      :
        ""
  );
}


export async function changePasswordAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const userId =
    await requireCurrentUserId();


  const currentPassword =
    value(
      formData,
      "currentPassword",
    );


  const newPassword =
    value(
      formData,
      "newPassword",
    );


  const confirmPassword =
    value(
      formData,
      "confirmPassword",
    );


  if (
    newPassword !==
    confirmPassword
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/account/security?status=password-mismatch",
    );
  }


  const policy =
    validatePasswordPolicy(
      newPassword,
    );


  if (
    !policy.valid
  ) {
    logAccountSecurityEvent(
      "password.change.rejected",
      userId,
      {
        reason:
          "policy",
      },
    );


    redirect(
      "/account/security?status=password-policy",
    );
  }


  const user =
    await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          userId,
      },

      select: {
        passwordHash:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !user
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/login",
    );
  }


  const currentValid =
    await compare(
      currentPassword,
      user.passwordHash,
    );


  if (
    !currentValid
  ) {
    logAccountSecurityEvent(
      "password.change.rejected",
      userId,
      {
        reason:
          "current-password",
      },
    );


    redirect(
      "/account/security?status=wrong-password",
    );
  }


  if (
    await compare(
      newPassword,
      user.passwordHash,
    )
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/account/security?status=same-password",
    );
  }


  const passwordHash =
    await hash(
      newPassword,
      12,
    );


  await prisma.user.update({
    where: {
      id:
        userId,
    },

    data: {
      passwordHash:
        passwordHash,

      authVersion: {
        increment:
          1,
      },

      passwordChangedAt:
        new Date(),
    },
  });


  logAccountSecurityEvent(
    "password.changed",
    userId,
  );


  await signOut({
    redirectTo:
      "/login?security=password-changed",
  });
}


export async function logoutAllDevicesAction(): Promise<void> {
  const userId =
    await requireCurrentUserId();


  await prisma.user.update({
    where: {
      id:
        userId,
    },

    data: {
      authVersion: {
        increment:
          1,
      },
    },
  });


  logAccountSecurityEvent(
    "sessions.revoked",
    userId,
  );


  await signOut({
    redirectTo:
      "/login?security=sessions-revoked",
  });
}


export async function deleteAccountAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const userId =
    await requireCurrentUserId();


  const password =
    value(
      formData,
      "password",
    );


  const confirmation =
    value(
      formData,
      "confirmation",
    );


  if (
    confirmation !==
    "DELETE MY ACCOUNT"
  ) {
    logAccountSecurityEvent(
      "account.delete.rejected",
      userId,
      {
        reason:
          "confirmation",
      },
    );


    redirect(
      "/account/security?status=delete-confirmation",
    );
  }


  const user =
    await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          userId,
      },

      select: {
        passwordHash:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !user
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/login",
    );
  }


  const passwordValid =
    await compare(
      password,
      user.passwordHash,
    );


  if (
    !passwordValid
  ) {
    logAccountSecurityEvent(
      "account.delete.rejected",
      userId,
      {
        reason:
          "password",
      },
    );


    redirect(
      "/account/security?status=delete-password",
    );
  }


  logAccountSecurityEvent(
    "account.deleted",
    userId,
  );


  await prisma.$transaction(
    async (
      transaction,
    ) => {
      const projects =
        await transaction.project.findMany({
          where: {
            userId:
              userId,
          },

          select: {
            id:
              true,
          },
        });


      const projectIds =
        projects.map(
          (
            project,
          ) =>
            project.id,
        );


      if (
        projectIds.length >
        0
      ) {
        await transaction.monthlyOverride.deleteMany({
          where: {
            projectId: {
              in:
                projectIds,
            },
          },
        });


        await transaction.financingEvent.deleteMany({
          where: {
            projectId: {
              in:
                projectIds,
            },
          },
        });


        await transaction.scenario.deleteMany({
          where: {
            projectId: {
              in:
                projectIds,
            },
          },
        });


        await transaction.project.deleteMany({
          where: {
            userId:
              userId,
          },
        });
      }


      await transaction.user.delete({
        where: {
          id:
            userId,
        },
      });
    },
  );


  await signOut({
    redirectTo:
      "/?account=deleted",
  });
}

    string,

  };

    redirect(
      "/login",
    );

    await searchParams;

    params.status

        messages[
          params.status
        ]

export default function WorkspaceError({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error:
    Error & {
      digest?:
        string;
    };

  reset:
    () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(
    () => {
      console.error(
        "VentureScope workspace error",
        {
          digest:
            error.digest ??
            null,
        },
      );
    },
    [
      error.digest,
    ],
  );

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl p-6 lg:p-10">
      <Card className="border-destructive/30">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-destructive/10 text-destructive">
            <CircleAlert
              className="size-5"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
          </div>

          <CardTitle className="mt-4">
            We could not load this workspace
          </CardTitle>

          <CardDescription className="max-w-2xl leading-6">
            The request failed safely. VentureScope does not expose database, authentication, stack-trace or internal service details here.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent>
          {error.digest ? (
            <p className="mb-5 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Reference: {
                error.digest
              }
            </p>
          ) : null}

          <Button
            type="button"
            onClick={
              reset
            }
          >
            <RotateCcw
              className="size-4"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />

            Try again

}

import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  hashInvitationToken,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/invitations";

import {
  acceptWorkspaceInvitationAction,
} from "../../workspaces/actions";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Workspace Invitation",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


export default async function InvitationPage({
  params,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      token:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    token,
  } =
    await params;


  const invitation =
    await prisma.workspaceInvitation.findUnique({
      where: {
        tokenHash:
          hashInvitationToken(
            token,
          ),
      },

      include: {
        workspace: {
          select: {
            name:
              true,
          },
        },
      },
    });


  if (
    !invitation ||
    invitation.acceptedAt ||
    invitation.expiresAt <=
      new Date()
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const emailMatches =
    invitation.emailNormalized ===
    user.email;


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-xl px-5 py-12">
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-6">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Workspace invitation
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
          {
            invitation.workspace
              .name
          }
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          You were invited as{" "}
          <strong>
            {
              invitation.role
            }
          </strong>
          .
        </p>

        {
          emailMatches
            ?
              (
                <form
                  action={
                    acceptWorkspaceInvitationAction
                  }
                  className="mt-6"
                >
                  <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="token"
                    value={
                      token
                    }
                  />

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="h-10 rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 text-sm font-medium text-background"
                  >
                    Accept invitation
                  </button>
                </form>
              )
            :
              (
                <div className="mt-6 rounded-lg border p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  This invitation was issued to a different email address.
                </div>
              )
        }
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/activity/page.tsx #####
import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  ActivityCenter,
} from "@/components/activity/activity-center";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  parseProjectAuditCategory,
  parseProjectAuditSeverity,
} from "@/lib/audit/catalog";

import {
  parseProjectAuditMetadata,
} from "@/lib/audit/metadata";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Activity Center",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function searchValue(
  value:
    string |
    string[] |
    undefined,
): string {
  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


export default async function ActivityPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      category?:
        string |
        string[];

      severity?:
        string |
        string[];

      action?:
        string |
        string[];

      actor?:
        string |
        string[];

      q?:
        string |
        string[];
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const raw =
    await searchParams;


  const categoryRaw =
    searchValue(
      raw.category,
    );


  const severityRaw =
    searchValue(
      raw.severity,
    );


  const action =
    searchValue(
      raw.action,
    )
      .toUpperCase()
      .slice(
        0,
        100,
      );


  const actor =
    searchValue(
      raw.actor,
    )
      .slice(
        0,
        100,
      );


  const query =
    searchValue(
      raw.q,
    )
      .slice(
        0,
        150,
      );


  const category =
    categoryRaw &&
    categoryRaw !==
      "ALL"
      ?
        parseProjectAuditCategory(
          categoryRaw,
        )
      :
        null;


  const severity =
    severityRaw &&
    severityRaw !==
      "ALL"
      ?
        parseProjectAuditSeverity(
          severityRaw,
        )
      :
        null;


  const where = {
    projectId,

    ...(category
      ?
        {
          category,
        }
      :
        {}),

    ...(severity
      ?
        {
          severity,
        }
      :
        {}),

    ...(action
      ?
        {
          action: {
            contains:
              action,

            mode:
              "insensitive" as const,
          },
        }
      :
        {}),

    ...(actor
      ?
        {
          actorUserId: {
            contains:
              actor,

            mode:
              "insensitive" as const,
          },
        }
      :
        {}),

    ...(query
      ?
        {
          OR: [
            {
              summary: {
                contains:
                  query,

                mode:
                  "insensitive" as const,
              },
            },

            {
              action: {
                contains:
                  query,

                mode:
                  "insensitive" as const,
              },
            },

            {
              entityType: {
                contains:
                  query,

                mode:
                  "insensitive" as const,
              },
            },

            {
              entityId: {
                contains:
                  query,

                mode:
                  "insensitive" as const,
              },
            },
          ],
        }
      :
        {}),
  };


  const [
    storedEvents,
    total,
    info,
    warning,
    critical,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      prisma.projectAuditEvent.findMany({
        where,

        orderBy: {
          createdAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          250,
      }),

      prisma.projectAuditEvent.count({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectAuditEvent.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          severity:
            "INFO",
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectAuditEvent.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          severity:
            "WARNING",
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectAuditEvent.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          severity:
            "CRITICAL",
        },
      }),
    ]);


  const actorIds =
    [
      ...new Set(
        storedEvents.flatMap(
          (
            event,
          ) =>
            event.actorUserId
              ?
                [
                  event.actorUserId,
                ]
              :
                [],
        ),
      ),
    ];


  const actors =
    actorIds.length >
      0
      ?
        await prisma.user.findMany({
          where: {
            id: {
              in:
                actorIds,
            },
          },

          select: {
            id:
              true,

            name:
              true,

            email:
              true,
          },
        })
      :
        [];


  const actorById =
    new Map(
      actors.map(
        (
          actorRecord,
        ) => [
          actorRecord.id,
          actorRecord.name ??
          actorRecord.email ??
          actorRecord.id,
        ],
      ),
    );


  const events =
    storedEvents.map(
      (
        event,
      ) => ({
        id:
          event.id,

        projectId:
          event.projectId,

        category:
          parseProjectAuditCategory(
            event.category,
          ),

        action:
          event.action,

        severity:
          parseProjectAuditSeverity(
            event.severity,
          ),

        actorUserId:
          event.actorUserId,

        actorLabel:
          event.actorUserId
            ?
              actorById.get(
                event.actorUserId,
              ) ??
              null
            :
              null,

        entityType:
          event.entityType,

        entityId:
          event.entityId,

        summary:
          event.summary,

        metadata:
          parseProjectAuditMetadata(
            event.metadata,
          ),

        createdAt:
          event.createdAt
            .toISOString(),
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Governance &amp; accountability
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Activity Center
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Review the immutable project audit trail across financial close, management decisions, KPI targets, variance explanations, and executive reviews.
        </p>
      </header>

      <ActivityCenter
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        events={
          events
        }
        summary={{
          total,

          info,

          warning,

          critical,
        }}
        filters={{
          category:
            category ??
            "ALL",

          severity:
            severity ??
            "ALL",

          action,

          actor,

          query,
        }}
      />
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/actuals/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  parseActualsCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/csv";

import {
  clearProjectActuals,
  importActualPeriods,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/service";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


function errorMessage(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        180,
      )
    :
      "Unable to import actuals.";
}


export async function importActualsAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  const uploaded =
    formData.get(
      "actualsCsv",
    );


  let failure:
    string |
    null =
      null;

  let imported =
    0;


  try {
    if (
      !(uploaded instanceof File) ||
      uploaded.size ===
        0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Choose a CSV file containing monthly actual financials.",
      );
    }


    if (
      uploaded.size >
      512 *
      1024
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Actuals CSV exceeds the 512 KB limit.",
      );
    }


    const rows =
      parseActualsCsv(
        await uploaded.text(),
      );


    const result =
      await importActualPeriods({
        projectId,

        actorUserId:
          user.id,

        rows,
      });


    imported =
      result.imported;
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    failure =
      errorMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/actuals`,
  );


  if (
    failure
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/actuals?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        failure,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/actuals?status=imported&count=${imported}`,
  );
}


export async function clearActualsAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  const confirmation =
    formString(
      formData,
      "confirmation",
    );


  if (
    confirmation !==
    "CLEAR ACTUALS"
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/actuals?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        "Type CLEAR ACTUALS to confirm deletion.",
      )}`,
    );
  }


  const result =
    await clearProjectActuals({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,
    });


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/actuals`,
  );


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/actuals?status=cleared&count=${result.count}`,
  );
}

export default async function ActualsPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      count?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    storedActuals,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          `${row.period
            .getUTCFullYear()
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              4,
              "0",
            )}-${(
            row.period.getUTCMonth() +
            1
          )
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              2,
              "0",
            )}`,

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Performance management
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Actuals vs forecast
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Compare observed monthly performance with the VentureScope financial plan, identify favorable and unfavorable variances, and keep a rolling record of execution.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        status.status
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  status.status ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  status.status ===
                    "imported"
                    ?
                      `Imported or updated ${status.count ?? "0"} monthly actual periods.`
                    :
                    status.status ===
                      "cleared"
                      ?
                        `Cleared ${status.count ?? "0"} actual periods.`
                      :
                        status.message ??
                        "The Actuals operation could not be completed."

            )
          :
            null
      }

      <ActualsVarianceWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }

          actuals
        }
      />

  );
}

"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  markProjectAlertsRead,
  updateProjectAlertReceipt,
} from "@/lib/notifications/service";

import {
  parseAlertFingerprint,
  parseAlertKey,
  parseAlertReceiptOperation,
} from "@/lib/notifications/validation";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


async function requireAlertProjectAccess(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      userId,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Project access is required to manage this alert inbox.",
    );
  }
}


export async function updateAlertReceiptAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireAlertProjectAccess(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  const alertKey =
    parseAlertKey(
      formString(
        formData,
        "alertKey",
      ),
    );


  const fingerprint =
    parseAlertFingerprint(
      formString(
        formData,
        "fingerprint",
      ),
    );


  const operation =
    parseAlertReceiptOperation(
      formString(
        formData,
        "operation",
      ),
    );


  await updateProjectAlertReceipt({
    projectId,

    userId:
      user.id,

    alertKey,

    fingerprint,

    operation,
  });


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/alerts`,
  );


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/alerts?status=updated`,
  );
}


export async function markAllAlertsReadAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireAlertProjectAccess(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  const raw =
    formString(
      formData,
      "alerts",
    );


  let parsed:
    unknown;


  try {
    parsed =
      JSON.parse(
        raw,
      );
  }
  catch {
    throw new Error(
      "Alert batch is invalid.",
    );
  }


  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      parsed,
    ) ||
    parsed.length >
      100
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Alert batch may contain at most 100 alerts.",
    );
  }


  const alerts =
    parsed.map(
      (
        item,
      ) => {
        if (
          typeof item !==
            "object" ||
          item ===
            null ||
          Array.isArray(
            item,
          )
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Alert batch entry is invalid.",
          );
        }


        const record =
          item as
            Record<
              string,
              unknown
            >;


        if (
          typeof record.alertKey !==
            "string" ||
          typeof record.fingerprint !==
            "string"
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Alert batch entry is incomplete.",
          );
        }


        return {
          alertKey:
            parseAlertKey(
              record.alertKey,
            ),

          fingerprint:
            parseAlertFingerprint(
              record.fingerprint,
            ),
        };
      },
    );


  await markProjectAlertsRead({
    projectId,

    userId:
      user.id,

    alerts,
  });


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/alerts`,
  );


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/alerts?status=all-read`,
  );
}

export default async function AlertInboxPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {

  }


  const [
    storedActuals,
    storedPolicy,
    storedTargets,
    storedCommentaries,
    storedStates,
    storedActions,
    storedAuditEvents,

    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },

      prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findUnique({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            periodKey:
              "asc",
          },

          {
            metricCode:
              "asc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          120,
      }),

      prisma.varianceCommentary.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            periodKey:
              "asc",
          },

          {
            metricCode:
              "asc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          1000,
      }),

      prisma.financialPeriodState.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.decisionAction.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          createdAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          200,
      }),

      prisma.projectAuditEvent.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,

          severity: {
            in: [
              "WARNING",
              "CRITICAL",
            ],
          },
        },

        orderBy: {
          createdAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          30,
      }),

      prisma.projectAlertReceipt.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,

          userId:
            user.id,
        },

        orderBy: {
          updatedAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          200,
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
            row.period,
          ),

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  const latestActual =
    actuals[
      actuals.length -
      1
    ] ??

  const riskPolicy =
    storedPolicy
      ?

          minimumCash:

          minimumRunwayMonths:

    );


  const auditEvents =

        if (

                {

                    :

      }

      <AlertInboxWorkspace

        }
        currency={

        }
        generatedAt={
          generatedAt
        }
        actuals={
          actuals
        }

        }

        }
        commentaries={
          commentaries
        }
        periodStates={
          periodStates
        }
        actions={
          actions
        }
        auditEvents={
          auditEvents
        }
        receipts={
          receipts
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/approvals/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  requireProjectWorkspaceOwner,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/access";

import {
  cancelApprovalRequest,
  createApprovalRequest,
  decideApprovalRequest,
} from "@/lib/approvals/service";

import {
  parseApprovalDecision,
  parseApprovalRequestType,
  parseApprovalSubjectValue,
} from "@/lib/approvals/validation";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


function nullableString(
  value:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  return value
    ?
      value
    :
      null;
}


function failureMessage(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        220,
      )
    :
      "Approval workflow operation failed.";
}


function revalidateApprovalSurfaces(
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/approvals`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/activity`,
  );
}


export async function createApprovalRequestAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const title =
      formString(
        formData,
        "title",
      );


    if (
      title.length <
        5 ||
      title.length >
        160
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Approval title must contain between 5 and 160 characters.",
      );
    }


    const description =
      formString(
        formData,
        "description",
      );


    if (
      description.length >
      3000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Approval description cannot exceed 3000 characters.",
      );
    }


    await createApprovalRequest({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      requestType:
        parseApprovalRequestType(
          formString(
            formData,
            "requestType",
          ),
        ),

      subjectType:
        parseApprovalSubjectValue(
          formString(
            formData,
            "subjectType",
          ),
          "Subject type",
        ),

      subjectId:
        parseApprovalSubjectValue(
          formString(
            formData,
            "subjectId",
          ),
          "Subject ID",
        ),

      title,

      description:
        nullableString(
          description,
        ),
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failureMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidateApprovalSurfaces(
    projectId,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/approvals?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/approvals?status=requested`,
  );
}


export async function decideApprovalRequestAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectWorkspaceOwner(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const requestId =
      formString(
        formData,
        "requestId",
      );


    if (
      !requestId
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Approval request ID is required.",
      );
    }


    const decisionNote =
      formString(
        formData,
        "decisionNote",
      );


    if (
      decisionNote.length <
        5 ||
      decisionNote.length >
        2000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Decision rationale must contain between 5 and 2000 characters.",
      );
    }


    await decideApprovalRequest({
      projectId,

      requestId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      decision:
        parseApprovalDecision(
          formString(
            formData,
            "decision",
          ),
        ),

      decisionNote,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failureMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidateApprovalSurfaces(
    projectId,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/approvals?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/approvals?status=decided`,
  );
}


export async function cancelApprovalRequestAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Project access is required.",
    );
  }


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const requestId =
      formString(
        formData,
        "requestId",
      );


    if (
      !requestId
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Approval request ID is required.",
      );
    }


    await cancelApprovalRequest({
      projectId,

      requestId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failureMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidateApprovalSurfaces(
    projectId,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/approvals?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/approvals?status=cancelled`,
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/approvals/page.tsx #####
import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  ApprovalCenter,
} from "@/components/approvals/approval-center";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  isProjectWorkspaceOwner,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/access";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
  getProjectForEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  parseApprovalRequestStatus,
  parseApprovalRequestType,
} from "@/lib/approvals/validation";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Approval Center",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function searchValue(
  value:
    string |
    string[] |
    undefined,
): string {
  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


export default async function ApprovalCenterPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      approvalStatus?:
        string |
        string[];

      requestType?:
        string |
        string[];

      q?:
        string |
        string[];

      status?:
        string |
        string[];

      message?:
        string |
        string[];
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const raw =
    await searchParams;


  const statusRaw =
    searchValue(
      raw.approvalStatus,
    );


  const requestTypeRaw =
    searchValue(
      raw.requestType,
    );


  const query =
    searchValue(
      raw.q,
    )
      .slice(
        0,
        160,
      );


  const statusFilter =
    statusRaw &&
    statusRaw !==
      "ALL"
      ?
        parseApprovalRequestStatus(
          statusRaw,
        )
      :
        null;


  const requestTypeFilter =
    requestTypeRaw &&
    requestTypeRaw !==
      "ALL"
      ?
        parseApprovalRequestType(
          requestTypeRaw,
        )
      :
        null;


  const where = {
    projectId,

    ...(statusFilter
      ?
        {
          status:
            statusFilter,
        }
      :
        {}),

    ...(requestTypeFilter
      ?
        {
          requestType:
            requestTypeFilter,
        }
      :
        {}),

    ...(query
      ?
        {
          OR: [
            {
              title: {
                contains:
                  query,

                mode:
                  "insensitive" as const,
              },
            },

            {
              description: {
                contains:
                  query,

                mode:
                  "insensitive" as const,
              },
            },

            {
              subjectType: {
                contains:
                  query,

                mode:
                  "insensitive" as const,
              },
            },

            {
              subjectId: {
                contains:
                  query,

                mode:
                  "insensitive" as const,
              },
            },
          ],
        }
      :
        {}),
  };


  const [
    editorProject,
    owner,
    storedRequests,
    total,
    pending,
    approved,
    rejected,
    cancelled,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      isProjectWorkspaceOwner(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.approvalRequest.findMany({
        where,

        include: {
          requestedBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },

          decidedBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: {
          requestedAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          250,
      }),

      prisma.approvalRequest.count({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.approvalRequest.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          status:
            "PENDING",
        },
      }),

      prisma.approvalRequest.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          status:
            "APPROVED",
        },
      }),

      prisma.approvalRequest.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          status:
            "REJECTED",
        },
      }),

      prisma.approvalRequest.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          status:
            "CANCELLED",
        },
      }),
    ]);


  const requests =
    storedRequests.map(
      (
        request,
      ) => ({
        id:
          request.id,

        projectId:
          request.projectId,

        requestType:
          parseApprovalRequestType(
            request.requestType,
          ),

        subjectType:
          request.subjectType,

        subjectId:
          request.subjectId,

        title:
          request.title,

        description:
          request.description,

        status:
          parseApprovalRequestStatus(
            request.status,
          ),

        requestedByUserId:
          request.requestedByUserId,

        requesterLabel:
          request.requestedBy?.name ??
          request.requestedBy?.email ??
          null,

        requestedAt:
          request.requestedAt
            .toISOString(),

        decidedByUserId:
          request.decidedByUserId,

        deciderLabel:
          request.decidedBy?.name ??
          request.decidedBy?.email ??
          null,

        decidedAt:
          request.decidedAt
            ?.toISOString() ??
          null,

        decisionNote:
          request.decisionNote,

        cancelledAt:
          request.cancelledAt
            ?.toISOString() ??
          null,
      }),
    );


  const operationStatus =
    searchValue(
      raw.status,
    );


  const operationMessage =
    searchValue(
      raw.message,
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Governance &amp; authorization
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Approval Center
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Submit material management decisions for formal authorization, preserve requester-versus-approver separation, document decision rationale, and retain an auditable approval history.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        operationStatus
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  operationStatus ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  operationStatus ===
                    "requested"
                    ?
                      "Approval request submitted successfully."
                    :
                  operationStatus ===
                    "decided"
                    ?
                      "Approval decision recorded successfully."
                    :
                  operationStatus ===
                    "cancelled"
                    ?
                      "Approval request cancelled successfully."
                    :
                      operationMessage ||
                      "Approval workflow operation failed."
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <ApprovalCenter
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currentUserId={
          user.id
        }
        canRequest={
          Boolean(
            editorProject,
          )
        }
        canDecide={
          owner
        }
        summary={{
          total,

          pending,

          approved,

          rejected,

          cancelled,
        }}
        requests={
          requests
        }
        filters={{
          status:
            statusFilter ??
            "ALL",

          requestType:
            requestTypeFilter ??
            "ALL",

          query,
        }}
      />
    </main>
  );
}

import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  BoardPackWorkspace,
} from "@/components/board-pack/board-pack-workspace";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  parseKpiMetricCode,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/metrics";

import {
  parseVarianceCauseCode,
  parseVarianceCommentaryStatus,
  parseVarianceMetricCode,
  parseVarianceNature,

import {
  financialPeriodKeyFromDate,
  parseFinancialPeriodStatus,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/validation";

import {
  parseExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/validation";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Board Pack",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function BoardPackPage({
  params,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const generatedAt =
    new Date()
      .toISOString();


  const [
    storedActuals,
    storedPolicy,
    storedTargets,
    storedCommentaries,
    storedStates,
    storedActions,
    latestReview,
    auditTotal,
    auditWarning,
    auditCritical,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findUnique({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectKpiTarget.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            periodKey:
              "desc",
          },

          {
            metricCode:
              "asc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          120,
      }),

      prisma.varianceCommentary.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            periodKey:
              "desc",
          },

          {
            metricCode:
              "asc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          1000,
      }),

      prisma.financialPeriodState.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "desc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.decisionAction.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            createdAt:
              "desc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          100,
      }),

      prisma.executiveReview.findFirst({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: {
          createdAt:
            "desc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectAuditEvent.count({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectAuditEvent.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          severity:
            "WARNING",
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectAuditEvent.count({
        where: {
          projectId,

          severity:
            "CRITICAL",
        },
      }),
    ]);


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
            row.period,
          ),

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  const riskPolicy =
    storedPolicy
      ?
        {
          minimumCash:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumCash,
            ),

          minimumRunwayMonths:
            storedPolicy.minimumRunwayMonths,

          minimumEbitdaMargin:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
            ),

          maximumMonthlyBurn:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
            ),

          downsideRevenueShock:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideRevenueShock
                .toString(),
            ),

          downsideCostInflation:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideCostInflation
                .toString(),
            ),
        }
      :
        DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY;


  const latestActual =
    actuals[
      actuals.length -
      1
    ] ??
    null;


  const targets =
    storedTargets.map(
      (
        target,
      ) => ({
        id:
          target.id,

        periodKey:
          target.periodKey,

        metricCode:
          parseKpiMetricCode(
            target.metricCode,
          ),

        targetValue:
          Number(
            target.targetValue
              .toString(),
          ),

        ownerName:
          target.ownerName,

        note:
          target.note,

        createdAt:
          target.createdAt
            .toISOString(),

        updatedAt:
          target.updatedAt
            .toISOString(),

        createdBy:
          target.createdBy?.name ??
          target.createdBy?.email ??
          null,
      }),
    );


  const commentaries =
    storedCommentaries.map(
      (
        commentary,
      ) => ({
        id:
          commentary.id,

        periodKey:
          commentary.periodKey,

        metricCode:
          parseVarianceMetricCode(
            commentary.metricCode,
          ),

        causeCode:
          parseVarianceCauseCode(
            commentary.causeCode,
          ),

        varianceNature:
          parseVarianceNature(
            commentary.varianceNature,
          ),

        explanation:
          commentary.explanation,

        correctiveAction:
          commentary.correctiveAction,

        ownerName:
          commentary.ownerName,

        recoveryPeriodKey:
          commentary.recoveryPeriodKey,

        status:
          parseVarianceCommentaryStatus(
            commentary.status,
          ),

        createdAt:
          commentary.createdAt
            .toISOString(),

        updatedAt:
          commentary.updatedAt
            .toISOString(),

        createdBy:
          commentary.createdBy?.name ??
          commentary.createdBy?.email ??
          null,
      }),
    );


  const periodStates =
    storedStates.map(
      (
        state,
      ) => ({
        id:
          state.id,

        periodKey:
          financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
            state.period,
          ),

        status:
          parseFinancialPeriodStatus(
            state.status,
          ),

        closeSequence:
          state.closeSequence,

        closedAt:
          state.closedAt
            ?.toISOString() ??
          null,

        closedByUserId:
          state.closedByUserId,

        reopenedAt:
          state.reopenedAt
            ?.toISOString() ??
          null,

        reopenedByUserId:
          state.reopenedByUserId,
      }),
    );


  const actions =
    storedActions.map(
      (
        action,
      ) => ({
        id:
          action.id,

        title:
          action.title,

        priority:
          action.priority,

        status:
          action.status,

        ownerName:
          action.ownerName,

        dueDate:
          action.dueDate
            ?.toISOString() ??
          null,

        sourceCode:
          action.sourceCode,
      }),
    );


  const defaultReportPeriod =
    latestActual?.period ??
    generatedAt.slice(
      0,
      7,
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header className="board-pack-print-hidden">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Executive reporting
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Board Pack
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Assemble VentureScope&apos;s existing financial, operating, governance, and management intelligence into a board-ready reporting package that can be printed or saved as PDF.
        </p>
      </header>

      <BoardPackWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        projectName={
          project.name
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        modelVersion={
          project.modelVersion
        }
        generatedAt={
          generatedAt
        }
        defaultReportPeriod={
          defaultReportPeriod
        }
        actuals={
          actuals
        }
        riskPolicy={
          riskPolicy
        }
        latestActualPeriod={
          latestActual?.period ??
          null
        }
        latestActualCash={
          latestActual?.cashBalance ??
          null
        }
        targets={
          targets
        }
        commentaries={
          commentaries
        }
        periodStates={
          periodStates
        }
        actions={
          actions
        }
        latestReview={
          latestReview
            ?
              {
                id:
                  latestReview.id,

                periodKey:
                  latestReview.periodKey,

                title:
                  latestReview.title,

                modelVersion:
                  latestReview.modelVersion,

                createdAt:
                  latestReview.createdAt
                    .toISOString(),

                createdBy:
                  latestReview.createdBy?.name ??
                  latestReview.createdBy?.email ??
                  null,

                snapshot:
                  parseExecutiveReviewSnapshot(
                    latestReview.snapshot,
                  ),
              }
            :
              null
        }
        auditSummary={{
          total:
            auditTotal,

          warning:
            auditWarning,

          critical:
            auditCritical,
        }}
      />
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/board-room/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/snapshot";

import {
  parseExecutiveReviewPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/validation";

import {
  createExecutiveReview,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/service";


const MAX_FORECAST_CSV_BYTES =
  512 *
  1024;


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


function failureMessage(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        180,
      )
    :
      "Unable to freeze executive review.";
}


export async function createExecutiveReviewAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  const project =
    await requireProjectEditor(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;

  let createdPeriod =
    "";


  try {
    const title =
      formString(
        formData,
        "title",
      );


    if (
      title.length <
        3 ||
      title.length >
        120
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Review title must contain between 3 and 120 characters.",
      );
    }


    const commentary =
      formString(
        formData,
        "commentary",
      );


    if (
      commentary.length >
      4000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Management commentary cannot exceed 4000 characters.",
      );
    }


    createdPeriod =
      parseExecutiveReviewPeriod(
        formString(
          formData,
          "periodKey",
        ),
      );


    const forecastCsv =
      formString(
        formData,
        "forecastCsv",
      );


    if (
      !forecastCsv
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Current forecast data is unavailable.",
      );
    }


    if (
      Buffer.byteLength(
        forecastCsv,
        "utf8",
      ) >
      MAX_FORECAST_CSV_BYTES
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Forecast snapshot exceeds the 512 KB safety limit.",
      );
    }


    const forecasts =
      normalizeForecastCsv(
        forecastCsv,
      );


    if (
      forecasts.length ===
      0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Current forecast contains no usable periods.",
      );
    }


    const [
      storedActuals,
      storedPolicy,
      storedActions,
    ] =
      await Promise.all([
        prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
          where: {
            projectId,
          },

          orderBy: {
            period:
              "asc",
          },
        }),

        prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findUnique({
          where: {
            projectId,
          },
        }),

        prisma.decisionAction.findMany({
          where: {
            projectId,
          },

          select: {
            status:
              true,

            priority:
              true,

            dueDate:
              true,
          },
        }),
      ]);


    const actuals =
      storedActuals.map(
        (
          row,
        ) => ({
          period:
            `${row.period
              .getUTCFullYear()
              .toString()
              .padStart(
                4,
                "0",
              )}-${(
              row.period.getUTCMonth() +
              1
            )
              .toString()
              .padStart(
                2,
                "0",
              )}`,

          revenue:
            decimalNumber(
              row.revenue,
            ),

          cogs:
            decimalNumber(
              row.cogs,
            ),

          operatingExpenses:
            decimalNumber(
              row.operatingExpenses,
            ),

          ebitda:
            decimalNumber(
              row.ebitda,
            ),

          netIncome:
            decimalNumber(
              row.netIncome,
            ),

          cashFlow:
            decimalNumber(
              row.cashFlow,
            ),

          cashBalance:
            decimalNumber(
              row.cashBalance,
            ),

          mrr:
            decimalNumber(
              row.mrr,
            ),

          customers:
            row.customers,
        }),
      );


    const riskPolicy =
      storedPolicy
        ?
          {
            minimumCash:
              decimalNumber(
                storedPolicy.minimumCash,
              ),

            minimumRunwayMonths:
              storedPolicy.minimumRunwayMonths,

            minimumEbitdaMargin:
              decimalNumber(
                storedPolicy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
              ),

            maximumMonthlyBurn:
              decimalNumber(
                storedPolicy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
              ),

            downsideRevenueShock:
              Number(
                storedPolicy
                  .downsideRevenueShock
                  .toString(),
              ),

            downsideCostInflation:
              Number(
                storedPolicy
                  .downsideCostInflation
                  .toString(),
              ),
          }
        :
          DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY;


    const latestActual =
      actuals[
        actuals.length -
        1
      ] ??
      null;


    const capturedAt =
      new Date()
        .toISOString();


    const snapshot =
      buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot({
        capturedAt,

        actuals,

        forecasts,

        riskPolicy,

        latestActualPeriod:
          latestActual?.period ??
          null,

        latestActualCash:
          latestActual?.cashBalance ??
          null,

        actions:
          storedActions.map(
            (
              action,
            ) => ({
              status:
                action.status,

              priority:
                action.priority,

              dueDate:
                action.dueDate
                  ?.toISOString() ??
                null,
            }),
          ),
      });


    await createExecutiveReview({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      periodKey:
        createdPeriod,

      title,

      commentary:
        commentary
          ?
            commentary
          :
            null,

      modelVersion:
        project.modelVersion,

      snapshot,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failureMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/board-room`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/board-room?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/board-room?status=created&period=${encodeURIComponent(
      createdPeriod,
    )}`,
  );
}

export default function BoardRoomLoading() {
  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl animate-pulse space-y-6 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8">
      <div className="h-9 w-72 rounded bg-muted" />

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        {
          Array.from({
            length:
              4,
          }).map(
            (
              _,
              index,
            ) => (
              <div
                key={
                  index
                }
                className="h-28 rounded-xl bg-muted"
              />
            ),
          )
        }
      </div>

      <div className="h-72 rounded-xl bg-muted" />

      <div className="h-64 rounded-xl bg-muted" />
    </main>
  );
}

export default async function BoardRoomPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      period?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const liveCapturedAt =
    new Date()
      .toISOString();


  const [
    editableProject,
    storedActuals,
    storedPolicy,
    storedActions,
    storedReviews,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findUnique({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.decisionAction.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        select: {
          status:
            true,

          priority:
            true,

          dueDate:
            true,
        },
      }),

      prisma.executiveReview.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: {
          createdAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          48,
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          `${row.period
            .getUTCFullYear()
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              4,
              "0",
            )}-${(
            row.period.getUTCMonth() +
            1
          )
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              2,
              "0",
            )}`,

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  const riskPolicy =
    storedPolicy
      ?
        {
          minimumCash:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumCash,
            ),

          minimumRunwayMonths:
            storedPolicy.minimumRunwayMonths,

          minimumEbitdaMargin:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
            ),

          maximumMonthlyBurn:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
            ),

          downsideRevenueShock:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideRevenueShock
                .toString(),
            ),

          downsideCostInflation:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideCostInflation
                .toString(),
            ),
        }
      :
        DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY;


  const latestActual =
    actuals[
      actuals.length -
      1
    ] ??
    null;


  const reviews =
    storedReviews.map(
      (
        review,
      ) => ({
        id:
          review.id,

        periodKey:
          review.periodKey,

        title:
          review.title,

        commentary:
          review.commentary,

        modelVersion:
          review.modelVersion,

        createdAt:
          review.createdAt
            .toISOString(),

        createdBy:
          review.createdBy?.name ??
          review.createdBy?.email ??
          null,

        snapshot:
          parseExecutiveReviewSnapshot(
            review.snapshot,
          ),
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Governance &amp; executive review
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Board Room
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Run executive financial reviews, freeze historical management snapshots, and compare prior board-level assessments with the live VentureScope model.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        status.status
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  status.status ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  status.status ===
                    "created"
                    ?
                      `Executive review for ${status.period ?? ""} was frozen successfully.`
                    :
                      status.message ??
                      "The Board Room operation could not be completed."
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <BoardRoomWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }
        actuals={
          actuals
        }
        riskPolicy={
          riskPolicy
        }
        latestActualPeriod={
          latestActual?.period ??
          null
        }
        latestActualCash={
          latestActual?.cashBalance ??
          null
        }
        actionStates={
          storedActions.map(
            (
              action,
            ) => ({
              status:
                action.status,

              priority:
                action.priority,

              dueDate:
                action.dueDate
                  ?.toISOString() ??
                null,
            }),
          )
        }
        reviews={
          reviews
        }
        liveCapturedAt={
          liveCapturedAt
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/capital-planning/page.tsx #####
import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  CapitalPlanningWorkspace,
} from "@/components/capital-planning/capital-planning-workspace";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
  getProjectForEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Capital Planning",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function CapitalPlanningPage({
  params,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    storedPolicy,
    latestActual,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findUnique({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findFirst({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "desc",
        },

        select: {
          period:
            true,

          cashBalance:
            true,
        },
      }),
    ]);


  const riskPolicy =
    storedPolicy
      ?
        {
          minimumCash:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumCash,
            ),

          minimumRunwayMonths:
            storedPolicy.minimumRunwayMonths,

          minimumEbitdaMargin:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
            ),

          maximumMonthlyBurn:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
            ),

          downsideRevenueShock:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideRevenueShock
                .toString(),
            ),

          downsideCostInflation:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideCostInflation
                .toString(),
            ),
        }
      :
        DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY;


  const latestActualPeriod =
    latestActual
      ?
        `${latestActual.period
          .getUTCFullYear()
          .toString()
          .padStart(
            4,
            "0",
          )}-${(
          latestActual.period.getUTCMonth() +
          1
        )
          .toString()
          .padStart(
            2,
            "0",
          )}`
      :
        null;


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Capital allocation
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Funding Strategy &amp; Capital Planning
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Quantify the funding gap needed to protect liquidity and compare the modeled cash, dilution, and debt-service consequences of equity, debt, and hybrid capital structures.
        </p>
      </header>

      <CapitalPlanningWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }
        riskPolicy={
          riskPolicy
        }
        latestActualPeriod={
          latestActualPeriod
        }
        latestActualCash={
          decimalNumber(
            latestActual?.cashBalance ??
            null,
          )
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}
