##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/consolidation/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  requireProjectWorkspaceOwner,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/access";

import {
  deleteWorkspaceFxRate,
  saveConsolidationSettings,
  saveWorkspaceFxRate,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/service";

import {
  assertDistinctCurrencyPair,
  parseFxDate,
  parseFxRate,
  parseFxSourceLabel,
  parseVentureScopeCurrency,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/validation";


function value(
  formData:
    FormData,
  key:
    string,
): string {
  const raw =
    formData.get(
      key,
    );


  return typeof raw ===
    "string"
    ?
      raw.trim()
    :
      "";
}


async function workspaceContext(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  await requireProjectWorkspaceOwner(
    userId,
    projectId,
  );


  const workspaceProject =
    await prisma.project.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,
      },

      select: {
        workspaceId:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !workspaceProject?.workspaceId
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Project workspace is unavailable.",
    );
  }


  return {
    workspaceId:
      workspaceProject.workspaceId,
  };
}


function refresh(
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/consolidation`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/activity`,
  );
}


export async function saveConsolidationSettingsAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    value(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  const context =
    await workspaceContext(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  await saveConsolidationSettings({
    projectId,

    workspaceId:
      context.workspaceId,

    actorUserId:
      user.id,

    reportingCurrency:
      parseVentureScopeCurrency(
        value(
          formData,
          "reportingCurrency",
        ),
      ),
  });


  refresh(
    projectId,
  );


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/consolidation?status=settings-saved`,
  );
}


export async function saveWorkspaceFxRateAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    value(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  const context =
    await workspaceContext(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  const baseCurrency =
    parseVentureScopeCurrency(
      value(
        formData,
        "baseCurrency",
      ),
    );


  const quoteCurrency =
    parseVentureScopeCurrency(
      value(
        formData,
        "quoteCurrency",
      ),
    );


  assertDistinctCurrencyPair({
    baseCurrency,

    quoteCurrency,
  });


  const effectiveDate =
    parseFxDate(
      value(
        formData,
        "effectiveDate",
      ),
    );


  await saveWorkspaceFxRate({
    projectId,

    workspaceId:
      context.workspaceId,

    actorUserId:
      user.id,

    baseCurrency,

    quoteCurrency,

    rate:
      parseFxRate(
        value(
          formData,
          "rate",
        ),
      ),

    effectiveDate:
      new Date(
        `${effectiveDate}T00:00:00.000Z`,
      ),

    sourceLabel:
      parseFxSourceLabel(
        value(
          formData,
          "sourceLabel",
        ),
      ),
  });


  refresh(
    projectId,
  );


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/consolidation?status=rate-saved`,
  );
}


export async function deleteWorkspaceFxRateAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    value(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  const context =
    await workspaceContext(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  const rateId =
    value(
      formData,
      "rateId",
    );


  if (
    !rateId
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "FX rate ID is required.",
    );
  }


  await deleteWorkspaceFxRate({
    projectId,

    workspaceId:
      context.workspaceId,

    actorUserId:
      user.id,

    rateId,
  });


  refresh(
    projectId,
  );


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/consolidation?status=rate-deleted`,
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/consolidation/page.tsx #####
import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  ConsolidationWorkspace,
} from "@/components/consolidation/consolidation-workspace";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  financialPeriodKeyFromDate,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/validation";

import {
  isProjectWorkspaceOwner,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/access";

import {
  parseVentureScopeCurrency,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/validation";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Consolidation Center",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function ConsolidationCenterPage({
  params,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const currentProject =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !currentProject
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const workspaceProject =
    await prisma.project.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,
      },

      select: {
        workspaceId:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !workspaceProject?.workspaceId
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const workspaceId =
    workspaceProject.workspaceId;


  const [
    editable,
    settings,
    storedRates,
    projects,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      isProjectWorkspaceOwner(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.workspaceConsolidationSettings.findUnique({
        where: {
          workspaceId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.workspaceFxRate.findMany({
        where: {
          workspaceId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            effectiveDate:
              "desc",
          },

          {
            baseCurrency:
              "asc",
          },

          {
            quoteCurrency:
              "asc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          500,
      }),

      prisma.project.findMany({
        where: {
          workspaceId,
        },

        select: {
          id:
            true,

          name:
            true,

          industry:
            true,

          currency:
            true,
        },

        orderBy: {
          name:
            "asc",
        },

        take:
          24,
      }),
    ]);


  const projectIds =
    projects.map(
      (
        project,
      ) =>
        project.id,
    );


  const [
    storedActuals,
    storedPolicies,
    storedActions,
  ] =
    projectIds.length >
      0
      ?
        await Promise.all([
          prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
            where: {
              projectId: {
                in:
                  projectIds,
              },
            },

            orderBy: {
              period:
                "asc",
            },
          }),

          prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findMany({
            where: {
              projectId: {
                in:
                  projectIds,
              },
            },
          }),

          prisma.decisionAction.findMany({
            where: {
              projectId: {
                in:
                  projectIds,
              },
            },

            take:
              1000,
          }),
        ])
      :
        [
          [],
          [],
          [],
        ];


  const actualsByProject =
    new Map<
      string,
      typeof storedActuals
    >();


  for (
    const actual
    of storedActuals
  ) {
    const rows =
      actualsByProject.get(
        actual.projectId,
      ) ??
      [];


    rows.push(
      actual,
    );


    actualsByProject.set(
      actual.projectId,
      rows,
    );
  }


  const policies =
    new Map(
      storedPolicies.map(
        (
          policy,
        ) => [
          policy.projectId,
          policy,
        ],
      ),
    );


  const actions =
    new Map<
      string,
      typeof storedActions
    >();


  for (
    const action
    of storedActions
  ) {
    const rows =
      actions.get(
        action.projectId,
      ) ??
      [];


    rows.push(
      action,
    );


    actions.set(
      action.projectId,
      rows,
    );
  }


  const sources =
    projects.map(
      (
        project,
      ) => {
        const sourceActuals =
          (
            actualsByProject.get(
              project.id,
            ) ??
            []
          ).map(
            (
              row,
            ) => ({
              period:
                financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
                  row.period,
                ),

              revenue:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.revenue,
                ),

              cogs:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.cogs,
                ),

              operatingExpenses:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.operatingExpenses,
                ),

              ebitda:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.ebitda,
                ),

              netIncome:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.netIncome,
                ),

              cashFlow:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.cashFlow,
                ),

              cashBalance:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.cashBalance,
                ),

              mrr:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.mrr,
                ),

              customers:
                row.customers,
            }),
          );


        const latest =
          sourceActuals[
            sourceActuals.length -
            1
          ] ??
          null;


        const policy =
          policies.get(
            project.id,
          );


        return {
          id:
            project.id,

          name:
            project.name,

          industry:
            project.industry ??
            "",

          currency:
            parseVentureScopeCurrency(
              project.currency,
            ),

          actuals:
            sourceActuals,

          riskPolicy:
            policy
              ?
                {
                  minimumCash:
                    decimalNumber(
                      policy.minimumCash,
                    ),

                  minimumRunwayMonths:
                    policy.minimumRunwayMonths,

                  minimumEbitdaMargin:
                    decimalNumber(
                      policy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
                    ),

                  maximumMonthlyBurn:
                    decimalNumber(
                      policy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
                    ),

                  downsideRevenueShock:
                    Number(
                      policy.downsideRevenueShock
                        .toString(),
                    ),

                  downsideCostInflation:
                    Number(
                      policy.downsideCostInflation
                        .toString(),
                    ),
                }
              :
                DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,

          latestActualPeriod:
            latest?.period ??
            null,

          latestActualCash:
            latest?.cashBalance ??
            null,

          actions:
            (
              actions.get(
                project.id,
              ) ??
              []
            ).map(
              (
                action,
              ) => ({
                status:
                  action.status,

                priority:
                  action.priority,

                dueDate:
                  action.dueDate
                    ?.toISOString() ??
                  null,
              }),
            ),
        };
      },
    );


  const rates =
    storedRates.map(
      (
        rate,
      ) => ({
        id:
          rate.id,

        baseCurrency:
          parseVentureScopeCurrency(
            rate.baseCurrency,
          ),

        quoteCurrency:
          parseVentureScopeCurrency(
            rate.quoteCurrency,
          ),

        rate:
          Number(
            rate.rate
              .toString(),
          ),

        effectiveDate:
          rate.effectiveDate
            .toISOString()
            .slice(
              0,
              10,
            ),

        sourceLabel:
          rate.sourceLabel,

        createdBy:
          rate.createdBy?.name ??
          rate.createdBy?.email ??
          null,

        createdAt:
          rate.createdAt
            .toISOString(),
      }),
    );


  const reportingCurrency =
    settings
      ?
        parseVentureScopeCurrency(
          settings.reportingCurrency,
        )
      :
        parseVentureScopeCurrency(
          currentProject.currency,
        );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1600px] space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Consolidated financial reporting
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Consolidation Center
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Convert and consolidate workspace project metrics into one reporting currency using manually governed, dated FX rates while preserving original currencies, rate provenance, and explicit missing-rate controls.
        </p>
      </header>

      <ConsolidationWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        generatedAt={
          new Date()
            .toISOString()
        }
        editable={
          editable
        }
        reportingCurrency={
          reportingCurrency
        }
        rates={
          rates
        }
        projects={
          sources
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  createDecisionAction,
  updateDecisionActionStatus,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/service";

import {
  parseDecisionDueDate,
  parseDecisionPriority,
  parseDecisionSourceCode,
  parseDecisionStatus,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/validation";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


function nullableString(
  value:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  return value
    ?
      value
    :
      null;
}


function actionError(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        180,
      )
    :
      "Unable to update the management action register.";
}


export async function createDecisionActionAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const title =
      formString(
        formData,
        "title",
      );


    if (
      title.length <
        3 ||
      title.length >
        120
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Action title must contain between 3 and 120 characters.",
      );
    }


    const details =
      formString(
        formData,
        "details",
      );


    if (
      details.length >
      1000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Action details cannot exceed 1000 characters.",
      );
    }


    const ownerName =
      formString(
        formData,
        "ownerName",
      );


    if (
      ownerName.length >
      80
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Action owner cannot exceed 80 characters.",
      );
    }


    await createDecisionAction({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      title,

      details:
        nullableString(
          details,
        ),

      sourceCode:
        parseDecisionSourceCode(
          formString(
            formData,
            "sourceCode",
          ),
        ),

      priority:
        parseDecisionPriority(
          formString(
            formData,
            "priority",
          ),
        ),

      ownerName:
        nullableString(
          ownerName,
        ),

      dueDate:
        parseDecisionDueDate(
          formString(
            formData,
            "dueDate",
          ),
        ),
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      actionError(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/decision-center`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/decision-center?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/decision-center?status=created`,
  );
}


export async function updateDecisionActionStatusAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const actionId =
      formString(
        formData,
        "actionId",
      );


    if (
      !actionId
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Management action ID is required.",
      );
    }


    await updateDecisionActionStatus({
      projectId,

      actionId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      status:
        parseDecisionStatus(
          formString(
            formData,
            "status",
          ),
        ),
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      actionError(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/decision-center`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/decision-center?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/decision-center?status=updated`,
  );
}

import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  DecisionCenterWorkspace,
} from "@/components/decision-center/decision-center-workspace";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  parseDecisionPriority,
  parseDecisionSourceCode,
  parseDecisionStatus,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/validation";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
  getProjectForEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Executive Decision Center",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function DecisionCenterPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    storedActuals,
    storedPolicy,
    storedActions,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findUnique({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.decisionAction.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            createdAt:
              "desc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          100,
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          `${row.period
            .getUTCFullYear()
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              4,
              "0",
            )}-${(
            row.period.getUTCMonth() +
            1
          )
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              2,
              "0",
            )}`,

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  const riskPolicy =
    storedPolicy
      ?
        {
          minimumCash:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumCash,
            ),

          minimumRunwayMonths:
            storedPolicy.minimumRunwayMonths,

          minimumEbitdaMargin:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
            ),

          maximumMonthlyBurn:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
            ),

          downsideRevenueShock:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideRevenueShock
                .toString(),
            ),

          downsideCostInflation:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideCostInflation
                .toString(),
            ),
        }
      :
        DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY;


  const latestActual =
    actuals[
      actuals.length -
      1
    ] ??
    null;


  const actions =
    storedActions.map(
      (
        action,
      ) => ({
        id:
          action.id,

        title:
          action.title,

        details:
          action.details,

        sourceCode:
          action.sourceCode
            ?
              parseDecisionSourceCode(
                action.sourceCode,
              )
            :
              null,

        priority:
          parseDecisionPriority(
            action.priority,
          ),

        status:
          parseDecisionStatus(
            action.status,
          ),

        ownerName:
          action.ownerName,

        dueDate:
          action.dueDate
            ?.toISOString() ??
          null,

        createdAt:
          action.createdAt
            .toISOString(),

        createdBy:
          action.createdBy?.name ??
          action.createdBy?.email ??
          null,
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Executive management
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Executive Decision Center
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Convert financial exceptions into prioritized management decisions and track accountable actions through completion.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        status.status
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  status.status ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  status.status ===
                    "created"
                    ?
                      "Management action created successfully."
                    :
                  status.status ===
                    "updated"
                    ?
                      "Management action status updated successfully."
                    :
                      status.message ??
                      "The Decision Center operation could not be completed."
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <DecisionCenterWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }
        actuals={
          actuals
        }
        riskPolicy={
          riskPolicy
        }
        latestActualPeriod={
          latestActual?.period ??
          null
        }
        latestActualCash={
          latestActual?.cashBalance ??
          null
        }
        actions={
          actions
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

export default async function FinancingPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{
    projectId: string;
  }>;
}) {
  const {
    projectId,
  } = await params;

  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const analysis =
    await getBaseFinancialAnalysis(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );

  const project =
    analysis.project;

  const projectStartMonth =
    dateToMonthKey(
      project.startMonth,
    );

  const projectEndMonth =
    addMonths(
      projectStartMonth,
      project.horizonMonths -
        1,
    );

  const events =
    project.financingEvents.map(
      serializeFinancingEvent,
    );

  const schedule =
    analysis.ready
      ? buildFinancingSchedule(
          analysis.forecast
            .months,
        )
      : [];

  const scheduleSummary =
    summarizeFinancingSchedule(
      schedule,
    );

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <FinancialPageHeader
        eyebrow="Model"
        title="Financing"
        description="Model equity rounds, debt, grants and other financing events. Financing changes cash flow but never operating revenue."
        scenarioName="Base Case"
      />

      {analysis.ready ? (
        <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-6">
          <FinancialKpiCard
            label="Total financing"
            value={formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              scheduleSummary.totalInflow,
              project.currency,
            )}
            detail="Total external cash inflow during the forecast."
            icon={
              CircleDollarSign
            }
          />

          <FinancialKpiCard
            label="Equity"
            value={formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              scheduleSummary.totalEquityInflow,
              project.currency,
            )}
            detail="Equity financing inside the forecast horizon."
            icon={
              Banknote
            }
          />

          <FinancialKpiCard
            label="Debt raised"
            value={formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              scheduleSummary.totalDebtInflow,
              project.currency,
            )}
            detail="Loan principal received."
            icon={
              Landmark
            }
          />

          <FinancialKpiCard
            label="Interest"
            value={formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              scheduleSummary.totalInterestExpense,
              project.currency,
            )}
            detail="Debt interest recognized during the forecast."
            icon={

            }
          />

          <FinancialKpiCard
            label="Principal repaid"

      <CreateFinancingEventForm

                Add a funding round, loan, grant or other financing event to understand how external capital changes the company&apos;s cash runway.

            </CardContent>

  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  ForecastAccuracyWorkspace,
} from "@/components/forecast-accuracy/forecast-accuracy-workspace";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Forecast Accuracy",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function ForecastAccuracyPage({
  params,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const storedActuals =
    await prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
      where: {
        projectId,
      },

      orderBy: {
        period:
          "asc",
      },
  });


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          `${row.period
            .getUTCFullYear()
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              4,
              "0",
            )}-${(
            row.period.getUTCMonth() +
            1
          )
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              2,
              "0",
            )}`,

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Planning quality
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Forecast accuracy
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Measure how closely the VentureScope plan has tracked observed performance, identify systematic forecasting bias, and detect whether forecasting reliability is improving or deteriorating.
        </p>
      </header>

      <ForecastAccuracyWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        actuals={
          actuals
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/imports/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  DATA_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES,
  parseDataImportType,
} from "@/lib/data-import/catalog";

import {
  applyGovernedDataImport,
} from "@/lib/data-import/service";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value
    :
      "";
}


function errorMessage(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        220,
      )
    :
      "Data import failed.";
}


function safeFileName(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value
      .trim()
      .slice(
        0,
        160,
      );


  if (
    !normalized
  ) {
    return "import.csv";
  }


  return normalized.replace(
    /[^A-Za-z0-9._ -]/gu,
    "_",
  );
}


export async function applyDataImportAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    ).trim();


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  let batchId =
    "";


  try {
    const csv =
      formString(
        formData,
        "csv",
      );


    if (
      !csv.trim()
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "CSV data is required.",
      );
    }


    if (
      new TextEncoder()
        .encode(
          csv,
        )
        .byteLength >
      DATA_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "CSV cannot exceed 512KB.",
      );
    }


    const result =
      await applyGovernedDataImport({
        projectId,

        actorUserId:
          user.id,

        importType:
          parseDataImportType(
            formString(
              formData,
              "importType",
            ).trim(),
          ),

        fileName:
          safeFileName(
            formString(
              formData,
              "fileName",
            ),
          ),

        csv,
      });


    batchId =
      result.batchId;
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      errorMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/imports`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/actuals`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/activity`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/alerts`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/imports?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/imports?status=imported&batch=${encodeURIComponent(
      batchId,
    )}`,
  );
}

import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  DataImportWorkbench,
} from "@/components/data-import/data-import-workbench";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
  getProjectForEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  parseDataImportStatus,
  parseDataImportType,
} from "@/lib/data-import/catalog";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Data Import Center",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function errorSummary(
  value:
    unknown,
): string |
  null {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    value ===
      undefined
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  try {
    const text =
      JSON.stringify(
        value,
      );


    return text.length >
      320
      ?
        `${text.slice(
          0,
          317,
        )}...`
      :
        text;
  }
  catch {
    return "Import error details unavailable.";
  }
}


export default async function DataImportCenterPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;

      batch?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    batches,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.dataImportBatch.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: {
          createdAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          100,
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const history =
    batches.map(
      (
        batch,
      ) => ({
        id:
          batch.id,

        importType:
          parseDataImportType(
            batch.importType,
          ),

        fileName:
          batch.fileName,

        status:
          parseDataImportStatus(
            batch.status,
          ),

        rowCount:
          batch.rowCount,

        insertedCount:
          batch.insertedCount,

        updatedCount:
          batch.updatedCount,

        rejectedCount:
          batch.rejectedCount,

        errorSummary:
          errorSummary(
            batch.errorSummary,
          ),

        createdBy:
          batch.createdBy?.name ??
          batch.createdBy?.email ??
          null,

        createdAt:
          batch.createdAt
            .toISOString(),

        completedAt:
          batch.completedAt
            ?.toISOString() ??
          null,
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Governed data operations
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Data Import Center
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Preview, validate, and explicitly apply CSV data for Actuals, KPI Targets, and Variance Commentary while preserving project authorization, Financial Close, atomic writes, import history, and audit evidence.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        status.status
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  status.status ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  status.status ===
                    "imported"
                    ?
                      `Import completed successfully${status.batch ? ` · Batch ${status.batch}` : ""}.`
                    :
                      status.message ??
                      "Data import failed."
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <DataImportWorkbench
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }
        history={
          history
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/period-close/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  requireProjectWorkspaceOwner,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/access";

import {
  closeFinancialPeriod,
  reopenFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/service";

import {
  financialPeriodDate,
  parseFinancialPeriodKey,
  validateCloseConfirmation,
  validateReopenConfirmation,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/validation";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


function failureMessage(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        200,
      )
    :
      "Unable to update financial-period status.";
}


function revalidateFinancialSurfaces(
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/period-close`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/actuals`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/board-room`,
  );
}


export async function closeFinancialPeriodAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;

  let periodKey =
    "";


  try {
    periodKey =
      parseFinancialPeriodKey(
        formString(
          formData,
          "periodKey",
        ),
      );


    validateCloseConfirmation({
      periodKey,

      confirmation:
        formString(
          formData,
          "confirmation",
        ),
    });


    const reason =
      formString(
        formData,
        "reason",
      );


    if (
      reason.length >
      1000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Close reason cannot exceed 1000 characters.",
      );
    }


    await closeFinancialPeriod({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      periodKey,

      period:
        financialPeriodDate(
          periodKey,
        ),

      reason:
        reason ||
        null,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failureMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidateFinancialSurfaces(
    projectId,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/period-close?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/period-close?status=closed&period=${encodeURIComponent(
      periodKey,
    )}`,
  );
}


export async function reopenFinancialPeriodAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectWorkspaceOwner(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;

  let periodKey =
    "";


  try {
    periodKey =
      parseFinancialPeriodKey(
        formString(
          formData,
          "periodKey",
        ),
      );


    validateReopenConfirmation({
      periodKey,

      confirmation:
        formString(
          formData,
          "confirmation",
        ),
    });


    const reason =
      formString(
        formData,
        "reason",
      );


    if (
      reason.length <
        5 ||
      reason.length >
        1000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Reopen reason must contain between 5 and 1000 characters.",
      );
    }


    await reopenFinancialPeriod({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      periodKey,

      period:
        financialPeriodDate(
          periodKey,
        ),

      reason,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failureMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidateFinancialSurfaces(
    projectId,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/period-close?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/period-close?status=reopened&period=${encodeURIComponent(
      periodKey,
    )}`,
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/period-close/loading.tsx #####
export default function FinancialCloseLoading() {
  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl animate-pulse space-y-6 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8">
      <div className="h-9 w-72 rounded bg-muted" />

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        {
          Array.from({
            length:
              4,
          }).map(
            (

function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;

    :

export default async function PeriodClosePage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      period?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    owner,
    actuals,
    states,
    storedEvents,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      isProjectWorkspaceOwner(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "desc",
        },

        select: {
          period:
            true,

          revenue:
            true,

          ebitda:
            true,

          cashBalance:
            true,
        },
      }),

      prisma.financialPeriodState.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "desc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.financialPeriodEvent.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          createdAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          250,
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const register =
    buildFinancialPeriodRegister({
      actuals:
        actuals.map(
          (
            actual,
          ) => ({
            periodKey:
              financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
                actual.period,
              ),

            revenue:
              decimalNumber(
                actual.revenue,
              ),

            ebitda:
              decimalNumber(
                actual.ebitda,
              ),

            cashBalance:
              decimalNumber(
                actual.cashBalance,
              ),
          }),
        ),

      states:
        states.map(
          (
            state,
          ) => ({
            id:
              state.id,

            periodKey:
              financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
                state.period,
              ),

            status:
              parseFinancialPeriodStatus(
                state.status,
              ),

            closeSequence:
              state.closeSequence,

            closedAt:
              state.closedAt
                ?.toISOString() ??
              null,

            closedByUserId:
              state.closedByUserId,

            reopenedAt:
              state.reopenedAt
                ?.toISOString() ??
              null,

            reopenedByUserId:
              state.reopenedByUserId,
          }),
        ),
    });


  const events =
    storedEvents.map(
      (
        event,
      ) => ({
        id:
          event.id,

        periodKey:
          financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
            event.period,
          ),

        action:
          parseFinancialPeriodEventAction(
            event.action,
          ),

        actorUserId:
          event.actorUserId,

        reason:
          event.reason,

        sequence:
          event.sequence,

        createdAt:
          event.createdAt
            .toISOString(),
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Financial governance
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Financial Close
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Lock completed Actual periods, prevent silent historical changes, and retain an auditable record of every close and deliberate reopen event.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        status.status
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  status.status ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  status.status ===
                    "closed"
                    ?
                      `Financial period ${status.period ?? ""} was closed successfully.`
                    :
                  status.status ===
                    "reopened"
                    ?
                      `Financial period ${status.period ?? ""} was reopened successfully.`
                    :
                      status.message ??
                      "The Financial Close operation could not be completed."
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <PeriodCloseWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }
        owner={
          owner
        }
        register={
          register
        }
        events={
          events
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/planning-cycle/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  parseBaselineKind,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-cycle/baseline";

import {
  createForecastBaseline,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-cycle/service";


const MAX_FORECAST_CSV_BYTES =
  512 *
  1024;


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


function failure(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        180,
      )
    :
      "Unable to create forecast baseline.";
}


export async function createForecastBaselineAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  const project =
    await requireProjectEditor(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;

  let baselineName =
    "";


  try {
    baselineName =
      formString(
        formData,
        "name",
      );


    if (
      baselineName.length <
        2 ||
      baselineName.length >
        80
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Baseline name must contain between 2 and 80 characters.",
      );
    }


    const kind =
      parseBaselineKind(
        formString(
          formData,
          "kind",
        ),
      );


    const forecastCsv =
      formString(
        formData,
        "forecastCsv",
      );


    if (
      !forecastCsv
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Current forecast data was not available.",
      );
    }


    if (
      Buffer.byteLength(
        forecastCsv,
        "utf8",
      ) >
      MAX_FORECAST_CSV_BYTES
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Forecast snapshot exceeds the 512 KB safety limit.",
      );
    }


    const rows =
      normalizeForecastCsv(
        forecastCsv,
      );


    if (
      rows.length ===
        0
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Current forecast export contains no usable financial periods.",
      );
    }


    await createForecastBaseline({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      name:
        baselineName,

      kind,

      modelVersion:
        project.modelVersion,

      rows,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failure(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/planning-cycle`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/planning-cycle?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/planning-cycle?status=created&name=${encodeURIComponent(
      baselineName,
    )}`,
  );
}

export default async function PlanningCyclePage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      name?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    storedActuals,
    storedBaselines,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.forecastBaseline.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: {
          createdAt:
            "desc",
        },

        take:
          20,
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          `${row.period
            .getUTCFullYear()
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              4,
              "0",
            )}-${(
            row.period.getUTCMonth() +
            1
          )
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              2,
              "0",
            )}`,

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  const baselines =
    storedBaselines.map(

        baseline,

        id:
          baseline.id,

        name:
          baseline.name,

        kind:
          parseBaselineKind(
            baseline.kind,
          ),

        modelVersion:
          baseline.modelVersion,

        createdAt:
          baseline.createdAt
            .toISOString(),

        createdBy:
          baseline.createdBy?.name ??
          baseline.createdBy?.email ??
          null,

        snapshot:
          parseForecastBaselineSnapshot(
            baseline.snapshot,
          ),
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">

        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Planning cycle
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Freeze approved plans, compare the live forecast with the original budget, and build a rolling outlook that replaces historical forecast months with observed actual performance.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        status.status
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  status.status ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  status.status ===
                    "created"

                      `Immutable baseline "${status.name ?? ""}" created successfully.`
                    :
                      status.message ??
                      "The planning-cycle operation could not be completed."
                }

            )
          :

      }

      <PlanningCycleWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }

        }

        }

  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/portfolio/page.tsx #####
import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  PortfolioDashboardWorkspace,
} from "@/components/portfolio-dashboard/portfolio-dashboard-workspace";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  financialPeriodKeyFromDate,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/validation";

import {
  parseKpiMetricCode,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/metrics";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Portfolio Dashboard",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function PortfolioDashboardPage({
  params,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const currentProject =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !currentProject
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const memberships =
    await prisma.workspaceMember.findMany({
      where: {
        userId:
          user.id,
      },

      select: {
        workspaceId:
          true,

        role:
          true,
      },
    });


  const workspaceIds =
    [
      ...new Set(
        memberships.map(
          (
            membership,
          ) =>
            membership.workspaceId,
        ),
      ),
    ];


  const roleByWorkspace =
    new Map(
      memberships.map(
        (
          membership,
        ) => [
          membership.workspaceId,
          membership.role,
        ],
      ),
    );


  const projectWhere = {
    workspaceId: {
      in:
        workspaceIds,
    },
  };


  const [
    accessibleProjectCount,
    storedProjects,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      prisma.project.count({
        where:
          projectWhere,
      }),

      prisma.project.findMany({
        where:
          projectWhere,

        select: {
          id:
            true,

          name:
            true,

          industry:
            true,

          currency:
            true,

          workspaceId:
            true,
        },

        take:
          24,
      }),
    ]);


  const projects =
    storedProjects.sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) => {
        if (
          left.id ===
          projectId
        ) {
          return -1;
        }


        if (
          right.id ===
          projectId
        ) {
          return 1;
        }


        return left.name.localeCompare(
          right.name,
        );
      },
    );


  const projectIds =
    projects.map(
      (
        project,
      ) =>
        project.id,
    );


  const [
    storedActuals,
    storedPolicies,
    storedTargets,
    storedActions,
    storedPeriodStates,
  ] =
    projectIds.length >
      0
      ?
        await Promise.all([
          prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
            where: {
              projectId: {
                in:
                  projectIds,
              },
            },

            orderBy: {
              period:
                "asc",
            },
          }),

          prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findMany({
            where: {
              projectId: {
                in:
                  projectIds,
              },
            },
          }),

          prisma.projectKpiTarget.findMany({
            where: {
              projectId: {
                in:
                  projectIds,
              },
            },

            orderBy: [
              {
                periodKey:
                  "asc",
              },

              {
                metricCode:
                  "asc",
              },
            ],

            take:
              2880,
          }),

          prisma.decisionAction.findMany({
            where: {
              projectId: {
                in:
                  projectIds,
              },
            },

            take:
              1000,
          }),

          prisma.financialPeriodState.findMany({
            where: {
              projectId: {
                in:
                  projectIds,
              },
            },

            orderBy: {
              period:
                "asc",
            },
          }),
        ])
      :
        [
          [],
          [],
          [],
          [],
          [],
        ];


  const actualsByProject =
    new Map<
      string,
      typeof storedActuals
    >();


  for (
    const actual
    of storedActuals
  ) {
    const rows =
      actualsByProject.get(
        actual.projectId,
      ) ??
      [];


    rows.push(
      actual,
    );


    actualsByProject.set(
      actual.projectId,
      rows,
    );
  }


  const policyByProject =
    new Map(
      storedPolicies.map(
        (
          policy,
        ) => [
          policy.projectId,
          policy,
        ],
      ),
    );


  const targetsByProject =
    new Map<
      string,
      typeof storedTargets
    >();


  for (
    const target
    of storedTargets
  ) {
    const rows =
      targetsByProject.get(
        target.projectId,
      ) ??
      [];


    rows.push(
      target,
    );


    targetsByProject.set(
      target.projectId,
      rows,
    );
  }


  const actionsByProject =
    new Map<
      string,
      typeof storedActions
    >();


  for (
    const action
    of storedActions
  ) {
    const rows =
      actionsByProject.get(
        action.projectId,
      ) ??
      [];


    rows.push(
      action,
    );


    actionsByProject.set(
      action.projectId,
      rows,
    );
  }


  const statesByProject =
    new Map<
      string,
      typeof storedPeriodStates
    >();


  for (
    const state
    of storedPeriodStates
  ) {
    const rows =
      statesByProject.get(
        state.projectId,
      ) ??
      [];


    rows.push(
      state,
    );


    statesByProject.set(
      state.projectId,
      rows,
    );
  }


  const sources =
    projects.map(
      (
        project,
      ) => {
        const storedProjectActuals =
          actualsByProject.get(
            project.id,
          ) ??
          [];


        const actuals =
          storedProjectActuals.map(
            (
              row,
            ) => ({
              period:
                financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
                  row.period,
                ),

              revenue:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.revenue,
                ),

              cogs:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.cogs,
                ),

              operatingExpenses:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.operatingExpenses,
                ),

              ebitda:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.ebitda,
                ),

              netIncome:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.netIncome,
                ),

              cashFlow:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.cashFlow,
                ),

              cashBalance:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.cashBalance,
                ),

              mrr:
                decimalNumber(
                  row.mrr,
                ),

              customers:
                row.customers,
            }),
          );


        const latestActual =
          actuals[
            actuals.length -
            1
          ] ??
          null;


        const policy =
          policyByProject.get(
            project.id,
          );


        const riskPolicy =
          policy
            ?
              {
                minimumCash:
                  decimalNumber(
                    policy.minimumCash,
                  ),

                minimumRunwayMonths:
                  policy.minimumRunwayMonths,

                minimumEbitdaMargin:
                  decimalNumber(
                    policy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
                  ),

                maximumMonthlyBurn:
                  decimalNumber(
                    policy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
                  ),

                downsideRevenueShock:
                  Number(
                    policy
                      .downsideRevenueShock
                      .toString(),
                  ),

                downsideCostInflation:
                  Number(
                    policy
                      .downsideCostInflation
                      .toString(),
                  ),
              }
            :
              DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY;


        const targets =
          (
            targetsByProject.get(
              project.id,
            ) ??
            []
          ).map(
            (
              target,
            ) => ({
              id:
                target.id,

              periodKey:
                target.periodKey,

              metricCode:
                parseKpiMetricCode(
                  target.metricCode,
                ),

              targetValue:
                Number(
                  target.targetValue
                    .toString(),
                ),

              ownerName:
                target.ownerName,

              note:
                target.note,

              createdAt:
                target.createdAt
                  .toISOString(),

              updatedAt:
                target.updatedAt
                  .toISOString(),

              createdBy:
                null,
            }),
          );


        const actions =
          (
            actionsByProject.get(
              project.id,
            ) ??
            []
          ).map(
            (
              action,
            ) => ({
              id:
                action.id,

              title:
                action.title,

              priority:
                action.priority,

              status:
                action.status,

              ownerName:
                action.ownerName,

              dueDate:
                action.dueDate
                  ?.toISOString() ??
                null,
            }),
          );


        const latestState =
          latestActual
            ?
              (
                statesByProject.get(
                  project.id,
                ) ??
                []
              )
                .filter(
                  (
                    state,
                  ) =>
                    financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
                      state.period,
                    ) ===
                    latestActual.period,
                )
                .at(
                  -1,
                ) ??
              null
            :
              null;


        const latestPeriodCloseStatus =
          !latestActual
            ?
              "NO_ACTUALS" as const
            :
          latestState?.status ===
            "CLOSED"
            ?
              "CLOSED" as const
            :
              "OPEN" as const;


        return {
          id:
            project.id,

          name:
            project.name,

          industry:
            project.industry ??
            "",

          currency:
            project.currency,

          role:
            project.workspaceId
              ?
                String(
                  roleByWorkspace.get(
                    project.workspaceId,
                  ) ??
                  "VIEWER",
                )
              :
                "VIEWER",

          isCurrentProject:
            project.id ===
            projectId,

          actuals,

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod:
            latestActual?.period ??
            null,

          latestActualCash:
            latestActual?.cashBalance ??
            null,

          latestPeriodCloseStatus,

          targets,

          actions,
        };
      },
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1600px] space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Multi-project management
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Portfolio Executive Dashboard
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Compare the projects you can access, identify where management attention is required, review liquidity and funding exposure by currency, and drill directly into project-level decision and reporting workflows.
        </p>
      </header>

      <PortfolioDashboardWorkspace
        currentProjectId={
          projectId
        }
        accessibleProjectCount={
          accessibleProjectCount
        }
        generatedAt={
          new Date()
            .toISOString()
        }
        projects={
          sources
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

import {

  ExecutiveReport,
} from "@/components/reports/executive-report";
import {
  ReportExportActions,
} from "@/components/reports/report-export-actions";
import {
  ScenarioSwitcher,
} from "@/components/scenarios/scenario-switcher";
import {
  requireUser,
} from "@/lib/auth/require-user";

  loadReportContext,
} from "@/lib/reports/context";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Reports",
};

export default async function ReportsPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{
    projectId: string;
  }>;

  searchParams?: Promise<{
    scenario?:
      | string
      | string[];
  }>;
}) {
  const {
    projectId,
  } = await params;

  const resolvedSearchParams =
    await searchParams;

  const scenarioId =
    Array.isArray(
      resolvedSearchParams
        ?.scenario,
    )
      ? resolvedSearchParams
          ?.scenario[0]
      : resolvedSearchParams
          ?.scenario;

  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const context =
    await loadReportContext(
      user.id,
      projectId,
      scenarioId,
    );

  if (!context) {
    notFound();
  }

  if (
    !context.ready
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
        <FinancialPageHeader
          eyebrow="Output"
          title="Executive report"
          description="Complete the model assumptions before generating financial reports and exports."
          scenarioName="Report"
        />

        <AnalysisSetupRequired
          projectId={
            projectId
          }
          missingSections={
            context.missingSections
          }
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const selectedScenarioId =
    context.selectedScenario
      ?.id;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1600px] space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <FinancialPageHeader
        eyebrow="Output"
        title="Executive report"
        description="Decision-ready financial summary, annual forecast, scenario comparison and key assumptions."
        scenarioName={
          context.forecast
            .scenario.name
        }
        scenarioControl={
          <ScenarioSwitcher
            scenarios={context.project.scenarios.map(
              (
                scenario,
              ) => ({
                id:
                  scenario.id,

                name:
                  scenario.name,

                type:
                  scenario.type,
              }),
            )}
            currentScenarioId={
              selectedScenarioId ??
              ""
            }
          />
        }
      />

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <ReportExportActions
          projectId={
            context.project.id
          }
          scenarioId={
            selectedScenarioId
          }
        />
      </div>

      <ExecutiveReport
        context={
          context
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  parseProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  saveProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/service";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


export async function saveRiskPolicyAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const policy =
      parseProjectRiskPolicy({
        minimumCash:
          formString(
            formData,
            "minimumCash",
          ),

        minimumRunwayMonths:
          formString(
            formData,
            "minimumRunwayMonths",
          ),

        minimumEbitdaMarginPercent:
          formString(
            formData,
            "minimumEbitdaMarginPercent",
          ),

        maximumMonthlyBurn:
          formString(
            formData,
            "maximumMonthlyBurn",
          ),

        downsideRevenueShockPercent:
          formString(
            formData,
            "downsideRevenueShockPercent",
          ),

        downsideCostInflationPercent:
          formString(
            formData,
            "downsideCostInflationPercent",
          ),
      });


    await saveProjectRiskPolicy({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      policy,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      cause instanceof Error
        ?
          cause.message.slice(
            0,
            180,
          )
        :
          "Unable to save financial guardrails.";
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/risk-center`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/risk-center?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/risk-center?status=saved`,
  );
}

import type {

} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";
