  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
  getProjectForEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Liquidity Risk Center",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function RiskCenterPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    storedPolicy,
    latestActual,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findUnique({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findFirst({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "desc",
        },

        select: {
          period:
            true,

          cashBalance:
            true,
        },
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const policy =
    storedPolicy
      ?
        {
          minimumCash:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumCash,
            ),

          minimumRunwayMonths:
            storedPolicy.minimumRunwayMonths,

          minimumEbitdaMargin:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
            ),

          maximumMonthlyBurn:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
            ),

          downsideRevenueShock:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideRevenueShock
                .toString(),
            ),

          downsideCostInflation:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideCostInflation
                .toString(),
            ),
        }
      :
        DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY;


  const latestActualPeriod =
    latestActual
      ?
        `${latestActual.period
          .getUTCFullYear()
          .toString()
          .padStart(
            4,
            "0",
          )}-${(
          latestActual.period.getUTCMonth() +
          1
        )
          .toString()
          .padStart(
            2,
            "0",
          )}`
      :
        null;


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Financial resilience
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Liquidity Risk Center
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Track cash guardrails, runway, monthly burn, EBITDA resilience, and downside liquidity before financial risks become operational emergencies.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        status.status
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  status.status ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  status.status ===
                    "saved"
                    ?
                      "Financial guardrails saved successfully."
                    :
                      status.message ??
                      "The guardrail update could not be completed."
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <RiskCenterWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }
        policy={
          policy
        }
        latestActualPeriod={
          latestActualPeriod
        }
        latestActualCash={
          decimalNumber(
            latestActual?.cashBalance ??
            null,
          )
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/scorecard/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  parseKpiMetricCode,
  parseKpiTargetPeriod,
  parseKpiTargetValue,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/metrics";

import {
  deleteProjectKpiTarget,
  saveProjectKpiTarget,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/service";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


function nullableString(
  value:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  return value
    ?
      value
    :
      null;
}


function failure(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        180,
      )
    :
      "Unable to update KPI targets.";
}


export async function saveKpiTargetAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const metricCode =
      parseKpiMetricCode(
        formString(
          formData,
          "metricCode",
        ),
      );


    const periodKey =
      parseKpiTargetPeriod(
        formString(
          formData,
          "periodKey",
        ),
      );


    const ownerName =
      formString(
        formData,
        "ownerName",
      );


    if (
      ownerName.length >
      80
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "KPI owner cannot exceed 80 characters.",
      );
    }


    const note =
      formString(
        formData,
        "note",
      );


    if (
      note.length >
      1000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "KPI target note cannot exceed 1000 characters.",
      );
    }


    await saveProjectKpiTarget({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      periodKey,

      metricCode,

      targetValue:
        parseKpiTargetValue(
          metricCode,
          formString(
            formData,
            "targetValue",
          ),
        ),

      ownerName:
        nullableString(
          ownerName,
        ),

      note:
        nullableString(
          note,
        ),
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failure(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard?status=saved`,
  );
}


export async function deleteKpiTargetAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const targetId =
      formString(
        formData,
        "targetId",
      );


    if (
      !targetId
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "KPI target ID is required.",
      );
    }


    await deleteProjectKpiTarget({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      targetId,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failure(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard?status=deleted`,
  );
}

import type {
  Metadata,
} from "next";

import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  ScorecardWorkspace,
} from "@/components/scorecard/scorecard-workspace";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";

import {
  parseKpiMetricCode,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/metrics";

import {
  getOwnedProject,
  getProjectForEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Management Scorecard",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function ScorecardPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    storedActuals,
    storedPolicy,
    storedTargets,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectRiskPolicy.findUnique({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.projectKpiTarget.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            periodKey:
              "desc",
          },

          {
            metricCode:
              "asc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          120,
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          `${row.period
            .getUTCFullYear()
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              4,
              "0",
            )}-${(
            row.period.getUTCMonth() +
            1
          )
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              2,
              "0",
            )}`,

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  const riskPolicy =
    storedPolicy
      ?
        {
          minimumCash:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumCash,
            ),

          minimumRunwayMonths:
            storedPolicy.minimumRunwayMonths,

          minimumEbitdaMargin:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
            ),

          maximumMonthlyBurn:
            decimalNumber(
              storedPolicy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
            ),

          downsideRevenueShock:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideRevenueShock
                .toString(),
            ),

          downsideCostInflation:
            Number(
              storedPolicy
                .downsideCostInflation
                .toString(),
            ),
        }
      :
        DEFAULT_PROJECT_RISK_POLICY;


  const latestActual =
    actuals[
      actuals.length -
      1
    ] ??
    null;


  const targets =
    storedTargets.map(
      (
        target,
      ) => ({
        id:
          target.id,

        periodKey:
          target.periodKey,

        metricCode:
          parseKpiMetricCode(
            target.metricCode,
          ),

        targetValue:
          Number(
            target.targetValue
              .toString(),
          ),

        ownerName:
          target.ownerName,

        note:
          target.note,

        createdAt:
          target.createdAt
            .toISOString(),

        updatedAt:
          target.updatedAt
            .toISOString(),

        createdBy:
          target.createdBy?.name ??
          target.createdBy?.email ??
          null,
      }),
    );


  const defaultPeriod =
    latestActual?.period ??
    new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(
        0,
        7,
      );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Management performance
        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          KPI Targets &amp; Management Scorecard
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Define management commitments and compare them with Actuals, the live forecast, runway, and historical forecast accuracy.
        </p>
      </header>

      {
        status.status
          ?
            (
              <div
                role={
                  status.status ===
                    "error"
                    ?
                      "alert"
                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  status.status ===
                    "saved"
                    ?
                      "KPI target saved successfully."
                    :
                  status.status ===
                    "deleted"
                    ?
                      "KPI target deleted successfully."
                    :
                      status.message ??
                      "The scorecard operation could not be completed."
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <ScorecardWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }
        defaultPeriod={
          defaultPeriod
        }
        actuals={
          actuals
        }
        riskPolicy={
          riskPolicy
        }
        latestActualPeriod={
          latestActual?.period ??
          null
        }
        latestActualCash={
          latestActual?.cashBalance ??
          null
        }
        targets={
          targets
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

    "Planning timeline",
};

export default async function PlanningTimelinePage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{
    projectId: string;
  }>;
}) {
  const {
    projectId,
  } = await params;

  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const analysis =
    await getFinancialAnalysis(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );

  const project =
    analysis.project;

  const projectStartMonth =
    dateToMonthKey(
      project.startMonth,
    );

  const projectEndMonth =
    addMonths(
      projectStartMonth,
      project.horizonMonths -
        1,
    );

  const scenarioNameMap =
    new Map(
      project.scenarios.map(
        (
          scenario,
        ) => [
          scenario.id,
          scenario.name,
        ],
      ),
    );

  const overrideViews =
    project.monthlyOverrides.map(
      (
        override,
      ) =>
        serializeMonthlyOverride(
          override,
          override.scenarioId
            ? scenarioNameMap.get(
                override.scenarioId,
              ) ??
              "Unknown scenario"
            : "All scenarios",
        ),
    );

  const globalOverrides =
    overrideViews.filter(
      (
        override,
      ) =>
        !override.scenarioId,
    ).length;

  const scenarioOverrides =
    overrideViews.length -
    globalOverrides;

  const affectedMonths =
    new Set(
      overrideViews.map(
        (
          override,
        ) =>
          override.month,
      ),
    ).size;

  const timelineItems: PlanningTimelineItem[] =
    [
      ...project.financingEvents.map(
        (
          event,
        ) => ({
          id:
            `financing-${event.id}`,

          month:
            dateToMonthKey(
              event.month,
            ),

          kind:
            "FINANCING" as const,

          title:
            event.name,

          detail:
            `${formatFinancingType(
              event.type,
            )} · ${formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              String(
                event.amount,
              ),
              project.currency,
            )}`,

          note:
            event.type ===
            "DEBT"
              ? `${event.apr ?? 0}% APR · ${event.termMonths ?? 0} month term`
              : null,
        }),
      ),

      ...overrideViews.map(
        (
          override,
        ) => ({
          id:
            `override-${override.id}`,

          month:
            override.month,

          kind:
            "OVERRIDE" as const,

          title:
            "Monthly planning override",

          detail:
            monthlyOverrideFieldLabels(
              override.values,
            ).join(
              ", ",
            ),

          scope:
            override.scenarioName,

          note:
            override.note,
        }),
      ),
    ].sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) =>
        left.month.localeCompare(
          right.month,
        ),
    );

  const baseScenario =
    project.scenarios.find(
      (
        scenario,
      ) =>
        scenario.type ===
        "BASE",
    );

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1500px] space-y-10 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <FinancialPageHeader
        eyebrow="Model"
        title="Planning timeline"
        description="Model one-off monthly changes without changing the long-term baseline assumptions. Global overrides apply first; scenario-specific overrides take precedence."
        scenarioName="Advanced Planning"
      />

      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <FinancialKpiCard
          label="Monthly overrides"
          value={String(
            overrideViews.length,
          )}
          detail="Persisted one-month adjustments."
          icon={
            SlidersHorizontal
          }
        />

        <FinancialKpiCard
          label="Affected months"
          value={String(
            affectedMonths,
          )}
          detail="Distinct forecast months containing overrides."
          icon={
            CalendarRange
          }
        />

        <FinancialKpiCard
          label="Scenario-specific"
          value={String(
            scenarioOverrides,
          )}
          detail={`${globalOverrides} overrides currently apply to all scenarios.`}
          icon={
            Layers3
          }
        />

        <FinancialKpiCard
          label="Timeline events"
          value={String(
            timelineItems.length,
          )}
          detail={`${project.financingEvents.length} financing events included.`}
          icon={
            Sparkles
          }
        />
      </section>

      <CreateMonthlyOverrideForm
        projectId={
          project.id
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        revenueMode={
          project.revenueMode
        }
        projectStartMonth={
          projectStartMonth
        }
        projectEndMonth={
          projectEndMonth
        }
        scenarios={project.scenarios.map(
          (
            scenario,
          ) => ({
            id:
              scenario.id,

            name:
              scenario.name,
          }),
        )}
        defaultScenarioId={
          baseScenario
            ?.id ??
          ""
        }
      />

      <section className="space-y-5">
        <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
              Monthly overrides
            </h3>

            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Scenario-specific values override All Scenarios values for the same field and month.
            </p>
          </div>

          <Badge variant="outline">
            {
              overrideViews.length
            }{" "}
            configured
          </Badge>
        </div>

        {overrideViews.length ===
        0 ? (
          <Card className="border-dashed">
            <CardContent className="p-9 text-center">
              <SlidersHorizontal
                className="mx-auto size-8 text-muted-foreground"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />

              <div className="mt-4 font-medium">
                No monthly overrides yet
              </div>

              <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                Add one-off changes for events such as launches, annual conferences, temporary hiring, promotional months or pricing interventions.
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
            {overrideViews.map(
              (
                override,
              ) => (
                <MonthlyOverrideCard
                  key={
                    override.id
                  }
                  projectId={
                    project.id
                  }
                  currency={
                    project.currency
                  }
                  revenueMode={
                    project.revenueMode
                  }
                  projectStartMonth={
                    projectStartMonth
                  }
                  projectEndMonth={
                    projectEndMonth
                  }
                  scenarios={project.scenarios.map(
                    (
                      scenario,
                    ) => ({
                      id:
                        scenario.id,

                      name:
                        scenario.name,
                    }),
                  )}
                  override={
                    override
                  }
                />
              ),
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="space-y-5">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
            Advanced timeline
          </h3>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
            A chronological view of financing and month-specific operating adjustments across the forecast.
          </p>
        </div>

        <PlanningTimeline
          items={
            timelineItems
          }
        />
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  parseRecoveryPeriod,
  parseVarianceCauseCode,
  parseVarianceCommentaryStatus,
  parseVarianceMetricCode,
  parseVarianceNature,
  parseVariancePeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/metrics";

import {
  deleteVarianceCommentary,
  saveVarianceCommentary,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/service";


function formString(
  formData:
    FormData,
  name:
    string,
): string {
  const value =
    formData.get(
      name,
    );


  return typeof value ===
    "string"
    ?
      value.trim()
    :
      "";
}


function nullableString(
  value:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  return value
    ?
      value
    :
      null;
}


function failureMessage(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        180,
      )
    :
      "Unable to update variance commentary.";
}


export async function saveVarianceCommentaryAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const explanation =
      formString(
        formData,
        "explanation",
      );


    if (
      explanation.length <
        5 ||
      explanation.length >
        2000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Management explanation must contain between 5 and 2000 characters.",
      );
    }


    const correctiveAction =
      formString(
        formData,
        "correctiveAction",
      );


    if (
      correctiveAction.length >
      2000
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Corrective action cannot exceed 2000 characters.",
      );
    }


    const ownerName =
      formString(
        formData,
        "ownerName",
      );


    if (
      ownerName.length >
      80
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Variance owner cannot exceed 80 characters.",
      );
    }


    await saveVarianceCommentary({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      periodKey:
        parseVariancePeriod(
          formString(
            formData,
            "periodKey",
          ),
        ),

      metricCode:
        parseVarianceMetricCode(
          formString(
            formData,
            "metricCode",
          ),
        ),

      causeCode:
        parseVarianceCauseCode(
          formString(
            formData,
            "causeCode",
          ),
        ),

      varianceNature:
        parseVarianceNature(
          formString(
            formData,
            "varianceNature",
          ),
        ),

      explanation,

      correctiveAction:
        nullableString(
          correctiveAction,
        ),

      ownerName:
        nullableString(
          ownerName,
        ),

      recoveryPeriodKey:
        parseRecoveryPeriod(
          formString(
            formData,
            "recoveryPeriodKey",
          ),
        ),

      status:
        parseVarianceCommentaryStatus(
          formString(
            formData,
            "status",
          ),
        ),
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failureMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review?status=saved`,
  );
}


export async function deleteVarianceCommentaryAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formString(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  let error:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    const commentaryId =
      formString(
        formData,
        "commentaryId",
      );


    if (
      !commentaryId
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Variance commentary ID is required.",
      );
    }


    await deleteVarianceCommentary({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      commentaryId,
    });
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    error =
      failureMessage(
        cause,
      );
  }


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review`,
  );


  if (
    error
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review?status=error&message=${encodeURIComponent(
        error,
      )}`,
    );
  }


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review?status=deleted`,
  );
}

function decimalNumber(
  value:
    {
      toString():
        string;
    } |
    null,
): number |
  null {
  return value ===
    null
    ?
      null
    :
      Number(
        value.toString(),
      );
}


export default async function VarianceReviewPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      projectId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      status?:
        string;

      message?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    projectId,
  } =
    await params;


  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const [
    editableProject,
    storedActuals,
    storedCommentaries,
    status,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getProjectForEditor(
        user.id,
        projectId,
      ),

      prisma.actualPeriod.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        orderBy: {
          period:
            "asc",
        },
      }),

      prisma.varianceCommentary.findMany({
        where: {
          projectId,
        },

        include: {
          createdBy: {
            select: {
              name:
                true,

              email:
                true,
            },
          },
        },

        orderBy: [
          {
            periodKey:
              "desc",
          },

          {
            metricCode:
              "asc",
          },
        ],

        take:
          1000,
      }),

      searchParams,
    ]);


  const actuals =
    storedActuals.map(
      (
        row,
      ) => ({
        period:
          `${row.period
            .getUTCFullYear()
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              4,
              "0",
            )}-${(
            row.period.getUTCMonth() +
            1
          )
            .toString()
            .padStart(
              2,
              "0",
            )}`,

        revenue:
          decimalNumber(
            row.revenue,
          ),

        cogs:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cogs,
          ),

        operatingExpenses:
          decimalNumber(
            row.operatingExpenses,
          ),

        ebitda:
          decimalNumber(
            row.ebitda,
          ),

        netIncome:
          decimalNumber(
            row.netIncome,
          ),

        cashFlow:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashFlow,
          ),

        cashBalance:
          decimalNumber(
            row.cashBalance,
          ),

        mrr:
          decimalNumber(
            row.mrr,
          ),

        customers:
          row.customers,
      }),
    );


  const commentaries =
    storedCommentaries.map(
      (
        commentary,
      ) => ({
        id:
          commentary.id,

        periodKey:
          commentary.periodKey,

        metricCode:
          parseVarianceMetricCode(
            commentary.metricCode,
          ),

        causeCode:
          parseVarianceCauseCode(
            commentary.causeCode,
          ),

        varianceNature:

        explanation:
          commentary.explanation,

        correctiveAction:
          commentary.correctiveAction,

        ownerName:
          commentary.ownerName,

        recoveryPeriodKey:
          commentary.recoveryPeriodKey,

        status:
          parseVarianceCommentaryStatus(
            commentary.status,
          ),

        createdAt:
          commentary.createdAt
            .toISOString(),

        updatedAt:
          commentary.updatedAt
            .toISOString(),

        createdBy:
          commentary.createdBy?.name ??
          commentary.createdBy?.email ??
          null,
      }),
    );


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">

        </p>

        <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Variance Commentary
        </h1>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Explain why Actuals differed from Forecast, classify root causes, assign corrective actions, and track expected recovery through the monthly management-review cycle.
        </p>
      </header>

      {

              <div
                role={

                    "error"

                    :
                      "status"
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
              >
                {

                    ?
                      "Variance explanation saved successfully."
                    :

                    "deleted"
                    ?
                      "Variance explanation deleted successfully."
                    :
                      status.message ??
                      "The Variance Review operation could not be completed."
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <VarianceReviewWorkspace
        projectId={
          projectId
        }
        currency={
          project.currency
        }
        editable={
          Boolean(
            editableProject,
          )
        }
        actuals={
          actuals
        }
        commentaries={
          commentaries
        }
      />
    </main>
  );
}

"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  requireProjectEditor,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-access";

import {
  createProjectRevision,
  restoreProjectRevision,
} from "@/lib/projects/versioning/service";


function value(
  formData:
    FormData,
  key:
    string,
): string {
  const candidate =
    formData.get(
      key,
    );


  return (
    typeof candidate ===
      "string"
      ?
        candidate.trim()
      :
        ""
  );
}


function optionalValue(
  formData:
    FormData,
  key:
    string,
  maxLength:
    number,
): string |
  null {
  const candidate =
    value(
      formData,
      key,
    );


  if (
    !candidate
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return candidate.slice(
    0,
    maxLength,
  );
}


export async function createProjectRevisionAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    value(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  const result =
    await createProjectRevision({
      projectId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      label:
        optionalValue(
          formData,
          "label",
          80,
        ),

      reason:
        optionalValue(
          formData,
          "reason",
          500,
        ),
    });


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/versions`,
  );


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/versions?status=checkpoint-created&version=${result.version}`,
  );
}


export async function restoreProjectRevisionAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    value(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  const revisionId =
    value(
      formData,
      "revisionId",
    );


  await requireProjectEditor(
    user.id,
    projectId,
  );


  const result =
    await restoreProjectRevision({
      projectId,

      revisionId,

      actorUserId:
        user.id,

      reason:
        optionalValue(
          formData,
          "reason",
          500,
        ),
    });


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}`,
    "layout",
  );


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/versions`,
  );


  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/versions?status=restored&version=${result.version}`,
  );
}

function formatDate(
  value:
    Date,
): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en",
    {
      dateStyle:
        "medium",

      timeStyle:
        "short",
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}

    ]);

    !revisionState
  ) {

  }

"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";
import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  requireUser,
} from "@/lib/auth/require-user";
import {
  createDefaultFinancialAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/defaults";
import {
  financialAssumptionsToJson,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/storage";
import type {
  CreateProjectState,
  RenameProjectState,
} from "@/lib/projects/action-state";
import {
  monthInputToUtcDate,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-dates";
import {
  createProjectSchema,
  projectIdentifierSchema,
  renameProjectSchema,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-validation";
import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_SCENARIOS,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-defaults";
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

export async function createProjectAction(
  _previousState: CreateProjectState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<CreateProjectState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    createProjectSchema.safeParse({
      name:
        formData.get(
          "name",
        ),

      industry:
        formData.get(
          "industry",
        ),

      currency:
        formData.get(
          "currency",
        ),

      startMonth:
        formData.get(
          "startMonth",
        ),

      horizonMonths:
        formData.get(
          "horizonMonths",
        ),

      revenueMode:
        formData.get(
          "revenueMode",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted model information.",

      errors:
        parsed.error
          .flatten()
          .fieldErrors,
    };
  }

  let projectId: string;

  try {
    const project =
      await prisma.project.create({
        data: {
          userId:
            user.id,

          name:
            parsed.data
              .name,

          industry:
            parsed.data
              .industry,

          currency:
            parsed.data
              .currency,

          startMonth:
            monthInputToUtcDate(
              parsed.data
                .startMonth,
            ),

          horizonMonths:
            parsed.data
              .horizonMonths,

          revenueMode:
            parsed.data
              .revenueMode,

          baseAssumptions:
            financialAssumptionsToJson(
              createDefaultFinancialAssumptions(),
            ),

          modelVersion:
            "1.0",

          scenarios: {
            create:
              DEFAULT_PROJECT_SCENARIOS.map(
                (
                  scenario,
                ) => ({
                  name:
                    scenario.name,

                  type:
                    scenario.type,

                  modifiers:
                    scenario.modifiers,
                }),
              ),
          },
        },

        select: {
          id: true,
        },
      });

    projectId =
      project.id;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope project creation failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      message:
        "We could not create this financial model. Your information has not been saved.",
    };
  }

  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );

  redirect(
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`,
  );
}

export async function renameProjectAction(
  _previousState: RenameProjectState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<RenameProjectState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    renameProjectSchema.safeParse({
      projectId:
        formData.get(
          "projectId",
        ),

      name:
        formData.get(
          "name",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      message:
        "Enter a valid model name.",

      errors:
        parsed.error
          .flatten()
          .fieldErrors,
    };
  }

  try {
    const result =
      await prisma.project.updateMany({
        where: {
          id:
            parsed.data
              .projectId,

          userId:
            user.id,
        },

        data: {
          name:
            parsed.data
              .name,
        },
      });

    if (
      result.count ===
      0
    ) {
      return {
        message:
          "This financial model is no longer available.",
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope project rename failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      message:
        "We could not rename this financial model.",
    };
  }

  const projectId =
    parsed.data
      .projectId;

  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`,
  );

  const requestedReturnTo =
    formData.get(
      "returnTo",
    );

  const projectReturnTo =
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`;

  const safeReturnTo =
    requestedReturnTo ===
    projectReturnTo
      ? projectReturnTo
      : "/dashboard";

  redirect(
    safeReturnTo,
  );
}

export async function deleteProjectAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    projectIdentifierSchema.safeParse(
      formData.get(
        "projectId",
      ),
    );

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/dashboard",
    );
  }

  try {
    await prisma.project.deleteMany({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data,

        userId:
          user.id,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope project deletion failed:",
      error,
    );
  }

  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );

  redirect(
    "/dashboard",
  );
}

export async function duplicateProjectAction(
  projectId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    projectIdentifierSchema.safeParse(
      projectId,
    );

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/dashboard",
    );
  }

  const source =
    await prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data,

        userId:
          user.id,
      },

      include: {
        scenarios: {
          orderBy: {
            createdAt:
              "asc",
          },
        },

        financingEvents: {
          orderBy: {
            month:
              "asc",
          },
        },

        monthlyOverrides: {
          orderBy: {
            month:
              "asc",
          },
        },
      },
    });

  if (!source) {
    redirect(
      "/dashboard",
    );
  }

  let duplicateId: string;

  try {
    const duplicate =
      await prisma.$transaction(
        async (
          transaction,
        ) => {
          const createdProject =
            await transaction.project.create({
              data: {
                userId:
                  user.id,

                name:
                  `${source.name} (Copy)`,

                industry:
                  source.industry,

                currency:
                  source.currency,

                startMonth:
                  source.startMonth,

                horizonMonths:
                  source.horizonMonths,

                revenueMode:
                  source.revenueMode,

                baseAssumptions:
                  JSON.parse(
                    JSON.stringify(
                      source.baseAssumptions,
                    ),
                  ),

                modelVersion:
                  source.modelVersion,
              },

              select: {
                id: true,
              },
            });

          const scenarioIdMap =
            new Map<
              string,
              string
            >();

          for (
            const scenario
            of source.scenarios
          ) {
            const createdScenario =
              await transaction.scenario.create({
                data: {
                  projectId:
                    createdProject.id,

                  name:
                    scenario.name,

                  type:
                    scenario.type,

                  modifiers:
                    JSON.parse(
                      JSON.stringify(
                        scenario.modifiers,
                      ),
                    ),
                },

                select: {
                  id: true,
                },
              });

            scenarioIdMap.set(
              scenario.id,
              createdScenario.id,
            );
          }

          if (
            source
              .financingEvents
              .length >
            0
          ) {
            await transaction
              .financingEvent
              .createMany({
                data:
                  source.financingEvents.map(
                    (
                      event,
                    ) => ({
                      projectId:
                        createdProject.id,

                      name:
                        event.name,

                      type:
                        event.type,

                      month:
                        event.month,

                      amount:
                        event.amount,

                      apr:
                        event.apr,

                      termMonths:
                        event.termMonths,

                      repaymentStartMonth:
                        event.repaymentStartMonth,
                    }),
                  ),
              });
          }

          if (
            source
              .monthlyOverrides
              .length >
            0
          ) {
            await transaction
              .monthlyOverride
              .createMany({
                data:
                  source.monthlyOverrides.map(
                    (
                      override,
                    ) => ({
                      projectId:
                        createdProject.id,

                      scenarioId:
                        override.scenarioId
                          ? scenarioIdMap.get(
                              override.scenarioId,
                            ) ??
                            null
                          : null,

                      month:
                        override.month,

                      values:
                        JSON.parse(
                          JSON.stringify(
                            override.values,
                          ),
                        ),

                      note:
                        override.note,
                    }),
                  ),
              });
          }

          return createdProject;
        },
      );

    duplicateId =
      duplicate.id;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope project duplication failed:",
      error,
    );

    redirect(
      "/dashboard",
    );
  }

  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );

  redirect(
    `/projects/${duplicateId}/overview`,
  );
}

"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  requireUser,
} from "@/lib/auth/require-user";
import type {
  AssumptionActionState,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/action-state";
import {
  assumptionFieldErrors,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/action-state";
import {
  customerRevenueAssumptionsFormSchema,
  directRevenueAssumptionsFormSchema,
  expenseAssumptionsFormSchema,
  generalAssumptionsFormSchema,
  projectAssumptionIdSchema,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/schemas";
import {
  financialAssumptionsToJson,
  parseStoredFinancialAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/storage";
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

async function findOwnedProjectForAssumptions(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
) {
  return prisma.project.findFirst({
    where: {
      id:
        projectId,

      userId,
    },

    select: {
      id: true,
      revenueMode: true,
      baseAssumptions: true,
    },
  });
}

function revalidateAssumptionPages(
  projectId: string,
) {
  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/assumptions`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/revenue`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/expenses`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );
}

export async function saveGeneralAssumptionsAction(
  _previousState: AssumptionActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<AssumptionActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    generalAssumptionsFormSchema.safeParse(
      {
        projectId:
          formData.get(
            "projectId",
          ),

        startingCash:
          formData.get(
            "startingCash",
          ),

        corporateTaxRate:
          formData.get(
            "corporateTaxRate",
          ),
      },
    );

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      status: "error",

      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted assumptions.",

      errors:
        assumptionFieldErrors(
          parsed.error,
        ),
    };
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProjectForAssumptions(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status: "error",
      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const assumptions =
    parseStoredFinancialAssumptions(
      project.baseAssumptions,
    );

  const nextAssumptions = {
    ...assumptions,

    completion: {
      ...assumptions.completion,
      general: true,
    },

    general: {
      startingCash:
        parsed.data
          .startingCash,

      corporateTaxRate:
        parsed.data
          .corporateTaxRate,
    },
  };

  try {
    const result =
      await prisma.project.updateMany({
        where: {
          id:
            project.id,

          userId:
            user.id,
        },

        data: {
          baseAssumptions:
            financialAssumptionsToJson(
              nextAssumptions,
            ),
        },
      });

    if (
      result.count !== 1
    ) {
      return {
        status: "error",
        message:
          "This financial model is no longer available.",
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope general assumption save failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      status: "error",
      message:
        "We could not save the general financial assumptions.",
    };
  }

  revalidateAssumptionPages(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status: "success",
    message:
      "General financial assumptions saved.",
  };
}

export async function saveRevenueAssumptionsAction(
  _previousState: AssumptionActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<AssumptionActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const projectIdResult =
    projectAssumptionIdSchema.safeParse(
      formData.get(
        "projectId",
      ),
    );

  if (
    !projectIdResult.success
  ) {
    return {
      status: "error",
      message:
        "The financial model identifier is invalid.",
    };
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProjectForAssumptions(
      user.id,
      projectIdResult.data,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status: "error",
      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const assumptions =
    parseStoredFinancialAssumptions(
      project.baseAssumptions,
    );

  if (
    project.revenueMode ===
    "DIRECT"
  ) {
    const parsed =
      directRevenueAssumptionsFormSchema.safeParse(
        {
          projectId:
            project.id,

          startingMonthlyRevenue:
            formData.get(
              "startingMonthlyRevenue",
            ),

          monthlyGrowthRate:
            formData.get(
              "monthlyGrowthRate",
            ),

          recurringRevenuePercentage:
            formData.get(
              "recurringRevenuePercentage",
            ),

          monthlyOneTimeRevenue:
            formData.get(
              "monthlyOneTimeRevenue",
            ),
        },
      );

    if (
      !parsed.success
    ) {
      return {
        status: "error",

        message:
          "Please correct the highlighted revenue assumptions.",

        errors:
          assumptionFieldErrors(
            parsed.error,
          ),
      };
    }

    const nextAssumptions = {
      ...assumptions,

      completion: {
        ...assumptions.completion,
        revenue: true,
      },

      directRevenue: {
        startingMonthlyRevenue:
          parsed.data
            .startingMonthlyRevenue,

        monthlyGrowthRate:
          parsed.data
            .monthlyGrowthRate,

        recurringRevenuePercentage:
          parsed.data
            .recurringRevenuePercentage,

        monthlyOneTimeRevenue:
          parsed.data
            .monthlyOneTimeRevenue,
      },
    };

    try {
      const result =
        await prisma.project.updateMany({
          where: {
            id:
              project.id,

            userId:
              user.id,
          },

          data: {
            baseAssumptions:
              financialAssumptionsToJson(
                nextAssumptions,
              ),
          },
        });

      if (
        result.count !== 1
      ) {
        return {
          status: "error",
          message:
            "This financial model is no longer available.",
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "VentureScope direct revenue assumption save failed:",
        error,
      );

      return {
        status: "error",
        message:
          "We could not save the revenue assumptions.",
      };
    }
  } else {
    const parsed =
      customerRevenueAssumptionsFormSchema.safeParse(
        {
          projectId:
            project.id,

          startingCustomers:
            formData.get(
              "startingCustomers",
            ),

          arpu:
            formData.get(
              "arpu",
            ),

          monthlyChurnRate:
            formData.get(
              "monthlyChurnRate",
            ),

          cac:
            formData.get(
              "cac",
            ),

          organicNewCustomers:
            formData.get(
              "organicNewCustomers",
            ),

          customerAcquisitionGrowthRate:
            formData.get(
              "customerAcquisitionGrowthRate",
            ),

          arpuGrowthRate:
            formData.get(
              "arpuGrowthRate",
            ),

          monthlyOneTimeRevenue:
            formData.get(
              "monthlyOneTimeRevenue",
            ),
        },
      );

    if (
      !parsed.success
    ) {
      return {
        status: "error",

        message:
          "Please correct the highlighted customer and revenue assumptions.",

        errors:
          assumptionFieldErrors(
            parsed.error,
          ),
      };
    }

    const nextAssumptions = {
      ...assumptions,

      completion: {
        ...assumptions.completion,
        revenue: true,
      },

      customerRevenue: {
        startingCustomers:
          parsed.data
            .startingCustomers,

        arpu:
          parsed.data.arpu,

        monthlyChurnRate:
          parsed.data
            .monthlyChurnRate,

        cac:
          parsed.data.cac,

        organicNewCustomers:
          parsed.data
            .organicNewCustomers,

        customerAcquisitionGrowthRate:
          parsed.data
            .customerAcquisitionGrowthRate,

        arpuGrowthRate:
          parsed.data
            .arpuGrowthRate,

        monthlyOneTimeRevenue:
          parsed.data
            .monthlyOneTimeRevenue,
      },
    };

    try {
      const result =
        await prisma.project.updateMany({
          where: {
            id:
              project.id,

            userId:
              user.id,
          },

          data: {
            baseAssumptions:
              financialAssumptionsToJson(
                nextAssumptions,
              ),
          },
        });

      if (
        result.count !== 1
      ) {
        return {
          status: "error",
          message:
            "This financial model is no longer available.",
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "VentureScope customer revenue assumption save failed:",
        error,
      );

      return {
        status: "error",
        message:
          "We could not save the customer and revenue assumptions.",
      };
    }
  }

  revalidateAssumptionPages(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status: "success",
    message:
      "Revenue assumptions saved.",
  };
}

            .cogsFixedMonthly,

      },

  };

  try {

          userId:
            user.id,

        data: {

    ) {

        status: "error",

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/financing-actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  auditSecurityEvent,
} from "@/lib/security/audit";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  requireUser,
} from "@/lib/auth/require-user";
import {
  addMonths,
  compareMonths,
  dateToMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/dates";
import type {
  MonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";
import type {
  FinancingActionState,
} from "@/lib/financing/action-state";
import {
  financingFieldErrors,
} from "@/lib/financing/action-state";
import {
  createFinancingEventSchema,
  deleteFinancingEventSchema,
  updateFinancingEventSchema,
} from "@/lib/financing/validation";
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";
import {
  monthInputToUtcDate,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-dates";

type ParsedFinancingData = {
  projectId: string;

  name: string;

  type:
    | "EQUITY"
    | "DEBT"
    | "GRANT"
    | "OTHER";

  month: string;

  amount: string;

  apr: string;

  termMonths: string;

  repaymentStartMonth: string;
};

async function findOwnedProject(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
) {
  return prisma.project.findFirst({
    where: {
      id:
        projectId,

      userId,
    },

    select: {
      id: true,

      startMonth: true,

      horizonMonths: true,
    },
  });
}

function validateProjectTiming(
  project: {
    startMonth: Date;

    horizonMonths: number;
  },
  data: ParsedFinancingData,
): FinancingActionState | null {
  const forecastStart =
    dateToMonthKey(
      project.startMonth,
    );

  const forecastEnd =
    addMonths(
      forecastStart,
      project.horizonMonths -
        1,
    );

  const financingMonth =
    data.month as MonthKey;

  if (
    compareMonths(
      financingMonth,
      forecastStart,
    ) <
      0 ||
    compareMonths(
      financingMonth,
      forecastEnd,
    ) >
      0
  ) {
    return {
      status: "error",

      message:
        "The financing event must occur inside the project forecast window.",

      errors: {
        month: [
          `Select a month from ${forecastStart} through ${forecastEnd}.`,
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  if (
    data.type ===
      "DEBT" &&
    data.repaymentStartMonth
  ) {
    const earliestRepayment =
      addMonths(
        financingMonth,
        1,
      );

    if (
      compareMonths(
        data.repaymentStartMonth as MonthKey,
        earliestRepayment,
      ) <
      0
    ) {
      return {
        status:
          "error",

        message:
          "Debt repayment must begin after the loan is funded.",

        errors: {
          repaymentStartMonth:
            [
              `Repayment must start in ${earliestRepayment} or later.`,
            ],
        },
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function revalidateFinancingOutputs(
  projectId: string,
) {
  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/financing`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/timeline`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/forecast`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/pnl`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/cash-flow`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );
}

function financingInputFromForm(
  formData: FormData,
) {
  return {
    projectId:
      formData.get(
        "projectId",
      ),

    name:
      formData.get(
        "name",
      ),

    type:
      formData.get(
        "type",
      ),

    month:
      formData.get(
        "month",
      ),

    amount:
      formData.get(
        "amount",
      ),

    apr:
      formData.get(
        "apr",
      ) ??
      "",

    termMonths:
      formData.get(
        "termMonths",
      ) ??
      "",

    repaymentStartMonth:
      formData.get(
        "repaymentStartMonth",
      ) ??
      "",
  };
}

export async function createFinancingEventAction(
  _previousState: FinancingActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<FinancingActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    createFinancingEventSchema.safeParse(
      financingInputFromForm(
        formData,
      ),
    );

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted financing information.",

      errors:
        financingFieldErrors(
          parsed.error,
        ),
    };
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const timingError =
    validateProjectTiming(
      project,
      parsed.data,
    );

  if (
    timingError
  ) {
    return timingError;
  }

  const debt =
    parsed.data.type ===
    "DEBT";

  const repaymentStart =
    debt
      ? (
          parsed.data
            .repaymentStartMonth ||
          addMonths(
            parsed.data
              .month as MonthKey,
            1,
          )
        )
      : null;

  try {
    await prisma.financingEvent.create({
      data: {
        projectId:
          project.id,

        name:
          parsed.data.name,

        type:
          parsed.data.type,

        month:
          monthInputToUtcDate(
            parsed.data.month,
          ),

        amount:
          parsed.data.amount,

        apr:
          debt
            ? parsed.data.apr
            : null,

        termMonths:
          debt
            ? Number(
                parsed.data
                  .termMonths,
              )
            : null,

        repaymentStartMonth:
          repaymentStart
            ? monthInputToUtcDate(
                repaymentStart,
              )
            : null,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope financing creation failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "We could not create this financing event.",
    };
  }

  revalidateFinancingOutputs(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status:
      "success",

    message:
      "Financing event created. Forecast cash flow has been refreshed.",
  };
}

export async function updateFinancingEventAction(
  _previousState: FinancingActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<FinancingActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    updateFinancingEventSchema.safeParse({
      ...financingInputFromForm(
        formData,
      ),

      eventId:
        formData.get(
          "eventId",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted financing information.",

      errors:
        financingFieldErrors(
          parsed.error,
        ),
    };
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const existing =
    await prisma.financingEvent.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data
            .eventId,

        projectId:
          project.id,
      },

      select: {
        id: true,
      },
    });

  if (!existing) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This financing event is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const timingError =
    validateProjectTiming(
      project,
      parsed.data,
    );

  if (
    timingError
  ) {
    return timingError;
  }

  const debt =
    parsed.data.type ===
    "DEBT";

  const repaymentStart =
    debt
      ? (
          parsed.data
            .repaymentStartMonth ||
          addMonths(
            parsed.data
              .month as MonthKey,
            1,
          )
        )
      : null;

  try {
    const result =
      await prisma.financingEvent.updateMany({
        where: {
          id:
            parsed.data
              .eventId,

          projectId:
            project.id,
        },

        data: {
          name:
            parsed.data.name,

          type:
            parsed.data.type,

          month:
            monthInputToUtcDate(
              parsed.data.month,
            ),

          amount:
            parsed.data.amount,

          apr:
            debt
              ? parsed.data.apr
              : null,

          termMonths:
            debt
              ? Number(
                  parsed.data
                    .termMonths,
                )
              : null,

          repaymentStartMonth:
            repaymentStart
              ? monthInputToUtcDate(
                  repaymentStart,
                )
              : null,
        },
      });

    if (
      result.count !==
      1
    ) {
      return {
        status:
          "error",

        message:
          "This financing event is no longer available.",
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope financing update failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "We could not update this financing event.",
    };
  }

  revalidateFinancingOutputs(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status:
      "success",

    message:
      "Financing event updated. Forecast cash flow has been refreshed.",
  };
}

export async function deleteFinancingEventAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    deleteFinancingEventSchema.safeParse({
      projectId:
        formData.get(
          "projectId",
        ),

      eventId:
        formData.get(
          "eventId",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await prisma.financingEvent.deleteMany({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data
            .eventId,

        projectId:
          project.id,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope financing deletion failed:",
      error,
    );

    return;
  }

  auditSecurityEvent({
    action:
      "financing.delete",

    userId:
      user.id,

    projectId:
      project.id,

    targetId:
      parsed.data.eventId,
  });

  revalidateFinancingOutputs(
    project.id,
  );
}

import {

} from "@/lib/auth/require-user";

} from "@/lib/finance/dates";
import type {
  MonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";
import type {
  MonthlyOverrideActionState,
} from "@/lib/overrides/action-state";

  monthlyOverrideFieldErrors,
} from "@/lib/overrides/action-state";

  monthlyOverrideValuesFromForm,
  monthlyOverrideValuesToJson,
} from "@/lib/overrides/storage";

  createMonthlyOverrideSchema,
  deleteMonthlyOverrideSchema,

} from "@/lib/overrides/validation";
