function overrideInput(
  formData: FormData,
) {
  return {
    projectId:
      formData.get(
        "projectId",
      ),

    scenarioId:
      formData.get(
        "scenarioId",
      ) ??
      "",

    month:
      formData.get(
        "month",
      ),

    revenue:
      formData.get(
        "revenue",
      ) ??
      "",

    marketing:
      formData.get(
        "marketing",
      ) ??
      "",

    salaries:
      formData.get(
        "salaries",
      ) ??
      "",

    rent:
      formData.get(
        "rent",
      ) ??
      "",

    cogs:
      formData.get(
        "cogs",
      ) ??
      "",

    cac:
      formData.get(
        "cac",
      ) ??
      "",

    churnRate:
      formData.get(
        "churnRate",
      ) ??
      "",

    arpu:
      formData.get(
        "arpu",
      ) ??
      "",

    note:
      formData.get(
        "note",
      ) ??
      "",
  };
}

async function ownedProject(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
) {
  return prisma.project.findFirst({
    where: {
      id:
        projectId,

      userId,
    },

    select: {
      id:
        true,

      startMonth:
        true,

      horizonMonths:
        true,

      scenarios: {
        select: {
          id:
            true,

          name:
            true,
        },
      },
    },
  });
}

function validateTiming(
  project: {
    startMonth: Date;

    horizonMonths: number;
  },
  month: string,
): MonthlyOverrideActionState | null {
  const start =
    dateToMonthKey(
      project.startMonth,
    );

  const end =
    addMonths(
      start,
      project.horizonMonths -
        1,
    );

  if (
    compareMonths(
      month as MonthKey,
      start,
    ) <
      0 ||
    compareMonths(
      month as MonthKey,
      end,
    ) >
      0
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "The override month must fall inside the project's forecast horizon.",

      errors: {
        month: [
          `Select a month from ${start} through ${end}.`,
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  return null;
}

function validateScenarioScope(
  project: {
    scenarios: Array<{
      id: string;

      name: string;
    }>;
  },
  scenarioId: string,
): MonthlyOverrideActionState | null {
  if (
    scenarioId ===
    ""
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const belongs =
    project.scenarios.some(
      (
        scenario,
      ) =>
        scenario.id ===
        scenarioId,
    );

  if (
    belongs
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    status:
      "error",

    message:
      "The selected scenario does not belong to this financial model.",

    errors: {
      scenarioId: [
        "Select a valid project scenario.",
      ],
    },
  };
}

function revalidateOverrideOutputs(
  projectId: string,
) {
  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/timeline`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/forecast`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/pnl`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/cash-flow`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/customers`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scenarios`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );
}

export async function createMonthlyOverrideAction(
  _previousState: MonthlyOverrideActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<MonthlyOverrideActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    createMonthlyOverrideSchema.safeParse(
      overrideInput(
        formData,
      ),
    );

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted monthly override information.",

      errors:
        monthlyOverrideFieldErrors(
          parsed.error,
        ),
    };
  }

  const project =
    await ownedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const timingError =
    validateTiming(
      project,
      parsed.data
        .month,
    );

  if (
    timingError
  ) {
    return timingError;
  }

  const scenarioError =
    validateScenarioScope(
      project,
      parsed.data
        .scenarioId,
    );

  if (
    scenarioError
  ) {
    return scenarioError;
  }

  const scenarioId =
    parsed.data
      .scenarioId ===
    ""
      ? null
      : parsed.data
          .scenarioId;

  const month =
    monthInputToUtcDate(
      parsed.data.month,
    );

  const existing =
    await prisma.monthlyOverride.findFirst({
      where: {
        projectId:
          project.id,

        scenarioId,

        month,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,
      },
    });

  if (
    existing
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "An override already exists for this month and scenario scope.",

      errors: {
        month: [
          "Edit the existing override instead of creating a duplicate.",
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  const values =
    monthlyOverrideValuesFromForm(
      parsed.data,
    );

  try {
    await prisma.monthlyOverride.create({
      data: {
        projectId:
          project.id,

        scenarioId,

        month,

        values:
          monthlyOverrideValuesToJson(
            values,
          ),

        note:
          parsed.data
            .note ||
          null,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope monthly override creation failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "We could not create this monthly override.",
    };
  }

  revalidateOverrideOutputs(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status:
      "success",

    message:
      "Monthly override created. Financial forecasts have been refreshed.",
  };
}

export async function updateMonthlyOverrideAction(
  _previousState: MonthlyOverrideActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<MonthlyOverrideActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    updateMonthlyOverrideSchema.safeParse({
      ...overrideInput(
        formData,
      ),

      overrideId:
        formData.get(
          "overrideId",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted monthly override information.",

      errors:
        monthlyOverrideFieldErrors(
          parsed.error,
        ),
    };
  }

  const project =
    await ownedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const existing =
    await prisma.monthlyOverride.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data
            .overrideId,

        projectId:
          project.id,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,
      },
    });

  if (!existing) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This monthly override is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const timingError =
    validateTiming(
      project,
      parsed.data
        .month,
    );

  if (
    timingError
  ) {
    return timingError;
  }

  const scenarioError =
    validateScenarioScope(
      project,
      parsed.data
        .scenarioId,
    );

  if (
    scenarioError
  ) {
    return scenarioError;
  }

  const scenarioId =
    parsed.data
      .scenarioId ===
    ""
      ? null
      : parsed.data
          .scenarioId;

  const month =
    monthInputToUtcDate(
      parsed.data.month,
    );

  const duplicate =
    await prisma.monthlyOverride.findFirst({
      where: {
        id: {
          not:
            existing.id,
        },

        projectId:
          project.id,

        scenarioId,

        month,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,
      },
    });

  if (
    duplicate
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Another override already exists for this month and scenario scope.",

      errors: {
        month: [
          "Choose another month or scenario scope.",
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  const values =
    monthlyOverrideValuesFromForm(
      parsed.data,
    );

  try {
    const result =
      await prisma.monthlyOverride.updateMany({
        where: {
          id:
            existing.id,

          projectId:
            project.id,
        },

        data: {
          scenarioId,

          month,

          values:
            monthlyOverrideValuesToJson(
              values,
            ),

          note:
            parsed.data
              .note ||
            null,
        },
      });

    if (
      result.count !==
      1
    ) {
      return {
        status:
          "error",

        message:
          "This monthly override is no longer available.",
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope monthly override update failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "We could not update this monthly override.",
    };
  }

  revalidateOverrideOutputs(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status:
      "success",

    message:
      "Monthly override updated. Financial forecasts have been refreshed.",
  };
}

export async function deleteMonthlyOverrideAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    deleteMonthlyOverrideSchema.safeParse({
      projectId:
        formData.get(
          "projectId",
        ),

      overrideId:
        formData.get(
          "overrideId",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const project =
    await ownedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await prisma.monthlyOverride.deleteMany({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data
            .overrideId,

        projectId:
          project.id,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope monthly override deletion failed:",
      error,
    );

    return;
  }

  auditSecurityEvent({
    action:
      "override.delete",

    userId:
      user.id,

    projectId:
      project.id,

    targetId:
      parsed.data.overrideId,
  });

  revalidateOverrideOutputs(
    project.id,
  );
}

"use server";

import {
  auditSecurityEvent,
} from "@/lib/security/audit";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  requireUser,
} from "@/lib/auth/require-user";
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";
import type {
  ScenarioActionState,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/action-state";
import {
  scenarioFieldErrors,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/action-state";
import {
  scenarioFormValuesToStorageModifiers,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/modifiers";
import {
  createScenarioSchema,
  scenarioMutationIdentifierSchema,
  updateScenarioSchema,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/validation";
import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_SCENARIOS,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-defaults";

const MAX_SCENARIOS_PER_PROJECT =
  10;

function scenarioFormInput(
  formData: FormData,
) {
  return {
    projectId:
      formData.get(
        "projectId",
      ),

    name:
      formData.get(
        "name",
      ),

    growthAdjustmentPercentage:
      formData.get(
        "growthAdjustmentPercentage",
      ),

    arpuAdjustmentPercentage:
      formData.get(
        "arpuAdjustmentPercentage",
      ),

    cacAdjustmentPercentage:
      formData.get(
        "cacAdjustmentPercentage",
      ),

    churnDeltaPercentagePoints:
      formData.get(
        "churnDeltaPercentagePoints",
      ),

    cogsDeltaPercentagePoints:
      formData.get(
        "cogsDeltaPercentagePoints",
      ),
  };
}

async function findOwnedProject(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
) {
  return prisma.project.findFirst({
    where: {
      id:
        projectId,

      userId,
    },

    select: {
      id: true,

      revenueMode:
        true,

      _count: {
        select: {
          scenarios:
            true,
        },
      },
    },
  });
}

function revalidateScenarioOutputs(
  projectId: string,
) {
  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scenarios`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/timeline`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/forecast`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/pnl`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/cash-flow`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/customers`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );
}

export async function createScenarioAction(
  _previousState: ScenarioActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<ScenarioActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    createScenarioSchema.safeParse(
      scenarioFormInput(
        formData,
      ),
    );

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted scenario information.",

      errors:
        scenarioFieldErrors(
          parsed.error,
        ),
    };
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  if (
    project._count
      .scenarios >=
    MAX_SCENARIOS_PER_PROJECT
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        `A VentureScope model can contain at most ${MAX_SCENARIOS_PER_PROJECT} scenarios.`,
    };
  }

  const duplicateName =
    await prisma.scenario.findFirst({
      where: {
        projectId:
          project.id,

        name: {
          equals:
            parsed.data.name,

          mode:
            "insensitive",
        },
      },

      select: {
        id: true,
      },
    });

  if (
    duplicateName
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "A scenario with this name already exists.",

      errors: {
        name: [
          "Choose a unique scenario name.",
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  const modifiers =
    scenarioFormValuesToStorageModifiers({
      growthAdjustmentPercentage:
        parsed.data
          .growthAdjustmentPercentage,

      arpuAdjustmentPercentage:
        parsed.data
          .arpuAdjustmentPercentage,

      cacAdjustmentPercentage:
        parsed.data
          .cacAdjustmentPercentage,

      churnDeltaPercentagePoints:
        parsed.data
          .churnDeltaPercentagePoints,

      cogsDeltaPercentagePoints:
        parsed.data
          .cogsDeltaPercentagePoints,
    });

  try {
    await prisma.scenario.create({
      data: {
        projectId:
          project.id,

        name:
          parsed.data.name,

        type:
          "CUSTOM",

        modifiers,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope scenario creation failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "We could not create this scenario.",
    };
  }

  revalidateScenarioOutputs(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status:
      "success",

    message:
      "Custom scenario created.",
  };
}

export async function updateScenarioAction(
  _previousState: ScenarioActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<ScenarioActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    updateScenarioSchema.safeParse({
      ...scenarioFormInput(
        formData,
      ),

      scenarioId:
        formData.get(
          "scenarioId",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted scenario information.",

      errors:
        scenarioFieldErrors(
          parsed.error,
        ),
    };
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const existing =
    await prisma.scenario.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data
            .scenarioId,

        projectId:
          project.id,
      },

      select: {
        id: true,

        name: true,

        type: true,
      },
    });

  if (!existing) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This scenario is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  if (
    existing.type ===
    "BASE"
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Base Case always represents the project's exact assumptions and cannot contain modifiers.",
    };
  }

  let nextName =
    existing.name;

  if (
    existing.type ===
    "CUSTOM"
  ) {
    const duplicateName =
      await prisma.scenario.findFirst({
        where: {
          projectId:
            project.id,

          id: {
            not:
              existing.id,
          },

          name: {
            equals:
              parsed.data.name,

            mode:
              "insensitive",
          },
        },

        select: {
          id: true,
        },
      });

    if (
      duplicateName
    ) {
      return {
        status:
          "error",

        message:
          "A scenario with this name already exists.",

        errors: {
          name: [
            "Choose a unique scenario name.",
          ],
        },
      };
    }

    nextName =
      parsed.data.name;
  }

  const modifiers =
    scenarioFormValuesToStorageModifiers({
      growthAdjustmentPercentage:
        parsed.data
          .growthAdjustmentPercentage,

      arpuAdjustmentPercentage:
        parsed.data
          .arpuAdjustmentPercentage,

      cacAdjustmentPercentage:
        parsed.data
          .cacAdjustmentPercentage,

      churnDeltaPercentagePoints:
        parsed.data
          .churnDeltaPercentagePoints,

      cogsDeltaPercentagePoints:
        parsed.data
          .cogsDeltaPercentagePoints,
    });

  try {
    const result =
      await prisma.scenario.updateMany({
        where: {
          id:
            existing.id,

          projectId:
            project.id,
        },

        data: {
          name:
            nextName,

          modifiers,
        },
      });

    if (
      result.count !==
      1
    ) {
      return {
        status:
          "error",

        message:
          "This scenario is no longer available.",
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope scenario update failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "We could not update this scenario.",
    };
  }

  revalidateScenarioOutputs(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status:
      "success",

    message:
      "Scenario modifiers updated.",
  };
}

export async function resetScenarioAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    scenarioMutationIdentifierSchema.safeParse({
      projectId:
        formData.get(
          "projectId",
        ),

      scenarioId:
        formData.get(
          "scenarioId",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return;
  }

  const scenario =
    await prisma.scenario.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data
            .scenarioId,

        projectId:
          project.id,
      },

      select: {
        id: true,

        type: true,
      },
    });

  if (
    !scenario ||
    scenario.type ===
      "CUSTOM"
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const defaultScenario =
    DEFAULT_PROJECT_SCENARIOS.find(
      (
        candidate,
      ) =>
        candidate.type ===
        scenario.type,
    );

  if (
    !defaultScenario
  ) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await prisma.scenario.updateMany({
      where: {
        id:
          scenario.id,

        projectId:
          project.id,
      },

      data: {
        modifiers:
          JSON.parse(
            JSON.stringify(
              defaultScenario.modifiers,
            ),
          ),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope scenario reset failed:",
      error,
    );

    return;
  }

  revalidateScenarioOutputs(
    project.id,
  );
}

export async function deleteScenarioAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    scenarioMutationIdentifierSchema.safeParse({
      projectId:
        formData.get(
          "projectId",
        ),

      scenarioId:
        formData.get(
          "scenarioId",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const project =
    await findOwnedProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await prisma.$transaction([
      prisma.monthlyOverride.deleteMany({
        where: {
          projectId:
            project.id,

          scenarioId:
            parsed.data
              .scenarioId,
        },
      }),

      prisma.scenario.deleteMany({
        where: {
          id:
            parsed.data
              .scenarioId,

          projectId:
            project.id,

          type:
            "CUSTOM",
        },
      }),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope scenario deletion failed:",
      error,
    );

    return;
  }

  auditSecurityEvent({
    action:
      "scenario.delete",

    userId:
      user.id,

    projectId:
      project.id,

    targetId:
      parsed.data.scenarioId,
  });

  revalidateScenarioOutputs(
    project.id,
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/projects/settings-actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  auditSecurityEvent,
} from "@/lib/security/audit";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  requireUser,
} from "@/lib/auth/require-user";
import {
  createDefaultFinancialAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/defaults";
import {
  financialAssumptionsToJson,
  parseStoredFinancialAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/storage";
import {
  addMonths,
  compareMonths,
  dateToMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/dates";
import type {
  MonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";
import {
  monthInputToUtcDate,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-dates";
import {
  DEFAULT_PROJECT_SCENARIOS,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-defaults";
import type {
  ProjectSettingsActionState,
} from "@/lib/settings/action-state";

  projectSettingsFieldErrors,
} from "@/lib/settings/action-state";

function revalidateProjectSurfaces(
  projectId: string,
) {
  revalidatePath(
    "/dashboard",
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/overview`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/assumptions`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/revenue`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/expenses`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/financing`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/timeline`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/forecast`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/pnl`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/cash-flow`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/customers`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/scenarios`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/reports`,
  );

  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}/settings`,
  );
}

async function getOwnedSettingsProject(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
) {
  return prisma.project.findFirst({
    where: {
      id:
        projectId,

      userId,
    },

    select: {
      id:
        true,

      name:
        true,

      industry:
        true,

      currency:
        true,

      startMonth:
        true,

      horizonMonths:
        true,

      revenueMode:
        true,

      baseAssumptions:
        true,

      modelVersion:
        true,

      financingEvents: {
        select: {
          id:
            true,

          name:
            true,

          month:
            true,
        },
      },

      monthlyOverrides: {
        select: {
          id:
            true,

          month:
            true,

          scenarioId:
            true,
        },
      },
    },
  });
}

function outsideWindow(
  month: MonthKey,
  startMonth: MonthKey,
  endMonth: MonthKey,
): boolean {
  return (
    compareMonths(
      month,
      startMonth,
    ) <
      0 ||
    compareMonths(
      month,
      endMonth,
    ) >
      0
  );
}

export async function updateProjectSettingsAction(
  _previousState: ProjectSettingsActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<ProjectSettingsActionState> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    updateProjectSettingsSchema.safeParse({
      projectId:
        formData.get(
          "projectId",
        ),

      name:
        formData.get(
          "name",
        ),

      industry:
        formData.get(
          "industry",
        ),

      currency:
        formData.get(
          "currency",
        ),

      startMonth:
        formData.get(
          "startMonth",
        ),

      horizonMonths:
        formData.get(
          "horizonMonths",
        ),

      revenueMode:
        formData.get(
          "revenueMode",
        ),
    });

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "Please correct the highlighted project settings.",

      errors:
        projectSettingsFieldErrors(
          parsed.error,
        ),
    };
  }

  const project =
    await getOwnedSettingsProject(
      user.id,
      parsed.data
        .projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "This financial model is no longer available.",
    };
  }

  const nextStart =
    parsed.data
      .startMonth as MonthKey;

  const nextEnd =
    addMonths(
      nextStart,
      parsed.data
        .horizonMonths -
        1,
    );

  const invalidFinancing =
    project.financingEvents.filter(
      (
        event,
      ) =>
        outsideWindow(
          dateToMonthKey(
            event.month,
          ),
          nextStart,
          nextEnd,
        ),
    );

  const invalidOverrides =
    project.monthlyOverrides.filter(
      (
        override,
      ) =>
        outsideWindow(
          dateToMonthKey(
            override.month,
          ),
          nextStart,
          nextEnd,
        ),
    );

  if (
    invalidFinancing.length >
      0 ||
    invalidOverrides.length >
      0
  ) {
    const details: string[] =
      [];

    if (
      invalidFinancing.length >
      0
    ) {
      const sample =
        invalidFinancing
          .slice(
            0,
            3,
          )
          .map(
            (
              event,
            ) =>
              `${event.name} (${dateToMonthKey(
                event.month,
              )})`,
          )
          .join(
            ", ",
          );

      details.push(
        `${invalidFinancing.length} financing event${invalidFinancing.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} would fall outside the new window: ${sample}`,
      );
    }

    if (
      invalidOverrides.length >
      0
    ) {
      const sample =
        invalidOverrides
          .slice(
            0,
            3,
          )
          .map(
            (
              override,
            ) =>
              dateToMonthKey(
                override.month,
              ),
          )
          .join(
            ", ",
          );

      details.push(
        `${invalidOverrides.length} monthly override${invalidOverrides.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} would fall outside the new window: ${sample}`,
      );
    }

    const message =
      `Forecast window change blocked. ${details.join(
        ". ",
      )}. Remove or move those planning events first.`;

    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message,

      errors: {
        startMonth: [
          "The requested forecast window would invalidate existing planning data.",
        ],

        horizonMonths: [
          `Required planning window currently extends beyond ${nextStart} through ${nextEnd}.`,
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  const revenueModeChanged =
    project.revenueMode !==
    parsed.data
      .revenueMode;

  const assumptions =
    parseStoredFinancialAssumptions(
      project.baseAssumptions,
    );

  const nextAssumptions =
    revenueModeChanged
      ? {
          ...assumptions,

          completion: {
            ...assumptions.completion,

            revenue:
              false,
          },
        }
      : assumptions;

  try {
    const result =
      await prisma.project.updateMany({
        where: {
          id:
            project.id,

          userId:
            user.id,
        },

        data: {
          name:
            parsed.data.name,

          industry:
            parsed.data
              .industry ||
            null,

          currency:
            parsed.data
              .currency,

          startMonth:
            monthInputToUtcDate(
              parsed.data
                .startMonth,
            ),

          horizonMonths:
            parsed.data
              .horizonMonths,

          revenueMode:
            parsed.data
              .revenueMode,

          baseAssumptions:
            financialAssumptionsToJson(
              nextAssumptions,
            ),
        },
      });

    if (
      result.count !==
      1
    ) {
      return {
        status:
          "error",

        message:
          "This financial model is no longer available.",
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope project settings update failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      status:
        "error",

      message:
        "We could not save the project settings.",
    };
  }

  auditSecurityEvent({
    action:
      "model.settings.update",

    userId:
      user.id,

    projectId:
      project.id,

    metadata: {
      revenueModeChanged,
    },
  });

  revalidateProjectSurfaces(
    project.id,
  );

  return {
    status:
      "success",

    message:
      revenueModeChanged
        ? "Project settings saved. Because the revenue model changed, review and save the Revenue assumptions before analysis resumes."
        : "Project settings saved.",
  };
}

async function resolveOwnedProjectId(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<{
  userId: string;

  projectId: string;
} | null> {
  const user =
    await requireUser();

  const parsed =
    settingsProjectIdentifierSchema.safeParse(
      formData.get(
        "projectId",
      ),
    );

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const project =
    await prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          parsed.data,

        userId:
          user.id,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,
      },
    });

  if (!project) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    userId:
      user.id,

    projectId:
      project.id,
  };
}

export async function resetFinancialAssumptionsAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const owned =
    await resolveOwnedProjectId(
      formData,
    );

  if (!owned) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await prisma.project.updateMany({
      where: {
        id:
          owned.projectId,

        userId:
          owned.userId,
      },

      data: {
        baseAssumptions:
          financialAssumptionsToJson(
            createDefaultFinancialAssumptions(),
          ),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope financial assumption reset failed:",
      error,
    );

    return;
  }

  auditSecurityEvent({
    action:
      "model.assumptions.reset",

    userId:
      owned.userId,

    projectId:
      owned.projectId,
  });

  revalidateProjectSurfaces(
    owned.projectId,
  );
}

export async function clearFinancingEventsAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const owned =
    await resolveOwnedProjectId(
      formData,
    );

  if (!owned) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await prisma.financingEvent.deleteMany({
      where: {
        projectId:
          owned.projectId,

        project: {
          userId:
            owned.userId,
        },
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope financing clear failed:",
      error,
    );

    return;
  }

  auditSecurityEvent({
    action:
      "model.financing.clear",

    userId:
      owned.userId,

    projectId:
      owned.projectId,
  });

  revalidateProjectSurfaces(
    owned.projectId,
  );
}

export async function clearMonthlyOverridesAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const owned =
    await resolveOwnedProjectId(
      formData,
    );

  if (!owned) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await prisma.monthlyOverride.deleteMany({
      where: {
        projectId:
          owned.projectId,

        project: {
          userId:
            owned.userId,
        },
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope monthly override clear failed:",
      error,
    );

    return;
  }

  auditSecurityEvent({
    action:
      "model.overrides.clear",

    userId:
      owned.userId,

    projectId:
      owned.projectId,
  });

  revalidateProjectSurfaces(
    owned.projectId,
  );
}

export async function resetScenarioLibraryAction(
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const owned =
    await resolveOwnedProjectId(
      formData,
    );

  if (!owned) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        await transaction.monthlyOverride.deleteMany({
          where: {
            projectId:
              owned.projectId,

            scenarioId: {
              not:
                null,
            },
          },
        });

        await transaction.scenario.deleteMany({
          where: {
            projectId:
              owned.projectId,
          },
        });

        await transaction.scenario.createMany({
          data:
            DEFAULT_PROJECT_SCENARIOS.map(
              (
                scenario,
              ) => ({
                projectId:
                  owned.projectId,

                name:
                  scenario.name,

                type:
                  scenario.type,

                modifiers:
                  JSON.parse(
                    JSON.stringify(
                      scenario.modifiers,
                    ),
                  ),
              }),
            ),
        });
      },
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope scenario library reset failed:",
      error,
    );

    return;
  }

  auditSecurityEvent({
    action:
      "model.scenarios.reset",

    userId:
      owned.userId,

    projectId:
      owned.projectId,
  });

  revalidateProjectSurfaces(
    owned.projectId,
  );
}

  removeWorkspaceMemberAction,

  title:
    "Workspace",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};

  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params:
    Promise<{
      workspaceId:
        string;
    }>;

  searchParams:
    Promise<{
      invite?:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const {
    workspaceId,
  } =
    await params;


  const permission =
    await getWorkspacePermission(
      workspaceId,
      user.id,
    );


  if (
    !permission
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const workspace =
    await prisma.workspace.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          workspaceId,
      },

      include: {
        owner: {
          select: {
            id:
              true,

            email:
              true,

            name:
              true,
          },
        },

        members: {
          include: {
            user: {
              select: {
                email:
                  true,

                name:
                  true,
              },
            },
          },

          orderBy: {
            createdAt:
              "asc",
          },
        },

        invitations: {
          where: {
            acceptedAt:
              null,

            expiresAt: {
              gt:
                new Date(),
            },
          },

          orderBy: {
            createdAt:
              "desc",
          },
        },

        projects: {
          select: {
            id:
              true,

            name:
              true,

            userId:
              true,
          },

          orderBy: {
            updatedAt:
              "desc",
          },
        },
      },
    });


  if (
    !workspace
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  const ownedProjects =
    await prisma.project.findMany({
      where: {
        userId:
          user.id,

        OR: [
          {
            workspaceId:
              null,
          },

          {
            workspaceId: {
              not:
                workspaceId,
            },
          },
        ],
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,

        name:
          true,
      },

      orderBy: {
        updatedAt:
          "desc",
      },
    });


  const {
    invite,
  } =
    await searchParams;


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header className="space-y-3">
        <Link
          href="/workspaces"
          className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
        >
          ← Workspaces
        </Link>

          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">

            }

            }

                            >
                              <input
                                type="hidden"
                                name="workspaceId"
                                value={
                                  workspace.id
                                }
                              />

                              <input
                                type="hidden"
                                name="memberId"
                                value={
                                  member.id
                                }
                              />

                              <button
                                type="submit"
                                className="h-9 rounded-lg border px-3 text-xs text-destructive"
                              >
                                Remove
                              </button>
                            </form>
                          </div>
                        )
                      :
                        (
                          <span className="text-xs font-medium">
                            {
                              member.role
                            }
                          </span>
                        )
                  }
                </div>
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>
      </section>

      {
        permission ===
        "OWNER"
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
                <h2 className="font-semibold">
                  Pending invitations
                </h2>

                <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                  {
                    workspace.invitations.map(
                      (
                        invitation,
                      ) => (
                        <div
                          key={
                            invitation.id
                          }
                          className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3"
                        >
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-sm font-medium">
                              {
                                invitation.emailNormalized
                              }
                            </p>

                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {
                                invitation.role
                              }
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <form
                            action={
                              revokeWorkspaceInvitationAction
                            }
                          >
                            <input
                              type="hidden"
                              name="workspaceId"
                              value={
                                workspace.id
                              }
                            />

                            <input
                              type="hidden"
                              name="invitationId"
                              value={
                                invitation.id
                              }
                            />

                            <button
                              type="submit"
                              className="text-xs text-destructive"
                            >
                              Revoke
                            </button>
                          </form>
                        </div>
                      ),
                    )
                  }

                  {
                    workspace.invitations.length ===
                    0
                      ?
                        (
                          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            No pending invitations.
                          </p>
                        )
                      :
                        null
                  }
                </div>
              </section>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      {
        permission ===
        "OWNER"
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/5 p-5">
                <h2 className="font-semibold text-destructive">
                  Delete workspace
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Projects are returned to their personal owners; the financial models themselves are not deleted.
                </p>

                <form
                  action={
                    deleteWorkspaceAction
                  }
                  className="mt-4"
                >
                  <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="workspaceId"
                    value={
                      workspace.id
                    }
                  />

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="h-10 rounded-lg bg-destructive px-4 text-sm font-medium text-destructive-foreground"
                  >
                    Delete workspace
                  </button>
                </form>
              </section>
            )
          :
            null
      }
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(app)/workspaces/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import {
  revalidatePath,
} from "next/cache";

import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  createInvitationToken,
  hashInvitationToken,
  invitationExpiry,
  normalizeInvitationEmail,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/invitations";

import {
  requireWorkspacePermission,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/access";


function formValue(
  formData:
    FormData,
  key:
    string,
): string {
  const candidate =
    formData.get(
      key,
    );


  return (
    typeof candidate ===
      "string"
      ?
        candidate.trim()
      :
        ""
  );
}


function safeRole(
  value:
    string,
):
  | "EDITOR"
  | "VIEWER" {
  return (
    value ===
    "EDITOR"
      ?
        "EDITOR"
      :
        "VIEWER"
  );
}


export async function createWorkspaceAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const name =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "name",
    );


  if (
    name.length <
      2 ||
    name.length >
      80
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/workspaces?status=invalid-name",
    );
  }


  const workspace =
    await prisma.workspace.create({
      data: {
        name,

        ownerId:
          user.id,
      },
    });


  redirect(
    `/workspaces/${workspace.id}`,
  );
}


export async function inviteWorkspaceMemberAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const workspaceId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "workspaceId",
    );


  await requireWorkspacePermission(
    workspaceId,
    user.id,
    "OWNER",
  );


  const email =
    normalizeInvitationEmail(
      formValue(
        formData,
        "email",
      ),
    );


  if (
    !email.includes(
      "@",
    ) ||
    email.length >
      254
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/workspaces/${workspaceId}?status=invalid-email`,
    );
  }


  if (
    email ===
    user.email
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/workspaces/${workspaceId}?status=self-invite`,
    );
  }


  const role =
    safeRole(
      formValue(
        formData,
        "role",
      ),
    );


  const token =
    createInvitationToken();


  await prisma.workspaceInvitation.create({
    data: {
      workspaceId,

      emailNormalized:
        email,

      role,

      tokenHash:
        hashInvitationToken(
          token,
        ),

      expiresAt:
        invitationExpiry(),

      createdByUserId:
        user.id,
    },
  });


  revalidatePath(
    `/workspaces/${workspaceId}`,
  );


  redirect(
    `/workspaces/${workspaceId}?invite=${encodeURIComponent(
      token,
    )}`,
  );
}


export async function acceptWorkspaceInvitationAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const token =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "token",
    );


  const invitation =
    await prisma.workspaceInvitation.findUnique({
      where: {
        tokenHash:
          hashInvitationToken(
            token,
          ),
      },
    });


  if (
    !invitation ||
    invitation.acceptedAt ||
    invitation.expiresAt <=
      new Date() ||
    invitation.emailNormalized !==
      user.email
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/invite/${encodeURIComponent(
        token,
      )}?status=invalid`,
    );
  }


  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.workspaceMember.upsert({
      where: {
        workspaceId_userId: {
          workspaceId:
            invitation.workspaceId,

          userId:
            user.id,
        },
      },

      update: {
        role:
          invitation.role,
      },

      create: {
        workspaceId:
          invitation.workspaceId,

        userId:
          user.id,

        role:
          invitation.role,
      },
    }),

    prisma.workspaceInvitation.update({
      where: {
        id:
          invitation.id,
      },

      data: {
        acceptedAt:
          new Date(),
      },
    }),
  ]);


  redirect(
    `/workspaces/${invitation.workspaceId}`,
  );
}


export async function updateWorkspaceMemberRoleAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const workspaceId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "workspaceId",
    );


  const memberId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "memberId",
    );


  const role =
    safeRole(
      formValue(
        formData,
        "role",
      ),
    );


  await requireWorkspacePermission(
    workspaceId,
    user.id,
    "OWNER",
  );


  await prisma.workspaceMember.updateMany({
    where: {
      id:
        memberId,

      workspaceId,
    },

    data: {
      role,
    },
  });


  revalidatePath(
    `/workspaces/${workspaceId}`,
  );
}


export async function removeWorkspaceMemberAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const workspaceId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "workspaceId",
    );


  const memberId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "memberId",
    );


  await requireWorkspacePermission(
    workspaceId,
    user.id,
    "OWNER",
  );


  await prisma.workspaceMember.deleteMany({
    where: {
      id:
        memberId,

      workspaceId,
    },
  });


  revalidatePath(
    `/workspaces/${workspaceId}`,
  );
}


export async function revokeWorkspaceInvitationAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const workspaceId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "workspaceId",
    );


  const invitationId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "invitationId",
    );


  await requireWorkspacePermission(
    workspaceId,
    user.id,
    "OWNER",
  );


  await prisma.workspaceInvitation.deleteMany({
    where: {
      id:
        invitationId,

      workspaceId,

      acceptedAt:
        null,
    },
  });


  revalidatePath(
    `/workspaces/${workspaceId}`,
  );
}


export async function assignProjectToWorkspaceAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const workspaceId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "workspaceId",
    );


  const projectId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  await requireWorkspacePermission(
    workspaceId,
    user.id,
    "EDITOR",
  );


  const project =
    await prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,

        userId:
          user.id,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    redirect(
      `/workspaces/${workspaceId}?status=project-not-owned`,
    );
  }


  await prisma.project.update({
    where: {
      id:
        projectId,
    },

    data: {
      workspaceId,
    },
  });


  revalidatePath(
    `/workspaces/${workspaceId}`,
  );


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}`,
  );
}


export async function removeProjectFromWorkspaceAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const projectId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "projectId",
    );


  const project =
    await prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,

        userId:
          user.id,
      },

      select: {
        workspaceId:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/workspaces?status=project-not-owned",
    );
  }


  await prisma.project.update({
    where: {
      id:
        projectId,
    },

    data: {
      workspaceId:
        null,
    },
  });


  revalidatePath(
    "/workspaces",
  );


  revalidatePath(
    `/projects/${projectId}`,
  );
}


export async function deleteWorkspaceAction(
  formData:
    FormData,
): Promise<void> {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const workspaceId =
    formValue(
      formData,
      "workspaceId",
    );


  await requireWorkspacePermission(
    workspaceId,
    user.id,
    "OWNER",
  );


  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.project.updateMany({
      where: {
        workspaceId,
      },

      data: {
        workspaceId:
          null,
      },
    }),

    prisma.workspace.delete({
      where: {
        id:
          workspaceId,
      },
    }),
  ]);


  redirect(
    "/workspaces",
  );
}

  Metadata,
} from "next";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  requireCurrentUserIdentity,
} from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

import {
  createWorkspaceAction,
} from "./actions";


export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title:
    "Workspaces",

  robots: {
    index:
      false,

    follow:
      false,
  },
};


export default async function WorkspacesPage() {
  const user =
    await requireCurrentUserIdentity();


  const workspaces =
    await prisma.workspace.findMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          {
            ownerId:
              user.id,
          },

          {
            members: {
              some: {
                userId:
                  user.id,
              },
            },
          },
        ],
      },

      include: {
        members: {
          where: {
            userId:
              user.id,
          },

          select: {
            role:
              true,
          },
        },

        _count: {
          select: {
            projects:
              true,

            members:
              true,
          },
        },
      },

      orderBy: {
        updatedAt:
          "desc",
      },
    });


  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl space-y-8 px-5 py-8 lg:px-8 lg:py-10">
      <header className="space-y-2">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Collaboration
        </p>

        <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          Workspaces
        </h1>

        <p className="max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Share financial models with trusted collaborators while keeping personal projects private by default.
        </p>
      </header>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Create workspace
        </h2>

        <form
          action={
            createWorkspaceAction
          }
          className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row"
        >
          <label className="flex-1">
            <span className="sr-only">
              Workspace name
            </span>

            <input
              required
              minLength={
                2
              }
              maxLength={
                80
              }
              name="name"
              placeholder="Finance team"
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            />
          </label>

          <button
            type="submit"
            className="h-10 rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 text-sm font-medium text-background"
          >
            Create workspace
          </button>
        </form>
      </section>

      <section className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        {
          workspaces.map(
            (
              workspace,
            ) => {
              const role =
                workspace.ownerId ===
                user.id
                  ?
                    "OWNER"
                  :
                    workspace.members[
                      0
                    ]?.role ??
                    "VIEWER";


              return (
                <Link
                  key={
                    workspace.id
                  }
                  href={
                    `/workspaces/${workspace.id}`
                  }
                  className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 transition-colors hover:bg-muted/40"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <h2 className="font-semibold">
                        {
                          workspace.name
                        }
                      </h2>

                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                        {
                          role
                        }
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {
                        workspace._count
                          .projects
                      }{" "}
                      projects
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {
                      workspace._count
                        .members
                    }{" "}
                    collaborators
                  </p>
                </Link>
              );
            },
          )
        }

        {
          workspaces.length ===
          0
            ?
              (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground md:col-span-2">
                  You do not belong to a collaborative workspace yet.
                </div>
              )
            :
              null
        }
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/(auth)/login/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import { AuthError } from "next-auth";

import { signIn } from "@/auth";
import type { LoginFormState } from "@/lib/auth/form-state";
import { loginSchema } from "@/lib/validation/auth";

export async function loginAction(
  _previousState: LoginFormState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<LoginFormState> {
  const parsed = loginSchema.safeParse({
    email: formData.get("email"),
    password: formData.get("password"),
  });

  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      message: "Please correct the highlighted fields.",
      errors: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
    };
  }

  try {
    await signIn("credentials", {
      email: parsed.data.email,
      password: parsed.data.password,
      redirectTo: "/dashboard",
    });

    return {};
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AuthError) {
      if (error.type === "CredentialsSignin") {
        return {
          message: "Incorrect email or password.",
        };
      }

      return {
        message:
          "Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.",
      };
    }

    throw error;
  }
}

##### FILE: ./app/(auth)/register/actions.ts #####
"use server";

import { hash } from "bcryptjs";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import type { RegisterFormState } from "@/lib/auth/form-state";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/db/prisma";
import { registerSchema } from "@/lib/validation/auth";

export async function registerAction(
  _previousState: RegisterFormState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<RegisterFormState> {
  const parsed = registerSchema.safeParse({
    name: formData.get("name"),
    email: formData.get("email"),
    password: formData.get("password"),
    confirmPassword: formData.get("confirmPassword"),
  });

  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      message: "Please correct the highlighted fields.",
      errors: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
    };
  }

  const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: {
      email: parsed.data.email,
    },

    select: {
      id: true,
    },
  });

  if (existingUser) {
    return {
      message: "An account already exists with this email address.",

      errors: {
        email: [
          "Use another email address or sign in to your existing account.",
        ],
      },
    };
  }

  const passwordHash = await hash(
    parsed.data.password,
    12,
  );

  try {
    await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        name: parsed.data.name,
        email: parsed.data.email,
        passwordHash,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "VentureScope registration failed:",
      error,
    );

    return {
      message:
        "We could not create your account. Please try again.",
    };
  }

  redirect("/login");
}

import {
  Skeleton,
} from "@/components/ui/skeleton";

export default function DemoLoading() {
  return (
    <main
      aria-busy="true"
      aria-live="polite"
      className="mx-auto min-h-svh max-w-[1600px] space-y-8 px-5 py-10 lg:px-8"

export default async function DemoPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: Promise<{
    scenario?:
      | string
      | string[];
  }>;
}) {
  const resolved =
    await searchParams;

  const requestedScenario =
    Array.isArray(
      resolved?.scenario,
    )
      ? resolved
          ?.scenario[0]
      : resolved
          ?.scenario;

  const scenario =
    getOrbitAnalyticsScenario(
      requestedScenario,
    );

  const forecast =
    buildOrbitAnalyticsDemoForecast(
      scenario.id,
    );

  const comparison =
    buildOrbitAnalyticsScenarioComparison();

  const assumptions =
    orbitAnalyticsDemoAssumptions();

  const dashboardData =
    buildFinancialDashboardData(
      forecast.months,
      forecast.revenueMode,
    );

  const annualColumns: FinancialTableColumn[] =
    forecast.annual.map(
      (
        year,

        key:
          String(
            year.year,
          ),

            year.year,
          ),

        detail:
          `${year.monthsIncluded} mo`,
      }),
    );

  const annualRows: FinancialTableRow[] =
    [
      {
        label:
          "Revenue",

            (
              year,
            ) =>

                year.revenue,
                forecast.currency,
              ),
          ),

        kind:
          "total",
      },

      {
        label:
          "Gross profit",

        values:
          forecast.annual.map(
            (
              year,
            ) =>
              formatCurrencyValue(
                year.grossProfit,
                forecast.currency,
              ),
          ),

        kind:
          "subtotal",
      },

      {
        label:
          "Gross margin",

        values:
          forecast.annual.map(
            (
              year,
            ) =>
              formatPercentageValue(
                year.grossMarginPercentage,
              ),
          ),

        kind:
          "metric",
      },

      {
        label:
          "EBITDA",

        values:
          forecast.annual.map(
            (
              year,
            ) =>
              formatCurrencyValue(
                year.ebitda,
                forecast.currency,
              ),
          ),

        kind:
          "total",
      },

      {
        label:
          "Net income",

        values:
          forecast.annual.map(
            (
              year,
            ) =>

                year.netIncome,

function DemoRow({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;

  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-5 border-b pb-3 last:border-b-0 last:pb-0">
      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {
          label
        }
      </span>

      <span className="text-right text-sm font-medium">
        {
          value
        }
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function DemoFeature({
  icon: Icon,
  title,
  description,
}: {
  icon:
    React.ComponentType<{
      className?: string;
    }>;

  title: string;

  description: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      <div className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-muted">
        <Icon
          className="size-4"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="text-sm font-medium">
          {
            title
          }
        </div>

        <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
          {
            description
          }
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

          label
        }
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold">
        {
          value
        }
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/api/diagnostics/route.ts #####
import {
  collectDiagnostics,
  diagnosticsEnabled,
  isDiagnosticsAuthorized,
} from "@/lib/observability/diagnostics";
import {
  observedJsonRoute,
} from "@/lib/observability/route";


export const dynamic =
  "force-dynamic";

export const runtime =
  "nodejs";


export function GET(
  request:
    Request,
) {
  return observedJsonRoute(
    "api.diagnostics",
    request,
    async () => {
      if (
        !diagnosticsEnabled() ||
        !isDiagnosticsAuthorized(
          request.headers,
        )
      ) {
        return {
          status:
            404,

          body: {
            status:
              "not_found",
          },
        };
      }


      const diagnostics =
        await collectDiagnostics();


      return {
        body: {
          status:
            "ok",

          diagnostics,
        },
      };
    },
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/api/observability/route.ts #####
import {
  observedJsonRoute,
} from "@/lib/observability/route";


export const dynamic =
  "force-dynamic";


export function GET(
  request:
    Request,
) {
  return observedJsonRoute(
    "api.observability",
    request,
    (
      requestId,
    ) => ({
      body: {
        status:
          "ok",

        service:
          "venturescope",

        version:
          process.env
            .APP_VERSION ??
          "development",

        environment:
          process.env
            .NODE_ENV ??
          "development",

        uptimeSeconds:
          Math.round(
            process.uptime() *
              100,
          ) /
          100,

        correlation:
          requestId,
      },
    }),
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/api/projects/[projectId]/export/csv/route.ts #####
import {
  auth,
} from "@/auth";
import {
  buildForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/reports/csv";
import {
  loadReportContext,
} from "@/lib/reports/context";
import {
  reportFilename,
} from "@/lib/reports/filename";

export const runtime =
  "nodejs";

export const dynamic =
  "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(
  request: Request,
  {
    params,
  }: {
    params: Promise<{
      projectId: string;
    }>;
  },
) {
  const session =
    await auth();

  if (
    !session?.user?.id
  ) {
    return new Response(
      "Unauthorized",
      {
        status:
          401,
      },
    );
  }

  const {
    projectId,
  } = await params;

  const url =
    new URL(
      request.url,
    );

  const scenarioId =
    url.searchParams.get(
      "scenario",
    ) ??
    undefined;

  const context =
    await loadReportContext(
      session.user.id,
      projectId,
      scenarioId,
    );

  if (!context) {
    return new Response(
      "Financial model not found.",
      {
        status:
          404,
      },
    );
  }

  if (
    !context.ready
  ) {
    return new Response(
      "Financial assumptions are incomplete.",
      {
        status:
          409,
      },
    );
  }

  const csv =
    buildForecastCsv(
      context,
    );

  const filename =
    reportFilename(
      context.project
        .name,
      context.forecast
        .scenario.name,
      "csv",
    );

  return new Response(
    csv,
    {
      status:
        200,

      headers: {
        "Content-Type":
          "text/csv; charset=utf-8",

        "Content-Disposition":
          `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,

        "Cache-Control":
          "private, no-store, max-age=0",

        "X-Content-Type-Options":
          "nosniff",
      },
    },
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/api/projects/[projectId]/export/pdf/route.ts #####
import {
  auth,
} from "@/auth";
import {
  loadReportContext,
} from "@/lib/reports/context";
import {
  reportFilename,
} from "@/lib/reports/filename";
import {
  buildExecutivePdf,
} from "@/lib/reports/pdf";

export const runtime =
  "nodejs";

export const dynamic =
  "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(
  request: Request,
  {
    params,
  }: {
    params: Promise<{
      projectId: string;
    }>;
  },
) {
  const session =
    await auth();

  if (
    !session?.user?.id
  ) {
    return new Response(
      "Unauthorized",
      {
        status:
          401,
      },
    );
  }

  const {
    projectId,
  } = await params;

  const url =
    new URL(
      request.url,
    );

  const scenarioId =
    url.searchParams.get(
      "scenario",
    ) ??
    undefined;

  const context =
    await loadReportContext(
      session.user.id,
      projectId,
      scenarioId,
    );

  if (!context) {
    return new Response(
      "Financial model not found.",
      {
        status:
          404,
      },
    );
  }

  if (
    !context.ready
  ) {
    return new Response(
      "Financial assumptions are incomplete.",
      {
        status:
          409,
      },
    );
  }

  const pdfBytes =
    await buildExecutivePdf(
      context,
    );

  const filename =
    reportFilename(
      context.project
        .name,
      context.forecast
        .scenario.name,
      "pdf",
    );

  const body =
    Uint8Array.from(
      pdfBytes,
    ).buffer;

  return new Response(
    body,
    {
      status:
        200,

      headers: {
        "Content-Type":
          "application/pdf",

        "Content-Disposition":
          `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,

        "Content-Length":
          String(
            pdfBytes.byteLength,
          ),

        "Cache-Control":
          "private, no-store, max-age=0",

        "X-Content-Type-Options":
          "nosniff",
      },
    },
  );
}

##### FILE: ./app/api/ready/route.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

export const runtime =
  "nodejs";

export const dynamic =
  "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    await prisma.$queryRaw`
      SELECT 1
    `;

    return Response.json(
      {
        status:
          "ready",

        database:
          "available",

        timestamp:
          new Date()
            .toISOString(),
      },
      {
        status:
          200,

        headers: {
          "Cache-Control":
            "no-store",
        },
      },
    );
  }
  catch {
    return Response.json(
      {
        status:
          "not-ready",

        database:
          "unavailable",

        timestamp:
          new Date()
            .toISOString(),
      },
      {
        status:
          503,

        headers: {
          "Cache-Control":
            "no-store",
        },
      },
    );
  }
}

##### FILE: ./app/global-error.tsx #####
"use client";

import {
  useEffect,
} from "react";

export default function GlobalError({
  error,
  reset,
}: {
  error:
    Error & {
      digest?:
        string;
    };

  reset:
    () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(
    () => {
      console.error(
        "VentureScope global application error",
        {
          digest:
            error.digest ??
            null,
        },
      );
    },
    [
      error.digest,
    ],
  );

  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        <main className="flex min-h-svh items-center justify-center bg-background p-6 text-foreground">
          <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border bg-card p-8 shadow-sm">
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
              VENTURESCOPE
            </div>

            <h1 className="mt-3 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
              Something went wrong
            </h1>

            <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
              VentureScope could not complete this request. No internal error details are exposed in the interface.
            </p>

            {error.digest ? (
              <p className="mt-4 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Reference: {
                  error.digest
                }
              </p>
            ) : null}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={
                reset
              }
              className="mt-6 rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-background"
            >
              Try again
            </button>
          </div>
        </main>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

import type {
  MetadataRoute,
} from "next";

import {
  getPublicSiteUrl,
} from "@/lib/seo/site";

export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  const site =
    getPublicSiteUrl()
      .toString()
      .replace(
        /\/$/,
        "",
      );

  return {
    rules: {
      userAgent:
        "*",

      allow: [
        "/",
        "/demo",
        "/login",
        "/register",
      ],

      disallow: [
        "/api/",
        "/dashboard",
        "/dashboard/",
        "/projects",
        "/projects/",
        "/workspaces",
        "/workspaces/",
        "/invite",
        "/invite/",
      ],
    },

    sitemap:
      `${site}/sitemap.xml`,
  };
}

import type {
  MetadataRoute,
} from "next";

import {
  getPublicSiteUrl,
} from "@/lib/seo/site";

export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  const site =
    getPublicSiteUrl()
      .toString()
      .replace(
        /\/$/,
        "",
      );

  return [
    {
      url:
        `${site}/`,

      lastModified:
        new Date(),

      changeFrequency:
        "weekly",

      priority:
        1,
    },

    {
      url:
        `${site}/demo`,

      lastModified:
        new Date(),

      changeFrequency:
        "monthly",

      priority:
        0.9,
    },
  ];
}

##### FILE: ./auth.ts #####
import { compare } from "bcryptjs";
import NextAuth from "next-auth";
import Credentials from "next-auth/providers/credentials";

import { prisma } from "@/lib/db/prisma";
import { loginSchema } from "@/lib/validation/auth";

import {
  enforceJwtSessionSecurity,
  enforceSessionSecurity,
} from "@/lib/auth/session-security";


export const {
  handlers,
  auth,
  signIn,
  signOut,
} = NextAuth({
  secret: process.env.AUTH_SECRET,

  session: {
    strategy: "jwt",
    maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60,
  },

  pages: {
    signIn: "/login",
  },

  providers: [
    Credentials({
      name: "Email and password",

      credentials: {
        email: {
          label: "Email",
          type: "email",
        },

        password: {
          label: "Password",
          type: "password",
        },
      },

      async authorize(credentials) {
        const parsed = loginSchema.safeParse(credentials);

        if (!parsed.success) {
          return null;
        }

        const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
          where: {
            email: parsed.data.email,
          },

          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            email: true,
            passwordHash: true,
          },
        });

        if (!user) {
          return null;
        }

        const passwordMatches = await compare(
          parsed.data.password,
          user.passwordHash,
        );

        if (!passwordMatches) {
          return null;
        }

        return {
          id: user.id,
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
        };
      },
    }),
  ],

  callbacks: {
    async jwt({
      token,
      user,
    }) {
      return enforceJwtSessionSecurity(
        token,
        user,
      );
    },

    session({
      session,
      token,
    }) {
      return enforceSessionSecurity(
        session,
        token,
      );
    },
  },
});

function severityTone(
  severity:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    severity
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "WARNING":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    default:
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function severitySurface(
  severity:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    severity
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "bg-destructive/5";

    case "WARNING":
      return "bg-amber-500/5";

    default:
      return "";
  }
}


function formatUtc(
  iso:
    string,
): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en",
    {
      dateStyle:
        "medium",

      timeStyle:
        "medium",

      timeZone:
        "UTC",
    },
  ).format(
    new Date(
      iso,
    ),
  );
}

function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percentage(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function varianceTone(
  favorable:
    boolean |
    null |
    undefined,
): string {
  if (
    favorable ===
      true
  ) {
    return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";
  }


  if (
    favorable ===
      false
  ) {
    return "text-destructive";
  }


  return "text-muted-foreground";
}
