      <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
        {
          money(
            actual,
            currency,
          )
        }
      </p>

      <div className="mt-3 space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <p>
          Forecast:{" "}
          {
            money(
              forecast,
              currency,
            )
          }
        </p>

        <p>
          Variance:{" "}
          {
            money(
              variance,
              currency,
            )
          }
          {
            varianceRate !==
              null
              ?
                ` (${percentage(
                  varianceRate,
                )})`
              :
                ""
          }
        </p>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}


export function ActualsVarianceWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  editable,
  actuals,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal
              .aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load forecast.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal
              .aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const forecastRows =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const report =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateVarianceReport(
          actuals,
          forecastRows,
        ),
      [
        actuals,
        forecastRows,
      ],
    );


  return (

                </p>

                  }

                    type="hidden"

                    }

                  <label className="flex-1 space-y-2">

                    </span>

      }

            report.summary
              .revenueForecast
          }
          variance={
            report.summary
              .revenueVariance
          }
          varianceRate={
            report.summary
              .revenueVarianceRate
          }
          currency={
            currency
          }
        />

        <SummaryCard
          label="Actual EBITDA"
          actual={
            report.summary
              .ebitdaActual
          }
          forecast={
            report.summary
              .ebitdaForecast
          }

              .ebitdaVariance

                                    Var.
                                  </th>,

                          </tr>
                        </thead>

                        <tbody>

                                <tr

                                >
                                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">
                                    {
                                      period.period
                                    }
                                  </th>

                                  {
                                    DISPLAY_METRICS.flatMap(
                                      (
                                        metric,
                                      ) => {
                                        const variance =
                                          period.metrics[
                                            metric.key
                                          ];


                                        return [
                                          <td
                                            key={`${metric.key}-actual`}

                    type="submit"
                    className="h-10 rounded-lg border border-destructive/40 px-4 text-sm font-medium text-destructive"
                  >
                    Clear actuals
                  </button>
                </form>
              </section>
            )
          :
            null
      }
    </div>
  );
}

type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

    string;

    number |

    AlertAuditEvent[];

  receipts:
    ProjectAlertReceiptView[];
};


function severityTone(
  severity:
    ProjectAlertSeverity,
): string {
  switch (
    severity
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "WARNING":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "INFO":
      return "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400";
  }
}


function severitySurface(
  severity:
    ProjectAlertSeverity,
): string {
  switch (
    severity
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "bg-destructive/5";

    case "WARNING":
      return "bg-amber-500/5";

    case "INFO":
      return "bg-blue-500/5";
  }
}


function formatDate(
  value:
    string |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    !value
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en",
    {
      dateStyle:
        "medium",

      timeStyle:
        "short",
    },
  ).format(
    new Date(
      value,
    ),
  );
}


function ReceiptForm({
  projectId,
  item,
  operation,
  label,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  item:
    ResolvedProjectAlert;

  operation:
    "READ" |
    "UNREAD" |
    "DISMISS" |
    "SNOOZE_24H";

  label:
    string;
}) {
  return (
    <form
      action={
        updateAlertReceiptAction
      }
    >
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="projectId"
        value={
          projectId
        }
      />

      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="alertKey"
        value={
          item.alert.key
        }
      />

      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="fingerprint"
        value={
          item.alert.fingerprint
        }
      />

      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="operation"
        value={
          operation
        }
      />

      <button
        type="submit"
        className="rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
      >
        {
          label
        }
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}


export function AlertInboxWorkspace({
  projectId,
  generatedAt,
  actuals,
  riskPolicy,

  latestActualCash,
  targets,
  commentaries,
  periodStates,
  actions,
  auditEvents,
  receipts,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    severityFilter,
    setSeverityFilter,
  ] =
    useState<
      ProjectAlertSeverity |
      "ALL"
    >(
      "ALL",
    );


  const [
    categoryFilter,
    setCategoryFilter,
  ] =
    useState<
      ProjectAlertCategory |
      "ALL"
    >(
      "ALL",
    );


  const [
    unreadOnly,
    setUnreadOnly,
  ] =
    useState(
      false,
    );


  const [
    showDismissed,
    setShowDismissed,
  ] =
    useState(
      false,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }

            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to calculate live alerts.",

        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }

    [

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

              ) => ({
                status:

                priority:

                dueDate:

        forecasts,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
        actions,
      ],
    );

        calculateManagementScorecard({

          actuals,

          forecasts,

          riskPolicy,

        targets,
        actuals,
        forecasts,
        riskPolicy,

    );

                }

      }

          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Active
          </p>

            {

            }

              inbox.summary
                .unread
            }
          </p>

              inbox.summary
                .warning
            }

          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">

          </p>

            {

                .snoozed
            }
          </p>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Dismissed
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              inbox.summary
                .dismissed
            }
          </p>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Severity
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                severityFilter
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setSeverityFilter(
                  event.target.value as
                    ProjectAlertSeverity |
                    "ALL",
                );
              }}

                All
              </option>

              <option value="CRITICAL">
                Critical
              </option>

              <option value="WARNING">
                Warning
              </option>

              <option value="INFO">
                Info
              </option>

          </label>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Category
            </span>

                categoryFilter
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setCategoryFilter(
                  event.target.value as
                    ProjectAlertCategory |
                    "ALL",
                );

              <option value="ALL">
                All

                      key={
                        category

                        category
                      }

                      {
                        category
                      }
                    </option>

              }
            </select>
          </label>

            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={
                unreadOnly
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setUnreadOnly(
                  event.target.checked,
                );
              }}
            />

            <span className="text-sm">
              Unread only
            </span>
          </label>

          <div className="flex items-end">
            {
              inbox.summary.unread >
              0
                ?
                  (
                    <form
                      action={
                        markAllAlertsReadAction
                      }
                    >
                      <input
                        type="hidden"
                        name="projectId"
                        value={
                          projectId
                        }
                      />

                      <input
                        type="hidden"
                        name="alerts"
                        value={
                          markAllPayload
                        }
                      />

                      <button
                        type="submit"
                        className="h-10 rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 text-sm font-medium text-background"
                      >
                        Mark all read
                      </button>
                    </form>
                  )
                :
                  (
                    <span className="pb-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Inbox is read.
                    </span>
                  )
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Active alert inbox
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-4xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Alerts are derived from live VentureScope authorities. A read, dismissed, or snoozed alert becomes active again automatically when the underlying alert fingerprint changes.
          </p>
        </div>

        {
          filtered.length ===
          0
            ?
              (
                <div className="p-8">
                  <p className="font-medium">
                    No active alerts match the selected filters.
                  </p>

                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    This does not mean the project has no risks; review the dedicated financial and governance workspaces for full detail.
                  </p>
                </div>
              )
            :
              (
                <div className="divide-y">
                  {
                    filtered.map(
                      (
                        item,
                      ) => (
                        <article
                          key={
                            item.alert.key
                          }
                          className={`p-5 ${severitySurface(
                            item.alert.severity,
                          )}`}
                        >
                          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-start">
                            <div className="max-w-4xl">
                              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                                {
                                  !item.read
                                    ?
                                      (
                                        <span className="rounded bg-foreground px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-background">
                                          UNREAD
                                        </span>
                                      )
                                    :
                                      null
                                }

                                {
                                  item.changedSinceReceipt
                                    ?
                                      (
                                        <span className="rounded border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">
                                          CHANGED
                                        </span>
                                      )
                                    :
                                      null
                                }

                                <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${severityTone(
                                  item.alert.severity,
                                )}`}>
                                  {
                                    item.alert.severity
                                  }
                                </span>

                                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                  {
                                    item.alert.category
                                  }
                                </span>
                              </div>

                              <h3 className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold">
                                {
                                  item.alert.title
                                }
                              </h3>

                              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                                {
                                  item.alert.detail
                                }
                              </p>

                              {
                                item.alert.createdAt
                                  ?
                                    (
                                      <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                        Event time: {
                                          formatDate(
                                            item.alert.createdAt,
                                          )
                                        }
                                      </p>
                                    )
                                  :
                                    null
                              }
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex min-w-fit flex-wrap gap-2">
                              <Link
                                href={
                                  item.alert.sourceHref
                                }
                                className="rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
                              >
                                {
                                  item.alert.sourceLabel
                                }
                              </Link>

                              <ReceiptForm
                                projectId={
                                  projectId
                                }
                                item={
                                  item
                                }
                                operation={
                                  item.read
                                    ?
                                      "UNREAD"
                                    :
                                      "READ"
                                }
                                label={
                                  item.read
                                    ?
                                      "Mark unread"
                                    :
                                      "Mark read"
                                }
                              />

                              <ReceiptForm
                                projectId={
                                  projectId
                                }
                                item={
                                  item
                                }
                                operation="SNOOZE_24H"
                                label="Snooze 24h"
                              />

                              <ReceiptForm
                                projectId={
                                  projectId
                                }
                                item={
                                  item
                                }
                                operation="DISMISS"
                                label="Dismiss"
                              />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </article>
                      ),
                    )
                  }
                </div>
              )
        }
      </section>

      {
        inbox.snoozed.length >
        0
          ?
            (
              <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
                <div className="border-b p-5">
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                    Snoozed alerts
                  </h2>

                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Snoozed alerts return automatically after their snooze time, unless the underlying alert changes sooner.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="divide-y">
                  {
                    inbox.snoozed.map(
                      (
                        item,
                      ) => (
                        <article
                          key={
                            item.alert.key
                          }
                          className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 p-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center"
                        >
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-medium">
                              {
                                item.alert.title
                              }
                            </p>

                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              Snoozed until {
                                formatDate(
                                  item.receipt
                                    ?.snoozedUntil ??
                                  null,
                                )
                              }
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <ReceiptForm
                            projectId={
                              projectId
                            }
                            item={
                              item
                            }
                            operation="UNREAD"
                            label="Reactivate now"
                          />
                        </article>
                      ),
                    )
                  }
                </div>
              </section>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-semibold">
              Dismissed alerts
            </h2>

            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Dismissal hides the current fingerprint only. A materially changed underlying alert will automatically return.
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setShowDismissed(
                (
                  value,
                ) =>
                  !value,
              );
            }}
            className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
          >
            {
              showDismissed
                ?
                  "Hide dismissed"
                :
                  `Show dismissed (${inbox.dismissed.length})`
            }
          </button>
        </div>

        {
          showDismissed
            ?
              (
                <div className="mt-5 divide-y rounded-lg border">
                  {
                    inbox.dismissed.length ===
                    0
                      ?
                        (
                          <div className="p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            No dismissed alerts.
                          </div>
                        )
                      :
                        inbox.dismissed.map(
                          (
                            item,
                          ) => (
                            <div
                              key={
                                item.alert.key
                              }
                              className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center"
                            >
                              <div>
                                <p className="font-medium">
                                  {
                                    item.alert.title
                                  }
                                </p>

                                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                  {
                                    item.alert.category
                                  }
                                  {" · "}
                                  {
                                    item.alert.severity
                                  }
                                </p>
                              </div>

                              <ReceiptForm
                                projectId={
                                  projectId
                                }
                                item={
                                  item
                                }
                                operation="UNREAD"
                                label="Reactivate"
                              />
                            </div>
                          ),
                        )
                  }
                </div>
              )
            :
              null
        }
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Notification integrity
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Alert Inbox state is personal to the signed-in user. Marking an alert read, snoozing it, or dismissing it does not resolve the underlying management issue and does not mutate forecasts, Actuals, actions, KPI targets, variance commentary, risk policies, financial-close status, or audit events.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/analytics/advanced-financial-analytics.tsx #####
"use client";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  calculateAdvancedAnalytics,
  normalizeForecastCsv,
  type ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  projectName:
    string;

  currency:
    string;
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
    null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
    null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function multiple(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  return (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  )
    ?
      "—"
    :
      `${value.toFixed(1)}×`;
}


function months(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  return (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  )
    ?
      "—"
    :
      `${value.toFixed(1)} mo`;
}


function MetricCard({
  label,
  value,
  detail,
}: {
  label:
    string;

  value:
    string;

  detail:
    string;
}) {
  return (
    <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
      <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
        {
          label
        }
      </p>

      <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
        {
          value
        }
      </p>

      <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        {
          detail
        }
      </p>
    </article>
  );
}


export function AdvancedFinancialAnalytics({
  projectId,
  projectName,
  currency,
}: Props) {
  const [
    rows,
    setRows,
  ] =
    useState<
      ForecastAnalyticsRow[]
    >(
      [],
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    discountRate,
    setDiscountRate,
  ] =
    useState(
      0.15,
    );


  const [
    terminalGrowthRate,
    setTerminalGrowthRate,
  ] =
    useState(
      0.03,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function load() {
        setLoading(
          true,
        );

        setError(
          null,
        );


        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          const csv =
            await response.text();


          const normalized =
            normalizeForecastCsv(
              csv,
            );


          if (
            normalized.length ===
            0
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              "The current forecast export does not contain recognizable monthly financial rows.",
            );
          }


          setRows(
            normalized,
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal
              .aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load advanced analytics.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal
              .aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void load();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const analytics =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateAdvancedAnalytics(
          rows,
          {
            discountRate,

            terminalGrowthRate,
          },
        ),
      [
        rows,
        discountRate,
        terminalGrowthRate,
      ],
    );


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
        <div className="h-64 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  if (
    error
  ) {
    return (
      <section
        role="alert"
        className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/5 p-5"
      >
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-destructive">
          Analytics unavailable
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {
            error
          }
        </p>

        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Complete enough model assumptions to produce a forecast, then return here.
        </p>
      </section>
    );
  }


  const dcf =
    analytics.dcf;


  const operating =
    analytics.operating;


  const unit =
    analytics.unitEconomics;


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
        <MetricCard
          label="DCF enterprise value"
          value={
            money(
              dcf?.enterpriseValue ??
              null,
              currency,
            )
          }
          detail="Present value of forecast cash flows plus terminal value."
        />

        <MetricCard
          label="Equity value proxy"
          value={
            money(
              dcf?.equityValueProxy ??
              null,
              currency,
            )
          }
          detail="Enterprise value plus modeled ending cash; debt is not netted here."
        />

        <MetricCard
          label="Rule of 40"
          value={
            percent(
              operating.ruleOf40,
            )
          }
          detail="Trailing revenue growth plus EBITDA margin."
        />

        <MetricCard
          label="Burn multiple"
          value={
            multiple(
              operating.burnMultiple,
            )
          }
          detail="Trailing net burn divided by modeled net-new ARR."
        />

        <MetricCard
          label="LTV / CAC"
          value={
            multiple(
              unit.ltvToCac,
            )
          }
          detail="Modeled customer lifetime value divided by acquisition cost."
        />

        <MetricCard
          label="CAC payback"
          value={
            months(
              unit.cacPaybackMonths,
            )
          }
          detail="Months of gross-margin contribution required to recover CAC."
        />
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-end">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              Valuation
            </p>

            <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">
              DCF assumptions
            </h2>

            <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
              VentureScope discounts modeled annual cash flows and applies a Gordon-growth terminal value. These are planning assumptions, not investment advice.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs font-medium">
                Discount rate
              </span>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="80"
                  step="0.5"
                  value={
                    Number(
                      (
                        discountRate *
                        100
                      ).toFixed(
                        2,
                      ),
                    )
                  }
                  onChange={(
                    event,
                  ) => {
                    setDiscountRate(
                      Number(
                        event.target
                          .value,
                      ) /
                        100,
                    );
                  }}
                  className="h-10 w-28 rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                />

                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  %
                </span>
              </div>
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-1">
              <span className="text-xs font-medium">
                Terminal growth
              </span>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="-5"
                  max="15"
                  step="0.25"
                  value={
                    Number(
                      (
                        terminalGrowthRate *
                        100
                      ).toFixed(
                        2,
                      ),
                    )
                  }
                  onChange={(
                    event,
                  ) => {
                    setTerminalGrowthRate(
                      Number(
                        event.target
                          .value,
                      ) /
                        100,
                    );
                  }}
                  className="h-10 w-28 rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                />

                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  %
                </span>
              </div>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>

        {
          dcf
            ?
              (
                <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
                  <MetricCard
                    label="Forecast PV"
                    value={
                      money(
                        dcf.presentValueOfForecast,
                        currency,
                      )
                    }
                    detail="Present value of explicit modeled cash flows."
                  />

                  <MetricCard
                    label="Terminal-value PV"
                    value={
                      money(
                        dcf.presentValueOfTerminalValue,
                        currency,
                      )
                    }
                    detail="Discounted terminal value contribution."
                  />

                  <MetricCard
                    label="Ending cash"
                    value={
                      money(
                        operating.endingCashBalance,
                        currency,
                      )
                    }
                    detail="Ending modeled cash used in the equity-value proxy."
                  />
                </div>
              )
            :
              (
                <div className="mt-6 rounded-lg border border-dashed p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  DCF requires a positive discount rate greater than terminal growth and at least one usable forecast period.
                </div>
              )
        }
      </section>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            Decision support
          </p>

          <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">
            DCF sensitivity matrix
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Rows vary terminal growth; columns vary discount rate.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[680px] text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">
                  Terminal growth
                </th>

                {
                  analytics.sensitivity.discountRates.map(
                    (
                      rate,
                    ) => (
                      <th
                        key={
                          rate
                        }
                        className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium"
                      >
                        {
                          percent(
                            rate,
                          )
                        }
                      </th>
                    ),
                  )
                }
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody>
              {
                analytics.sensitivity.terminalGrowthRates.map(
                  (
                    growth,
                  ) => (
                    <tr
                      key={
                        growth
                      }
                      className="border-b last:border-0"
                    >
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">
                        {
                          percent(
                            growth,
                          )
                        }
                      </th>

                      {
                        analytics.sensitivity.discountRates.map(
                          (
                            discount,
                          ) => {
                            const cell =
                              analytics.sensitivity.cells.find(
                                (
                                  candidate,
                                ) =>
                                  candidate.discountRate ===
                                    discount &&
                                  candidate.terminalGrowthRate ===
                                    growth,
                              );


                            return (
                              <td
                                key={
                                  discount
                                }
                                className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums"
                              >
                                {
                                  money(
                                    cell?.enterpriseValue ??
                                    null,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </td>
                            );
                          },
                        )
                      }
                    </tr>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <h2 className="font-semibold">
            Operating efficiency
          </h2>

          <dl className="mt-5 space-y-4 text-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                Trailing revenue
              </dt>

              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {
                  money(
                    operating.trailingRevenue,
                    currency,
                  )
                }
              </dd>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                Revenue growth
              </dt>

              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {
                  percent(
                    operating.revenueGrowthRate,
                  )
                }
              </dd>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                EBITDA margin
              </dt>

              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {
                  percent(
                    operating.ebitdaMarginRate,
                  )
                }
              </dd>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                Contribution / gross margin
              </dt>

              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {
                  percent(
                    operating.contributionMarginRate,
                  )
                }
              </dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <h2 className="font-semibold">
            Unit economics
          </h2>

          <dl className="mt-5 space-y-4 text-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                Monthly ARPU
              </dt>

              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {
                  money(
                    unit.monthlyArpu,
                    currency,
                  )
                }
              </dd>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                CAC
              </dt>

              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {
                  money(
                    unit.cac,
                    currency,
                  )
                }
              </dd>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                Lifetime value
              </dt>

              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {
                  money(
                    unit.lifetimeValue,
                    currency,
                  )
                }
              </dd>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                Churn rate
              </dt>

              <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {
                  percent(
                    unit.churnRate,
                  )
                }
              </dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
        </div>
      </section>

      {
        dcf?.annualCashFlows.length
          ?
            (
              <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
                <div className="border-b p-5">
                  <h2 className="font-semibold">
                    Annual valuation cash flows
                  </h2>

                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Derived from the authoritative monthly forecast export for {
                      projectName
                    }.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[560px] text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Year
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Revenue
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          EBITDA
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Cash-flow proxy
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody>
                      {
                        dcf.annualCashFlows.map(
                          (
                            year,
                          ) => (
                            <tr
                              key={
                                year.year
                              }
                              className="border-b last:border-0"
                            >
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">
                                Year {
                                  year.year
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                {
                                  money(
                                    year.revenue,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                {
                                  money(
                                    year.ebitda,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                {
                                  money(
                                    year.freeCashFlow,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </section>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        Parsed {
          analytics.rowCount
        } forecast rows. Advanced analytics are deterministic planning outputs derived from your VentureScope forecast and should not be treated as accounting, tax, or investment advice.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

  decideApprovalRequestAction,

  APPROVAL_REQUEST_STATUSES,
  APPROVAL_REQUEST_TYPES,
  type ApprovalRequestView,
  type ApprovalSummary,
} from "@/lib/approvals/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  currentUserId:
    string;

  canRequest:
    boolean;

  canDecide:
    boolean;

  summary:
    ApprovalSummary;

  requests:
    ApprovalRequestView[];

  filters: {
    status:
      string;

    requestType:
      string;

    query:
      string;
  };
};


function statusTone(
  status:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    status
  ) {
    case "APPROVED":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "REJECTED":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "PENDING":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "CANCELLED":
      return "text-muted-foreground";

    default:
      return "";
  }
}


function requestTypeLabel(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll(
      "_",
      " ",
    )
    .replace(
      /\b\w/gu,
      (
        character,
      ) =>
        character.toUpperCase(),
    );
}


function personLabel(
  value:
    string |
    null,
): string {
  return value ??
    "Unavailable";
}

                                                    <input
                                                      type="hidden"
                                                      name="projectId"
                                                      value={
                                                        projectId
                                                      }
                                                    />

                                                    <input
                                                      type="hidden"
                                                      name="requestId"
                                                      value={
                                                        request.id
                                                      }
                                                    />

                                                    <input
                                                      type="hidden"
                                                      name="decision"
                                                      value="REJECT"
                                                    />

                                                    <textarea
                                                      required
                                                      minLength={
                                                        5
                                                      }
                                                      maxLength={
                                                        2000
                                                      }
                                                      rows={
                                                        3
                                                      }
                                                      name="decisionNote"
                                                      placeholder="Required rejection rationale"
                                                      className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                                                    />

                                                    <button
                                                      type="submit"
                                                      className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-destructive"
                                                    >
                                                      Reject request
                                                    </button>
                                                  </form>
                                                </>
                                              )
                                            :
                                              null
                                        }

                                        {
                                          mayCancel
                                            ?
                                              (
                                                <form
                                                  action={
                                                    cancelApprovalRequestAction
                                                  }
                                                >
                                                  <input
                                                    type="hidden"
                                                    name="projectId"
                                                    value={
                                                      projectId
                                                    }
                                                  />

                                                  <input
                                                    type="hidden"
                                                    name="requestId"
                                                    value={
                                                      request.id
                                                    }
                                                  />

                                                  <button
                                                    type="submit"
                                                    className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium"
                                                  >
                                                    Cancel my request
                                                  </button>
                                                </form>
                                              )
                                            :
                                              null
                                        }
                                      </div>
                                    )
                                  :
                                    null
                              }
                            </div>
                          </article>
                        );
                      },
                    )
                  }
                </div>
              )
        }
      </section>

      <section className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/activity`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Activity Center
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/alerts`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Alert Inbox
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/decision-center`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Decision Center
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/period-close`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Financial Close
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/board-room`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Board Room
        </Link>
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Approval integrity
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          An APPROVED request records management authorization; it does not automatically modify the financial model or execute another workflow. Forecast changes, risk-policy updates, financial-period reopening, KPI changes, capital decisions, and imports remain governed by their own authoritative services. This prevents approval records from becoming an uncontrolled backdoor around existing domain security.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/assumptions/assumption-action-message.tsx #####
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  CircleAlert,
} from "lucide-react";

import type {
  AssumptionActionState,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/action-state";
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

export function AssumptionActionMessage({
  state,
}: {
  state: AssumptionActionState;
}) {
  if (
    !state.message
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const success =
    state.status ===
    "success";

  const Icon =
    success
      ? CheckCircle2
      : CircleAlert;

  return (
    <div
      role={
        success
          ? "status"
          : "alert"
      }
      className={cn(
        "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm",
        success
          ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5"
          : "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive",
      )}
    >
      <Icon
        className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      <span>
        {
          state.message
        }
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/assumptions/assumption-save-button.tsx #####
"use client";

import {
  LoaderCircle,
  Save,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  useFormStatus,
} from "react-dom";

import {
  Button,
} from "@/components/ui/button";

type AssumptionSaveButtonProps = {
  label?: string;
  pendingLabel?: string;
};

export function AssumptionSaveButton({
  label = "Save assumptions",
  pendingLabel = "Saving...",
}: AssumptionSaveButtonProps) {
  const {
    pending,
  } = useFormStatus();

  return (
    <Button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending}
    >
      {pending ? (
        <>
          <LoaderCircle
            className="size-4 animate-spin"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />

          {pendingLabel}
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Save
            className="size-4"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />

          {label}
        </>
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}

  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

type ExpenseAssumptionsFormProps = {
  projectId: string;
  currency: string;
  assumptions: ExpenseAssumptions;
};

export function ExpenseAssumptionsForm({
  projectId,
  currency,
  assumptions,
}: ExpenseAssumptionsFormProps) {
  const [
    state,
    action,
  ] = useActionState(
    saveExpenseAssumptionsAction,
    initialAssumptionActionState,
  );

  const [
    cogsMethod,
    setCogsMethod,
  ] =
    useState<CogsMethod>(
      assumptions.cogs.method,
    );

  const [
    marketingGrowthPeriod,
    setMarketingGrowthPeriod,
  ] =
    useState<GrowthPeriod>(
      assumptions.marketing
        .growthPeriod,
    );

  const [
    customExpenses,
    setCustomExpenses,
  ] = useState<
    CustomOperatingExpense[]
  >(
    assumptions.operatingExpenses
      .custom,
  );

  function addCustomExpense() {
    if (
      customExpenses.length >=
      20
    ) {
      return;
    }

    setCustomExpenses(
      (
        current,
      ) => [
        ...current,
        {
          id:
            crypto.randomUUID(),
          name: "",
          monthlyAmount:
            "0",
        },
      ],
    );
  }

  function updateCustomExpense(
    id: string,
    field:
      | "name"
      | "monthlyAmount",
    value: string,
  ) {
    setCustomExpenses(
      (
        current,
      ) =>
        current.map(
          (
            expense,
          ) =>
            expense.id ===
            id
              ? {
                  ...expense,
                  [field]:
                    value,
                }
              : expense,
        ),
    );
  }

  function removeCustomExpense(
    id: string,
  ) {
    setCustomExpenses(
      (
        current,
      ) =>
        current.filter(
          (
            expense,
          ) =>
            expense.id !==
            id,
        ),
    );
  }

  return (
    <form
      action={action}
      className="space-y-6"
    >
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="projectId"
        value={projectId}
      />

      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="cogsMethod"
        value={cogsMethod}
      />

      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="marketingGrowthPeriod"
        value={
          marketingGrowthPeriod
        }
      />

      <AssumptionActionMessage
        state={state}
      />

      <Card className="border-border/70">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <CardTitle>
                Salaries
              </CardTitle>

              <CardDescription className="mt-1">
                Monthly payroll and annual salary growth.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>

            <BriefcaseBusiness
              className="size-5 text-muted-foreground"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

            id="salariesMonthly"
            name="salariesMonthly"
            label="Monthly salaries"
            currency={currency}
            defaultValue={
              assumptions.salaries
                .monthlyAmount
            }
            min="-0"
            error={
              state.errors
                ?.salariesMonthly?.[0]
            }
          />

            id="salaryAnnualGrowthRate"
            name="salaryAnnualGrowthRate"
            label="Annual salary growth"
            suffix="% / year"
            defaultValue={
              assumptions.salaries
                .annualGrowthRate
            }
            min="-100"
            error={
              state.errors
                ?.salaryAnnualGrowthRate?.[0]
            }
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card className="border-border/70">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <CardTitle>
                Rent
              </CardTitle>

              <CardDescription className="mt-1">

                }

                }
              >
                <Plus

            </div>

            {customExpenses.length ===
            0 ? (
              <div className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-dashed p-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                No custom operating expenses.
              </div>
            ) : (

                        }

                          value={
                            expense.name
                          }
                          onChange={(
                            event,
                          ) =>
                            updateCustomExpense(
                              expense.id,
                              "name",
                              event
                                .target
                                .value,
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder={`Custom expense ${index + 1}`}
                          required
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <Label
                          htmlFor={`custom-amount-${expense.id}`}
                        >
                          Monthly amount
                        </Label>

                        <div className="relative">
                          <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">

                            }
                          </span>

                          <Input

                            name="customExpenseMonthlyAmount"
                            type="number"
                            min="0"
                            step="0.01"
                            value={
                              expense.monthlyAmount
                            }
                            onChange={(
                              event,
                            ) =>
                              updateCustomExpense(
                                expense.id,
                                "monthlyAmount",
                                event
                                  .target
                                  .value,
                              )
                            }
                            className="pl-14"
                            required
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-end">

                          type="button"
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          aria-label={`Remove ${expense.name || "custom expense"}`}

                            removeCustomExpense(

                            )
                          }

                            className="size-4"
                            aria-hidden="true"
                          />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ),
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {state.errors
              ?.customExpenses?.[0] ? (
              <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-destructive">
                {
                  state.errors
                    .customExpenses[0]
                }
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </CardContent>

        <CardFooter className="justify-end border-t py-5">
          <AssumptionSaveButton
            label="Save expense assumptions"
          />
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}

type ExpenseFieldProps = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  label: string;
  defaultValue: string;
  currency?: string;
  suffix?: string;
  min?: string;
  max?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  error?: string;
};

function ExpenseField({
  id,
  name,
  label,
  defaultValue,
  currency,
  suffix,
  min,
  max,
  disabled = false,
  error,
}: ExpenseFieldProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Label htmlFor={id}>
        {label}
      </Label>

      <div className="relative">
        {currency ? (
          <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 z-10 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            {currency}
          </span>
        ) : null}

        <Input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type="number"
          min={min}
          max={max}
          step="0.01"
          defaultValue={
            defaultValue
          }
          disabled={
            disabled
          }
          className={cn(
            currency &&
              "pl-14",
            suffix &&
              "pr-24",
          )}
          required={
            !disabled
          }
        />

        {suffix ? (
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {suffix}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {error ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import {
  CircleDollarSign,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  useActionState,
} from "react";

import {
  saveRevenueAssumptionsAction,
} from "@/app/(app)/projects/assumption-actions";
import {
  AssumptionActionMessage,
} from "@/components/assumptions/assumption-action-message";
import {
  AssumptionSaveButton,
} from "@/components/assumptions/assumption-save-button";
import {
  Badge,
} from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Input,
} from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Label,
} from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  initialAssumptionActionState,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/action-state";
import type {
  CustomerRevenueAssumptions,
  DirectRevenueAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/types";

type RevenueAssumptionsFormProps = {
  projectId: string;
  currency: string;

  revenueMode:
    | "DIRECT"
    | "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN";

  directAssumptions: DirectRevenueAssumptions;

  customerAssumptions: CustomerRevenueAssumptions;

  marketingMonthlyAmount: string;
};

export function RevenueAssumptionsForm({
  projectId,
  currency,
  revenueMode,
  directAssumptions,
  customerAssumptions,
  marketingMonthlyAmount,
}: RevenueAssumptionsFormProps) {
  const [
    state,
    action,
  ] = useActionState(
    saveRevenueAssumptionsAction,
    initialAssumptionActionState,
  );

  const direct =
    revenueMode ===
    "DIRECT";

  return (
    <form
      action={action}
    >
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="projectId"
        value={projectId}
      />

      <Card className="border-border/70">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start">
            <div>
              <div className="mb-3">
                <Badge>
                  {direct
                    ? "DIRECT REVENUE"
                    : "CUSTOMER-DRIVEN"}
                </Badge>
              </div>

              <CardTitle>
                {direct
                  ? "Direct revenue assumptions"
                  : "Customer-driven revenue assumptions"}
              </CardTitle>

              <CardDescription className="mt-1 max-w-2xl">
                {direct
                  ? "Revenue will later be forecast directly from the starting monthly revenue and growth assumptions."
                  : "Revenue will later be generated from customer acquisition, churn and ARPU."}
              </CardDescription>
            </div>

            {direct ? (
              <TrendingUp
                className="size-5 text-muted-foreground"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
            ) : (
              <Users
                className="size-5 text-muted-foreground"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="space-y-7">
          <AssumptionActionMessage
            state={state}
          />

          {direct ? (
            <DirectFields
              currency={currency}
              assumptions={
                directAssumptions
              }
              errors={
                state.errors
              }
            />
          ) : (
            <CustomerFields
              projectId={
                projectId
              }
              currency={
                currency
              }
              assumptions={
                customerAssumptions
              }
              marketingMonthlyAmount={
                marketingMonthlyAmount
              }
              errors={
                state.errors
              }
            />
          )}
        </CardContent>

        <CardFooter className="justify-end border-t py-5">
          <AssumptionSaveButton
            label="Save revenue assumptions"
          />
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}

type FinancialFieldProps = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  label: string;
  defaultValue: string;
  prefix?: string;
  suffix?: string;
  min?: string;
  max?: string;
  step?: string;
  help: string;
  error?: string;
};

function FinancialField({
  id,
  name,
  label,
  defaultValue,
  prefix,
  suffix,
  min,
  max,
  step = "0.01",
  help,
  error,
}: FinancialFieldProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Label htmlFor={id}>
        {label}
      </Label>

      <div className="relative">
        {prefix ? (
          <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            {prefix}
          </span>
        ) : null}

        <Input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type="number"
          defaultValue={
            defaultValue
          }
          min={min}
          max={max}
          step={step}
          className={
            prefix
              ? "pl-14"
              : suffix
                ? "pr-24"
                : undefined
          }
          required
        />

        {suffix ? (
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {suffix}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        {help}
      </p>

      {error ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/auth/auth-submit-button.tsx #####
"use client";

import { LoaderCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

type AuthSubmitButtonProps = {
  idleLabel: string;
  pendingLabel: string;
};

export function AuthSubmitButton({
  idleLabel,
  pendingLabel,
}: AuthSubmitButtonProps) {
  const {
    pending,
  } = useFormStatus();

  return (
    <Button
      type="submit"
      className="w-full"
      disabled={pending}
    >
      {pending ? (
        <>
          <LoaderCircle
            className="size-4 animate-spin"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />

          {pendingLabel}
        </>
      ) : (
        idleLabel
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}
