"use client";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/snapshot";

import {
  compareExecutiveReview,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/comparison";

import {
  calculateManagementScorecard,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/calculations";

import {
  kpiMetricDefinition,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/metrics";

import {
  calculateVarianceReview,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/calculations";

import {
  varianceMetricDefinition,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/metrics";

import {
  buildFinancialPeriodRegister,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/register";

import {
  buildBoardPackExecutiveSummary,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-pack/insights";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";

import type {
  KpiTargetView,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/types";

import type {
  VarianceCommentaryView,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/types";

import type {
  FinancialPeriodStateView,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/types";

import type {
  BoardPackActionView,
  BoardPackAuditSummary,
  BoardPackLatestReview,
  BoardPackInsightSeverity,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-pack/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  projectName:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  modelVersion:
    string;

  generatedAt:
    string;

  defaultReportPeriod:
    string;

  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  targets:
    KpiTargetView[];

  commentaries:
    VarianceCommentaryView[];

  periodStates:
    FinancialPeriodStateView[];

  actions:
    BoardPackActionView[];

  latestReview:
    BoardPackLatestReview |
    null;

  auditSummary:
    BoardPackAuditSummary;
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function numberValue(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function insightTone(
  severity:
    BoardPackInsightSeverity,
): string {
  switch (
    severity
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "WARNING":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "INFO":
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function scorecardValue({
  metric,
  value,
  currency,
}: {
  metric:
    KpiTargetView[
      "metricCode"
    ];

  value:
    number |
    null;

  currency:
    string;
}) {
  const format =
    kpiMetricDefinition(
      metric,
    ).format;


  switch (
    format
  ) {
    case "MONEY":
      return money(
        value,
        currency,
      );


    case "PERCENT":
      return percent(
        value,
      );


    case "MONTHS":
      return value ===
        null
        ?
          "—"
        :
          `${numberValue(
            value,
          )} mo`;


    case "NUMBER":
      return numberValue(
        value,
      );
  }
}


function varianceValue({
  metric,
  value,
  currency,
}: {
  metric:
    VarianceCommentaryView[
      "metricCode"
    ];

  value:
    number |
    null;

  currency:
    string;
}) {
  return varianceMetricDefinition(
    metric,
  ).format ===
    "MONEY"
    ?
      money(
        value,
        currency,
      )
    :
      numberValue(
        value,
      );
}


function printDocument() {
  window.print();
}


export function BoardPackWorkspace({
  projectId,
  projectName,
  currency,
  modelVersion,
  generatedAt,
  defaultReportPeriod,
  actuals,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
  targets,
  commentaries,
  periodStates,
  actions,
  latestReview,
  auditSummary,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    reportPeriod,
    setReportPeriod,
  ] =
    useState(
      defaultReportPeriod,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to prepare the management board pack.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const forecasts =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const liveSnapshot =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot({
          capturedAt:
            generatedAt,

          actuals,

          forecasts,

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,

          actions:
            actions.map(
              (
                action,
              ) => ({
                status:
                  action.status,

                priority:
                  action.priority,

                dueDate:
                  action.dueDate,
              }),
            ),
        }),
      [
        generatedAt,
        actuals,
        forecasts,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
        actions,
      ],
    );


  const scorecard =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateManagementScorecard({
          targets,

          actuals,

          forecasts,

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,
        }),
      [
        targets,
        actuals,
        forecasts,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
      ],
    );


  const varianceReview =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateVarianceReview({
          actuals,

          forecasts,

          commentaries,
        }),
      [
        actuals,
        forecasts,
        commentaries,
      ],
    );


  const periodRegister =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildFinancialPeriodRegister({
          actuals:
            actuals.map(
              (
                actual,
              ) => ({
                periodKey:
                  actual.period,

                revenue:
                  actual.revenue,

                ebitda:
                  actual.ebitda,

                cashBalance:
                  actual.cashBalance,
              }),
            ),

          states:
            periodStates,
        }),
      [
        actuals,
        periodStates,
      ],
    );


  const executiveSummary =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildBoardPackExecutiveSummary({
          reportPeriod,

          liveSnapshot,

          scorecard,

          varianceReview,

          periodRegister,

          actions,
        }),
      [
        reportPeriod,
        liveSnapshot,
        scorecard,
        varianceReview,
        periodRegister,
        actions,
      ],
    );


  const latestReviewComparison =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        latestReview
          ?
            compareExecutiveReview(
              latestReview.snapshot,
              liveSnapshot,
            )
          :
            null,
      [
        latestReview,
        liveSnapshot,
      ],
    );


  const reportPeriods =
    useMemo(
      () => {
        const periods =
          [
            ...new Set(
              actuals.map(
                (
                  actual,
                ) =>
                  actual.period,
              ),
            ),
          ].sort(
            (
              left,
              right,
            ) =>
              right.localeCompare(
                left,
              ),
          );


        return periods.length >
          0
          ?
            periods
          :
            [
              defaultReportPeriod,
            ];
      },
      [
        actuals,
        defaultReportPeriod,
      ],
    );


  const reportScorecardRows =
    scorecard.rows
      .filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.target.periodKey ===
          reportPeriod,
      )
      .slice(
        0,
        12,
      );


  const materialVarianceRows =
    varianceReview.rows
      .filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.periodKey ===
            reportPeriod &&
          (
            row.materiality ===
              "MATERIAL" ||
            row.materiality ===
              "REVIEW"
          ),
      )
      .slice(
        0,
        12,
      );


  const openActions =
    actions
      .filter(
        (
          action,
        ) =>
          action.status !==
            "DONE" &&
          action.status !==
            "DISMISSED",
      )
      .slice(
        0,
        12,
      );


  const reportClose =
    periodRegister.rows.find(
      (
        row,
      ) =>
        row.periodKey ===
        reportPeriod,
    ) ??
    null;


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                4,
            }).map(
              (
                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-96 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {
          `
          @media print {
            @page {
              size: A4;
              margin: 12mm;
            }

            body {
              background: white !important;
            }

            .board-pack-print-hidden {
              display: none !important;
            }

            .board-pack-sheet {
              max-width: none !important;
              width: 100% !important;
            }

            .board-pack-break-before {
              break-before: page;
            }

            .board-pack-avoid-break {
              break-inside: avoid;
            }

            .board-pack-table {
              font-size: 10px;
            }
          }
          `
        }
      </style>

      <div className="board-pack-sheet space-y-8">
        {
          error
            ?
              (
                <div
                  role="alert"
                  className="board-pack-print-hidden rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm"
                >
                  {
                    error
                  }
                </div>
              )
            :
              null
        }

        <section className="board-pack-print-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-end">
            <label className="space-y-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                Reporting period
              </span>

              <select
                value={
                  reportPeriod
                }
                onChange={(
                  event,
                ) => {
                  setReportPeriod(
                    event.target.value,
                  );
                }}
                className="h-10 min-w-56 rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  reportPeriods.map(
                    (
                      period,
                    ) => (
                      <option
                        key={
                          period
                        }
                        value={
                          period
                        }
                      >
                        {
                          period
                        }
                      </option>
                    ),
                  )
                }
              </select>
            </label>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={
                  printDocument
                }
                className="rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-background"
              >
                Print / Save as PDF
              </button>

              <Link
                href={`/projects/${projectId}/board-room`}
                className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
              >
                Board Room
              </Link>

              <Link
                href={`/projects/${projectId}/activity`}
                className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
              >
                Activity Center
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="board-pack-avoid-break rounded-xl border bg-background p-6">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            VentureScope Management Reporting
          </p>

          <h1 className="mt-2 text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            {
              projectName
            }
          </h1>

          <p className="mt-3 text-xl">
            Board &amp; Management Pack · {
              reportPeriod
            }
          </p>

          <div className="mt-8 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Generated
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium">
                {
                  new Date(
                    generatedAt,
                  ).toLocaleString()
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Currency
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium">
                {
                  currency
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Model version
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium">
                {
                  modelVersion
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                Financial close
              </p>

              <p className={`mt-1 text-sm font-semibold ${
                reportClose?.status ===
                  "CLOSED"
                  ?
                    "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                  :
                    "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400"
              }`}>
                {
                  reportClose?.status ??
                  "NO ACTUALS"
                }
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <article className="board-pack-avoid-break rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
              Forecast accuracy
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
              {
                percent(
                  liveSnapshot
                    .kpis
                    .forecastAccuracyScore,
                )
              }
            </p>
          </article>

          <article className="board-pack-avoid-break rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
              Liquidity risk
            </p>

            <p className={`mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold ${
              liveSnapshot.kpis
                .liquidityRiskLevel ===
                "CRITICAL" ||
              liveSnapshot.kpis
                .liquidityRiskLevel ===
                "HIGH"
                ?
                  "text-destructive"
                :
                  ""
            }`}>
              {
                liveSnapshot
                  .kpis
                  .liquidityRiskLevel
              }
            </p>

            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Score {
                liveSnapshot
                  .kpis
                  .liquidityRiskScore
              } / 100
            </p>
          </article>

          <article className="board-pack-avoid-break rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
              Capital need
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
              {
                money(
                  liveSnapshot
                    .kpis
                    .capitalNeed,
                  currency,
                )
              }
            </p>
          </article>

          <article className="board-pack-avoid-break rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
              Open actions
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
              {
                liveSnapshot
                  .actions
                  .open
              }
            </p>

            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {
                liveSnapshot
                  .actions
                  .criticalOpen
              } critical · {
                liveSnapshot
                  .actions
                  .overdue
              } overdue
            </p>
          </article>
        </section>

        <section className="board-pack-avoid-break rounded-xl border bg-background">
          <div className="border-b p-5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">
                  Executive summary
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Deterministic management exceptions derived from existing VentureScope authorities.
                </p>
              </div>

              <p className="text-sm">
                <span className="font-semibold text-destructive">
                  {
                    executiveSummary
                      .critical
                  } critical
                </span>
                {" · "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                  {
                    executiveSummary
                      .warnings
                  } warning
                </span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="divide-y">
            {
              executiveSummary
                .insights
                .map(
                  (
                    insight,
                  ) => (
                    <article
                      key={
                        insight.code
                      }
                      className="board-pack-avoid-break p-5"
                    >
                      <p className={`text-xs font-semibold ${insightTone(
                        insight.severity,
                      )}`}>
                        {
                          insight.severity
                        }
                      </p>

                      <h3 className="mt-2 font-semibold">
                        {
                          insight.title
                        }
                      </h3>

                      <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                        {
                          insight.detail
                        }
                      </p>

                      <p className="mt-2 text-sm">
                        <span className="font-medium">
                          Management response:
                        </span>{" "}
                        {
                          insight.managementResponse
                        }
                      </p>
                    </article>
                  ),
                )
            }
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="board-pack-avoid-break grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
              Revenue variance
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
              {
                percent(
                  liveSnapshot
                    .kpis
                    .revenueVarianceRate,
                )
              }
            </p>
          </article>

          <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
              EBITDA variance
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
              {
                percent(
                  liveSnapshot
                    .kpis
                    .ebitdaVarianceRate,
                )
              }
            </p>
          </article>

          <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
              Downside minimum cash
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
              {
                money(
                  liveSnapshot
                    .kpis
                    .minimumDownsideCash,
                  currency,
                )
              }
            </p>
          </article>
        </section>

        <section className="board-pack-break-before rounded-xl border bg-background">
          <div className="border-b p-5">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">
              Management scorecard
            </h2>

            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {
                scorecard.summary.onTrack
              } on track · {
                scorecard.summary.atRisk
              } at risk · {
                scorecard.summary.offTrack
              } off track
            </p>
          </div>

          {
            reportScorecardRows.length ===
            0
              ?
                (
                  <div className="p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    No KPI targets are configured for {
                      reportPeriod
                    }.
                  </div>
                )
              :
                (
                  <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="board-pack-table w-full min-w-[760px] text-sm">
                      <thead>
                        <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                            KPI
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                            Status
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Target
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Current
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Gap
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                            Owner
                          </th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>

                      <tbody>
                        {
                          reportScorecardRows.map(
                            (
                              row,
                            ) => (
                              <tr
                                key={
                                  row.target.id
                                }
                                className="border-b last:border-0"
                              >
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                  {
                                    kpiMetricDefinition(
                                      row.target.metricCode,
                                    ).label
                                  }
                                </th>

                                <td className={`px-4 py-3 font-semibold ${
                                  row.status ===
                                    "OFF_TRACK"
                                    ?
                                      "text-destructive"
                                    :
                                  row.status ===
                                    "AT_RISK"
                                    ?
                                      "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400"
                                    :
                                  row.status ===
                                    "ON_TRACK"
                                    ?
                                      "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                    :
                                      "text-muted-foreground"
                                }`}>
                                  {
                                    row.status
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                  {
                                    scorecardValue({
                                      metric:
                                        row.target.metricCode,

                                      value:
                                        row.target.targetValue,

##### FILE: ./components/board-room/board-room-workspace.tsx #####
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/snapshot";

import {
  compareExecutiveReview,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/comparison";

import type {
  ExecutiveActionState,
  ExecutiveReviewView,
  ReviewComparisonMetric,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/types";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";

import {
  createExecutiveReviewAction,
} from "@/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/board-room/actions";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  editable:
    boolean;

  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  actionStates:
    ExecutiveActionState[];

  reviews:
    ExecutiveReviewView[];

  liveCapturedAt:
    string;
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function signedPercent(
  metric:
    ReviewComparisonMetric,
): string {
  if (
    metric.delta ===
    null
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  const formatted =
    percent(
      Math.abs(
        metric.delta,
      ),
    );


  if (
    metric.delta >
    0
  ) {
    return `+${formatted}`;
  }


  if (
    metric.delta <
    0
  ) {
    return `-${formatted}`;
  }


  return formatted;
}


function signedNumber(
  metric:
    ReviewComparisonMetric,
): string {
  if (
    metric.delta ===
    null
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return metric.delta >
    0
    ?
      `+${metric.delta}`
    :
      String(
        metric.delta,
      );
}


function signedMoney(
  metric:
    ReviewComparisonMetric,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    metric.delta ===
    null
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  const formatted =
    money(
      Math.abs(
        metric.delta,
      ),
      currency,
    );


  return metric.delta >
    0
    ?
      `+${formatted}`
    :
    metric.delta <
      0
      ?
        `-${formatted}`
      :
        formatted;
}


function riskTone(
  level:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    level
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
    case "HIGH":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "MODERATE":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    default:
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";
  }
}


export function BoardRoomWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  editable,
  actuals,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
  actionStates,
  reviews,
  liveCapturedAt,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    selectedReviewId,
    setSelectedReviewId,
  ] =
    useState(
      reviews[
        0
      ]?.id ??
      "",
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load Board Room financial intelligence.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const forecasts =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const liveSnapshot =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot({
          capturedAt:
            liveCapturedAt,

          actuals,

          forecasts,

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,

          actions:
            actionStates,
        }),
      [
        liveCapturedAt,
        actuals,
        forecasts,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
        actionStates,
      ],
    );


  const selectedReview =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        reviews.find(
          (
            review,
          ) =>
            review.id ===
            selectedReviewId,
        ) ??
        reviews[
          0
        ] ??
        null,
      [
        reviews,
        selectedReviewId,
      ],
    );


  const comparison =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        selectedReview
          ?
            compareExecutiveReview(
              selectedReview
                .snapshot,
              liveSnapshot,
            )
          :
            null,
      [
        selectedReview,
        liveSnapshot,
      ],
    );


  const defaultPeriod =
    latestActualPeriod ??
    liveCapturedAt.slice(
      0,
      7,
    );


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                4,
            }).map(
              (
                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-80 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {
        error
          ?
            (
              <div
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  error
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Forecast accuracy
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              percent(
                liveSnapshot
                  .kpis
                  .forecastAccuracyScore,
              )
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Historical forecast reliability.
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Liquidity risk
          </p>

          <p className={`mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold ${riskTone(
            liveSnapshot
              .kpis
              .liquidityRiskLevel,
          )}`}>
            {
              liveSnapshot
                .kpis
                .liquidityRiskLevel

##### FILE: ./components/brand/venturescope-logo.tsx #####
import {
  ChartNoAxesCombined,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type VentureScopeLogoProps = {
  href?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
};

export function VentureScopeLogo({
  href = "/",
  compact = false,
  className,
}: VentureScopeLogoProps) {
  const content = (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center gap-2.5",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-foreground text-background shadow-sm">
        <ChartNoAxesCombined
          className="size-5"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      </div>

      {!compact ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col leading-none">
          <span className="text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight">
            VentureScope
          </span>

          <span className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-muted-foreground">
            Financial Intelligence
          </span>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );

  if (!href) {
    return content;
  }

  return (
    <Link
      href={href}
      aria-label="VentureScope home"
    >
      {content}
    </Link>
  );
}

"use client";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  calculateCapitalPlanningReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/calculations";

import type {
  CapitalPlanningBasis,
  CapitalStrategyKind,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  editable:
    boolean;

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;
};


const STRATEGY_LABELS:
  Record<
    CapitalStrategyKind,
    string
  > = {
    EQUITY:
      "Equity",

    DEBT:
      "Debt",

    HYBRID:
      "Hybrid",
  };


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function numericInput(
  value:
    string,
  fallback:
    number,
): number {
  if (
    value.trim() ===
    ""
  ) {
    return fallback;
  }


  const parsed =
    Number(
      value,
    );


  return Number.isFinite(
    parsed,
  )
    ?
      parsed
    :
      fallback;
}


function floorTone(
  breach:
    string |
    null,
): string {
  return breach
    ?
      "text-destructive"
    :
      "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";
}


export function CapitalPlanningWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  editable,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    basis,
    setBasis,
  ] =
    useState<
      CapitalPlanningBasis
    >(
      "DOWNSIDE",
    );


  const [
    targetCashFloor,
    setTargetCashFloor,
  ] =
    useState(
      String(
        riskPolicy.minimumCash ??
        0,
      ),
    );


  const [
    raisePeriodIndex,
    setRaisePeriodIndex,
  ] =
    useState(
      0,
    );


  const [
    capitalOverride,
    setCapitalOverride,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    preMoneyValuation,
    setPreMoneyValuation,
  ] =
    useState(
      "5000000",
    );


  const [
    debtRatePercent,
    setDebtRatePercent,
  ] =
    useState(
      "8",
    );


  const [
    debtTermMonths,
    setDebtTermMonths,
  ] =
    useState(
      "36",
    );


  const [
    hybridEquityPercent,
    setHybridEquityPercent,
  ] =
    useState(
      "50",
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load forecast capital data.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const rows =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const parsedTargetFloor =
    Math.max(
      0,
      numericInput(
        targetCashFloor,
        0,
      ),
    );


  const baseInputs =
    useMemo(
      () => ({
        targetCashFloor:
          parsedTargetFloor,

        raisePeriodIndex,

        capitalAmount:
          0,

        preMoneyValuation:
          Math.max(
            0,
            numericInput(
              preMoneyValuation,
              0,
            ),
          ),

        annualDebtRate:
          Math.min(
            1,
            Math.max(
              0,
              numericInput(
                debtRatePercent,
                0,
              ) /
              100,
            ),
          ),

        debtTermMonths:
          Math.min(
            120,
            Math.max(
              1,
              Math.round(
                numericInput(
                  debtTermMonths,
                  36,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),

        hybridEquityShare:
          Math.min(
            1,
            Math.max(
              0,
              numericInput(
                hybridEquityPercent,
                50,
              ) /
              100,
            ),
          ),
      }),
      [
        parsedTargetFloor,
        raisePeriodIndex,
        preMoneyValuation,
        debtRatePercent,
        debtTermMonths,
        hybridEquityPercent,
      ],
    );


  const fundingGapReport =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateCapitalPlanningReport({
          basis,

          rows,

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,

          inputs:
            baseInputs,
        }),
      [
        basis,
        rows,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
        baseInputs,
      ],
    );


  const effectiveCapital =
    capitalOverride.trim() ===
      ""
      ?
        fundingGapReport
          .requiredCapitalAfterRaise
      :
        Math.max(
          0,
          numericInput(
            capitalOverride,
            fundingGapReport
              .requiredCapitalAfterRaise,
          ),
        );


  const report =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateCapitalPlanningReport({
          basis,

          rows,

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,

          inputs: {
            ...baseInputs,

            capitalAmount:
              effectiveCapital,
          },
        }),
      [
        basis,
        rows,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
        baseInputs,
        effectiveCapital,
      ],
    );


  const equity =
    report.strategies.find(
      (
        strategy,
      ) =>
        strategy.kind ===
        "EQUITY",
    );


  const debt =
    report.strategies.find(
      (
        strategy,
      ) =>
        strategy.kind ===
        "DEBT",
    );


  const hybrid =
    report.strategies.find(
      (
        strategy,
      ) =>
        strategy.kind ===
        "HYBRID",
    );


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {
        editable
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                  Capital planning assumptions
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                  Compare capital structures without changing the underlying VentureScope forecast. Blank capital amount uses the calculated funding gap automatically.
                </p>

                <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Planning basis
                    </span>

                    <select
                      value={
                        basis
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setBasis(
                          event.target.value as
                            CapitalPlanningBasis,
                        );

                        setRaisePeriodIndex(
                          0,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                      <option value="DOWNSIDE">
                        Downside stress
                      </option>

                      <option value="BASE">
                        Base forecast
                      </option>
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Target cash floor
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      step="0.01"
                      value={
                        targetCashFloor
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setTargetCashFloor(
                          event.target.value,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Funding month
                    </span>

                    <select
                      value={
                        Math.min(
                          raisePeriodIndex,
                          Math.max(
                            0,
                            report.sourcePath
                              .length -
                            1,
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setRaisePeriodIndex(
                          Number(
                            event.target.value,
                          ),
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                      {
                        report.sourcePath.length ===
                          0
                          ?
                            (
                              <option value="0">
                                No forecast periods
                              </option>
                            )
                          :
                            report.sourcePath.map(
                              (
                                point,
                                index,
                              ) => (
                                <option
                                  key={
                                    point.period
                                  }
                                  value={
                                    index
                                  }
                                >
                                  {
                                    point.period
                                  }
                                </option>
                              ),
                            )
                      }
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Capital amount
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      step="0.01"
                      value={
                        capitalOverride
                      }
                      placeholder={
                        String(
                          Math.round(
                            fundingGapReport
                              .requiredCapitalAfterRaise,
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setCapitalOverride(
                          event.target.value,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Equity pre-money valuation
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      step="1000"
                      value={
                        preMoneyValuation
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setPreMoneyValuation(
                          event.target.value,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Debt annual rate %
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      max="100"
                      step="0.1"
                      value={
                        debtRatePercent
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setDebtRatePercent(
                          event.target.value,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Debt term months
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="1"
                      max="120"
                      step="1"
                      value={
                        debtTermMonths
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setDebtTermMonths(
                          event.target.value,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Hybrid equity share %
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      max="100"
                      step="1"
                      value={
                        hybridEquityPercent
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setHybridEquityPercent(
                          event.target.value,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>
                </div>
              </section>
            )
          :
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                You have Viewer access. Capital-plan outputs are visible using the default Risk Center assumptions; changing funding-case inputs requires Editor permission.
              </section>
            )
      }

      {
        error
          ?
            (
              <div
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  error
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      {
        loading
          ?
            (
              <div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
            )
          :
            (
              <>
                <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                  <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                      Capital need
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
                      {
                        money(
                          report.requiredCapitalAfterRaise,
                          currency,
                        )
                      }
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      Minimum gross injection needed after the selected funding month to protect the target cash floor before financing costs.
                    </p>
                  </article>

                  <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                      Modeled capital
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
                      {
                        money(
                          effectiveCapital,
                          currency,
                        )
                      }
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {
                        capitalOverride.trim() ===
                          ""
                          ?
                            "Automatically using calculated funding gap."
                          :
                            "Using manual capital-plan amount."
                      }
                    </p>
                  </article>

                  <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                      Source minimum cash
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
                      {
                        money(
                          report.sourceMinimumCash,
                          currency,
                        )
                      }
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {
                        basis ===
                          "DOWNSIDE"
                          ?
                            "Minimum cash under Risk Center downside stress."
                          :
                            "Minimum cash under the current base forecast."
                      }
                    </p>
                  </article>

                  <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                      Funding timing
                    </p>

                    <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
                      {
                        report.raisePeriod ??
                        "—"
                      }
                    </p>

                    <p className={`mt-2 text-xs ${floorTone(
                      report.preRaiseFloorBreachPeriod,
                    )}`}>
                      {
                        report.preRaiseFloorBreachPeriod
                          ?
                            `Cash floor already breaches in ${report.preRaiseFloorBreachPeriod} before the selected raise.`
                          :
                            "No cash-floor breach occurs before funding."
                      }
                    </p>
                  </article>
                </section>

                <section className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
                  {
                    report.strategies.map(
                      (
                        strategy,
                      ) => (
                        <article
                          key={
                            strategy.kind
                          }
                          className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                              {
                                STRATEGY_LABELS[
                                  strategy.kind
                                ]
                              }
                            </h2>

                            <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${floorTone(
                              strategy.floorBreachPeriod,
                            )}`}>
                              {
                                strategy.floorBreachPeriod
                                  ?
                                    "FLOOR BREACH"
                                  :
                                    "FLOOR PROTECTED"
                              }
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <p className="mt-4 text-2xl font-semibold">
                            {
                              money(
                                strategy.minimumCash,
                                currency,
                              )
                            }
                          </p>

                          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            Minimum modeled cash
                          </p>

                          <dl className="mt-5 space-y-3 text-sm">
                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                Equity
                              </dt>

                              <dd>
                                {
                                  money(
                                    strategy.equityAmount,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </dd>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                Debt
                              </dt>

                              <dd>
                                {
                                  money(
                                    strategy.debtAmount,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </dd>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                Dilution
                              </dt>

                              <dd>
                                {
                                  percent(
                                    strategy.dilution,
                                  )
                                }
                              </dd>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                Monthly debt service
                              </dt>

                              <dd>
                                {
                                  money(
                                    strategy.monthlyDebtService,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </dd>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                Total debt interest
                              </dt>

                              <dd>
                                {
                                  money(
                                    strategy.totalDebtInterest,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </dd>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                Ending cash
                              </dt>

                              <dd>
                                {
                                  money(
                                    strategy.endingCash,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </dd>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                Months below floor
                              </dt>

                              <dd>
                                {
                                  strategy.monthsBelowFloor
                                }
                              </dd>
                            </div>
                          </dl>
                        </article>
                      ),
                    )
                  }
                </section>

                <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
                  <div className="border-b p-5">
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                      Capital structure comparison
                    </h2>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Same gross capital amount, different equity dilution and debt-service consequences.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full min-w-[980px] text-sm">
                      <thead>
                        <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                            Strategy
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Equity
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Debt
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Dilution
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Monthly debt service
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Min cash
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Ending cash
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                            Floor breach
                          </th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>

                      <tbody>
                        {
                          report.strategies.map(
                            (
                              strategy,
                            ) => (
                              <tr
                                key={
                                  strategy.kind
                                }
                                className="border-b last:border-0"
                              >
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">
                                  {
                                    STRATEGY_LABELS[
                                      strategy.kind
                                    ]
                                  }
                                </th>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      strategy.equityAmount,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      strategy.debtAmount,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    percent(
                                      strategy.dilution,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      strategy.monthlyDebtService,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      strategy.minimumCash,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      strategy.endingCash,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className={`px-4 py-3 ${floorTone(
                                  strategy.floorBreachPeriod,
                                )}`}>
                                  {
                                    strategy.floorBreachPeriod ??
                                    "None"
                                  }
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            ),
                          )
                        }
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                </section>

                {
                  equity &&
                  debt &&
                  hybrid
                    ?
                      (
                        <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
                          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                            Capital trade-offs
                          </h2>

                          <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
                            <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
                              <p className="font-medium">
                                Equity
                              </p>

                              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                                No modeled debt service. Estimated dilution is {
                                  percent(
                                    equity.dilution,
                                  )
                                } at the entered pre-money valuation.
                              </p>
                            </article>

                            <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
                              <p className="font-medium">
                                Debt
                              </p>

                              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                                No modeled equity dilution, but monthly debt service is {
                                  money(
                                    debt.monthlyDebtService,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                } and reduces post-funding liquidity.
                              </p>
                            </article>

                            <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
                              <p className="font-medium">
                                Hybrid
                              </p>

                              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                                Splits the modeled capital between equity and debt, producing {
                                  percent(
                                    hybrid.dilution,
                                  )
                                } estimated dilution and {
                                  money(
                                    hybrid.monthlyDebtService,
                                    currency,
                                  )
                                } monthly debt service.
                              </p>
                            </article>
                          </div>
                        </section>
                      )
                    :
                      null
                }

                <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
                  <div className="border-b p-5">
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                      Liquidity path after funding
                    </h2>

                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Compare source cash with the three capital structures over the modeled horizon.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="max-h-[540px] overflow-auto">
                    <table className="w-full min-w-[820px] text-sm">
                      <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-background">
                        <tr className="border-b">
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                            Period
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Source
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Equity
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Debt
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Hybrid
                          </th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>

                      <tbody>
                        {
                          report.sourcePath.map(
                            (
                              point,
                              index,
                            ) => (
                              <tr
                                key={
                                  point.period
                                }
                                className="border-b last:border-0"
                              >
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">
                                  {
                                    point.period
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      point.cashBalance,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      equity?.cashPath[
                                        index
                                      ]?.adjustedCashBalance ??
                                      null,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      debt?.cashPath[
                                        index
                                      ]?.adjustedCashBalance ??
                                      null,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                  {
                                    money(
                                      hybrid?.cashPath[
                                        index
                                      ]?.adjustedCashBalance ??
                                      null,
                                      currency,
                                    )
                                  }
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            ),
                          )
                        }
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                </section>
              </>
            )
      }

      <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        Capital Planning is a deterministic modeling workspace, not an investment or lending recommendation. Cases do not create financing transactions, change forecast assumptions, alter Actuals, or mutate immutable baselines or model versions.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
