"use client";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  deleteWorkspaceFxRateAction,
  saveConsolidationSettingsAction,
  saveWorkspaceFxRateAction,
} from "@/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/consolidation/actions";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/snapshot";

import {
  buildConsolidatedPortfolioReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/calculations";

import {
  VENTURESCOPE_CURRENCIES,
  type ConsolidationProjectSource,
  type VentureScopeCurrency,
  type WorkspaceFxRateView,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  generatedAt:
    string;

  editable:
    boolean;

  reportingCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;

  rates:
    WorkspaceFxRateView[];

  projects:
    ConsolidationProjectSource[];
};


function money(
  amount:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    amount ===
    null
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          amount,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        2,
    },
  ).format(
    amount,
  );
}


export function ConsolidationWorkspace({
  projectId,
  generatedAt,
  editable,
  reportingCurrency,
  rates,
  projects,
}: Props) {
  const [
    asOfDate,
    setAsOfDate,
  ] =
    useState(
      generatedAt.slice(
        0,
        10,
      ),
    );


  const [
    forecasts,
    setForecasts,
  ] =
    useState<
      Record<
        string,
        string
      >
    >(
      {},
    );


  const [
    failures,
    setFailures,
  ] =
    useState<
      Record<
        string,
        string
      >
    >(
      {},
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function load() {
        const loaded:
          Record<
            string,
            string
          > =
            {};


        const failed:
          Record<
            string,
            string
          > =
            {};


        await Promise.all(
          projects.map(
            async (
              project,
            ) => {
              try {
                const response =
                  await fetch(
                    `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                      project.id,
                    )}/export/csv`,
                    {
                      cache:
                        "no-store",

                      signal:
                        controller.signal,
                    },
                  );


                if (
                  !response.ok
                ) {
                  throw new Error(
                    `HTTP ${response.status}`,
                  );
                }


                loaded[
                  project.id
                ] =
                  await response.text();
              }
              catch (
                cause
              ) {
                if (
                  controller.signal.aborted
                ) {
                  return;
                }


                failed[
                  project.id
                ] =
                  cause instanceof Error
                    ?
                      cause.message
                    :
                      "Forecast unavailable";
              }
            },
          ),
        );


        if (
          controller.signal.aborted
        ) {
          return;
        }


        setForecasts(
          loaded,
        );

        setFailures(
          failed,
        );

        setLoading(
          false,
        );
      }


      void load();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projects,
    ],
  );


  const analytics =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        projects.map(
          (
            project,
          ) => {
            const csv =
              forecasts[
                project.id
              ];


            if (
              csv ===
              undefined
            ) {
              return {
                projectId:
                  project.id,

                name:
                  project.name,

                industry:
                  project.industry,

                currency:
                  project.currency,

                latestActualPeriod:
                  project.latestActualPeriod,

                latestActualCash:
                  project.latestActualCash,

                capitalNeed:
                  null,

                forecastAvailable:
                  false,
              };
            }


            const rows =
              normalizeForecastCsv(
                csv,
              );


            const snapshot =
              buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot({
                capturedAt:
                  generatedAt,

                actuals:
                  project.actuals,

                forecasts:
                  rows,

                riskPolicy:
                  project.riskPolicy,

                latestActualPeriod:
                  project.latestActualPeriod,

                latestActualCash:
                  project.latestActualCash,

                actions:
                  project.actions,
              });


            return {
              projectId:
                project.id,

              name:
                project.name,

              industry:
                project.industry,

              currency:
                project.currency,

              latestActualPeriod:
                project.latestActualPeriod,

              latestActualCash:
                project.latestActualCash,

              capitalNeed:
                snapshot.kpis
                  .capitalNeed,

              forecastAvailable:
                true,
            };
          },
        ),
      [
        projects,
        forecasts,
        generatedAt,
      ],
    );


  const report =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildConsolidatedPortfolioReport({
          projects:
            analytics,

          reportingCurrency,

          asOfDate,

          rates,
        }),
      [

        reportingCurrency,
        asOfDate,
        rates,
      ],
    );


  if (

  ) {

      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                4,
            }).map(

                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-96 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />

                                          <button
                                            type="submit"
                                            className="rounded border px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-destructive"
                                          >
                                            Delete
                                          </button>
                                        </form>
                                      )
                                    :
                                      "Owner-managed"
                                }
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )
        }
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Multi-currency integrity
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Consolidated totals include only amounts that can be converted using an eligible direct or inverse workspace rate as of the selected date. Missing rates are surfaced explicitly rather than replaced with stale, guessed, external, or triangulated values. Original project-currency amounts remain authoritative.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function DashboardRangeSelector({
  range,
  onChange,
  availableMonths,
}: {
  range: DashboardRange;

  onChange:
    (
      range: DashboardRange,
    ) => void;

  availableMonths: number;
}) {
  const options: Array<{
    value: DashboardRange;

    label: string;

    enabled: boolean;
  }> = [
    {
      value:
        12,

      label:
        "12M",

      enabled:
        availableMonths >=
        12,
    },

    {
      value:
        24,

      label:
        "24M",

      enabled:
        availableMonths >=
        24,
    },

    {
      value:
        "ALL",

      label:
        "All",

      enabled:
        true,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-muted p-1">
      {options.map(
        (
          option,
        ) => (
          <Button
            key={
              String(
                option.value,
              )
            }
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            disabled={
              !option.enabled
            }
            onClick={() =>
              onChange(
                option.value,
              )
            }
            className={cn(
              "h-8 px-3 text-xs",
              range ===
                option.value &&
                "bg-background shadow-sm hover:bg-background",
            )}
          >
            {
              option.label
            }
          </Button>
        ),
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ChartContainer({
  children,
  label,
}: {
  children:
    React.ReactNode;

  label: string;
}) {
  return (
    <figure>
      <div
        role="img"
        aria-label={
          label
        }
        className="h-[300px] w-full"
      >
        <ResponsiveContainer
          width="100%"
          height="100%"
        >
          {
            children
          }
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>

      <figcaption className="sr-only">
        {
          label
        }. Equivalent financial values are also available in VentureScope&apos;s tabular analysis views.
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  );
}

function formatAxisCurrency(
  value: unknown,
  currency: string,
): string {
  return formatCompactCurrencyValue(
    String(
      value ??
      0,
    ),
    currency,
  );
}

function formatTooltipCurrency(
  value: unknown,
  currency: string,
): string {
  return formatCompactCurrencyValue(
    String(
      value ??
      0,
    ),
    currency,
  );
}

  background:
    "var(--popover)",

  border:
    "1px solid var(--border)",

  borderRadius:
    "0.75rem",

  color:
    "var(--popover-foreground)",

    "0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10)",
};

"use client";

import {
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  applyDataImportAction,
} from "@/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/imports/actions";

import {
  DATA_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES,
  DATA_IMPORT_TEMPLATE,
} from "@/lib/data-import/catalog";

import {
  validateDataImportCsv,
} from "@/lib/data-import/validation";

import type {
  DataImportBatchView,
  DataImportType,
} from "@/lib/data-import/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  editable:
    boolean;

  history:
    DataImportBatchView[];
};


function typeLabel(
  type:
    DataImportType,
): string {
  switch (
    type
  ) {
    case "ACTUALS":
      return "Actuals";

    case "KPI_TARGETS":
      return "KPI Targets";

    case "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY":
      return "Variance Commentary";
  }
}


function statusTone(
  status:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    status
  ) {
    case "SUCCEEDED":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "FAILED":
      return "text-destructive";

    default:
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";
  }
}


function downloadTemplate(
  importType:
    DataImportType,
) {
  const blob =
    new Blob(
      [
        DATA_IMPORT_TEMPLATE[
          importType
        ],
      ],
      {
        type:
          "text/csv;charset=utf-8",
      },
    );


  const url =
    URL.createObjectURL(
      blob,
    );


  const anchor =
    document.createElement(
      "a",
    );


  anchor.href =
    url;

  anchor.download =
    `venturescope-${importType.toLowerCase().replaceAll(
      "_",
      "-",
    )}-template.csv`;


  document.body.appendChild(
    anchor,
  );


  anchor.click();

  anchor.remove();


  URL.revokeObjectURL(
    url,
  );
}

    useMemo(
      () => {
        if (
          !csv.trim()
        ) {
          return null;
        }


        try {
          return {
            result:
              validateDataImportCsv({
                importType,

                csv,
              }),

            error:
              null,
          };
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          return {
            result:
              null,

            error:
              cause instanceof Error
                ?
                  cause.message
                :
                  "CSV validation failed.",
          };
        }
      },
      [
        csv,
        importType,
      ],
    );


  const valid =
    Boolean(
      validation
        ?.result &&
      validation.result.issues
        .length ===
        0 &&
      validation.result.rowCount >
        0,
    );


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
          Import governance
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Data Import Center uses a preview → validation → explicit apply workflow. Imports are atomic: if any application-stage row fails, the business-data transaction rolls back. Actuals also remain protected by the Financial Close database trigger, so a CSV cannot silently overwrite a CLOSED month.
        </p>

        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Viewer
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold">
              Read import history
            </p>
          </article>

          <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Editor
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold">
              Preview + validate + apply
            </p>
          </article>

          <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Owner
            </p>

            <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold">
              Preview + validate + apply
            </p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>

      {
        editable
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
                <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-end">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                      Governed CSV import
                    </p>

                    <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">
                      Preview and validate
                    </h2>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      downloadTemplate(
                        importType,
                      );
                    }}
                    className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
                  >
                    Download sample CSV
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Import type
                    </span>

                    <select
                      value={
                        importType
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setImportType(
                          event.target.value as
                            DataImportType,
                        );

                        setFileError(
                          null,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                      <option value="ACTUALS">
                        Actuals
                      </option>

                      <option value="KPI_TARGETS">
                        KPI Targets
                      </option>

                      <option value="VARIANCE_COMMENTARY">
                        Variance Commentary
                      </option>
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      CSV file
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept=".csv,text/csv"
                      className="block w-full rounded-lg border p-2 text-sm"
                      onChange={async (
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        const file =
                          event.target.files?.[
                            0
                          ];


                        if (
                          !file
                        ) {
                          return;
                        }


                        if (
                          file.size >
                          DATA_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES
                        ) {
                          setCsv(
                            "",
                          );

                          setFileName(
                            "",
                          );

                          setFileError(
                            "CSV cannot exceed 512KB.",
                          );

                          return;
                        }


                        const text =
                          await file.text();


                        setCsv(
                          text,
                        );

                        setFileName(
                          file.name,
                        );

                        setFileError(
                          null,
                        );
                      }}
                    />
                  </label>
                </div>

                {
                  fileError
                    ?
                      (
                        <div
                          role="alert"
                          className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-3 text-sm"
                        >
                          {
                            fileError
                          }
                        </div>
                      )
                    :
                      null
                }

                {
                  validation?.error
                    ?
                      (
                        <div
                          role="alert"
                          className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-3 text-sm"
                        >
                          {
                            validation.error
                          }
                        </div>
                      )
                    :
                      null
                }

                {
                  validation?.result
                    ?
                      (
                        <div className="mt-6 space-y-5">
                          <section className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
                            <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Rows
                              </p>

                              <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold">
                                {
                                  validation.result
                                    .rowCount
                                }
                              </p>
                            </article>

                            <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Validation issues
                              </p>

                              <p className={`mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold ${
                                validation.result
                                  .issues
                                  .length >
                                0
                                  ?
                                    "text-destructive"
                                  :
                                    "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                              }`}>
                                {
                                  validation.result
                                    .issues
                                    .length
                                }
                              </p>
                            </article>

                            <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Status
                              </p>

                              <p className={`mt-1 text-sm font-semibold ${
                                valid
                                  ?
                                    "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                  :
                                    "text-destructive"
                              }`}>
                                {
                                  valid
                                    ?
                                      "READY TO APPLY"
                                    :
                                      "NOT READY"
                                }
                              </p>
                            </article>
                          </section>

                          {
                            validation.result
                              .issues
                              .length >
                            0
                              ?
                                (

                                              .issues

                                                0,

                                              .map(

                                                    key={`${issue.row}:${issue.field}:${index}`}
                                                    className="border-b last:border-0"
                                                  >

                                                      {

                                                      }

                              :

                          <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
                            <div className="border-b p-4">
                              <h3 className="font-semibold">
                                Preview
                              </h3>

                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                First eight rows only.
                              </p>
                            </div>

                            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                              <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] text-xs">
                                <thead>
                                  <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                                    {
                                      validation.result
                                        .headers
                                        .map(
                                          (
                                            header,
                                          ) => (
                                            <th
                                              key={
                                                header
                                              }
                                              className="px-3 py-2 text-left"
                                            >
                                              {
                                                header
                                              }
                                            </th>
                                          ),
                                        )
                                    }
                                  </tr>
                                </thead>

                                <tbody>
                                  {
                                    validation.result
                                      .preview
                                      .map(
                                        (
                                          row,
                                          index,
                                        ) => (
                                          <tr
                                            key={
                                              index
                                            }
                                            className="border-b last:border-0"
                                          >
                                            {
                                              validation.result
                                                .headers
                                                .map(
                                                  (
                                                    header,
                                                  ) => (
                                                    <td
                                                      key={
                                                        header
                                                      }
                                                      className="max-w-xs truncate px-3 py-2"
                                                    >
                                                      {
                                                        row[
                                                          header
                                                        ] ??
                                                        ""
                                                      }
                                                    </td>
                                                  ),
                                                )
                                            }
                                          </tr>
                                        ),
                                      )
                                  }
                                </tbody>
                              </table>
                            </div>
                          </section>

                          <form
                            action={
                              applyDataImportAction
                            }
                          >
                            <input
                              type="hidden"
                              name="projectId"
                              value={
                                projectId
                              }
                            />

                            <input
                              type="hidden"
                              name="importType"
                              value={
                                importType
                              }
                            />

                            <input
                              type="hidden"
                              name="fileName"
                              value={
                                fileName ||
                                `${importType.toLowerCase()}.csv`
                              }

                            <textarea
                              hidden
                              readOnly
                              name="csv"
                              value={

                              }
                            />

                            <button
                              type="submit"
                              disabled={
                                !valid
                              }
                              className="rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-background disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
                            >
                              Apply validated import
                            </button>
                          </form>
                        </div>
                      )
                    :
                      null
                }
              </section>
            )
          :
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                You have Viewer access. Import history is available below, but applying CSV data requires Editor permission.
              </section>
            )
      }

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Import history
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            The latest 100 governed import attempts are retained for this project.
          </p>
        </div>

        {
          history.length ===
          0
            ?
              (
                <div className="p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  No governed imports have been recorded yet.
                </div>
              )
            :
              (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[1200px] text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Time
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Type
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          File
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Status
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Rows
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Inserted
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Updated
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Rejected
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          User
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Error
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody>
                      {
                        history.map(
                          (
                            batch,
                          ) => (
                            <tr
                              key={
                                batch.id
                              }
                              className="border-b align-top last:border-0"
                            >
                              <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-xs">
                                {
                                  new Date(
                                    batch.createdAt,
                                  ).toLocaleString()
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">
                                {
                                  typeLabel(
                                    batch.importType,
                                  )
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="max-w-xs truncate px-4 py-3">
                                {
                                  batch.fileName
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className={`px-4 py-3 font-semibold ${statusTone(
                                batch.status,
                              )}`}>
                                {
                                  batch.status
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                {
                                  batch.rowCount
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                {
                                  batch.insertedCount
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                {
                                  batch.updatedCount
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                {
                                  batch.rejectedCount
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                {
                                  batch.createdBy ??
                                  "Unavailable"
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="max-w-sm px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                {
                                  batch.errorSummary ??
                                  "—"
                                }
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )
        }
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Import integrity
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Preview validation does not modify project data. Applying an import is explicit and atomic. Actuals imports remain subject to Financial Close at the PostgreSQL boundary; KPI Targets and Variance Commentary keep their existing project-scoped identities. Every completed or failed import is recorded in import history and the Project Audit Trail.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  calculateVarianceReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/variance";

import {
  calculateForecastAccuracyReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/forecast-accuracy/calculations";

import {
  calculateLiquidityRiskReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/calculations";

import {
  calculateCapitalPlanningReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/calculations";

import {
  buildExecutiveDecisionSignals,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/signals";

import {
  DECISION_ACTION_PRIORITIES,
  DECISION_ACTION_STATUSES,
  type DecisionActionPriority,
  type DecisionActionView,
  type DecisionSignalSeverity,
  type DecisionSourceCode,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/types";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";

import {
  createDecisionActionAction,
  updateDecisionActionStatusAction,
} from "@/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/decision-center/actions";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  editable:
    boolean;

  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  actions:
    DecisionActionView[];
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function severityTone(
  severity:
    DecisionSignalSeverity,
): string {
  switch (
    severity
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "WARNING":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "INFO":
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function severityPriority(
  severity:
    DecisionSignalSeverity,
): DecisionActionPriority {
  switch (
    severity
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "CRITICAL";

    case "WARNING":
      return "HIGH";

    case "INFO":
      return "MEDIUM";
  }
}


function statusTone(
  status:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    status
  ) {
    case "DONE":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "BLOCKED":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "IN_PROGRESS":
      return "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400";

    case "DISMISSED":
      return "text-muted-foreground";

    default:
      return "";
  }
}


export function DecisionCenterWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  editable,
  actuals,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
  actions,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    actionTitle,
    setActionTitle,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    actionDetails,
    setActionDetails,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    actionSource,
    setActionSource,
  ] =
    useState<
      DecisionSourceCode
    >(
      "MANUAL",
    );


  const [
    actionPriority,
    setActionPriority,
  ] =
    useState<
      DecisionActionPriority
    >(
      "MEDIUM",
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load executive financial intelligence.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const forecasts =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const variance =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateVarianceReport(
          actuals,
          forecasts,
        ),
      [
        actuals,
        forecasts,
      ],
    );


  const accuracy =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateForecastAccuracyReport(
          actuals,
          forecasts,
        ),
      [
        actuals,
        forecasts,
      ],
    );


  const risk =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
          rows:
            forecasts,

          policy:
            riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,
        }),
      [
        forecasts,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
      ],
    );


  const capital =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateCapitalPlanningReport({
          basis:
            "DOWNSIDE",

          rows:
            forecasts,

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,

          inputs: {
            targetCashFloor:
              Math.max(
                0,
                riskPolicy.minimumCash ??
                0,
              ),

            raisePeriodIndex:
              0,

            capitalAmount:
              0,

            preMoneyValuation:
              0,

            annualDebtRate:
              0,

            debtTermMonths:
              36,

            hybridEquityShare:
              0.50,
          },
        }),
      [
        forecasts,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
      ],
    );


  const signals =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildExecutiveDecisionSignals({
          actualPeriods:
            actuals.length,

          revenueVarianceRate:
            variance.summary
              .revenueVarianceRate,

          ebitdaVarianceRate:
            variance.summary
              .ebitdaVarianceRate,

          forecastAccuracyScore:
            accuracy
              .overallAccuracyScore,

          forecastBiasCount:
            accuracy.metrics.filter(
              (
                metric,
              ) =>
                metric.bias ===
                  "OVER_FORECASTING" ||
                metric.bias ===
                  "UNDER_FORECASTING",
            ).length,

          liquidityRiskLevel:
            risk.level,

          downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
            risk
              .firstDownsideCashExhaustionPeriod,

          requiredCapital:
            capital
              .requiredCapitalAfterRaise,
        }),
      [
        actuals.length,
        variance,
        accuracy,
        risk,
        capital,
      ],
    );


  const openActions =
    actions.filter(
      (
        action,
      ) =>
        action.status !==
          "DONE" &&
        action.status !==
          "DISMISSED",
    );


  const criticalSignals =
    signals.filter(
      (
        signal,
      ) =>
        signal.severity ===
        "CRITICAL",
    );


  function populateActionFromSignal(
    signal:
      typeof signals[
        number
      ],
  ) {
    setActionTitle(
      signal.title,
    );

    setActionDetails(
      signal.actionHint,
    );

    setActionSource(
      signal.code,
    );

    setActionPriority(
      severityPriority(
        signal.severity,
      ),
    );


    document
      .getElementById(
        "decision-action-form",
      )
      ?.scrollIntoView({
        behavior:
          "smooth",

        block:
          "start",
      });
  }


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                4,
            }).map(
              (
                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {
        error
          ?
            (
              <div
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  error
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Critical signals
          </p>

          <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${
            criticalSignals.length >
              0
              ?
                "text-destructive"
              :
                "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
          }`}>
            {
              criticalSignals.length
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Derived from performance, forecast, liquidity, and capital intelligence.
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Open actions
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              openActions.length
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Actions not marked Done or Dismissed.
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Liquidity risk
          </p>

          <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${
            risk.level ===
              "CRITICAL" ||
            risk.level ===
              "HIGH"
              ?
                "text-destructive"
              :
                ""
          }`}>
            {
              risk.level
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Risk Center score {
              risk.score
            } / 100
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Downside capital need
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              money(
                capital
                  .requiredCapitalAfterRaise,
                currency,
              )
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Modeled funding gap against the Risk Center cash floor.
          </p>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Revenue variance
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              percent(
                variance.summary
                  .revenueVarianceRate,
              )
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Actual versus matched forecast.
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            EBITDA variance
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              percent(
                variance.summary
                  .ebitdaVarianceRate,
              )
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Actual versus matched forecast.
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Forecast accuracy
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">

        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Executive decision signals
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            VentureScope converts the major financial exceptions into a prioritized management queue. Signals remain diagnostics until management deliberately creates an action.
          </p>
        </div>

        {
          signals.length ===
            0
            ?
              (
                <div className="p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  No material decision signal is currently detected from the available financial data and configured guardrails.
                </div>
              )
            :

                          }

import {
  formatCompactCurrencyValue,
  formatLongMonthKey,
  formatRunway,
} from "@/lib/finance/formatting";
import type {
  ScenarioComparisonItem,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export function DemoScenarioTable({
  comparison,
  currency,
}: {
  comparison: ScenarioComparisonItem[];

  currency: string;
}) {
  const rows = [
    {
      label:
        "First-year revenue",

      values:
        comparison.map(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              item.firstYearRevenue,
              currency,
            ),
        ),
    },

    {
      label:
        "First-year EBITDA",

      values:
        comparison.map(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              item.firstYearEbitda,
              currency,
            ),
        ),
    },

    {
      label:
        "Ending cash",

      values:
        comparison.map(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              item.endingCash,
              currency,
            ),
        ),
    },

    {
      label:
        "Ending MRR",

      values:
        comparison.map(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              item.endingMrr,
              currency,
            ),
        ),
    },

    {
      label:
        "Runway",

      values:
        comparison.map(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            formatRunway(
              item.runway,
            ),
        ),
    },

    {
      label:
        "Break-even",

      values:
        comparison.map(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            item.sustainedBreakEvenMonth
              ? formatLongMonthKey(
                  item.sustainedBreakEvenMonth,
                )
              : "Not reached",
        ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-max min-w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b bg-muted/40">
              <th className="sticky left-0 z-10 min-w-52 border-r bg-muted/95 px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-foreground">
                Metric
              </th>

              {comparison.map(
                (
                  item,
                ) => (
                  <th
                    key={
                      item.scenarioId ??
                      item.scenarioName
                    }
                    className="min-w-44 border-r px-4 py-3 text-right last:border-r-0"
                  >
                    <div className="font-semibold">
                      {
                        item.scenarioName
                      }
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                      {
                        item.scenarioType
                      }
                    </div>
                  </th>
                ),
              )}
            </tr>
          </thead>

          <tbody>
            {rows.map(
              (
                row,
              ) => (
                <tr
                  key={
                    row.label
                  }
                  className="border-b last:border-b-0"
                >
                  <th className="sticky left-0 z-10 border-r bg-background px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">
                    {
                      row.label
                    }
                  </th>

                  {row.values.map(
                    (
                      value,
                      index,
                    ) => (
                      <td
                        key={`${row.label}-${index}`}
                        className="border-r px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs tabular-nums last:border-r-0"
                      >
                        {
                          value
                        }
                      </td>
                    ),
                  )}
                </tr>
              ),
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>

import Link from "next/link";

import type {
  FinancialScenarioInput,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

export function DemoScenarioTabs({
  scenarios,
  activeScenarioId,
}: {
  scenarios: FinancialScenarioInput[];

  activeScenarioId: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border bg-background p-1 sm:inline-flex sm:w-auto">
      {scenarios.map(
        (
          scenario,
        ) => {
          const active =
            scenario.id ===
            activeScenarioId;

          return (
            <Link
              key={
                scenario.id
              }
              href={`/demo?scenario=${encodeURIComponent(
                scenario.id ??
                "",
              )}`}
              className={cn(
                "whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors",
                active
                  ? "bg-foreground text-background"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground",
              )}
            >
              {
                scenario.name
              }
            </Link>
          );
        },
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type AnalysisSetupRequiredProps = {

const SECTION_LABELS: Record<
  MissingAssumptionSection,

const SECTION_PATHS: Record<

  expenses:
    "expenses",

export function AnalysisSetupRequired({
  projectId,
  missingSections,

  const firstMissing =
    missingSections[0] ??
    "general";

  return (
    <Card className="overflow-hidden border-dashed">
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-muted">
          <CircleAlert
            className="size-5"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
        </div>

        <CardTitle className="mt-4">

        </CardTitle>

        <CardDescription className="max-w-2xl leading-6">
          VentureScope does not generate analysis from incomplete inputs.
          Complete the remaining assumption sections before opening the financial forecast.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent>
        <div className="mb-6 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
          {(
            [
              "general",
              "revenue",
              "expenses",
            ] as MissingAssumptionSection[]
          ).map(
            (
              section,
            ) => {
              const missing =
                missingSections.includes(
                  section,
                );

              return (
                <div
                  key={
                    section
                  }
                  className="rounded-xl border p-4"
                >
                  <div className="text-sm font-medium">
                    {
                      SECTION_LABELS[
                        section
                      ]
                    }
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {missing
                      ? "Configuration required"
                      : "Configured"}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            },
          )}
        </div>

        <Button asChild>
          <Link
            href={`/projects/${projectId}/${SECTION_PATHS[firstMissing]}`}
          >
            Configure{" "}
            {
              SECTION_LABELS[
                firstMissing
              ]
            }

            <ArrowRight
              className="size-4"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/financial/financial-table.tsx #####
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

export type FinancialTableColumn = {
  key: string;

  label: string;

  detail?: string;
};

export type FinancialTableRow = {
  label: string;

  values: string[];

  kind?:
    | "normal"
    | "subtotal"
    | "total"
    | "metric";

  indent?: boolean;
};

type FinancialTableProps = {
  caption: string;

  columns: FinancialTableColumn[];

  rows: FinancialTableRow[];
};

export function FinancialTable({
  caption,
  columns,
  rows,
}: FinancialTableProps) {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-max min-w-full border-collapse text-sm">
          <caption className="sr-only">
            {caption}
          </caption>

          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b bg-muted/40">
              <th
                scope="col"
                className="sticky left-0 z-20 min-w-56 border-r bg-muted/95 px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-foreground backdrop-blur"
              >
                Metric
              </th>

              {columns.map(
                (
                  column,
                ) => (
                  <th
                    key={
                      column.key
                    }
                    scope="col"
                    className="min-w-32 border-r px-4 py-3 text-right last:border-r-0"
                  >
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold">
                      {
                        column.label
                      }
                    </div>

                    {column.detail ? (
                      <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                        {
                          column.detail
                        }
                      </div>
                    ) : null}
                  </th>
                ),
              )}
            </tr>
          </thead>

          <tbody>
            {rows.map(
              (
                row,
                rowIndex,
              ) => {
                const kind =
                  row.kind ??
                  "normal";

                const rowClass =
                  kind ===
                  "total"
                    ? "border-t-2 bg-muted/40 font-semibold"
                    : kind ===
                        "subtotal"
                      ? "border-t bg-muted/20 font-medium"
                      : kind ===
                          "metric"
                        ? "bg-muted/10 text-muted-foreground"
                        : "";

                const stickyClass =
                  kind ===
                  "total"
                    ? "bg-muted"
                    : kind ===
                        "subtotal"
                      ? "bg-muted/80"
                      : kind ===
                          "metric"
                        ? "bg-muted/50"
                        : "bg-background";

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={`${row.label}-${rowIndex}`}
                    className={cn(
                      "border-b last:border-b-0",
                      rowClass,
                    )}
                  >
                    <th
                      scope="row"
                      className={cn(
                        "sticky left-0 z-10 min-w-56 border-r px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium backdrop-blur",
                        stickyClass,
                        row.indent &&
                          "pl-8 font-normal text-muted-foreground",
                      )}
                    >
                      {
                        row.label
                      }
                    </th>

                    {row.values.map(
                      (
                        value,
                        valueIndex,
                      ) => (
                        <td
                          key={`${row.label}-${valueIndex}`}
                          className="min-w-32 border-r px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs tabular-nums last:border-r-0"
                        >
                          {
                            value
                          }
                        </td>
                      ),
                    )}
                  </tr>
                );
              },
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/financial/forecast-view-toggle.tsx #####
import Link from "next/link";

import type {
  AnalysisTableView,
} from "@/lib/finance/formatting";
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

type ForecastViewToggleProps = {
  pathname: string;

  view: AnalysisTableView;

  scenarioId?: string;
};

export function ForecastViewToggle({
  pathname,
  view,
  scenarioId,
}: ForecastViewToggleProps) {
  function href(
    nextView: AnalysisTableView,
  ) {
    const params =
      new URLSearchParams();

    params.set(
      "view",
      nextView,
    );

    if (
      scenarioId
    ) {
      params.set(
        "scenario",
        scenarioId,
      );
    }

    return `${pathname}?${params.toString()}`;
  }

  return (
    <div className="inline-flex rounded-lg border bg-background p-1">
      <Link
        href={href(
          "monthly",
        )}
        className={cn(
          "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
          view ===
            "monthly"
            ? "bg-foreground text-background"
            : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground",
        )}
      >
        Monthly
      </Link>

      <Link
        href={href(
          "annual",
        )}
        className={cn(
          "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
          view ===
            "annual"
            ? "bg-foreground text-background"
            : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground",
        )}
      >
        Annual
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  CheckCircle2,

} from "lucide-react";

import type {
  FinancingActionState,
} from "@/lib/financing/action-state";
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

export function FinancingActionMessage({
  state,
}: {
  state: FinancingActionState;
}) {
  if (
    !state.message
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const success =
    state.status ===
    "success";

  const Icon =
    success
      ? CheckCircle2
      : CircleAlert;

  return (
    <div
      role={
        success
          ? "status"
          : "alert"
      }
      className={cn(
        "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm",
        success
          ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5"
          : "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive",
      )}
    >
      <Icon
        className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      <span>
        {
          state.message
        }
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

import type {

} from "@/lib/financing/types";

type FinancingEventCardProps = {
  projectId: string;

  currency: string;

  projectStartMonth: string;

  projectEndMonth: string;

  event: FinancingEventViewModel;
};

export function FinancingEventCard({
  projectId,
  currency,
  projectStartMonth,
  projectEndMonth,
  event,
}: FinancingEventCardProps) {
  const debt =
    event.type ===
    "DEBT";

  return (
    <Card className="border-border/70">
      <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-start justify-between gap-5 space-y-0">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 gap-4">
          <div className="flex size-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-foreground text-background">
            {debt ? (

              />
            ) : (

                className="size-5"

              />
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <div className="font-semibold">
                {
                  event.name
                }
              </div>

              <Badge
                variant={
                  debt
                    ? "secondary"
                    : "outline"
                }
              >
                {formatFinancingType(
                  event.type,
                )}
              </Badge>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
              {financingTypeDescription(
                event.type,
              )}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <FinancingEventActions
          projectId={
            projectId
          }
          currency={
            currency
          }
          projectStartMonth={
            projectStartMonth
          }
          projectEndMonth={
            projectEndMonth
          }
          event={
            event
          }
        />
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent>
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <Metric
            icon={
              Banknote
            }
            label="Amount"
            value={formatCompactCurrencyValue(
              event.amount,
              currency,
            )}
          />

          <Metric
            icon={
              CalendarRange
            }
            label="Funding month"
            value={formatLongMonthKey(
              event.month,
            )}
          />

                icon={

                }

                value={`${event.apr ?? "0"}%`}

            </span>
            . Principal is repaid equally across the loan term while interest declines with outstanding principal.
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );

  label,
  value,
}: {

    React.ComponentType<{
      className?: string;

  value: string;

        />

          label
        }
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2 text-sm font-medium">
        {
          value
        }
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  const [
    type,

  ] =
    useState<FinancingEventType>(
      defaults.type,
    );

  const [
    month,
    setMonth,
  ] = useState(
    defaults.month,
  );

  const [
    repaymentStartMonth,
    setRepaymentStartMonth,
  ] = useState(
    defaults.repaymentStartMonth,
  );

  function handleTypeChange(
    nextType:
      FinancingEventType,
  ) {
    setType(
      nextType,
    );

    if (
      nextType ===
        "DEBT" &&
      !repaymentStartMonth
    ) {
      setRepaymentStartMonth(
        addMonths(
          month as MonthKey,
          1,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  function handleMonthChange(
    nextMonth: string,
  ) {
    setMonth(
      nextMonth,
    );

    if (
      type !==
      "DEBT"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const earliest =
      addMonths(
        nextMonth as MonthKey,
        1,
      );

    if (
      !repaymentStartMonth ||
      compareMonths(
        repaymentStartMonth as MonthKey,
        earliest,
      ) <
        0
    ) {
      setRepaymentStartMonth(
        earliest,
      );
    }
  }

  const debt =
    type ===
    "DEBT";

  const earliestRepayment =
    addMonths(
      month as MonthKey,
      1,
    );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
          <Label
            htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-name`}
          >
            Financing name
          </Label>

          <Input
            id={`${idPrefix}-name`}
            name="name"
            defaultValue={
              defaults.name
            }
            placeholder="Seed Round"
            required
          />

          {errors
            ?.name?.[0] ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
              {
                errors
                  .name[0]
              }
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label
            htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-type`}
          >
            Financing type
          </Label>

          <select
            id={`${idPrefix}-type`}
            name="type"
            value={
              type
            }
            onChange={(
              event,
            ) =>
              handleTypeChange(
                event
                  .target
                  .value as FinancingEventType,
              )
            }
            className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs outline-none transition-[color,box-shadow] focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50"
          >
            <option value="EQUITY">
              Equity
            </option>

            <option value="DEBT">
              Debt
            </option>

            <option value="GRANT">
              Grant
            </option>

            <option value="OTHER">
              Other
            </option>
          </select>

          <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
            {
              financingTypeDescription(
                type,
              )
            }
          </p>

          {errors
            ?.type?.[0] ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
              {
                errors
                  .type[0]
              }
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label
            htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-month`}
          >
            Funding month
          </Label>

          <Input
            id={`${idPrefix}-month`}
            name="month"
            type="month"
            min={
              projectStartMonth
            }
            max={
              projectEndMonth
            }
            value={
              month
            }
            onChange={(
              event,
            ) =>
              handleMonthChange(
                event
                  .target
                  .value,
              )
            }
            required
          />

          <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
            Must fall inside the project forecast horizon.
          </p>

          {errors
            ?.month?.[0] ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
              {
                errors
                  .month[0]
              }
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
          <Label
            htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-amount`}
          >
            Financing amount
          </Label>

          <div className="relative">
            <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              {
                currency
              }
            </span>

            <Input
              id={`${idPrefix}-amount`}
              name="amount"
              type="number"
              min="0.01"
              step="0.01"
              defaultValue={
                defaults.amount
              }
              className="pl-14"
              required
            />
          </div>

          {errors
            ?.amount?.[0] ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
              {
                errors
                  .amount[0]
              }
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      {debt ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
          <div className="mb-5 flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-background">
              <Landmark
                className="size-4"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="text-sm font-medium">
                Debt terms
              </div>

              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
                VentureScope uses equal-principal repayment with declining interest.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-3">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label
                htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-apr`}
              >
                APR
              </Label>

              <div className="relative">
                <Input
                  id={`${idPrefix}-apr`}
                  name="apr"
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  max="100"
                  step="0.01"
                  defaultValue={
                    defaults.apr ||
                    "0"
                  }
                  className="pr-10"
                  required
                />

                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  %
                </span>
              </div>

              {errors
                ?.apr?.[0] ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                  {
                    errors
                      .apr[0]
                  }
                </p>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label
                htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-term`}
              >
                Loan term
              </Label>

              <div className="relative">
                <Input
                  id={`${idPrefix}-term`}
                  name="termMonths"
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="600"
                  step="1"
                  defaultValue={
                    defaults.termMonths ||

                  }
                  className="pr-20"

                />

                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  months
                </span>
              </div>

              {errors
                ?.termMonths?.[0] ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                  {

                      .termMonths[0]
                  }
                </p>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label
                htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-repayment-start`}
              >
                Repayment starts
              </Label>

              <Input
                id={`${idPrefix}-repayment-start`}
                name="repaymentStartMonth"
                type="month"
                min={

                }
                value={

                }
