"use client";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  calculateForecastAccuracyReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/forecast-accuracy/calculations";

import type {
  ForecastAccuracyMetricReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/forecast-accuracy/types";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];
};


const LABELS = {
  revenue:
    "Revenue",

  cogs:
    "COGS",

  operatingExpenses:
    "Operating expenses",

  ebitda:
    "EBITDA",

  cashFlow:
    "Cash flow",

  cashBalance:
    "Cash balance",

  mrr:
    "MRR",
} as const;


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function accuracyTone(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null
  ) {
    return "text-muted-foreground";
  }


  if (
    value >=
    0.9
  ) {
    return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";
  }


  if (
    value >=
    0.8
  ) {
    return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";
  }


  return "text-destructive";
}


function trendLabel(
  report:
    ForecastAccuracyMetricReport,
): string {
  switch (
    report.trend
  ) {
    case "IMPROVING":
      return "Improving";

    case "WORSENING":
      return "Worsening";

    case "STABLE":
      return "Stable";

    case "INSUFFICIENT_DATA":
      return "Not enough history";
  }
}


function biasLabel(
  report:
    ForecastAccuracyMetricReport,
): string {
  switch (
    report.bias
  ) {
    case "BALANCED":
      return "Balanced";

    case "OVER_FORECASTING":
      return "Over-forecasting";

    case "UNDER_FORECASTING":
      return "Under-forecasting";

    case "INSUFFICIENT_DATA":
      return "Not enough history";
  }
}


export function ForecastAccuracyWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  actuals,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal
              .aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load forecast history.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal
              .aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const forecasts =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const report =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateForecastAccuracyReport(
          actuals,
          forecasts,
        ),
      [
        actuals,
        forecasts,
      ],
    );


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-5">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                4,
            }).map(
              (
                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  if (
    error
  ) {
    return (
      <section
        role="alert"
        className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-5"
      >
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-destructive">
          Forecast accuracy unavailable
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {
            error
          }
        </p>
      </section>
    );
  }


  if (
    actuals.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return (
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          No actual history yet
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Import monthly actual performance from the Actuals workspace. VentureScope will then measure historical forecast accuracy, bias, and trend automatically.
        </p>
      </section>
    );
  }


  const revenue =
    report.metrics.find(
      (
        metric,
      ) =>
        metric.metric ===
        "revenue",
    );


  const ebitda =
    report.metrics.find(
      (
        metric,
      ) =>
        metric.metric ===
        "ebitda",
    );


  const cash =
    report.metrics.find(
      (
        metric,
      ) =>
        metric.metric ===
        "cashBalance",
    );


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Overall accuracy
          </p>

          <p
            className={`mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold ${accuracyTone(
              report.overallAccuracyScore,
            )}`}
          >
            {
              percent(
                report.overallAccuracyScore,
              )
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Average accuracy across usable financial metrics.
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Overall WAPE
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              percent(
                report.overallWape,
              )
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Weighted absolute forecast error.
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Matched periods
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              report.matchedPeriods
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Months with both forecast and actual observations.
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Latest actual month
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              report.latestPeriod ??
              "—"
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Latest observed execution period.
          </p>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {
          [
            [
              "Revenue",
              revenue,
            ] as const,

            [
              "EBITDA",
              ebitda,
            ] as const,

            [
              "Cash balance",
              cash,
            ] as const,
          ].map(
            (
              [
                label,
                metric,
              ],
            ) => (
              <article
                key={
                  String(
                    label,
                  )
                }
                className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5"
              >
                <h2 className="font-semibold">
                  {
                    label
                  }
                </h2>

                {
                  metric
                    ?
                      (
                        <dl className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-sm">
                          <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                              Accuracy
                            </dt>

                            <dd className={accuracyTone(
                              metric.overall
                                .accuracyScore,
                            )}>
                              {
                                percent(
                                  metric.overall
                                    .accuracyScore,
                                )
                              }
                            </dd>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                              WAPE
                            </dt>

                            <dd>
                              {
                                percent(
                                  metric.overall
                                    .wape,
                                )
                              }
                            </dd>

"use client";

import {
  Input,
} from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Label,
} from "@/components/ui/label";
import type {
  MonthlyOverrideValues,
  RevenueMode,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

type MonthlyOverrideFieldsProps = {
  currency: string;

  revenueMode: RevenueMode;

  defaults: MonthlyOverrideValues;

  errors?: Record<
    string,
    string[] | undefined
  >;
};

export function MonthlyOverrideFields({
  currency,
  revenueMode,
  defaults,
  errors,
}: MonthlyOverrideFieldsProps) {
  const customerDriven =
    revenueMode ===
    "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-7">
      <div>
        <div className="font-medium">
          Monthly financial overrides
        </div>

        <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
          Leave a field blank to keep the normal forecast value for that month.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
        <OverrideField
          id="override-revenue"
          name="revenue"
          label="Revenue"
          prefix={
            currency
          }
          defaultValue={
            defaults.revenue ??
            ""
          }
          help="Force total recognized revenue for this month."
          error={
            errors
              ?.revenue?.[0]
          }
        />

        <OverrideField
          id="override-marketing"
          name="marketing"
          label="Marketing"
          prefix={
            currency
          }
          defaultValue={
            defaults.marketing ??
            ""
          }
          help="Replace the monthly marketing budget."
          error={
            errors
              ?.marketing?.[0]
          }
        />

        <OverrideField
          id="override-salaries"
          name="salaries"
          label="Salaries"
          prefix={
            currency
          }
          defaultValue={
            defaults.salaries ??
            ""
          }
          help="Replace total payroll for this month."
          error={
            errors
              ?.salaries?.[0]
          }
        />

        <OverrideField
          id="override-rent"
          name="rent"
          label="Rent"
          prefix={
            currency
          }
          defaultValue={
            defaults.rent ??
            ""
          }
          help="Replace rent expense for this month."
          error={
            errors
              ?.rent?.[0]
          }
        />

        <OverrideField
          id="override-cogs"
          name="cogs"
          label="COGS"
          prefix={
            currency
          }
          defaultValue={
            defaults.cogs ??
            ""
          }
          help="Force an absolute COGS amount for this month."
          error={
            errors
              ?.cogs?.[0]
          }
        />

        {customerDriven ? (
          <>
            <OverrideField
              id="override-cac"
              name="cac"
              label="CAC"
              prefix={
                currency
              }
              min="0.01"
              defaultValue={
                defaults.cac ??
                ""
              }
              help="Replace paid customer acquisition cost for this month."
              error={
                errors
                  ?.cac?.[0]
              }
            />

            <OverrideField
              id="override-churn"
              name="churnRate"
              label="Churn"
              suffix="%"
              min="0"
              max="100"
              defaultValue={
                defaults.churnRate ??
                ""
              }
              help="Replace monthly customer churn for this month."
              error={
                errors
                  ?.churnRate?.[0]
              }
            />

            <OverrideField
              id="override-arpu"
              name="arpu"
              label="ARPU"
              prefix={
                currency
              }
              defaultValue={
                defaults.arpu ??
                ""
              }
              help="Replace ARPU for this month."
              error={
                errors
                  ?.arpu?.[0]
              }
            />
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <input
              type="hidden"
              name="cac"
              value=""
            />

            <input
              type="hidden"
              name="churnRate"
              value=""
            />

            <input
              type="hidden"
              name="arpu"
              value=""
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function OverrideField({
  id,
  name,
  label,
  prefix,
  suffix,
  defaultValue,
  min = "0",
  max,
  help,
  error,
}: {
  id: string;

  name: string;

  label: string;

  prefix?: string;

  suffix?: string;

  defaultValue: string;

  min?: string;

  max?: string;

  help: string;

  error?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Label htmlFor={id}>
        {
          label
        }
      </Label>

      <div className="relative">
        {prefix ? (
          <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            {
              prefix
            }
          </span>
        ) : null}

        <Input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type="number"
          min={min}
          max={max}
          step="0.01"
          defaultValue={
            defaultValue
          }
          placeholder="No override"
          className={
            prefix
              ? "pl-14"
              : suffix
                ? "pr-10"
                : undefined
          }
        />

        {suffix ? (
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {
              suffix
            }
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        {
          help
        }
      </p>

      {error ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {
            error
          }
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/overrides/override-action-message.tsx #####
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  CircleAlert,
} from "lucide-react";

import type {
  MonthlyOverrideActionState,
} from "@/lib/overrides/action-state";
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

export function OverrideActionMessage({
  state,
}: {
  state: MonthlyOverrideActionState;
}) {
  if (
    !state.message
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const success =
    state.status ===
    "success";

  const Icon =
    success
      ? CheckCircle2
      : CircleAlert;

  return (
    <div
      role={
        success
          ? "status"
          : "alert"
      }
      className={cn(
        "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm",
        success
          ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5"
          : "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive",
      )}
    >
      <Icon
        className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      {
        state.message
      }
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/overrides/planning-timeline.tsx #####
import {
  Banknote,
  CircleDollarSign,
  SlidersHorizontal,
} from "lucide-react";

import {
  Badge,
} from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  formatLongMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/formatting";

export type PlanningTimelineItem = {
  id: string;

  month: string;

  kind:
    | "OVERRIDE"
    | "FINANCING";

  title: string;

  detail: string;

  scope?: string;

  note?: string | null;
};

export function PlanningTimeline({
  items,
}: {
  items: PlanningTimelineItem[];
}) {
  if (
    items.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-10 text-center">
        <CircleDollarSign
          className="mx-auto size-8 text-muted-foreground"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />

        <div className="mt-4 font-medium">
          No timeline events yet
        </div>

        <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-lg text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Financing events and monthly planning overrides will appear here in chronological order.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const groups =
    new Map<
      string,
      PlanningTimelineItem[]
    >();

  for (
    const item
    of items
  ) {
    const existing =
      groups.get(
        item.month,
      ) ??
      [];

    existing.push(
      item,
    );

    groups.set(
      item.month,
      existing,
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-0">
      {Array.from(
        groups.entries(),
      ).map(
        (
          [
            month,
            monthItems,
          ],
          groupIndex,
        ) => (
          <div
            key={
              month
            }
            className="grid grid-cols-[24px_minmax(0,1fr)] gap-4"
          >
            <div className="relative flex justify-center">
              <div className="mt-2 size-3 rounded-full border-2 border-background bg-foreground ring-1 ring-border" />

              {groupIndex <
              groups.size -
                1 ? (
                <div className="absolute bottom-0 top-5 w-px bg-border" />
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="pb-8">
              <div className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold">
                {formatLongMonthKey(
                  month,
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                {monthItems.map(
                  (
                    item,
                  ) => {
                    const Icon =
                      item.kind ===
                      "FINANCING"
                        ? Banknote
                        : SlidersHorizontal;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={
                          item.id
                        }
                        className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                          <div className="flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-muted">
                            <Icon
                              className="size-4"
                              aria-hidden="true"
                            />
                          </div>

                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                              <div className="font-medium">
                                {
                                  item.title
                                }
                              </div>

                              <Badge
                                variant="outline"
                              >
                                {
                                  item.kind ===
                                  "FINANCING"
                                    ? "FINANCING"
                                    : "OVERRIDE"
                                }
                              </Badge>

                              {item.scope ? (
                                <Badge
                                  variant="secondary"
                                >
                                  {
                                    item.scope
                                  }
                                </Badge>
                              ) : null}
                            </div>

                            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                              {
                                item.detail
                              }
                            </p>

                            {item.note ? (
                              <p className="mt-3 border-t pt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
                                {
                                  item.note
                                }
                              </p>
                            ) : null}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  },
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ),
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  closeFinancialPeriodAction,
  reopenFinancialPeriodAction,

  FinancialPeriodEventView,
  FinancialPeriodRegister,

  projectId:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  editable:
    boolean;

  owner:
    boolean;

  register:
    FinancialPeriodRegister;

  events:
    FinancialPeriodEventView[];
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function actorLabel(
  actorUserId:
    string |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    !actorUserId
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return actorUserId.length >
    18
    ?
      `${actorUserId.slice(
        0,
        8,
      )}…${actorUserId.slice(
        -6,
      )}`
    :
      actorUserId;
}

                                  ?
                                    "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                                  :
                                    "text-destructive"
                              }`}>
                                {
                                  event.action
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                {
                                  event.sequence
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs">
                                {
                                  actorLabel(
                                    event.actorUserId,
                                  )
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="max-w-lg px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
                                {
                                  event.reason ??
                                  "—"
                                }
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )
        }
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Close integrity
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Financial close does not copy or rewrite Actuals. A CLOSED period remains the same ActualPeriod record, but PostgreSQL rejects INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE attempts for that project and month until an Owner deliberately reopens it.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

const METRIC_LABELS:
  Record<

  > = {

function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function varianceTone(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    value ===
      0
  ) {
    return "text-muted-foreground";
  }


  return value >
    0
    ?
      "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
    :
      "text-destructive";
}

export function PlanningCycleWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  editable,
  actuals,
  baselines,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    selectedBaselineId,
    setSelectedBaselineId,
  ] =
    useState(
      baselines[
        0
      ]?.id ??
      "",
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal
              .aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load the current forecast.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal
              .aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const currentForecast =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const selectedBaseline =

"use client";

import {
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  PLANNING_TEMPLATES,
  planningTemplateSegments,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/catalog";

import {
  buildPlanningTemplateBrief,
  comparePlanningTemplates,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/comparison";

import {
  rankPlanningTemplates,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/matching";

import type {
  PlanningTemplate,
  PlanningTemplateAssumption,
  PlanningTemplateFit,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/types";


type Props = {
  projectName:
    string;

  projectIndustry:
    string;

  currency:
    string;
};


function fitTone(
  fit:
    PlanningTemplateFit,
): string {
  switch (
    fit
  ) {
    case "RECOMMENDED":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "POSSIBLE":
      return "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400";

    case "EXPLORATORY":
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function riskTone(
  severity:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    severity
  ) {
    case "HIGH":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "MEDIUM":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    default:
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function assumptionValue({
  assumption,
  currency,
}: {
  assumption:
    PlanningTemplateAssumption |
    null;

  currency:
    string;
}): string {
  if (
    !assumption
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  const value =
    assumption.value;


  if (
    typeof value ===
    "string"
  ) {
    return value;
  }


  switch (
    assumption.unit
  ) {
    case "%":
      return new Intl.NumberFormat(
        "en",
        {
          style:
            "percent",

          maximumFractionDigits:
            1,
        },
      ).format(
        value,
      );


    case "currency":
      return new Intl.NumberFormat(
        "en",
        {
          style:
            "currency",

          currency,

          maximumFractionDigits:
            0,
        },
      ).format(
        value,
      );


    case "months":
      return `${value} months`;


    case "days":
      return `${value} days`;


    case "count":
      return new Intl.NumberFormat(
        "en",
        {
          maximumFractionDigits:
            0,
        },
      ).format(
        value,
      );


    case "x":
      return `${value}x`;


    case "text":
      return String(
        value,
      );
  }
}


function templateSearchText(
  template:
    PlanningTemplate,
): string {
  return [
    template.name,
    template.segment,
    template.description,
    ...template.keywords,
    ...template.kpis,
    ...template.risks.map(
      (
        risk,
      ) =>
        risk.title,
    ),
  ]
    .join(
      " ",
    )
    .toLowerCase();
}

  PortfolioAttentionLevel,
  PortfolioProjectSource,
} from "@/lib/finance/portfolio-dashboard/types";

function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function attentionTone(
  level:
    PortfolioAttentionLevel,
): string {
  switch (
    level
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "REVIEW":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "MONITOR":
      return "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400";

    case "STABLE":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";
  }
}


function closeTone(
  status:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    status
  ) {
    case "CLOSED":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "OPEN":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    default:
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function actionPriorityRank(
  priority:
    string,
): number {
  switch (
    priority
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return 0;

    case "HIGH":
      return 1;

    case "MEDIUM":
      return 2;

    case "LOW":
      return 3;

    default:
      return 4;
  }
}


export function PortfolioDashboardWorkspace({
  currentProjectId,
  accessibleProjectCount,
  generatedAt,
  projects,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastByProject,
    setForecastByProject,
  ] =
    useState<
      Record<
        string,
        string
      >
    >(
      {},
    );


  const [
    forecastErrors,
    setForecastErrors,
  ] =
    useState<
      Record<
        string,
        string
      >
    >(
      {},
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    search,
    setSearch,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    attentionFilter,
    setAttentionFilter,
  ] =
    useState<
      PortfolioAttentionLevel |
      "ALL"
    >(
      "ALL",
    );


  const [
    currencyFilter,
    setCurrencyFilter,
  ] =
    useState(
      "ALL",
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadPortfolioForecasts() {
        const csv:
          Record<
            string,
            string
          > =
            {};


        const errors:
          Record<
            string,
            string
          > =
            {};


        await Promise.all(
          projects.map(
            async (
              project,
            ) => {
              try {
                const response =
                  await fetch(
                    `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                      project.id,
                    )}/export/csv`,
                    {
                      cache:
                        "no-store",

                      signal:
                        controller.signal,
                    },
                  );


                if (
                  !response.ok
                ) {
                  throw new Error(
                    `HTTP ${response.status}`,
                  );
                }


                csv[
                  project.id
                ] =
                  await response.text();
              }
              catch (
                cause
              ) {
                if (
                  controller.signal.aborted
                ) {
                  return;
                }


                errors[
                  project.id
                ] =
                  cause instanceof Error
                    ?
                      cause.message
                    :
                      "Forecast unavailable";
              }
            },
          ),
        );


        if (
          controller.signal.aborted
        ) {
          return;
        }


        setForecastByProject(
          csv,
        );

        setForecastErrors(
          errors,
        );

        setLoading(
          false,
        );
      }


      void loadPortfolioForecasts();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projects,
    ],
  );


  const analytics =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        projects.map(
          (
            project,
          ) => {
            const forecastAvailable =
              Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                forecastByProject,
                project.id,
              );


            if (
              !forecastAvailable
            ) {
              return {
                project,

                forecastAvailable:
                  false,

                liveSnapshot:
                  null,

                scorecardSummary:
                  null,
              };
            }


            const forecasts =
              normalizeForecastCsv(
                forecastByProject[
                  project.id
                ] ??
                "",
              );


            const liveSnapshot =
              buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot({
                capturedAt:
                  generatedAt,

                actuals:
                  project.actuals,

                forecasts,

                riskPolicy:
                  project.riskPolicy,

                latestActualPeriod:
                  project.latestActualPeriod,

                latestActualCash:
                  project.latestActualCash,

                actions:
                  project.actions.map(
                    (
                      action,
                    ) => ({
                      status:
                        action.status,

                      priority:
                        action.priority,

                      dueDate:
                        action.dueDate,
                    }),
                  ),
              });


            const scorecard =
              calculateManagementScorecard({
                targets:
                  project.targets,

                actuals:
                  project.actuals,

                forecasts,

                riskPolicy:
                  project.riskPolicy,

                latestActualPeriod:
                  project.latestActualPeriod,

                latestActualCash:
                  project.latestActualCash,
              });


            return {
              project,

              forecastAvailable:
                true,

              liveSnapshot,

              scorecardSummary:
                scorecard.summary,
            };
          },
        ),
      [
        projects,
        forecastByProject,
        generatedAt,
      ],
    );


  const dashboard =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildPortfolioExecutiveDashboard(
          analytics,
        ),
      [
        analytics,
      ],
    );


  const currencies =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        [
          ...new Set(
            projects.map(
              (
                project,
              ) =>
                project.currency,
            ),
          ),
        ].sort(),
      [
        projects,
      ],
    );


  const filteredRows =
    useMemo(
      () => {
        const needle =
          search
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();


        return dashboard.rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            (
              !needle ||
              [
                row.name,
                row.industry,
                row.currency,
                row.role,
                row.liquidityRiskLevel ??
                "",
              ]
                .join(
                  " ",
                )
                .toLowerCase()
                .includes(
                  needle,
                )
            ) &&
            (
              attentionFilter ===
                "ALL" ||
              row.attentionLevel ===
                attentionFilter
            ) &&
            (
              currencyFilter ===
                "ALL" ||
              row.currency ===
                currencyFilter
            ),
        );
      },
      [
        dashboard.rows,
        search,
        attentionFilter,
        currencyFilter,
      ],
    );


  const unresolvedActions =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        projects
          .flatMap(
            (
              project,
            ) =>
              project.actions
                .filter(
                  (
                    action,
                  ) =>
                    action.status !==
                      "DONE" &&
                    action.status !==
                      "DISMISSED",
                )
                .map(
                  (
                    action,
                  ) => ({
                    ...action,

                    projectId:
                      project.id,

                    projectName:
                      project.name,

                    currency:
                      project.currency,
                  }),
                ),
          )
          .sort(
            (
              left,
              right,
            ) => {
              const priority =
                actionPriorityRank(
                  left.priority,
                ) -
                actionPriorityRank(
                  right.priority,
                );


              if (
                priority !==
                0
              ) {
                return priority;
              }


              if (
                left.dueDate &&
                right.dueDate
              ) {
                return left.dueDate.localeCompare(
                  right.dueDate,
                );
              }


              if (
                left.dueDate
              ) {
                return -1;
              }


              if (
                right.dueDate
              ) {
                return 1;
              }


              return left.title.localeCompare(
                right.title,
              );
            },
          )
          .slice(
            0,
            15,
          ),
      [
        projects,
      ],
    );


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-6">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                6,
            }).map(
              (
                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-96 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {
        accessibleProjectCount >
        projects.length
          ?
            (
              <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Portfolio analysis is limited to 24 projects per dashboard load. Showing {
                  projects.length
                } of {
                  accessibleProjectCount
                } accessible projects.
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-6">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Projects
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              dashboard.summary
                .loadedProjects
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            High / critical risk
          </p>

          <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${
            dashboard.summary
              .criticalHighRisk >
            0
              ?
                "text-destructive"
              :
                ""
          }`}>
            {
              dashboard.summary
                .criticalHighRisk
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Critical actions
          </p>

          <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${
            dashboard.summary
              .openCriticalActions >
            0
              ?
                "text-destructive"
              :
                ""
          }`}>
            {
              dashboard.summary
                .openCriticalActions
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Off-track targets
          </p>

          <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${
            dashboard.summary
              .offTrackTargets >
            0
              ?
                "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400"
              :
                ""
          }`}>
            {
              dashboard.summary
                .offTrackTargets
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Open periods
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              dashboard.summary
                .openFinancialPeriods
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Avg forecast accuracy
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              percent(
                dashboard.summary
                  .averageForecastAccuracy,
              )
            }
          </p>

          {
            dashboard.summary
              .forecastUnavailable >
            0
              ?
                (
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {
                      dashboard.summary
                        .forecastUnavailable
                    } unavailable
                  </p>
                )
              :
                null
          }
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Portfolio risk distribution
          </h2>

          <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-5">
            <div className="rounded-lg border p-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Critical
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold text-destructive">
                {
                  dashboard.summary
                    .riskDistribution
                    .critical
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border p-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                High
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold text-destructive">
                {
                  dashboard.summary
                    .riskDistribution
                    .high
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border p-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Moderate
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                {
                  dashboard.summary
                    .riskDistribution
                    .moderate
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border p-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Low
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                {
                  dashboard.summary
                    .riskDistribution
                    .low
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border p-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Unavailable
              </p>

              <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">
                {
                  dashboard.summary
                    .riskDistribution
                    .unavailable
                }
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Forecast readiness
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-4 text-4xl font-semibold">
            {
              dashboard.summary
                .forecastReady
            }
            <span className="text-lg font-normal text-muted-foreground">
              {" / "}
              {
                dashboard.summary
                  .loadedProjects
              }
            </span>
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
            Portfolio analytics only classify liquidity, capital need, and forecast accuracy when the project&apos;s authenticated forecast export is available.
          </p>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Currency-separated portfolio exposure
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-4xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            VentureScope does not perform FX conversion. Cash and capital requirements are aggregated only inside the same project currency.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[780px] text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                  Currency
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  Projects
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  Forecast-ready
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  Projects with Actual cash
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  Latest Actual cash
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                  Modeled capital need
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody>
              {
                dashboard.currencies.map(
                  (
                    item,
                  ) => (
                    <tr
                      key={
                        item.currency
                      }
                      className="border-b last:border-0"
                    >
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                        {
                          item.currency
                        }
                      </th>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        {
                          item.projectCount
                        }
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        {
                          item.projectsWithForecast
                        }
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        {
                          item.projectsWithActualCash
                        }
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">
                        {
                          money(
                            item.latestActualCash,
                            item.currency,
                          )
                        }
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">
                        {
                          money(
                            item.capitalNeed,
                            item.currency,
                          )
                        }
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Search projects
            </span>

            <input
              value={
                search
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setSearch(
                  event.target.value,
                );
              }}
              placeholder="Name, industry, currency..."
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            />
          </label>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Attention
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                attentionFilter
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setAttentionFilter(
                  event.target.value as
                    PortfolioAttentionLevel |
                    "ALL",
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="ALL">
                All levels
              </option>

              <option value="CRITICAL">
                Critical
              </option>

              <option value="REVIEW">
                Review
              </option>

              <option value="MONITOR">
                Monitor
              </option>

              <option value="STABLE">
                Stable
              </option>
            </select>
          </label>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Currency
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                currencyFilter
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setCurrencyFilter(
                  event.target.value,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="ALL">
                All currencies
              </option>

              {
                currencies.map(
                  (
                    currency,
                  ) => (
                    <option
                      key={
                        currency
                      }
                      value={
                        currency
                      }
                    >
                      {
                        currency
                      }
                    </option>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Project attention register
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-4xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Attention score is a management-triage indicator based on existing liquidity risk, modeled funding need, critical actions, target performance, financial-close status, forecast reliability, and data readiness. It is not a valuation or financial KPI.
          </p>
        </div>

        {
          filteredRows.length ===
          0
            ?
              (
                <div className="p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  No projects match the selected filters.
                </div>
              )
            :
              (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[1650px] text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Project
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Role
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Attention
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Liquidity risk
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Latest cash
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Capital need
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Forecast accuracy
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Critical actions
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Off-track targets
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Latest close
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Drill down
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody>
                      {
                        filteredRows.map(
                          (
                            row,
                          ) => (
                            <tr
                              key={
                                row.id
                              }
                              className={`border-b align-top last:border-0 ${
                                row.id ===
                                  currentProjectId
                                  ?
                                    "bg-muted/20"
                                  :
                                    ""
                              }`}
                            >
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <div>
                                    <p className="font-semibold">
                                      {
                                        row.name
                                      }
                                    </p>

                                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                      {
                                        row.industry ||
                                        "Industry not specified"
                                      }
                                      {" · "}
                                      {
                                        row.currency
                                      }
                                    </p>
                                  </div>

                                  {
                                    row.isCurrentProject
                                      ?
                                        (
                                          <span className="rounded border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium">
                                            CURRENT
                                          </span>
                                        )
                                      :
                                        null
                                  }
                                </div>
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                {
                                  row.role
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <p className={`font-semibold ${attentionTone(
                                  row.attentionLevel,
                                )}`}>
                                  {
                                    row.attentionLevel
                                  }
                                </p>

                                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                  {
                                    row.attentionScore
                                  }
                                  /100
                                </p>
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                {
                                  row.forecastAvailable
                                    ?
                                      (
                                        <>
                                          <p className="font-semibold">
                                            {
                                              row.liquidityRiskLevel ??
                                              "—"
                                            }
                                          </p>

                                          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                            Score {
                                              row.liquidityRiskScore ??
                                              "—"
                                            }
                                          </p>
                                        </>
                                      )
                                    :
                                      (
                                        <span
                                          title={
                                            forecastErrors[
                                              row.id
                                            ] ??
                                            "Forecast unavailable"
                                          }
                                          className="text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                          Forecast unavailable
                                        </span>
                                      )
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">
                                {
                                  money(
                                    row.latestActualCash,
                                    row.currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">
                                {
                                  row.forecastAvailable
                                    ?
                                      money(
                                        row.capitalNeed,
                                        row.currency,
                                      )
                                    :
                                      "—"
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                {
                                  percent(
                                    row.forecastAccuracy,
                                  )
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className={`px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold ${
                                row.criticalOpenActions >
                                0
                                  ?
                                    "text-destructive"
                                  :
                                    ""
                              }`}>
                                {
                                  row.criticalOpenActions
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className={`px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold ${
                                row.offTrackTargets >
                                0
                                  ?
                                    "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400"
                                  :
                                    ""
                              }`}>
                                {
                                  row.offTrackTargets
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className={`px-4 py-3 font-semibold ${closeTone(
                                row.latestPeriodCloseStatus,
                              )}`}>
                                {
                                  row.latestActualPeriod
                                    ?
                                      `${row.latestActualPeriod} · ${row.latestPeriodCloseStatus}`
                                    :
                                      "NO ACTUALS"
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                  <Link
                                    href={`/projects/${row.id}/dashboard`}
                                    className="rounded border px-2 py-1 text-xs"
                                  >
                                    Dashboard
                                  </Link>

                                  <Link
                                    href={`/projects/${row.id}/risk-center`}
                                    className="rounded border px-2 py-1 text-xs"
                                  >
                                    Risk
                                  </Link>

                                  <Link
                                    href={`/projects/${row.id}/capital-planning`}
                                    className="rounded border px-2 py-1 text-xs"
                                  >
                                    Capital

  active: boolean;
  complete: boolean;

function StepIndicator({
  number,
  label,
  active,
  complete,
}: StepIndicatorProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border p-3 transition-colors",
        active
          ? "border-foreground bg-muted/50"
          : "border-border",
      )}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-sm font-semibold",

            complete
            ? "border-foreground bg-foreground text-background"
            : "border-border text-muted-foreground",

            className="size-4"
            aria-hidden="true"

          number
        )}

        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Step {number}
        </div>

        <div className="text-sm font-medium">
          {label}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

"use client";

import {
  Copy,
  LoaderCircle,
  MoreHorizontal,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  useActionState,
  useState,
  useTransition,
} from "react";
import {
  useFormStatus,
} from "react-dom";

import {
  deleteProjectAction,
  duplicateProjectAction,
  renameProjectAction,
} from "@/app/(app)/projects/actions";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import {
  Button,
} from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import {
  Input,
} from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Label,
} from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  initialRenameProjectState,
} from "@/lib/projects/action-state";

type ProjectActionsProps = {
  projectId: string;
  projectName: string;
  returnTo: string;
};

export function ProjectActions({
  projectId,
  projectName,
  returnTo,
}: ProjectActionsProps) {
  const [
    renameOpen,
    setRenameOpen,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    deleteOpen,
    setDeleteOpen,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    duplicatePending,
    startDuplicateTransition,
  ] = useTransition();

  const [
    renameState,
    renameFormAction,
  ] = useActionState(
    renameProjectAction,
    initialRenameProjectState,
  );

  function duplicateProject() {
    startDuplicateTransition(
      async () => {
        await duplicateProjectAction(
          projectId,
        );
      },
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <DropdownMenu>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger
          asChild
        >
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            aria-label={`Actions for ${projectName}`}
          >
            {duplicatePending ? (
              <LoaderCircle
                className="size-4 animate-spin"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
            ) : (
              <MoreHorizontal
                className="size-4"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
            )}
          </Button>
        </DropdownMenuTrigger>

        <DropdownMenuContent
          align="end"
          className="w-48"
        >
          <DropdownMenuItem
            onSelect={(
              event,
            ) => {
              event.preventDefault();

              setRenameOpen(
                true,
              );
            }}
          >
            <Pencil
              className="size-4"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />

            Rename
          </DropdownMenuItem>

          <DropdownMenuItem
            disabled={
              duplicatePending
            }
            onSelect={(
              event,
            ) => {
              event.preventDefault();

              duplicateProject();
            }}
          >
            <Copy
              className="size-4"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />

            Duplicate
          </DropdownMenuItem>

          <DropdownMenuSeparator />

          <DropdownMenuItem
            variant="destructive"
            onSelect={(
              event,
            ) => {
              event.preventDefault();

              setDeleteOpen(
                true,
              );
            }}
          >
            <Trash2
              className="size-4"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />

            Delete
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>

      <Dialog
        open={
          renameOpen
        }
        onOpenChange={
          setRenameOpen
        }
      >
        <DialogContent>
          <form
            action={
              renameFormAction
            }
          >
            <input
              type="hidden"
              name="projectId"
              value={
                projectId
              }
            />

            <input
              type="hidden"
              name="returnTo"
              value={
                returnTo
              }
            />

            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>
                Rename financial model
              </DialogTitle>

              <DialogDescription>
                Change the model name. Financial configuration and scenarios remain unchanged.
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>

            <div className="space-y-3 py-6">
              {renameState.message ? (
                <div
                  role="alert"
                  className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-destructive"
                >
                  {
                    renameState.message
                  }
                </div>
              ) : null}

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor={`rename-${projectId}`}>
                  Model name
                </Label>

                <Input
                  id={`rename-${projectId}`}
                  name="name"
                  defaultValue={
                    projectName
                  }
                  autoFocus
                />

                {renameState
                  .errors
                  ?.name?.[0] ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                    {
                      renameState
                        .errors
                        .name[0]
                    }
                  </p>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>

            <DialogFooter>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() =>
                  setRenameOpen(
                    false,
                  )
                }
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>

              <RenameSubmitButton />
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <AlertDialog
        open={
          deleteOpen
        }
        onOpenChange={
          setDeleteOpen
        }
      >
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <form
            action={
              deleteProjectAction
            }
          >
            <input
              type="hidden"
              name="projectId"
              value={
                projectId
              }
            />

            <AlertDialogHeader>
              <AlertDialogTitle>
                Delete &ldquo;{projectName}&rdquo;?
              </AlertDialogTitle>

              <AlertDialogDescription>
                This permanently deletes the financial model and all scenarios, financing events and monthly overrides belonging to it.
              </AlertDialogDescription>
            </AlertDialogHeader>

            <AlertDialogFooter className="mt-6">
              <AlertDialogCancel
                type="button"
              >
                Cancel
              </AlertDialogCancel>

              <AlertDialogAction
                asChild
              >
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  variant="destructive"
                >
                  <Trash2
                    className="size-4"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />

                  Delete model
                </Button>
              </AlertDialogAction>
            </AlertDialogFooter>
          </form>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  );
}

function RenameSubmitButton() {
  const {
    pending,
  } = useFormStatus();

  return (
    <Button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending}
    >
      {pending ? (
        <>
          <LoaderCircle
            className="size-4 animate-spin"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />

          Saving...
        </>
      ) : (
        "Save name"
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}
