"use client";

import {
  ChevronDown,
  Menu,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  usePathname,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  buildProjectWorkspaceNavigation,
} from "@/lib/projects/workspace-navigation";
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

export function ProjectMobileWorkspaceNav({
  projectId,
}: {
  projectId: string;
}) {
  const pathname =
    usePathname();

  const groups =
    buildProjectWorkspaceNavigation(
      projectId,
    );

  const current =
    groups
      .flatMap(
        (
          group,
        ) =>
          group.items,
      )
      .find(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.href ===
          pathname,
      );

  return (
    <details className="group relative">
      <summary className="flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm font-medium outline-none transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
        <Menu
          className="size-4"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />

        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">
          {
            current?.label ??
            "Project navigation"
          }
        </span>

        <ChevronDown
          className="size-4 shrink-0 transition-transform group-open:rotate-180"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      </summary>

      <nav
        aria-label="Mobile project workspace"
        className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-[calc(100%+0.5rem)] z-40 max-h-[70svh] overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border bg-popover p-3 text-popover-foreground shadow-xl"
      >
        {groups.map(
          (
            group,
          ) => (
            <div
              key={
                group.label
              }
              className="mb-4 last:mb-0"
            >
              <div className="mb-1 px-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-muted-foreground">
                {
                  group.label
                }
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                {group.items.map(
                  (
                    item,
                  ) => {
                    const active =
                      pathname ===
                      item.href;

                    const Icon =
                      item.icon;

                    return (
                      <Link
                        key={
                          item.href
                        }
                        href={
                          item.href
                        }
                        aria-current={
                          active
                            ? "page"
                            : undefined
                        }
                        className={cn(
                          "flex min-h-10 items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 text-sm transition-colors",
                          active
                            ? "bg-foreground font-medium text-background"
                            : "hover:bg-muted",
                        )}
                      >
                        <Icon
                          className="size-4 shrink-0"
                          aria-hidden="true"
                        />

                        {
                          item.label
                        }
                      </Link>
                    );
                  },
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ),
        )}
      </nav>
    </details>
  );
}

                        "flex h-10 items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors",
                        active
                          ? "bg-foreground text-background"
                          : "hover:bg-muted",
                      )}
                    >
                      <Icon
                        className="size-4"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      />

                      {
                        item.label
                      }
                    </Link>
                  );
                },
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ),
      )}
    </nav>
  );
}

import {

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  Button,
} from "@/components/ui/button";

export function ReportExportActions({
  projectId,
  scenarioId,
}: {
  projectId: string;

  scenarioId?: string;
}) {
  const query =
    scenarioId
      ? `?scenario=${encodeURIComponent(
          scenarioId,
        )}`
      : "";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <Button
        asChild
        variant="outline"
      >
        <Link
          href={`/api/projects/${projectId}/export/csv${query}`}
          prefetch={false}
        >
          <FileSpreadsheet
            className="size-4"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />

          Export CSV
        </Link>
      </Button>

      <Button asChild>
        <Link
          href={`/api/projects/${projectId}/export/pdf${query}`}
          prefetch={false}
        >
          <FileText
            className="size-4"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />

          Export PDF

            className="size-4"

##### FILE: ./components/risk-center/risk-center-workspace.tsx #####
"use client";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  calculateLiquidityRiskReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/calculations";

import type {
  GuardrailState,
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";

import {
  saveRiskPolicyAction,
} from "@/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/risk-center/actions";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  editable:
    boolean;

  policy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function guardrailTone(
  state:
    GuardrailState,
): string {
  switch (
    state
  ) {
    case "PASS":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "WARNING":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "BREACH":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "UNAVAILABLE":
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function riskTone(
  level:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    level
  ) {
    case "LOW":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "MODERATE":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "HIGH":
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "text-destructive";

    default:
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


export function RiskCenterWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  editable,
  policy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load forecast risk data.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const rows =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const report =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
          rows,

          policy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,
        }),
      [
        rows,
        policy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
      ],
    );


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {
        editable
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                  Financial guardrails
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                  Define the limits management wants VentureScope to watch continuously against the live forecast.
                </p>

                <form
                  action={
                    saveRiskPolicyAction
                  }
                  className="mt-5 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3"
                >
                  <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="projectId"
                    value={
                      projectId
                    }
                  />

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Minimum cash
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step="0.01"
                      min="0"
                      name="minimumCash"
                      defaultValue={
                        policy.minimumCash ??
                        ""
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Minimum runway months
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="1"
                      max="60"
                      step="1"
                      required
                      name="minimumRunwayMonths"
                      defaultValue={
                        policy.minimumRunwayMonths
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Minimum EBITDA margin %
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="-100"
                      max="100"
                      step="0.1"
                      name="minimumEbitdaMarginPercent"
                      defaultValue={
                        policy.minimumEbitdaMargin ===
                          null
                          ?
                            ""
                          :
                            policy.minimumEbitdaMargin *
                            100
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Maximum monthly burn
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      step="0.01"
                      name="maximumMonthlyBurn"
                      defaultValue={
                        policy.maximumMonthlyBurn ??
                        ""
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Downside revenue shock %
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      max="90"
                      step="1"
                      required
                      name="downsideRevenueShockPercent"
                      defaultValue={
                        policy.downsideRevenueShock *
                        100
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Downside cost inflation %
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      max="100"
                      step="1"
                      required
                      name="downsideCostInflationPercent"
                      defaultValue={
                        policy.downsideCostInflation *
                        100
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <div className="sm:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3">
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="h-10 rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 text-sm font-medium text-background"
                    >
                      Save financial guardrails
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </section>
            )
          :
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                You have Viewer access. Risk analysis is visible, but changing financial guardrails requires Editor permission.
              </section>
            )
      }

      {
        error
          ?
            (
              <div
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  error
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      {
        loading
          ?

                                        :

                                            currency,

                                      "EBITDA_MARGIN"

                                          guardrail.threshold,

                                      :
                                      guardrail.code ===

                                            :

                    Downside stress

                        policy.downsideCostInflation,

                        {

                            latestActualCash,
                            currency,
                          )

                            report.minimumDownsideCash,
                            currency,
                          )

                    <article className="rounded-lg border p-4">

                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">

                          )

                      Downside cash path
                    </h2>
                  </div>

                  <div className="max-h-[520px] overflow-auto">
                    <table className="w-full min-w-[650px] text-sm">
                      <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-background">
                        <tr className="border-b">
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                            Period
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            Baseline cash flow
                          </th>

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">

                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">

                          </th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>

                      <tbody>

                          report.downsideCash.map(
                            (
                              row,
                            ) => (
                              <tr
                                key={
                                  row.period
                                }

                              >
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">

                                    row.period
                                  }

                                  {

                                  }

                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">

##### FILE: ./components/scenario-comparison/scenario-comparison-workspace.tsx #####
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  buildScenarioDecisionMatrix,
  cleanScenarioChangePath,
  compareScenarios,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-comparison/comparison";

import {
  summarizeJsonValue,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/json";

import type {
  ScenarioComparisonView,
  ScenarioDivergence,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-comparison/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  scenarios:
    ScenarioComparisonView[];
};


function divergenceTone(
  divergence:
    ScenarioDivergence,
): string {
  switch (
    divergence
  ) {
    case "HIGH":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "MODERATE":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "LOW":
      return "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400";

    case "IDENTICAL":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";
  }
}


function changeTone(
  kind:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    kind
  ) {
    case "ADDED":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "REMOVED":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "TYPE_CHANGED":
      return "text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400";

    default:
      return "";
  }
}


function numericDirectionTone(
  direction:
    string,
): string {
  return direction ===
    "INCREASED"
    ?
      "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
    :
      "text-destructive";
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


export function ScenarioComparisonWorkspace({
  projectId,
  scenarios,
}: Props) {
  const defaultReference =
    scenarios.find(
      (
        scenario,
      ) =>
        scenario.isBase,
    ) ??
    scenarios[
      0
    ] ??
    null;


  const defaultTarget =
    scenarios.find(
      (
        scenario,
      ) =>
        scenario.id !==
        defaultReference?.id,
    ) ??
    defaultReference;


  const [
    referenceId,
    setReferenceId,
  ] =
    useState(
      defaultReference?.id ??
      "",
    );


  const [
    targetId,
    setTargetId,
  ] =
    useState(
      defaultTarget?.id ??
      "",
    );


  const byId =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        new Map(
          scenarios.map(
            (
              scenario,
            ) => [
              scenario.id,
              scenario,
            ],
          ),
        ),
      [
        scenarios,
      ],
    );


  const reference =
    byId.get(
      referenceId,
    ) ??
    scenarios[
      0
    ] ??
    null;


  const target =
    byId.get(
      targetId,
    ) ??
    scenarios[
      1
    ] ??
    scenarios[
      0
    ] ??
    null;


  const comparison =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        reference &&
        target
          ?
            compareScenarios(
              reference,
              target,
            )
          :
            null,
      [
        reference,
        target,
      ],
    );


  const matrix =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        reference
          ?
            buildScenarioDecisionMatrix(
              reference,
              scenarios,
            )
          :
            [],
      [
        reference,
        scenarios,
      ],
    );


  const numericByPath =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        new Map(
          comparison
            ?.numericChanges
            .map(
              (
                change,
              ) => [
                change.path,
                change,
              ],
            ) ??
            [],
        ),
      [
        comparison,
      ],
    );


  if (
    scenarios.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return (
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          No scenarios are available
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Create Base, Bull, Bear, or custom scenarios before opening the Scenario Comparison Center.
        </p>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/scenarios`}
          className="mt-5 inline-flex rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Open Scenarios
        </Link>
      </section>
    );
  }


  if (
    scenarios.length ===
    1
  ) {
    return (
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          A second scenario is required
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Scenario Comparison needs at least two scenario configurations. Your existing scenario remains unchanged.
        </p>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/scenarios`}
          className="mt-5 inline-flex rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Create another scenario
        </Link>
      </section>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-end">
          <div className="grid flex-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="space-y-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                Reference scenario
              </span>

              <select
                value={
                  referenceId
                }
                onChange={(
                  event,
                ) => {
                  setReferenceId(
                    event.target.value,
                  );
                }}
                className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  scenarios.map(
                    (
                      scenario,
                    ) => (
                      <option
                        key={
                          scenario.id
                        }
                        value={
                          scenario.id
                        }
                      >
                        {
                          scenario.name
                        }
                        {
                          scenario.isBase
                            ?
                              " · Base"
                            :
                              ""
                        }
                      </option>
                    ),
                  )
                }
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                Compare with
              </span>

              <select
                value={
                  targetId
                }
                onChange={(
                  event,
                ) => {
                  setTargetId(
                    event.target.value,
                  );
                }}
                className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  scenarios.map(
                    (
                      scenario,
                    ) => (
                      <option
                        key={
                          scenario.id
                        }
                        value={
                          scenario.id
                        }
                      >
                        {
                          scenario.name
                        }
                        {
                          scenario.isBase
                            ?
                              " · Base"
                            :
                              ""
                        }
                      </option>
                    ),
                  )
                }
              </select>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setReferenceId(
                  targetId,
                );

                setTargetId(
                  referenceId,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 rounded-lg border px-4 text-sm font-medium"
            >
              Swap
            </button>

            <Link
              href={`/projects/${projectId}/scenarios`}
              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-lg border px-4 text-sm font-medium"
            >
              Manage scenarios
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {
        reference?.id ===
        target?.id
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Select two different scenarios to inspect their driver differences.
              </section>
            )
          :
            comparison
              ?
                (
                  <>
                    <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                      <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                          Driver changes
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
                          {
                            comparison
                              .summary
                              .totalChanges
                          }
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          Recursive configuration differences.
                        </p>
                      </article>

                      <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                          Divergence
                        </p>

                        <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${divergenceTone(
                          comparison
                            .summary
                            .divergence,
                        )}`}>
                          {
                            comparison
                              .summary
                              .divergence
                          }
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          Degree of configuration divergence, not financial quality.
                        </p>
                      </article>

                      <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                          Numeric movements
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
                          {
                            comparison
                              .summary
                              .numericIncreases
                          }
                          {" ↑ / "}
                          {
                            comparison
                              .summary
                              .numericDecreases
                          }
                          {" ↓"}
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          Direction only; business meaning depends on the driver.
                        </p>
                      </article>

                      <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                          Structural changes
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
                          {
                            comparison
                              .summary
                              .structuralChanges
                          }
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          Added, removed, or type-changed model drivers.
                        </p>
                      </article>
                    </section>

                    <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
                      <div className="border-b p-5">
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                          Driver comparison

                          {
                            reference.name
                          } → {
                            target.name
                          }
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      {
                        comparison.changes.length ===
                        0
                          ?
                            (
                              <div className="p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">

                              </div>
                            )
                          :
                            (
                              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                <table className="w-full min-w-[1200px] text-sm">
                                  <thead>
                                    <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">

                                      </th>

                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">

                                      </th>

                                      </th>

                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                        Target
                                      </th>

                                        Numeric delta
                                      </th>

                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                                        Relative
                                      </th>
                                    </tr>
                                  </thead>

                                  <tbody>
                                    {
                                      comparison.changes.map(
                                        (
                                          change,
                                          index,
                                        ) => {
                                          const numeric =
                                            numericByPath.get(
                                              change.path,
                                            );


                                          return (
                                            <tr
                                              key={`${change.path}-${change.kind}-${index}`}
                                              className="border-b align-top last:border-0"

                                              )}`}>

                                                }

                                                  )
                                                }
                                              </td>

                                                {
                                                  summarizeJsonValue(
                                                    change.before,
                                                  )
                                                }
                                              </td>

                                              <td className="max-w-sm px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs">
                                                {
                                                  summarizeJsonValue(
                                                    change.after,
                                                  )
                                                }
                                              </td>

                                              <td className={`px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums ${
                                                numeric
                                                  ?
                                                    numericDirectionTone(
                                                      numeric.direction,
                                                    )
                                                  :
                                                    ""
                                              }`}>
                                                {
                                                  numeric
                                                    ?
                                                      `${
                                                        numeric.delta >
                                                        0
                                                          ?
                                                            "+"
                                                          :
                                                            ""
                                                      }${numeric.delta}`
                                                    :
                                                      "—"
                                                }
                                              </td>

                                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                                {
                                                  numeric
                                                    ?

                                                        numeric.relativeRate,
                                                      )
                                                    :
                                                      "—"
                                                }
                                              </td>
                                            </tr>
                                          );
                                        },
                                      )
                                    }
                                  </tbody>
                                </table>
                              </div>

                      }
                    </section>
                  </>

              :

      }

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Scenario decision matrix
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Every scenario is measured against the selected reference. Divergence indicates configuration distance only; VentureScope does not infer that an increase is automatically better or worse.

It does not duplicate financial formulas, execute an invented scenario engine, mutate scenarios, or claim that a positive numeric movement is economically favorable without knowing the meaning of that driver.
        </p>

  );

  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";
import {
  CartesianGrid,
  Legend,
  Line,
  LineChart,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";

import {
  FinancialKpiCard,
} from "@/components/financial/financial-kpi-card";
import {
  Button,
} from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  generateFinancialForecast,
} from "@/lib/finance/engine";
import {
  formatCompactCurrencyValue,
  formatLongMonthKey,
  formatMonthKey,
  formatRunway,
} from "@/lib/finance/formatting";
import type {
  FinancialModelInput,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";
import {
  scenarioFormValuesToStorageModifiers,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/modifiers";

type SimulatorValues = {
  growth: number;

  arpu: number;

  cac: number;

  churn: number;

  cogs: number;
};

const INITIAL_VALUES: SimulatorValues =
  {
    growth:
      0,

    arpu:
      0,

    cac:
      0,

    churn:
      0,

    cogs:
      0,
  };

export function LiveScenarioSimulator({
  baseInput,
}: {
  baseInput: FinancialModelInput;
}) {
  const [
    values,
    setValues,
  ] =
    useState<SimulatorValues>(
      INITIAL_VALUES,
    );

  const baseForecast =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        generateFinancialForecast(
          baseInput,
        ),
      [
        baseInput,
      ],
    );

  const simulatedForecast =
    useMemo(
      () => {
        const modifiers =
          scenarioFormValuesToStorageModifiers({
            growthAdjustmentPercentage:
              String(
                values.growth,
              ),

            arpuAdjustmentPercentage:
              String(
                values.arpu,
              ),

            cacAdjustmentPercentage:
              String(
                values.cac,
              ),

            churnDeltaPercentagePoints:
              String(
                values.churn,
              ),

            cogsDeltaPercentagePoints:
              String(
                values.cogs,
              ),
          });

        return generateFinancialForecast({
          ...baseInput,

          scenario: {
            id:
              baseInput.scenario
                ?.id,

            name:
              "Live Simulation",

            type:
              "CUSTOM",

            modifiers,
          },
        });
      },
      [
        baseInput,
        values,
      ],
    );

  const chartData =
    baseForecast.months
      .slice(
        0,
        Math.min(
          24,
          baseForecast.months.length,
        ),
      )
      .map(
        (
          month,
          index,
        ) => ({
          label:
            formatMonthKey(
              month.month,
            ),

          baseRevenue:
            Number(
              month.revenue,
            ),

          simulatedRevenue:
            Number(
              simulatedForecast.months[
                index
              ].revenue,
            ),
        }),
      );

  const customerDriven =
    baseInput.revenueMode ===
    "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
            Live simulation
          </h3>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
            Adjust scenario modifiers locally and see the financial result instantly. Nothing is persisted while you experiment.
          </p>
        </div>

        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() =>
            setValues(
              INITIAL_VALUES,
            )
          }
        >
          <RotateCcw
            className="size-4"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />

          Reset simulation
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <SimulatorControl
          label={
            customerDriven
              ? "Acquisition growth adjustment"
              : "Revenue growth adjustment"
          }
          value={
            values.growth
          }
          min={-100}
          max={200}
          step={1}
          suffix="%"
          onChange={(
            value,
          ) =>
            setValues(
              (
                current,
              ) => ({
                ...current,
                growth:
                  value,
              }),
            )
          }
        />

        <SimulatorControl
          label="COGS adjustment"
          value={
            values.cogs
          }
          min={-50}
          max={50}
          step={0.5}
          suffix="pp"
          onChange={(
            value,
          ) =>
            setValues(
              (
                current,
              ) => ({
                ...current,
                cogs:
                  value,
              }),
            )
          }
        />

        {customerDriven ? (
          <>
            <SimulatorControl
              label="ARPU adjustment"
              value={
                values.arpu
              }
              min={-100}
              max={200}
              step={1}
              suffix="%"
              onChange={(
                value,
              ) =>
                setValues(
                  (
                    current,
                  ) => ({
                    ...current,
                    arpu:
                      value,
                  }),
                )
              }
            />

            <SimulatorControl
              label="CAC adjustment"
              value={
                values.cac
              }
              min={-95}
              max={300}
              step={1}
              suffix="%"
              onChange={(
                value,
              ) =>
                setValues(
                  (
                    current,
                  ) => ({
                    ...current,
                    cac:
                      value,
                  }),
                )
              }
            />

            <SimulatorControl
              label="Churn adjustment"
              value={
                values.churn
              }
              min={-25}
              max={25}
              step={0.5}
              suffix="pp"
              onChange={(
                value,
              ) =>
                setValues(
                  (
                    current,
                  ) => ({
                    ...current,
                    churn:
                      value,
                  }),
                )
              }
            />
          </>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-6">
        <FinancialKpiCard

          value={formatCompactCurrencyValue(

              .firstYearRevenue,

          icon={

          }
        />

        <FinancialKpiCard
          label="First-year EBITDA"
          value={formatCompactCurrencyValue(
            simulatedForecast.metrics
              .firstYearEbitda,
            simulatedForecast.currency,
          )}
          detail={`Base: ${formatCompactCurrencyValue(
            baseForecast.metrics
              .firstYearEbitda,
            baseForecast.currency,
          )}`}
          icon={
            TrendingUp
          }
        />

        <FinancialKpiCard
          label="Ending cash"
          value={formatCompactCurrencyValue(
            simulatedForecast.metrics
              .endingCash,
            simulatedForecast.currency,

              .endingCash,
            baseForecast.currency,
          )}`}

        />

        <FinancialKpiCard

function SimulatorControl({
  label,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  step,
  suffix,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;

  value: number;

  min: number;

  max: number;

  step: number;

  suffix: string;

  onChange:
    (
      value: number,
    ) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <label className="text-sm font-medium">
          {
            label
          }
        </label>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <input
            type="number"
            min={min}
            max={max}
            step={step}
            value={
              value
            }
            onChange={(
              event,
            ) => {
              const parsed =
                Number(
                  event.target.value,
                );

              if (
                Number.isFinite(
                  parsed,
                )
              ) {
                onChange(
                  Math.max(
                    min,
                    Math.min(
                      max,
                      parsed,
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }
            }}
            className="h-8 w-20 rounded-md border bg-transparent px-2 text-right text-sm outline-none"
          />

          <span className="w-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {
              suffix
            }
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <input
        type="range"
        min={min}
        max={max}
        step={step}
        value={
          value
        }
        onChange={(
          event,
        ) =>
          onChange(
            Number(
              event.target.value,
            ),
          )
        }
        className="mt-5 w-full accent-foreground"
      />

      <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
        <span>
          {min}
          {suffix}
        </span>

        <span>
          Base 0
          {suffix}
        </span>

        <span>
          {max}
          {suffix}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/scenarios/scenario-action-message.tsx #####
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  CircleAlert,
} from "lucide-react";

import type {
  ScenarioActionState,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/action-state";
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

export function ScenarioActionMessage({
  state,
}: {
  state: ScenarioActionState;
}) {
  if (
    !state.message
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const success =
    state.status ===
    "success";

  const Icon =
    success
      ? CheckCircle2
      : CircleAlert;

  return (
    <div
      role={
        success
          ? "status"
          : "alert"
      }
      className={cn(
        "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm",
        success
          ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5"
          : "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive",
      )}
    >
      <Icon
        className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      {
        state.message
      }
    </div>
  );
}

                ) => (
                  <td
                    key={`open-${item.scenarioId ?? item.scenarioName}`}
                    className="border-r px-4 py-3 text-right last:border-r-0"
                  >
                    {item.scenarioId ? (
                      <Button
                        asChild
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                      >
                        <Link
                          href={`/projects/${projectId}/overview?scenario=${encodeURIComponent(
                            item.scenarioId,
                          )}`}
                        >
                          Open
                        </Link>
                      </Button>
                    ) : (
                      "—"
                    )}
                  </td>
                ),
              )}
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ComparisonRow({
  label,
  values,
}: {
  label: string;

  values: string[];
}) {
  return (
    <tr className="border-b last:border-b-0">
      <th className="sticky left-0 z-10 border-r bg-background px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">
        {
          label
        }
      </th>

      {values.map(
        (
          value,
          index,
        ) => (
          <td
            key={`${label}-${index}`}
            className="border-r px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs tabular-nums last:border-r-0"
          >
            {
              value
            }
          </td>
        ),
      )}
    </tr>
  );
}

function ModifierSummary({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;

  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 p-3">
      <div className="text-muted-foreground">
        {
          label
        }
      </div>

      <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-foreground">
        {
          value
        }
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function signed(
  value: string,
): string {
  const number =
    Number(
      value,
    );

  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      number,
    )
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    number >
    0
  ) {
    return `+${value}`;
  }

  return value;
}

##### FILE: ./components/scenarios/scenario-switcher.tsx #####
"use client";

import {
  LoaderCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  usePathname,
  useRouter,
  useSearchParams,
} from "next/navigation";
import {
  useTransition,
} from "react";

import type {
  ScenarioSwitcherOption,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/types";

type ScenarioSwitcherProps = {
  scenarios: ScenarioSwitcherOption[];

  currentScenarioId: string;
};

export function ScenarioSwitcher({
  scenarios,
  currentScenarioId,
}: ScenarioSwitcherProps) {
  const router =
    useRouter();

  const pathname =
    usePathname();

  const searchParams =
    useSearchParams();

  const [
    pending,
    startTransition,
  ] = useTransition();

  function selectScenario(
    scenarioId: string,
  ) {
    const params =
      new URLSearchParams(
        searchParams.toString(),
      );

    params.set(
      "scenario",
      scenarioId,
    );

    startTransition(
      () => {
        router.push(
          `${pathname}?${params.toString()}`,
        );
      },
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-background px-2 py-1.5">
      {pending ? (
        <LoaderCircle
          className="size-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      ) : null}

      <label
        htmlFor="analysis-scenario"
        className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground"
      >
        Scenario
      </label>

      <select
        id="analysis-scenario"
        value={
          currentScenarioId
        }
        onChange={(
          event,
        ) =>
          selectScenario(
            event.target.value,
          )
        }
        disabled={
          pending
        }
        className="h-8 max-w-52 bg-transparent text-sm font-medium outline-none"
      >
        {scenarios.map(
          (
            scenario,
          ) => (
            <option
              key={
                scenario.id
              }
              value={
                scenario.id
              }
            >
              {
                scenario.name
              }
            </option>
          ),
        )}
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  targets:
    KpiTargetView[];
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function number(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function displayValue({
  metric,
  value,
  currency,
}: {
  metric:
    KpiMetricCode;

  value:
    number |
    null;

  currency:
    string;
}): string {
  const definition =
    kpiMetricDefinition(
      metric,
    );


  switch (
    definition.format
  ) {
    case "MONEY":
      return money(
        value,
        currency,
      );


    case "PERCENT":
      return percent(
        value,
      );


    case "MONTHS":
      return value ===
        null
        ?
          "—"
        :
          `${number(
            value,
          )} mo`;


    case "NUMBER":
      return number(
        value,
      );
  }
}


function statusTone(
  status:
    KpiTargetStatus,
): string {
  switch (
    status
  ) {
    case "ON_TRACK":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "AT_RISK":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "OFF_TRACK":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "UNAVAILABLE":
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function statusSurface(
  status:
    KpiTargetStatus,
): string {
  switch (
    status
  ) {
    case "ON_TRACK":
      return "bg-emerald-500/5";

    case "AT_RISK":
      return "bg-amber-500/5";

    case "OFF_TRACK":
      return "bg-destructive/5";

    case "UNAVAILABLE":
      return "bg-muted/20";
  }
}


function scorecardRowLabel(
  row:
    KpiScorecardRow,
): string {
  return kpiMetricDefinition(
    row.target.metricCode,
  ).label;
}


export function ScorecardWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  editable,
  defaultPeriod,
  actuals,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
  targets,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    targetPeriod,
    setTargetPeriod,
  ] =
    useState(
      defaultPeriod,
    );


  const [
    selectedMetric,
    setSelectedMetric,
  ] =
    useState<
      KpiMetricCode
    >(
      "REVENUE",
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load management scorecard data.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const forecasts =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const scorecard =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateManagementScorecard({
          targets,

          actuals,

          forecasts,

          riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,
        }),
      [
        targets,
        actuals,
        forecasts,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
      ],
    );


  const selectedExistingTarget =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        targets.find(
          (
            target,
          ) =>
            target.periodKey ===
              targetPeriod &&
            target.metricCode ===
              selectedMetric,
        ) ??
        null,
      [
        targets,
        targetPeriod,
        selectedMetric,
      ],
    );


  const periods =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        [
          ...new Set(
            targets.map(
              (
                target,
              ) =>
                target.periodKey,
            ),
          ),
        ].sort(
          (
            left,
            right,
          ) =>
            right.localeCompare(
              left,
            ),
        ),
      [
        targets,
      ],
    );


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                4,
            }).map(
              (
                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-80 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {
        error
          ?
            (
              <div
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  error
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Targets
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              scorecard.summary
                .total
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            On track
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
            {
              scorecard.summary
                .onTrack
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            At risk
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
            {
              scorecard.summary
                .atRisk
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Off track
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-destructive">
            {
              scorecard.summary
                .offTrack
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Tracked periods
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              scorecard.summary
                .trackedPeriods
            }
          </p>
        </article>
      </section>

      {
        editable
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                  Set management target
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                  Saving the same metric and period updates that target. Percentage targets are entered as percentages, such as 20 for a 20% EBITDA margin.
                </p>

                <form
                  key={`${targetPeriod}-${selectedMetric}-${selectedExistingTarget?.updatedAt ?? "new"}`}
                  action={
                    saveKpiTargetAction
                  }
                  className="mt-5 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3"
                >
                  <input
                    type="hidden"
                    name="projectId"
                    value={
                      projectId
                    }
                  />

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Period
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="month"
                      required
                      name="periodKey"
                      value={
                        targetPeriod
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setTargetPeriod(
                          event.target.value,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      KPI
                    </span>

                    <select
                      name="metricCode"
                      value={
                        selectedMetric
                      }
                      onChange={(
                        event,
                      ) => {
                        setSelectedMetric(
                          event.target.value as
                            KpiMetricCode,
                        );
                      }}
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                      {
                        KPI_METRICS.map(
                          (
                            metric,
                          ) => (
                            <option
                              key={
                                metric.code
                              }
                              value={
                                metric.code
                              }
                            >
                              {
                                metric.label
                              }
                            </option>
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Target value
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step={
                        selectedMetric ===
                          "CUSTOMERS" ||
                        selectedMetric ===
                          "RUNWAY_MONTHS"
                          ?
                            "1"
                          :
                            "0.01"
                      }
                      required
                      name="targetValue"
                      defaultValue={
                        selectedExistingTarget
                          ?
                            targetValueForInput({
                              metric:
                                selectedExistingTarget.metricCode,

                              value:
                                selectedExistingTarget.targetValue,
                            })
                          :
                            ""
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Owner
                    </span>

                    <input
                      name="ownerName"
                      maxLength={
                        80
                      }
                      defaultValue={
                        selectedExistingTarget
                          ?.ownerName ??
                        ""
                      }
                      placeholder="Finance lead"
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2 sm:col-span-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Management note
                    </span>

                    <input
                      name="note"
                      maxLength={
                        1000
                      }
                      defaultValue={
                        selectedExistingTarget
                          ?.note ??
                        ""
                      }
                      placeholder="Context, commitment, or management rationale."
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <div className="sm:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3">
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="h-10 rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 text-sm font-medium text-background"
                    >
                      {
                        selectedExistingTarget
                          ?
                            "Update KPI target"
                          :
                            "Add KPI target"
                      }
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </section>
            )
          :
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                You have Viewer access. Management targets and scorecard status are visible, but changing targets requires Editor permission.
              </section>
            )
      }

      {
        scorecard.rows.length ===
        0
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8">
                <h2 className="font-semibold">
                  No management targets yet
                </h2>

                <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                  Add targets for revenue, EBITDA margin, cash, MRR, customers, runway, or forecast accuracy to activate the management scorecard.
                </p>
              </section>
            )
          :
            (
              <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
                <div className="border-b p-5">
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                    Management scorecard
                  </h2>

                  <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Period KPIs prefer Actuals when available and otherwise use the authoritative forecast. Runway and forecast accuracy are evaluated from the live analytical authorities.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[1280px] text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Period
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          KPI
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Status
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Target
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Current
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Gap
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Source
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Owner
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Note
                        </th>

                        {
                          editable
                            ?
                              (
                                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                  Manage
                                </th>
                              )
                            :
                              null
                        }
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody>
                      {
                        scorecard.rows.map(
                          (
                            row,
                          ) => (
                            <tr
                              key={
                                row.target.id
                              }
                              className={`border-b align-top last:border-0 ${statusSurface(
                                row.status,
                              )}`}
                            >
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">
                                {
                                  row.target
                                    .periodKey
                                }
                              </td>

                              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                {
                                  scorecardRowLabel(
                                    row,
                                  )
                                }
                              </th>

                              <td className={`px-4 py-3 font-semibold ${statusTone(
                                row.status,
                              )}`}>
                                {
                                  row.status
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                {
                                  displayValue({
                                    metric:
                                      row.target.metricCode,

                                    value:
                                      row.target.targetValue,

                                    currency,
                                  })
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                                {
                                  displayValue({
                                    metric:
                                      row.target.metricCode,

                                    value:
                                      row.currentValue,

                                    currency,
                                  })
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className={`px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums ${
                                row.gap !==
                                  null &&
                                row.gap <
                                  0
                                  ?
                                    "text-destructive"
                                  :
                                    ""
                              }`}>
                                {
                                  row.gap ===
                                    null
                                    ?
                                      "—"
                                    :
                                      displayValue({
                                        metric:
                                          row.target.metricCode,

                                        value:
                                          row.gap,

                                        currency,
                                      })
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs">
                                {
                                  row.source
                                }
                              </td>

                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                {
                                  row.target
                                    .ownerName ??
                                  "—"
                                }
                              </td>

                                {
                                  row.target
                                    .note ??
                                  "—"
                                }
                              </td>

                              {
                                editable
                                  ?
                                    (

                                        <div className="flex gap-2">

                                            type="button"

                                              setTargetPeriod(
                                                row.target.periodKey,
                                              );

                                              setSelectedMetric(
                                                row.target.metricCode,
                                              );


                                              document
                                                .querySelector(
                                                  'input[name="targetValue"]',
                                                )
                                                ?.scrollIntoView({
                                                  behavior:
                                                    "smooth",

                                                  block:
                                                    "center",
                                                });
                                            }}
                                            className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium"
                                          >
                                            Edit
                                          </button>

                                          <form
                                            action={
                                              deleteKpiTargetAction
                                            }
                                          >

                                              type="hidden"
                                              name="projectId"

                                              }

                                              type="hidden"

                                              type="submit"

                                            </button>
                                          </form>

                              }

      {

            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
                <h2 className="font-semibold">
                  Scorecard coverage
                </h2>

                <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {
                    periods.map(
                      (
                        period,
                      ) => (
                        <span
                          key={
