                          }
                          className="rounded border px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                        >
                          {
                            period
                          }
                        </span>
                      ),
                    )
                  }
                </div>
              </section>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/actuals`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Actuals
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/forecast`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Forecast
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/forecast-accuracy`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Forecast Accuracy
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/risk-center`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Risk Center
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/decision-center`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Decision Center
        </Link>
      </section>

      <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        KPI targets are management commitments, not forecast assumptions. Updating a target does not change the financial model, Actuals, scenarios, risk policy, baselines, sensitivity cases, or immutable revisions.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/sensitivity-lab/sensitivity-lab-workspace.tsx #####
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  buildSensitivityAxis,
  calculateSensitivityCell,
  calculateSensitivitySurface,
} from "@/lib/finance/sensitivity-lab/calculations";

import type {
  SensitivityCell,
  SensitivityCellState,
} from "@/lib/finance/sensitivity-lab/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function stateTone(
  state:
    SensitivityCellState,
): string {
  switch (
    state
  ) {
    case "RESILIENT":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "FLOOR_BREACH":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "CASH_EXHAUSTION":
      return "text-destructive";
  }
}


function stateSurface(
  state:
    SensitivityCellState,
): string {
  switch (
    state
  ) {
    case "RESILIENT":
      return "bg-emerald-500/10";

    case "FLOOR_BREACH":
      return "bg-amber-500/10";

    case "CASH_EXHAUSTION":
      return "bg-destructive/10";
  }
}


function numericInput(
  value:
    string,
  fallback:
    number,
): number {
  if (
    value.trim() ===
    ""
  ) {
    return fallback;
  }


  const parsed =
    Number(
      value,
    );


  return Number.isFinite(
    parsed,
  )
    ?
      parsed
    :
      fallback;
}


export function SensitivityLabWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const [
    revenueMaxPercent,
    setRevenueMaxPercent,
  ] =
    useState(
      "40",
    );


  const [
    costMaxPercent,
    setCostMaxPercent,
  ] =
    useState(
      "20",
    );


  const [
    gridPoints,
    setGridPoints,
  ] =
    useState(
      5,
    );


  const [
    targetFloor,
    setTargetFloor,
  ] =
    useState(
      String(
        riskPolicy.minimumCash ??
        0,
      ),
    );


  const [
    metric,
    setMetric,
  ] =
    useState<
      "MIN_CASH" |
      "CAPITAL_NEED"
    >(
      "MIN_CASH",
    );


  const [
    selectedCell,
    setSelectedCell,
  ] =
    useState<
      SensitivityCell |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load sensitivity data.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const rows =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const parsedRevenueMax =
    Math.min(
      0.90,
      Math.max(
        0,
        numericInput(
          revenueMaxPercent,
          40,
        ) /
        100,
      ),
    );


  const parsedCostMax =
    Math.min(
      1,
      Math.max(
        0,
        numericInput(
          costMaxPercent,
          20,
        ) /
        100,
      ),
    );


  const parsedFloor =
    Math.max(
      0,
      numericInput(
        targetFloor,
        riskPolicy.minimumCash ??
        0,
      ),
    );


  const revenueAxis =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildSensitivityAxis(
          parsedRevenueMax,
          gridPoints,
        ),
      [
        parsedRevenueMax,
        gridPoints,
      ],
    );


  const costAxis =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        buildSensitivityAxis(
          parsedCostMax,
          gridPoints,
        ),
      [
        parsedCostMax,
        gridPoints,
      ],
    );


  const surface =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateSensitivitySurface({
          rows,

          basePolicy:
            riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,

          targetCashFloor:
            parsedFloor,

          revenueShocks:
            revenueAxis,

          costInflations:
            costAxis,
        }),
      [
        rows,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
        parsedFloor,
        revenueAxis,
        costAxis,
      ],
    );


  const currentPolicyCase =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateSensitivityCell({
          rows,

          basePolicy:
            riskPolicy,

          latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash,

          targetCashFloor:
            parsedFloor,

          revenueShock:
            riskPolicy.downsideRevenueShock,

          costInflation:
            riskPolicy.downsideCostInflation,
        }),
      [
        rows,
        riskPolicy,
        latestActualPeriod,
        latestActualCash,
        parsedFloor,
      ],
    );


  const cellByCoordinates =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        new Map(
          surface.cells.map(
            (
              cell,
            ) => [
              `${cell.revenueShock}:${cell.costInflation}`,
              cell,
            ],
          ),
        ),
      [
        surface.cells,
      ],
    );


  const effectiveSelectedCell =
    selectedCell ??
    currentPolicyCase;


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                4,
            }).map(
              (
                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-96 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {
        error
          ?
            (
              <div
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  error
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
          Sensitivity design
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Test combinations of revenue downside and cost inflation. Every cell reuses the existing Risk Center downside engine and Capital Planning funding-gap authority.
        </p>

        <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">
          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Maximum revenue shock %
            </span>

            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              max="90"
              step="1"
              value={
                revenueMaxPercent
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setRevenueMaxPercent(
                  event.target.value,
                );

                setSelectedCell(
                  null,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            />
          </label>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Maximum cost inflation %
            </span>

            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              max="100"
              step="1"
              value={
                costMaxPercent
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setCostMaxPercent(
                  event.target.value,
                );

                setSelectedCell(
                  null,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            />
          </label>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Grid resolution
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                gridPoints
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setGridPoints(
                  Number(
                    event.target.value,
                  ),
                );

                setSelectedCell(
                  null,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="3">
                3 × 3
              </option>

              <option value="5">
                5 × 5
              </option>

              <option value="7">
                7 × 7
              </option>
            </select>
          </label>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Target cash floor
            </span>

            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              step="0.01"
              value={
                targetFloor
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setTargetFloor(
                  event.target.value,
                );

                setSelectedCell(
                  null,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            />
          </label>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              Surface metric
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                metric
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setMetric(
                  event.target.value as
                    "MIN_CASH" |
                    "CAPITAL_NEED",
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="MIN_CASH">
                Minimum cash
              </option>

              <option value="CAPITAL_NEED">
                Capital need
              </option>
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Resilient cases
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
            {
              surface.summary
                .resilientCells
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            of {
              surface.summary
                .totalCells
            } combinations
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Cash exhaustion cases
          </p>

          <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${
            surface.summary
              .cashExhaustionCells >
            0
              ?
                "text-destructive"
              :
                ""
          }`}>
            {
              surface.summary
                .cashExhaustionCells
            }
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Earliest: {
              surface.summary
                .earliestCashExhaustionPeriod ??
              "none"
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Worst minimum cash
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              money(
                surface.summary
                  .worstMinimumCash,
                currency,
              )
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Maximum capital need
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-semibold">
            {
              money(
                surface.summary
                  .maximumCapitalNeed,
                currency,
              )
            }
          </p>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Revenue shock × cost inflation
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Select a cell to inspect its liquidity and capital consequences.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto p-5">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[760px] border-collapse text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th className="border p-3 text-left">
                  Revenue shock
                </th>

                {
                  surface.costInflations.map(
                    (
                      costInflation,
                    ) => (
                      <th
                        key={
                          costInflation
                        }
                        className="border p-3 text-center"

                        Cost +{
                          percent(
                            costInflation,
                          )
                        }
                      </th>
                    ),
                  )
                }
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody>
              {
                surface.revenueShocks.map(
                  (
                    revenueShock,
                  ) => (
                    <tr
                      key={
                        revenueShock
                      }
                    >
                      <th className="border p-3 text-left">
                        Revenue -{
                          percent(
                            revenueShock,
                          )
                        }
                      </th>

                      {
                        surface.costInflations.map(
                          (
                            costInflation,
                          ) => {
                            const cell =
                              cellByCoordinates.get(
                                `${revenueShock}:${costInflation}`,
                              );


                            if (
                              !cell
                            ) {
                              return (
                                <td
                                  key={
                                    costInflation
                                  }
                                  className="border p-3"
                                >
                                  —
                                </td>
                              );
                            }


                            return (
                              <td
                                key={
                                  costInflation
                                }
                                className={`border p-0 ${stateSurface(
                                  cell.state,
                                )}`}
                              >
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    setSelectedCell(
                                      cell,
                                    );
                                  }}
                                  className="block min-h-24 w-full p-3 text-left"
                                >
                                  <p className={`text-xs font-semibold ${stateTone(
                                    cell.state,

                                    }

                                  <p className="mt-2 font-semibold">
                                    {
                                      metric ===
                                        "MIN_CASH"
                                        ?
                                          money(
                                            cell.minimumCash,
                                            currency,
                                          )
                                        :
                                          money(
                                            cell.capitalNeed,
                                            currency,
                                          )
                                    }
                                  </p>

                                  {
                                    cell.cashExhaustionPeriod
                                      ?
                                        (
                                          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-destructive">
                                            Exhausts {
                                              cell.cashExhaustionPeriod
                                            }
                                          </p>
                                        )
                                      :
                                        null
                                  }
                                </button>
                              </td>
                            );
                          },
                        )
                      }
                    </tr>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Selected stress case

              percent(

              )
            } · Costs +{
              percent(
                effectiveSelectedCell
                  .costInflation,
              )
            }
          </h2>

          <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="rounded-lg border p-4">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">

              </p>

                effectiveSelectedCell

                    effectiveSelectedCell
                      .minimumCash,
                    currency,

                      .endingCash,
                    currency,
                  )
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border p-4">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Capital need
              </p>

              <p className="mt-2 font-semibold">
                {
                  money(
                    effectiveSelectedCell
                      .capitalNeed,
                    currency,
                  )
                }
              </p>

              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">

              <p className={`mt-2 font-semibold ${stateTone(

                {
                  currentPolicyCase.state
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border p-4">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Minimum cash
              </p>

              <p className="mt-2 font-semibold">
                {
                  money(
                    currentPolicyCase
                      .minimumCash,
                    currency,
                  )
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border p-4">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Capital need
              </p>

              <p className="mt-2 font-semibold">
                {
                  money(
                    currentPolicyCase
                      .capitalNeed,
                    currency,
                  )
                }
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border p-4">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Exhaustion
              </p>

              <p className="mt-2 font-semibold">
                {
                  currentPolicyCase
                    .cashExhaustionPeriod ??
                  "None"
                }
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Link
              href={`/projects/${projectId}/risk-center`}
              className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
            >
              Open Risk Center
            </Link>

            <Link
              href={`/projects/${projectId}/capital-planning`}
              className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
            >
              Open Capital Planning
            </Link>
          </div>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Funding-resilience boundary
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            For each revenue shock, this shows the highest modeled cost inflation in the current grid that still requires no additional capital to preserve the target cash floor.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[650px] text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                  Revenue shock
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                  Maximum cost inflation without funding
                </th>

                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                  Interpretation
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody>
              {
                surface.boundary.map(
                  (
                    point,
                  ) => (
                    <tr
                      key={
                        point.revenueShock
                      }
                      className="border-b last:border-0"
                    >
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">
                        {
                          percent(
                            point.revenueShock,
                          )
                        }
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        {
                          point.maximumCostInflationWithoutFunding ===
                            null
                            ?
                              "None in grid"
                            :
                              percent(
                                point.maximumCostInflationWithoutFunding,
                              )
                        }
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-muted-foreground">
                        {
                          point.maximumCostInflationWithoutFunding ===
                            null
                            ?
                              "Even the lowest modeled cost case requires capital at this revenue shock."
                            :
                              "Cases at or below this modeled cost shock remain within the no-funding boundary."
                        }
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Sensitivity integrity
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          The Sensitivity Lab is a deterministic stress-analysis layer. Revenue shock and cost inflation are passed into the existing Risk Center downside calculation, and capital need is calculated by the existing Capital Planning authority. No scenario, forecast assumption, Actual, risk policy, planning baseline, or model revision is changed.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

        "Delete all monthly overrides?",

      confirmationDescription:
        "All one-off Revenue, Marketing, Salaries, Rent, COGS, CAC, Churn and ARPU adjustments will be removed.",

      buttonLabel:
        "Clear overrides",

      icon:
        SlidersHorizontal,
    },

    {
      type:
        "SCENARIOS",

      title:
        "Reset scenario library",

      description:
        "Remove custom scenarios and recreate clean Base, Bull and Bear defaults.",

      confirmationTitle:
        "Reset the complete scenario library?",

      confirmationDescription:
        "All custom scenarios and all scenario-specific monthly overrides will be deleted. Global monthly overrides remain. Base, Bull and Bear will be recreated from VentureScope defaults.",

      buttonLabel:
        "Reset scenarios",

      icon:
        ShieldAlert,
    },
  ];

export function ModelGovernance({
  projectId,
}: {
  projectId: string;
}) {
  const [
    selected,
    setSelected,
  ] =
    useState<DestructiveAction | null>(
      null,
    );

  const definition =
    definitions.find(
      (
        item,
      ) =>
        item.type ===
        selected,
    );

  const action =
    selected ===
    "ASSUMPTIONS"
      ? resetFinancialAssumptionsAction
      : selected ===
          "FINANCING"
        ? clearFinancingEventsAction
        : selected ===
            "OVERRIDES"
          ? clearMonthlyOverridesAction
          : resetScenarioLibraryAction;

  return (
    <>
      <Card className="border-destructive/30">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-destructive/10 text-destructive">
              <ShieldAlert
                className="size-5"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <CardTitle>
                Model governance
              </CardTitle>

              <CardDescription className="mt-1 max-w-3xl leading-6">
                Destructive operations require explicit confirmation. VentureScope never performs these actions automatically when normal settings change.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
          {definitions.map(
            (
              item,
            ) => {
              const Icon =
                item.icon;

              return (
                <div
                  key={
                    item.type
                  }
                  className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-5 rounded-xl border p-5"
                >
                  <div className="flex gap-3">
                    <div className="flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-muted">
                      <Icon
                        className="size-4"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <div className="font-medium">
                        {
                          item.title
                        }
                      </div>

                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
                        {
                          item.description
                        }
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    className="w-fit"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setSelected(
                        item.type,
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    <Trash2
                      className="size-4"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />

                    {
                      item.buttonLabel
                    }
                  </Button>
                </div>
              );
            },
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <AlertDialog
        open={
          selected !==
          null
        }
        onOpenChange={(
          open,
        ) => {
          if (!open) {
            setSelected(
              null,
            );
          }
        }}
      >
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>
              {
                definition
                  ?.confirmationTitle
              }
            </AlertDialogTitle>

            <AlertDialogDescription>
              {
                definition
                  ?.confirmationDescription
              }
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>

          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>
              Cancel
            </AlertDialogCancel>

            {definition ? (
              <form
                action={
                  action
                }
              >
                <input
                  type="hidden"
                  name="projectId"
                  value={
                    projectId
                  }
                />

                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  variant="destructive"
                >
                  <Trash2
                    className="size-4"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />

                  Confirm
                </Button>
              </form>
            ) : null}
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/settings/settings-action-message.tsx #####
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  CircleAlert,
} from "lucide-react";

import type {
  ProjectSettingsActionState,
} from "@/lib/settings/action-state";
import {
  cn,
} from "@/lib/utils";

export function SettingsActionMessage({
  state,
}: {
  state: ProjectSettingsActionState;
}) {
  if (
    !state.message
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const success =
    state.status ===
    "success";

  const Icon =
    success
      ? CheckCircle2
      : CircleAlert;

  return (
    <div
      role={
        success
          ? "status"
          : "alert"
      }
      className={cn(
        "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm",
        success
          ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5"
          : "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive",
      )}
    >
      <Icon
        className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      <span>
        {
          state.message
        }
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/theme/theme-toggle.tsx #####
"use client";

import {
  Moon,
  Sun,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  useTheme,
} from "next-themes";
import {
  useSyncExternalStore,
} from "react";

import {
  Button,
} from "@/components/ui/button";

function subscribeToHydration() {
  return () => {};
}

function getClientSnapshot() {
  return true;
}

function getServerSnapshot() {
  return false;
}

export function ThemeToggle() {
  const {
    resolvedTheme,
    setTheme,
  } =
    useTheme();

  const mounted =
    useSyncExternalStore(
      subscribeToHydration,
      getClientSnapshot,
      getServerSnapshot,
    );

  if (!mounted) {
    return (
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="ghost"
        size="icon"
        disabled
        aria-label="Theme control loading"
      >
        <Sun
          className="size-4"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      </Button>
    );
  }

  const dark =
    resolvedTheme ===
    "dark";

  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      onClick={() =>
        setTheme(
          dark
            ? "light"
            : "dark",
        )
      }
      aria-label={
        dark
          ? "Switch to light theme"
          : "Switch to dark theme"
      }
    >
      {dark ? (
        <Sun
          className="size-4"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      ) : (
        <Moon
          className="size-4"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { cn } from "cn"
import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogPrimitive } from "radix-ui"

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

function AlertDialog({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <AlertDialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="alert-dialog" {...props} />
}

function AlertDialogTrigger({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="alert-dialog-trigger" {...props} />
  )
}

function AlertDialogPortal({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Portal>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="alert-dialog-portal" {...props} />
  )
}

function AlertDialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Overlay>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Overlay
      data-slot="alert-dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/10 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogContent({
  className,
  size = "default",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Content> & {
  size?: "default" | "sm"
}) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPortal>
      <AlertDialogOverlay />
      <AlertDialogPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="alert-dialog-content"
        data-size={size}
        className={cn(
          "group/alert-dialog-content fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 grid w-full -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 gap-4 rounded-xl bg-popover p-4 text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 duration-100 outline-none data-[size=default]:max-w-xs data-[size=sm]:max-w-xs data-[size=default]:sm:max-w-sm data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </AlertDialogPortal>
  )
}

function AlertDialogHeader({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-dialog-header"
      className={cn(
        "grid grid-rows-[auto_1fr] place-items-center gap-1.5 text-center has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]:grid-rows-[auto_auto_1fr] has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]:gap-x-4 sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:place-items-start sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:text-left sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]:grid-rows-[auto_1fr]",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogFooter({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "-mx-4 -mb-4 flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 rounded-b-xl border-t bg-muted/50 p-4 group-data-[size=sm]/alert-dialog-content:grid group-data-[size=sm]/alert-dialog-content:grid-cols-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogMedia({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-dialog-media"
      className={cn(
        "mb-2 inline-flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-muted sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:row-span-2 *:[svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-6",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogTitle({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Title>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="alert-dialog-title"
      className={cn(
        "font-heading text-base font-medium sm:group-data-[size=default]/alert-dialog-content:group-has-data-[slot=alert-dialog-media]/alert-dialog-content:col-start-2",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Description>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="alert-dialog-description"
      className={cn(
        "text-sm text-balance text-muted-foreground md:text-pretty *:[a]:underline *:[a]:underline-offset-3 *:[a]:hover:text-foreground",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogAction({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Action> &
  Pick<React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>, "variant" | "size">) {
  return (
    <Button variant={variant} size={size} asChild>
      <AlertDialogPrimitive.Action
        data-slot="alert-dialog-action"
        className={cn(className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </Button>
  )
}

function AlertDialogCancel({
  className,
  variant = "outline",
  size = "default",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Cancel> &
  Pick<React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>, "variant" | "size">) {
  return (
    <Button variant={variant} size={size} asChild>
      <AlertDialogPrimitive.Cancel
        data-slot="alert-dialog-cancel"
        className={cn(className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </Button>
  )
}

export {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogMedia,
  AlertDialogOverlay,
  AlertDialogPortal,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
}

import * as React from "react"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "group/badge inline-flex h-5 w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-4xl border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3!",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-primary/80",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-secondary/80",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a]:hover:bg-destructive/20",
        outline:
          "border-border text-foreground [a]:hover:bg-muted [a]:hover:text-muted-foreground",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"span"> &
  VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "span"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="badge"
      data-variant={variant}
      className={cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Badge, badgeVariants }

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { cn } from "cn"
import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "radix-ui"

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react"

function Dialog({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="dialog" {...props} />
}

function DialogTrigger({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="dialog-trigger" {...props} />
}

function DialogPortal({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="dialog-portal" {...props} />
}

function DialogClose({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Close>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Close data-slot="dialog-close" {...props} />
}

function DialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Overlay>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Overlay
      data-slot="dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 isolate z-50 bg-black/10 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogContent({
  className,
  children,
  showCloseButton = true,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <DialogPortal>
      <DialogOverlay />
      <DialogPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="dialog-content"
        className={cn(
          "fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 gap-4 rounded-xl bg-popover p-4 text-sm text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 duration-100 outline-none sm:max-w-sm data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close data-slot="dialog-close" asChild>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              className="absolute top-2 right-2"
              size="icon-sm"
            >
              <XIcon
              />
              <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
            </Button>
          </DialogPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </DialogPrimitive.Content>
    </DialogPortal>
  )
}

function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-header"
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogFooter({
  className,
  showCloseButton = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "-mx-4 -mb-4 flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 rounded-b-xl border-t bg-muted/50 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {showCloseButton && (
        <DialogPrimitive.Close asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Close</Button>
        </DialogPrimitive.Close>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function DialogTitle({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="dialog-title"
      className={cn(
        "font-heading text-base leading-none font-medium",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="dialog-description"
      className={cn(
        "text-sm text-muted-foreground *:[a]:underline *:[a]:underline-offset-3 *:[a]:hover:text-foreground",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogOverlay,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
}

import * as React from "react"
import { cn } from "cn"
import { Separator as SeparatorPrimitive } from "radix-ui"

function Separator({
  className,
  orientation = "horizontal",
  decorative = true,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SeparatorPrimitive.Root>) {
  return (
    <SeparatorPrimitive.Root
      data-slot="separator"
      decorative={decorative}
      orientation={orientation}
      className={cn(
        "shrink-0 bg-border data-horizontal:h-px data-horizontal:w-full data-vertical:w-px data-vertical:self-stretch",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Separator }

##### FILE: ./components/variance-review/variance-review-workspace.tsx #####
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import {
  calculateVarianceReview,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/calculations";

import {
  VARIANCE_METRICS,
  varianceMetricDefinition,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/metrics";

import {
  VARIANCE_CAUSE_CODES,
  VARIANCE_COMMENTARY_STATUSES,
  VARIANCE_NATURES,
  type VarianceCommentaryView,
  type VarianceFavorability,
  type VarianceMateriality,
  type VarianceMetricCode,
  type VarianceReviewRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/types";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import {
  deleteVarianceCommentaryAction,
  saveVarianceCommentaryAction,
} from "@/app/(app)/projects/[projectId]/variance-review/actions";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  currency:
    string;

  editable:
    boolean;

  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];

  commentaries:
    VarianceCommentaryView[];
};


function money(
  value:
    number |
    null,
  currency:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "currency",

      currency,

      notation:
        Math.abs(
          value,
        ) >=
        1_000_000
          ?
            "compact"
          :
            "standard",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function numberValue(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function percent(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en",
    {
      style:
        "percent",

      maximumFractionDigits:
        1,
    },
  ).format(
    value,
  );
}


function metricValue({
  metric,
  value,
  currency,
}: {
  metric:
    VarianceMetricCode;

  value:
    number |
    null;

  currency:
    string;
}): string {
  return varianceMetricDefinition(
    metric,
  ).format ===
    "MONEY"
    ?
      money(
        value,
        currency,
      )
    :
      numberValue(
        value,
      );
}


function favorabilityTone(
  value:
    VarianceFavorability,
): string {
  switch (
    value
  ) {
    case "FAVORABLE":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "UNFAVORABLE":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "NEUTRAL":
    case "UNAVAILABLE":
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function materialityTone(
  value:
    VarianceMateriality,
): string {
  switch (
    value
  ) {
    case "MATERIAL":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "REVIEW":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "IMMATERIAL":
    case "UNAVAILABLE":
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function commentaryStatusTone(
  status:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    status
  ) {
    case "RESOLVED":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "MONITORING":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "OPEN":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "ACCEPTED":
      return "text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400";

    default:
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function metricLabel(
  row:
    VarianceReviewRow,
): string {
  return varianceMetricDefinition(
    row.metricCode,
  ).label;
}


export function VarianceReviewWorkspace({
  projectId,
  currency,
  editable,
  actuals,
  commentaries,
}: Props) {
  const [
    forecastCsv,
    setForecastCsv,
  ] =
    useState(
      "",
    );


  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );


  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  const latestActualPeriod =
    actuals[
      actuals.length -
      1
    ]?.period ??
    "ALL";


  const [
    periodFilter,
    setPeriodFilter,
  ] =
    useState(
      latestActualPeriod,
    );


  const [
    metricFilter,
    setMetricFilter,
  ] =
    useState<
      VarianceMetricCode |
      "ALL"
    >(
      "ALL",
    );


  const [
    showMaterialOnly,
    setShowMaterialOnly,
  ] =
    useState(
      false,
    );


  const [
    selectedKey,
    setSelectedKey,
  ] =
    useState<
      string |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );


  useEffect(
    () => {
      const controller =
        new AbortController();


      async function loadForecast() {
        try {
          const response =
            await fetch(
              `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
                projectId,
              )}/export/csv`,
              {
                cache:
                  "no-store",

                signal:
                  controller.signal,
              },
            );


          if (
            !response.ok
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `Forecast export returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
            );
          }


          setForecastCsv(
            await response.text(),
          );
        }
        catch (
          cause
        ) {
          if (
            controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            return;
          }


          setError(
            cause instanceof Error
              ?
                cause.message
              :
                "Unable to load variance-review data.",
          );
        }
        finally {
          if (
            !controller.signal.aborted
          ) {
            setLoading(
              false,
            );
          }
        }
      }


      void loadForecast();


      return () => {
        controller.abort();
      };
    },
    [
      projectId,
    ],
  );


  const forecasts =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        normalizeForecastCsv(
          forecastCsv,
        ),
      [
        forecastCsv,
      ],
    );


  const review =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        calculateVarianceReview({
          actuals,

          forecasts,

          commentaries,
        }),
      [
        actuals,
        forecasts,
        commentaries,
      ],
    );


  const selectedRow =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        review.rows.find(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.key ===
            selectedKey,
        ) ??
        null,
      [
        review.rows,
        selectedKey,
      ],
    );


  const availablePeriods =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        [
          ...new Set(
            review.rows.map(
              (
                row,
              ) =>
                row.periodKey,
            ),
          ),
        ].sort(
          (
            left,
            right,
          ) =>
            right.localeCompare(
              left,
            ),
        ),
      [
        review.rows,
      ],
    );


  const filteredRows =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        review.rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            (
              periodFilter ===
                "ALL" ||
              row.periodKey ===
                periodFilter
            ) &&
            (
              metricFilter ===
                "ALL" ||
              row.metricCode ===
                metricFilter
            ) &&
            (
              !showMaterialOnly ||
              row.materiality ===
                "MATERIAL"
            ),
        ),
      [
        review.rows,
        periodFilter,
        metricFilter,
        showMaterialOnly,
      ],
    );


  if (
    loading
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">
          {
            Array.from({
              length:
                5,
            }).map(
              (
                _,
                index,
              ) => (
                <div
                  key={
                    index
                  }
                  className="h-28 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted"
                />
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>

        <div className="h-80 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {
        error
          ?
            (
              <div
                role="alert"
                className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  error
                }
              </div>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">
        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Material variances
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              review.summary
                .material
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Unexplained material
          </p>

          <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${
            review.summary
              .materialUnexplained >
            0
              ?
                "text-destructive"
              :
                "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
          }`}>
            {
              review.summary
                .materialUnexplained
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Unfavorable
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-destructive">
            {
              review.summary
                .unfavorable
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Open / monitoring
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
            {
              review.summary
                .openCommentaries
            }
            {" / "}
            {
              review.summary
                .monitoringCommentaries
            }
          </p>
        </article>

        <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
            Resolved
          </p>

          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
            {
              review.summary
                .resolvedCommentaries
            }
          </p>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-medium">
              Period
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                periodFilter
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setPeriodFilter(
                  event.target.value,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="ALL">
                All periods
              </option>

              {
                availablePeriods.map(
                  (
                    period,
                  ) => (
                    <option
                      key={
                        period
                      }
                      value={
                        period
                      }
                    >
                      {
                        period
                      }
                    </option>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </select>
          </label>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-medium">
              Metric
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                metricFilter
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setMetricFilter(
                  event.target.value as
                    VarianceMetricCode |
                    "ALL",
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="ALL">
                All metrics
              </option>

              {
                VARIANCE_METRICS.map(
                  (
                    metric,
                  ) => (
                    <option
                      key={
                        metric.code
                      }
                      value={
                        metric.code
                      }
                    >
                      {
                        metric.label
                      }
                    </option>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </select>
          </label>

          <label className="flex items-end gap-2 pb-2">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={
                showMaterialOnly
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setShowMaterialOnly(
                  event.target.checked,
                );
              }}
            />

            <span className="text-sm">
              Material only
            </span>
          </label>

          <div className="flex items-end">
            <p className="pb-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {
                filteredRows.length
              } variance rows
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
        <div className="border-b p-5">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
            Monthly variance register
          </h2>

          <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Variance convention is Actual minus Forecast. Favorability accounts for whether a metric benefits from being higher or lower.
          </p>
        </div>

        {
          filteredRows.length ===
          0
            ?
              (
                <div className="p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  No matched Actual-versus-Forecast rows satisfy the selected filters.
                </div>
              )
            :
              (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[1500px] text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Period
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Metric
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Actual
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Forecast
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Variance
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          Variance %
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Favorability
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                          Materiality
                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">

                        </th>

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">

                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">

                    </thead>

                    <tbody>
                      {

                                row.key
                              }
