                      defaultValue={
                        selectedRow.commentary
                          ?.correctiveAction ??
                        ""
                      }
                      placeholder="What management action is being taken?"
                      className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Owner
                    </span>

                    <input
                      name="ownerName"
                      maxLength={
                        80
                      }
                      defaultValue={
                        selectedRow.commentary
                          ?.ownerName ??
                        ""
                      }
                      placeholder="Commercial lead"
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Expected recovery
                    </span>

                    <input
                      type="month"
                      name="recoveryPeriodKey"
                      defaultValue={
                        selectedRow.commentary
                          ?.recoveryPeriodKey ??
                        ""
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    />
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                      Review status
                    </span>

                    <select
                      name="status"
                      defaultValue={
                        selectedRow.commentary
                          ?.status ??
                        "OPEN"
                      }
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                      {
                        VARIANCE_COMMENTARY_STATUSES.map(
                          (
                            status,
                          ) => (
                            <option
                              key={
                                status
                              }
                              value={
                                status
                              }
                            >
                              {
                                status
                              }
                            </option>
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <div className="flex items-end">
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="h-10 rounded-lg bg-foreground px-4 text-sm font-medium text-background"
                    >
                      Save explanation
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>

                {
                  selectedRow.commentary
                    ?
                      (
                        <form
                          action={
                            deleteVarianceCommentaryAction
                          }
                          className="mt-4"
                        >
                          <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="projectId"
                            value={
                              projectId
                            }
                          />

                          <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="commentaryId"
                            value={
                              selectedRow.commentary.id
                            }
                          />

                          <button
                            type="submit"
                            className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-destructive"
                          >
                            Delete explanation
                          </button>
                        </form>
                      )
                    :
                      null
                }
              </section>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      {
        !editable
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                You have Viewer access. Variances and management explanations are visible, but creating or changing commentary requires Editor permission.
              </section>
            )
          :
            null
      }

      <section className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/actuals`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Actuals
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/forecast-accuracy`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Forecast Accuracy
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/scorecard`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Scorecard
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/decision-center`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Decision Center
        </Link>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/board-room`}
          className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Board Room
        </Link>
      </section>

      <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        Variance commentary is management interpretation attached to observed Actual-versus-Forecast performance. It does not rewrite Actuals, forecasts, scenarios, targets, baselines, risk policies, or immutable model revisions.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

##### FILE: ./components/version-diff/version-diff-workspace.tsx #####
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";

import {
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  compareRevisionSnapshots,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/diff";

import {
  summarizeJsonValue,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/json";

import type {
  ModelChangeCategory,
  ModelChangeMateriality,
  RevisionDiffView,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/types";


type Props = {
  projectId:
    string;

  revisions:
    RevisionDiffView[];
};


const CATEGORIES:
  (
    ModelChangeCategory |
    "ALL"
  )[] = [
    "ALL",
    "PROJECT",
    "ASSUMPTIONS",
    "SCENARIOS",
    "FINANCING",
    "OVERRIDES",
    "OTHER",
  ];


const MATERIALITIES:
  (
    ModelChangeMateriality |
    "ALL"
  )[] = [
    "ALL",
    "HIGH",
    "MEDIUM",
    "LOW",
  ];


function materialityTone(
  materiality:
    ModelChangeMateriality,
): string {
  switch (
    materiality
  ) {
    case "HIGH":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "MEDIUM":
      return "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";

    case "LOW":
      return "text-muted-foreground";
  }
}


function kindTone(
  kind:
    string,
): string {
  switch (
    kind
  ) {
    case "ADDED":
      return "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400";

    case "REMOVED":
      return "text-destructive";

    case "TYPE_CHANGED":
      return "text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400";

    default:
      return "";
  }
}


function revisionLabel(
  revision:
    RevisionDiffView,
): string {
  return `v${revision.version}${
    revision.label
      ?
        ` · ${revision.label}`
      :
        ""
  }`;
}


export function VersionDiffWorkspace({
  projectId,
  revisions,
}: Props) {
  const initialFrom =
    revisions[
      1
    ]?.id ??
    revisions[
      0
    ]?.id ??
    "";


  const initialTo =
    revisions[
      0
    ]?.id ??
    "";


  const [
    fromId,
    setFromId,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialFrom,
    );


  const [
    toId,
    setToId,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialTo,
    );


  const [
    category,
    setCategory,
  ] =
    useState<
      ModelChangeCategory |
      "ALL"
    >(
      "ALL",
    );


  const [
    materiality,
    setMateriality,
  ] =
    useState<
      ModelChangeMateriality |
      "ALL"
    >(
      "ALL",
    );


  const byId =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        new Map(
          revisions.map(
            (
              revision,
            ) => [
              revision.id,
              revision,
            ],
          ),
        ),
      [
        revisions,
      ],
    );


  const fromRevision =
    byId.get(
      fromId,
    ) ??
    null;


  const toRevision =
    byId.get(
      toId,
    ) ??
    null;


  const diff =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        fromRevision &&
        toRevision
          ?
            compareRevisionSnapshots(
              fromRevision,
              toRevision,
            )
          :
            null,
      [
        fromRevision,
        toRevision,
      ],
    );


  const filteredChanges =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        diff
          ?
            diff.changes.filter(
              (
                change,
              ) =>
                (
                  category ===
                    "ALL" ||
                  change.category ===
                    category
                ) &&
                (
                  materiality ===
                    "ALL" ||
                  change.materiality ===
                    materiality
                ),
            )
          :
            [],
      [
        diff,
        category,
        materiality,
      ],
    );


  const sourceVersion = (
    revision:
      RevisionDiffView |
      null,
  ) => {
    if (
      !revision
      ?.sourceRevisionId
    ) {
      return null;
    }


    return byId.get(
      revision.sourceRevisionId,
    )?.version ??
      null;
  };


  if (
    revisions.length <
    2
  ) {
    return (
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Two model revisions are required
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Create at least two immutable model checkpoints before using Model Diff.
        </p>

        <Link
          href={`/projects/${projectId}/versions`}
          className="mt-5 inline-flex rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
        >
          Open model versions
        </Link>
      </section>
    );
  }


  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5 sm:p-6">
        <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] lg:items-end">
          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              From revision
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                fromId
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setFromId(
                  event.target.value,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              {
                revisions.map(
                  (
                    revision,
                  ) => (
                    <option
                      key={
                        revision.id
                      }
                      value={
                        revision.id
                      }
                    >
                      {
                        revisionLabel(
                          revision,
                        )
                      }
                    </option>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </select>
          </label>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setFromId(
                toId,
              );

              setToId(
                fromId,
              );
            }}
            className="h-10 rounded-lg border px-4 text-sm font-medium"
          >
            Swap
          </button>

          <label className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">
              To revision
            </span>

            <select
              value={
                toId
              }
              onChange={(
                event,
              ) => {
                setToId(
                  event.target.value,
                );
              }}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              {
                revisions.map(
                  (
                    revision,
                  ) => (
                    <option
                      key={
                        revision.id
                      }
                      value={
                        revision.id
                      }
                    >
                      {
                        revisionLabel(
                          revision,
                        )
                      }
                    </option>
                  ),
                )
              }
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
          {
            [
              [
                "FROM",
                fromRevision,
              ] as const,

              [
                "TO",
                toRevision,
              ] as const,
            ].map(
              (
                [
                  direction,
                  revision,
                ],
              ) => (
                <article
                  key={
                    String(
                      direction,
                    )
                  }
                  className="rounded-lg border p-4"
                >
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                    {
                      direction
                    }
                  </p>

                  {
                    revision
                      ?
                        (
                          <>
                            <p className="mt-2 font-semibold">
                              {
                                revisionLabel(
                                  revision,
                                )
                              }
                            </p>

                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {
                                new Date(
                                  revision.createdAt,
                                ).toLocaleString()
                              }
                            </p>

                            {
                              revision.reason
                                ?
                                  (
                                    <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
                                      {
                                        revision.reason
                                      }
                                    </p>
                                  )
                                :
                                  null
                            }

                            {
                              sourceVersion(
                                revision,
                              ) !==
                              null
                                ?
                                  (
                                    <p className="mt-3 text-xs font-medium">
                                      Restore lineage: v{
                                        sourceVersion(
                                          revision,
                                        )
                                      }
                                    </p>
                                  )
                                :
                                  null
                            }
                          </>
                        )
                      :
                        null
                  }
                </article>
              ),
            )
          }
        </div>
      </section>

      {
        fromRevision?.id ===
        toRevision?.id
          ?
            (
              <section className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Select two different revisions to inspect model changes.
              </section>
            )
          :
            diff
              ?
                (
                  <>
                    <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                      <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                          Total changes
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
                          {
                            diff.summary
                              .total
                          }
                        </p>
                      </article>

                      <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                          High materiality
                        </p>

                        <p className={`mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold ${
                          diff.summary
                            .high >
                          0
                            ?
                              "text-destructive"
                            :
                              ""
                        }`}>
                          {
                            diff.summary
                              .high
                          }
                        </p>
                      </article>

                      <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                          Added / removed
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
                          {
                            diff.summary
                              .added
                          }
                          {" / "}
                          {
                            diff.summary
                              .removed
                          }
                        </p>
                      </article>

                      <article className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
                          Assumption changes
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold">
                          {
                            diff.summary
                              .assumptions
                          }
                        </p>
                      </article>
                    </section>

                    <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
                      {
                        [
                          [
                            "Project",
                            diff.summary
                              .project,
                          ],

                          [
                            "Assumptions",
                            diff.summary
                              .assumptions,
                          ],

                          [
                            "Scenarios",
                            diff.summary
                              .scenarios,
                          ],

                          [
                            "Financing",
                            diff.summary
                              .financing,
                          ],

                          [
                            "Overrides",
                            diff.summary
                              .overrides,
                          ],

                          [
                            "Other",
                            diff.summary
                              .other,
                          ],
                        ].map(
                          (
                            [
                              label,
                              value,
                            ],
                          ) => (
                            <article
                              key={
                                String(
                                  label,
                                )
                              }
                              className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-4"
                            >
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                {
                                  label
                                }
                              </p>

                              <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold">
                                {
                                  value
                                }
                              </p>
                            </article>
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                    </section>

                    <section className="rounded-xl border bg-background p-5">
                      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:max-w-2xl">
                        <label className="space-y-2">
                          <span className="text-xs font-medium">
                            Category
                          </span>

                          <select
                            value={
                              category
                            }
                            onChange={(
                              event,
                            ) => {
                              setCategory(
                                event.target.value as
                                  ModelChangeCategory |
                                  "ALL",
                              );
                            }}
                            className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                          >
                            {
                              CATEGORIES.map(
                                (
                                  value,
                                ) => (
                                  <option
                                    key={
                                      value
                                    }
                                    value={
                                      value
                                    }
                                  >
                                    {
                                      value
                                    }
                                  </option>
                                ),
                              )
                            }
                          </select>
                        </label>

                        <label className="space-y-2">
                          <span className="text-xs font-medium">
                            Materiality
                          </span>

                          <select
                            value={
                              materiality
                            }
                            onChange={(
                              event,
                            ) => {
                              setMateriality(
                                event.target.value as
                                  ModelChangeMateriality |
                                  "ALL",
                              );
                            }}
                            className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
                          >
                            {
                              MATERIALITIES.map(
                                (
                                  value,
                                ) => (
                                  <option
                                    key={
                                      value
                                    }
                                    value={
                                      value
                                    }
                                  >
                                    {
                                      value
                                    }
                                  </option>
                                ),
                              )
                            }
                          </select>
                        </label>
                      </div>
                    </section>

                    <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background">
                      <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 border-b p-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                        <div>
                          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">
                            Model change register
                          </h2>

                          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Recursive comparison of immutable revision snapshots.
                          </p>
                        </div>

                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {
                            filteredChanges.length
                          } shown
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      {
                        filteredChanges.length ===
                        0
                          ?
                            (
                              <div className="p-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                No changes match the selected filters.
                              </div>
                            )
                          :
                            (
                              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                <table className="w-full min-w-[1200px] text-sm">
                                  <thead>
                                    <tr className="border-b bg-muted/30">
                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                        Materiality
                                      </th>

                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                        Category
                                      </th>

                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                        Change
                                      </th>

                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                        Model path
                                      </th>

                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                        Before
                                      </th>

                                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                                        After
                                      </th>
                                    </tr>
                                  </thead>

                                  <tbody>
                                    {
                                      filteredChanges.map(
                                        (
                                          change,
                                          index,
                                        ) => (
                                          <tr
                                            key={`${change.path}-${change.kind}-${index}`}
                                            className="border-b align-top last:border-0"
                                          >
                                            <td className={`px-4 py-3 font-semibold ${materialityTone(
                                              change.materiality,
                                            )}`}>
                                              {
                                                change.materiality
                                              }
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                              {
                                                change.category
                                              }
                                            </td>

                                            <td className={`px-4 py-3 font-medium ${kindTone(
                                              change.kind,
                                            )}`}>
                                              {
                                                change.kind
                                              }
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="max-w-md px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs">
                                              {
                                                change.path
                                              }
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="max-w-sm px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                              {
                                                summarizeJsonValue(
                                                  change.before,
                                                )
                                              }
                                            </td>

                                            <td className="max-w-sm px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs">
                                              {
                                                summarizeJsonValue(
                                                  change.after,
                                                )
                                              }
                                            </td>
                                          </tr>
                                        ),
                                      )
                                    }
                                  </tbody>
                                </table>
                              </div>
                            )
                      }
                    </section>
                  </>
                )
              :
                null
      }

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/20 p-5">
        <h2 className="font-semibold">
          Governance interpretation
        </h2>

        <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">
          Model Diff compares immutable model inputs and configuration. It does not restore either revision, modify the live model, or estimate financial impact by inventing a second forecast engine. High materiality identifies changes to major planning authorities such as assumptions, financing, overrides, or structural project settings.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

type RequestErrorContext = {
  path?:
    string;

  method?:
    string;
};


export function onRequestError(
  error:
    unknown,
  request:
    RequestErrorContext,
) {
  logStructured(
    "error",
    "runtime.request.error",
    {
      path:
        request?.path ??
        "unknown",

      method:
        request?.method ??
        "unknown",

      errorName:
        error instanceof Error
          ?
            error.name
          :
            "UnknownError",
    },
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/approvals/service.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";

import {
  approvalStatusFromDecision,
  assertApprovalPending,
  parseApprovalRequestStatus,
} from "@/lib/approvals/validation";

import type {
  ApprovalDecision,
  ApprovalRequestType,
} from "@/lib/approvals/types";


const MAX_APPROVAL_REQUESTS_PER_PROJECT =
  500;


const MAX_PENDING_REQUESTS_PER_PROJECT =
  100;


export async function createApprovalRequest({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  requestType,
  subjectType,
  subjectId,
  title,
  description,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  requestType:
    ApprovalRequestType;

  subjectType:
    string |
    null;

  subjectId:
    string |
    null;

  title:
    string;

  description:
    string |
    null;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const [
          total,
          pending,
        ] =
          await Promise.all([
            transaction.approvalRequest.count({
              where: {
                projectId,
              },
            }),

            transaction.approvalRequest.count({
              where: {
                projectId,

                status:
                  "PENDING",
              },
            }),
          ]);


        if (
          total >=
          MAX_APPROVAL_REQUESTS_PER_PROJECT
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `A project may contain at most ${MAX_APPROVAL_REQUESTS_PER_PROJECT} approval requests.`,
          );
        }


        if (
          pending >=
          MAX_PENDING_REQUESTS_PER_PROJECT
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `A project may contain at most ${MAX_PENDING_REQUESTS_PER_PROJECT} pending approval requests.`,
          );
        }


        const created =
          await transaction.approvalRequest.create({
            data: {
              projectId,

              requestType,

              subjectType,

              subjectId,

              title,

              description,

              requestedByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              title:
                true,

              requestType:
                true,

              status:
                true,

              requestedAt:
                true,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "PROJECT",

            action:
              "APPROVAL_REQUEST_CREATED",

            severity:
              "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "ApprovalRequest",

            entityId:
              created.id,

            summary:
              `Approval requested: ${created.title}`,

            metadata: {
              requestType,

              status:
                created.status,

              subjectType,

              subjectId,
            },
          },
        });


        return created;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.approval-request.created",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      approvalRequestId:
        result.id,

      requestType:
        result.requestType,
    },
  );


  return result;
}


export async function decideApprovalRequest({
  projectId,
  requestId,
  actorUserId,
  decision,
  decisionNote,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  requestId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  decision:
    ApprovalDecision;

  decisionNote:
    string;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const existing =
          await transaction.approvalRequest.findFirst({
            where: {
              id:
                requestId,

              projectId,
            },
          });


        if (
          !existing
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Approval request was not found in this project.",
          );
        }


        const currentStatus =
          parseApprovalRequestStatus(
            existing.status,
          );


        assertApprovalPending(
          currentStatus,
        );


        if (
          existing.requestedByUserId ===
          actorUserId
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Requester and approver must be different users.",
          );
        }


        const status =
          approvalStatusFromDecision(
            decision,
          );


        const now =
          new Date();


        const updated =
          await transaction.approvalRequest.update({
            where: {
              id:
                existing.id,
            },

            data: {
              status,

              decidedByUserId:
                actorUserId,

              decidedAt:
                now,

              decisionNote,

              cancelledAt:
                null,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              title:
                true,

              requestType:
                true,

              status:
                true,

              decidedAt:
                true,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "PROJECT",

            action:
              status ===
                "APPROVED"
                ?
                  "APPROVAL_REQUEST_APPROVED"
                :
                  "APPROVAL_REQUEST_REJECTED",

            severity:
              status ===
                "REJECTED"
                ?
                  "WARNING"
                :
                  "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "ApprovalRequest",

            entityId:
              updated.id,

            summary:
              `${status === "APPROVED" ? "Approval granted" : "Approval rejected"}: ${updated.title}`,

            metadata: {
              requestType:
                updated.requestType,

              previousStatus:
                currentStatus,

              status,

              decisionNote,
            },
          },
        });


        return updated;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.approval-request.decided",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      approvalRequestId:
        result.id,

      status:
        result.status,
    },
  );


  return result;
}


export async function cancelApprovalRequest({
  projectId,
  requestId,
  actorUserId,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  requestId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const existing =
          await transaction.approvalRequest.findFirst({
            where: {
              id:
                requestId,

              projectId,
            },
          });


        if (
          !existing
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Approval request was not found in this project.",
          );
        }


        const currentStatus =
          parseApprovalRequestStatus(
            existing.status,
          );


        assertApprovalPending(
          currentStatus,
        );


        if (
          existing.requestedByUserId !==
          actorUserId
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Only the requester may cancel a pending approval request.",
          );
        }


        const now =
          new Date();


        const updated =
          await transaction.approvalRequest.update({
            where: {
              id:
                existing.id,
            },

            data: {
              status:
                "CANCELLED",

              cancelledAt:
                now,

              decidedAt:
                null,

              decidedByUserId:
                null,

              decisionNote:
                null,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              title:
                true,

              requestType:
                true,

              status:
                true,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "PROJECT",

            action:
              "APPROVAL_REQUEST_CANCELLED",

            severity:
              "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "ApprovalRequest",

            entityId:
              updated.id,

            summary:
              `Approval request cancelled: ${updated.title}`,

            metadata: {
              requestType:
                updated.requestType,

              previousStatus:
                currentStatus,

              status:
                "CANCELLED",
            },
          },
        });


        return updated;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.approval-request.cancelled",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      approvalRequestId:
        result.id,
    },
  );


  return result;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/approvals/validation.ts #####
import {
  APPROVAL_DECISIONS,
  APPROVAL_REQUEST_STATUSES,
  APPROVAL_REQUEST_TYPES,
  type ApprovalDecision,
  type ApprovalRequestStatus,
  type ApprovalRequestType,
} from "@/lib/approvals/types";


export function parseApprovalRequestType(
  value:
    string,
): ApprovalRequestType {
  if (
    APPROVAL_REQUEST_TYPES.includes(
      value as
        ApprovalRequestType,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      ApprovalRequestType;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid approval request type.",
  );
}


export function parseApprovalRequestStatus(
  value:
    string,
): ApprovalRequestStatus {
  if (
    APPROVAL_REQUEST_STATUSES.includes(
      value as
        ApprovalRequestStatus,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      ApprovalRequestStatus;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid approval request status.",
  );
}


export function parseApprovalDecision(
  value:
    string,
): ApprovalDecision {
  if (
    APPROVAL_DECISIONS.includes(
      value as
        ApprovalDecision,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      ApprovalDecision;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid approval decision.",
  );
}


export function approvalStatusFromDecision(
  decision:
    ApprovalDecision,
): Extract<
  ApprovalRequestStatus,
  "APPROVED" |
  "REJECTED"
> {
  return decision ===
    "APPROVE"
    ?
      "APPROVED"
    :
      "REJECTED";
}


export function assertApprovalPending(
  status:
    ApprovalRequestStatus,
) {
  if (
    status !==
    "PENDING"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Only pending approval requests may transition.",
    );
  }
}


export function parseApprovalSubjectValue(
  value:
    string,
  label:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  const normalized =
    value.trim();


  if (
    !normalized
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  if (
    normalized.length >
    120
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${label} cannot exceed 120 characters.`,
    );
  }


  if (
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9:_\-. /]+$/u.test(
      normalized,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${label} contains unsupported characters.`,
    );
  }


  return normalized;
}

export function parseProjectAuditSeverity(
  value:
    string,
): ProjectAuditSeverity {
  if (
    PROJECT_AUDIT_SEVERITIES.includes(
      value as

    )
  ) {
    return value as
      ProjectAuditSeverity;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid project audit severity.",
  );
}


export function sanitizeAuditAction(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();


  if (
    !/^[A-Z0-9_]{3,100}$/u.test(
      normalized,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Audit action must contain only uppercase letters, digits, and underscores.",
    );
  }


  return normalized;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/audit/metadata.ts #####
import type {
  ProjectAuditMetadata,
} from "@/lib/audit/types";


function isRecord(
  value:
    unknown,
): value is
  Record<
    string,
    unknown
  > {
  return (
    typeof value ===
      "object" &&
    value !==
      null &&
    !Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  );
}


export function parseProjectAuditMetadata(
  value:
    unknown,
): ProjectAuditMetadata |
  null {
  if (
    value ===
    null ||
    value ===
    undefined
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  if (
    !isRecord(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const entries =
    Object.entries(
      value,
    ).flatMap(
      (
        [
          key,
          child,
        ],
      ) => {
        if (
          child ===
            null ||
          typeof child ===
            "string" ||
          typeof child ===
            "number" ||
          typeof child ===
            "boolean"
        ) {
          return [
            [
              key,
              child,
            ] as const,
          ];
        }


        return [];
      },
    );


  return Object.fromEntries(
    entries,
  );
}


export function summarizeProjectAuditMetadata(
  metadata:
    ProjectAuditMetadata |
    null,
): string {
  if (
    !metadata
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  const entries =
    Object.entries(
      metadata,
    );


  if (
    entries.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return "—";
  }


  return entries
    .slice(
      0,
      8,
    )
    .map(
      (
        [
          key,
          value,
        ],
      ) =>
        `${key}=${String(
          value,
        )}`,
    )
    .join(
      " · ",
    );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/auth/current-user.ts #####
import {
  redirect,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  auth,
} from "@/auth";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";


export type CurrentUserIdentity = {
  id:
    string;

  email:
    string;
};


export async function requireCurrentUserIdentity(): Promise<
  CurrentUserIdentity
> {
  const session =
    await auth();


  const directId =
    (
      session?.user as
        | {
            id?:
              string;
          }
        | undefined
    )?.id;


  const email =
    session?.user
      ?.email
      ?.trim()
      .toLowerCase();


  if (
    directId &&
    email
  ) {
    return {
      id:
        directId,

      email,
    };
  }


  if (
    !email
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/login",
    );
  }


  const user =
    await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: {
        email,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,

        email:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !user
  ) {
    redirect(
      "/login",
    );
  }


  return {
    id:
      user.id,

    email:
      user.email
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase(),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/auth/password-policy.ts #####
export const PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH =
  12;

export const PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH =
  128;


export type PasswordPolicyResult =
  |
    {
      valid:
        true;

      issues:
        [];
    }
  |
    {
      valid:
        false;

      issues:
        string[];
    };


export function validatePasswordPolicy(
  password:
    string,
): PasswordPolicyResult {
  const issues:
    string[] =
      [];


  if (
    password.length <
    PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH
  ) {
    issues.push(
      `Use at least ${PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH} characters.`,
    );
  }


  if (
    password.length >
    PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH
  ) {
    issues.push(
      `Use no more than ${PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH} characters.`,
    );
  }


  if (
    !/[a-z]/.test(
      password,
    )
  ) {
    issues.push(
      "Include a lowercase letter.",
    );
  }


  if (
    !/[A-Z]/.test(
      password,
    )
  ) {
    issues.push(
      "Include an uppercase letter.",
    );
  }


  if (
    !/[0-9]/.test(
      password,
    )
  ) {
    issues.push(
      "Include a number.",
    );
  }


  if (
    !/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(
      password,
    )
  ) {
    issues.push(
      "Include a symbol.",
    );
  }


  if (
    /(.)\1{3,}/.test(
      password,
    )
  ) {
    issues.push(
      "Avoid long repeated-character sequences.",
    );
  }


  if (
    issues.length >
    0
  ) {
    return {
      valid:
        false,

      issues,
    };
  }


  return {
    valid:
      true,

    issues:
      [],
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/auth/session-security.ts #####
import type {
  Session,
  User,
} from "next-auth";

import type {
  JWT,
} from "next-auth/jwt";


type SecurityJwt =
  JWT & {
    authVersion?:
      number;
  };


export function isAuthVersionValid(
  tokenVersion:
    unknown,
  currentVersion:
    number,
): boolean {
  return (
    typeof tokenVersion ===
      "number" &&
    Number.isInteger(
      tokenVersion,
    ) &&
    tokenVersion ===
      currentVersion
  );
}


async function currentAuthVersion(
  userId:
    string,
): Promise<
  number |
  null
> {
  const {
    prisma,
  } =
    await import(
      "@/lib/db/prisma"
    );


  const user =
    await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          userId,
      },

      select: {
        authVersion:
          true,
      },
    });


  return (
    user?.authVersion ??
    null
  );
}


export async function enforceJwtSessionSecurity(
  token:
    JWT,
  user?:
    User,
): Promise<
  JWT |
  null
> {
  const userId =
    user?.id ??
    token.sub;


  if (
    !userId
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const version =
    await currentAuthVersion(
      userId,
    );


  if (
    version ===
    null
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  if (
    user
  ) {
    return {
      ...token,

      authVersion:
        version,
    } as SecurityJwt;
  }


  const secured =
    token as
      SecurityJwt;


  if (
    !isAuthVersionValid(
      secured.authVersion,
      version,
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return secured;
}


export function enforceSessionSecurity(
  session:
    Session,
  token:
    JWT,
): Session {
  if (
    session.user &&
    token.sub
  ) {
    (
      session.user as
        typeof session.user & {
          id:
            string;
        }
    ).id =
      token.sub;
  }


  return session;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/data-import/csv.ts #####
export function parseCsvMatrix(
  input:
    string,
): string[][] {
  const normalized =
    input
      .replace(
        /^\uFEFF/u,
        "",
      )
      .replaceAll(
        "\r\n",
        "\n",
      )
      .replaceAll(
        "\r",
        "\n",
      );


  const rows:
    string[][] =
      [];


  let currentRow:
    string[] =
      [];


  let current =
    "";


  let quoted =
    false;


  for (
    let index =
      0;
    index <
    normalized.length;
    index +=
      1
  ) {
    const character =
      normalized[
        index
      ];


    if (
      quoted
    ) {
      if (
        character ===
        '"'
      ) {
        if (
          normalized[
            index +
            1
          ] ===
          '"'
        ) {
          current +=
            '"';

          index +=
            1;
        }
        else {
          quoted =
            false;
        }
      }
      else {
        current +=
          character;
      }


      continue;
    }


    if (
      character ===
      '"'
    ) {
      quoted =
        true;

      continue;
    }


    if (
      character ===
      ","
    ) {
      currentRow.push(
        current.trim(),
      );

      current =
        "";

      continue;
    }


    if (
      character ===
      "\n"
    ) {
      currentRow.push(
        current.trim(),
      );

      current =
        "";


      if (
        currentRow.some(
          (
            value,
          ) =>
            value !==
            "",
        )
      ) {
        rows.push(
          currentRow,
        );
      }


      currentRow =
        [];

      continue;
    }


    current +=
      character;
  }


  if (
    quoted
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "CSV contains an unterminated quoted field.",
    );
  }


  currentRow.push(
    current.trim(),
  );


  if (
    currentRow.some(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value !==
        "",
    )
  ) {
    rows.push(
      currentRow,
    );
  }


  return rows;
}


export function csvRecords(
  input:
    string,
): {
  headers:
    string[];

  records:
    Record<
      string,
      string
    >[];
} {
  const matrix =
    parseCsvMatrix(
      input,
    );


  if (
    matrix.length ===
    0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "CSV is empty.",
    );
  }


  const headers =
    matrix[
      0
    ].map(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value.trim(),
    );


  if (
    headers.some(
      (
        header,
      ) =>
        !header,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "CSV contains an empty header.",
    );
  }


  if (
    new Set(
      headers,
    ).size !==
    headers.length
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "CSV contains duplicate headers.",
    );
  }


  const records =
    matrix
      .slice(
        1,
      )
      .map(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          Object.fromEntries(
            headers.map(
              (
                header,
                index,
              ) => [
                header,
                row[
                  index
                ] ??
                "",
              ],
            ),
          ),
      );


  return {
    headers,

    records,
  };
}

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  financialPeriodDate,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/validation";

import {
  validateDataImportCsv,
} from "@/lib/data-import/validation";

import type {
  DataImportIssue,
  DataImportType,
  NormalizedActualImportRow,
  NormalizedKpiImportRow,
  NormalizedVarianceImportRow,

function failureText(
  cause:
    unknown,
): string {
  return cause instanceof Error
    ?
      cause.message.slice(
        0,
        500,
      )
    :
      "Data import failed.";
}


function rejectedRows(
  issues:
    DataImportIssue[],
): number {
  return new Set(
    issues.map(
      (
        issue,
      ) =>
        issue.row,
    ),
  ).size;
}


export async function applyGovernedDataImport({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  importType,
  fileName,
  csv,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  importType:
    DataImportType;

  fileName:
    string;

  csv:
    string;
}) {
  const validation =
    validateDataImportCsv({
      importType,

      csv,
    });


  const batch =
    await prisma.dataImportBatch.create({
      data: {
        projectId,

        importType,

        fileName,

        status:
          "PROCESSING",

        rowCount:
          validation.rowCount,

        createdByUserId:
          actorUserId,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    validation.issues.length >
    0
  ) {
    const rejected =
      rejectedRows(
        validation.issues,
      );


    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        await transaction.dataImportBatch.update({
          where: {
            id:
              batch.id,
          },

          data: {
            status:
              "FAILED",

            rejectedCount:
              rejected,

            completedAt:
              new Date(),

            errorSummary: {
              message:
                "CSV validation failed.",

              issues:
                validation.issues.slice(
                  0,
                  50,
                ),
            } as never,
          },
        });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "PROJECT",

            action:
              "DATA_IMPORT_VALIDATION_FAILED",

            severity:
              "WARNING",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "DataImportBatch",

            entityId:
              batch.id,

            summary:
              `Data import validation failed: ${fileName}`,

            metadata: {
              importType,

              rowCount:
                validation.rowCount,

              rejectedCount:
                rejected,
            },
          },
        });
      },
    );


    throw new Error(
      `Import contains ${validation.issues.length} validation issue${
        validation.issues.length ===
          1
          ?
            ""
          :
            "s"
      }.`,
    );
  }


  try {
    const result =
      await prisma.$transaction(
        async (
          transaction,
        ) => {
          let inserted =
            0;

          let updated =
            0;


          if (
            importType ===
            "ACTUALS"
          ) {
            const rows =
              validation.rows.filter(
                (
                  row,
                ): row is
                  NormalizedActualImportRow =>
                    row.kind ===
                    "ACTUALS",
              );


            for (
              const row
              of rows
            ) {
              const period =
                financialPeriodDate(
                  row.periodKey,
                );


              const existing =
                await transaction.actualPeriod.findFirst({
                  where: {
                    projectId,

                    period,
                  },

                  select: {
                    id:
                      true,
                  },
                });


              const data = {
                revenue:
                  row.revenue,

                cogs:
                  row.cogs,

                operatingExpenses:
                  row.operatingExpenses,

                ebitda:
                  row.ebitda,

                netIncome:
                  row.netIncome,

                cashFlow:
                  row.cashFlow,

                cashBalance:
                  row.cashBalance,

                mrr:
                  row.mrr,

                customers:
                  row.customers,
              };


              if (
                existing
              ) {
                await transaction.actualPeriod.update({
                  where: {
                    id:
                      existing.id,
                  },

                  data,
                });


                updated +=
                  1;
              }
              else {
                await transaction.actualPeriod.create({
                  data: {
                    projectId,

                    period,

                    ...data,
                  },
                });


                inserted +=
                  1;
              }
            }
          }


          if (
            importType ===
            "KPI_TARGETS"
          ) {
            const rows =
              validation.rows.filter(
                (
                  row,
                ): row is
                  NormalizedKpiImportRow =>
                    row.kind ===
                    "KPI_TARGETS",
              );


            for (
              const row
              of rows
            ) {
              const existing =
                await transaction.projectKpiTarget.findUnique({
                  where: {
                    projectId_periodKey_metricCode: {
                      projectId,

                      periodKey:
                        row.periodKey,

                      metricCode:
                        row.metricCode,
                    },
                  },

                  select: {
                    id:
                      true,
                  },
                });


              if (
                existing
              ) {
                await transaction.projectKpiTarget.update({
                  where: {
                    id:
                      existing.id,
                  },

                  data: {
                    targetValue:
                      row.targetValue,

                    ownerName:
                      row.ownerName,

                    note:
                      row.note,
                  },
                });


                updated +=
                  1;
              }
              else {
                await transaction.projectKpiTarget.create({
                  data: {
                    projectId,

                    periodKey:
                      row.periodKey,

                    metricCode:
                      row.metricCode,

                    targetValue:
                      row.targetValue,

                    ownerName:
                      row.ownerName,

                    note:
                      row.note,

                    createdByUserId:
                      actorUserId,
                  },
                });


                inserted +=
                  1;
              }
            }
          }


          if (
            importType ===
            "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY"
          ) {
            const rows =
              validation.rows.filter(
                (
                  row,
                ): row is
                  NormalizedVarianceImportRow =>
                    row.kind ===
                    "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY",
              );


            for (
              const row
              of rows
            ) {
              const existing =
                await transaction.varianceCommentary.findUnique({
                  where: {
                    projectId_periodKey_metricCode: {
                      projectId,

                      periodKey:
                        row.periodKey,

                      metricCode:
                        row.metricCode,
                    },
                  },

                  select: {
                    id:
                      true,
                  },
                });


              const data = {
                causeCode:
                  row.causeCode,

                varianceNature:
                  row.varianceNature,

                explanation:
                  row.explanation,

                correctiveAction:
                  row.correctiveAction,

                ownerName:
                  row.ownerName,

                recoveryPeriodKey:
                  row.recoveryPeriodKey,

                status:
                  row.status,
              };


              if (
                existing
              ) {
                await transaction.varianceCommentary.update({
                  where: {
                    id:
                      existing.id,
                  },

                  data,
                });


                updated +=
                  1;
              }
              else {
                await transaction.varianceCommentary.create({
                  data: {
                    projectId,

                    periodKey:
                      row.periodKey,

                    metricCode:
                      row.metricCode,

                    ...data,

                    createdByUserId:
                      actorUserId,
                  },
                });


                inserted +=
                  1;
              }
            }
          }


          await transaction.dataImportBatch.update({
            where: {
              id:
                batch.id,
            },

            data: {
              status:
                "SUCCEEDED",

              insertedCount:
                inserted,

              updatedCount:
                updated,

              rejectedCount:
                0,

              completedAt:
                new Date(),
            },
          });


          await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
            data: {
              projectId,

              category:
                "PROJECT",

              action:
                "DATA_IMPORT_APPLIED",

              severity:
                "INFO",

              actorUserId,

              entityType:
                "DataImportBatch",

              entityId:
                batch.id,

              summary:
                `Data import applied: ${fileName}`,

              metadata: {
                importType,

                rowCount:
                  validation.rowCount,

                insertedCount:
                  inserted,

                updatedCount:
                  updated,
              },
            },
          });


          return {
            inserted,

            updated,
          };
        },
      );


    return {
      batchId:
        batch.id,

      rowCount:
        validation.rowCount,

      insertedCount:
        result.inserted,

      updatedCount:
        result.updated,
    };
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    const message =
      failureText(
        cause,
      );


    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        await transaction.dataImportBatch.update({
          where: {
            id:
              batch.id,
          },

          data: {
            status:
              "FAILED",

            rejectedCount:
              validation.rowCount,

            completedAt:
              new Date(),

            errorSummary: {
              message,
            } as never,
          },
        });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "PROJECT",

            action:
              "DATA_IMPORT_FAILED",

            severity:
              "WARNING",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "DataImportBatch",

            entityId:
              batch.id,

            summary:
              `Data import failed: ${fileName}`,

            metadata: {
              importType,

              rowCount:
                validation.rowCount,

              message,
            },
          },
        });
      },
    );


    throw new Error(
      message,
    );
  }
}

function optional(
  value:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  const normalized =
    value.trim();


  return normalized
    ?
      normalized
    :
      null;
}


function numberOrNull(
  value:
    string,
  field:
    string,
): number |
  null {
  const normalized =
    value.trim();


  if (
    !normalized
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const parsed =
    Number(
      normalized,
    );


  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      parsed,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${field} must be a valid number.`,
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


function customersOrNull(
  value:
    string,
): number |
  null {
  const parsed =
    numberOrNull(
      value,
      "customers",
    );


  if (
    parsed ===
    null
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      parsed,
    ) ||
    parsed <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "customers must be a non-negative whole number.",
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


function pushIssue(
  issues:
    DataImportIssue[],
  row:
    number,
  field:
    string,
  cause:
    unknown,
) {
  issues.push({
    row,

    field,

    message:
      cause instanceof Error
        ?
          cause.message
        :
          "Invalid value.",
  });
}


function validateActualRow({
  record,
  rowNumber,
  issues,
}: {
  record:
    Record<
      string,
      string
    >;

  rowNumber:
    number;

  issues:
    DataImportIssue[];
}): NormalizedActualImportRow |
  null {
  const before =
    issues.length;


  const periodKey =
    parseMonthKey(
      record.period ??
      "",
    );


  if (
    !periodKey
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "period",
      new Error(
        "period must be a valid month.",
      ),
    );
  }


  const readNumber = (
    field:
      string,
  ) => {
    try {
      return numberOrNull(
        record[
          field
        ] ??
        "",
        field,
      );
    }
    catch (
      cause
    ) {
      pushIssue(
        issues,
        rowNumber,
        field,
        cause,
      );

      return null;
    }
  };


  const revenue =
    readNumber(
      "revenue",
    );

  const cogs =
    readNumber(
      "cogs",
    );

  const operatingExpenses =
    readNumber(
      "operatingExpenses",
    );

  const ebitda =
    readNumber(
      "ebitda",
    );

  const netIncome =
    readNumber(
      "netIncome",
    );

  const cashFlow =
    readNumber(
      "cashFlow",
    );

  const cashBalance =
    readNumber(
      "cashBalance",
    );

  const mrr =
    readNumber(
      "mrr",
    );


  let customers:
    number |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    customers =
      customersOrNull(
        record.customers ??
        "",
      );
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "customers",
      cause,
    );
  }


  if (
    issues.length !==
    before ||
    !periodKey
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return {
    kind:
      "ACTUALS",

    rowNumber,

    periodKey,

    revenue,

    cogs,

    operatingExpenses,

    ebitda,

    netIncome,

    cashFlow,

    cashBalance,

    mrr,

    customers,
  };
}


function validateKpiRow({
  record,
  rowNumber,
  issues,
}: {
  record:
    Record<
      string,
      string
    >;

  rowNumber:
    number;

  issues:
    DataImportIssue[];
}): NormalizedKpiImportRow |
  null {
  const before =
    issues.length;


  const periodKey =
    parseMonthKey(
      record.periodKey ??
      "",
    );


  if (
    !periodKey
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "periodKey",
      new Error(
        "periodKey must be a valid month.",
      ),
    );
  }


  let metricCode:
    NormalizedKpiImportRow[
      "metricCode"
    ] |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    metricCode =
      parseKpiMetricCode(
        record.metricCode ??
        "",
      );
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "metricCode",
      cause,
    );
  }


  let targetValue:
    number |
    null =
      null;


  if (
    metricCode
  ) {
    try {
      targetValue =
        parseKpiTargetValue(
          metricCode,
          record.targetValue ??
          "",
        );
    }
    catch (
      cause
    ) {
      pushIssue(
        issues,
        rowNumber,
        "targetValue",
        cause,
      );
    }
  }


  const ownerName =
    optional(
      record.ownerName ??
      "",
    );


  const note =
    optional(
      record.note ??
      "",
    );


  if (
    ownerName &&
    ownerName.length >
    80
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "ownerName",
      new Error(
        "ownerName cannot exceed 80 characters.",
      ),
    );
  }


  if (
    note &&
    note.length >
    1000
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "note",
      new Error(
        "note cannot exceed 1000 characters.",
      ),
    );
  }


  if (
    issues.length !==
      before ||
    !periodKey ||
    !metricCode ||
    targetValue ===
      null
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return {
    kind:
      "KPI_TARGETS",

    rowNumber,

    periodKey,

    metricCode,

    targetValue,

    ownerName,

    note,
  };
}


function validateVarianceRow({
  record,
  rowNumber,
  issues,
}: {
  record:
    Record<
      string,
      string
    >;

  rowNumber:
    number;

  issues:
    DataImportIssue[];
}): NormalizedVarianceImportRow |
  null {
  const before =
    issues.length;


  let periodKey:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  let metricCode:
    NormalizedVarianceImportRow[
      "metricCode"
    ] |
    null =
      null;


  let causeCode:
    NormalizedVarianceImportRow[
      "causeCode"
    ] |
    null =
      null;


  let varianceNature:
    NormalizedVarianceImportRow[
      "varianceNature"
    ] |
    null =
      null;


  let status:
    NormalizedVarianceImportRow[
      "status"
    ] |
    null =
      null;


  let recoveryPeriodKey:
    string |
    null =
      null;


  try {
    periodKey =
      parseVariancePeriod(
        record.periodKey ??
        "",
      );
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "periodKey",
      cause,
    );
  }


  try {
    metricCode =
      parseVarianceMetricCode(
        record.metricCode ??
        "",
      );
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "metricCode",
      cause,
    );
  }


  try {
    causeCode =
      parseVarianceCauseCode(
        record.causeCode ??
        "",
      );
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "causeCode",
      cause,
    );
  }


  try {
    varianceNature =
      parseVarianceNature(
        record.varianceNature ??
        "",
      );
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "varianceNature",
      cause,
    );
  }


  try {
    status =
      parseVarianceCommentaryStatus(
        record.status ??
        "",
      );
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "status",
      cause,
    );
  }


  try {
    recoveryPeriodKey =
      parseRecoveryPeriod(
        record.recoveryPeriodKey ??
        "",
      );
  }
  catch (
    cause
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "recoveryPeriodKey",
      cause,
    );
  }


  const explanation =
    (
      record.explanation ??
      ""
    ).trim();


  if (
    explanation.length <
      5 ||
    explanation.length >
      2000
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "explanation",
      new Error(
        "explanation must contain between 5 and 2000 characters.",
      ),
    );
  }


  const correctiveAction =
    optional(
      record.correctiveAction ??
      "",
    );


  const ownerName =
    optional(
      record.ownerName ??
      "",
    );


  if (
    correctiveAction &&
    correctiveAction.length >
    2000
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "correctiveAction",
      new Error(
        "correctiveAction cannot exceed 2000 characters.",
      ),
    );
  }


  if (
    ownerName &&
    ownerName.length >
    80
  ) {
    pushIssue(
      issues,
      rowNumber,
      "ownerName",
      new Error(
        "ownerName cannot exceed 80 characters.",
      ),
    );
  }


  if (
    issues.length !==
      before ||
    !periodKey ||
    !metricCode ||
    !causeCode ||
    !varianceNature ||
    !status
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return {
    kind:
      "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY",

    rowNumber,

    periodKey,

    metricCode,

    causeCode,

    varianceNature,

    explanation,

    correctiveAction,

    ownerName,

    recoveryPeriodKey,

    status,
  };
}


export function validateDataImportCsv({
  importType,
  csv,
}: {
  importType:
    DataImportType;

  csv:
    string;
}): DataImportValidationResult {
  if (
    new TextEncoder()
      .encode(
        csv,
      )
      .byteLength >
    DATA_IMPORT_MAX_BYTES
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "CSV cannot exceed 512KB.",
    );
  }


  const {
    headers,
    records,
  } =
    csvRecords(
      csv,
    );


  const missing =
    REQUIRED_HEADERS[
      importType
    ].filter(
      (
        header,
      ) =>
        !headers.includes(
          header,
        ),
    );


  if (
    missing.length >
    0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Missing required CSV headers: ${missing.join(
        ", ",
      )}.`,
    );
  }


  if (
    records.length >
    DATA_IMPORT_MAX_ROWS[
      importType
    ]
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${importType} import may contain at most ${DATA_IMPORT_MAX_ROWS[
        importType
      ]} rows.`,
    );
  }


  const issues:
    DataImportIssue[] =
      [];


  const rows:
    NormalizedDataImportRow[] =
      [];


  records.forEach(
    (
      record,
      index,
    ) => {
      const rowNumber =
        index +
        2;


      const row =
        importType ===
          "ACTUALS"
          ?
            validateActualRow({
              record,

              rowNumber,

              issues,
            })
          :
        importType ===
          "KPI_TARGETS"
          ?
            validateKpiRow({
              record,

              rowNumber,

              issues,
            })
          :
            validateVarianceRow({
              record,

              rowNumber,

              issues,
            });


      if (
        row
      ) {
        rows.push(
          row,
        );
      }
    },
  );


  const duplicateKeys =
    new Set<
      string
    >();


  const seen =
    new Set<
      string
    >();


  for (
    const row
    of rows
  ) {
    const key =
      row.kind ===
        "ACTUALS"
        ?
          row.periodKey
        :
          `${row.periodKey}:${row.metricCode}`;


    if (
      seen.has(
        key,
      )
    ) {
      duplicateKeys.add(
        key,
      );

      issues.push({
        row:
          row.rowNumber,

        field:
          "duplicate",

        message:
          `Duplicate import key: ${key}.`,
      });
    }


    seen.add(
      key,
    );
  }


  return {
    importType,

    headers,

    rowCount:
      records.length,

    issues,

    rows:
      duplicateKeys.size >
        0
        ?
          []
        :
          rows,

    preview:
      records.slice(
        0,
        8,
      ),
  };
}

import {
  PrismaPg,
} from "@prisma/adapter-pg";

import {
  PrismaClient,
} from "@/generated/prisma/client";
import {
  getServerEnvironment,
} from "@/lib/env/server";

const globalForPrisma =
  globalThis as unknown as {
    venturescopePrisma?:
      PrismaClient;
  };

function createPrismaClient() {
  const environment =
    getServerEnvironment();

  const adapter =
    new PrismaPg({
      connectionString:
        environment.DATABASE_URL,
    });

  return new PrismaClient({
    adapter,
  });
}

  globalForPrisma
    .venturescopePrisma ??
  createPrismaClient();

if (
  process.env.NODE_ENV !==
  "production"
) {
  globalForPrisma.venturescopePrisma =
    prisma;
}
