##### FILE: ./lib/env/server.ts #####
import {
  z,
} from "zod";

const serverEnvironmentSchema =
  z.object({
    NODE_ENV:
      z
        .enum([
          "development",
          "test",
          "production",
        ])
        .default(
          "development",
        ),

    DATABASE_URL:
      z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(
          1,
          "DATABASE_URL is required.",
        )
        .refine(
          (
            value,
          ) =>
            value.startsWith(
              "postgresql://",
            ) ||
            value.startsWith(
              "postgres://",
            ),
          "DATABASE_URL must be a PostgreSQL connection string.",
        ),

    AUTH_SECRET:
      z
        .string()
        .min(
          32,
          "AUTH_SECRET must contain at least 32 characters.",
        ),

    AUTH_URL:
      z
        .string()
        .url(
          "AUTH_URL must be an absolute URL.",
        )
        .optional(),

    TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS:
      z
        .enum([
          "true",
          "false",
        ])
        .optional()
        .default(
          "false",
        ),

    APP_VERSION:
      z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(
          1,
        )
        .optional(),
  });

export type ServerEnvironment =
  z.infer<
    typeof serverEnvironmentSchema
  >;

let cached:
  | ServerEnvironment
  | undefined;

export function parseServerEnvironment(
  source:
    Record<
      string,
      string | undefined
    >,
): ServerEnvironment {
  const parsed =
    serverEnvironmentSchema.safeParse(
      source,
    );

  if (
    !parsed.success
  ) {
    const issues =
      parsed.error.issues
        .map(
          (
            issue,
          ) =>
            `${issue.path.join(".") || "environment"}: ${issue.message}`,
        )
        .join(
          "; ",
        );

    throw new Error(
      `Invalid VentureScope server environment: ${issues}`,
    );
  }

  return parsed.data;
}

export function getServerEnvironment(): ServerEnvironment {
  cached ??=
    parseServerEnvironment(
      process.env,
    );

  return cached;
}

import {

} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/csv";

import type {
  ActualImportRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import {
  formatMonthKey,

} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";


const MAX_IMPORT_BYTES =
  512 *
  1024;


const MAX_IMPORT_ROWS =
  120;


const HEADER_ALIASES = {
  period: [
    "month",
    "period",
    "date",
  ],

  revenue: [
    "revenue",
    "sales",
  ],

  cogs: [
    "cogs",
    "costofgoodssold",
    "costofsales",
  ],

  operatingExpenses: [
    "operatingexpenses",
    "opex",
    "expenses",
  ],

    "cashflow",
    "netcashflow",
  ],

  cashBalance: [
    "cashbalance",
    "endingcash",
  ],

  mrr: [
    "mrr",
    "monthlyrecurringrevenue",
  ],

  customers: [
    "customers",
    "activecustomers",
  ],
} as const;


function normalizeHeader(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  return value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(
      /[^a-z0-9]/g,
      "",
    );
}


function findColumn(
  headers:
    string[],
  aliases:
    readonly string[],
): number {
  for (
    const alias
    of aliases
  ) {
    const index =
      headers.indexOf(
        alias,
      );


    if (
      index >=
      0
    ) {
      return index;
    }
  }


  return -1;
}


function parseFinancialNumber(
  raw:
    string |
    undefined,
): number |
  null {
  if (
    raw ===
      undefined
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const trimmed =
    raw.trim();


  if (
    !trimmed ||
    trimmed ===
      "-" ||
    trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
      "n/a"
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const parenthesized =
    /^\(.*\)$/.test(
      trimmed,
    );


  const normalized =
    trimmed
      .replace(
        /[()]/g,
        "",
      )
      .replace(
        /[$€£¥₹₽₺₩₦₱₴₸₡₲₵₭₮₼₾₿]/g,
        "",
      )
      .replace(
        /,/g,
        "",
      )
      .replace(
        /\s/g,
        "");


  const parsed =
    Number(
      normalized,
    );


  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      parsed,
    ) ||
    Math.abs(
      parsed,
    ) >
      1e15
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid financial number: ${raw}`,
    );
  }


  return parenthesized
    ?
      -parsed
    :
      parsed;
}


export function parseActualMonth(
  raw:
    string,
): Date {
  const parsed =
    parseMonthStartUtc(
      raw,
    );


  if (
    !parsed
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid actuals month: ${raw}`,
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


export function actualPeriodKey(
  date:
    Date,
): string {
  return formatMonthKey(
    date,
  );
}


export function parseActualsCsv(
  csv:
    string,
): ActualImportRow[] {
  if (
    Buffer.byteLength(
      csv,
      "utf8",
    ) >
    MAX_IMPORT_BYTES
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Actuals CSV exceeds the 512 KB import limit.",
    );
  }


  const table =
    parseCsvTable(
      csv,
    );


  if (
    table.length <
    2
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Actuals CSV contains no data rows.",
    );
  }


  const headerIndex =
    table.findIndex(
      (
        row,
      ) => {
        const headers =
          row.map(
            normalizeHeader,
          );


        return (
          findColumn(
            headers,
            HEADER_ALIASES.period,
          ) >=
            0 &&
          Object.entries(
            HEADER_ALIASES,
          ).some(
            (
              [
                name,
                aliases,
              ],
            ) =>
              name !==
                "period" &&
              findColumn(
                headers,
                aliases,
              ) >=
                0,
          )
        );
      },
    );


  if (
    headerIndex <
    0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Actuals CSV must contain Month/Period and at least one financial metric column.",
    );
  }


  const headers =
    table[
      headerIndex
    ].map(
      normalizeHeader,
    );


  const periodColumn =
    findColumn(
      headers,
      HEADER_ALIASES.period,
    );


  const columns = {
    revenue:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.revenue,
      ),

    cogs:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.cogs,
      ),

    operatingExpenses:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.operatingExpenses,
      ),

    ebitda:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.ebitda,
      ),

    netIncome:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.netIncome,
      ),

    cashFlow:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.cashFlow,
      ),

    cashBalance:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.cashBalance,
      ),

    mrr:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.mrr,
      ),

    customers:
      findColumn(
        headers,
        HEADER_ALIASES.customers,
      ),
  };


  const output:
    ActualImportRow[] =
      [];


  const seen =
    new Set<
      string
    >();


  for (
    const row
    of table.slice(
      headerIndex +
        1,
    )
  ) {
    const rawPeriod =
      row[
        periodColumn
      ]?.trim();


    if (
      !rawPeriod
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    const period =
      parseActualMonth(
        rawPeriod,
      );


    const key =
      actualPeriodKey(
        period,
      );


    if (
      seen.has(
        key,
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Actuals CSV contains duplicate month ${key}.`,
      );
    }


    seen.add(
      key,
    );


    const financial = {
      revenue:
        columns.revenue >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.revenue
              ],
            )
          :
            null,

      cogs:
        columns.cogs >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.cogs
              ],
            )
          :
            null,

      operatingExpenses:
        columns.operatingExpenses >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.operatingExpenses
              ],
            )
          :
            null,

      ebitda:
        columns.ebitda >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.ebitda
              ],
            )
          :
            null,

      netIncome:
        columns.netIncome >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.netIncome
              ],
            )
          :
            null,

      cashFlow:
        columns.cashFlow >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.cashFlow
              ],
            )
          :
            null,

      cashBalance:
        columns.cashBalance >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.cashBalance
              ],
            )
          :
            null,

      mrr:
        columns.mrr >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.mrr
              ],
            )
          :
            null,

      customers:
        columns.customers >=
          0
          ?
            parseFinancialNumber(
              row[
                columns.customers
              ],
            )
          :
            null,
    };


    if (
      financial.customers !==
        null &&
      (
        !Number.isInteger(
          financial.customers,
        ) ||
        financial.customers <
          0
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Customers must be a non-negative integer for ${key}.`,
      );
    }


    if (
      Object.values(
        financial,
      ).every(
        (
          value,
        ) =>
          value ===
          null,
      )
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    output.push({
      period,
      ...financial,
    });
  }


  if (
    output.length ===
    0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Actuals CSV contains no usable financial rows.",
    );
  }


  if (
    output.length >
    MAX_IMPORT_ROWS
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Actuals CSV exceeds the ${MAX_IMPORT_ROWS}-month import limit.`,
    );
  }


  return output.sort(
    (
      left,
      right,
    ) =>
      left.period.getTime() -
      right.period.getTime(),
  );
}

const MIN_YEAR =
  2000;


const MAX_YEAR =
  2100;


const MONTHS:
  Record<
    string,
    number
  > = {
    jan:
      1,

    january:
      1,

    feb:
      2,

    february:
      2,

    mar:
      3,

    march:
      3,

    apr:
      4,

    april:
      4,

    may:
      5,

    jun:
      6,

    june:
      6,

    jul:
      7,

    july:
      7,

    aug:
      8,

    august:
      8,

    sep:
      9,

    sept:
      9,

    september:
      9,

    oct:
      10,

    october:
      10,

    nov:
      11,

    november:
      11,

    dec:
      12,

    december:
      12,
  };


function validYear(
  year:
    number,
): boolean {
  return (
    Number.isInteger(
      year,
    ) &&
    year >=
      MIN_YEAR &&
    year <=
      MAX_YEAR
  );
}


function validMonth(
  month:
    number,
): boolean {
  return (
    Number.isInteger(
      month,
    ) &&
    month >=
      1 &&
    month <=
      12
  );
}


function key(
  year:
    number,
  month:
    number,
): string |
  null {
  if (
    !validYear(
      year,
    ) ||
    !validMonth(
      month,
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return `${year
    .toString()
    .padStart(
      4,
      "0",
    )}-${month
    .toString()
    .padStart(
      2,
      "0",
    )}`;
}


function monthNumber(
  value:
    string,
): number |
  null {
  return MONTHS[
    value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(
        /\.$/u,
        "",
      )
  ] ??
    null;
}


/**
 * Parse month representations without using JavaScript's ambiguous
 * locale/local-time Date string parser.
 *
 * Supported examples:
 *
 * 2027-01
 * 2027-01-31
 * 2027/01
 * 01/2027
 * Jan 2027
 * January 2027
 * 2027 Jan
 * 2027 January
 */
export function parseMonthKey(
  raw:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  const trimmed =
    raw.trim();


  if (
    !trimmed
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const yearMonth =
    /^(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})(?:[-/]\d{1,2})?$/u.exec(
      trimmed,
    );


  if (
    yearMonth
  ) {
    return key(
      Number(
        yearMonth[
          1
        ],
      ),
      Number(
        yearMonth[
          2
        ],
      ),
    );
  }


  const monthYear =
    /^(\d{1,2})[-/](\d{4})$/u.exec(
      trimmed,
    );


  if (
    monthYear
  ) {
    return key(
      Number(
        monthYear[
          2
        ],
      ),
      Number(
        monthYear[
          1
        ],
      ),
    );
  }


  const namedMonthYear =
    /^([A-Za-z]{3,9})[\s,/-]+(\d{4})$/u.exec(
      trimmed,
    );


  if (
    namedMonthYear
  ) {
    const month =
      monthNumber(
        namedMonthYear[
          1
        ],
      );


    return month ===
      null
      ?
        null
      :
        key(
          Number(
            namedMonthYear[
              2
            ],
          ),
          month,
        );
  }


  const yearNamedMonth =
    /^(\d{4})[\s,/-]+([A-Za-z]{3,9})$/u.exec(
      trimmed,
    );


  if (
    yearNamedMonth
  ) {
    const month =
      monthNumber(
        yearNamedMonth[
          2
        ],
      );


    return month ===
      null
      ?
        null
      :
        key(
          Number(
            yearNamedMonth[
              1
            ],
          ),
          month,
        );
  }


  return null;
}


export function parseMonthStartUtc(
  raw:
    string,
): Date |
  null {
  const parsed =
    parseMonthKey(
      raw,
    );


  if (
    !parsed
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const [
    year,
    month,
  ] =
    parsed
      .split(
        "-",
      )
      .map(
        Number,
      );


  return new Date(
    Date.UTC(
      year,
      month -
        1,
      1,
    ),
  );
}


export function formatMonthKey(
  date:
    Date,
): string {
  if (
    Number.isNaN(
      date.getTime(),
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Cannot format an invalid month date.",
    );
  }


  return `${date
    .getUTCFullYear()
    .toString()
    .padStart(
      4,
      "0",
    )}-${(
    date.getUTCMonth() +
    1
  )
    .toString()
    .padStart(
      2,
      "0",
    )}`;
}

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";

import type {
  ActualImportRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";


export async function importActualPeriods({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  rows,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  rows:
    ActualImportRow[];
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        for (
          const row
          of rows
        ) {
          await transaction.actualPeriod.upsert({
            where: {
              projectId_period: {
                projectId,

                period:
                  row.period,
              },
            },

            create: {
              projectId,

              period:
                row.period,

              revenue:
                row.revenue,

              cogs:
                row.cogs,

              operatingExpenses:
                row.operatingExpenses,

              ebitda:
                row.ebitda,

              netIncome:
                row.netIncome,

              cashFlow:
                row.cashFlow,

              cashBalance:
                row.cashBalance,

              mrr:
                row.mrr,

              customers:
                row.customers,

              source:
                "CSV",
            },

            update: {
              revenue:
                row.revenue,

              cogs:
                row.cogs,

              operatingExpenses:
                row.operatingExpenses,

              ebitda:
                row.ebitda,

              netIncome:
                row.netIncome,

              cashFlow:
                row.cashFlow,

              cashBalance:
                row.cashBalance,

              mrr:
                row.mrr,

              customers:
                row.customers,

              source:
                "CSV",
            },
          });
        }


        return {
          imported:
            rows.length,
        };
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.actuals.imported",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      importedPeriods:
        result.imported,
    },
  );


  return result;
}


export async function clearProjectActuals({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.actualPeriod.deleteMany({
      where: {
        projectId,
      },
    });


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.actuals.cleared",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      deletedPeriods:
        result.count,
    },
  );


  return result;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/actuals/variance.ts #####
import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import {
  ACTUAL_METRICS,
  type ActualFinancialPeriod,
  type ActualMetric,
  type ForecastVarianceReport,
  type MetricVariance,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import {
  parseMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";


const LOWER_IS_BETTER =
  new Set<
    ActualMetric
  >([
    "cogs",
    "operatingExpenses",
  ]);


function forecastMetric(
  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow,
  metric:
    ActualMetric,
): number |
  null {
  switch (
    metric
  ) {
    case "revenue":
      return row.revenue;

    case "cogs":
      return row.cogs;

    case "operatingExpenses":
      return row.operatingExpenses;

    case "ebitda":
      return row.ebitda;

    case "netIncome":
      return row.netIncome;

    case "cashFlow":
      return row.cashFlow;

    case "cashBalance":
      return row.cashBalance;

    case "mrr":
      return row.mrr;

    case "customers":
      return row.customers;
  }
}


export function normalizeForecastPeriodKey(
  raw:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  return parseMonthKey(
    raw,
  );
}


export function metricVariance(
  metric:
    ActualMetric,
  actual:
    number,
  forecast:
    number,
): MetricVariance {
  const variance =
    actual -
    forecast;


  const varianceRate =
    forecast ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        variance /
        Math.abs(
          forecast,
        );


  const favorable =
    variance ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        LOWER_IS_BETTER.has(
          metric,
        )
          ?
            variance <
            0
          :
            variance >
            0;


  return {
    actual,
    forecast,
    variance,
    varianceRate,
    favorable,
  };
}


export function calculateVarianceReport(
  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[],
  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
): ForecastVarianceReport {
  const forecastByPeriod =
    new Map<
      string,
      ForecastAnalyticsRow
    >();


  for (
    const forecast
    of forecasts
  ) {
    const key =
      normalizeForecastPeriodKey(
        forecast.period,
      );


    if (
      key
    ) {
      forecastByPeriod.set(
        key,
        forecast,
      );
    }
  }


  const periods =
    actuals.flatMap(
      (
        actual,
      ) => {
        const forecast =
          forecastByPeriod.get(
            actual.period,
          );


        if (
          !forecast
        ) {
          return [];
        }


        const metrics:
          Partial<
            Record<
              ActualMetric,
              MetricVariance
            >
          > =
            {};


        for (
          const metric
          of ACTUAL_METRICS
        ) {
          const actualValue =
            actual[
              metric
            ];


          const forecastValue =
            forecastMetric(
              forecast,
              metric,
            );


          if (
            actualValue ===
              null ||
            forecastValue ===
              null
          ) {
            continue;
          }


          metrics[
            metric
          ] =
            metricVariance(
              metric,
              actualValue,
              forecastValue,
            );
        }


        return [
          {
            period:
              actual.period,

            metrics,
          },
        ];
      },
    );


  const sumMetric =
    (
      metric:
        ActualMetric,
      side:
        "actual" |
        "forecast",
    ): number =>
      periods.reduce(
        (
          total,
          period,
        ) =>
          total +
          (
            period.metrics[
              metric
            ]?.[
              side
            ] ??
            0
          ),
        0,
      );


  const revenueActual =
    sumMetric(
      "revenue",
      "actual",
    );


  const revenueForecast =
    sumMetric(
      "revenue",
      "forecast",
    );


  const ebitdaActual =
    sumMetric(
      "ebitda",
      "actual",
    );


  const ebitdaForecast =
    sumMetric(
      "ebitda",
      "forecast",
    );


  const latestCash =
    [
      ...periods,
    ]
      .reverse()
      .find(
        (
          period,
        ) =>
          period.metrics
            .cashBalance !==
          undefined,
      )
      ?.metrics
      .cashBalance;


  const revenueVariance =
    revenueActual -
    revenueForecast;


  const ebitdaVariance =
    ebitdaActual -
    ebitdaForecast;


  return {
    periods,

    summary: {
      matchedPeriods:
        periods.length,

      actualPeriods:
        actuals.length,

      revenueActual,

      revenueForecast,

      revenueVariance,

      revenueVarianceRate:
        revenueForecast ===
          0
          ?
            null
          :
            revenueVariance /
            Math.abs(
              revenueForecast,
            ),

      ebitdaActual,

      ebitdaForecast,

      ebitdaVariance,

      ebitdaVarianceRate:
        ebitdaForecast ===
          0
          ?
            null
          :
            ebitdaVariance /
            Math.abs(
              ebitdaForecast,
            ),

      latestCashActual:
        latestCash?.actual ??
        null,

      latestCashForecast:
        latestCash?.forecast ??
        null,

      latestCashVariance:
        latestCash?.variance ??
        null,
    },
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/aggregation.ts #####
import {
  nullableFinancialString,
  percentageRatio,
  sumDecimals,
  toFinancialString,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  AnnualForecast,
  MonthlyForecast,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

function decimalField(
  month: MonthlyForecast,
  field:
    | "revenue"
    | "recurringRevenue"
    | "oneTimeRevenue"
    | "cogs"
    | "grossProfit"
    | "salaries"
    | "rent"
    | "marketing"
    | "otherOperatingExpenses"
    | "totalOperatingExpenses"
    | "ebitda"
    | "interestExpense"
    | "tax"
    | "netIncome"
    | "operatingCashFlow"
    | "debtPrincipalRepayment"
    | "netCashMovement"
    | "grossBurn"
    | "netBurn",
): string {
  return month[
    field
  ];
}

export function aggregateAnnualForecast(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
): AnnualForecast[] {
  const grouped =
    new Map<
      number,
      MonthlyForecast[]
    >();

  for (
    const month
    of months
  ) {
    const existing =
      grouped.get(
        month.year,
      ) ??
      [];

    existing.push(
      month,
    );

    grouped.set(
      month.year,
      existing,
    );
  }

  return Array.from(
    grouped.entries(),
  )
    .sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) =>
        left[0] -
        right[0],
    )
    .map(
      (
        [
          year,
          yearMonths,
        ],
      ) => {
        const sum =
          (
            field:
              | "revenue"
              | "recurringRevenue"
              | "oneTimeRevenue"
              | "cogs"
              | "grossProfit"
              | "salaries"
              | "rent"
              | "marketing"
              | "otherOperatingExpenses"
              | "totalOperatingExpenses"
              | "ebitda"
              | "interestExpense"
              | "tax"
              | "netIncome"
              | "operatingCashFlow"
              | "debtPrincipalRepayment"
              | "netCashMovement"
              | "grossBurn"
              | "netBurn",
          ) =>
            sumDecimals(
              yearMonths.map(
                (
                  month,
                ) =>
                  decimalField(
                    month,
                    field,
                  ),
              ),
            );

        const revenue =
          sum(
            "revenue",
          );

        const grossProfit =
          sum(
            "grossProfit",
          );

        const ebitda =
          sum(
            "ebitda",
          );

        const netIncome =
          sum(
            "netIncome",
          );

        const financingInflow =
          sumDecimals(
            yearMonths.map(
              (
                month,
              ) =>
                month.financingInflows
                  .total,
            ),
          );

        const lastMonth =
          yearMonths[
            yearMonths.length -
              1
          ];

        const grossMargin =
          percentageRatio(
            grossProfit,
            revenue,
          );

        const ebitdaMargin =
          percentageRatio(
            ebitda,
            revenue,
          );

        const netMargin =
          percentageRatio(
            netIncome,
            revenue,
          );

        const averageGrossBurn =
          sum(
            "grossBurn",
          ).div(
            yearMonths.length,
          );

        const averageNetBurn =
          sum(
            "netBurn",
          ).div(
            yearMonths.length,
          );

        return {
          year,

          monthsIncluded:
            yearMonths.length,

          revenue:
            toFinancialString(
              revenue,
            ),

          recurringRevenue:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "recurringRevenue",
              ),
            ),

          oneTimeRevenue:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "oneTimeRevenue",
              ),
            ),

          cogs:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "cogs",
              ),
            ),

          grossProfit:
            toFinancialString(
              grossProfit,
            ),

          grossMarginPercentage:
            nullableFinancialString(
              grossMargin,
            ),

          salaries:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "salaries",
              ),
            ),

          rent:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "rent",
              ),
            ),

          marketing:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "marketing",
              ),
            ),

          otherOperatingExpenses:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "otherOperatingExpenses",
              ),
            ),

          totalOperatingExpenses:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "totalOperatingExpenses",
              ),
            ),

          ebitda:
            toFinancialString(
              ebitda,
            ),

          ebitdaMarginPercentage:
            nullableFinancialString(
              ebitdaMargin,
            ),

          interestExpense:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "interestExpense",
              ),
            ),

          tax:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "tax",
              ),
            ),

          netIncome:
            toFinancialString(
              netIncome,
            ),

          netMarginPercentage:
            nullableFinancialString(
              netMargin,
            ),

          operatingCashFlow:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "operatingCashFlow",
              ),
            ),

          financingInflow:
            toFinancialString(
              financingInflow,
            ),

          debtPrincipalRepayment:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "debtPrincipalRepayment",
              ),
            ),

          netCashMovement:
            toFinancialString(
              sum(
                "netCashMovement",
              ),
            ),

          endingCash:
            lastMonth
              .endingCash,

          endingMrr:
            lastMonth.mrr,

          endingCustomers:
            lastMonth
              .endingCustomers,

          averageGrossBurn:
            toFinancialString(
              averageGrossBurn,
            ),

          averageNetBurn:
            toFinancialString(
              averageNetBurn,
            ),
        };
      },
    );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/analysis-context.ts #####
import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  countCompletedAssumptionSections,
  parseStoredFinancialAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/storage";
import {
  generateFinancialForecast,
} from "@/lib/finance/engine";
import {
  buildFinancialModelInput,
} from "@/lib/finance/project-input";
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

export type MissingAssumptionSection =
  | "general"
  | "revenue"
  | "expenses";

export async function getFinancialAnalysis(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
  scenarioId?: string,
) {
  const project =
    await prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,

        userId,
      },

      include: {
        financingEvents: {
          orderBy: {
            month:
              "asc",
          },
        },

        monthlyOverrides: {
          orderBy: [
            {
              month:
                "asc",
            },
            {
              createdAt:
                "asc",
            },
          ],
        },

        scenarios: {
          orderBy: {
            createdAt:
              "asc",
          },
        },
      },
    });

  if (!project) {
    notFound();
  }

  const assumptions =
    parseStoredFinancialAssumptions(
      project.baseAssumptions,
    );

  const completedSections =
    countCompletedAssumptionSections(
      assumptions,
    );

  const missingSections: MissingAssumptionSection[] =
    [];

  if (
    !assumptions.completion
      .general
  ) {
    missingSections.push(
      "general",
    );
  }

  if (
    !assumptions.completion
      .revenue
  ) {
    missingSections.push(
      "revenue",
    );
  }

  if (
    !assumptions.completion
      .expenses
  ) {
    missingSections.push(
      "expenses",
    );
  }

  const baseScenario =
    project.scenarios.find(
      (
        scenario,
      ) =>
        scenario.type ===
        "BASE",
    );

  const requestedScenario =
    scenarioId
      ? project.scenarios.find(
          (
            scenario,
          ) =>
            scenario.id ===
            scenarioId,
        )
      : undefined;

  const selectedScenario =
    requestedScenario ??
    baseScenario ??
    project.scenarios[0];

  if (
    completedSections !==
    3
  ) {
    return {
      ready:
        false as const,

      project,

      assumptions,

      completedSections,

      missingSections,

      baseScenario,

      selectedScenario,
    };
  }

  const input =
    buildFinancialModelInput(
      project,
      selectedScenario,
    );

  const forecast =
    generateFinancialForecast(
      input,
    );

  return {
    ready:
      true as const,

    project,

    assumptions,

    completedSections,

    missingSections,

    baseScenario,

    selectedScenario,

    forecast,
  };
}

export async function getBaseFinancialAnalysis(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
) {
  return getFinancialAnalysis(
    userId,
    projectId,
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/analytics/calculations.ts #####
import Decimal from "decimal.js";

import type {
  AdvancedFinancialAnalytics,
  AnnualCashFlow,
  DcfAssumptions,
  DcfResult,
  DcfSensitivityMatrix,
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
  OperatingAnalytics,
  UnitEconomics,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";


function decimal(
  value:
    number,
): Decimal {
  return new Decimal(
    value,
  );
}


function valueOrZero(
  value:
    number |
    null,
): number {
  return value ??
    0;
}


function sumMetric(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  metric:
    keyof ForecastAnalyticsRow,
): number {
  return rows.reduce(
    (
      total,
      row,
    ) => {
      const value =
        row[
          metric
        ];


      if (
        typeof value !==
        "number"
      ) {
        return total;
      }


      return total +
        value;
    },
    0,
  );
}


function lastNumber(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  metric:
    keyof ForecastAnalyticsRow,
): number |
  null {
  for (
    let index =
      rows.length -
      1;
    index >=
      0;
    index -=
      1
  ) {
    const value =
      rows[
        index
      ][
        metric
      ];


    if (
      typeof value ===
        "number"
    ) {
      return value;
    }
  }


  return null;
}


function firstNumber(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  metric:
    keyof ForecastAnalyticsRow,
): number |
  null {
  for (
    const row
    of rows
  ) {
    const value =
      row[
        metric
      ];


    if (
      typeof value ===
        "number"
    ) {
      return value;
    }
  }


  return null;
}


function grossProfitForRow(
  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow,
): number {
  if (
    row.grossProfit !==
    null
  ) {
    return row.grossProfit;
  }


  return (
    valueOrZero(
      row.revenue,
    ) -
    valueOrZero(
      row.cogs,
    )
  );
}


function cashFlowForRow(
  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow,
): number {
  if (
    row.cashFlow !==
    null
  ) {
    return row.cashFlow;
  }


  if (
    row.netIncome !==
    null
  ) {
    return row.netIncome;
  }


  return valueOrZero(
    row.ebitda,
  );
}


export function annualizeForecast(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
): AnnualCashFlow[] {
  const annual:
    AnnualCashFlow[] =
      [];


  for (
    let start =
      0;
    start <
      rows.length &&
    annual.length <
      5;
    start +=
      12
  ) {
    const block =
      rows.slice(
        start,
        start +
          12,
      );


    if (
      block.length ===
      0
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    annual.push({
      year:
        annual.length +
        1,

      freeCashFlow:
        block.reduce(
          (
            total,
            row,
          ) =>
            total +
            cashFlowForRow(
              row,
            ),
          0,
        ),

      revenue:
        sumMetric(
          block,
          "revenue",
        ),

      ebitda:
        sumMetric(
          block,
          "ebitda",
        ),
    });
  }


  return annual;
}


export function calculateDcf(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  assumptions:
    DcfAssumptions,
): DcfResult |
  null {
  const annualCashFlows =
    annualizeForecast(
      rows,
    );


  if (
    annualCashFlows.length ===
      0 ||
    assumptions.discountRate <=
      assumptions.terminalGrowthRate ||
    assumptions.discountRate <=
      0
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const discountRate =
    decimal(
      assumptions.discountRate,
    );


  const terminalGrowth =
    decimal(
      assumptions.terminalGrowthRate,
    );


  let presentValue =
    decimal(
      0,
    );


  annualCashFlows.forEach(
    (
      year,
      index,
    ) => {
      const denominator =
        decimal(
          1,
        )
          .plus(
            discountRate,
          )
          .pow(
            index +
              1,
          );


      presentValue =
        presentValue.plus(
          decimal(
            year.freeCashFlow,
          ).dividedBy(
            denominator,
          ),
        );
    },
  );


  const terminalCashFlow =
    decimal(
      annualCashFlows[
        annualCashFlows.length -
        1
      ].freeCashFlow,
    );


  const terminalValue =
    terminalCashFlow
      .times(
        decimal(
          1,
        ).plus(
          terminalGrowth,
        ),
      )
      .dividedBy(
        discountRate.minus(
          terminalGrowth,
        ),
      );


  const terminalDiscount =
    decimal(
      1,
    )
      .plus(
        discountRate,
      )
      .pow(
        annualCashFlows.length,
      );


  const presentTerminal =
    terminalValue.dividedBy(
      terminalDiscount,
    );


  const enterpriseValue =
    presentValue.plus(
      presentTerminal,
    );


  const endingCash =
    lastNumber(
      rows,
      "cashBalance",
    ) ??
    0;


  return {
    enterpriseValue:
      enterpriseValue.toNumber(),

    equityValueProxy:
      enterpriseValue
        .plus(
          endingCash,
        )
        .toNumber(),

    presentValueOfForecast:
      presentValue.toNumber(),

    presentValueOfTerminalValue:
      presentTerminal.toNumber(),

    terminalValue:
      terminalValue.toNumber(),

    annualCashFlows,
  };
}


function clamp(
  value:
    number,
  minimum:
    number,
  maximum:
    number,
): number {
  return Math.min(
    maximum,
    Math.max(
      minimum,
      value,
    ),
  );
}


function uniqueSorted(
  values:
    number[],
): number[] {
  return [
    ...new Set(
      values.map(
        (
          value,
        ) =>
          Number(
            value.toFixed(
              4,
            ),
          ),
      ),
    ),
  ].sort(
    (
      left,
      right,
    ) =>
      left -
      right,
  );
}


export function calculateDcfSensitivity(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  assumptions:
    DcfAssumptions,
): DcfSensitivityMatrix {
  const discountRates =
    uniqueSorted(
      [
        -0.04,
        -0.02,
        0,
        0.02,
        0.04,
      ].map(
        (
          delta,
        ) =>
          clamp(
            assumptions.discountRate +
              delta,
            0.01,
            0.8,
          ),
      ),
    );


  const terminalGrowthRates =
    uniqueSorted(
      [
        -0.02,
        -0.01,
        0,
        0.01,
        0.02,
      ].map(
        (
          delta,
        ) =>
          clamp(
            assumptions.terminalGrowthRate +
              delta,
            -0.05,
            0.15,
          ),
      ),
    );


  return {
    discountRates,

    terminalGrowthRates,

    cells:
      terminalGrowthRates.flatMap(
        (
          terminalGrowthRate,
        ) =>
          discountRates.map(
            (
              discountRate,
            ) => ({
              discountRate,

              terminalGrowthRate,

              enterpriseValue:
                terminalGrowthRate >=
                  discountRate -
                    0.0025
                  ?
                    null
                  :
                    calculateDcf(
                      rows,
                      {
                        discountRate,

                        terminalGrowthRate,
                      },
                    )
                      ?.enterpriseValue ??
                    null,
            }),
          ),
      ),
  };
}


export function calculateUnitEconomics(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
): UnitEconomics {
  const trailing =
    rows.slice(
      -12,
    );


  const revenue =
    sumMetric(
      trailing,
      "revenue",
    );


  const grossProfit =
    trailing.reduce(
      (
        total,
        row,
      ) =>
        total +
        grossProfitForRow(
          row,
        ),
      0,
    );


  const grossMarginRate =
    revenue !==
      0
      ?
        grossProfit /
        revenue
      :
        null;


  const latestMrr =
    lastNumber(
      rows,
      "mrr",
    );


  const latestCustomers =
    lastNumber(
      rows,
      "customers",
    );


  const monthlyArpu =
    latestMrr !==
      null &&
    latestCustomers !==
      null &&
    latestCustomers >
      0
      ?
        latestMrr /
        latestCustomers
      :
        null;


  const cac =
    lastNumber(
      rows,
      "cac",
    );


  const churnRate =
    lastNumber(
      rows,
      "churnRate",
    );


  const lifetimeValue =
    monthlyArpu !==
      null &&
    grossMarginRate !==
      null &&
    churnRate !==
      null &&
    churnRate >
      0
      ?
        (
          monthlyArpu *
          grossMarginRate
        ) /
        churnRate
      :
        null;


  const ltvToCac =
    lifetimeValue !==
      null &&
    cac !==
      null &&
    cac >
      0
      ?
        lifetimeValue /
        cac
      :
        null;


  const cacPaybackMonths =
    cac !==
      null &&
    monthlyArpu !==
      null &&
    grossMarginRate !==
      null &&
    monthlyArpu *
      grossMarginRate >
      0
      ?
        cac /
        (
          monthlyArpu *
          grossMarginRate
        )
      :
        null;


  return {
    monthlyArpu,

    grossMarginRate,

    lifetimeValue,

    cac,

    ltvToCac,

    cacPaybackMonths,

    churnRate,
  };
}


export function calculateOperatingAnalytics(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
): OperatingAnalytics {
  const trailing =
    rows.slice(
      -12,
    );


  const previous =
    rows.slice(
      -24,
      -12,
    );


  const trailingRevenue =
    sumMetric(
      trailing,
      "revenue",
    );


  const previousRevenue =
    sumMetric(
      previous,
      "revenue",
    );


  const trailingEbitda =
    sumMetric(
      trailing,
      "ebitda",
    );


  const revenueGrowthRate =
    previous.length >
      0 &&
    previousRevenue !==
      0
      ?
        (
          trailingRevenue -
          previousRevenue
        ) /
        Math.abs(
          previousRevenue,
        )
      :
        null;


  const ebitdaMarginRate =
    trailingRevenue !==
      0
      ?
        trailingEbitda /
        trailingRevenue
      :
        null;


  const trailingGrossProfit =
    trailing.reduce(
      (
        total,
        row,
      ) =>
        total +
        grossProfitForRow(
          row,
        ),
      0,
    );


  const contributionMarginRate =
    trailingRevenue !==
      0
      ?
        trailingGrossProfit /
        trailingRevenue
      :
        null;


  const ruleOf40 =
    revenueGrowthRate !==
      null &&
    ebitdaMarginRate !==
      null
      ?
        revenueGrowthRate +
        ebitdaMarginRate
      :
        null;


  const trailingCashFlow =
    trailing.reduce(
      (
        total,
        row,
      ) =>
        total +
        cashFlowForRow(
          row,
        ),
      0,
    );


  const netBurn =
    Math.max(
      0,
      -trailingCashFlow,
    );


  const endingMrr =
    lastNumber(
      trailing,
      "mrr",
    );


  const startingMrr =
    firstNumber(
      trailing,
      "mrr",
    );


  const netNewArr =
    endingMrr !==
      null &&
    startingMrr !==
      null
      ?
        Math.max(
          0,
          (
            endingMrr -
            startingMrr
          ) *
            12,
        )
      :
        0;


  const burnMultiple =
    netBurn >
      0 &&
    netNewArr >
      0
      ?
        netBurn /
        netNewArr
      :
        null;


  return {
    trailingRevenue,

    trailingEbitda,

    revenueGrowthRate,

    ebitdaMarginRate,

    contributionMarginRate,

    ruleOf40,

    burnMultiple,

    endingCashBalance:
      lastNumber(
        rows,
        "cashBalance",
      ),
  };
}


export function calculateAdvancedAnalytics(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  assumptions:
    DcfAssumptions,
): AdvancedFinancialAnalytics {
  return {
    rowCount:
      rows.length,

    dcf:
      calculateDcf(
        rows,
        assumptions,
      ),

    sensitivity:
      calculateDcfSensitivity(
        rows,
        assumptions,
      ),

    unitEconomics:
      calculateUnitEconomics(
        rows,
      ),

    operating:
      calculateOperatingAnalytics(
        rows,
      ),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/analytics/csv.ts #####
import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";


type Metric =
  Exclude<
    keyof ForecastAnalyticsRow,
    "period"
  >;


const PERIOD_ALIASES = [
  "period",
  "month",
  "date",
  "forecastmonth",
  "forecastperiod",
];


const METRIC_ALIASES:
  Record<
    Metric,
    string[]
  > = {
    revenue: [
      "revenue",
      "totalrevenue",
      "sales",
    ],

    cogs: [
      "cogs",
      "costofgoodssold",
      "costofsales",
    ],

    grossProfit: [

function normalizeHeader(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  return value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(
      /[^a-z0-9]/g,
      "",
    );
}


export function parseCsvTable(
  value:
    string,
): string[][] {
  const rows:
    string[][] =
      [];


  let row:
    string[] =
      [];

  let field =
    "";

  let quoted =
    false;


  for (
    let index =
      0;
    index <
      value.length;
    index +=
      1
  ) {
    const character =
      value[
        index
      ];


    if (
      quoted
    ) {
      if (
        character ===
        '"'
      ) {
        if (
          value[
            index +
            1
          ] ===
          '"'
        ) {
          field +=
            '"';

          index +=
            1;
        }
        else {
          quoted =
            false;
        }
      }
      else {
        field +=
          character;
      }


      continue;
    }


    if (
      character ===
      '"'
    ) {
      quoted =
        true;

      continue;
    }


    if (
      character ===
      ","
    ) {
      row.push(
        field,
      );

      field =
        "";

      continue;
    }


    if (
      character ===
      "\n"
    ) {
      row.push(
        field,
      );

      rows.push(
        row,
      );

      row =
        [];

      field =
        "";

      continue;
    }


    if (
      character ===
      "\r"
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    field +=
      character;
  }


  if (
    field.length >
      0 ||
    row.length >
      0
  ) {
    row.push(
      field,
    );

    rows.push(
      row,
    );
  }


  return rows;
}


function numericValue(
  raw:
    string |
    undefined,
): number |
  null {
  if (
    raw ===
      undefined
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const trimmed =
    raw.trim();


  if (
    !trimmed ||
    trimmed ===
      "-" ||
    trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
      "n/a"
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const percentage =
    trimmed.includes(
      "%",
    );


  const negative =
    /^\(.*\)$/.test(
      trimmed,
    );


  const normalized =
    trimmed
      .replace(
        /[()]/g,
        "",
      )
      .replace(
        /[%€£$¥₺₽₹₫₩₦₱₴₸₡₲₵₭₮₼₾₿]/g,
        "",
      )
      .replace(
        /\s/g,
        "",
      )
      .replace(
        /,/g,
        "");


  const parsed =
    Number(
      normalized,
    );


  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      parsed,
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const signed =
    negative
      ?
        -parsed
      :
        parsed;


  return percentage
    ?
      signed /
        100
    :
      signed;
}


function aliasIndex(
  headers:
    string[],
  aliases:
    string[],
): number {
  for (
    const alias
    of aliases
  ) {
    const exact =
      headers.indexOf(
        alias,
      );


    if (
      exact >=
      0
    ) {
      return exact;
    }
  }


  return -1;
}


function headerScore(
  row:
    string[],
): number {
  const headers =
    row.map(
      normalizeHeader,
    );


  let score =
    PERIOD_ALIASES.some(
      (
        alias,
      ) =>
        headers.includes(
          alias,
        ),
    )
      ?
        2
      :
        0;


  for (
    const aliases
    of Object.values(
      METRIC_ALIASES,
    )
  ) {
    if (
      aliases.some(
        (
          alias,
        ) =>
          headers.includes(
            alias,
          ),
      )
    ) {
      score +=
        1;
    }
  }


  return score;
}


export function normalizeForecastCsv(
  csv:
    string,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow[] {
  const table =
    parseCsvTable(
      csv,
    );


  if (
    table.length <
    2
  ) {
    return [];
  }


  let headerIndex =
    -1;

  let bestScore =
    0;


  table.forEach(
    (
      row,
      index,
    ) => {
      const score =
        headerScore(
          row,
        );


      if (
        score >
        bestScore
      ) {
        bestScore =
          score;

        headerIndex =
          index;
      }
    },
  );


  if (
    headerIndex <
      0 ||
    bestScore <
      3
  ) {
    return [];
  }


  const headers =
    table[
      headerIndex
    ].map(
      normalizeHeader,
    );


  const periodIndex =
    aliasIndex(
      headers,
      PERIOD_ALIASES,
    );


  const indexes =
    Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(
        METRIC_ALIASES,
      ).map(
        (
          [
            metric,
            aliases,
          ],
        ) => [
          metric,
          aliasIndex(
            headers,
            aliases,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ) as
      Record<
        Metric,
        number
      >;


  const result:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[] =
      [];


  for (
    const row
    of table.slice(
      headerIndex +
        1,
    )
  ) {
    const values =
      {} as
        Record<
          Metric,
          number |
          null
        >;


    let populatedMetrics =
      0;


    for (
      const metric
      of Object.keys(
        indexes,
      ) as
        Metric[]
    ) {
      const index =
        indexes[
          metric
        ];


      const numeric =
        index >=
          0
          ?
            numericValue(
              row[
                index
              ],
            )
          :
            null;


      values[
        metric
      ] =
        numeric;


      if (
        numeric !==
        null
      ) {
        populatedMetrics +=
          1;
      }
    }


    if (
      populatedMetrics <
      1
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    const period =
      periodIndex >=
        0
        ?
          (
            row[
              periodIndex
            ]?.trim() ??
            ""
          )
        :
          `Month ${result.length + 1}`;


    result.push({
      period:
        period ||
        `Month ${result.length + 1}`,

      ...values,
    });
  }


  return result;
}

import {
  z,
} from "zod";

function decimalString(
  label: string,
  options: {
    min?: number;
    max?: number;
    exclusiveMin?: number;
  } = {},
) {
  return z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(
      1,
      `${label} is required.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (value) =>
        /^-?(?:\d+|\d+\.\d+|\.\d+)$/.test(
          value,
        ) &&
        Number.isFinite(
          Number(value),
        ),
      `${label} must be a valid number.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (value) =>
        options.min ===
          undefined ||
        Number(value) >=
          options.min,
      options.min ===
        undefined
        ? `${label} is invalid.`
        : `${label} must be at least ${options.min}.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (value) =>
        options.max ===
          undefined ||
        Number(value) <=
          options.max,
      options.max ===
        undefined
        ? `${label} is invalid.`
        : `${label} must not exceed ${options.max}.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (value) =>
        options.exclusiveMin ===
          undefined ||
        Number(value) >
          options.exclusiveMin,
      options.exclusiveMin ===
        undefined
        ? `${label} is invalid.`
        : `${label} must be greater than ${options.exclusiveMin}.`,
    );
}

function nonNegativeMoney(
  label: string,
) {
  return decimalString(
    label,
    {
      min: 0,
      max: 1_000_000_000_000_000,
    },
  );
}

function percentage(
  label: string,
) {
  return decimalString(
    label,
    {
      min: 0,
      max: 100,
    },
  );
}

function growthRate(
  label: string,
) {
  return decimalString(
    label,
    {
      min: -100,
      max: 10_000,
    },
  );
}

function nonNegativeInteger(
  label: string,
) {
  return z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .regex(
      /^\d+$/,
      `${label} must be a whole number.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (value) =>
        Number(value) <=
        1_000_000_000,
      `${label} is too large.`,
    );
}

                  "name",
                ],
                message:
                  "Custom expense names must be unique.",
              });
            }

            names.add(
              normalized,
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );

import type {
  Prisma,
} from "@/generated/prisma/client";

import {
  createDefaultFinancialAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/defaults";
import {
  financialAssumptionsV1StorageSchema,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/schemas";
import type {
  FinancialAssumptionsV1,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/types";

export function parseStoredFinancialAssumptions(
  value: unknown,
): FinancialAssumptionsV1 {
  const parsed =
    financialAssumptionsV1StorageSchema.safeParse(
      value,
    );

  if (
    parsed.success
  ) {
    return parsed.data;
  }

  return createDefaultFinancialAssumptions();
}

export function financialAssumptionsToJson(
  assumptions: FinancialAssumptionsV1,
): Prisma.InputJsonValue {
  return JSON.parse(
    JSON.stringify(
      assumptions,
    ),
  ) as Prisma.InputJsonValue;
}

export function countCompletedAssumptionSections(
  assumptions: FinancialAssumptionsV1,
): number {
  return [
    assumptions.completion
      .general,
    assumptions.completion
      .revenue,
    assumptions.completion
      .expenses,
  ].filter(
    Boolean,
  ).length;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/board-pack/insights.ts #####
import type {
  BoardPackExecutiveSummary,
  BoardPackInsight,
  BoardPackIntelligenceInput,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-pack/types";


const SEVERITY_ORDER = {
  CRITICAL:
    0,

  WARNING:
    1,

  INFO:
    2,
} as const;


export function buildBoardPackExecutiveSummary({
  reportPeriod,
  liveSnapshot,
  scorecard,
  varianceReview,
  periodRegister,
  actions,
}: BoardPackIntelligenceInput): BoardPackExecutiveSummary {
  const insights:
    BoardPackInsight[] =
      [];


  if (
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .liquidityRiskLevel ===
      "CRITICAL" ||
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .liquidityRiskLevel ===
      "HIGH"
  ) {
    insights.push({
      code:
        "LIQUIDITY",

      severity:
        liveSnapshot.kpis
          .liquidityRiskLevel ===
          "CRITICAL"
          ?
            "CRITICAL"
          :
            "WARNING",

      title:
        `${liveSnapshot.kpis.liquidityRiskLevel.toLowerCase()} liquidity risk`,

      detail:
        `Liquidity risk score is ${liveSnapshot.kpis.liquidityRiskScore}/100.`,

      managementResponse:
        "Review liquidity guardrails, downside exposure, cash preservation measures, and funding timing.",
    });
  }


  if (
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .capitalNeed >
    0
  ) {
    insights.push({
      code:
        "CAPITAL_NEED",

      severity:
        liveSnapshot.kpis
          .downsideCashExhaustionPeriod
          ?
            "CRITICAL"
          :
            "WARNING",

      title:
        "Downside case requires additional capital",

      detail:
        "The current downside case has a positive modeled funding requirement.",

      managementResponse:
        "Confirm funding strategy, decision deadlines, and contingency actions.",
    });
  }


  if (
    scorecard.summary
      .offTrack >
    0
  ) {
    insights.push({
      code:
        "OFF_TRACK_TARGETS",

      severity:
        scorecard.summary
          .offTrack >=
          3
          ?
            "CRITICAL"
          :
            "WARNING",

      title:
        `${scorecard.summary.offTrack} management target${scorecard.summary.offTrack === 1 ? "" : "s"} off track`,

      detail:
        `The management scorecard contains ${scorecard.summary.offTrack} OFF_TRACK target${scorecard.summary.offTrack === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`,

      managementResponse:
        "Confirm owners, recovery actions, and whether the operating plan needs adjustment.",
    });
  }


  if (
    varianceReview.summary
      .materialUnexplained >
    0
  ) {
    insights.push({
      code:
        "UNEXPLAINED_VARIANCE",

      severity:
        varianceReview.summary
          .materialUnexplained >=
          3
          ?
            "CRITICAL"
          :
            "WARNING",

      title:
        `${varianceReview.summary.materialUnexplained} material variance${varianceReview.summary.materialUnexplained === 1 ? "" : "s"} without management explanation`,

      detail:
        "Material Actual-versus-Forecast movements remain without structured management commentary.",

      managementResponse:
        "Assign root causes and corrective actions before the management review is finalized.",
    });
  }


  const unresolvedCriticalActions =
    actions.filter(
      (
        action,
      ) =>
        action.priority ===
          "CRITICAL" &&
        action.status !==
          "DONE" &&
        action.status !==
          "DISMISSED",
    );


  if (
    unresolvedCriticalActions.length >
    0
  ) {
    insights.push({
      code:
        "CRITICAL_ACTIONS",

      severity:
        "CRITICAL",

      title:
        `${unresolvedCriticalActions.length} critical management action${unresolvedCriticalActions.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} unresolved`,

      detail:
        "Critical actions remain open, in progress, or blocked.",

      managementResponse:
        "Review accountability, blockers, deadlines, and escalation requirements.",
    });
  }


  const reportPeriodRow =
    periodRegister.rows.find(
      (
        row,
      ) =>
        row.periodKey ===
        reportPeriod,
    );


  if (
    reportPeriodRow &&
    reportPeriodRow.status ===
      "OPEN"
  ) {
    insights.push({
      code:
        "OPEN_FINANCIAL_PERIOD",

      severity:
        "WARNING",

      title:
        `${reportPeriod} financial period is still open`,

      detail:
        "The reporting period has Actuals but has not yet been financially closed.",

      managementResponse:
        "Complete the financial-close review before treating the period as final historical performance.",
    });
  }


  if (
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .forecastAccuracyScore !==
      null &&
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .forecastAccuracyScore <
      0.80
  ) {
    insights.push({
      code:
        "FORECAST_ACCURACY",

      severity:
        "WARNING",

      title:
        "Forecast reliability is below 80%",

      detail:
        "Historical forecast accuracy is materially below the desired planning-confidence level.",

      managementResponse:
        "Review recurring forecast errors and challenge the assumptions driving persistent bias.",
    });
  }


  if (
    insights.length ===
    0
  ) {
    insights.push({
      code:
        "NO_MAJOR_EXCEPTION",

      severity:
        "INFO",

      title:
        "No major management exception detected",

      detail:
        "The current board-pack authorities do not identify a critical management exception.",

      managementResponse:
        "Continue monitoring performance, forecast reliability, liquidity, and execution commitments.",
    });
  }


  insights.sort(
    (
      left,
      right,
    ) =>
      SEVERITY_ORDER[
        left.severity
      ] -
      SEVERITY_ORDER[
        right.severity
      ],
  );


  return {
    insights,

    critical:
      insights.filter(
        (
          insight,
        ) =>
          insight.severity ===
          "CRITICAL",
      ).length,

    warnings:
      insights.filter(
        (
          insight,
        ) =>
          insight.severity ===
          "WARNING",
      ).length,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/board-room/comparison.ts #####
import type {
  ExecutiveReviewComparison,
  ExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
  ReviewComparisonMetric,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/types";


function comparison(
  frozen:
    number |
    null,
  live:
    number |
    null,
): ReviewComparisonMetric {
  return {
    frozen,

    live,

    delta:
      frozen ===
        null ||
      live ===
        null
        ?
          null
        :
          live -
          frozen,
  };
}


export function compareExecutiveReview(
  frozen:
    ExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
  live:
    ExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
): ExecutiveReviewComparison {
  return {
    revenueVarianceRate:
      comparison(
        frozen.kpis
          .revenueVarianceRate,
        live.kpis
          .revenueVarianceRate,
      ),

    ebitdaVarianceRate:
      comparison(
        frozen.kpis
          .ebitdaVarianceRate,
        live.kpis
          .ebitdaVarianceRate,
      ),

    forecastAccuracyScore:
      comparison(
        frozen.kpis
          .forecastAccuracyScore,
        live.kpis
          .forecastAccuracyScore,
      ),

    liquidityRiskScore:
      comparison(
        frozen.kpis
          .liquidityRiskScore,
        live.kpis
          .liquidityRiskScore,
      ),

    capitalNeed:
      comparison(
        frozen.kpis
          .capitalNeed,
        live.kpis
          .capitalNeed,
      ),

    openActions:
      comparison(
        frozen.actions
          .open,
        live.actions
          .open,
      ),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/board-room/service.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";

import type {
  ExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/types";


const MAX_REVIEWS_PER_PROJECT =
  48;


export async function createExecutiveReview({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  periodKey,
  title,
  commentary,
  modelVersion,
  snapshot,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  periodKey:
    string;

  title:
    string;

  commentary:
    string |
    null;

  modelVersion:
    string;

  snapshot:
    ExecutiveReviewSnapshot;
}) {
  const review =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const count =
          await transaction.executiveReview.count({
            where: {
              projectId,
            },
          });


        if (
          count >=
          MAX_REVIEWS_PER_PROJECT
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `A project may contain at most ${MAX_REVIEWS_PER_PROJECT} frozen executive reviews.`,
          );
        }


        const created =
          await transaction.executiveReview.create({
            data: {
              projectId,

              periodKey,

              title,

              commentary,

              modelVersion,

              snapshot:
                snapshot as never,

              createdByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              periodKey:
                true,

              title:
                true,

              createdAt:
                true,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "BOARD_ROOM",

            action:
              "EXECUTIVE_REVIEW_FROZEN",

            severity:
              "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "ExecutiveReview",

            entityId:
              created.id,

            summary:
              `Executive review frozen: ${created.title}`,

            metadata: {
              periodKey,

              modelVersion,

              criticalSignals:
                snapshot.signals.filter(
                  (
                    signal,
                  ) =>
                    signal.severity ===
                    "CRITICAL",
                ).length,

              openActions:
                snapshot.actions.open,
            },
          },
        });


        return created;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.executive-review.created",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      executiveReviewId:
        review.id,

      periodKey:
        review.periodKey,
    },
  );


  return review;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/board-room/snapshot.ts #####
import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import {
  calculateVarianceReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/variance";

import {
  calculateForecastAccuracyReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/forecast-accuracy/calculations";

import {
  calculateLiquidityRiskReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/calculations";

import {
  calculateCapitalPlanningReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/calculations";

import {
  buildExecutiveDecisionSignals,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/signals";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";

import type {
  ExecutiveActionState,
  ExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/types";


function isOpenStatus(
  status:
    string,
): boolean {
  return (
    status !==
      "DONE" &&
    status !==
      "DISMISSED"
  );
}


export function buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot({
  capturedAt,
  actuals,
  forecasts,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
  actions,
}: {
  capturedAt:
    string;

  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];

  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  actions:
    ExecutiveActionState[];
}): ExecutiveReviewSnapshot {
  const variance =
    calculateVarianceReport(
      actuals,
      forecasts,
    );


  const accuracy =
    calculateForecastAccuracyReport(
      actuals,
      forecasts,
    );


  const risk =
    calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
      rows:
        forecasts,

      policy:
        riskPolicy,

      latestActualPeriod,

      latestActualCash,
    });


  const capital =
    calculateCapitalPlanningReport({
      basis:
        "DOWNSIDE",

      rows:
        forecasts,

      riskPolicy,

      latestActualPeriod,

      latestActualCash,

      inputs: {
        targetCashFloor:
          Math.max(
            0,
            riskPolicy.minimumCash ??
            0,
          ),

        raisePeriodIndex:
          0,

        capitalAmount:
          0,

        preMoneyValuation:
          0,

        annualDebtRate:
          0,

        debtTermMonths:
          36,

        hybridEquityShare:
          0.50,
      },
    });


  const forecastBiasCount =
    accuracy.metrics.filter(
      (
        metric,
      ) =>
        metric.bias ===
          "OVER_FORECASTING" ||
        metric.bias ===
          "UNDER_FORECASTING",
    ).length;


  const signals =
    buildExecutiveDecisionSignals({
      actualPeriods:
        actuals.length,

      revenueVarianceRate:
        variance.summary
          .revenueVarianceRate,

      ebitdaVarianceRate:
        variance.summary
          .ebitdaVarianceRate,

      forecastAccuracyScore:
        accuracy
          .overallAccuracyScore,

      forecastBiasCount,

      liquidityRiskLevel:
        risk.level,

      downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
        risk
          .firstDownsideCashExhaustionPeriod,

      requiredCapital:
        capital
          .requiredCapitalAfterRaise,
    });


  const capturedTime =
    new Date(
      capturedAt,
    ).getTime();


  const openActions =
    actions.filter(
      (
        action,
      ) =>
        isOpenStatus(
          action.status,
        ),
    );


  const criticalOpen =
    openActions.filter(
      (
        action,
      ) =>
        action.priority ===
        "CRITICAL",
    ).length;


  const overdue =
    openActions.filter(
      (
        action,
      ) => {
        if (
          !action.dueDate
        ) {
          return false;
        }


        const due =
          new Date(
            action.dueDate,
          ).getTime();


        return (
          Number.isFinite(
            due,
          ) &&
          due <
            capturedTime
        );
      },
    ).length;


  const done =
    actions.filter(
      (
        action,
      ) =>
        action.status ===
        "DONE",
    ).length;


  return {
    schemaVersion:
      1,

    capturedAt,

    kpis: {
      actualPeriods:
        actuals.length,

      matchedPeriods:
        variance.summary
          .matchedPeriods,

      revenueVarianceRate:
        variance.summary
          .revenueVarianceRate,

      ebitdaVarianceRate:
        variance.summary
          .ebitdaVarianceRate,

      forecastAccuracyScore:
        accuracy
          .overallAccuracyScore,

      forecastWape:
        accuracy
          .overallWape,

      liquidityRiskLevel:
        risk.level,

      liquidityRiskScore:
        risk.score,

      minimumForecastCash:
        risk.minimumForecastCash,

      minimumDownsideCash:
        risk.minimumDownsideCash,

      downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
        risk
          .firstDownsideCashExhaustionPeriod,

      capitalNeed:
        capital
          .requiredCapitalAfterRaise,
    },

    actions: {
      open:
        openActions.length,

      criticalOpen,

      overdue,

      done,
    },

    signals,
  };
}
