##### FILE: ./lib/finance/board-room/validation.ts #####
import {
  DECISION_SOURCE_CODES,
  type DecisionSignalCategory,
  type DecisionSignalSeverity,
  type DecisionSourceCode,
  type ExecutiveDecisionSignal,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/types";

import type {
  ExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/types";

import {
  parseMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";


type JsonRecord =
  Record<
    string,
    unknown
  >;


const RISK_LEVELS = [
  "LOW",
  "MODERATE",
  "HIGH",
  "CRITICAL",
] as const;


const SIGNAL_SEVERITIES:
  DecisionSignalSeverity[] = [
    "INFO",
    "WARNING",
    "CRITICAL",
  ];


const SIGNAL_CATEGORIES:
  DecisionSignalCategory[] = [
    "PERFORMANCE",
    "FORECAST",
    "LIQUIDITY",
    "CAPITAL",
  ];


function isRecord(
  value:
    unknown,
): value is
  JsonRecord {
  return (
    typeof value ===
      "object" &&
    value !==
      null &&
    !Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  );
}


function requiredString(
  value:
    unknown,
  field:
    string,
): string {
  if (
    typeof value !==
      "string"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid ${field}.`,
    );
  }


  return value;
}


function requiredNumber(
  value:
    unknown,
  field:
    string,
): number {
  if (
    typeof value !==
      "number" ||
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid ${field}.`,
    );
  }


  return value;
}


function nullableNumber(
  value:
    unknown,
  field:
    string,
): number |
  null {
  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return requiredNumber(
    value,
    field,
  );
}


function signal(
  value:
    unknown,
): ExecutiveDecisionSignal {
  if (
    !isRecord(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid executive review signal.",
    );
  }


  const code =
    requiredString(
      value.code,
      "signal code",
    ) as
      DecisionSourceCode;


  if (
    !DECISION_SOURCE_CODES.includes(
      code,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid executive signal code.",
    );
  }


  const category =
    requiredString(
      value.category,
      "signal category",
    ) as
      DecisionSignalCategory;


  if (
    !SIGNAL_CATEGORIES.includes(
      category,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid executive signal category.",
    );
  }


  const severity =
    requiredString(
      value.severity,
      "signal severity",
    ) as
      DecisionSignalSeverity;


  if (
    !SIGNAL_SEVERITIES.includes(
      severity,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid executive signal severity.",
    );
  }


  return {
    code,

    category,

    severity,

    title:
      requiredString(
        value.title,
        "signal title",
      ),

    message:
      requiredString(
        value.message,
        "signal message",
      ),

    actionHint:
      requiredString(
        value.actionHint,
        "signal action hint",
      ),

    hrefSuffix:
      requiredString(
        value.hrefSuffix,
        "signal source link",
      ),
  };
}


export function parseExecutiveReviewPeriod(
  raw:
    string,
): string {
  const parsed =
    parseMonthKey(
      raw,
    );


  if (
    !parsed
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Review period must be a valid month.",
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


export function parseExecutiveReviewSnapshot(
  value:
    unknown,
): ExecutiveReviewSnapshot {
  if (
    !isRecord(
      value,
    ) ||
    value.schemaVersion !==
      1 ||
    typeof value.capturedAt !==
      "string" ||
    !isRecord(
      value.kpis,
    ) ||
    !isRecord(
      value.actions,
    ) ||
    !Array.isArray(
      value.signals,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid executive review snapshot.",
    );
  }


  const riskLevel =
    requiredString(
      value.kpis
        .liquidityRiskLevel,
      "liquidity risk level",
    ) as
      typeof RISK_LEVELS[
        number
      ];


  if (
    !RISK_LEVELS.includes(
      riskLevel,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid executive review risk level.",
    );
  }


  return {
    schemaVersion:
      1,

    capturedAt:
      value.capturedAt,

    kpis: {
      actualPeriods:
        requiredNumber(
          value.kpis
            .actualPeriods,
          "actual periods",
        ),

      matchedPeriods:
        requiredNumber(
          value.kpis
            .matchedPeriods,
          "matched periods",
        ),

      revenueVarianceRate:
        nullableNumber(
          value.kpis
            .revenueVarianceRate,
          "revenue variance",
        ),

      ebitdaVarianceRate:
        nullableNumber(
          value.kpis
            .ebitdaVarianceRate,
          "EBITDA variance",
        ),

      forecastAccuracyScore:
        nullableNumber(
          value.kpis
            .forecastAccuracyScore,
          "forecast accuracy",
        ),

      forecastWape:
        nullableNumber(
          value.kpis
            .forecastWape,
          "forecast WAPE",
        ),

      liquidityRiskLevel:
        riskLevel,

      liquidityRiskScore:
        requiredNumber(
          value.kpis
            .liquidityRiskScore,
          "liquidity risk score",
        ),

      minimumForecastCash:
        nullableNumber(
          value.kpis
            .minimumForecastCash,
          "minimum forecast cash",
        ),

      minimumDownsideCash:
        nullableNumber(
          value.kpis
            .minimumDownsideCash,
          "minimum downside cash",
        ),

      downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
        value.kpis
          .downsideCashExhaustionPeriod ===
          null
          ?
            null
          :
            requiredString(
              value.kpis
                .downsideCashExhaustionPeriod,
              "downside exhaustion period",
            ),

      capitalNeed:
        requiredNumber(
          value.kpis
            .capitalNeed,
          "capital need",
        ),
    },

    actions: {
      open:
        requiredNumber(
          value.actions
            .open,
          "open actions",
        ),

      criticalOpen:
        requiredNumber(
          value.actions
            .criticalOpen,
          "critical open actions",
        ),

      overdue:
        requiredNumber(
          value.actions
            .overdue,
          "overdue actions",
        ),

      done:
        requiredNumber(
          value.actions
            .done,
          "done actions",
        ),
    },

    signals:
      value.signals.map(
        signal,
      ),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/capital-planning/calculations.ts #####
import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import {
  parseMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";

import {
  buildDownsideCashScenario,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/calculations";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";

import type {
  AdjustedCapitalCashPoint,
  CapitalCashPoint,
  CapitalPlanningBasis,
  CapitalPlanningInputs,
  CapitalPlanningReport,
  CapitalStrategyKind,
  CapitalStrategyResult,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/types";


type NormalizedForecast = {
  period:
    string;

  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow;
};


function normalizeForecast(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null,
): NormalizedForecast[] {
  const normalized =
    rows.flatMap<
      NormalizedForecast
    >(
      (
        row,
      ): NormalizedForecast[] => {
        const period =
          parseMonthKey(
            row.period,
          );


        return period
          ?
            [
              {
                period,
                row,
              },
            ]
          :
            [];
      },
    );


  const ordered =
    [
      ...normalized,
    ].sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) =>
        left.period.localeCompare(
          right.period,
        ),
    );


  if (
    !latestActualPeriod
  ) {
    return ordered;
  }


  const future =
    ordered.filter(
      (
        entry,
      ) =>
        entry.period >
        latestActualPeriod,
    );


  return future.length >
    0
    ?
      future
    :
      ordered;
}


function cashFlowProxy(
  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow,
): number {
  return (
    row.cashFlow ??
    row.netIncome ??
    row.ebitda ??
    0
  );
}


export function buildBaseCapitalCashPath({
  rows,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
}: {
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;
}): CapitalCashPoint[] {
  const normalized =
    normalizeForecast(
      rows,
      latestActualPeriod,
    );


  let runningCash =
    latestActualCash ??
    0;


  return normalized.map(
    (
      entry,
    ) => {
      if (
        entry.row.cashBalance !==
        null
      ) {
        runningCash =
          entry.row.cashBalance;
      }
      else {
        runningCash +=
          cashFlowProxy(
            entry.row,
          );
      }


      return {
        period:
          entry.period,

        cashBalance:
          runningCash,
      };
    },
  );
}


export function buildCapitalSourceCashPath({
  basis,
  rows,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
}: {
  basis:
    CapitalPlanningBasis;

  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;
}): CapitalCashPoint[] {
  if (
    basis ===
    "DOWNSIDE"
  ) {
    return buildDownsideCashScenario(
      rows,
      riskPolicy,
      latestActualPeriod,
      latestActualCash,
    ).map(
      (
        point,
      ) => ({
        period:
          point.period,

        cashBalance:
          point.stressedCashBalance,
      }),
    );
  }


  return buildBaseCapitalCashPath({
    rows,

    latestActualPeriod,

    latestActualCash,
  });
}


function minimumCash(
  path:
    CapitalCashPoint[],
): number |
  null {
  return path.length ===
    0
    ?
      null
    :
      Math.min(
        ...path.map(
          (
            point,
          ) =>
            point.cashBalance,
        ),
      );
}


function endingCash(
  path:
    CapitalCashPoint[],
): number |
  null {
  return path.length ===
    0
    ?
      null
    :
      path[
        path.length -
        1
      ].cashBalance;
}


function firstCashExhaustion(
  path:
    CapitalCashPoint[],
): string |
  null {
  return path.find(
    (
      point,
    ) =>
      point.cashBalance <=
      0,
  )?.period ??
    null;
}


function clampedRaiseIndex(
  path:
    CapitalCashPoint[],
  requested:
    number,
): number {
  if (
    path.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return 0;
  }


  return Math.min(
    path.length -
      1,
    Math.max(
      0,
      Math.trunc(
        requested,
      ),
    ),
  );
}


export function minimumCapitalRequired({
  path,
  targetCashFloor,
  raisePeriodIndex,
}: {
  path:
    CapitalCashPoint[];

  targetCashFloor:
    number;

  raisePeriodIndex:
    number;
}): number {
  if (
    path.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return 0;
  }


  const index =
    clampedRaiseIndex(
      path,
      raisePeriodIndex,
    );


  const minimumAfterRaise =
    Math.min(
      ...path
        .slice(
          index,
        )
        .map(
          (
            point,
          ) =>
            point.cashBalance,
        ),
    );


  return Math.max(
    0,
    targetCashFloor -
      minimumAfterRaise,
  );
}


export function firstPreRaiseFloorBreach({
  path,
  targetCashFloor,
  raisePeriodIndex,
}: {
  path:
    CapitalCashPoint[];

  targetCashFloor:
    number;

  raisePeriodIndex:
    number;
}): string |
  null {
  if (
    path.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const index =
    clampedRaiseIndex(
      path,
      raisePeriodIndex,
    );


  return path
    .slice(
      0,
      index,
    )
    .find(
      (
        point,
      ) =>
        point.cashBalance <
        targetCashFloor,
    )
    ?.period ??
    null;
}


export function amortizedMonthlyPayment({
  principal,
  annualRate,
  termMonths,
}: {
  principal:
    number;

  annualRate:
    number;

  termMonths:
    number;
}): number {
  if (
    principal <=
    0
  ) {
    return 0;
  }


  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      termMonths,
    ) ||
    termMonths <=
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Debt term must be a positive whole number of months.",
    );
  }


  if (
    annualRate <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Debt interest rate cannot be negative.",
    );
  }


  const monthlyRate =
    annualRate /
    12;


  if (
    monthlyRate ===
      0
  ) {
    return principal /
      termMonths;
  }


  return (
    principal *
    monthlyRate /
    (
      1 -
      (
        1 +
        monthlyRate
      ) **
      -termMonths
    )
  );
}


export function equityDilution({
  equityAmount,
  preMoneyValuation,
}: {
  equityAmount:
    number;

  preMoneyValuation:
    number;
}): number |
  null {
  if (
    equityAmount <=
    0
  ) {
    return 0;
  }


  if (
    preMoneyValuation <=
    0
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return (
    equityAmount /
    (
      preMoneyValuation +
      equityAmount
    )
  );
}


function strategyMix({
  kind,
  capitalAmount,
  hybridEquityShare,
}: {
  kind:
    CapitalStrategyKind;

  capitalAmount:
    number;

  hybridEquityShare:
    number;
}): {
  equityAmount:
    number;

  debtAmount:
    number;
} {
  switch (
    kind
  ) {
    case "EQUITY":
      return {
        equityAmount:
          capitalAmount,

        debtAmount:
          0,
      };


    case "DEBT":
      return {
        equityAmount:
          0,

        debtAmount:
          capitalAmount,
      };


    case "HYBRID": {
      const equityAmount =
        capitalAmount *
        hybridEquityShare;


      return {
        equityAmount,

        debtAmount:
          capitalAmount -
          equityAmount,
      };
    }
  }
}


export function calculateCapitalStrategy({
  kind,
  path,
  inputs,
}: {
  kind:
    CapitalStrategyKind;

  path:
    CapitalCashPoint[];

  inputs:
    CapitalPlanningInputs;
}): CapitalStrategyResult {
  const capitalAmount =
    Math.max(
      0,
      inputs.capitalAmount,
    );


  const raiseIndex =
    clampedRaiseIndex(
      path,
      inputs.raisePeriodIndex,
    );


  const mix =
    strategyMix({
      kind,

      capitalAmount,

      hybridEquityShare:
        Math.min(
          1,
          Math.max(
            0,
            inputs.hybridEquityShare,
          ),
        ),
    });


  const monthlyDebtService =
    amortizedMonthlyPayment({
      principal:
        mix.debtAmount,

      annualRate:
        inputs.annualDebtRate,

      termMonths:
        inputs.debtTermMonths,
    });


  const totalDebtInterest =
    mix.debtAmount ===
      0
      ?
        0
      :
        (
          monthlyDebtService *
          inputs.debtTermMonths
        ) -
        mix.debtAmount;


  const cashPath:
    AdjustedCapitalCashPoint[] =
      path.map(
        (
          point,
          index,
        ) => {
          const injected =
            index >=
              raiseIndex
              ?
                capitalAmount
              :
                0;


          const elapsedPaymentMonths =
            index >
              raiseIndex
              ?
                Math.min(
                  index -
                    raiseIndex,
                  inputs.debtTermMonths,
                )
              :
                0;


          const cumulativeDebtService =
            monthlyDebtService *
            elapsedPaymentMonths;


          return {
            period:
              point.period,

            sourceCashBalance:
              point.cashBalance,

            adjustedCashBalance:
              point.cashBalance +
              injected -
              cumulativeDebtService,

            cumulativeDebtService,
          };
        },
      );


  const adjustedBalances =
    cashPath.map(
      (
        point,
      ) =>
        point.adjustedCashBalance,
    );


  const minimum =
    adjustedBalances.length ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        Math.min(
          ...adjustedBalances,
        );


  const ending =
    adjustedBalances.length ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        adjustedBalances[
          adjustedBalances.length -
          1
        ];


  const floorBreach =
    cashPath.find(
      (
        point,
      ) =>
        point.adjustedCashBalance <
        inputs.targetCashFloor,
    );


  const exhaustion =
    cashPath.find(
      (
        point,
      ) =>
        point.adjustedCashBalance <=
        0,
    );


  return {
    kind,

    capitalAmount,

    equityAmount:
      mix.equityAmount,

    debtAmount:
      mix.debtAmount,

    dilution:
      equityDilution({
        equityAmount:
          mix.equityAmount,

        preMoneyValuation:
          inputs.preMoneyValuation,
      }),

    monthlyDebtService,

    totalDebtInterest,

    minimumCash:
      minimum,

    endingCash:
      ending,

    floorBreachPeriod:
      floorBreach?.period ??
      null,

    cashExhaustionPeriod:
      exhaustion?.period ??
      null,

    monthsBelowFloor:
      cashPath.filter(
        (
          point,
        ) =>
          point.adjustedCashBalance <
          inputs.targetCashFloor,
      ).length,

    cashPath,
  };
}


export function calculateCapitalPlanningReport({
  basis,
  rows,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
  inputs,
}: {
  basis:
    CapitalPlanningBasis;

  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  inputs:
    CapitalPlanningInputs;
}): CapitalPlanningReport {
  if (
    inputs.targetCashFloor <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Target cash floor cannot be negative.",
    );
  }


  if (
    inputs.capitalAmount <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Capital amount cannot be negative.",
    );
  }


  if (
    inputs.preMoneyValuation <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Pre-money valuation cannot be negative.",
    );
  }


  if (
    inputs.annualDebtRate <
      0 ||
    inputs.annualDebtRate >
      1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Annual debt rate must be between 0 and 100%.",
    );
  }


  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      inputs.debtTermMonths,
    ) ||
    inputs.debtTermMonths <
      1 ||
    inputs.debtTermMonths >
      120
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Debt term must be between 1 and 120 months.",
    );
  }


  if (
    inputs.hybridEquityShare <
      0 ||
    inputs.hybridEquityShare >
      1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Hybrid equity share must be between 0 and 100%.",
    );
  }


  const sourcePath =
    buildCapitalSourceCashPath({
      basis,

      rows,

      riskPolicy,

      latestActualPeriod,

      latestActualCash,
    });


  const raisePeriodIndex =
    clampedRaiseIndex(
      sourcePath,
      inputs.raisePeriodIndex,
    );


  const requiredCapitalAfterRaise =
    minimumCapitalRequired({
      path:
        sourcePath,

      targetCashFloor:
        inputs.targetCashFloor,

      raisePeriodIndex,
    });


  const preRaiseFloorBreachPeriod =
    firstPreRaiseFloorBreach({
      path:
        sourcePath,

      targetCashFloor:
        inputs.targetCashFloor,

      raisePeriodIndex,
    });


  return {
    basis,

    targetCashFloor:
      inputs.targetCashFloor,

    raisePeriodIndex,

    raisePeriod:
      sourcePath[
        raisePeriodIndex
      ]?.period ??
      null,

    sourcePath,

    sourceMinimumCash:
      minimumCash(
        sourcePath,
      ),

    sourceEndingCash:
      endingCash(
        sourcePath,
      ),

    sourceCashExhaustionPeriod:
      firstCashExhaustion(
        sourcePath,
      ),

    requiredCapitalAfterRaise,

    preRaiseFloorBreachPeriod,

    strategies: (
      [
        "EQUITY",
        "DEBT",
        "HYBRID",
      ] as const
    ).map(
      (
        kind,
      ) =>
        calculateCapitalStrategy({
          kind,

          path:
            sourcePath,

          inputs: {
            ...inputs,

            raisePeriodIndex,
          },
        }),
    ),
  };
}

import {
  averageDecimals,
  decimal,
  sumDecimals,
  toFinancialString,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  MonthlyForecast,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export type AnnualCashAnalytics = {
  year: number;

  monthsIncluded: number;

  openingCash: string;

  operatingCashInflow: string;

  operatingCashOutflow: string;

  operatingCashFlow: string;

  financingInflow: string;

  debtPrincipalRepayment: string;

  netCashMovement: string;

  endingCash: string;

  grossBurn: string;

  netBurn: string;

  averageGrossBurn: string;

  averageNetBurn: string;
};

export type CashForecastSummary = {
  startingCash: string;

  endingCash: string;

  totalFinancingInflow: string;

  totalPrincipalRepayment: string;

  minimumEndingCash: string;
};

export function calculateCashForecastSummary(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
): CashForecastSummary {
  if (
    months.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return {
      startingCash:
        "0",

      endingCash:
        "0",

      totalFinancingInflow:
        "0",

      totalPrincipalRepayment:
        "0",

      minimumEndingCash:
        "0",
    };
  }

  const minimumEndingCash =
    months.reduce(
      (
        minimum,
        month,
      ) => {
        const current =
          decimal(
            month.endingCash,
          );

        return current.lt(
          minimum,
        )
          ? current
          : minimum;
      },
      decimal(
        months[0]
          .endingCash,
      ),
    );

  return {
    startingCash:
      months[0]
        .openingCash,

    endingCash:
      months[
        months.length -
          1
      ].endingCash,

    totalFinancingInflow:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          months.map(
            (
              month,
            ) =>
              month.financingInflows
                .total,
          ),
        ),
      ),

    totalPrincipalRepayment:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          months.map(
            (
              month,
            ) =>
              month.debtPrincipalRepayment,
          ),
        ),
      ),

    minimumEndingCash:
      toFinancialString(
        minimumEndingCash,
      ),
  };
}

export function aggregateCashAnalytics(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
): AnnualCashAnalytics[] {
  const grouped =
    new Map<
      number,
      MonthlyForecast[]
    >();

  for (
    const month
    of months
  ) {
    const group =
      grouped.get(
        month.year,
      ) ??
      [];

    group.push(
      month,
    );

    grouped.set(
      month.year,
      group,
    );
  }

  return Array.from(
    grouped.entries(),
  )
    .sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) =>
        left[0] -
        right[0],
    )
    .map(
      (
        [
          year,
          yearMonths,
        ],
      ) => {
        const first =
          yearMonths[0];

        const last =
          yearMonths[
            yearMonths.length -
              1
          ];

        const grossBurnValues =
          yearMonths.map(
            (
              month,
            ) =>
              decimal(
                month.grossBurn,
              ),
          );

        const netBurnValues =
          yearMonths.map(
            (
              month,
            ) =>
              decimal(
                month.netBurn,
              ),
          );

        return {
          year,

          monthsIncluded:
            yearMonths.length,

          openingCash:
            first.openingCash,

          operatingCashInflow:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.operatingCashInflow,
                ),
              ),
            ),

          operatingCashOutflow:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.operatingCashOutflow,
                ),
              ),
            ),

          operatingCashFlow:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.operatingCashFlow,
                ),
              ),
            ),

          financingInflow:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.financingInflows
                      .total,
                ),
              ),
            ),

          debtPrincipalRepayment:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.debtPrincipalRepayment,
                ),
              ),
            ),

          netCashMovement:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.netCashMovement,
                ),
              ),
            ),

          endingCash:
            last.endingCash,

          grossBurn:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.grossBurn,
                ),
              ),
            ),

          netBurn:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.netBurn,
                ),
              ),
            ),

          averageGrossBurn:
            toFinancialString(
              averageDecimals(
                grossBurnValues,
              ),
            ),

          averageNetBurn:
            toFinancialString(
              averageDecimals(
                netBurnValues,
              ),
            ),
        };
      },
    );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/consolidation/calculations.ts #####
import Decimal from "decimal.js";

import {
  convertCurrencyAmount,
  resolveWorkspaceFxRate,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/fx";

import type {
  ConsolidatedPortfolioReport,
  VentureScopeCurrency,
  WorkspaceFxRateView,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/types";


export type ConsolidationAnalyticsInput = {
  projectId:
    string;

  name:
    string;

  industry:
    string;

  currency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  capitalNeed:
    number |
    null;

  forecastAvailable:
    boolean;
};


export function buildConsolidatedPortfolioReport({
  projects,
  reportingCurrency,
  asOfDate,
  rates,
}: {
  projects:
    ConsolidationAnalyticsInput[];

  reportingCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;

  asOfDate:
    string;

  rates:
    WorkspaceFxRateView[];
}): ConsolidatedPortfolioReport {
  let totalCash =
    new Decimal(
      0,
    );


  let totalCapitalNeed =
    new Decimal(
      0,
    );


  let missingCashRates =
    0;


  let missingCapitalRates =
    0;


  const rows =
    projects.map(
      (
        project,
      ) => {
        const needsFx =
          project.currency !==
          reportingCurrency;


        const amountRequiresRate =
          (
            project.latestActualCash !==
              null &&
            project.latestActualCash !==
              0
          ) ||
          (
            project.capitalNeed !==
              null &&
            project.capitalNeed !==
              0
          );


        const resolvedFx =
          needsFx &&
          amountRequiresRate
            ?
              resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
                sourceCurrency:
                  project.currency,

                reportingCurrency,

                asOfDate,

                rates,
              })
            :
              resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
                sourceCurrency:
                  reportingCurrency,

                reportingCurrency,

                asOfDate,

                rates,
              });


        let consolidatedCash:
          number |
          null =
            null;


        if (
          project.latestActualCash !==
          null
        ) {
          if (
            project.latestActualCash ===
            0
          ) {
            consolidatedCash =
              0;
          }
          else if (
            resolvedFx &&
            (
              !needsFx ||
              resolvedFx.sourceCurrency ===
                project.currency
            )
          ) {
            consolidatedCash =
              convertCurrencyAmount({
                amount:
                  project.latestActualCash,

                fx:
                  resolvedFx,
              });
          }
          else {
            missingCashRates +=
              1;
          }
        }


        let consolidatedCapitalNeed:
          number |
          null =
            null;


        if (
          project.capitalNeed !==
          null
        ) {
          if (
            project.capitalNeed ===
            0
          ) {
            consolidatedCapitalNeed =
              0;
          }
          else if (
            resolvedFx &&
            (
              !needsFx ||
              resolvedFx.sourceCurrency ===
                project.currency
            )
          ) {
            consolidatedCapitalNeed =
              convertCurrencyAmount({
                amount:
                  project.capitalNeed,

                fx:
                  resolvedFx,
              });
          }
          else {
            missingCapitalRates +=
              1;
          }
        }


        if (
          consolidatedCash !==
          null
        ) {
          totalCash =
            totalCash.plus(
              consolidatedCash,
            );
        }


        if (
          consolidatedCapitalNeed !==
          null
        ) {
          totalCapitalNeed =
            totalCapitalNeed.plus(
              consolidatedCapitalNeed,
            );
        }


        return {
          projectId:
            project.projectId,

          name:
            project.name,

          industry:
            project.industry,

          sourceCurrency:
            project.currency,

          latestActualPeriod:
            project.latestActualPeriod,

          latestActualCash:
            project.latestActualCash,

          capitalNeed:
            project.capitalNeed,

          forecastAvailable:
            project.forecastAvailable,

          resolvedFx:
            needsFx
              ?
                resolvedFx
              :
                resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
                  sourceCurrency:
                    project.currency,

                  reportingCurrency,

                  asOfDate,

                  rates,
                }),

          consolidatedCash,

          consolidatedCapitalNeed,
        };
      },
    );


  return {
    reportingCurrency,

    asOfDate,

    rows,

    totalCash:
      totalCash
        .toDecimalPlaces(
          8,
        )
        .toNumber(),

    totalCapitalNeed:
      totalCapitalNeed
        .toDecimalPlaces(
          8,
        )
        .toNumber(),

    projects:
      rows.length,

    forecastReady:
      rows.filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.forecastAvailable,
      ).length,

    missingCashRates,

    missingCapitalRates,

    complete:
      missingCashRates ===
        0 &&
      missingCapitalRates ===
        0,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/consolidation/fx.ts #####
import Decimal from "decimal.js";

import type {
  ResolvedFxRate,
  VentureScopeCurrency,
  WorkspaceFxRateView,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/types";


function applicableRates({
  rates,
  asOfDate,
}: {
  rates:
    WorkspaceFxRateView[];

  asOfDate:
    string;
}) {
  return rates
    .filter(
      (
        rate,
      ) =>
        rate.effectiveDate <=
        asOfDate,
    )
    .sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) =>
        right.effectiveDate.localeCompare(
          left.effectiveDate,
        ),
    );
}


export function resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
  sourceCurrency,
  reportingCurrency,
  asOfDate,
  rates,
}: {
  sourceCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;

  reportingCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;

  asOfDate:
    string;

  rates:
    WorkspaceFxRateView[];
}): ResolvedFxRate |
  null {
  if (
    sourceCurrency ===
    reportingCurrency
  ) {
    return {
      sourceCurrency,

      reportingCurrency,

      rate:
        1,

      effectiveDate:
        null,

      sourceLabel:
        "Identity conversion",

      direction:
        "IDENTITY",
    };
  }


  const eligible =
    applicableRates({
      rates,

      asOfDate,
    });


  const direct =
    eligible.find(
      (
        rate,
      ) =>
        rate.baseCurrency ===
          sourceCurrency &&
        rate.quoteCurrency ===
          reportingCurrency,
    );


  if (
    direct
  ) {
    return {
      sourceCurrency,

      reportingCurrency,

      rate:
        direct.rate,

      effectiveDate:
        direct.effectiveDate,

      sourceLabel:
        direct.sourceLabel,

      direction:
        "DIRECT",
    };
  }


  const inverse =
    eligible.find(
      (
        rate,
      ) =>
        rate.baseCurrency ===
          reportingCurrency &&
        rate.quoteCurrency ===
          sourceCurrency,
    );


  if (
    inverse
  ) {
    return {
      sourceCurrency,

      reportingCurrency,

      rate:
        new Decimal(
          1,
        )
          .div(
            inverse.rate,
          )
          .toNumber(),

      effectiveDate:
        inverse.effectiveDate,

      sourceLabel:
        `${inverse.sourceLabel} · inverse`,

      direction:
        "INVERSE",
    };
  }


  return null;
}


export function convertCurrencyAmount({
  amount,
  fx,
}: {
  amount:
    number;

  fx:
    ResolvedFxRate;
}): number {
  if (
    amount ===
    0
  ) {
    return 0;
  }


  return new Decimal(
    amount,
  )
    .mul(
      fx.rate,
    )
    .toDecimalPlaces(
      8,
    )
    .toNumber();
}

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import type {
  VentureScopeCurrency,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/types";


const MAX_WORKSPACE_FX_RATES =
  500;


export async function saveConsolidationSettings({
  projectId,
  workspaceId,
  actorUserId,
  reportingCurrency,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  workspaceId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  reportingCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;
}) {
  return prisma.$transaction(
    async (
      transaction,
    ) => {
      const settings =
        await transaction.workspaceConsolidationSettings.upsert({
          where: {
            workspaceId,
          },

          create: {
            workspaceId,

            reportingCurrency,

            createdByUserId:
              actorUserId,

            updatedByUserId:
              actorUserId,
          },

          update: {
            reportingCurrency,

            updatedByUserId:
              actorUserId,
          },
        });


      await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
        data: {
          projectId,

          category:
            "PROJECT",

          action:
            "CONSOLIDATION_REPORTING_CURRENCY_UPDATED",

          severity:
            "INFO",

          actorUserId,

          entityType:
            "WorkspaceConsolidationSettings",

          entityId:
            workspaceId,

          summary:
            `Consolidation reporting currency set to ${reportingCurrency}`,

          metadata: {
            workspaceId,

            reportingCurrency,
          },
        },
      });


      return settings;
    },
  );
}


export async function saveWorkspaceFxRate({
  projectId,
  workspaceId,
  actorUserId,
  baseCurrency,
  quoteCurrency,
  rate,
  effectiveDate,
  sourceLabel,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  workspaceId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  baseCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;

  quoteCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;

  rate:
    number;

  effectiveDate:
    Date;

  sourceLabel:
    string;
}) {
  return prisma.$transaction(
    async (
      transaction,
    ) => {
      const existing =
        await transaction.workspaceFxRate.findUnique({
          where: {
            workspaceId_baseCurrency_quoteCurrency_effectiveDate: {
              workspaceId,

              baseCurrency,

              quoteCurrency,

              effectiveDate,
            },
          },

          select: {
            id:
              true,

            rate:
              true,
          },
        });


      if (
        !existing
      ) {
        const count =
          await transaction.workspaceFxRate.count({
            where: {
              workspaceId,
            },
          });


        if (
          count >=
          MAX_WORKSPACE_FX_RATES
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `A workspace may contain at most ${MAX_WORKSPACE_FX_RATES} manual FX rates.`,
          );
        }
      }


      const saved =
        await transaction.workspaceFxRate.upsert({
          where: {
            workspaceId_baseCurrency_quoteCurrency_effectiveDate: {
              workspaceId,

              baseCurrency,

              quoteCurrency,

              effectiveDate,
            },
          },

          create: {
            workspaceId,

            baseCurrency,

            quoteCurrency,

            rate,

            effectiveDate,

            sourceLabel,

            createdByUserId:
              actorUserId,
          },

          update: {
            rate,

            sourceLabel,
          },
        });


      await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
        data: {
          projectId,

          category:
            "PROJECT",

          action:
            existing
              ?
                "WORKSPACE_FX_RATE_UPDATED"
              :
                "WORKSPACE_FX_RATE_CREATED",

          severity:
            "INFO",

          actorUserId,

          entityType:
            "WorkspaceFxRate",

          entityId:
            saved.id,

          summary:
            `${baseCurrency}/${quoteCurrency} FX rate ${existing ? "updated" : "created"}`,

          metadata: {
            workspaceId,

            baseCurrency,

            quoteCurrency,

            rate,

            effectiveDate:
              effectiveDate
                .toISOString()
                .slice(
                  0,
                  10,
                ),

            sourceLabel,

            previousRate:
              existing?.rate
                .toString() ??
              null,
          },
        },
      });


      return saved;
    },
  );
}


export async function deleteWorkspaceFxRate({
  projectId,
  workspaceId,
  actorUserId,
  rateId,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  workspaceId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  rateId:
    string;
}) {
  return prisma.$transaction(
    async (
      transaction,
    ) => {
      const rate =
        await transaction.workspaceFxRate.findFirst({
          where: {
            id:
              rateId,

            workspaceId,
          },
        });


      if (
        !rate
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "FX rate was not found in this workspace.",
        );
      }


      await transaction.workspaceFxRate.delete({
        where: {
          id:
            rate.id,
        },
      });


      await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
        data: {
          projectId,

          category:
            "PROJECT",

          action:
            "WORKSPACE_FX_RATE_DELETED",

          severity:
            "WARNING",

          actorUserId,

          entityType:
            "WorkspaceFxRate",

          entityId:
            rate.id,

          summary:
            `${rate.baseCurrency}/${rate.quoteCurrency} FX rate deleted`,

          metadata: {
            workspaceId,

            baseCurrency:
              rate.baseCurrency,

            quoteCurrency:
              rate.quoteCurrency,

            rate:
              rate.rate.toString(),

            effectiveDate:
              rate.effectiveDate
                .toISOString()
                .slice(
                  0,
                  10,
                ),

            sourceLabel:
              rate.sourceLabel,
          },
        },
      });


      return rate;
    },
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/consolidation/validation.ts #####
import {
  VENTURESCOPE_CURRENCIES,
  type VentureScopeCurrency,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/types";


export function parseVentureScopeCurrency(
  value:
    string,
): VentureScopeCurrency {
  const normalized =
    value
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();


  if (
    VENTURESCOPE_CURRENCIES.includes(
      normalized as
        VentureScopeCurrency,
    )
  ) {
    return normalized as
      VentureScopeCurrency;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Unsupported VentureScope currency.",
  );
}


export function parseFxRate(
  value:
    string,
): number {
  const parsed =
    Number(
      value,
    );


  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      parsed,
    ) ||
    parsed <=
      0 ||
    parsed >
      1_000_000
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "FX rate must be greater than zero and no greater than 1,000,000.",
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


export function parseFxDate(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value.trim();


  if (
    !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/u.test(
      normalized,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "FX effective date must use YYYY-MM-DD.",
    );
  }


  const date =
    new Date(
      `${normalized}T00:00:00.000Z`,
    );


  if (
    Number.isNaN(
      date.getTime(),
    ) ||
    date
      .toISOString()
      .slice(
        0,
        10,
      ) !==
      normalized
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "FX effective date is invalid.",
    );
  }


  return normalized;
}


export function parseFxSourceLabel(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value.trim();


  if (
    normalized.length <
      2 ||
    normalized.length >
      120
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "FX source label must contain between 2 and 120 characters.",
    );
  }


  return normalized;
}


export function assertDistinctCurrencyPair({
  baseCurrency,
  quoteCurrency,
}: {
  baseCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;

  quoteCurrency:
    VentureScopeCurrency;
}) {
  if (
    baseCurrency ===
    quoteCurrency
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Base and quote currencies must be different.",
    );
  }
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/customer-analytics.ts #####
import {
  decimal,
  sumDecimals,
  toFinancialString,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  MonthlyForecast,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export type CustomerForecastSummary = {
  startingCustomers: string;

  endingCustomers: string;

  totalPaidNewCustomers: string;

  totalOrganicNewCustomers: string;

  totalNewCustomers: string;

  totalChurnedCustomers: string;

  netCustomerGrowth: string;

  endingArpu: string;

  endingMrr: string;
};

export type AnnualCustomerAnalytics = {
  year: number;

  monthsIncluded: number;

  openingCustomers: string;

  paidNewCustomers: string;

  organicNewCustomers: string;

  newCustomers: string;

  churnedCustomers: string;

  endingCustomers: string;

  netCustomerGrowth: string;

  endingArpu: string;

  endingMrr: string;
};

function customerMonths(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
): MonthlyForecast[] {
  return months.filter(
    (
      month,
    ) =>
      month.endingCustomers !==
      null,
  );
}

export function calculateCustomerForecastSummary(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
): CustomerForecastSummary {
  const available =
    customerMonths(
      months,
    );

  if (
    available.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return {
      startingCustomers:
        "0",

      endingCustomers:
        "0",

      totalPaidNewCustomers:
        "0",

      totalOrganicNewCustomers:
        "0",

      totalNewCustomers:
        "0",

      totalChurnedCustomers:
        "0",

      netCustomerGrowth:
        "0",

      endingArpu:
        "0",

      endingMrr:
        "0",
    };
  }

  const first =
    available[0];

  const last =
    available[
      available.length -
        1
    ];

  const startingCustomers =
    decimal(
      first.openingCustomers ??
        "0",
    );

  const endingCustomers =
    decimal(
      last.endingCustomers ??
        "0",
    );

  return {
    startingCustomers:
      toFinancialString(
        startingCustomers,
      ),

    endingCustomers:
      toFinancialString(
        endingCustomers,
      ),

    totalPaidNewCustomers:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          available.map(
            (
              month,
            ) =>
              month.paidNewCustomers ??
              "0",
          ),
        ),
      ),

    totalOrganicNewCustomers:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          available.map(
            (
              month,
            ) =>
              month.organicNewCustomers ??
              "0",
          ),
        ),
      ),

    totalNewCustomers:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          available.map(
            (
              month,
            ) =>
              month.newCustomers ??
              "0",
          ),
        ),
      ),

    totalChurnedCustomers:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          available.map(
            (
              month,
            ) =>
              month.churnedCustomers ??
              "0",
          ),
        ),
      ),

    netCustomerGrowth:
      toFinancialString(
        endingCustomers.minus(
          startingCustomers,
        ),
      ),

    endingArpu:
      last.arpu ??
      "0",

    endingMrr:
      last.mrr,
  };
}

export function aggregateCustomerAnalytics(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
): AnnualCustomerAnalytics[] {
  const available =
    customerMonths(
      months,
    );

  const grouped =
    new Map<
      number,
      MonthlyForecast[]
    >();

  for (
    const month
    of available
  ) {
    const group =
      grouped.get(
        month.year,
      ) ??
      [];

    group.push(
      month,
    );

    grouped.set(
      month.year,
      group,
    );
  }

  return Array.from(
    grouped.entries(),
  )
    .sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) =>
        left[0] -
        right[0],
    )
    .map(
      (
        [
          year,
          yearMonths,
        ],
      ) => {
        const first =
          yearMonths[0];

        const last =
          yearMonths[
            yearMonths.length -
              1
          ];

        const openingCustomers =
          decimal(
            first.openingCustomers ??
              "0",
          );

        const endingCustomers =
          decimal(
            last.endingCustomers ??
              "0",
          );

        return {
          year,

          monthsIncluded:
            yearMonths.length,

          openingCustomers:
            toFinancialString(
              openingCustomers,
            ),

          paidNewCustomers:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.paidNewCustomers ??
                    "0",
                ),
              ),
            ),

          organicNewCustomers:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.organicNewCustomers ??
                    "0",
                ),
              ),
            ),

          newCustomers:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.newCustomers ??
                    "0",
                ),
              ),
            ),

          churnedCustomers:
            toFinancialString(
              sumDecimals(
                yearMonths.map(
                  (
                    month,
                  ) =>
                    month.churnedCustomers ??
                    "0",
                ),
              ),
            ),

          endingCustomers:
            toFinancialString(
              endingCustomers,
            ),

          netCustomerGrowth:
            toFinancialString(
              endingCustomers.minus(
                openingCustomers,
              ),
            ),

          endingArpu:
            last.arpu ??
            "0",

          endingMrr:
            last.mrr,
        };
      },
    );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/customer-engine.ts #####
import Decimal from "decimal.js";

import type {
  CustomerRevenueAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/types";
import {
  ZERO,
  compoundValue,
  decimal,
  maxZero,
  percentageToRate,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";

export type CustomerRevenueRuntimeOverrides = {
  cac?: string;

  monthlyChurnRate?: string;

  arpu?: string;
};

export type CustomerRevenueMonthResult = {
  openingCustomers: Decimal;

  paidNewCustomers: Decimal;
  organicNewCustomers: Decimal;
  newCustomers: Decimal;

  churnedCustomers: Decimal;
  endingCustomers: Decimal;

  arpu: Decimal;

  recurringRevenue: Decimal;
  nonRecurringRevenue: Decimal;
  oneTimeRevenue: Decimal;
  totalRevenue: Decimal;

  mrr: Decimal;
};

export function calculateCustomerRevenueMonth(
  assumptions: CustomerRevenueAssumptions,
  monthIndex: number,
  openingCustomers: Decimal,
  monthlyMarketingBudget: Decimal,
  runtimeOverrides: CustomerRevenueRuntimeOverrides = {},
): CustomerRevenueMonthResult {
  const cac =
    decimal(
      runtimeOverrides.cac ??
      assumptions.cac,
    );

  const acquisitionGrowthRate =
    percentageToRate(
      assumptions
        .customerAcquisitionGrowthRate,
    );

  const acquisitionGrowthFactor =
    compoundValue(
      1,
      acquisitionGrowthRate,
      monthIndex,
    );

  const paidAcquisitionBase =
    cac.gt(
      ZERO,
    )
      ? monthlyMarketingBudget.div(
          cac,
        )
      : new Decimal(
          0,
        );

  const organicAcquisitionBase =
    decimal(
      assumptions
        .organicNewCustomers,
    );

  const paidNewCustomers =
    paidAcquisitionBase.mul(
      acquisitionGrowthFactor,
    );

  const organicNewCustomers =
    organicAcquisitionBase.mul(
      acquisitionGrowthFactor,
    );

  const newCustomers =
    paidNewCustomers.plus(
      organicNewCustomers,
    );

  const churnRate =
    percentageToRate(
      runtimeOverrides.monthlyChurnRate ??
      assumptions
        .monthlyChurnRate,
    );

  const churnedCustomers =
    openingCustomers.mul(
      churnRate,
    );

  const endingCustomers =
    maxZero(
      openingCustomers
        .plus(
          newCustomers,
        )
        .minus(
          churnedCustomers,
        ),
    );

  const arpuGrowthRate =
    percentageToRate(
      assumptions
        .arpuGrowthRate,
    );

  const arpu =
    runtimeOverrides.arpu !==
    undefined
      ? decimal(
          runtimeOverrides.arpu,
        )
      : compoundValue(
          assumptions.arpu,
          arpuGrowthRate,
          monthIndex,
        );

  const mrr =
    endingCustomers.mul(
      arpu,
    );

  const oneTimeRevenue =
    decimal(
      assumptions
        .monthlyOneTimeRevenue,
    );

  const totalRevenue =
    mrr.plus(
      oneTimeRevenue,
    );

  return {
    openingCustomers,

    paidNewCustomers,
    organicNewCustomers,
    newCustomers,

    churnedCustomers,
    endingCustomers,

    arpu,

    recurringRevenue:
      mrr,

    nonRecurringRevenue:
      oneTimeRevenue,

    oneTimeRevenue,

    totalRevenue,

    mrr,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/dashboard-data.ts #####
import {
  decimal,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  MonthlyForecast,
  RevenueMode,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export type FinancialDashboardPoint = {
  month: string;

  revenue: number;

  totalExpenses: number;

  ebitda: number;

  endingCash: number;

  financingInflow: number;

  mrr: number;

  grossBurn: number;

  netBurn: number;

  endingCustomers: number | null;

  newCustomers: number | null;

  churnedCustomers: number | null;
};

export type FinancialDashboardData = {
  revenueMode: RevenueMode;

  points: FinancialDashboardPoint[];
};

function chartNumber(
  value:
    | string
    | null,
): number {
  if (
    value === null
  ) {
    return 0;
  }

  const result =
    decimal(
      value,
    ).toNumber();

  return Number.isFinite(
    result,
  )
    ? result
    : 0;
}

function nullableChartNumber(
  value:
    | string
    | null,
): number | null {
  if (
    value === null
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return chartNumber(
    value,
  );
}

export function buildFinancialDashboardData(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
  revenueMode: RevenueMode,
): FinancialDashboardData {
  return {
    revenueMode,

    points:
      months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) => ({
          month:
            month.month,

          revenue:
            chartNumber(
              month.revenue,
            ),

          totalExpenses:
            decimal(
              month.cogs,
            )
              .plus(
                month.totalOperatingExpenses,
              )
              .toNumber(),

          ebitda:
            chartNumber(
              month.ebitda,
            ),

          endingCash:
            chartNumber(
              month.endingCash,
            ),

          financingInflow:
            chartNumber(
              month.financingInflows
                .total,
            ),

          mrr:
            chartNumber(
              month.mrr,
            ),

          grossBurn:
            chartNumber(
              month.grossBurn,
            ),

          netBurn:
            chartNumber(
              month.netBurn,
            ),

          endingCustomers:
            nullableChartNumber(
              month.endingCustomers,
            ),

          newCustomers:
            nullableChartNumber(
              month.newCustomers,
            ),

          churnedCustomers:
            nullableChartNumber(
              month.churnedCustomers,
            ),
        }),
      ),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/dates.ts #####
import type {
  MonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

const MONTH_KEY_PATTERN =
  /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/;

export function assertMonthKey(
  value: string,
): asserts value is MonthKey {
  if (
    !MONTH_KEY_PATTERN.test(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid financial month: ${value}`,
    );
  }
}

export function monthKeyToSerial(
  value: MonthKey,
): number {
  assertMonthKey(
    value,
  );

  const match =
    MONTH_KEY_PATTERN.exec(
      value,
    );

  if (!match) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid financial month: ${value}`,
    );
  }

  const year =
    Number(
      match[1],
    );

  const month =
    Number(
      match[2],
    );

  return (
    year *
      12 +
    month -
    1
  );
}

export function serialToMonthKey(
  serial: number,
): MonthKey {
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      serial,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Month serial must be an integer.",
    );
  }

  const year =
    Math.floor(
      serial /
        12,
    );

  const zeroBasedMonth =
    serial -
    year *
      12;

  const month =
    zeroBasedMonth +
    1;

  return `${year}-${String(
    month,
  ).padStart(
    2,
    "0",
  )}`;
}

export function addMonths(
  month: MonthKey,
  amount: number,
): MonthKey {
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      amount,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Month offset must be an integer.",
    );
  }

  return serialToMonthKey(
    monthKeyToSerial(
      month,
    ) +
      amount,
  );
}

export function monthDistance(
  from: MonthKey,
  to: MonthKey,
): number {
  return (
    monthKeyToSerial(
      to,
    ) -
    monthKeyToSerial(
      from,
    )
  );
}

export function compareMonths(
  left: MonthKey,
  right: MonthKey,
): number {
  return (
    monthKeyToSerial(
      left,
    ) -
    monthKeyToSerial(
      right,
    )
  );
}

export function enumerateMonths(
  startMonth: MonthKey,
  count: number,
): MonthKey[] {
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      count,
    ) ||
    count <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Forecast month count must be a non-negative integer.",
    );
  }

  return Array.from(
    {
      length: count,
    },
    (
      _,
      index,
    ) =>
      addMonths(
        startMonth,
        index,
      ),
  );
}

export function yearFromMonth(
  month: MonthKey,
): number {
  assertMonthKey(
    month,
  );

  return Number(
    month.slice(
      0,
      4,
    ),
  );
}

export function monthNumberFromMonth(
  month: MonthKey,
): number {
  assertMonthKey(
    month,
  );

  return Number(
    month.slice(
      5,
      7,
    ),
  );
}

export function dateToMonthKey(
  date: Date,
): MonthKey {
  const year =
    date.getUTCFullYear();

  const month =
    String(
      date.getUTCMonth() +
        1,
    ).padStart(
      2,
      "0",
    );

  return `${year}-${month}`;
}

export * from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/signals";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";

import type {
  DecisionActionPriority,
  DecisionActionStatus,
  DecisionSourceCode,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/types";


export async function createDecisionAction({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  title,
  details,
  sourceCode,
  priority,
  ownerName,
  dueDate,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  title:
    string;

  details:
    string |
    null;

  sourceCode:
    DecisionSourceCode;

  priority:
    DecisionActionPriority;

  ownerName:
    string |
    null;

  dueDate:
    Date |
    null;
}) {
  const action =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const created =
          await transaction.decisionAction.create({
            data: {
              projectId,

              title,

              details,

              sourceCode,

              priority,

              ownerName,

              dueDate,

              createdByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              title:
                true,

              priority:
                true,

              status:
                true,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "DECISION_CENTER",

            action:
              "DECISION_ACTION_CREATED",

            severity:
              priority ===
                "CRITICAL"
                ?
                  "CRITICAL"
                :
              priority ===
                "HIGH"
                ?
                  "WARNING"
                :
                  "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "DecisionAction",

            entityId:
              created.id,

            summary:
              `Management action created: ${created.title}`,

            metadata: {
              priority:
                created.priority,

              status:
                created.status,

              sourceCode,
            },
          },
        });


        return created;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.decision-action.created",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      decisionActionId:
        action.id,

      priority:
        action.priority,

      status:
        action.status,
    },
  );


  return action;
}


export async function updateDecisionActionStatus({
  projectId,
  actionId,
  actorUserId,
  status,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actionId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  status:
    DecisionActionStatus;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const existing =
          await transaction.decisionAction.findFirst({
            where: {
              id:
                actionId,

              projectId,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              title:
                true,

              status:
                true,
            },
          });


        if (
          !existing
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Management action was not found in this project.",
          );
        }


        const updated =
          await transaction.decisionAction.update({
            where: {
              id:
                existing.id,
            },

            data: {
              status,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              status:
                true,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "DECISION_CENTER",

            action:
              "DECISION_ACTION_STATUS_CHANGED",

            severity:
              status ===
                "BLOCKED"
                ?
                  "WARNING"
                :
                  "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "DecisionAction",

            entityId:
              existing.id,

            summary:
              `Management action status changed: ${existing.title}`,

            metadata: {
              previousStatus:
                existing.status,

              status,
            },
          },
        });


        return updated;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.decision-action.status-changed",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      decisionActionId:
        actionId,

      status,
    },
  );


  return result;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/decision-center/signals.ts #####
import type {
  ExecutiveDecisionInputs,
  ExecutiveDecisionSignal,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/types";


const SEVERITY_ORDER = {
  CRITICAL:
    0,

  WARNING:
    1,

  INFO:
    2,
} as const;


export function buildExecutiveDecisionSignals(
  inputs:
    ExecutiveDecisionInputs,
): ExecutiveDecisionSignal[] {
  const signals:
    ExecutiveDecisionSignal[] =
      [];


  if (
    inputs.actualPeriods ===
    0
  ) {
    signals.push({
      code:
        "NO_ACTUALS",

      category:
        "PERFORMANCE",

      severity:
        "INFO",

      title:
        "Actual performance is not yet connected",

      message:
        "No monthly Actuals are available, so variance and forecast-accuracy intelligence are incomplete.",

      actionHint:
        "Import the latest monthly Actuals and establish the operating review cadence.",

      hrefSuffix:
        "actuals",
    });
  }


  if (
    inputs.liquidityRiskLevel ===
      "CRITICAL" ||
    inputs.liquidityRiskLevel ===
      "HIGH"
  ) {
    signals.push({
      code:
        "LIQUIDITY_RISK",

      category:
        "LIQUIDITY",

      severity:
        inputs.liquidityRiskLevel ===
          "CRITICAL"
          ?
            "CRITICAL"
          :
            "WARNING",

      title:
        `${inputs.liquidityRiskLevel.toLowerCase()} liquidity risk requires management attention`,

      message:
        "The current Risk Center assessment indicates material liquidity pressure against the configured financial guardrails.",

      actionHint:
        "Review cash guardrails, downside exposure, spending commitments, and funding timing.",

      hrefSuffix:
        "risk-center",
    });
  }


  if (
    inputs.downsideCashExhaustionPeriod
  ) {
    signals.push({
      code:
        "DOWNSIDE_EXHAUSTION",

      category:
        "LIQUIDITY",

      severity:
        "CRITICAL",

      title:
        "Downside case exhausts cash",

      message:
        `The deterministic downside stress reaches cash exhaustion in ${inputs.downsideCashExhaustionPeriod}.`,

      actionHint:
        "Define contingency actions before the modeled downside cash-exhaustion period.",

      hrefSuffix:
        "risk-center",
    });
  }


  if (
    inputs.requiredCapital >
    0
  ) {
    signals.push({
      code:
        "CAPITAL_GAP",

      category:
        "CAPITAL",

      severity:
        inputs.liquidityRiskLevel ===
          "CRITICAL" ||
        inputs.downsideCashExhaustionPeriod !==
          null
          ?
            "CRITICAL"
          :
            "WARNING",

      title:
        "Additional capital is required to protect liquidity",

      message:
        "The Capital Planning model identifies a positive funding requirement to protect the configured target cash floor.",

      actionHint:
        "Compare equity, debt, and hybrid structures and establish the required funding timeline.",

      hrefSuffix:
        "capital-planning",
    });
  }


  if (
    inputs.forecastAccuracyScore !==
      null
  ) {
    if (
      inputs.forecastAccuracyScore <
      0.75
    ) {
      signals.push({
        code:
          "FORECAST_ACCURACY",

        category:
          "FORECAST",

        severity:
          "CRITICAL",

        title:
          "Forecast reliability is materially weak",

        message:
          "Historical forecast accuracy is below 75%, reducing confidence in forward planning decisions.",

        actionHint:
          "Revisit the assumptions driving the largest recurring forecast errors.",

        hrefSuffix:
          "forecast-accuracy",
      });
    }
    else if (
      inputs.forecastAccuracyScore <
      0.90
    ) {
      signals.push({
        code:
          "FORECAST_ACCURACY",

        category:
          "FORECAST",

        severity:
          "WARNING",

        title:
          "Forecast reliability should be improved",

        message:
          "Historical forecast accuracy is below 90%.",

        actionHint:
          "Review rolling forecast errors and improve the assumptions with the weakest historical reliability.",

        hrefSuffix:
          "forecast-accuracy",
      });
    }
  }


  if (
    inputs.forecastBiasCount >=
    2
  ) {
    signals.push({
      code:
        "FORECAST_BIAS",

      category:
        "FORECAST",

      severity:
        "WARNING",

      title:
        "Systematic forecast bias exists across multiple metrics",

      message:
        "At least two financial metrics show persistent directional over- or under-forecasting.",

      actionHint:
        "Review the recurring bias before approving the next planning baseline.",

      hrefSuffix:
        "forecast-accuracy",
    });
  }


  if (
    inputs.revenueVarianceRate !==
      null &&
    inputs.revenueVarianceRate <
      0
  ) {
    signals.push({
      code:
        "REVENUE_VARIANCE",

      category:
        "PERFORMANCE",

      severity:
        inputs.revenueVarianceRate <=
          -0.10
          ?
            "CRITICAL"
          :
            "WARNING",

      title:
        "Revenue is below plan",

      message:
        inputs.revenueVarianceRate <=
          -0.10
          ?
            "Actual revenue is at least 10% below the matched forecast."
          :
            "Actual revenue is below the matched forecast.",

      actionHint:
        "Identify whether the variance is caused by volume, pricing, timing, conversion, or customer retention.",

      hrefSuffix:
        "actuals",
    });
  }


  if (
    inputs.ebitdaVarianceRate !==
      null &&
    inputs.ebitdaVarianceRate <
      0
  ) {
    signals.push({
      code:
        "EBITDA_VARIANCE",

      category:
        "PERFORMANCE",

      severity:
        inputs.ebitdaVarianceRate <=
          -0.15
          ?
            "CRITICAL"
          :
            "WARNING",

      title:
        "EBITDA is below plan",

      message:
        inputs.ebitdaVarianceRate <=
          -0.15
          ?
            "Actual EBITDA is at least 15% below the matched forecast."
          :
            "Actual EBITDA is below the matched forecast.",

      actionHint:
        "Separate gross-margin pressure from operating-expense variance and assign corrective actions.",

      hrefSuffix:
        "actuals",
    });
  }


  return signals.sort(
    (
      left,
      right,
    ) =>
      SEVERITY_ORDER[
        left.severity
      ] -
      SEVERITY_ORDER[
        right.severity
      ],
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/decision-center/validation.ts #####
import {
  DECISION_ACTION_PRIORITIES,
  DECISION_ACTION_STATUSES,
  DECISION_SOURCE_CODES,
  type DecisionActionPriority,
  type DecisionActionStatus,
  type DecisionSourceCode,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/types";


export function parseDecisionPriority(
  value:
    string,
): DecisionActionPriority {
  if (
    DECISION_ACTION_PRIORITIES.includes(
      value as
        DecisionActionPriority,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      DecisionActionPriority;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid management-action priority.",
  );
}


export function parseDecisionStatus(
  value:
    string,
): DecisionActionStatus {
  if (
    DECISION_ACTION_STATUSES.includes(
      value as
        DecisionActionStatus,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      DecisionActionStatus;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid management-action status.",
  );
}


export function parseDecisionSourceCode(
  value:
    string,
): DecisionSourceCode {
  if (
    DECISION_SOURCE_CODES.includes(
      value as
        DecisionSourceCode,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      DecisionSourceCode;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid management-action source.",
  );
}


export function parseDecisionDueDate(
  value:
    string,
): Date |
  null {
  const trimmed =
    value.trim();


  if (
    !trimmed
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  if (
    !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/u.test(
      trimmed,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Due date must use YYYY-MM-DD.",
    );
  }


  const parsed =
    new Date(
      `${trimmed}T00:00:00.000Z`,
    );


  if (
    Number.isNaN(
      parsed.getTime(),
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Due date is invalid.",
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}

import Decimal from "decimal.js";

import {
  aggregateAnnualForecast,
} from "@/lib/finance/aggregation";
import {
  calculateCustomerRevenueMonth,
} from "@/lib/finance/customer-engine";
import {
  enumerateMonths,
  monthNumberFromMonth,
  yearFromMonth,
} from "@/lib/finance/dates";
import {
  calculateCogs,
  calculateMonthlyExpenseProfile,
} from "@/lib/finance/expense-engine";
import {
  calculateFinancingForMonth,
} from "@/lib/finance/financing-engine";
import {
  ZERO,
  decimal,
  maxZero,
  nullableFinancialString,
  percentageRatio,
  percentageToRate,
  sumDecimals,
  toFinancialString,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import {
  calculateFinancialMetrics,
} from "@/lib/finance/metrics";
import {
  calculateDirectRevenueMonth,
} from "@/lib/finance/revenue-engine";
import {
  applyMonthlyExpenseOverrides,
  applyMonthlyRevenueOverride,
  customerRuntimeOverrides,
  resolveMonthlyOverride,
} from "@/lib/finance/override-engine";

  applyScenarioToAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/scenario-engine";
import type {
  FinancialForecast,
