} from "@/lib/finance/types";

function assertFinancialModelInput(
  input: FinancialModelInput,
): void {
  if (
    !input.projectId
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Financial model projectId is required.",
    );
  }

  if (
    !input.projectName
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Financial model projectName is required.",
    );
  }

  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      input.horizonMonths,
    ) ||
    input.horizonMonths <
      12 ||
    input.horizonMonths >
      60
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Financial forecast horizon must be 12, 24, 36, 48 or 60 months.",
    );
  }

  if (
    ![
      12,
      24,
      36,
      48,
      60,
    ].includes(
      input.horizonMonths,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Unsupported VentureScope forecast horizon.",
    );
  }
}

function calculateBreakEvenRevenue(
  totalOperatingExpensesBeforeCogs: Decimal,
  cogsMethod:
    | "PERCENTAGE"
    | "FIXED_MONTHLY",
  cogsPercentageRate: Decimal,
  fixedMonthlyCogs: Decimal,
): Decimal | null {
  if (
    cogsMethod ===
    "FIXED_MONTHLY"
  ) {
    return totalOperatingExpensesBeforeCogs.plus(
      fixedMonthlyCogs,
    );
  }

  const contributionMargin =
    new Decimal(
      1,
    ).minus(
      cogsPercentageRate,
    );

  if (
    contributionMargin.lte(
      ZERO,
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return totalOperatingExpensesBeforeCogs.div(
    contributionMargin,
  );
}

export function generateFinancialForecast(
  input: FinancialModelInput,
): FinancialForecast {
  assertFinancialModelInput(
    input,
  );

  const scenario =
    input.scenario ?? {
      name: "Base Case",
      type: "BASE" as const,
      modifiers: {},
    };

  const assumptions =
    applyScenarioToAssumptions(
      input.assumptions,
      input.revenueMode,
      scenario,
    );

  const forecastMonths =
    enumerateMonths(
      input.startMonth,
      input.horizonMonths,
    );

  const financingEvents =
    input.financingEvents ??
    [];

  let openingCash =
    decimal(
      assumptions.general
        .startingCash,
    );

  let openingCustomers =
    input.revenueMode ===
    "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN"
      ? decimal(
          assumptions
            .customerRevenue
            .startingCustomers,
        )
      : new Decimal(
          0,
        );

  const monthlyForecast: MonthlyForecast[] =
    [];

  for (
    let index =
      0;
    index <
    forecastMonths.length;
    index +=
      1
  ) {
    const month =
      forecastMonths[
        index
      ];

    const resolvedOverride =
      resolveMonthlyOverride(
        input.monthlyOverrides ??
        [],
        scenario.id,
        month,
      );

    let expenseProfile =
      calculateMonthlyExpenseProfile(
        assumptions.expenses,
        index,
      );

    expenseProfile =
      applyMonthlyExpenseOverrides(
        expenseProfile,
        resolvedOverride.values,
      );

    let openingCustomersOutput:
      | Decimal
      | null =
      null;

    let paidNewCustomers:
      | Decimal
      | null =
      null;

    let organicNewCustomers:
      | Decimal
      | null =
      null;

    let newCustomers:
      | Decimal
      | null =
      null;

    let churnedCustomers:
      | Decimal
      | null =
      null;

    let endingCustomers:
      | Decimal
      | null =
      null;

    let arpu:
      | Decimal
      | null =
      null;

    let mrr =
      new Decimal(
        0,
      );

    let recurringRevenue =
      new Decimal(
        0,
      );

    let nonRecurringRevenue =
      new Decimal(
        0,
      );

    let oneTimeRevenue =
      new Decimal(
        0,
      );

    let revenue =
      new Decimal(
        0,
      );

    if (
      input.revenueMode ===
      "DIRECT"
    ) {
      const revenueResult =
        calculateDirectRevenueMonth(
          assumptions.directRevenue,
          index,
        );

      mrr =
        revenueResult.mrr;

      recurringRevenue =
        revenueResult.recurringRevenue;

      nonRecurringRevenue =
        revenueResult.nonRecurringRevenue;

      oneTimeRevenue =
        revenueResult.oneTimeRevenue;

      revenue =
        revenueResult.totalRevenue;
    } else {
      const revenueResult =
        calculateCustomerRevenueMonth(
          assumptions.customerRevenue,
          index,
          openingCustomers,
          expenseProfile.marketing,
          customerRuntimeOverrides(
            resolvedOverride.values,
          ),
        );

      openingCustomersOutput =
        revenueResult.openingCustomers;

      paidNewCustomers =
        revenueResult.paidNewCustomers;

      organicNewCustomers =
        revenueResult.organicNewCustomers;

      newCustomers =
        revenueResult.newCustomers;

      churnedCustomers =
        revenueResult.churnedCustomers;

      endingCustomers =
        revenueResult.endingCustomers;

      arpu =
        revenueResult.arpu;

      mrr =
        revenueResult.mrr;

      recurringRevenue =
        revenueResult.recurringRevenue;

      nonRecurringRevenue =
        revenueResult.nonRecurringRevenue;

      oneTimeRevenue =
        revenueResult.oneTimeRevenue;

      revenue =
        revenueResult.totalRevenue;
    }

    const revenueOverrideResult =
      applyMonthlyRevenueOverride({
        revenueMode:
          input.revenueMode,

        overrideRevenue:
          resolvedOverride.values
            .revenue,

        recurringRevenuePercentage:
          assumptions.directRevenue
            .recurringRevenuePercentage,

        recurringRevenue,

        nonRecurringRevenue,

        oneTimeRevenue,

        totalRevenue:
          revenue,

        mrr,
      });

    recurringRevenue =
      revenueOverrideResult
        .recurringRevenue;

    nonRecurringRevenue =
      revenueOverrideResult
        .nonRecurringRevenue;

    oneTimeRevenue =
      revenueOverrideResult
        .oneTimeRevenue;

    revenue =
      revenueOverrideResult
        .totalRevenue;

    mrr =
      revenueOverrideResult
        .mrr;

    const cogs =
      resolvedOverride.values
        .cogs !==
      undefined
        ? maxZero(
            decimal(
              resolvedOverride.values
                .cogs,
            ),
          )
        : calculateCogs(
            expenseProfile,
            revenue,
          );

    const grossProfit =
      revenue.minus(
        cogs,
      );

    const totalOperatingExpenses =
      expenseProfile
        .totalOperatingExpensesBeforeCogs;

    const ebitda =
      grossProfit.minus(
        totalOperatingExpenses,
      );

    const financing =
      calculateFinancingForMonth(
        financingEvents,
        month,
      );

    const interestExpense =
      financing.interestExpense;

    const profitBeforeTax =
      ebitda.minus(
        interestExpense,
      );

    const taxRate =
      percentageToRate(
        assumptions.general
          .corporateTaxRate,
      );

    const tax =
      profitBeforeTax.gt(
        ZERO,
      )
        ? profitBeforeTax.mul(
            taxRate,
          )
        : new Decimal(
            0,
          );

    const netIncome =
      profitBeforeTax.minus(
        tax,
      );

    const operatingCashInflow =
      revenue;

    const operatingCashOutflow =
      sumDecimals([
        cogs,
        totalOperatingExpenses,
        interestExpense,
        tax,
      ]);

    const operatingCashFlow =
      operatingCashInflow.minus(
        operatingCashOutflow,
      );

    const netCashMovement =
      operatingCashFlow
        .plus(
          financing.totalInflow,
        )
        .minus(
          financing.principalRepayment,
        );

    const endingCash =
      openingCash.plus(
        netCashMovement,
      );

    const grossBurn =
      cogs.plus(
        totalOperatingExpenses,
      );

    const netBurn =
      maxZero(
        grossBurn.minus(
          operatingCashInflow,
        ),
      );

    const grossMargin =
      percentageRatio(
        grossProfit,
        revenue,
      );

    const ebitdaMargin =
      percentageRatio(
        ebitda,
        revenue,
      );

    const netMargin =
      percentageRatio(
        netIncome,
        revenue,
      );

    const breakEvenRevenue =
      calculateBreakEvenRevenue(
        totalOperatingExpenses,
        expenseProfile.cogsMethod,
        expenseProfile
          .cogsPercentageRate,
        expenseProfile
          .fixedMonthlyCogs,
      );

    monthlyForecast.push({
      index,

      month,

      year:
        yearFromMonth(
          month,
        ),

      monthNumber:
        monthNumberFromMonth(
          month,
        ),

      openingCustomers:
        openingCustomersOutput
          ? toFinancialString(
              openingCustomersOutput,
            )
          : null,

      paidNewCustomers:
        paidNewCustomers
          ? toFinancialString(
              paidNewCustomers,
            )
          : null,

      organicNewCustomers:
        organicNewCustomers
          ? toFinancialString(
              organicNewCustomers,
            )
          : null,

      newCustomers:
        newCustomers
          ? toFinancialString(
              newCustomers,
            )
          : null,

      churnedCustomers:
        churnedCustomers
          ? toFinancialString(
              churnedCustomers,
            )
          : null,

      endingCustomers:
        endingCustomers
          ? toFinancialString(
              endingCustomers,
            )
          : null,

      arpu:
        arpu
          ? toFinancialString(
              arpu,
            )
          : null,

      mrr:
        toFinancialString(
          mrr,
        ),

      recurringRevenue:
        toFinancialString(
          recurringRevenue,
        ),

      nonRecurringRevenue:
        toFinancialString(
          nonRecurringRevenue,
        ),

      oneTimeRevenue:
        toFinancialString(
          oneTimeRevenue,
        ),

      revenue:
        toFinancialString(
          revenue,
        ),

      cogs:
        toFinancialString(
          cogs,
        ),

      grossProfit:
        toFinancialString(
          grossProfit,
        ),

      grossMarginPercentage:
        nullableFinancialString(
          grossMargin,
        ),

      salaries:
        toFinancialString(
          expenseProfile.salaries,
        ),

      rent:
        toFinancialString(
          expenseProfile.rent,
        ),

      marketing:
        toFinancialString(
          expenseProfile.marketing,
        ),

      operatingExpenseBreakdown: {
        software:
          toFinancialString(
            expenseProfile.software,
          ),

        professionalServices:
          toFinancialString(
            expenseProfile.professionalServices,
          ),

        insurance:
          toFinancialString(
            expenseProfile.insurance,
          ),

        utilities:
          toFinancialString(
            expenseProfile.utilities,
          ),

        travel:
          toFinancialString(
            expenseProfile.travel,
          ),

        other:
          toFinancialString(
            expenseProfile.other,
          ),

        custom:
          toFinancialString(
            expenseProfile.custom,
          ),
      },

      otherOperatingExpenses:
        toFinancialString(
          expenseProfile.otherOperatingExpenses,
        ),

      totalOperatingExpenses:
        toFinancialString(
          totalOperatingExpenses,
        ),

      ebitda:
        toFinancialString(
          ebitda,
        ),

      ebitdaMarginPercentage:
        nullableFinancialString(
          ebitdaMargin,
        ),

      interestExpense:
        toFinancialString(
          interestExpense,
        ),

      profitBeforeTax:
        toFinancialString(
          profitBeforeTax,
        ),

      tax:
        toFinancialString(
          tax,
        ),

      netIncome:
        toFinancialString(
          netIncome,
        ),

      netMarginPercentage:
        nullableFinancialString(
          netMargin,
        ),

      operatingCashInflow:
        toFinancialString(
          operatingCashInflow,
        ),

      operatingCashOutflow:
        toFinancialString(
          operatingCashOutflow,
        ),

      operatingCashFlow:
        toFinancialString(
          operatingCashFlow,
        ),

      financingInflows: {
        equity:
          toFinancialString(
            financing.equityInflow,
          ),

        debt:
          toFinancialString(
            financing.debtInflow,
          ),

        grant:
          toFinancialString(
            financing.grantInflow,
          ),

        other:
          toFinancialString(
            financing.otherInflow,
          ),

        total:
          toFinancialString(
            financing.totalInflow,
          ),
      },

      debtPrincipalRepayment:
        toFinancialString(
          financing.principalRepayment,
        ),

      openingCash:
        toFinancialString(
          openingCash,
        ),

      netCashMovement:
        toFinancialString(
          netCashMovement,
        ),

      endingCash:
        toFinancialString(
          endingCash,
        ),

      grossBurn:
        toFinancialString(
          grossBurn,
        ),

      netBurn:
        toFinancialString(
          netBurn,
        ),

      breakEvenRevenue:
        nullableFinancialString(
          breakEvenRevenue,
        ),
    });

    openingCash =
      endingCash;

    if (
      input.revenueMode ===
        "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN" &&
      endingCustomers
    ) {
      openingCustomers =
        endingCustomers;
    }
  }

  const annual =
    aggregateAnnualForecast(
      monthlyForecast,
    );

  const metrics =
    calculateFinancialMetrics(
      monthlyForecast,
      annual,
      assumptions.general
        .startingCash,
    );

  return {
    projectId:
      input.projectId,

    projectName:
      input.projectName,

    currency:
      input.currency,

    revenueMode:
      input.revenueMode,

    modelVersion:
      input.modelVersion,

    startMonth:
      input.startMonth,

    horizonMonths:
      input.horizonMonths,

    scenario: {
      id:
        scenario.id,

      name:
        scenario.name,

      type:
        scenario.type,
    },

    months:
      monthlyForecast,

    annual,

    metrics,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/expense-engine.ts #####
import type Decimal from "decimal.js";

import type {
  ExpenseAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/types";
import {
  annualPercentageToMonthlyRate,
  compoundValue,
  decimal,
  percentageToRate,
  sumDecimals,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";

export type MonthlyExpenseProfile = {
  salaries: Decimal;
  rent: Decimal;
  marketing: Decimal;

  software: Decimal;
  professionalServices: Decimal;
  insurance: Decimal;
  utilities: Decimal;
  travel: Decimal;
  other: Decimal;
  custom: Decimal;

  otherOperatingExpenses: Decimal;

  totalOperatingExpensesBeforeCogs: Decimal;

  cogsMethod:
    | "PERCENTAGE"
    | "FIXED_MONTHLY";

  cogsPercentageRate: Decimal;

  fixedMonthlyCogs: Decimal;
};

function growthRateForPeriod(
  percentage: string,
  period:
    | "MONTHLY"
    | "ANNUAL",
): Decimal {
  if (
    period ===
    "ANNUAL"
  ) {
    return annualPercentageToMonthlyRate(
      percentage,
    );
  }

  return percentageToRate(
    percentage,
  );
}

export function calculateMonthlyExpenseProfile(
  assumptions: ExpenseAssumptions,
  monthIndex: number,
): MonthlyExpenseProfile {
  const salaryMonthlyRate =
    annualPercentageToMonthlyRate(
      assumptions.salaries
        .annualGrowthRate,
    );

  const rentMonthlyRate =
    annualPercentageToMonthlyRate(
      assumptions.rent
        .annualGrowthRate,
    );

  const marketingRate =
    growthRateForPeriod(
      assumptions.marketing
        .growthRate,
      assumptions.marketing
        .growthPeriod,
    );

  const salaries =
    compoundValue(
      assumptions.salaries
        .monthlyAmount,
      salaryMonthlyRate,
      monthIndex,
    );

  const rent =
    compoundValue(
      assumptions.rent
        .monthlyAmount,
      rentMonthlyRate,
      monthIndex,
    );

  const marketing =
    compoundValue(
      assumptions.marketing
        .monthlyAmount,
      marketingRate,
      monthIndex,
    );

  const software =
    decimal(
      assumptions.operatingExpenses
        .software,
    );

  const professionalServices =
    decimal(
      assumptions.operatingExpenses
        .professionalServices,
    );

  const insurance =
    decimal(
      assumptions.operatingExpenses
        .insurance,
    );

  const utilities =
    decimal(
      assumptions.operatingExpenses
        .utilities,
    );

  const travel =
    decimal(
      assumptions.operatingExpenses
        .travel,
    );

  const other =
    decimal(
      assumptions.operatingExpenses
        .other,
    );

  const custom =
    sumDecimals(
      assumptions.operatingExpenses
        .custom.map(
          (
            expense,
          ) =>
            expense.monthlyAmount,
        ),
    );

  const otherOperatingExpenses =
    sumDecimals([
      software,
      professionalServices,
      insurance,
      utilities,
      travel,
      other,
      custom,
    ]);

  const totalOperatingExpensesBeforeCogs =
    sumDecimals([
      salaries,
      rent,
      marketing,
      otherOperatingExpenses,
    ]);

  return {
    salaries,
    rent,
    marketing,

    software,
    professionalServices,
    insurance,
    utilities,
    travel,
    other,
    custom,

    otherOperatingExpenses,

    totalOperatingExpensesBeforeCogs,

    cogsMethod:
      assumptions.cogs
        .method,

    cogsPercentageRate:
      percentageToRate(
        assumptions.cogs
          .percentage,
      ),

    fixedMonthlyCogs:
      decimal(
        assumptions.cogs
          .fixedMonthlyAmount,
      ),
  };
}

export function calculateCogs(
  profile: MonthlyExpenseProfile,
  revenue: Decimal,
): Decimal {
  if (
    profile.cogsMethod ===
    "FIXED_MONTHLY"
  ) {
    return profile.fixedMonthlyCogs;
  }

  return revenue.mul(
    profile.cogsPercentageRate,
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/financing-engine.ts #####
import Decimal from "decimal.js";

import {
  addMonths,
  compareMonths,
  monthDistance,
} from "@/lib/finance/dates";
import {
  ZERO,
  decimal,
  maxZero,
  minDecimal,
  percentageToRate,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  FinancingEventInput,
  MonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export type MonthlyFinancingResult = {
  equityInflow: Decimal;
  debtInflow: Decimal;
  grantInflow: Decimal;
  otherInflow: Decimal;

  totalInflow: Decimal;

  interestExpense: Decimal;

  principalRepayment: Decimal;
};

function emptyResult(): MonthlyFinancingResult {
  return {
    equityInflow:
      new Decimal(
        0,
      ),

    debtInflow:
      new Decimal(
        0,
      ),

    grantInflow:
      new Decimal(
        0,
      ),

    otherInflow:
      new Decimal(
        0,
      ),

    totalInflow:
      new Decimal(
        0,
      ),

    interestExpense:
      new Decimal(
        0,
      ),

    principalRepayment:
      new Decimal(
        0,
      ),
  };
}

function normalizedRepaymentStartMonth(
  event: FinancingEventInput,
): MonthKey {
  const defaultStart =
    addMonths(
      event.month,
      1,
    );

  if (
    !event.repaymentStartMonth
  ) {
    return defaultStart;
  }

  if (
    compareMonths(
      event.repaymentStartMonth,
      defaultStart,
    ) <
    0
  ) {
    return defaultStart;
  }

  return event.repaymentStartMonth;
}

function debtScheduleForMonth(
  event: FinancingEventInput,
  month: MonthKey,
): {
  interestExpense: Decimal;
  principalRepayment: Decimal;
} {
  if (
    event.type !==
    "DEBT"
  ) {
    return {
      interestExpense:
        new Decimal(
          0,
        ),

      principalRepayment:
        new Decimal(
          0,
        ),
    };
  }

  if (
    compareMonths(
      month,
      event.month,
    ) <
    0
  ) {
    return {
      interestExpense:
        new Decimal(
          0,
        ),

      principalRepayment:
        new Decimal(
          0,
        ),
    };
  }

  const amount =
    maxZero(
      decimal(
        event.amount,
      ),
    );

  const termMonths =
    event.termMonths &&
    event.termMonths >
      0
      ? Math.floor(
          event.termMonths,
        )
      : null;

  const repaymentStart =
    normalizedRepaymentStartMonth(
      event,
    );

  let principalPerMonth =
    new Decimal(
      0,
    );

  let priorPrincipalPayments =
    0;

  let currentPrincipalPayment =
    false;

  if (
    termMonths !==
    null
  ) {
    principalPerMonth =
      amount.div(
        termMonths,
      );

    const paymentDistance =
      monthDistance(
        repaymentStart,
        month,
      );

    priorPrincipalPayments =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(
          termMonths,
          paymentDistance,
        ),
      );

    currentPrincipalPayment =
      paymentDistance >=
        0 &&
      paymentDistance <
        termMonths;
  }

  const openingOutstanding =
    maxZero(
      amount.minus(
        principalPerMonth.mul(
          priorPrincipalPayments,
        ),
      ),
    );

  const aprRate =
    percentageToRate(
      event.apr ??
        "0",
    );

  const monthlyInterestRate =
    aprRate.div(
      12,
    );

  const interestExpense =
    compareMonths(
      month,
      event.month,
    ) >
      0 &&
    openingOutstanding.gt(
      ZERO,
    )
      ? openingOutstanding.mul(
          monthlyInterestRate,
        )
      : new Decimal(
          0,
        );

  const principalRepayment =
    currentPrincipalPayment
      ? minDecimal(
          principalPerMonth,
          openingOutstanding,
        )
      : new Decimal(
          0,
        );

  return {
    interestExpense,
    principalRepayment,
  };
}

export function calculateFinancingForMonth(
  events: FinancingEventInput[],
  month: MonthKey,
): MonthlyFinancingResult {
  const result =
    emptyResult();

  for (
    const event
    of events
  ) {
    const amount =
      maxZero(
        decimal(
          event.amount,
        ),
      );

    if (
      event.month ===
      month
    ) {
      switch (
        event.type
      ) {
        case "EQUITY":
          result.equityInflow =
            result.equityInflow.plus(
              amount,
            );
          break;

        case "DEBT":
          result.debtInflow =
            result.debtInflow.plus(
              amount,
            );
          break;

        case "GRANT":
          result.grantInflow =
            result.grantInflow.plus(
              amount,
            );
          break;

        case "OTHER":
          result.otherInflow =
            result.otherInflow.plus(
              amount,
            );
          break;
      }
    }

    const debtSchedule =
      debtScheduleForMonth(
        event,
        month,
      );

    result.interestExpense =
      result.interestExpense.plus(
        debtSchedule.interestExpense,
      );

    result.principalRepayment =
      result.principalRepayment.plus(
        debtSchedule.principalRepayment,
      );
  }

  result.totalInflow =
    result.equityInflow
      .plus(
        result.debtInflow,
      )
      .plus(
        result.grantInflow,
      )
      .plus(
        result.otherInflow,
      );

  return result;
}

import {
  ACCURACY_METRICS,
  type AccuracyMetric,
  type ForecastAccuracyFlag,
  type ForecastAccuracyMetricReport,
  type ForecastAccuracyReport,
  type ForecastAccuracyStatistics,
  type ForecastBiasClassification,
  type ForecastObservation,
  type ForecastTrendClassification,
} from "@/lib/finance/forecast-accuracy/types";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import {
  normalizeForecastPeriodKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/variance";


function forecastValue(
  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow,
  metric:
    AccuracyMetric,
): number |
  null {
  switch (
    metric
  ) {
    case "revenue":
      return row.revenue;

    case "cogs":
      return row.cogs;

    case "operatingExpenses":
      return row.operatingExpenses;

    case "ebitda":
      return row.ebitda;

    case "cashFlow":
      return row.cashFlow;

    case "cashBalance":
      return row.cashBalance;

    case "mrr":
      return row.mrr;
  }
}


function actualValue(
  row:
    ActualFinancialPeriod,
  metric:
    AccuracyMetric,
): number |
  null {
  switch (
    metric
  ) {
    case "revenue":
      return row.revenue;

    case "cogs":
      return row.cogs;

    case "operatingExpenses":
      return row.operatingExpenses;

    case "ebitda":
      return row.ebitda;

    case "cashFlow":
      return row.cashFlow;

    case "cashBalance":
      return row.cashBalance;

    case "mrr":
      return row.mrr;
  }
}


/*
 * Signed error convention:
 *
 * forecast - actual
 *
 * Positive = model over-forecasted.
 * Negative = model under-forecasted.
 */
export function forecastObservation(
  period:
    string,
  actual:
    number,
  forecast:
    number,
): ForecastObservation {
  const error =
    forecast -
    actual;


  return {
    period,

    actual,

    forecast,

    error,

    absoluteError:
      Math.abs(
        error,
      ),

    absolutePercentageError:
      actual ===
        0
        ?
          null
        :
          Math.abs(
            error /
            actual,
          ),
  };
}


export function calculateAccuracyStatistics(
  observations:
    ForecastObservation[],
): ForecastAccuracyStatistics {
  if (
    observations.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return {
      observations:
        0,

      actualTotal:
        0,

      forecastTotal:
        0,

      signedError:
        0,

      absoluteError:
        0,

      wape:
        null,

      mape:
        null,

      rmse:
        null,

      biasRate:
        null,

      accuracyScore:
        null,
    };
  }


  const actualTotal =
    observations.reduce(
      (
        total,
        observation,
      ) =>
        total +
        observation.actual,
      0,
    );


  const absoluteActualTotal =
    observations.reduce(
      (
        total,
        observation,
      ) =>
        total +
        Math.abs(
          observation.actual,
        ),
      0,
    );


  const forecastTotal =
    observations.reduce(
      (
        total,
        observation,
      ) =>
        total +
        observation.forecast,
      0,
    );


  const signedError =
    observations.reduce(
      (
        total,
        observation,
      ) =>
        total +
        observation.error,
      0,
    );


  const absoluteError =
    observations.reduce(
      (
        total,
        observation,
      ) =>
        total +
        observation.absoluteError,
      0,
    );


  const percentageErrors =
    observations.flatMap(
      (
        observation,
      ) =>
        observation.absolutePercentageError ===
          null
          ?
            []
          :
            [
              observation.absolutePercentageError,
            ],
    );


  const wape =
    absoluteActualTotal ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        absoluteError /
        absoluteActualTotal;


  const mape =
    percentageErrors.length ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        percentageErrors.reduce(
          (
            total,
            value,
          ) =>
            total +
            value,
          0,
        ) /
        percentageErrors.length;


  const rmse =
    Math.sqrt(
      observations.reduce(
        (
          total,
          observation,
        ) =>
          total +
          observation.error **
            2,
        0,
      ) /
      observations.length,
    );


  const biasRate =
    absoluteActualTotal ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        signedError /
        absoluteActualTotal;


  return {
    observations:
      observations.length,

    actualTotal,

    forecastTotal,

    signedError,

    absoluteError,

    wape,

    mape,

    rmse,

    biasRate,

    accuracyScore:
      wape ===
        null
        ?
          null
        :
          Math.max(
            0,
            1 -
            wape,
          ),
  };
}


function rollingStatistics(
  observations:
    ForecastObservation[],
  periods:
    number,
): ForecastAccuracyStatistics {
  return calculateAccuracyStatistics(
    observations.slice(
      -periods,
    ),
  );
}


export function classifyBias(
  statistics:
    ForecastAccuracyStatistics,
): ForecastBiasClassification {
  if (
    statistics.observations <
      2 ||
    statistics.biasRate ===
      null
  ) {
    return "INSUFFICIENT_DATA";
  }


  if (
    Math.abs(
      statistics.biasRate,
    ) <
    0.05
  ) {
    return "BALANCED";
  }


  return statistics.biasRate >
    0
    ?
      "OVER_FORECASTING"
    :
      "UNDER_FORECASTING";
}


export function classifyTrend(
  observations:
    ForecastObservation[],
): ForecastTrendClassification {
  if (
    observations.length <
    6
  ) {
    return "INSUFFICIENT_DATA";
  }


  const recent =
    calculateAccuracyStatistics(
      observations.slice(
        -3,
      ),
    );


  const previous =
    calculateAccuracyStatistics(
      observations.slice(
        -6,
        -3,
      ),
    );


  if (
    recent.wape ===
      null ||
    previous.wape ===
      null
  ) {
    return "INSUFFICIENT_DATA";
  }


  const difference =
    recent.wape -
    previous.wape;


  if (
    difference <=
    -0.02
  ) {
    return "IMPROVING";
  }


  if (
    difference >=
    0.02
  ) {
    return "WORSENING";
  }


  return "STABLE";
}


function observationsForMetric(
  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[],
  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  metric:
    AccuracyMetric,
): ForecastObservation[] {
  const forecastByPeriod =
    new Map<
      string,
      ForecastAnalyticsRow
    >();


  for (
    const forecast
    of forecasts
  ) {
    const period =
      normalizeForecastPeriodKey(
        forecast.period,
      );


    if (
      period
    ) {
      forecastByPeriod.set(
        period,
        forecast,
      );
    }
  }


  return actuals.flatMap(
    (
      actual,
    ) => {
      const forecast =
        forecastByPeriod.get(
          actual.period,
        );


      if (
        !forecast
      ) {
        return [];
      }


      const actualMetric =
        actualValue(
          actual,
          metric,
        );


      const forecastMetric =
        forecastValue(
          forecast,
          metric,
        );


      if (
        actualMetric ===
          null ||
        forecastMetric ===
          null
      ) {
        return [];
      }


      return [
        forecastObservation(
          actual.period,
          actualMetric,
          forecastMetric,
        ),
      ];
    },
  );
}


function metricReport(
  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[],
  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  metric:
    AccuracyMetric,
): ForecastAccuracyMetricReport {
  const observations =
    observationsForMetric(
      actuals,
      forecasts,
      metric,
    );


  const overall =
    calculateAccuracyStatistics(
      observations,
    );


  return {
    metric,

    observations,

    overall,

    rolling3:
      rollingStatistics(
        observations,
        3,
      ),

    rolling6:
      rollingStatistics(
        observations,
        6,
      ),

    rolling12:
      rollingStatistics(
        observations,
        12,
      ),

    bias:
      classifyBias(
        overall,
      ),

    trend:
      classifyTrend(
        observations,
      ),
  };
}


function managementFlags(
  reports:
    ForecastAccuracyMetricReport[],
): ForecastAccuracyFlag[] {
  const flags:
    ForecastAccuracyFlag[] =
      [];


  for (
    const report
    of reports
  ) {
    const {
      overall,
      rolling3,
      bias,
      trend,
      metric,
    } =
      report;


    if (
      overall.observations <
      3
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    if (
      overall.wape !==
        null &&
      overall.wape >=
        0.3
    ) {
      flags.push({
        severity:
          "CRITICAL",

        metric,

        code:
          "HIGH_FORECAST_ERROR",

        message:
          `${metric} forecast error is above 30% WAPE.`,
      });
    }
    else if (
      overall.wape !==
        null &&
      overall.wape >=
        0.2
    ) {
      flags.push({
        severity:
          "WARNING",

        metric,

        code:
          "ELEVATED_FORECAST_ERROR",

        message:
          `${metric} forecast error is above 20% WAPE.`,
      });
    }


    if (
      bias ===
        "OVER_FORECASTING"
    ) {
      flags.push({
        severity:
          "WARNING",

        metric,

        code:
          "PERSISTENT_OVER_FORECAST",

        message:
          `${metric} has persistent positive forecast bias.`,
      });
    }


    if (
      bias ===
        "UNDER_FORECASTING"
    ) {
      flags.push({
        severity:
          "INFO",

        metric,

        code:
          "PERSISTENT_UNDER_FORECAST",

        message:
          `${metric} has persistent negative forecast bias.`,
      });
    }


    if (
      trend ===
        "WORSENING" &&
      rolling3.wape !==
        null
    ) {
      flags.push({
        severity:
          rolling3.wape >=
            0.25
            ?
              "CRITICAL"
            :
              "WARNING",

        metric,

        code:
          "ACCURACY_WORSENING",

        message:
          `${metric} forecast accuracy deteriorated over the latest three matched periods.`,
      });
    }
  }


  const severityOrder = {
    CRITICAL:
      0,

    WARNING:
      1,

    INFO:
      2,
  };


  return flags.sort(
    (
      left,
      right,
    ) =>
      severityOrder[
        left.severity
      ] -
      severityOrder[
        right.severity
      ],
  );
}


export function calculateForecastAccuracyReport(
  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[],
  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
): ForecastAccuracyReport {
  const metrics =
    ACCURACY_METRICS.map(
      (
        metric,
      ) =>
        metricReport(
          actuals,
          forecasts,
          metric,
        ),
    );


  const usable =
    metrics.filter(
      (
        report,
      ) =>
        report.overall.wape !==
          null,
    );


  const overallWape =
    usable.length ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        usable.reduce(
          (
            total,
            report,
          ) =>
            total +
            (
              report.overall.wape ??
              0
            ),
          0,
        ) /
        usable.length;


  const latestPeriod =
    actuals.length ===
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        [
          ...actuals,
        ]
          .sort(
            (
              left,
              right,
            ) =>
              left.period.localeCompare(
                right.period,
              ),
          )
          .at(
            -1,
          )
          ?.period ??
        null;


  const matchedPeriods =
    Math.max(
      0,
      ...metrics.map(
        (
          report,
        ) =>
          report.overall.observations,
      ),
    );


  return {
    matchedPeriods,

    metrics,

    flags:
      managementFlags(
        metrics,
      ),

    overallWape,

    overallAccuracyScore:
      overallWape ===
        null
        ?
          null
        :
          Math.max(
            0,
            1 -
            overallWape,
          ),

    latestPeriod,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/formatting.ts #####
import type {
  RunwayResult,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export type AnalysisTableView =
  | "monthly"
  | "annual";

function safeNumber(
  value:
    | string
    | number
    | null
    | undefined,
): number {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    value === ""
  ) {
    return 0;
  }

  const parsed =
    Number(value);

  return Number.isFinite(
    parsed,
  )
    ? parsed
    : 0;
}

export function resolveAnalysisTableView(
  value:
    | string
    | string[]
    | undefined,
): AnalysisTableView {
  const resolved =
    Array.isArray(value)
      ? value[0]
      : value;

  return resolved ===
    "annual"
    ? "annual"
    : "monthly";
}

export function formatCurrencyValue(
  value:
    | string
    | number,
  currency: string,
  options: {
    compact?: boolean;
    maximumFractionDigits?: number;
    minimumFractionDigits?: number;
  } = {},
): string {
  const amount =
    safeNumber(value);

  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en-US",
    {
      style: "currency",
      currency,
      notation:
        options.compact
          ? "compact"
          : "standard",
      compactDisplay:
        "short",
      maximumFractionDigits:
        options.maximumFractionDigits ??
        (
          options.compact
            ? 1
            : 0
        ),
      minimumFractionDigits:
        options.minimumFractionDigits ??
        0,
    },
  ).format(
    amount,
  );
}

export function formatExpenseCurrencyValue(
  value:
    | string
    | number,
  currency: string,
): string {
  const amount =
    Math.abs(
      safeNumber(
        value,
      ),
    );

  if (
    amount === 0
  ) {
    return formatCurrencyValue(
      0,
      currency,
    );
  }

  return `−${formatCurrencyValue(
    amount,
    currency,
  )}`;
}

export function formatCompactCurrencyValue(
  value:
    | string
    | number,
  currency: string,
): string {
  return formatCurrencyValue(
    value,
    currency,
    {
      compact: true,
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    },
  );
}

export function formatPercentageValue(
  value:
    | string
    | number
    | null,
  maximumFractionDigits =
    1,
): string {
  if (
    value === null
  ) {
    return "—";
  }

  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en-US",
    {
      maximumFractionDigits,
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    },
  ).format(
    safeNumber(
      value,
    ),
  )}%`;
}

export function formatNumberValue(
  value:
    | string
    | number
    | null,
  maximumFractionDigits =
    2,
): string {
  if (
    value === null
  ) {
    return "—";
  }

  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en-US",
    {
      maximumFractionDigits,
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    },
  ).format(
    safeNumber(
      value,
    ),
  );
}

export function formatCustomerValue(
  value:
    | string
    | number
    | null,
): string {
  if (
    value === null
  ) {
    return "—";
  }

  return new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en-US",
    {
      maximumFractionDigits: 0,
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    },
  ).format(
    safeNumber(
      value,
    ),
  );
}

export function formatMonthKey(
  month: string,
): string {
  const match =
    /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.exec(
      month,
    );

  if (!match) {
    return month;
  }

  const year =
    Number(
      match[1],
    );

  const monthNumber =
    Number(
      match[2],
    );

  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en-US",
    {
      month: "short",
      year: "2-digit",
      timeZone: "UTC",
    },
  ).format(
    new Date(
      Date.UTC(
        year,
        monthNumber - 1,
        1,
      ),
    ),
  );
}

export function formatLongMonthKey(
  month:
    | string
    | null,
): string {
  if (!month) {
    return "Not reached";
  }

  const match =
    /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.exec(
      month,
    );

  if (!match) {
    return month;
  }

  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en-US",
    {
      month: "long",
      year: "numeric",
      timeZone: "UTC",
    },
  ).format(
    new Date(
      Date.UTC(
        Number(
          match[1],
        ),
        Number(
          match[2],
        ) - 1,
        1,
      ),
    ),
  );
}

export function formatRunway(
  runway: RunwayResult,
): string {
  switch (
    runway.status
  ) {
    case "ZERO":
      return "0 mo";

    case "EXHAUSTED":
      return `${runway.months ?? 0} mo`;

    case "BEYOND_HORIZON":
      return `>${runway.horizonMonths} mo`;

    case "CASH_FLOW_POSITIVE":
      return "Cash-flow +";
  }
}

export function formatRunwayDetail(
  runway: RunwayResult,
): string {
  switch (
    runway.status
  ) {
    case "ZERO":
      return "Starting cash is already exhausted.";

    case "EXHAUSTED":
      return runway.exhaustedMonth
        ? `Cash reaches zero in ${formatLongMonthKey(
            runway.exhaustedMonth,
          )}.`
        : "Cash reaches zero within the forecast.";

    case "BEYOND_HORIZON":
      return `Cash remains above zero throughout the ${runway.horizonMonths}-month forecast.`;

    case "CASH_FLOW_POSITIVE":
      return "The final three months are operating cash-flow positive.";
  }
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/math.ts #####
import Decimal from "decimal.js";

Decimal.set({
  precision: 40,
  rounding: Decimal.ROUND_HALF_UP,
  toExpNeg: -50,
  toExpPos: 50,
});

export const ZERO =
  new Decimal(0);

export const ONE =
  new Decimal(1);

export function decimal(
  value:
    | Decimal.Value
    | null
    | undefined,
): Decimal {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    value ===
      undefined ||
    value ===
      ""
  ) {
    return new Decimal(0);
  }

  try {
    const result =
      new Decimal(value);

    if (
      !result.isFinite()
    ) {
      return new Decimal(0);
    }

    return result;
  } catch {
    return new Decimal(0);
  }
}

export function percentageToRate(
  value:
    | Decimal.Value
    | null
    | undefined,
): Decimal {
  return decimal(
    value,
  ).div(100);
}

export function rateToPercentage(
  value:
    | Decimal.Value,
): Decimal {
  return decimal(
    value,
  ).mul(100);
}

export function clampDecimal(
  value: Decimal,
  min: Decimal.Value,
  max: Decimal.Value,
): Decimal {
  const minimum =
    decimal(
      min,
    );

  const maximum =
    decimal(
      max,
    );

  if (
    value.lt(
      minimum,
    )
  ) {
    return minimum;
  }

  if (
    value.gt(
      maximum,
    )
  ) {
    return maximum;
  }

  return value;
}

export function maxZero(
  value: Decimal,
): Decimal {
  return value.lt(
    ZERO,
  )
    ? new Decimal(0)
    : value;
}

export function minDecimal(
  left: Decimal,
  right: Decimal,
): Decimal {
  return left.lte(
    right,
  )
    ? left
    : right;
}

export function compoundValue(
  startingValue: Decimal.Value,
  periodicRate: Decimal,
  periods: number,
): Decimal {
  if (
    periods <=
    0
  ) {
    return decimal(
      startingValue,
    );
  }

  const factor =
    ONE.plus(
      periodicRate,
    );

  if (
    factor.lte(
      ZERO,
    )
  ) {
    return new Decimal(0);
  }

  return decimal(
    startingValue,
  ).mul(
    factor.pow(
      periods,
    ),
  );
}

export function annualPercentageToMonthlyRate(
  annualPercentage:
    | Decimal.Value,
): Decimal {
  const annualRate =
    percentageToRate(
      annualPercentage,
    );

  const annualFactor =
    ONE.plus(
      annualRate,
    );

  if (
    annualFactor.lte(
      ZERO,
    )
  ) {
    return new Decimal(
      -1,
    );
  }

  return annualFactor
    .pow(
      ONE.div(
        12,
      ),
    )
    .minus(
      ONE,
    );
}

export function safeRatio(
  numerator: Decimal,
  denominator: Decimal,
): Decimal | null {
  if (
    denominator.eq(
      ZERO,
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return numerator.div(
    denominator,
  );
}

export function percentageRatio(
  numerator: Decimal,
  denominator: Decimal,
): Decimal | null {
  const ratio =
    safeRatio(
      numerator,
      denominator,
    );

  if (!ratio) {
    return null;
  }

  return ratio.mul(
    100,
  );
}

export function averageDecimals(
  values: Decimal[],
): Decimal {
  if (
    values.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return new Decimal(
      0,
    );
  }

  const sum =
    values.reduce(
      (
        total,
        value,
      ) =>
        total.plus(
          value,
        ),
      new Decimal(
        0,
      ),
    );

  return sum.div(
    values.length,
  );
}

export function sumDecimals(
  values: Array<
    Decimal.Value
  >,
): Decimal {
  return values.reduce<Decimal>(
    (
      total,
      value,
    ) =>
      total.plus(
        decimal(
          value,
        ),
      ),
    new Decimal(
      0,
    ),
  );
}

export function toFinancialString(
  value:
    | Decimal
    | Decimal.Value,
): string {
  const number =
    value instanceof Decimal
      ? value
      : decimal(
          value,
        );

  if (
    !number.isFinite()
  ) {
    return "0";
  }

  if (
    number.eq(
      ZERO,
    )
  ) {
    return "0";
  }

  const fixed =
    number.toFixed(
      12,
    );

  return fixed
    .replace(
      /(\.\d*?[1-9])0+$/,
      "$1",
    )
    .replace(
      /\.0+$/,
      "",
    );
}

export function nullableFinancialString(
  value:
    | Decimal
    | null,
): string | null {
  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return toFinancialString(
    value,
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/metrics.ts #####
import {
  averageDecimals,
  decimal,
  nullableFinancialString,
  percentageRatio,
  sumDecimals,
  toFinancialString,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  AnnualForecast,
  BreakEvenResult,
  FinancialMetrics,
  MonthlyForecast,
  RunwayResult,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

const SUSTAINED_BREAK_EVEN_MONTHS =
  3;

function calculateRunway(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
  startingCash: string,
): RunwayResult {
  if (
    decimal(
      startingCash,
    ).lte(
      0,
    )
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "ZERO",

      months:
        0,

      exhaustedMonth:
        months[0]
          ?.month ??
        null,

      horizonMonths:
        months.length,
    };
  }

  const exhaustedIndex =
    months.findIndex(
      (
        month,
      ) =>
        decimal(
          month.endingCash,
        ).lte(
          0,
        ),
    );

  if (
    exhaustedIndex >=
    0
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "EXHAUSTED",

      months:
        exhaustedIndex +
        1,

      exhaustedMonth:
        months[
          exhaustedIndex
        ].month,

      horizonMonths:
        months.length,
    };
  }

  const trailingMonths =
    months.slice(
      -Math.min(
        3,
        months.length,
      ),
    );

  const sustainablyCashFlowPositive =
    trailingMonths.length >=
      3 &&
    trailingMonths.every(
      (
        month,
      ) =>
        decimal(
          month.operatingCashFlow,
        ).gte(
          0,
        ),
    );

  if (
    sustainablyCashFlowPositive
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "CASH_FLOW_POSITIVE",

      months:
        null,

      exhaustedMonth:
        null,

      horizonMonths:
        months.length,
    };
  }

  return {
    status:
      "BEYOND_HORIZON",

    months:
      null,

    exhaustedMonth:
      null,

    horizonMonths:
      months.length,
  };
}

function calculateBreakEven(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
): BreakEvenResult {
  const firstEbitdaBreakEven =
    months.find(
      (
        month,
      ) =>
        decimal(
          month.ebitda,
        ).gte(
          0,
        ),
    );

  let sustainedBreakEvenMonth:
    | string
    | null =
    null;

  for (
    let index =
      0;
    index <=
    months.length -
      SUSTAINED_BREAK_EVEN_MONTHS;
    index +=
      1
  ) {
    const window =
      months.slice(
        index,
        index +
          SUSTAINED_BREAK_EVEN_MONTHS,
      );

    if (
      window.every(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          decimal(
            month.ebitda,
          ).gte(
            0,
          ),
      )
    ) {
      sustainedBreakEvenMonth =
        months[
          index
        ].month;

      break;
    }
  }

  return {
    firstEbitdaBreakEvenMonth:
      firstEbitdaBreakEven
        ?.month ??
      null,

    sustainedBreakEvenMonth,

    sustainedMonthsRequired:
      SUSTAINED_BREAK_EVEN_MONTHS,
  };
}

export function calculateFinancialMetrics(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
  annual: AnnualForecast[],
  startingCash: string,
): FinancialMetrics {
  if (
    months.length ===
    0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Financial metrics require at least one forecast month.",
    );
  }

  const totalRevenue =
    sumDecimals(
      months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          month.revenue,
      ),
    );

  const totalGrossProfit =
    sumDecimals(
      months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          month.grossProfit,
      ),
    );

  const totalEbitda =
    sumDecimals(
      months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          month.ebitda,
      ),
    );

  const totalNetIncome =
    sumDecimals(
      months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          month.netIncome,
      ),
    );

  const firstAnnual =
    annual[0];

  const lastMonth =
    months[
      months.length -
        1
    ];

  const initialWindow =
    months.slice(
      0,
      Math.min(
        3,
        months.length,
      ),
    );

  const initialThreeMonthAverageGrossBurn =
    averageDecimals(
      initialWindow.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          decimal(
            month.grossBurn,
          ),
      ),
    );

  const initialThreeMonthAverageNetBurn =
    averageDecimals(
      initialWindow.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          decimal(
            month.netBurn,
          ),
      ),
    );

  const grossMargin =
    percentageRatio(
      totalGrossProfit,
      totalRevenue,
    );

  const ebitdaMargin =
    percentageRatio(
      totalEbitda,
      totalRevenue,
    );

  const netMargin =
    percentageRatio(
      totalNetIncome,
      totalRevenue,
    );

  return {
    totalRevenue:
      toFinancialString(
        totalRevenue,
      ),

    totalGrossProfit:
      toFinancialString(
        totalGrossProfit,
      ),

    totalEbitda:
      toFinancialString(
        totalEbitda,
      ),

    totalNetIncome:
      toFinancialString(
        totalNetIncome,
      ),

    firstYearRevenue:
      firstAnnual
        ?.revenue ??
      "0",

    firstYearEbitda:
      firstAnnual
        ?.ebitda ??
      "0",

    endingCash:
      lastMonth.endingCash,

    endingMrr:
      lastMonth.mrr,

    endingArr:
      toFinancialString(
        decimal(
          lastMonth.mrr,
        ).mul(
          12,
        ),
      ),

    endingCustomers:
      lastMonth
        .endingCustomers,

    grossMarginPercentage:
      nullableFinancialString(
        grossMargin,
      ),

    ebitdaMarginPercentage:
      nullableFinancialString(
        ebitdaMargin,
      ),

    netMarginPercentage:
      nullableFinancialString(
        netMargin,
      ),

    initialThreeMonthAverageGrossBurn:
      toFinancialString(
        initialThreeMonthAverageGrossBurn,
      ),

    initialThreeMonthAverageNetBurn:
      toFinancialString(
        initialThreeMonthAverageNetBurn,
      ),

    initialBreakEvenRevenue:
      months[0]
        .breakEvenRevenue,

    runway:
      calculateRunway(
        months,
        startingCash,
      ),

    breakEven:
      calculateBreakEven(
        months,
      ),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/override-engine.ts #####
import Decimal from "decimal.js";

import type {
  MonthlyExpenseProfile,
} from "@/lib/finance/expense-engine";
import {
  decimal,
  maxZero,
  minDecimal,
  percentageToRate,
  sumDecimals,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  MonthKey,
  MonthlyOverrideInput,
  MonthlyOverrideValues,
  RevenueMode,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export type ResolvedMonthlyOverride = {
  applied: boolean;

  ids: string[];

  values: MonthlyOverrideValues;

  note: string | null;
};

export type CustomerRuntimeOverrides = {
  cac?: string;

  monthlyChurnRate?: string;

  arpu?: string;
};

function numericValue(
  value: unknown,
): string | undefined {
  if (
    typeof value !==
      "string" &&
    typeof value !==
      "number"
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const normalized =
    String(
      value,
    ).trim();

  if (
    normalized ===
    ""
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }

  if (
    !/^-?(?:\d+|\d+\.\d+|\.\d+)$/.test(
      normalized,
    )
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const parsed =
    decimal(
      normalized,
    );

  if (
    !parsed.isFinite()
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return normalized;
}

export function parseMonthlyOverrideValues(
  value: unknown,
): MonthlyOverrideValues {
  if (
    !value ||
    typeof value !==
      "object" ||
    Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return {};
  }

  const source =
    value as Record<
      string,
      unknown
    >;

  const result: MonthlyOverrideValues =
    {};

  const revenue =
    numericValue(
      source.revenue,
    );

  const marketing =
    numericValue(
      source.marketing,
    );

  const salaries =
    numericValue(
      source.salaries,
    );

  const rent =
    numericValue(
      source.rent,
    );

  const cogs =
    numericValue(
      source.cogs,
    );

  const cac =
    numericValue(
      source.cac,
    );

  const churnRate =
    numericValue(
      source.churnRate,
    );

  const arpu =
    numericValue(
      source.arpu,
    );

  if (
    revenue !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.revenue =
      revenue;
  }

  if (
    marketing !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.marketing =
      marketing;
  }

  if (
    salaries !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.salaries =
      salaries;
  }

  if (
    rent !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.rent =
      rent;
  }

  if (
    cogs !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.cogs =
      cogs;
  }

  if (
    cac !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.cac =
      cac;
  }

  if (
    churnRate !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.churnRate =
      churnRate;
  }

  if (
    arpu !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.arpu =
      arpu;
  }

  return result;
}

function mergeOverrideValues(
  current: MonthlyOverrideValues,
  next: MonthlyOverrideValues,
): MonthlyOverrideValues {
  return {
    ...current,
    ...next,
  };
}

export function resolveMonthlyOverride(
  overrides: MonthlyOverrideInput[],
  scenarioId:
    | string
    | undefined,
  month: MonthKey,
): ResolvedMonthlyOverride {
  const globalOverrides =
    overrides.filter(
      (
        override,
      ) =>
        override.month ===
          month &&
        !override.scenarioId,
    );

  const scenarioOverrides =
    scenarioId
      ? overrides.filter(
          (
            override,
          ) =>
            override.month ===
              month &&
            override.scenarioId ===
              scenarioId,
        )
      : [];

  const ordered = [
    ...globalOverrides,
    ...scenarioOverrides,
  ];

  if (
    ordered.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return {
      applied:
        false,

      ids:
        [],

      values:
        {},

      note:
        null,
    };
  }

  let values: MonthlyOverrideValues =
    {};

  const notes: string[] =
    [];

  for (
    const override
    of ordered
  ) {
    values =
      mergeOverrideValues(
        values,
        override.values,
      );

    if (
      override.note &&
      override.note.trim()
    ) {
      notes.push(
        override.note.trim(),
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    applied:
      Object.keys(
        values,
      ).length >
      0,

    ids:
      ordered
        .map(
          (
            override,
          ) =>
            override.id,
        )
        .filter(
          (
            id,
          ): id is string =>
            Boolean(
              id,
            ),
        ),

    values,

    note:
      notes.length >
      0
        ? notes.join(
            " · ",
          )
        : null,
  };
}

export function applyMonthlyExpenseOverrides(
  profile: MonthlyExpenseProfile,
  values: MonthlyOverrideValues,
): MonthlyExpenseProfile {
  const salaries =
    values.salaries !==
    undefined
      ? maxZero(
          decimal(
            values.salaries,
          ),
        )
      : profile.salaries;

  const rent =
    values.rent !==
    undefined
      ? maxZero(
          decimal(
            values.rent,
          ),
        )
      : profile.rent;

  const marketing =
    values.marketing !==
    undefined
      ? maxZero(
          decimal(
            values.marketing,
          ),
        )
      : profile.marketing;

  return {
    ...profile,

    salaries,

    rent,

    marketing,

    totalOperatingExpensesBeforeCogs:
      sumDecimals([
        salaries,
        rent,
        marketing,
        profile.otherOperatingExpenses,
      ]),
  };
}

export function customerRuntimeOverrides(
  values: MonthlyOverrideValues,
): CustomerRuntimeOverrides {
  const result: CustomerRuntimeOverrides =
    {};

  if (
    values.cac !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.cac =
      values.cac;
  }

  if (
    values.churnRate !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.monthlyChurnRate =
      values.churnRate;
  }

  if (
    values.arpu !==
    undefined
  ) {
    result.arpu =
      values.arpu;
  }

  return result;
}

export type RevenueOverrideState = {
  revenueMode: RevenueMode;

  overrideRevenue:
    | string
    | undefined;

  recurringRevenuePercentage: string;

  recurringRevenue: Decimal;

  nonRecurringRevenue: Decimal;

  oneTimeRevenue: Decimal;

  totalRevenue: Decimal;

  mrr: Decimal;
};

export function applyMonthlyRevenueOverride(
  state: RevenueOverrideState,
): {
  recurringRevenue: Decimal;

  nonRecurringRevenue: Decimal;

  oneTimeRevenue: Decimal;

  totalRevenue: Decimal;

  mrr: Decimal;
} {
  if (
    state.overrideRevenue ===
    undefined
  ) {
    return {
      recurringRevenue:
        state.recurringRevenue,

      nonRecurringRevenue:
        state.nonRecurringRevenue,

      oneTimeRevenue:
        state.oneTimeRevenue,

      totalRevenue:
        state.totalRevenue,

      mrr:
        state.mrr,
    };
  }

  const totalRevenue =
    maxZero(
      decimal(
        state.overrideRevenue,
      ),
    );

  if (
    state.revenueMode ===
    "DIRECT"
  ) {
    const recurringShare =
      percentageToRate(
        state.recurringRevenuePercentage,
      );

    const recurringRevenue =
      totalRevenue.mul(
        recurringShare,
      );

    const nonRecurringRevenue =
      totalRevenue.minus(
        recurringRevenue,
      );

    return {
      recurringRevenue,

      nonRecurringRevenue,

      oneTimeRevenue:
        nonRecurringRevenue,

      totalRevenue,

      mrr:
        recurringRevenue,
    };
  }

  const recurringRevenue =
    minDecimal(
      state.mrr,
      totalRevenue,
    );

  const nonRecurringRevenue =
    maxZero(
      totalRevenue.minus(
        recurringRevenue,
      ),
    );

  return {
    recurringRevenue,

    nonRecurringRevenue,

    oneTimeRevenue:
      nonRecurringRevenue,

    totalRevenue,

    mrr:
      state.mrr,
  };
}

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";


export async function isProjectWorkspaceOwner(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const project =
    await prisma.project.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,
      },

      select: {
        workspaceId:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !project?.workspaceId
  ) {
    return false;
  }


  const membership =
    await prisma.workspaceMember.findFirst({
      where: {
        workspaceId:
          project.workspaceId,

        userId,

        role:
          "OWNER",
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,
      },
    });


  return Boolean(
    membership,
  );
}


export async function requireProjectWorkspaceOwner(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  const owner =
    await isProjectWorkspaceOwner(
      userId,
      projectId,
    );


  if (
    !owner
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Workspace Owner permission is required to reopen a closed financial period.",
    );
  }
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/period-close/register.ts #####
import type {
  FinancialPeriodActualView,
  FinancialPeriodRegister,
  FinancialPeriodStateView,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/types";


export function buildFinancialPeriodRegister({
  actuals,
  states,
}: {
  actuals:
    FinancialPeriodActualView[];

  states:
    FinancialPeriodStateView[];
}): FinancialPeriodRegister {
  const statesByPeriod =
    new Map(
      states.map(
        (
          state,
        ) => [
          state.periodKey,
          state,
        ],
      ),
    );


  const rows =
    actuals
      .map(
        (
          actual,
        ) => {
          const state =
            statesByPeriod.get(
              actual.periodKey,
            );


          return {
            periodKey:
              actual.periodKey,

            status:
              state?.status ??
              "OPEN" as const,

            closeSequence:
              state?.closeSequence ??
              0,

            closedAt:
              state?.closedAt ??
              null,

            closedByUserId:
              state?.closedByUserId ??
              null,

            reopenedAt:
              state?.reopenedAt ??
              null,

            reopenedByUserId:
              state?.reopenedByUserId ??
              null,

            revenue:
              actual.revenue,

            ebitda:
              actual.ebitda,

            cashBalance:
              actual.cashBalance,
          };
        },
      )
      .sort(
        (
          left,
          right,
        ) =>
          right.periodKey.localeCompare(
            left.periodKey,
          ),
      );


  return {
    rows,

    summary: {
      totalPeriods:
        rows.length,

      openPeriods:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.status ===
            "OPEN",
        ).length,

      closedPeriods:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.status ===
            "CLOSED",
        ).length,

      closeCycles:
        rows.reduce(
          (
            total,
            row,
          ) =>
            total +
            row.closeSequence,
          0,
        ),
    },
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/period-close/service.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";


export async function closeFinancialPeriod({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  period,
  periodKey,
  reason,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  period:
    Date;

  periodKey:
    string;

  reason:
    string |
    null;
}) {
  const now =
    new Date();


  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const actual =
          await transaction.actualPeriod.findFirst({
            where: {
              projectId,

              period,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,
            },
          });


        if (
          !actual
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `Actuals for ${periodKey} do not exist and cannot be closed.`,
          );
        }


        const existing =
          await transaction.financialPeriodState.findUnique({
            where: {
              projectId_period: {
                projectId,

                period,
              },
            },
          });


        if (
          existing?.status ===
          "CLOSED"
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `${periodKey} is already closed.`,
          );
        }


        const sequence =
          (
            existing?.closeSequence ??
            0
          ) +
          1;


        const state =
          await transaction.financialPeriodState.upsert({
            where: {
              projectId_period: {
                projectId,

                period,
              },
            },

            create: {
              projectId,

              period,

              status:
                "CLOSED",

              closeSequence:
                sequence,

              closedAt:
                now,

              closedByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },

            update: {
              status:
                "CLOSED",

              closeSequence:
                sequence,

              closedAt:
                now,

              closedByUserId:
                actorUserId,

              reopenedAt:
                null,

              reopenedByUserId:
                null,
            },
          });


        const event =
          await transaction.financialPeriodEvent.create({
            data: {
              projectId,

              period,

              action:
                "CLOSED",

              actorUserId,

              reason,

              sequence,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "FINANCIAL_CLOSE",

            action:
              "FINANCIAL_PERIOD_CLOSED",

            severity:
              "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "FinancialPeriodEvent",

            entityId:
              event.id,

            summary:
              `Financial period closed: ${periodKey}`,

            metadata: {
              periodKey,

              closeSequence:
                sequence,

              reason,
            },
          },
        });


        return state;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.financial-period.closed",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      periodKey,

      closeSequence:
        result.closeSequence,
    },
  );


  return result;
}


export async function reopenFinancialPeriod({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  period,
  periodKey,
  reason,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  period:
    Date;

  periodKey:
    string;

  reason:
    string;
}) {
  const now =
    new Date();


  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const existing =
          await transaction.financialPeriodState.findUnique({
            where: {
              projectId_period: {
                projectId,

                period,
              },
            },
          });


        if (
          !existing ||
          existing.status !==
            "CLOSED"
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `${periodKey} is not currently closed.`,
          );
        }


        const state =
          await transaction.financialPeriodState.update({
            where: {
              projectId_period: {
                projectId,

                period,
              },
            },

            data: {
              status:
                "OPEN",

              reopenedAt:
                now,

              reopenedByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },
          });


        const event =
          await transaction.financialPeriodEvent.create({
            data: {
              projectId,

              period,

              action:
                "REOPENED",

              actorUserId,

              reason,

              sequence:
                existing.closeSequence,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "FINANCIAL_CLOSE",

            action:
              "FINANCIAL_PERIOD_REOPENED",

            severity:
              "WARNING",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "FinancialPeriodEvent",

            entityId:
              event.id,

            summary:
              `Financial period reopened: ${periodKey}`,

            metadata: {
              periodKey,

              closeSequence:
                existing.closeSequence,

              reason,
            },
          },
        });


        return state;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "warn",
    "project.financial-period.reopened",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      periodKey,

      closeSequence:
        result.closeSequence,
    },
  );


  return result;
}
