import {
  parseMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";

import {
  FINANCIAL_PERIOD_EVENT_ACTIONS,
  FINANCIAL_PERIOD_STATUSES,
  type FinancialPeriodEventAction,
  type FinancialPeriodStatus,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/types";


export function parseFinancialPeriodKey(
  raw:
    string,
): string {
  const parsed =
    parseMonthKey(
      raw,
    );


  if (
    !parsed
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Financial period must be a valid month.",
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


export function financialPeriodDate(
  periodKey:
    string,
): Date {
  const normalized =
    parseFinancialPeriodKey(
      periodKey,
    );


  const result =
    new Date(
      `${normalized}-01T00:00:00.000Z`,
    );


  if (
    Number.isNaN(
      result.getTime(),
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Financial period date is invalid.",
    );
  }


  return result;
}


export function financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
  value:
    Date,
): string {
  return `${value
    .getUTCFullYear()
    .toString()
    .padStart(
      4,
      "0",
    )}-${(
    value.getUTCMonth() +
    1
  )
    .toString()
    .padStart(
      2,
      "0",
    )}`;
}


export function parseFinancialPeriodStatus(
  value:
    string,
): FinancialPeriodStatus {
  if (
    FINANCIAL_PERIOD_STATUSES.includes(
      value as
        FinancialPeriodStatus,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      FinancialPeriodStatus;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid financial period status.",
  );
}


export function parseFinancialPeriodEventAction(
  value:
    string,
): FinancialPeriodEventAction {
  if (
    FINANCIAL_PERIOD_EVENT_ACTIONS.includes(
      value as
        FinancialPeriodEventAction,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      FinancialPeriodEventAction;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid financial period event action.",
  );
}


export function validateCloseConfirmation({
  periodKey,
  confirmation,
}: {
  periodKey:
    string;

  confirmation:
    string;
}) {
  const expected =
    `CLOSE ${periodKey}`;


  if (
    confirmation.trim() !==
    expected
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Confirmation must exactly match "${expected}".`,
    );
  }
}


export function validateReopenConfirmation({
  periodKey,
  confirmation,
}: {
  periodKey:
    string;

  confirmation:
    string;
}) {
  const expected =
    `REOPEN ${periodKey}`;


  if (
    confirmation.trim() !==
    expected
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Confirmation must exactly match "${expected}".`,
    );
  }
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/planning-cycle/baseline.ts #####
import {
  BASELINE_KINDS,
  type ForecastBaselineKind,
  type ForecastBaselineSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-cycle/types";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";


type JsonRecord =
  Record<
    string,
    unknown
  >;


function isRecord(
  value:
    unknown,
): value is
  JsonRecord {
  return (
    typeof value ===
      "object" &&
    value !==
      null &&
    !Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  );
}


function nullableNumber(
  value:
    unknown,
): number |
  null {
  return typeof value ===
    "number" &&
    Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
    ?
      value
    :
      null;
}


function forecastRow(
  value:
    unknown,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  if (
    !isRecord(
      value,
    ) ||
    typeof value.period !==
      "string"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid forecast baseline row.",
    );
  }


  return {
    period:
      value.period,

    revenue:
      nullableNumber(
        value.revenue,
      ),

    cogs:
      nullableNumber(
        value.cogs,
      ),

    grossProfit:
      nullableNumber(
        value.grossProfit,
      ),

    operatingExpenses:
      nullableNumber(
        value.operatingExpenses,
      ),

    ebitda:
      nullableNumber(
        value.ebitda,
      ),

    netIncome:
      nullableNumber(
        value.netIncome,
      ),

    cashFlow:
      nullableNumber(
        value.cashFlow,
      ),

    cashBalance:
      nullableNumber(
        value.cashBalance,
      ),

    mrr:
      nullableNumber(
        value.mrr,
      ),

    customers:
      nullableNumber(
        value.customers,
      ),

    cac:
      nullableNumber(
        value.cac,
      ),

    churnRate:
      nullableNumber(
        value.churnRate,
      ),
  };
}


export function parseBaselineKind(
  value:
    string,
): ForecastBaselineKind {
  if (
    BASELINE_KINDS.includes(
      value as
        ForecastBaselineKind,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      ForecastBaselineKind;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid baseline kind.",
  );
}


export function parseForecastBaselineSnapshot(
  value:
    unknown,
): ForecastBaselineSnapshot {
  if (
    !isRecord(
      value,
    ) ||
    value.schemaVersion !==
      1 ||
    typeof value.capturedAt !==
      "string" ||
    !Array.isArray(
      value.rows,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid forecast baseline snapshot.",
    );
  }


  const rows =
    value.rows.map(
      forecastRow,
    );


  if (
    rows.length ===
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Forecast baseline contains no forecast rows.",
    );
  }


  if (
    rows.length >
    120
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Forecast baseline exceeds the 120-period safety limit.",
    );
  }


  return {
    schemaVersion:
      1,

    capturedAt:
      value.capturedAt,

    rows,
  };
}


export function newForecastBaselineSnapshot(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
): ForecastBaselineSnapshot {
  return parseForecastBaselineSnapshot({
    schemaVersion:
      1,

    capturedAt:
      new Date()
        .toISOString(),

    rows:
      JSON.parse(
        JSON.stringify(
          rows,
        ),
      ) as
        unknown,
  });
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/planning-cycle/calculations.ts #####
import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import {
  normalizeForecastPeriodKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/variance";

import type {
  PlanningComparisonMetric,
  PlanningCycleReport,
  PlanningMetric,
  RollingReforecastRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-cycle/types";


const METRICS:
  PlanningMetric[] = [
    "revenue",
    "cogs",
    "operatingExpenses",
    "ebitda",
    "cashFlow",
    "cashBalance",
    "mrr",
  ];function forecastMetric(
  forecast:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow,
  metric:
    PlanningMetric,
): number |
  null {
  switch (
    metric
  ) {
    case "revenue":
      return forecast.revenue;

    case "cogs":
      return forecast.cogs;

    case "operatingExpenses":
      return forecast.operatingExpenses;

    case "ebitda":
      return forecast.ebitda;

    case "cashFlow":
      return forecast.cashFlow;

    case "cashBalance":
      return forecast.cashBalance;

    case "mrr":
      return forecast.mrr;
  }
}


function rollingValue(
  row:
    RollingReforecastRow,
  metric:
    PlanningMetric,
): number |
  null {
  return row[
    metric
  ];
}


function sumMetric<
  TRow,
>(
  rows:
    TRow[],
  getter:
    (
      row:
        TRow,
    ) =>
      number |
      null,
): number |
  null {
  const values =
    rows.flatMap(
      (
        row,
      ) => {
        const value =
          getter(
            row,
          );


        return value ===
          null
          ?
            []
          :
            [
              value,
            ];
      },
    );


  if (
    values.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return values.reduce(
    (
      total,
      value,
    ) =>
      total +
      value,
    0,
  );
}


function lastMetric<
  TRow,
>(
  rows:
    TRow[],
  getter:
    (
      row:
        TRow,
    ) =>
      number |
      null,
): number |
  null {
  for (
    let index =
      rows.length -
      1;
    index >=
      0;
    index -=
      1
  ) {
    const value =
      getter(
        rows[
          index
        ],
      );


    if (
      value !==
      null
    ) {
      return value;
    }
  }


  return null;
}


function aggregate(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  metric:
    PlanningMetric,
): number |
  null {
  if (
    metric ===
      "cashBalance"
  ) {
    return lastMetric(
      rows,
      (
        row,
      ) =>
        forecastMetric(
          row,
          metric,
        ),
    );
  }


  return sumMetric(
    rows,
    (
      row,
    ) =>
      forecastMetric(
        row,
        metric,
      ),
  );
}


function aggregateRolling(
  rows:
    RollingReforecastRow[],
  metric:
    PlanningMetric,
): number |
  null {
  if (
    metric ===
      "cashBalance"
  ) {
    return lastMetric(
      rows,
      (
        row,
      ) =>
        rollingValue(
          row,
          metric,
        ),
    );
  }


  return sumMetric(
    rows,
    (
      row,
    ) =>
      rollingValue(
        row,
        metric,
      ),
  );
}


function comparison(
  baseline:
    number |
    null,
  current:
    number |
    null,
  rolling:
    number |
    null,
): PlanningComparisonMetric {
  const currentVsBaseline =
    baseline !==
      null &&
    current !==
      null
      ?
        current -
        baseline
      :
        null;


  const rollingVsBaseline =
    baseline !==
      null &&
    rolling !==
      null
      ?
        rolling -
        baseline
      :
        null;


  const validBaseline =
    baseline !==
      null &&
    baseline !==
      0;


  return {
    baseline,

    currentForecast:
      current,

    rollingReforecast:
      rolling,

    currentVsBaseline,

    rollingVsBaseline,

    currentVsBaselineRate:
      currentVsBaseline !==
        null &&
      validBaseline
        ?
          currentVsBaseline /
          Math.abs(
            baseline,
          )
        :
          null,

    rollingVsBaselineRate:
      rollingVsBaseline !==
        null &&
      validBaseline
        ?
          rollingVsBaseline /
          Math.abs(
            baseline,
          )
        :
          null,
  };
}


export function buildRollingReforecast(
  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[],
  currentForecast:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
): RollingReforecastRow[] {
  const actualByPeriod =
    new Map<
      string,
      ActualFinancialPeriod
    >(
      actuals.map(
        (
          actual,
        ) => [
          actual.period,
          actual,
        ],
      ),
    );


  return currentForecast.flatMap<
    RollingReforecastRow
  >(
    (
      forecast,
    ): RollingReforecastRow[] => {
      const period =
        normalizeForecastPeriodKey(
          forecast.period,
        );


      if (
        !period
      ) {
        return [];
      }


      const actual =
        actualByPeriod.get(
          period,
        );


      if (
        actual
      ) {
        return [
          {
            period,

            source:
              "ACTUAL",

            revenue:
              actual.revenue,

            cogs:
              actual.cogs,

            operatingExpenses:
              actual.operatingExpenses,

            ebitda:
              actual.ebitda,

            cashFlow:
              actual.cashFlow,

            cashBalance:
              actual.cashBalance,

            mrr:
              actual.mrr,
          },
        ];
      }


      return [
        {
          period,

          source:
            "FORECAST",

          revenue:
            forecast.revenue,

          cogs:
            forecast.cogs,

          operatingExpenses:
            forecast.operatingExpenses,

          ebitda:
            forecast.ebitda,

          cashFlow:
            forecast.cashFlow,

          cashBalance:
            forecast.cashBalance,

          mrr:
            forecast.mrr,
        },
      ];
    },
  );
}


export function calculatePlanningCycleReport(
  baseline:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  currentForecast:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[],
): PlanningCycleReport {
  const rollingRows =
    buildRollingReforecast(
      actuals,
      currentForecast,
    );


  const metrics =
    Object.fromEntries(
      METRICS.map(
        (
          metric,
        ) => [
          metric,

          comparison(
            aggregate(
              baseline,
              metric,
            ),

            aggregate(
              currentForecast,
              metric,
            ),

            aggregateRolling(
              rollingRows,
              metric,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ) as
      Record<
        PlanningMetric,
        PlanningComparisonMetric
      >;


  return {
    actualPeriodsUsed:
      rollingRows.filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.source ===
          "ACTUAL",
      ).length,

    forecastPeriodsUsed:
      rollingRows.filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.source ===
          "FORECAST",
      ).length,

    metrics,

    rollingRows,

    baselineRows:
      baseline,

    currentForecastRows:
      currentForecast,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/planning-cycle/service.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";

import {
  newForecastBaselineSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-cycle/baseline";

import type {
  ForecastBaselineKind,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-cycle/types";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";


const MAX_BASELINES =
  20;


export async function createForecastBaseline({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  name,
  kind,
  modelVersion,
  rows,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  name:
    string;

  kind:
    ForecastBaselineKind;

  modelVersion:
    string;

  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];
}) {
  const snapshot =
    newForecastBaselineSnapshot(
      rows,
    );


  const baseline =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const count =
          await transaction.forecastBaseline.count({
            where: {
              projectId,
            },
          });


        if (
          count >=
          MAX_BASELINES
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `A project may contain at most ${MAX_BASELINES} immutable forecast baselines.`,
          );
        }


        return transaction.forecastBaseline.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            name,

            kind,

            modelVersion,

            snapshot:
              snapshot as never,

            createdByUserId:
              actorUserId,
          },

          select: {
            id:
              true,

            name:
              true,

            kind:
              true,

            createdAt:
              true,
          },
        });
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.forecast-baseline.created",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      baselineId:
        baseline.id,

      baselineName:
        baseline.name,

      baselineKind:
        baseline.kind,
    },
  );


  return baseline;
}

import type {
  PlanningTemplate,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/types";


function deepFreeze<
  T,
>(
  value:
    T,
): T {
  if (
    value !==
      null &&
    typeof value ===
      "object" &&
    !Object.isFrozen(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    Object.freeze(
      value,
    );


    for (
      const child
      of Object.values(
        value as
          Record<
            string,
            unknown
          >,
      )
    ) {
      deepFreeze(
        child,
      );
    }
  }


  return value;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/planning-templates/comparison.ts #####
import type {
  PlanningTemplate,
  PlanningTemplateBrief,
  PlanningTemplateComparisonRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/types";


export function comparePlanningTemplates(
  left:
    PlanningTemplate,
  right:
    PlanningTemplate,
): PlanningTemplateComparisonRow[] {
  const keys =
    [
      ...new Set(
        [
          ...left.assumptions.map(
            (
              assumption,
            ) =>
              assumption.key,
          ),

          ...right.assumptions.map(
            (
              assumption,
            ) =>
              assumption.key,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ];


  return keys
    .map(
      (
        key,
      ) => {
        const leftAssumption =
          left.assumptions.find(
            (
              assumption,
            ) =>
              assumption.key ===
              key,
          ) ??
          null;


        const rightAssumption =
          right.assumptions.find(
            (
              assumption,
            ) =>
              assumption.key ===
              key,
          ) ??
          null;


        const source =
          leftAssumption ??
          rightAssumption;


        if (
          !source
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Planning Template comparison invariant failed.",
          );
        }


        return {
          key,

          label:
            source.label,

          area:
            source.area,

          left:
            leftAssumption,

          right:
            rightAssumption,
        };
      },
    )
    .sort(
      (
        leftRow,
        rightRow,
      ) => {
        const area =
          leftRow.area.localeCompare(
            rightRow.area,
          );


        if (
          area !==
          0
        ) {
          return area;
        }


        return leftRow.label.localeCompare(
          rightRow.label,
        );
      },
    );
}


export function buildPlanningTemplateBrief(
  template:
    PlanningTemplate,
): PlanningTemplateBrief {
  const revenue =
    template.assumptions.filter(
      (
        assumption,
      ) =>
        assumption.area ===
        "REVENUE",
    );


  const operations =
    template.assumptions.filter(
      (
        assumption,
      ) =>
        assumption.area ===
          "OPEX" ||
        assumption.area ===
          "OPERATIONS",
    );


  const cash =
    template.assumptions.filter(
      (
        assumption,
      ) =>
        assumption.area ===
        "CASH",
    );


  const highRisks =
    template.risks.filter(
      (
        risk,
      ) =>
        risk.severity ===
        "HIGH",
    );


  return {
    templateId:
      template.id,

    title:
      `${template.name} planning brief`,

    revenueFocus:
      revenue.length >
        0
        ?
          `Build the revenue plan around ${revenue.map(
            (
              assumption,
            ) =>
              assumption.label.toLowerCase(),
          ).join(", ")}.`
        :
          "Define explicit operating drivers behind revenue.",

    operatingFocus:
      operations.length >
        0
        ?
          `Track ${operations.map(
            (
              assumption,
            ) =>
              assumption.label.toLowerCase(),
          ).join(", ")} as explicit operating assumptions.`
        :
          "Keep operating-cost assumptions visible and measurable.",

    liquidityFocus:
      cash.length >
        0
        ?
          `Protect liquidity using ${cash.map(
            (
              assumption,
            ) =>
              assumption.label.toLowerCase(),
          ).join(", ")}.`
        :
          "Establish a management cash floor and downside liquidity case.",

    kpiFocus:
      `Prioritize ${template.kpis.slice(
        0,
        5,
      ).join(", ")}.`,

    riskFocus:
      highRisks.length >
        0
        ?
          `Highest-priority risks: ${highRisks.map(
            (
              risk,
            ) =>
              risk.title,
          ).join(", ")}.`
        :
          `Monitor ${template.risks.map(
            (
              risk,
            ) =>
              risk.title,
          ).join(", ")}.`,
  };
}

export * from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/catalog";

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/planning-templates/matching.ts #####
import {
  PLANNING_TEMPLATES,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/catalog";

import type {
  PlanningTemplate,
  PlanningTemplateFit,
  PlanningTemplateMatch,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/types";


function normalizeText(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  return value
    .normalize(
      "NFKD",
    )
    .replace(
      /[\u0300-\u036f]/gu,
      "",
    )
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(
      /[^a-z0-9]+/gu,
      " ",
    )
    .replace(
      /\s+/gu,
      " ",
    )
    .trim();
}


function tokens(
  value:
    string,
): Set<string> {
  return new Set(
    normalizeText(
      value,
    )
      .split(
        " ",
      )
      .filter(
        (
          token,
        ) =>
          token.length >=
          2,
      ),
  );
}


function fitForScore(
  score:
    number,
): PlanningTemplateFit {
  if (
    score >=
    60
  ) {
    return "RECOMMENDED";
  }


  if (
    score >=
    25
  ) {
    return "POSSIBLE";
  }


  return "EXPLORATORY";
}


export function scorePlanningTemplate({
  industry,
  template,
}: {
  industry:
    string;

  template:
    PlanningTemplate;
}): PlanningTemplateMatch {
  const normalizedIndustry =
    normalizeText(
      industry,
    );


  const industryTokens =
    tokens(
      industry,
    );


  let score =
    0;


  const reasons:
    string[] =
      [];


  const normalizedSegment =
    normalizeText(
      template.segment,
    );


  const normalizedName =
    normalizeText(
      template.name,
    );


  if (
    normalizedIndustry &&
    (
      normalizedIndustry ===
        normalizedSegment ||
      normalizedIndustry ===
        normalizedName
    )
  ) {
    score +=
      70;

    reasons.push(
      "Industry directly matches the template segment.",
    );
  }


  if (
    normalizedIndustry &&
    (
      normalizedIndustry.includes(
        normalizedName,
      ) ||
      normalizedName.includes(
        normalizedIndustry,
      )
    )
  ) {
    score +=
      25;

    reasons.push(
      "Industry closely matches the template name.",
    );
  }


  let keywordHits =
    0;


  for (
    const keyword
    of template.keywords
  ) {
    const normalizedKeyword =
      normalizeText(
        keyword,
      );


    if (
      normalizedKeyword &&
      (
        normalizedIndustry.includes(
          normalizedKeyword,
        ) ||
        normalizedKeyword.includes(
          normalizedIndustry,
        )
      )
    ) {
      keywordHits +=
        1;
    }
  }


  if (
    keywordHits >
    0
  ) {
    score +=
      Math.min(
        40,
        keywordHits *
        15,
      );

    reasons.push(
      `${keywordHits} industry keyword match${keywordHits === 1 ? "" : "es"}.`,
    );
  }


  const templateTokens =
    new Set(
      [
        template.name,
        template.segment,
        ...template.keywords,
      ].flatMap(
        (
          value,
        ) => [
          ...tokens(
            value,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );


  const overlap =
    [
      ...industryTokens,
    ].filter(
      (
        token,
      ) =>
        templateTokens.has(
          token,
        ),
    );


  if (
    overlap.length >
    0
  ) {
    score +=
      Math.min(
        30,
        overlap.length *
        10,
      );

    reasons.push(
      `Shared industry terms: ${overlap.join(", ")}.`,
    );
  }


  const finalScore =
    Math.min(
      100,
      score,
    );


  if (
    reasons.length ===
    0
  ) {
    reasons.push(
      "No direct industry match; use this template only as an exploratory planning reference.",
    );
  }


  return {
    template,

    score:
      finalScore,

    fit:
      fitForScore(
        finalScore,
      ),

    reasons,
  };
}


export function rankPlanningTemplates(
  industry:
    string,
): PlanningTemplateMatch[] {
  return PLANNING_TEMPLATES
    .map(
      (
        template,
      ) =>
        scorePlanningTemplate({
          industry,

          template,
        }),
    )
    .sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) => {
        const scoreDifference =
          right.score -
          left.score;


        if (
          scoreDifference !==
          0
        ) {
          return scoreDifference;
        }


        return left.template
          .name
          .localeCompare(
            right.template.name,
          );
      },
    );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/portfolio-dashboard/calculations.ts #####
import type {
  PortfolioAttentionLevel,
  PortfolioCurrencySummary,
  PortfolioExecutiveDashboard,
  PortfolioProjectAnalytics,
  PortfolioProjectRow,
  PortfolioRiskDistribution,
} from "@/lib/finance/portfolio-dashboard/types";


function attentionLevel(
  score:
    number,
): PortfolioAttentionLevel {
  if (
    score >=
    70
  ) {
    return "CRITICAL";
  }


  if (
    score >=
    40
  ) {
    return "REVIEW";
  }


  if (
    score >=
    20
  ) {
    return "MONITOR";
  }


  return "STABLE";
}


function riskAttentionPoints(
  level:
    string |
    null,
): number {
  switch (
    level
  ) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return 45;


    case "HIGH":
      return 35;


    case "MODERATE":
      return 20;


    case "LOW":
      return 0;


    default:
      return 10;
  }
}


export function portfolioAttentionScore(
  analytics:
    PortfolioProjectAnalytics,
): number {
  const {
    project,
    liveSnapshot,
    scorecardSummary,
    forecastAvailable,
  } =
    analytics;


  let score =
    riskAttentionPoints(
      liveSnapshot?.kpis
        .liquidityRiskLevel ??
      null,
    );


  if (
    liveSnapshot?.kpis
      .capitalNeed &&
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .capitalNeed >
    0
  ) {
    score +=
      20;
  }


  score +=
    Math.min(
      20,
      (
        liveSnapshot?.actions
          .criticalOpen ??
        0
      ) *
      10,
    );


  score +=
    Math.min(
      10,
      (
        scorecardSummary
          ?.offTrack ??
        0
      ) *
      5,
    );


  if (
    project.latestPeriodCloseStatus ===
    "OPEN"
  ) {
    score +=
      5;
  }


  if (
    liveSnapshot?.kpis
      .forecastAccuracyScore !==
      null &&
    liveSnapshot?.kpis
      .forecastAccuracyScore !==
      undefined &&
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .forecastAccuracyScore <
      0.80
  ) {
    score +=
      10;
  }


  if (
    !forecastAvailable
  ) {
    score +=
      10;
  }


  return Math.min(
    100,
    score,
  );
}


function projectRow(
  analytics:
    PortfolioProjectAnalytics,
): PortfolioProjectRow {
  const score =
    portfolioAttentionScore(
      analytics,
    );


  const snapshot =
    analytics.liveSnapshot;


  return {
    id:
      analytics.project.id,

    name:
      analytics.project.name,

    industry:
      analytics.project.industry,

    currency:
      analytics.project.currency,

    role:
      analytics.project.role,

    isCurrentProject:
      analytics.project.isCurrentProject,

    latestActualPeriod:
      analytics.project.latestActualPeriod,

    latestActualCash:
      analytics.project.latestActualCash,

    latestPeriodCloseStatus:
      analytics.project.latestPeriodCloseStatus,

    forecastAvailable:
      analytics.forecastAvailable,

    liquidityRiskLevel:
      snapshot?.kpis
        .liquidityRiskLevel ??
      null,

    liquidityRiskScore:
      snapshot?.kpis
        .liquidityRiskScore ??
      null,

    capitalNeed:
      snapshot?.kpis
        .capitalNeed ??
      null,

    forecastAccuracy:
      snapshot?.kpis
        .forecastAccuracyScore ??
      null,

    openActions:
      snapshot?.actions
        .open ??
      0,

    criticalOpenActions:
      snapshot?.actions
        .criticalOpen ??
      0,

    overdueActions:
      snapshot?.actions
        .overdue ??
      0,

    offTrackTargets:
      analytics.scorecardSummary
        ?.offTrack ??
      0,

    atRiskTargets:
      analytics.scorecardSummary
        ?.atRisk ??
      0,

    attentionScore:
      score,

    attentionLevel:
      attentionLevel(
        score,
      ),
  };
}


function currencySummaries(
  analytics:
    PortfolioProjectAnalytics[],
): PortfolioCurrencySummary[] {
  const currencies =
    new Map<
      string,
      PortfolioCurrencySummary
    >();


  for (
    const item
    of analytics
  ) {
    const currency =
      item.project.currency;


    const existing =
      currencies.get(
        currency,
      ) ??
      {
        currency,

        projectCount:
          0,

        projectsWithForecast:
          0,

        projectsWithActualCash:
          0,

        latestActualCash:
          0,

        capitalNeed:
          0,
      };


    existing.projectCount +=
      1;


    if (
      item.forecastAvailable
    ) {
      existing.projectsWithForecast +=
        1;
    }


    if (
      item.project.latestActualCash !==
      null
    ) {
      existing.projectsWithActualCash +=
        1;

      existing.latestActualCash +=
        item.project.latestActualCash;
    }


    if (
      item.liveSnapshot
    ) {
      existing.capitalNeed +=
        item.liveSnapshot
          .kpis
          .capitalNeed;
    }


    currencies.set(
      currency,
      existing,
    );
  }


  return [
    ...currencies.values(),
  ].sort(
    (
      left,
      right,
    ) =>
      left.currency.localeCompare(
        right.currency,
      ),
  );
}


function riskDistribution(
  rows:
    PortfolioProjectRow[],
): PortfolioRiskDistribution {
  return {
    critical:
      rows.filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.liquidityRiskLevel ===
          "CRITICAL",
      ).length,

    high:
      rows.filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.liquidityRiskLevel ===
          "HIGH",
      ).length,

    moderate:
      rows.filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.liquidityRiskLevel ===
          "MODERATE",
      ).length,

    low:
      rows.filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.liquidityRiskLevel ===
          "LOW",
      ).length,

    unavailable:
      rows.filter(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.liquidityRiskLevel ===
          null,
      ).length,
  };
}


export function buildPortfolioExecutiveDashboard(
  analytics:
    PortfolioProjectAnalytics[],
): PortfolioExecutiveDashboard {
  const rows =
    analytics
      .map(
        projectRow,
      )
      .sort(
        (
          left,
          right,
        ) => {
          const attention =
            right.attentionScore -
            left.attentionScore;


          if (
            attention !==
            0
          ) {
            return attention;
          }


          const risk =
            (
              right.liquidityRiskScore ??
              -1
            ) -
            (
              left.liquidityRiskScore ??
              -1
            );


          if (
            risk !==
            0
          ) {
            return risk;
          }


          return left.name.localeCompare(
            right.name,
          );
        },
      );


  const accuracyValues =
    rows.flatMap(
      (
        row,
      ) =>
        row.forecastAccuracy ===
          null
          ?
            []
          :
            [
              row.forecastAccuracy,
            ],
    );


  return {
    rows,

    currencies:
      currencySummaries(
        analytics,
      ),

    summary: {
      loadedProjects:
        rows.length,

      forecastReady:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.forecastAvailable,
        ).length,

      forecastUnavailable:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            !row.forecastAvailable,
        ).length,

      criticalHighRisk:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.liquidityRiskLevel ===
              "CRITICAL" ||
            row.liquidityRiskLevel ===
              "HIGH",
        ).length,

      openCriticalActions:
        rows.reduce(
          (
            total,
            row,
          ) =>
            total +
            row.criticalOpenActions,
          0,
        ),

      offTrackTargets:
        rows.reduce(
          (
            total,
            row,
          ) =>
            total +
            row.offTrackTargets,
          0,
        ),

      openFinancialPeriods:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.latestPeriodCloseStatus ===
            "OPEN",
        ).length,

      averageForecastAccuracy:
        accuracyValues.length ===
          0
          ?
            null
          :
            accuracyValues.reduce(
              (
                total,
                value,
              ) =>
                total +
                value,
              0,
            ) /
            accuracyValues.length,

      riskDistribution:
        riskDistribution(
          rows,
        ),
    },
  };
}

type StringableValue = {
  toString(): string;
};

type PersistedFinancingEvent = {
  id?: string;

  name: string;

  type:
    | FinancingType
    | string;

  month: Date;

  amount:
    | string
    | number
    | StringableValue;

  apr?:
    | string
    | number
    | StringableValue
    | null;

  termMonths?:
    | number
    | null;

  repaymentStartMonth?:
    | Date
    | null;

  id?: string;

    | string
    | null;

    | null;

export type PersistedProjectFinancialSource = {
  id: string;

  name: string;

  currency: string;

  startMonth: Date;

  horizonMonths: number;

  revenueMode:
    | RevenueMode
    | string;

  modelVersion: string;

  baseAssumptions: unknown;

  financingEvents?: PersistedFinancingEvent[];

  monthlyOverrides?: PersistedMonthlyOverride[];
};

function asString(
  value:
    | string
    | number
    | StringableValue,
): string {
  return String(
    value,
  );
}

function toRevenueMode(
  value: string,
): RevenueMode {
  if (
    value ===
    "DIRECT"
  ) {
    return "DIRECT";
  }

  if (
    value ===
    "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN"
  ) {
    return "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN";
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Unsupported revenue mode: ${value}`,
  );
}

function toFinancingType(
  value: string,
): FinancingType {
  if (
    value ===
      "EQUITY" ||
    value ===
      "DEBT" ||
    value ===
      "GRANT" ||
    value ===
      "OTHER"
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Unsupported financing type: ${value}`,
  );
}

function toScenarioType(
  value: string,
): ScenarioType {
  if (
    value ===
      "BASE" ||
    value ===
      "BULL" ||
    value ===
      "BEAR" ||
    value ===
      "CUSTOM"
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Unsupported scenario type: ${value}`,
  );
}

function mapFinancingEvent(
  event: PersistedFinancingEvent,
): FinancingEventInput {
  return {
    id:
      event.id,

    name:
      event.name,

    type:
      toFinancingType(
        event.type,
      ),

    month:
      dateToMonthKey(
        event.month,
      ),

    amount:
      asString(
        event.amount,
      ),

    apr:
      event.apr ===
        null ||
      event.apr ===
        undefined
        ? null
        : asString(
            event.apr,
          ),

    termMonths:
      event.termMonths ??
      null,

    repaymentStartMonth:
      event.repaymentStartMonth
        ? dateToMonthKey(
            event.repaymentStartMonth,
          )
        : null,
  };
}

function mapMonthlyOverride(
  override: PersistedMonthlyOverride,
): MonthlyOverrideInput {
  return {
    id:
      override.id,

    projectId:
      override.projectId,

    scenarioId:
      override.scenarioId ??
      null,

    month:
      dateToMonthKey(
        override.month,
      ),

    values:
      parseMonthlyOverrideValues(
        override.values,
      ),

    note:
      override.note ??
      null,
  };
}

export function mapPersistedScenario(
  scenario: PersistedScenario,
): FinancialScenarioInput {
  return {
    id:
      scenario.id,

    name:
      scenario.name,

    type:
      toScenarioType(
        scenario.type,
      ),

    modifiers:
      scenario.modifiers ??
      {},
  };
}

export function buildFinancialModelInput(
  project: PersistedProjectFinancialSource,
  scenario?: PersistedScenario,
): FinancialModelInput {
  return {
    projectId:
      project.id,

    projectName:
      project.name,

    currency:
      project.currency,

    startMonth:
      dateToMonthKey(
        project.startMonth,
      ),

    horizonMonths:
      project.horizonMonths,

    revenueMode:
      toRevenueMode(
        project.revenueMode,
      ),

    modelVersion:
      project.modelVersion,

    assumptions:
      parseStoredFinancialAssumptions(
        project.baseAssumptions,
      ),

    financingEvents:
      (
        project.financingEvents ??
        []
      ).map(
        mapFinancingEvent,
      ),

    monthlyOverrides:
      (
        project.monthlyOverrides ??
        []
      ).map(
        mapMonthlyOverride,
      ),

    scenario:
      scenario
        ? mapPersistedScenario(
            scenario,
          )
        : undefined,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/revenue-engine.ts #####
import type Decimal from "decimal.js";

import type {
  DirectRevenueAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/types";
import {
  compoundValue,
  decimal,
  percentageToRate,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";

export type DirectRevenueMonthResult = {
  coreRevenue: Decimal;

  recurringRevenue: Decimal;

  nonRecurringRevenue: Decimal;

  oneTimeRevenue: Decimal;

  totalRevenue: Decimal;

  mrr: Decimal;
};

export function calculateDirectRevenueMonth(
  assumptions: DirectRevenueAssumptions,
  monthIndex: number,
): DirectRevenueMonthResult {
  const monthlyGrowthRate =
    percentageToRate(
      assumptions.monthlyGrowthRate,
    );

  const coreRevenue =
    compoundValue(
      assumptions
        .startingMonthlyRevenue,
      monthlyGrowthRate,
      monthIndex,
    );

  const recurringShare =
    percentageToRate(
      assumptions
        .recurringRevenuePercentage,
    );

  const recurringRevenue =
    coreRevenue.mul(
      recurringShare,
    );

  const coreNonRecurringRevenue =
    coreRevenue.minus(
      recurringRevenue,
    );

  const oneTimeRevenue =
    decimal(
      assumptions
        .monthlyOneTimeRevenue,
    );

  const nonRecurringRevenue =
    coreNonRecurringRevenue.plus(
      oneTimeRevenue,
    );

  const totalRevenue =
    coreRevenue.plus(
      oneTimeRevenue,
    );

  return {
    coreRevenue,
    recurringRevenue,
    nonRecurringRevenue,
    oneTimeRevenue,
    totalRevenue,
    mrr:
      recurringRevenue,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/risk-center/calculations.ts #####
import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import {
  parseMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";

import type {
  DownsideCashPeriod,
  LiquidityRiskLevel,
  LiquidityRiskReport,
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
  RiskGuardrail,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";


type NormalizedForecastRow = {
  period:
    string;

  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow;
};


function normalizeForecastRows(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null,
): NormalizedForecastRow[] {
  const normalized =
    rows.flatMap(
      (
        row,
      ) => {
        const period =
          parseMonthKey(
            row.period,
          );


        return period
          ?
            [
              {
                period,
                row,
              },
            ]
          :
            [];
      },
    );


  if (
    !latestActualPeriod
  ) {
    return normalized;
  }


  const future =
    normalized.filter(
      (
        entry,
      ) =>
        entry.period >
        latestActualPeriod,
    );


  return future.length >
    0
    ?
      future
    :
      normalized;
}


function numericValues(
  rows:
    NormalizedForecastRow[],
  getter:
    (
      row:
        ForecastAnalyticsRow,
    ) =>
      number |
      null,
): number[] {
  return rows.flatMap(
    (
      entry,
    ) => {
      const value =
        getter(
          entry.row,
        );


      return value ===
        null
        ?
          []
        :
          [
            value,
          ];
    },
  );
}


function minimum(
  values:
    number[],
): number |
  null {
  return values.length ===
    0
    ?
      null
    :
      Math.min(
        ...values,
      );
}


function maximum(
  values:
    number[],
): number |
  null {
  return values.length ===
    0
    ?
      null
    :
      Math.max(
        ...values,
      );
}


function firstPeriod(
  rows:
    NormalizedForecastRow[],
  predicate:
    (
      row:
        ForecastAnalyticsRow,
    ) =>
      boolean,
): {
  period:
    string;

  index:
    number;
} |
  null {
  const index =
    rows.findIndex(
      (
        entry,
      ) =>
        predicate(
          entry.row,
        ),
    );


  return index <
    0
    ?
      null
    :
      {
        period:
          rows[
            index
          ].period,

        index,
      };
}


function cashFlowProxy(
  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow,
): number {
  return (
    row.cashFlow ??
    row.netIncome ??
    row.ebitda ??
    0
  );
}


function openingCash(
  rows:
    NormalizedForecastRow[],
  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null,
): number {
  if (
    latestActualCash !==
      null
  ) {
    return latestActualCash;
  }


  const first =
    rows[
      0
    ]?.row;


  if (
    !first
  ) {
    return 0;
  }


  if (
    first.cashBalance !==
      null
  ) {
    return (
      first.cashBalance -
      cashFlowProxy(
        first,
      )
    );
  }


  return 0;
}


export function buildDownsideCashScenario(
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  policy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null,
  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null,
): DownsideCashPeriod[] {
  const normalized =
    normalizeForecastRows(
      rows,
      latestActualPeriod,
    );


  let cash =
    openingCash(
      normalized,
      latestActualCash,
    );


  return normalized.map(
    (
      entry,
    ) => {
      const row =
        entry.row;


      const baselineCashFlow =
        cashFlowProxy(
          row,
        );


      const revenueLoss =
        (
          row.revenue ??
          0
        ) *
        policy.downsideRevenueShock;


      const costBase =
        (
          row.cogs ??
          0
        ) +
        (
          row.operatingExpenses ??
          0
        );


      const extraCosts =
        costBase *
        policy.downsideCostInflation;


      const stressedCashFlow =
        baselineCashFlow -
        revenueLoss -
        extraCosts;


      cash +=
        stressedCashFlow;


      return {
        period:
          entry.period,

        baselineCashFlow,

        stressedCashFlow,

        stressedCashBalance:
          cash,
      };
    },
  );
}


function riskLevel(
  score:
    number,
): LiquidityRiskLevel {
  if (
    score >=
    75
  ) {
    return "CRITICAL";
  }


  if (
    score >=
    50
  ) {
    return "HIGH";
  }


  if (
    score >=
    25
  ) {
    return "MODERATE";
  }


  return "LOW";
}


function stateForBreach(
  breached:
    boolean,
  warning:
    boolean,
): "PASS" |
  "WARNING" |
  "BREACH" {
  if (
    breached
  ) {
    return "BREACH";
  }


  return warning
    ?
      "WARNING"
    :
      "PASS";
}


export function calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
  rows,
  policy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
}: {
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  policy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;
}): LiquidityRiskReport {
  const normalized =
    normalizeForecastRows(
      rows,
      latestActualPeriod,
    );


  const cashValues =
    numericValues(
      normalized,
      (
        row,
      ) =>
        row.cashBalance,
    );


  const minimumForecastCash =
    minimum(
      cashValues,
    );


  const exhaustion =
    firstPeriod(
      normalized,
      (
        row,
      ) =>
        row.cashBalance !==
          null &&
        row.cashBalance <=
          0,
    );


  const runwayMonths =
    exhaustion
      ?
        exhaustion.index +
        1
      :
        null;


  const minimumCashBreach =
    policy.minimumCash ===
      null
      ?
        null
      :
        firstPeriod(
          normalized,
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.cashBalance !==
              null &&
            row.cashBalance <
              policy.minimumCash!,
        );


  const margins =
    normalized.flatMap(
      (
        entry,
      ) => {
        const revenue =
          entry.row.revenue;


        const ebitda =
          entry.row.ebitda;


        if (
          revenue ===
            null ||
          ebitda ===
            null ||
          revenue ===
            0
        ) {
          return [];
        }


        return [
          {
            period:
              entry.period,

            margin:
              ebitda /
              revenue,
          },
        ];
      },
    );


  const minimumEbitdaMargin =
    minimum(
      margins.map(
        (
          margin,
        ) =>
          margin.margin,
      ),
    );


  const ebitdaBreach =
    policy.minimumEbitdaMargin ===
      null
      ?
        null
      :
        margins.find(
          (
            value,
          ) =>
            value.margin <
            policy.minimumEbitdaMargin!,
        ) ??
        null;


  const burns =
    normalized.flatMap(
      (
        entry,
      ) => {
        const flow =
          cashFlowProxy(
            entry.row,
          );


        return flow <
          0
          ?
            [
              {
                period:
                  entry.period,

                burn:
                  -flow,
              },
            ]
          :
            [];
      },
    );


  const maximumMonthlyBurn =
    maximum(
      burns.map(
        (
          burn,
        ) =>
          burn.burn,
      ),
    );


  const burnBreach =
    policy.maximumMonthlyBurn ===
      null
      ?
        null
      :
        burns.find(
          (
            value,
          ) =>
            value.burn >
            policy.maximumMonthlyBurn!,
        ) ??
        null;


  const downsideCash =
    buildDownsideCashScenario(
      rows,
      policy,
      latestActualPeriod,
      latestActualCash,
    );


  const minimumDownsideCash =
    minimum(
      downsideCash.map(
        (
          value,
        ) =>
          value.stressedCashBalance,
      ),
    );


  const downsideBreachIndex =
    downsideCash.findIndex(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value.stressedCashBalance <=
        0,
    );


  const downsideBreach =
    downsideBreachIndex <
      0
      ?
        null
      :
        downsideCash[
          downsideBreachIndex
        ];


  const runwayWarning =
    runwayMonths !==
      null &&
    runwayMonths <=
      policy.minimumRunwayMonths +
      2;


  const runwayBreach =
    runwayMonths !==
      null &&
    runwayMonths <
      policy.minimumRunwayMonths;


  const guardrails:
    RiskGuardrail[] = [
      {
        code:
          "MINIMUM_CASH",

        label:
          "Minimum cash",

        state:
          policy.minimumCash ===
            null
            ?
              "UNAVAILABLE"
            :
              stateForBreach(
                minimumCashBreach !==
                  null,
                minimumForecastCash !==
                  null &&
                minimumForecastCash <
                  policy.minimumCash *
                  1.2,
              ),

        current:
          minimumForecastCash,

        threshold:
          policy.minimumCash,

        breachPeriod:
          minimumCashBreach?.period ??
          null,

        message:
          policy.minimumCash ===
            null
            ?
              "No minimum-cash guardrail configured."
            :
            minimumCashBreach
              ?
                `Forecast cash falls below the configured floor in ${minimumCashBreach.period}.`
              :
                "Forecast cash remains above the configured floor.",
      },

      {
        code:
          "RUNWAY",

        label:
          "Cash runway",

        state:
          stateForBreach(
            runwayBreach,
            runwayWarning,
          ),

        current:
          runwayMonths,

        threshold:
          policy.minimumRunwayMonths,

        breachPeriod:
          exhaustion?.period ??
          null,

        message:
          runwayMonths ===
            null
            ?
              "No cash exhaustion is projected within the current forecast horizon."
            :
            runwayBreach
              ?
                `Cash exhaustion occurs before the ${policy.minimumRunwayMonths}-month runway guardrail.`
              :
                `Projected cash exhaustion is ${runwayMonths} months away.`,
      },

      {
        code:
          "EBITDA_MARGIN",

        label:
          "Minimum EBITDA margin",

        state:
          policy.minimumEbitdaMargin ===
            null
            ?
              "UNAVAILABLE"
            :
              stateForBreach(
                ebitdaBreach !==
                  null,
                minimumEbitdaMargin !==
                  null &&
                minimumEbitdaMargin <
                  policy.minimumEbitdaMargin +
                  0.03,
              ),

        current:
          minimumEbitdaMargin,

        threshold:
          policy.minimumEbitdaMargin,

        breachPeriod:
          ebitdaBreach?.period ??
          null,

        message:
          policy.minimumEbitdaMargin ===
            null
            ?
              "No EBITDA-margin guardrail configured."
            :
            ebitdaBreach
              ?
                `EBITDA margin falls below policy in ${ebitdaBreach.period}.`
              :
                "Forecast EBITDA margin remains within policy.",
      },

      {
        code:
          "MONTHLY_BURN",

        label:
          "Maximum monthly burn",

        state:
          policy.maximumMonthlyBurn ===
            null
            ?
              "UNAVAILABLE"
            :
              stateForBreach(
                burnBreach !==
                  null,
                maximumMonthlyBurn !==
                  null &&
                maximumMonthlyBurn >
                  policy.maximumMonthlyBurn *
                  0.85,
              ),

        current:
          maximumMonthlyBurn,

        threshold:
          policy.maximumMonthlyBurn,

        breachPeriod:
          burnBreach?.period ??
          null,

        message:
          policy.maximumMonthlyBurn ===
            null
            ?
              "No monthly-burn guardrail configured."
            :
            burnBreach
              ?
                `Monthly burn exceeds policy in ${burnBreach.period}.`
              :
                "Forecast monthly burn remains within policy.",
      },

      {
        code:
          "DOWNSIDE_LIQUIDITY",

        label:
          "Downside liquidity",

        state:
          stateForBreach(
            downsideBreach !==
              null,
            minimumDownsideCash !==
              null &&
            minimumDownsideCash <
              (
                policy.minimumCash ??
                0
              ),
          ),

        current:
          minimumDownsideCash,

        threshold:
          0,

        breachPeriod:
          downsideBreach?.period ??
          null,

        message:
          downsideBreach
            ?
              `Downside stress exhausts cash in ${downsideBreach.period}.`
            :
              "Downside stress preserves positive cash throughout the modeled horizon.",
      },
    ];


  let score =
    0;


  if (
    exhaustion
  ) {
    const months =
      exhaustion.index +
      1;


    score +=
      months <=
        3
        ?
          35
        :
        months <=
          6
          ?
            30
          :
          months <=
            12
            ?
              20
            :
              10;
  }


  if (
    minimumCashBreach
  ) {
    score +=
      20;
  }


  if (
    runwayBreach
  ) {
    score +=
      20;
  }


  if (
    ebitdaBreach
  ) {
    score +=
      15;
  }


  if (
    burnBreach
  ) {
    score +=
      10;
  }


  if (
    downsideBreach
  ) {
    score +=
      downsideBreachIndex <
        3
        ?
          20
        :
        downsideBreachIndex <
          6
          ?
            15
          :
          downsideBreachIndex <
            12
            ?
              10
            :
              5;
  }


  score =
    Math.min(
      100,
      score,
    );


  return {
    score,

    level:
      riskLevel(
        score,
      ),

    forecastPeriods:
      normalized.length,

    latestActualPeriod,

    latestActualCash,

    runwayMonths,

    firstCashExhaustionPeriod:
      exhaustion?.period ??
      null,

    firstMinimumCashBreachPeriod:
      minimumCashBreach?.period ??
      null,

    firstDownsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
      downsideBreach?.period ??
      null,

    minimumForecastCash,

    minimumDownsideCash,

    maximumMonthlyBurn,

    minimumEbitdaMargin,

    guardrails,

    downsideCash,
  };
}

      6,

    minimumEbitdaMargin:
      null,

    maximumMonthlyBurn:
      null,

    downsideRevenueShock:
      0.20,

    downsideCostInflation:
      0.10,
  };


function optionalNumber(
  raw:
    string,
  label:
    string,
): number |
  null {
  const trimmed =
    raw.trim();


  if (
    !trimmed
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  const parsed =
    Number(
      trimmed,
    );


  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      parsed,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${label} must be a valid number.`,
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


function requiredNumber(
  raw:
    string,
  label:
    string,
): number {
  const parsed =
    optionalNumber(
      raw,
      label,
    );


  if (
    parsed ===
    null
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${label} is required.`,
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


function percentage(
  raw:
    string,
  label:
    string,
  minimum:
    number,
  maximum:
    number,
): number {
  const parsed =
    requiredNumber(
      raw,
      label,
    );


  if (
    parsed <
      minimum ||
    parsed >
      maximum
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${label} must be between ${minimum}% and ${maximum}%.`,
    );
  }


  return parsed /
    100;
}


export function parseProjectRiskPolicy({
  minimumCash,
  minimumRunwayMonths,
  minimumEbitdaMarginPercent,
  maximumMonthlyBurn,
  downsideRevenueShockPercent,
  downsideCostInflationPercent,
}: {
  minimumCash:
    string;

  minimumRunwayMonths:
    string;

  minimumEbitdaMarginPercent:
    string;

  maximumMonthlyBurn:
    string;

  downsideRevenueShockPercent:
    string;

  downsideCostInflationPercent:
    string;
}): ProjectRiskPolicy {
  const cash =
    optionalNumber(
      minimumCash,
      "Minimum cash",
    );


  if (
    cash !==
      null &&
    cash <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Minimum cash cannot be negative.",
    );
  }


  const runway =
    requiredNumber(
      minimumRunwayMonths,
      "Minimum runway",
    );


  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      runway,
    ) ||
    runway <
      1 ||
    runway >
      60
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Minimum runway must be a whole number between 1 and 60 months.",
    );
  }


  const rawMargin =
    optionalNumber(
      minimumEbitdaMarginPercent,
      "Minimum EBITDA margin",
    );


  if (
    rawMargin !==
      null &&
    (
      rawMargin <
        -100 ||
      rawMargin >
        100
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Minimum EBITDA margin must be between -100% and 100%.",
    );
  }


  const burn =
    optionalNumber(
      maximumMonthlyBurn,
      "Maximum monthly burn",
    );


  if (
    burn !==
      null &&
    burn <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Maximum monthly burn cannot be negative.",
    );
  }


  return {
    minimumCash:
      cash,

    minimumRunwayMonths:
      runway,

    minimumEbitdaMargin:
      rawMargin ===
        null
        ?
          null
        :
          rawMargin /
          100,

    maximumMonthlyBurn:
      burn,

    downsideRevenueShock:
      percentage(
        downsideRevenueShockPercent,
        "Revenue downside shock",
        0,
        90,
      ),

    downsideCostInflation:
      percentage(
        downsideCostInflationPercent,
        "Cost inflation",
        0,
        100,
      ),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/scenario-engine.ts #####
import {
  clampDecimal,
  decimal,
  toFinancialString,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  FinancialAssumptionsV1,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/types";
import type {
  FinancialScenarioInput,
  RevenueMode,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

type ScenarioModifiers = {
  revenueGrowthMultiplier: string;

  customerAcquisitionGrowthMultiplier: string;

  arpuMultiplier: string;

  cacMultiplier: string;

  churnPercentagePointDelta: string;

  cogsPercentagePointDelta: string;
};

const DEFAULT_MODIFIERS: ScenarioModifiers =
  {
    revenueGrowthMultiplier:
      "1",

    customerAcquisitionGrowthMultiplier:
      "1",

    arpuMultiplier:
      "1",

    cacMultiplier:
      "1",

    churnPercentagePointDelta:
      "0",

    cogsPercentagePointDelta:
      "0",
  };

function readModifier(
  modifiers: unknown,
  key: keyof ScenarioModifiers,
  fallback: string,
): string {
  if (
    !modifiers ||
    typeof modifiers !==
      "object" ||
    Array.isArray(
      modifiers,
    )
  ) {
    return fallback;
  }

  const value =
    (
      modifiers as Record<
        string,
        unknown
      >
    )[key];

  if (
    typeof value ===
      "number" ||
    typeof value ===
      "string"
  ) {
    const parsed =
      decimal(
        value,
      );

    if (
      parsed.isFinite()
    ) {
      return toFinancialString(
        parsed,
      );
    }
  }

  return fallback;
}

export function parseScenarioModifiers(
  scenario:
    | FinancialScenarioInput
    | undefined,
): ScenarioModifiers {
  if (
    !scenario ||
    scenario.type ===
      "BASE"
  ) {
    return {
      ...DEFAULT_MODIFIERS,
    };
  }

  return {
    revenueGrowthMultiplier:
      readModifier(
        scenario.modifiers,
        "revenueGrowthMultiplier",
        "1",
      ),

    customerAcquisitionGrowthMultiplier:
      readModifier(
        scenario.modifiers,
        "customerAcquisitionGrowthMultiplier",
        "1",
      ),

    arpuMultiplier:
      readModifier(
        scenario.modifiers,
        "arpuMultiplier",
        "1",
      ),

    cacMultiplier:
      readModifier(
        scenario.modifiers,
        "cacMultiplier",
        "1",
      ),

    churnPercentagePointDelta:
      readModifier(
        scenario.modifiers,
        "churnPercentagePointDelta",
        "0",
      ),

    cogsPercentagePointDelta:
      readModifier(
        scenario.modifiers,
        "cogsPercentagePointDelta",
        "0",
      ),
  };
}

function cloneAssumptions(
  assumptions: FinancialAssumptionsV1,
): FinancialAssumptionsV1 {
  return JSON.parse(
    JSON.stringify(
      assumptions,
    ),
  ) as FinancialAssumptionsV1;
}

function multiplyPercentageValue(
  value: string,
  multiplier: string,
): string {
  const result =
    decimal(
      value,
    ).mul(
      clampDecimal(
        decimal(
          multiplier,
        ),
        0,
        1000,
      ),
    );

  return toFinancialString(
    clampDecimal(
      result,
      -100,
      10000,
    ),
  );
}

export function applyScenarioToAssumptions(
  assumptions: FinancialAssumptionsV1,
  revenueMode: RevenueMode,
  scenario:
    | FinancialScenarioInput
    | undefined,
): FinancialAssumptionsV1 {
  const next =
    cloneAssumptions(
      assumptions,
    );

  if (
    !scenario ||
    scenario.type ===
      "BASE"
  ) {
    return next;
  }

  const modifiers =
    parseScenarioModifiers(
      scenario,
    );

  if (
    revenueMode ===
    "DIRECT"
  ) {
    next.directRevenue.monthlyGrowthRate =
      multiplyPercentageValue(
        next.directRevenue
          .monthlyGrowthRate,
        modifiers
          .revenueGrowthMultiplier,
      );
  } else {
    next.customerRevenue.customerAcquisitionGrowthRate =
      multiplyPercentageValue(
        next.customerRevenue
          .customerAcquisitionGrowthRate,
        modifiers
          .customerAcquisitionGrowthMultiplier,
      );

    const adjustedArpu =
      decimal(
        next.customerRevenue
          .arpu,
      ).mul(
        clampDecimal(
          decimal(
            modifiers.arpuMultiplier,
          ),
          0,
          1000,
        ),
      );

    next.customerRevenue.arpu =
      toFinancialString(
        adjustedArpu,
      );

    const adjustedCac =
      decimal(
        next.customerRevenue
          .cac,
      ).mul(
        clampDecimal(
          decimal(
            modifiers.cacMultiplier,
          ),
          0,
          1000,
        ),
      );

    next.customerRevenue.cac =
      toFinancialString(
        clampDecimal(
          adjustedCac,
          "0.000000000001",
          "1000000000000000",
        ),
      );

    const churnDeltaPercentagePoints =
      decimal(
        modifiers
          .churnPercentagePointDelta,
      ).mul(
        100,
      );

    next.customerRevenue.monthlyChurnRate =
      toFinancialString(
        clampDecimal(
          decimal(
            next.customerRevenue
              .monthlyChurnRate,
          ).plus(
            churnDeltaPercentagePoints,
          ),
          0,
          100,
        ),
      );
  }

  if (
    next.expenses.cogs
      .method ===
    "PERCENTAGE"
  ) {
    const cogsDeltaPercentagePoints =
      decimal(
        modifiers
          .cogsPercentagePointDelta,
      ).mul(
        100,
      );

    next.expenses.cogs.percentage =
      toFinancialString(
        clampDecimal(
          decimal(
            next.expenses.cogs
              .percentage,
          ).plus(
            cogsDeltaPercentagePoints,
          ),
          0,
          100,
        ),
      );
  }

  return next;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/scorecard/calculations.ts #####
import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import {
  parseMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";

import {
  calculateForecastAccuracyReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/forecast-accuracy/calculations";

import {
  calculateLiquidityRiskReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/calculations";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";

import {
  kpiMetricDefinition,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/metrics";

import type {
  KpiMetricCode,
  KpiScorecardRow,
  KpiTargetStatus,
  KpiTargetView,
  KpiValueSource,
  ManagementScorecard,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/types";


type KpiObservedValue = {
  value:
    number |
    null;

  source:
    KpiValueSource;
};


function actualForPeriod(
  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[],
  period:
    string,
): ActualFinancialPeriod |
  null {
  return actuals.find(
    (
      actual,
    ) =>
      actual.period ===
      period,
  ) ??
    null;
}


function forecastForPeriod(
  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[],
  period:
    string,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow |
  null {
  return forecasts.find(
    (
      forecast,
    ) =>
      parseMonthKey(
        forecast.period,
      ) ===
      period,
  ) ??
    null;
}


function periodValue({
  metric,
  period,
  actuals,
  forecasts,
}: {
  metric:
    KpiMetricCode;

  period:
    string;

  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];

  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];
}): KpiObservedValue {
  const actual =
    actualForPeriod(
      actuals,
      period,
    );


  const forecast =
    forecastForPeriod(
      forecasts,
      period,
    );


  const actualValue = () => {
    if (
      !actual
    ) {
      return null;
    }


    switch (
      metric
    ) {
      case "REVENUE":
        return actual.revenue;


      case "EBITDA_MARGIN":
        if (
          actual.revenue ===
            null ||
          actual.ebitda ===
            null ||
          actual.revenue ===
            0
        ) {
          return null;
        }


        return (
          actual.ebitda /
          actual.revenue
        );


      case "CASH_BALANCE":
        return actual.cashBalance;


      case "MRR":
        return actual.mrr;


      case "CUSTOMERS":
        return actual.customers;


      case "RUNWAY_MONTHS":
      case "FORECAST_ACCURACY":
        return null;
    }
  };


  const observedActual =
    actualValue();


  if (
    observedActual !==
    null
  ) {
    return {
      value:
        observedActual,

      source:
        "ACTUAL",
    };
  }


  if (
    !forecast
  ) {
    return {
      value:
        null,

      source:
        "UNAVAILABLE",
    };
  }


  switch (
    metric
  ) {
    case "REVENUE":
      return {
        value:
          forecast.revenue,

        source:
          forecast.revenue ===
            null
            ?
              "UNAVAILABLE"
            :
              "FORECAST",
      };


    case "EBITDA_MARGIN":
      if (
        forecast.revenue ===
          null ||
        forecast.ebitda ===
          null ||
        forecast.revenue ===
          0
      ) {
        return {
          value:
            null,

          source:
            "UNAVAILABLE",
        };
      }


      return {
        value:
          forecast.ebitda /
          forecast.revenue,

        source:
          "FORECAST",
      };


    case "CASH_BALANCE":
      return {
        value:
          forecast.cashBalance,

        source:
          forecast.cashBalance ===
            null
            ?
              "UNAVAILABLE"
            :
              "FORECAST",
      };


    case "MRR":
      return {
        value:
          forecast.mrr,

        source:
          forecast.mrr ===
            null
            ?
              "UNAVAILABLE"
            :
              "FORECAST",
      };


    case "CUSTOMERS":
      return {
        value:
          forecast.customers,

        source:
          forecast.customers ===
            null
            ?
              "UNAVAILABLE"
            :
              "FORECAST",
      };


    case "RUNWAY_MONTHS":
    case "FORECAST_ACCURACY":
      return {
        value:
          null,

        source:
          "UNAVAILABLE",
      };
  }
}


function statusForValue({
  metric,
  current,
  target,
}: {
  metric:
    KpiMetricCode;

  current:
    number |
    null;

  target:
    number;
}): {
  status:
    KpiTargetStatus;

  threshold:
    number;
} {
  const definition =
    kpiMetricDefinition(
      metric,
    );


  const tolerance =
    definition
      .atRiskTolerance(
        target,
      );


  const threshold =
    target -
    tolerance;


  if (
    current ===
    null
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "UNAVAILABLE",

      threshold,
    };
  }


  if (
    current >=
    target
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "ON_TRACK",

      threshold,
    };
  }


  if (
    current >=
    threshold
  ) {
    return {
      status:
        "AT_RISK",

      threshold,
    };
  }


  return {
    status:
      "OFF_TRACK",

    threshold,
  };
}


const STATUS_ORDER = {
  OFF_TRACK:
    0,

  AT_RISK:
    1,

  UNAVAILABLE:
    2,

  ON_TRACK:
    3,
} as const;


export function calculateManagementScorecard({
  targets,
  actuals,
  forecasts,
  riskPolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
}: {
  targets:
    KpiTargetView[];

  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];

  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  riskPolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;
}): ManagementScorecard {
  const accuracy =
    calculateForecastAccuracyReport(
      actuals,
      forecasts,
    );


  const risk =
    calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
      rows:
        forecasts,

      policy:
        riskPolicy,

      latestActualPeriod,

      latestActualCash,
    });


  const analyticsValue = (
    metric:
      KpiMetricCode,
  ): KpiObservedValue => {
    switch (
      metric
    ) {
      case "RUNWAY_MONTHS":
        return {
          value:
            risk.runwayMonths ??
            (
              risk.forecastPeriods >
                0
                ?
                  risk.forecastPeriods
                :
                  null
            ),

          source:
            risk.forecastPeriods >
              0
              ?
                "LIVE_ANALYTICS"
              :
                "UNAVAILABLE",
        };


      case "FORECAST_ACCURACY":
        return {
          value:
            accuracy
              .overallAccuracyScore,

          source:
            accuracy
              .overallAccuracyScore ===
              null
              ?
                "UNAVAILABLE"
              :
                "LIVE_ANALYTICS",
        };


      case "REVENUE":
      case "EBITDA_MARGIN":
      case "CASH_BALANCE":
      case "MRR":
      case "CUSTOMERS":
        return {
          value:
            null,

          source:
            "UNAVAILABLE",
        };
    }
  };


  const rows:
    KpiScorecardRow[] =
      targets.map(
        (
          target,
        ) => {
          const observed =
            target.metricCode ===
              "RUNWAY_MONTHS" ||
            target.metricCode ===
              "FORECAST_ACCURACY"
              ?
                analyticsValue(
                  target.metricCode,
                )
              :
                periodValue({
                  metric:
                    target.metricCode,

                  period:
                    target.periodKey,

                  actuals,

                  forecasts,
                });


          const result =
            statusForValue({
              metric:
                target.metricCode,

              current:
                observed.value,

              target:
                target.targetValue,
            });


          return {
            target,

            currentValue:
              observed.value,

            source:
              observed.source,

            status:
              result.status,

            gap:
              observed.value ===
                null
                ?
                  null
                :
                  observed.value -
                  target.targetValue,

            atRiskThreshold:
              result.threshold,
          };
        },
      )
        .sort(
          (
            left,
            right,
          ) => {
            const status =
              STATUS_ORDER[
                left.status
              ] -
              STATUS_ORDER[
                right.status
              ];


            if (
              status !==
              0
            ) {
              return status;
            }


            const period =
              right.target
                .periodKey
                .localeCompare(
                  left.target
                    .periodKey,
                );


            if (
              period !==
              0
            ) {
              return period;
            }


            return left.target
              .metricCode
              .localeCompare(
                right.target
                  .metricCode,
              );
          },
        );


  const periods =
    new Set(
      rows.map(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.target
            .periodKey,
      ),
    );


  return {
    rows,

    summary: {
      total:
        rows.length,

      onTrack:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.status ===
            "ON_TRACK",
        ).length,

      atRisk:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.status ===
            "AT_RISK",
        ).length,

      offTrack:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.status ===
            "OFF_TRACK",
        ).length,

      unavailable:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.status ===
            "UNAVAILABLE",
        ).length,

      trackedPeriods:
        periods.size,
    },
  };
}

export type KpiMetricDefinition = {
  code:
    KpiMetricCode;

  label:
    string;

  format:
    "MONEY" |
    "PERCENT" |
    "NUMBER" |
    "MONTHS";

  atRiskTolerance:
    (
      target:
        number,
    ) =>
      number;
};


export const KPI_METRICS:
  KpiMetricDefinition[] = [
    {
      code:
        "REVENUE",

      label:
        "Revenue",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      atRiskTolerance:
        (
          target,
        ) =>
          Math.abs(
            target,
          ) *
          0.10,
    },

    {
      code:
        "EBITDA_MARGIN",

      label:
        "EBITDA margin",

      format:
        "PERCENT",

      atRiskTolerance: () =>
        0.03,
    },

    {
      code:
        "CASH_BALANCE",

      label:
        "Cash balance",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      atRiskTolerance:
        (
          target,
        ) =>
          Math.abs(
            target,
          ) *
          0.10,
    },

    {
      code:
        "MRR",

      label:
        "MRR",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      atRiskTolerance:
        (
          target,
        ) =>
          Math.abs(
            target,
          ) *

    },

    {

        "CUSTOMERS",

      format:

      atRiskTolerance:
        (
          target,
        ) =>
          Math.max(
            1,

              Math.abs(
                target,
              ) *
              0.10,
            ),
          ),
    },

    {
