        "RUNWAY_MONTHS",

      label:
        "Runway",

      format:
        "MONTHS",

      atRiskTolerance: () =>
        2,
    },

    {
      code:
        "FORECAST_ACCURACY",

      label:
        "Forecast accuracy",

      format:
        "PERCENT",

      atRiskTolerance: () =>
        0.05,
    },
  ];


export function parseKpiMetricCode(
  value:
    string,
): KpiMetricCode {
  if (
    KPI_METRIC_CODES.includes(
      value as
        KpiMetricCode,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      KpiMetricCode;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid KPI metric.",
  );
}


export function kpiMetricDefinition(
  code:
    KpiMetricCode,
): KpiMetricDefinition {
  const definition =
    KPI_METRICS.find(
      (
        metric,
      ) =>
        metric.code ===
        code,
    );


  if (
    !definition
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "KPI metric definition is missing.",
    );
  }


  return definition;
}


export function parseKpiTargetPeriod(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const parsed =
    parseMonthKey(
      value,
    );


  if (
    !parsed
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Target period must be a valid month.",
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


function finiteNumber(
  raw:
    string,
  label:
    string,
): number {
  const value =
    Number(
      raw.trim(),
    );


  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${label} must be a valid number.`,
    );
  }


  return value;
}


export function parseKpiTargetValue(
  metric:
    KpiMetricCode,
  raw:
    string,
): number {
  const value =
    finiteNumber(
      raw,
      "KPI target",
    );


  switch (
    metric
  ) {
    case "EBITDA_MARGIN":
      if (
        value <
          -100 ||
        value >
          100
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "EBITDA margin target must be between -100% and 100%.",
        );
      }


      return value /
        100;


    case "FORECAST_ACCURACY":
      if (
        value <
          0 ||
        value >
          100
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Forecast accuracy target must be between 0% and 100%.",
        );
      }


      return value /
        100;


    case "CUSTOMERS":
      if (
        !Number.isInteger(
          value,
        ) ||
        value <
          0
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Customer target must be a non-negative whole number.",
        );
      }


      return value;


    case "RUNWAY_MONTHS":
      if (
        !Number.isInteger(
          value,
        ) ||
        value <
          1 ||
        value >
          120
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Runway target must be a whole number between 1 and 120 months.",
        );
      }


      return value;


    case "REVENUE":
    case "CASH_BALANCE":
    case "MRR":
      if (
        value <
        0
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Financial KPI target cannot be negative.",
        );
      }


      return value;
  }
}


export function targetValueForInput({
  metric,
  value,
}: {
  metric:
    KpiMetricCode;

  value:
    number;
}): number {
  return (
    metric ===
      "EBITDA_MARGIN" ||
    metric ===
      "FORECAST_ACCURACY"
  )
    ?
      value *
      100
    :
      value;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/scorecard/service.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";

import type {
  KpiMetricCode,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/types";


const MAX_TARGETS_PER_PROJECT =
  120;


export async function saveProjectKpiTarget({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  periodKey,
  metricCode,
  targetValue,
  ownerName,
  note,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  periodKey:
    string;

  metricCode:
    KpiMetricCode;

  targetValue:
    number;

  ownerName:
    string |
    null;

  note:
    string |
    null;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const existing =
          await transaction.projectKpiTarget.findUnique({
            where: {
              projectId_periodKey_metricCode: {
                projectId,

                periodKey,

                metricCode,
              },
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              targetValue:
                true,
            },
          });


        if (
          !existing
        ) {
          const count =
            await transaction.projectKpiTarget.count({
              where: {
                projectId,
              },
            });


          if (
            count >=
            MAX_TARGETS_PER_PROJECT
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `A project may contain at most ${MAX_TARGETS_PER_PROJECT} KPI targets.`,
            );
          }
        }


        const saved =
          await transaction.projectKpiTarget.upsert({
            where: {
              projectId_periodKey_metricCode: {
                projectId,

                periodKey,

                metricCode,
              },
            },

            create: {
              projectId,

              periodKey,

              metricCode,

              targetValue,

              ownerName,

              note,

              createdByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },

            update: {
              targetValue,

              ownerName,

              note,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              periodKey:
                true,

              metricCode:
                true,

              targetValue:
                true,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "SCORECARD",

            action:
              existing
                ?
                  "KPI_TARGET_UPDATED"
                :
                  "KPI_TARGET_CREATED",

            severity:
              "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "ProjectKpiTarget",

            entityId:
              saved.id,

            summary:
              `${existing ? "KPI target updated" : "KPI target created"}: ${metricCode} ${periodKey}`,

            metadata: {
              periodKey,

              metricCode,

              targetValue:
                saved.targetValue.toString(),

              previousTargetValue:
                existing
                  ?
                    existing.targetValue.toString()
                  :
                    null,
            },
          },
        });


        return saved;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.kpi-target.saved",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      kpiTargetId:
        result.id,

      periodKey:
        result.periodKey,

      metricCode:
        result.metricCode,
    },
  );


  return result;
}


export async function deleteProjectKpiTarget({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  targetId,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  targetId:
    string;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const target =
          await transaction.projectKpiTarget.findFirst({
            where: {
              id:
                targetId,

              projectId,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              periodKey:
                true,

              metricCode:
                true,

              targetValue:
                true,
            },
          });


        if (
          !target
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "KPI target was not found in this project.",
          );
        }


        await transaction.projectKpiTarget.delete({
          where: {
            id:
              target.id,
          },
        });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "SCORECARD",

            action:
              "KPI_TARGET_DELETED",

            severity:
              "WARNING",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "ProjectKpiTarget",

            entityId:
              target.id,

            summary:
              `KPI target deleted: ${target.metricCode} ${target.periodKey}`,

            metadata: {
              periodKey:
                target.periodKey,

              metricCode:
                target.metricCode,

              targetValue:
                target.targetValue.toString(),
            },
          },
        });


        return target;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.kpi-target.deleted",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      kpiTargetId:
        targetId,
    },
  );


  return {
    id:
      result.id,
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/sensitivity-lab/calculations.ts #####
import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import {
  buildDownsideCashScenario,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/calculations";

import {
  calculateCapitalPlanningReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/calculations";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";

import type {
  SensitivityBoundaryPoint,
  SensitivityCell,
  SensitivityCellState,
  SensitivitySurface,
  SensitivitySurfaceSummary,
} from "@/lib/finance/sensitivity-lab/types";


export function buildSensitivityAxis(
  maximumRate:
    number,
  points:
    number,
): number[] {
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      maximumRate,
    ) ||
    maximumRate <
      0 ||
    maximumRate >
      1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Sensitivity maximum rate must be between 0 and 100%.",
    );
  }


  if (
    !Number.isInteger(
      points,
    ) ||
    points <
      2 ||
    points >
      7
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Sensitivity grid must contain between 2 and 7 points per axis.",
    );
  }


  const divisor =
    points -
    1;


  return Array.from(
    {
      length:
        points,
    },
    (
      _,
      index,
    ) => {
      const raw =
        maximumRate *
        index /
        divisor;


      /*
       * Sensitivity rates are model coordinates rather than
       * accumulated financial arithmetic. Canonicalizing the
       * coordinate avoids IEEE-754 representations such as
       * 0.30000000000000004 and keeps grid keys, comparisons,
       * tests, and UI labels deterministic.
       */
      return Number(
        raw.toFixed(
          12,
        ),
      );
    },
  );
}


function minimum(
  values:
    number[],
): number |
  null {
  return values.length ===
    0
    ?
      null
    :
      Math.min(
        ...values,
      );
}


function ending(
  values:
    number[],
): number |
  null {
  return values.length ===
    0
    ?
      null
    :
      values[
        values.length -
        1
      ];
}


function stateForCell({
  minimumCash,
  exhaustionPeriod,
  targetCashFloor,
}: {
  minimumCash:
    number |
    null;

  exhaustionPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  targetCashFloor:
    number;
}): SensitivityCellState {
  if (
    exhaustionPeriod !==
    null
  ) {
    return "CASH_EXHAUSTION";
  }


  if (
    minimumCash !==
      null &&
    minimumCash <
      targetCashFloor
  ) {
    return "FLOOR_BREACH";
  }


  return "RESILIENT";
}


export function calculateSensitivityCell({
  rows,
  basePolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
  targetCashFloor,
  revenueShock,
  costInflation,
}: {
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  basePolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  targetCashFloor:
    number;

  revenueShock:
    number;

  costInflation:
    number;
}): SensitivityCell {
  if (
    revenueShock <
      0 ||
    revenueShock >
      1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Revenue shock must be between 0 and 100%.",
    );
  }


  if (
    costInflation <
      0 ||
    costInflation >
      1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Cost inflation must be between 0 and 100%.",
    );
  }


  if (
    targetCashFloor <
      0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Target cash floor cannot be negative.",
    );
  }


  const policy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy = {
      ...basePolicy,

      minimumCash:
        targetCashFloor,

      downsideRevenueShock:
        revenueShock,

      downsideCostInflation:
        costInflation,
    };


  const downside =
    buildDownsideCashScenario(
      rows,
      policy,
      latestActualPeriod,
      latestActualCash,
    );


  const balances =
    downside.map(
      (
        point,
      ) =>
        point.stressedCashBalance,
    );


  const minimumCash =
    minimum(
      balances,
    );


  const endingCash =
    ending(
      balances,
    );


  const cashExhaustionPeriod =
    downside.find(
      (
        point,
      ) =>
        point.stressedCashBalance <=
        0,
    )?.period ??
    null;


  const capital =
    calculateCapitalPlanningReport({
      basis:
        "DOWNSIDE",

      rows,

      riskPolicy:
        policy,

      latestActualPeriod,

      latestActualCash,

      inputs: {
        targetCashFloor,

        raisePeriodIndex:
          0,

        capitalAmount:
          0,

        preMoneyValuation:
          0,

        annualDebtRate:
          0,

        debtTermMonths:
          36,

        hybridEquityShare:
          0.50,
      },
    });


  return {
    revenueShock,

    costInflation,

    minimumCash,

    endingCash,

    cashExhaustionPeriod,

    capitalNeed:
      capital
        .requiredCapitalAfterRaise,

    state:
      stateForCell({
        minimumCash,

        exhaustionPeriod:
          cashExhaustionPeriod,

        targetCashFloor,
      }),
  };
}


function buildBoundary({
  cells,
  revenueShocks,
}: {
  cells:
    SensitivityCell[];

  revenueShocks:
    number[];
}): SensitivityBoundaryPoint[] {
  return revenueShocks.map(
    (
      revenueShock,
    ) => {
      const resilientCosts =
        cells
          .filter(
            (
              cell,
            ) =>
              Math.abs(
                cell.revenueShock -
                revenueShock,
              ) <
              1e-12 &&
              cell.capitalNeed ===
              0,
          )
          .map(
            (
              cell,
            ) =>
              cell.costInflation,
          );


      return {
        revenueShock,

        maximumCostInflationWithoutFunding:
          resilientCosts.length ===
            0
            ?
              null
            :
              Math.max(
                ...resilientCosts,
              ),
      };
    },
  );
}


function summarize(
  cells:
    SensitivityCell[],
): SensitivitySurfaceSummary {
  const minimumCashValues =
    cells.flatMap(
      (
        cell,
      ) =>
        cell.minimumCash ===
          null
          ?
            []
          :
            [
              cell.minimumCash,
            ],
    );


  const exhaustionPeriods =
    cells.flatMap(
      (
        cell,
      ) =>
        cell.cashExhaustionPeriod
          ?
            [
              cell.cashExhaustionPeriod,
            ]
          :
            [],
    )
      .sort();


  return {
    totalCells:
      cells.length,

    resilientCells:
      cells.filter(
        (
          cell,
        ) =>
          cell.state ===
          "RESILIENT",
      ).length,

    floorBreachCells:
      cells.filter(
        (
          cell,
        ) =>
          cell.state ===
          "FLOOR_BREACH",
      ).length,

    cashExhaustionCells:
      cells.filter(
        (
          cell,
        ) =>
          cell.state ===
          "CASH_EXHAUSTION",
      ).length,

    worstMinimumCash:
      minimum(
        minimumCashValues,
      ),

    maximumCapitalNeed:
      cells.length ===
        0
        ?
          0
        :
          Math.max(
            ...cells.map(
              (
                cell,
              ) =>
                cell.capitalNeed,
            ),
          ),

    earliestCashExhaustionPeriod:
      exhaustionPeriods[
        0
      ] ??
      null,
  };
}


export function calculateSensitivitySurface({
  rows,
  basePolicy,
  latestActualPeriod,
  latestActualCash,
  targetCashFloor,
  revenueShocks,
  costInflations,
}: {
  rows:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  basePolicy:
    ProjectRiskPolicy;

  latestActualPeriod:
    string |
    null;

  latestActualCash:
    number |
    null;

  targetCashFloor:
    number;

  revenueShocks:
    number[];

  costInflations:
    number[];
}): SensitivitySurface {
  if (
    revenueShocks.length <
      2 ||
    revenueShocks.length >
      7 ||
    costInflations.length <
      2 ||
    costInflations.length >
      7
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Sensitivity surfaces require between 2 and 7 values on each axis.",
    );
  }


  const normalizedRevenue =
    [
      ...revenueShocks,
    ].sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) =>
        left -
        right,
    );


  const normalizedCosts =
    [
      ...costInflations,
    ].sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) =>
        left -
        right,
    );


  const cells =
    normalizedRevenue.flatMap(
      (
        revenueShock,
      ) =>
        normalizedCosts.map(
          (
            costInflation,
          ) =>
            calculateSensitivityCell({
              rows,

              basePolicy,

              latestActualPeriod,

              latestActualCash,

              targetCashFloor,

              revenueShock,

              costInflation,
            }),
        ),
    );


  return {
    revenueShocks:
      normalizedRevenue,

    costInflations:
      normalizedCosts,

    targetCashFloor,

    cells,

    boundary:
      buildBoundary({
        cells,

        revenueShocks:
          normalizedRevenue,
      }),

    summary:
      summarize(
        cells,
      ),
  };
}

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import {
  parseMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";

import {
  VARIANCE_METRICS,
  varianceMetricDefinition,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/metrics";

import type {
  VarianceCommentaryView,
  VarianceFavorability,
  VarianceMateriality,
  VarianceMetricCode,
  VarianceReview,
  VarianceReviewRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/types";


type MetricRow = {
  revenue:
    number |
    null;

  cogs:
    number |
    null;

  operatingExpenses:
    number |
    null;

  ebitda:
    number |
    null;

  netIncome:
    number |
    null;

  cashFlow:
    number |
    null;

  cashBalance:
    number |
    null;

  mrr:
    number |
    null;

  customers:
    number |
    null;
};


function metricValue(
  metric:
    VarianceMetricCode,
  row:
    MetricRow,
): number |
  null {
  switch (
    metric
  ) {
    case "REVENUE":
      return row.revenue;


    case "COGS":
      return row.cogs;


    case "OPERATING_EXPENSES":
      return row.operatingExpenses;


    case "EBITDA":
      return row.ebitda;


    case "NET_INCOME":
      return row.netIncome;


    case "CASH_FLOW":
      return row.cashFlow;


    case "CASH_BALANCE":
      return row.cashBalance;


    case "MRR":
      return row.mrr;


    case "CUSTOMERS":
      return row.customers;
  }
}


function forecastPeriod(
  row:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow,
): string |
  null {
  return parseMonthKey(
    row.period,
  );
}


function varianceRate(
  actual:
    number,
  forecast:
    number,
): number |
  null {
  if (
    forecast ===
    0
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return (
    actual -
    forecast
  ) /
    Math.abs(
      forecast,
    );
}


function favorability({
  metric,
  variance,
}: {
  metric:
    VarianceMetricCode;

  variance:
    number |
    null;
}): VarianceFavorability {
  if (
    variance ===
    null
  ) {
    return "UNAVAILABLE";
  }


  if (
    Math.abs(
      variance,
    ) <
    1e-9
  ) {
    return "NEUTRAL";
  }


  const direction =
    varianceMetricDefinition(
      metric,
    ).favorableDirection;


  if (
    direction ===
    "HIGHER"
  ) {
    return variance >
      0
      ?
        "FAVORABLE"
      :
        "UNFAVORABLE";
  }


  return variance <
    0
    ?
      "FAVORABLE"
    :
      "UNFAVORABLE";
}


function materiality({
  variance,
  rate,
}: {
  variance:
    number |
    null;

  rate:
    number |
    null;
}): VarianceMateriality {
  if (
    variance ===
    null
  ) {
    return "UNAVAILABLE";
  }


  if (
    Math.abs(
      variance,
    ) <
    1e-9
  ) {
    return "IMMATERIAL";
  }


  if (
    rate ===
    null
  ) {
    return "REVIEW";
  }


  const absoluteRate =
    Math.abs(
      rate,
    );


  if (
    absoluteRate >=
    0.10
  ) {
    return "MATERIAL";
  }


  if (
    absoluteRate >=
    0.05
  ) {
    return "REVIEW";
  }


  return "IMMATERIAL";
}


export function varianceReviewKey(
  periodKey:
    string,
  metricCode:
    VarianceMetricCode,
): string {
  return `${periodKey}:${metricCode}`;
}


export function calculateVarianceReview({
  actuals,
  forecasts,
  commentaries,
}: {
  actuals:
    ActualFinancialPeriod[];

  forecasts:
    ForecastAnalyticsRow[];

  commentaries:
    VarianceCommentaryView[];
}): VarianceReview {
  const forecastByPeriod =
    new Map(
      forecasts.flatMap(
        (
          forecast,
        ) => {
          const period =
            forecastPeriod(
              forecast,
            );


          return period
            ?
              [
                [
                  period,
                  forecast,
                ] as const,
              ]
            :
              [];
        },
      ),
    );


  const commentaryByKey =
    new Map(
      commentaries.map(
        (
          commentary,
        ) => [
          varianceReviewKey(
            commentary.periodKey,
            commentary.metricCode,
          ),
          commentary,
        ],
      ),
    );


  const rows:
    VarianceReviewRow[] =
      actuals.flatMap(
        (
          actual,
        ) => {
          const forecast =
            forecastByPeriod.get(
              actual.period,
            );


          if (
            !forecast
          ) {
            return [];
          }


          return VARIANCE_METRICS.map(
            (
              metric,
            ) => {
              const actualValue =
                metricValue(
                  metric.code,
                  actual,
                );


              const forecastValue =
                metricValue(
                  metric.code,
                  forecast,
                );


              const delta =
                actualValue ===
                  null ||
                forecastValue ===
                  null
                  ?
                    null
                  :
                    actualValue -
                    forecastValue;


              const rate =
                actualValue ===
                  null ||
                forecastValue ===
                  null
                  ?
                    null
                  :
                    varianceRate(
                      actualValue,
                      forecastValue,
                    );


              const key =
                varianceReviewKey(
                  actual.period,
                  metric.code,
                );


              return {
                key,

                periodKey:
                  actual.period,

                metricCode:
                  metric.code,

                actual:
                  actualValue,

                forecast:
                  forecastValue,

                variance:
                  delta,

                varianceRate:
                  rate,

                favorability:
                  favorability({
                    metric:
                      metric.code,

                    variance:
                      delta,
                  }),

                materiality:
                  materiality({
                    variance:
                      delta,

                    rate,
                  }),

                commentary:
                  commentaryByKey.get(
                    key,
                  ) ??
                  null,
              };
            },
          );
        },
      )
        .sort(
          (
            left,
            right,
          ) => {
            const period =
              right.periodKey.localeCompare(
                left.periodKey,
              );


            if (
              period !==
              0
            ) {
              return period;
            }


            const materialityOrder = {
              MATERIAL:
                0,

              REVIEW:
                1,

              IMMATERIAL:
                2,

              UNAVAILABLE:
                3,
            } as const;


            const materialityDifference =
              materialityOrder[
                left.materiality
              ] -
              materialityOrder[
                right.materiality
              ];


            if (
              materialityDifference !==
              0
            ) {
              return materialityDifference;
            }


            return left.metricCode.localeCompare(
              right.metricCode,
            );
          },
        );


  const commentaryStatuses =
    commentaries.map(
      (
        commentary,
      ) =>
        commentary.status,
    );


  return {
    rows,

    summary: {
      totalRows:
        rows.length,

      material:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.materiality ===
            "MATERIAL",
        ).length,

      materialUnexplained:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.materiality ===
              "MATERIAL" &&
            row.commentary ===
              null,
        ).length,

      unfavorable:
        rows.filter(
          (
            row,
          ) =>
            row.favorability ===
            "UNFAVORABLE",
        ).length,

      openCommentaries:
        commentaryStatuses.filter(
          (
            status,
          ) =>
            status ===
            "OPEN",
        ).length,

      monitoringCommentaries:
        commentaryStatuses.filter(
          (
            status,
          ) =>
            status ===
            "MONITORING",
        ).length,

      resolvedCommentaries:
        commentaryStatuses.filter(
          (
            status,
          ) =>
            status ===
            "RESOLVED",
        ).length,

      acceptedCommentaries:
        commentaryStatuses.filter(
          (
            status,
          ) =>
            status ===
            "ACCEPTED",
        ).length,

      reviewedPeriods:
        new Set(
          commentaries.map(
            (
              commentary,
            ) =>
              commentary.periodKey,
          ),
        ).size,
    },
  };
}

import {
  parseMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";

import {
  VARIANCE_CAUSE_CODES,

} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/types";


export type VarianceMetricDefinition = {
  code:
    VarianceMetricCode;

  label:
    string;

  format:
    "MONEY" |
    "NUMBER";

  favorableDirection:
    "HIGHER" |
    "LOWER";
};


export const VARIANCE_METRICS:
  VarianceMetricDefinition[] = [
    {
      code:
        "REVENUE",

      label:
        "Revenue",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      favorableDirection:
        "HIGHER",
    },

    {
      code:
        "COGS",

      label:
        "COGS",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      favorableDirection:
        "LOWER",
    },

    {
      code:
        "OPERATING_EXPENSES",

      label:
        "Operating expenses",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      favorableDirection:
        "LOWER",
    },

    {
      code:
        "EBITDA",

      label:
        "EBITDA",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      favorableDirection:
        "HIGHER",
    },

    {
      code:
        "NET_INCOME",

      label:
        "Net income",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      favorableDirection:
        "HIGHER",
    },

    {
      code:
        "CASH_FLOW",

      label:
        "Cash flow",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      favorableDirection:
        "HIGHER",
    },

    {
      code:
        "CASH_BALANCE",

      label:
        "Cash balance",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      favorableDirection:
        "HIGHER",
    },

    {
      code:
        "MRR",

      label:
        "MRR",

      format:
        "MONEY",

      favorableDirection:
        "HIGHER",
    },

    {
      code:
        "CUSTOMERS",

      label:
        "Customers",

      format:
        "NUMBER",

      favorableDirection:
        "HIGHER",
    },
  ];


export function varianceMetricDefinition(
  code:
    VarianceMetricCode,
): VarianceMetricDefinition {
  const definition =
    VARIANCE_METRICS.find(
      (
        metric,
      ) =>
        metric.code ===
        code,
    );


  if (
    !definition
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Variance metric definition is missing.",
    );
  }


  return definition;
}


export function parseVarianceMetricCode(
  value:
    string,
): VarianceMetricCode {
  if (
    VARIANCE_METRIC_CODES.includes(
      value as
        VarianceMetricCode,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      VarianceMetricCode;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid variance metric.",
  );
}


export function parseVarianceCauseCode(
  value:
    string,
): VarianceCauseCode {
  if (
    VARIANCE_CAUSE_CODES.includes(
      value as
        VarianceCauseCode,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      VarianceCauseCode;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid variance root cause.",
  );
}


export function parseVarianceNature(
  value:
    string,
): VarianceNature {
  if (
    VARIANCE_NATURES.includes(
      value as
        VarianceNature,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      VarianceNature;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid variance nature.",
  );
}


export function parseVarianceCommentaryStatus(
  value:
    string,
): VarianceCommentaryStatus {
  if (
    VARIANCE_COMMENTARY_STATUSES.includes(
      value as
        VarianceCommentaryStatus,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      VarianceCommentaryStatus;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid variance review status.",
  );
}


export function parseVariancePeriod(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const parsed =
    parseMonthKey(
      value,
    );


  if (
    !parsed
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Variance period must be a valid month.",
    );
  }


  return parsed;
}


export function parseRecoveryPeriod(
  value:
    string,
): string |
  null {
  if (
    !value.trim()
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return parseVariancePeriod(
    value,
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/finance/variance-review/service.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";

import type {
  VarianceCauseCode,
  VarianceCommentaryStatus,
  VarianceMetricCode,
  VarianceNature,
} from "@/lib/finance/variance-review/types";


const MAX_COMMENTARIES_PER_PROJECT =
  1000;


export async function saveVarianceCommentary({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  periodKey,
  metricCode,
  causeCode,
  varianceNature,
  explanation,
  correctiveAction,
  ownerName,
  recoveryPeriodKey,
  status,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  periodKey:
    string;

  metricCode:
    VarianceMetricCode;

  causeCode:
    VarianceCauseCode;

  varianceNature:
    VarianceNature;

  explanation:
    string;

  correctiveAction:
    string |
    null;

  ownerName:
    string |
    null;

  recoveryPeriodKey:
    string |
    null;

  status:
    VarianceCommentaryStatus;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const existing =
          await transaction.varianceCommentary.findUnique({
            where: {
              projectId_periodKey_metricCode: {
                projectId,

                periodKey,

                metricCode,
              },
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              status:
                true,

              causeCode:
                true,
            },
          });


        if (
          !existing
        ) {
          const count =
            await transaction.varianceCommentary.count({
              where: {
                projectId,
              },
            });


          if (
            count >=
            MAX_COMMENTARIES_PER_PROJECT
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              `A project may contain at most ${MAX_COMMENTARIES_PER_PROJECT} variance commentaries.`,
            );
          }
        }


        const saved =
          await transaction.varianceCommentary.upsert({
            where: {
              projectId_periodKey_metricCode: {
                projectId,

                periodKey,

                metricCode,
              },
            },

            create: {
              projectId,

              periodKey,

              metricCode,

              causeCode,

              varianceNature,

              explanation,

              correctiveAction,

              ownerName,

              recoveryPeriodKey,

              status,

              createdByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },

            update: {
              causeCode,

              varianceNature,

              explanation,

              correctiveAction,

              ownerName,

              recoveryPeriodKey,

              status,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              periodKey:
                true,

              metricCode:
                true,

              status:
                true,
            },
          });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "VARIANCE_REVIEW",

            action:
              existing
                ?
                  "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY_UPDATED"
                :
                  "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY_CREATED",

            severity:
              status ===
                "OPEN"
                ?
                  "WARNING"
                :
                  "INFO",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "VarianceCommentary",

            entityId:
              saved.id,

            summary:
              `${existing ? "Variance commentary updated" : "Variance commentary created"}: ${metricCode} ${periodKey}`,

            metadata: {
              periodKey,

              metricCode,

              causeCode,

              varianceNature,

              status,

              previousStatus:
                existing?.status ??
                null,

              previousCauseCode:
                existing?.causeCode ??
                null,

              recoveryPeriodKey,
            },
          },
        });


        return saved;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.variance-commentary.saved",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      varianceCommentaryId:
        result.id,

      periodKey:
        result.periodKey,

      metricCode:
        result.metricCode,

      status:
        result.status,
    },
  );


  return result;
}


export async function deleteVarianceCommentary({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  commentaryId,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  commentaryId:
    string;
}) {
  const commentary =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const existing =
          await transaction.varianceCommentary.findFirst({
            where: {
              id:
                commentaryId,

              projectId,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              periodKey:
                true,

              metricCode:
                true,

              status:
                true,

              causeCode:
                true,
            },
          });


        if (
          !existing
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Variance commentary was not found in this project.",
          );
        }


        await transaction.varianceCommentary.delete({
          where: {
            id:
              existing.id,
          },
        });


        await transaction.projectAuditEvent.create({
          data: {
            projectId,

            category:
              "VARIANCE_REVIEW",

            action:
              "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY_DELETED",

            severity:
              "WARNING",

            actorUserId,

            entityType:
              "VarianceCommentary",

            entityId:
              existing.id,

            summary:
              `Variance commentary deleted: ${existing.metricCode} ${existing.periodKey}`,

            metadata: {
              periodKey:
                existing.periodKey,

              metricCode:
                existing.metricCode,

              status:
                existing.status,

              causeCode:
                existing.causeCode,
            },
          },
        });


        return existing;
      },
    );


  logStructured(
    "info",
    "project.variance-commentary.deleted",
    {
      projectId,

      actorUserId,

      varianceCommentaryId:
        commentaryId,
    },
  );


  return {
    id:
      commentary.id,
  };
}

export function formatFinancingType(
  type: FinancingEventType,
): string {
  switch (
    type
  ) {
    case "EQUITY":
      return "Equity";

    case "DEBT":
      return "Debt";

    case "GRANT":
      return "Grant";

    case "OTHER":
      return "Other";
  }
}

export function financingTypeDescription(
  type: FinancingEventType,
): string {
  switch (
    type
  ) {
    case "EQUITY":
      return "Cash contribution without debt repayment.";

    case "DEBT":
      return "Loan financing with interest and principal repayment.";

    case "GRANT":
      return "Non-repayable grant financing.";

    case "OTHER":
      return "Other external cash financing.";
  }
}

##### FILE: ./lib/financing/schedule.ts #####
import {
  decimal,
  sumDecimals,
  toFinancialString,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  MonthlyForecast,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export type FinancingScheduleRow = {
  month: string;

  equityInflow: string;

  debtInflow: string;

  grantInflow: string;

  otherInflow: string;

  totalInflow: string;

  interestExpense: string;

  principalRepayment: string;

  netFinancingCashImpact: string;
};

export type FinancingScheduleSummary = {
  totalInflow: string;

  totalEquityInflow: string;

  totalDebtInflow: string;

  totalGrantInflow: string;

  totalOtherInflow: string;

  totalInterestExpense: string;

  totalPrincipalRepayment: string;

  netFinancingCashImpact: string;
};

export function buildFinancingSchedule(
  months: MonthlyForecast[],
): FinancingScheduleRow[] {
  return months
    .filter(
      (
        month,
      ) =>
        !decimal(
          month.financingInflows
            .total,
        ).eq(
          0,
        ) ||
        !decimal(
          month.interestExpense,
        ).eq(
          0,
        ) ||
        !decimal(
          month.debtPrincipalRepayment,
        ).eq(
          0,
        ),
    )
    .map(
      (
        month,
      ) => {
        const totalInflow =
          decimal(
            month.financingInflows
              .total,
          );

        const interest =
          decimal(
            month.interestExpense,
          );

        const principal =
          decimal(
            month.debtPrincipalRepayment,
          );

        return {
          month:
            month.month,

          equityInflow:
            month.financingInflows
              .equity,

          debtInflow:
            month.financingInflows
              .debt,

          grantInflow:
            month.financingInflows
              .grant,

          otherInflow:
            month.financingInflows
              .other,

          totalInflow:
            month.financingInflows
              .total,

          interestExpense:
            month.interestExpense,

          principalRepayment:
            month.debtPrincipalRepayment,

          netFinancingCashImpact:
            toFinancialString(
              totalInflow
                .minus(
                  interest,
                )
                .minus(
                  principal,
                ),
            ),
        };
      },
    );
}

export function summarizeFinancingSchedule(
  rows: FinancingScheduleRow[],
): FinancingScheduleSummary {
  const totalInflow =
    sumDecimals(
      rows.map(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.totalInflow,
      ),
    );

  const totalInterest =
    sumDecimals(
      rows.map(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.interestExpense,
      ),
    );

  const totalPrincipal =
    sumDecimals(
      rows.map(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.principalRepayment,
      ),
    );

  return {
    totalInflow:
      toFinancialString(
        totalInflow,
      ),

    totalEquityInflow:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          rows.map(
            (
              row,
            ) =>
              row.equityInflow,
          ),
        ),
      ),

    totalDebtInflow:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          rows.map(
            (
              row,
            ) =>
              row.debtInflow,
          ),
        ),
      ),

    totalGrantInflow:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          rows.map(
            (
              row,
            ) =>
              row.grantInflow,
          ),
        ),
      ),

    totalOtherInflow:
      toFinancialString(
        sumDecimals(
          rows.map(
            (
              row,
            ) =>
              row.otherInflow,
          ),
        ),
      ),

    totalInterestExpense:
      toFinancialString(
        totalInterest,
      ),

    totalPrincipalRepayment:
      toFinancialString(
        totalPrincipal,
      ),

    netFinancingCashImpact:
      toFinancialString(
        totalInflow
          .minus(
            totalInterest,
          )
          .minus(
            totalPrincipal,
          ),
      ),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/financing/types.ts #####
import {
  dateToMonthKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/dates";

export type FinancingEventType =
  | "EQUITY"
  | "DEBT"
  | "GRANT"
  | "OTHER";

export type FinancingEventViewModel = {
  id: string;

  name: string;

  type: FinancingEventType;

  month: string;

  amount: string;

  apr: string | null;

  termMonths: number | null;

  repaymentStartMonth: string | null;

  createdAt: string;

  updatedAt: string;
};

type StringableValue = {
  toString(): string;
};

type PersistedFinancingEvent = {
  id: string;

  name: string;

  type:
    | FinancingEventType
    | string;

  month: Date;

  amount:
    | string
    | number
    | StringableValue;

  apr:
    | string
    | number
    | StringableValue
    | null;

  termMonths:
    | number
    | null;

  repaymentStartMonth:
    | Date
    | null;

  createdAt: Date;

  updatedAt: Date;
};

function asFinancingType(
  value: string,
): FinancingEventType {
  if (
    value === "EQUITY" ||
    value === "DEBT" ||
    value === "GRANT" ||
    value === "OTHER"
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Unsupported financing type: ${value}`,
  );
}

export function serializeFinancingEvent(
  event: PersistedFinancingEvent,
): FinancingEventViewModel {
  return {
    id:
      event.id,

    name:
      event.name,

    type:
      asFinancingType(
        event.type,
      ),

    month:
      dateToMonthKey(
        event.month,
      ),

    amount:
      String(
        event.amount,
      ),

    apr:
      event.apr ===
      null
        ? null
        : String(
            event.apr,
          ),

    termMonths:
      event.termMonths,

    repaymentStartMonth:
      event.repaymentStartMonth
        ? dateToMonthKey(
            event.repaymentStartMonth,
          )
        : null,

    createdAt:
      event.createdAt.toISOString(),

    updatedAt:
      event.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/financing/validation.ts #####
import {
  z,
} from "zod";

const MONTH_PATTERN =
  /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/;

function positiveMoney(
  label: string,
) {
  return z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(
      1,
      `${label} is required.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        /^-?(?:\d+|\d+\.\d+|\.\d+)$/.test(
          value,
        ) &&
        Number.isFinite(
          Number(
            value,
          ),
        ),
      `${label} must be a valid number.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        Number(
          value,
        ) >
        0,
      `${label} must be greater than 0.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        Number(
          value,
        ) <=
        1_000_000_000_000_000,
      `${label} is too large.`,
    );
}

function optionalApr() {
  return z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value === "" ||
        (
          /^-?(?:\d+|\d+\.\d+|\.\d+)$/.test(
            value,
          ) &&
          Number.isFinite(
            Number(
              value,
            ),
          )
        ),
      "APR must be a valid number.",
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value === "" ||
        (
          Number(
            value,
          ) >=
            0 &&
          Number(
            value,
          ) <=
            100
        ),
      "APR must be between 0% and 100%.",
    );
}

const baseFinancingSchema =
  z
    .object({
      projectId:
        z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .min(
            1,
            "Project identifier is required.",
          ),

      name:
        z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .min(
            2,
            "Financing name must contain at least 2 characters.",
          )
          .max(
            100,
            "Financing name must contain at most 100 characters.",
          ),

      type:
        z.enum([
          "EQUITY",
          "DEBT",
          "GRANT",
          "OTHER",
        ]),

      month:
        z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .regex(
            MONTH_PATTERN,
            "Select a valid financing month.",
          ),

      amount:
        positiveMoney(
          "Financing amount",
        ),

      apr:
        optionalApr(),

      termMonths:
        z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .refine(
            (
              value,
            ) =>
              value === "" ||
              /^\d+$/.test(
                value,
              ),
            "Loan term must be a whole number of months.",
          )
          .refine(
            (
              value,
            ) =>
              value === "" ||
              (
                Number(
                  value,
                ) >=
                  1 &&
                Number(
                  value,
                ) <=
                  600
              ),
            "Loan term must be between 1 and 600 months.",
          ),

      repaymentStartMonth:
        z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .refine(
            (
              value,
            ) =>
              value === "" ||
              MONTH_PATTERN.test(
                value,
              ),
            "Select a valid repayment start month.",
          ),
    })
    .superRefine(
      (
        data,
        context,
      ) => {
        if (
          data.type !==
          "DEBT"
        ) {
          return;
        }

        if (
          data.apr ===
          ""
        ) {
          context.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            path: [
              "apr",
            ],
            message:
              "APR is required for debt financing.",
          });
        }

        if (
          data.termMonths ===
          ""
        ) {
          context.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            path: [
              "termMonths",
            ],
            message:
              "Loan term is required for debt financing.",
          });
        }
      },
    );

export const createFinancingEventSchema =
  baseFinancingSchema;

export const updateFinancingEventSchema =
  baseFinancingSchema.and(
    z.object({
      eventId:
        z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .min(
            1,
            "Financing event identifier is required.",
          ),
    }),
  );

export const deleteFinancingEventSchema =
  z.object({
    projectId:
      z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(
          1,
          "Project identifier is required.",
        ),

    eventId:
      z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(
          1,
          "Financing event identifier is required.",
        ),
  });

##### FILE: ./lib/notifications/calculations.ts #####
import {
  deterministicAlertFingerprint,
} from "@/lib/notifications/fingerprint";

import type {
  ProjectAlert,
  ProjectAlertInput,
  ProjectAlertSeverity,
} from "@/lib/notifications/types";


const SEVERITY_ORDER = {
  CRITICAL:
    0,

  WARNING:
    1,

  INFO:
    2,
} as const;


function alert({
  key,
  category,
  severity,
  title,
  detail,
  sourceHref,
  sourceLabel,
  createdAt =
    null,
}: Omit<
  ProjectAlert,
  "fingerprint" | "createdAt"
> & {
  createdAt?:
    string |
    null;
}): ProjectAlert {
  return {
    key,

    category,

    severity,

    title,

    detail,

    sourceHref,

    sourceLabel,

    createdAt,

    fingerprint:
      deterministicAlertFingerprint(
        [
          key,
          category,
          severity,
          title,
          detail,
          sourceHref,
        ].join(
          "|",
        ),
      ),
  };
}


function actionSeverity(
  priority:
    string,
): ProjectAlertSeverity {
  if (
    priority ===
    "CRITICAL"
  ) {
    return "CRITICAL";
  }


  if (
    priority ===
    "HIGH"
  ) {
    return "WARNING";
  }


  return "INFO";
}


export function deriveProjectAlerts({
  projectId,
  latestActualPeriod,
  liveSnapshot,
  scorecard,
  varianceReview,
  periodRegister,
  actions,
  auditEvents,
}: ProjectAlertInput): ProjectAlert[] {
  const alerts:
    ProjectAlert[] =
      [];


  const riskLevel =
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .liquidityRiskLevel;


  if (
    riskLevel ===
      "CRITICAL" ||
    riskLevel ===
      "HIGH"
  ) {
    alerts.push(
      alert({
        key:
          "LIQUIDITY_RISK",

        category:
          "LIQUIDITY",

        severity:
          riskLevel ===
            "CRITICAL"
            ?
              "CRITICAL"
            :
              "WARNING",

        title:
          `${riskLevel.toLowerCase()} liquidity risk`,

        detail:
          `Liquidity risk score ${liveSnapshot.kpis.liquidityRiskScore}/100; downside minimum cash ${String(
            liveSnapshot.kpis.minimumDownsideCash,
          )}; exhaustion ${liveSnapshot.kpis.downsideCashExhaustionPeriod ?? "not modeled"}.`,

        sourceHref:
          `/projects/${projectId}/risk-center`,

        sourceLabel:
          "Risk Center",
      }),
    );
  }


  if (
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .downsideCashExhaustionPeriod
  ) {
    alerts.push(
      alert({
        key:
          "DOWNSIDE_CASH_EXHAUSTION",

        category:
          "LIQUIDITY",

        severity:
          "CRITICAL",

        title:
          "Downside case exhausts cash",

        detail:
          `Modeled downside cash exhaustion occurs in ${liveSnapshot.kpis.downsideCashExhaustionPeriod}.`,

        sourceHref:
          `/projects/${projectId}/sensitivity-lab`,

        sourceLabel:
          "Sensitivity Lab",
      }),
    );
  }


  if (
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .capitalNeed >
    0
  ) {
    alerts.push(
      alert({
        key:
          "CAPITAL_NEED",

        category:
          "CAPITAL",

        severity:
          liveSnapshot.kpis
            .downsideCashExhaustionPeriod
            ?
              "CRITICAL"
            :
              "WARNING",

        title:
          "Additional capital is required",

        detail:
          `Current downside capital requirement: ${liveSnapshot.kpis.capitalNeed}.`,

        sourceHref:
          `/projects/${projectId}/capital-planning`,

        sourceLabel:
          "Capital Planning",
      }),
    );
  }


  if (
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .forecastAccuracyScore !==
      null &&
    liveSnapshot.kpis
      .forecastAccuracyScore <
      0.80
  ) {
    alerts.push(
      alert({
        key:
          "FORECAST_ACCURACY",

        category:
          "FORECAST",

        severity:
          liveSnapshot.kpis
            .forecastAccuracyScore <
            0.65
            ?
              "CRITICAL"
            :
              "WARNING",

        title:
          "Forecast accuracy requires attention",

        detail:
          `Historical forecast accuracy is ${(liveSnapshot.kpis.forecastAccuracyScore * 100).toFixed(
            1,
          )}%.`,

        sourceHref:
          `/projects/${projectId}/forecast-accuracy`,

        sourceLabel:
          "Forecast Accuracy",
      }),
    );
  }


  for (
    const actionItem
    of actions
  ) {
    if (
      actionItem.status ===
        "DONE" ||
      actionItem.status ===
        "DISMISSED"
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    if (
      actionItem.priority !==
        "CRITICAL" &&
      actionItem.priority !==
        "HIGH"
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    alerts.push(
      alert({
        key:
          `ACTION:${actionItem.id}`,

        category:
          "ACTION",

        severity:
          actionSeverity(
            actionItem.priority,
          ),

        title:
          actionItem.title,

        detail:
          `${actionItem.priority} priority · ${actionItem.status} · owner ${actionItem.ownerName ?? "unassigned"} · due ${actionItem.dueDate ?? "not set"}.`,

        sourceHref:
          `/projects/${projectId}/decision-center`,

        sourceLabel:
          "Decision Center",
      }),
    );
  }


  for (
    const row
    of scorecard.rows
  ) {
    if (
      row.status !==
        "OFF_TRACK" &&
      row.status !==
        "AT_RISK"
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    alerts.push(
      alert({
        key:
          `KPI:${row.target.id}`,

        category:
          "KPI",

        severity:
          row.status ===
            "OFF_TRACK"
            ?
              "WARNING"
            :
              "INFO",

        title:
          `${row.target.metricCode} target ${row.status.toLowerCase().replace(
            "_",
            " ",
          )}`,

        detail:
          `${row.target.periodKey} · target ${row.target.targetValue} · current ${row.currentValue ?? "unavailable"} · source ${row.source}.`,

        sourceHref:
          `/projects/${projectId}/scorecard`,

        sourceLabel:
          "Scorecard",
      }),
    );
  }


  for (
    const row
    of varianceReview.rows
  ) {
    if (
      row.materiality !==
        "MATERIAL" ||
      row.commentary !==
        null
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    alerts.push(
      alert({
        key:
          `VARIANCE:${row.key}`,

        category:
          "VARIANCE",

        severity:
          row.favorability ===
            "UNFAVORABLE"
            ?
              "CRITICAL"
            :
              "WARNING",

        title:
          `Material ${row.metricCode} variance is unexplained`,

        detail:
          `${row.periodKey} · variance ${row.variance ?? "unavailable"} · rate ${row.varianceRate ?? "unavailable"} · ${row.favorability}.`,

        sourceHref:
          `/projects/${projectId}/variance-review`,

        sourceLabel:
          "Variance Review",
      }),
    );
  }


  if (
    latestActualPeriod
  ) {
    const latestClose =
      periodRegister.rows.find(
        (
          row,
        ) =>
          row.periodKey ===
          latestActualPeriod,
      );


    if (
      latestClose?.status ===
      "OPEN"
    ) {
      alerts.push(
        alert({
          key:
            `FINANCIAL_CLOSE:${latestActualPeriod}`,

          category:
            "FINANCIAL_CLOSE",

          severity:
            "WARNING",

          title:
            `${latestActualPeriod} financial period remains open`,

          detail:
            "The latest Actual period has not yet been financially closed.",

          sourceHref:
            `/projects/${projectId}/period-close`,

          sourceLabel:
            "Financial Close",
        }),
      );
    }
  }


  for (
    const event
    of auditEvents
  ) {
    const significant =
      event.severity ===
        "CRITICAL" ||
      event.action ===
        "FINANCIAL_PERIOD_REOPENED";


    if (
      !significant
    ) {
      continue;
    }


    alerts.push(
      alert({
        key:
          `AUDIT:${event.id}`,

        category:
          "GOVERNANCE",

        severity:
          event.severity,

        title:
          event.action
            .toLowerCase()
            .replaceAll(
              "_",
              " ",
            ),

        detail:
          event.summary,

        sourceHref:
          `/projects/${projectId}/activity`,

        sourceLabel:
          "Activity Center",

        createdAt:
          event.createdAt,
      }),
    );
  }


  return alerts
    .sort(
      (
        left,
        right,
      ) => {
        const severity =
          SEVERITY_ORDER[
            left.severity
          ] -
          SEVERITY_ORDER[
            right.severity
          ];


        if (
          severity !==
          0
        ) {
          return severity;
        }


        const created =
          (
            right.createdAt ??
            ""
          ).localeCompare(
            left.createdAt ??
            "",
          );


        if (
          created !==
          0
        ) {
          return created;
        }


        return left.title.localeCompare(
          right.title,
        );
      },
    )
    .slice(
      0,
      100,
    );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/notifications/fingerprint.ts #####
function fnv1a32(
  value:
    string,
  seed:
    number,
): number {
  let hash =
    seed >>>
    0;


  for (
    let index =
      0;
    index <
    value.length;
    index +=
      1
  ) {
    hash ^=
      value.charCodeAt(
        index,
      );


    hash =
      Math.imul(
        hash,
        0x01000193,
      ) >>>
      0;
  }


  return hash;
}


export function deterministicAlertFingerprint(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const left =
    fnv1a32(
      value,
      0x811c9dc5,
    );


  const right =
    fnv1a32(
      [...value]
        .reverse()
        .join(
          "",
        ),
      0x9e3779b9,
    );


  return (
    left
      .toString(
        16,
      )
      .padStart(
        8,
        "0",
      )
    +
    right
      .toString(
        16,
      )
      .padStart(
        8,
        "0",
      )
  );
}

import type {
  ProjectAlert,
  ProjectAlertInbox,
  ProjectAlertReceiptView,
  ResolvedProjectAlert,
} from "@/lib/notifications/types";


export function resolveProjectAlertInbox({
  alerts,
  receipts,
  now,
}: {
  alerts:
    ProjectAlert[];

  receipts:
    ProjectAlertReceiptView[];

  now:
    Date;
}): ProjectAlertInbox {
  const receiptByKey =
    new Map(
      receipts.map(
        (
          receipt,
        ) => [
          receipt.alertKey,
          receipt,
        ],
      ),
    );


  const resolved:
    ResolvedProjectAlert[] =
      alerts.map(
        (
          alert,
        ) => {
          const stored =
            receiptByKey.get(
              alert.key,
            ) ??
            null;


          const sameFingerprint =
            stored?.fingerprint ===
            alert.fingerprint;


          const receipt =
            sameFingerprint
              ?
                stored
              :
                null;


          const dismissed =
            Boolean(
              receipt?.dismissedAt,
            );


          const snoozed =
            receipt?.snoozedUntil
              ?
                new Date(
                  receipt.snoozedUntil,
                ).getTime() >
                now.getTime()
              :
                false;


          return {
            alert,

            read:
              Boolean(
                receipt?.readAt,
              ),

            dismissed,

            snoozed,

            changedSinceReceipt:
              Boolean(
                stored &&
                !sameFingerprint
              ),

            receipt,
          };
        },
      );


  const visible =
    resolved.filter(
      (
        item,
      ) =>
        !item.dismissed &&
        !item.snoozed,
    );


  const dismissed =
    resolved.filter(
      (
        item,
      ) =>
        item.dismissed,
    );


  const snoozed =
    resolved.filter(
      (
        item,
      ) =>
        !item.dismissed &&
        item.snoozed,
    );


  return {
    visible,

    dismissed,

    snoozed,

    summary: {
      total:
        resolved.length,

      visible:
        visible.length,

      unread:
        visible.filter(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            !item.read,
        ).length,

      critical:
        visible.filter(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            item.alert.severity ===
            "CRITICAL",
        ).length,

      warning:
        visible.filter(
          (
            item,
          ) =>
            item.alert.severity ===
            "WARNING",
        ).length,

      dismissed:
        dismissed.length,

      snoozed:
        snoozed.length,
    },
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/notifications/service.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import type {
  AlertReceiptOperation,
} from "@/lib/notifications/validation";


export async function updateProjectAlertReceipt({
  projectId,
  userId,
  alertKey,
  fingerprint,
  operation,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  userId:
    string;

  alertKey:
    string;

  fingerprint:
    string;

  operation:
    AlertReceiptOperation;
}) {
  if (
    operation ===
    "UNREAD"
  ) {
    await prisma.projectAlertReceipt.deleteMany({
      where: {
        projectId,

        userId,

        alertKey,
      },
    });


    return;
  }


  const now =
    new Date();


  const snoozedUntil =
    operation ===
      "SNOOZE_24H"
      ?
        new Date(
          now.getTime() +
          24 *
          60 *
          60 *
          1000,
        )
      :
        null;


  await prisma.projectAlertReceipt.upsert({
    where: {
      userId_projectId_alertKey: {
        userId,

        projectId,

        alertKey,
      },
    },

    create: {
      projectId,

      userId,

      alertKey,

      fingerprint,

      readAt:
        now,

      dismissedAt:
        operation ===
          "DISMISS"
          ?
            now
          :
            null,

      snoozedUntil,
    },

    update: {
      fingerprint,

      readAt:
        now,

      dismissedAt:
        operation ===
          "DISMISS"
          ?
            now
          :
            null,

      snoozedUntil,
    },
  });
}


export async function markProjectAlertsRead({
  projectId,
  userId,
  alerts,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  userId:
    string;

  alerts:
    {
      alertKey:
        string;

      fingerprint:
        string;
    }[];
}) {
  const now =
    new Date();


  await prisma.$transaction(
    async (
      transaction,
    ) => {
      for (
        const item
        of alerts
      ) {
        await transaction.projectAlertReceipt.upsert({
          where: {
            userId_projectId_alertKey: {
              userId,

              projectId,

              alertKey:
                item.alertKey,
            },
          },

          create: {
            projectId,

            userId,

            alertKey:
              item.alertKey,

            fingerprint:
              item.fingerprint,

            readAt:
              now,
          },

          update: {
            fingerprint:
              item.fingerprint,

            readAt:
              now,

            dismissedAt:
              null,

            snoozedUntil:
              null,
          },
        });
      }
    },
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/notifications/validation.ts #####
import {
  PROJECT_ALERT_CATEGORIES,
  type ProjectAlertCategory,
} from "@/lib/notifications/types";


export const ALERT_RECEIPT_OPERATIONS = [
  "READ",
  "UNREAD",
  "DISMISS",
  "SNOOZE_24H",
] as const;


export type AlertReceiptOperation =
  typeof ALERT_RECEIPT_OPERATIONS[
    number
  ];


export function parseAlertReceiptOperation(
  value:
    string,
): AlertReceiptOperation {
  if (
    ALERT_RECEIPT_OPERATIONS.includes(
      value as
        AlertReceiptOperation,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      AlertReceiptOperation;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Invalid alert inbox operation.",
  );
}


export function parseAlertKey(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value.trim();


  if (
    normalized.length <
      3 ||
    normalized.length >
      180 ||
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9:_\-.]+$/u.test(
      normalized,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Alert key is invalid.",
    );
  }


  return normalized;
}


export function parseAlertFingerprint(
  value:
    string,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value.trim();


  if (
    !/^[a-f0-9]{16}$/u.test(
      normalized,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Alert fingerprint is invalid.",
    );
  }


  return normalized;
}


export function parseProjectAlertCategory(
  value:
    string,
): ProjectAlertCategory {
  if (
    PROJECT_ALERT_CATEGORIES.includes(
      value as
        ProjectAlertCategory,
    )
  ) {
    return value as
      ProjectAlertCategory;
  }


  throw new Error(
    "Alert category is invalid.",
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/observability/diagnostics.ts #####
import {
  timingSafeEqual,
} from "node:crypto";

import {
  snapshotRequestMetrics,
} from "@/lib/observability/metrics";


function configuredToken(): string {
  return (
    process.env
      .VENTURESCOPE_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN ??
    ""
  ).trim();
}


function bearerToken(
  headers:
    Headers,
): string {
  const authorization =
    headers.get(
      "authorization",
    ) ??
    "";


  if (
    !authorization
      .toLowerCase()
      .startsWith(
        "bearer ",
      )
  ) {
    return "";
  }


  return authorization
    .slice(
      7,
    )
    .trim();
}


function secureStringEqual(
  left:
    string,
  right:
    string,
): boolean {
  if (
    !left ||
    !right
  ) {
    return false;
  }


  const leftBytes =
    Buffer.from(
      left,
      "utf8",
    );

  const rightBytes =
    Buffer.from(
      right,
      "utf8",
    );


  if (
    leftBytes.length !==
    rightBytes.length
  ) {
    return false;
  }


  return timingSafeEqual(
    leftBytes,
    rightBytes,
  );
}


export function diagnosticsEnabled(): boolean {
  return (
    configuredToken()
      .length >=
    32
  );
}


export function isDiagnosticsAuthorized(
  headers:
    Headers,
): boolean {
  const expected =
    configuredToken();


  if (
    expected.length <
    32
  ) {
    return false;
  }


  return secureStringEqual(
    bearerToken(
      headers,
    ),
    expected,
  );
}


function toMegabytes(
  bytes:
    number,
): number {
  return (
    Math.round(
      (
        bytes /
        1024 /
        1024
      ) *
        100,
    ) /
    100
  );
}


async function collectDatabaseDiagnostics(): Promise<{
  status:
    "ready" |
    "unavailable";

  latencyMs:
    number;
}> {
  const started =
    performance.now();


  let status:
    "ready" |
    "unavailable" =
      "ready";


  try {
    /*
     * Prisma is intentionally imported lazily.
     *
     * Token authorization helpers must remain independently
     * importable in unit tests without requiring DATABASE_URL
     * or AUTH_SECRET.
     *
     * Database/server environment validation therefore occurs
     * only when deep runtime diagnostics actually probe the DB.
     */
    const {
      prisma,
    } =
      await import(
        "@/lib/db/prisma"
      );


    await prisma
      .$queryRaw`
        SELECT 1
      `;
  }
  catch {
    status =
      "unavailable";
  }


  const latencyMs =
    performance.now() -
    started;


  return {
    status,

    latencyMs:
      Math.round(
        latencyMs *
          100,
      ) /
      100,
  };
}


export async function collectDiagnostics() {
  const memory =
    process.memoryUsage();


  const database =
    await collectDatabaseDiagnostics();


  return {
    service:
      "venturescope",

    version:
      process.env
        .APP_VERSION ??
      "development",

    environment:
      process.env
        .NODE_ENV ??
      "development",

    runtime: {
      node:
        process.versions
          .node,

      uptimeSeconds:
        Math.round(
          process.uptime() *
            100,
        ) /
        100,
    },

    memoryMb: {
      rss:
        toMegabytes(
          memory.rss,
        ),

      heapUsed:
        toMegabytes(
          memory.heapUsed,
        ),

      heapTotal:
        toMegabytes(
          memory.heapTotal,
        ),

      external:
        toMegabytes(
          memory.external,
        ),
    },

    database,

    requests:
      snapshotRequestMetrics(),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/observability/logger.ts #####
type Primitive =
  string |
  number |
  boolean |
  null;

type LogValue =
  Primitive |
  Primitive[] |
  {
    [key: string]:
      LogValue;
  };


type LogMetadata = {
  [key: string]:
    LogValue;
};


const SENSITIVE_KEY =
  /secret|password|passwd|token|authorization|cookie|database[_-]?url|email|session/i;


function sanitizeValue(
  key:
    string,
  value:
    unknown,
  depth:
    number,
): LogValue {
  if (
    SENSITIVE_KEY.test(
      key,
    )
  ) {
    return "[REDACTED]";
  }


  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    typeof value ===
      "string" ||
    typeof value ===
      "number" ||
    typeof value ===
      "boolean"
  ) {
    return value;
  }


  if (
    depth >=
    3
  ) {
    return "[TRUNCATED]";
  }


  if (
    Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return value
      .slice(
        0,
        20,
      )
      .map(
        (
          entry,
        ) =>
          sanitizeValue(
            "array",
            entry,
            depth +
              1,
          ) as Primitive,
      )
      .filter(
        (
          entry,
        ):
          entry is Primitive =>
            typeof entry ===
              "string" ||
            typeof entry ===
              "number" ||
            typeof entry ===
              "boolean" ||
            entry ===
              null,
      );
  }


  if (
    typeof value ===
      "object"
  ) {
    const result:
      LogMetadata =
        {};


    for (
      const [
        childKey,
        childValue,
      ]
      of Object.entries(
        value,
      ).slice(
        0,
        30,
      )
    ) {
      result[
        childKey
      ] =
        sanitizeValue(
          childKey,
          childValue,
          depth +
            1,
        );
    }


    return result;
  }


  return String(
    value,
  );
}


export function sanitizeLogMetadata(
  metadata:
    Record<
      string,
      unknown
    >,
): LogMetadata {
  const sanitized:
    LogMetadata =
      {};


  for (
    const [
      key,
      value,
    ]
    of Object.entries(
      metadata,
    )
  ) {
    sanitized[
      key
    ] =
      sanitizeValue(
        key,
        value,
        0,
      );
  }


  return sanitized;
}


export function logStructured(
  level:
    "info" |
    "warn" |
    "error",
  event:
    string,
  metadata:
    Record<
      string,
      unknown
    > =
      {},
): void {
  const payload = {
    event:
      "venturescope.observability",

    timestamp:
      new Date()
        .toISOString(),

    level,

    name:
      event,

    service:
      "venturescope",

    version:
      process.env
        .APP_VERSION ??
      "development",

    environment:
      process.env
        .NODE_ENV ??
      "development",

    ...sanitizeLogMetadata(
      metadata,
    ),
  };


  const serialized =
    JSON.stringify(
      payload,
    );


  if (
    level ===
    "error"
  ) {
    console.error(
      serialized,
    );

    return;
  }


  if (
    level ===
    "warn"
  ) {
    console.warn(
      serialized,
    );

    return;
  }


  console.log(
    serialized,
  );
}
