export type RequestObservation = {
  route:
    string;

  status:
    number;

  durationMs:
    number;

  failed:
    boolean;
};


type MetricsStore = {
  startedAt:
    number;

  totalRequests:
    number;

  failedRequests:
    number;

  slowRequests:
    number;

  totalDurationMs:
    number;

  statuses:
    Record<
      string,
      number
    >;

  routes:
    Record<
      string,
      number
    >;
};


type ObservabilityGlobal = typeof globalThis & {
  __venturescopeObservabilityMetrics?:
    MetricsStore;
};


function createStore(): MetricsStore {
  return {
    startedAt:
      Date.now(),

    totalRequests:
      0,

    failedRequests:
      0,

    slowRequests:
      0,

    totalDurationMs:
      0,

    statuses:
      {},

    routes:
      {},
  };
}


function store(): MetricsStore {
  const root =
    globalThis as
      ObservabilityGlobal;


  root.__venturescopeObservabilityMetrics ??=
    createStore();


  return root.__venturescopeObservabilityMetrics;
}


export function getSlowRequestThresholdMs(): number {
  const parsed =
    Number.parseInt(
      process.env
        .VENTURESCOPE_SLOW_REQUEST_MS ??
      "",
      10,
    );


  if (
    !Number.isFinite(
      parsed,
    ) ||
    parsed <
      50 ||
    parsed >
      60_000
  ) {
    return 750;
  }


  return parsed;
}


export function recordRequestObservation(
  observation:
    RequestObservation,
): void {
  const metrics =
    store();


  metrics.totalRequests +=
    1;

  metrics.totalDurationMs +=
    observation
      .durationMs;


  if (
    observation.failed
  ) {
    metrics.failedRequests +=
      1;
  }


  if (
    observation.durationMs >=
    getSlowRequestThresholdMs()
  ) {
    metrics.slowRequests +=
      1;
  }


  const statusKey =
    String(
      observation
        .status,
    );


  metrics.statuses[
    statusKey
  ] =
    (
      metrics.statuses[
        statusKey
      ] ??
      0
    ) +
    1;


  metrics.routes[
    observation.route
  ] =
    (
      metrics.routes[
        observation.route
      ] ??
      0
    ) +
    1;
}


export function snapshotRequestMetrics() {
  const metrics =
    store();


  const averageDurationMs =
    metrics.totalRequests >
      0
      ?
        metrics.totalDurationMs /
        metrics.totalRequests
      :
        0;


  return {
    startedAt:
      new Date(
        metrics.startedAt,
      ).toISOString(),

    totalRequests:
      metrics.totalRequests,

    failedRequests:
      metrics.failedRequests,

    slowRequests:
      metrics.slowRequests,

    averageDurationMs:
      Math.round(
        averageDurationMs *
          100,
      ) /
      100,

    statuses: {
      ...metrics.statuses,
    },

    routes: {
      ...metrics.routes,
    },
  };
}


export function resetRequestMetricsForTests(): void {
  const root =
    globalThis as
      ObservabilityGlobal;


  root.__venturescopeObservabilityMetrics =
    createStore();
}

##### FILE: ./lib/observability/request-id.ts #####
const REQUEST_ID_PATTERN =
  /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{7,127}$/;


export function normalizeRequestId(
  value:
    string |
    null |
    undefined,
): string | null {
  const candidate =
    value?.trim();

  if (
    !candidate ||
    !REQUEST_ID_PATTERN.test(
      candidate,
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return candidate;
}


export function createRequestId(): string {
  return crypto.randomUUID();
}


export function resolveRequestId(
  headers:
    Headers,
): string {
  return (
    normalizeRequestId(
      headers.get(
        "x-request-id",
      ),
    ) ??
    createRequestId()
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/observability/route.ts #####
import {
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  logStructured,
} from "@/lib/observability/logger";
import {
  getSlowRequestThresholdMs,
  recordRequestObservation,
} from "@/lib/observability/metrics";
import {
  resolveRequestId,
} from "@/lib/observability/request-id";


type JsonBody =
  Record<
    string,
    unknown
  >;


export type ObservedJsonResult = {
  status?:
    number;

  body:
    JsonBody;
};


type ObservedHandler =
  (
    requestId:
      string,
  ) =>
    Promise<
      ObservedJsonResult
    > |
    ObservedJsonResult;


export async function observedJsonRoute(
  route:
    string,
  request:
    Request,
  handler:
    ObservedHandler,
): Promise<
  NextResponse
> {
  const requestId =
    resolveRequestId(
      request.headers,
    );

  const started =
    performance.now();


  try {
    const result =
      await handler(
        requestId,
      );


    const status =
      result.status ??
      200;


    const durationMs =
      performance.now() -
      started;


    const failed =
      status >=
      500;


    recordRequestObservation({
      route,
      status,
      durationMs,
      failed,
    });


    const metadata = {
      requestId,
      route,
      method:
        request.method,
      status,
      durationMs:
        Math.round(
          durationMs *
            100,
        ) /
        100,
    };


    if (
      failed
    ) {
      logStructured(
        "error",
        "http.request",
        metadata,
      );
    }
    else if (
      durationMs >=
      getSlowRequestThresholdMs()
    ) {
      logStructured(
        "warn",
        "http.request.slow",
        metadata,
      );
    }
    else {
      logStructured(
        "info",
        "http.request",
        metadata,
      );
    }


    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ...result.body,

        requestId,
      },
      {
        status,

        headers: {
          "Cache-Control":
            "no-store, max-age=0",

          "Server-Timing":
            `app;dur=${durationMs.toFixed(
              1,
            )}`,

          "X-Request-Id":
            requestId,

          "X-Robots-Tag":
            "noindex, nofollow",
        },
      },
    );
  }
  catch (
    error
  ) {
    const durationMs =
      performance.now() -
      started;


    recordRequestObservation({
      route,
      status:
        500,
      durationMs,
      failed:
        true,
    });


    logStructured(
      "error",
      "http.request.exception",
      {
        requestId,
        route,
        method:
          request.method,
        status:
          500,
        durationMs:
          Math.round(
            durationMs *
              100,
          ) /
          100,
        errorName:
          error instanceof Error
            ?
              error.name
            :
              "UnknownError",
      },
    );


    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        status:
          "error",

        requestId,
      },
      {
        status:
          500,

        headers: {
          "Cache-Control":
            "no-store, max-age=0",

          "Server-Timing":
            `app;dur=${durationMs.toFixed(
              1,
            )}`,

          "X-Request-Id":
            requestId,

          "X-Robots-Tag":
            "noindex, nofollow",
        },
      },
    );
  }
}

export type ReleaseVersionPayload = {

    typeof RELEASE_SERVICE;

  environment:
    string;
};


export function normalizeReleaseVersion(
  value:
    string |
    null |
    undefined,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value?.trim();

  if (
    !normalized
  ) {
    return "development";
  }

  return normalized;
}


export function normalizeReleaseEnvironment(
  value:
    string |
    null |
    undefined,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value?.trim();

  if (
    !normalized
  ) {
    return "development";
  }

  return normalized;
}


export function buildReleaseVersionPayload(
  environment:
    NodeJS.ProcessEnv =
      process.env,
): ReleaseVersionPayload {
  return {
    service:
      RELEASE_SERVICE,

    version:
      normalizeReleaseVersion(
        environment
          .APP_VERSION,
      ),

    environment:
      normalizeReleaseEnvironment(
        environment
          .NODE_ENV,
      ),
  };
}

const FIELD_LABELS: Record<
  keyof MonthlyOverrideValues,
  string
> = {

    "Revenue",

  marketing:
    "Marketing",

  salaries:
    "Salaries",

  rent:
    "Rent",

  cogs:
    "COGS",

  cac:
    "CAC",

  churnRate:
    "Churn",

    values,

    .filter(

        field,

        field in
        FIELD_LABELS,

        FIELD_LABELS[
          field
        ],
    );
}

import type {
  Prisma,
} from "@/generated/prisma/client";

import type {
  MonthlyOverrideValues,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";

export const MONTHLY_OVERRIDE_FIELDS = [
  "revenue",
  "marketing",
  "salaries",
  "rent",
  "cogs",
  "cac",
  "churnRate",
  "arpu",
] as const;

export type MonthlyOverrideField =
  (typeof MONTHLY_OVERRIDE_FIELDS)[number];

export function monthlyOverrideValuesFromForm(
  data: {
    revenue: string;

    marketing: string;

    salaries: string;

    rent: string;

    cogs: string;

    cac: string;

    churnRate: string;

    arpu: string;
  },
): MonthlyOverrideValues {
  const values: MonthlyOverrideValues =
    {};

  for (
    const field
    of MONTHLY_OVERRIDE_FIELDS
  ) {
    const value =
      data[field].trim();

    if (
      value !==
      ""
    ) {
      values[field] =
        value;
    }
  }

  return values;
}

export function monthlyOverrideValuesToJson(
  values: MonthlyOverrideValues,
): Prisma.InputJsonValue {
  return JSON.parse(
    JSON.stringify(
      values,
    ),
  ) as Prisma.InputJsonValue;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/overrides/validation.ts #####
import {
  z,
} from "zod";

const MONTH_PATTERN =
  /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/;

function optionalNumber(
  label: string,
  options: {
    min?: number;

    max?: number;

    exclusiveMin?: number;
  } = {},
) {
  return z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value === "" ||
        (
          /^-?(?:\d+|\d+\.\d+|\.\d+)$/.test(
            value,
          ) &&
          Number.isFinite(
            Number(
              value,
            ),
          )
        ),
      `${label} must be a valid number.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value === "" ||
        options.min ===
          undefined ||
        Number(
          value,
        ) >=
          options.min,
      options.min ===
        undefined
        ? `${label} is invalid.`
        : `${label} must be at least ${options.min}.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value === "" ||
        options.max ===
          undefined ||
        Number(
          value,
        ) <=
          options.max,
      options.max ===
        undefined
        ? `${label} is invalid.`
        : `${label} must not exceed ${options.max}.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        value === "" ||
        options.exclusiveMin ===
          undefined ||
        Number(
          value,
        ) >
          options.exclusiveMin,
      options.exclusiveMin ===
        undefined
        ? `${label} is invalid.`
        : `${label} must be greater than ${options.exclusiveMin}.`,
    );
}

const nonNegativeMoney =
  (
    label: string,
  ) =>
    optionalNumber(
      label,
      {
        min:
          0,

        max:
          1_000_000_000_000_000,
      },
    );

const fields = {
  projectId:
    z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .min(
        1,
        "Project identifier is required.",
      ),

  scenarioId:
    z
      .string()
      .trim(),

  month:
    z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(
        MONTH_PATTERN,
        "Select a valid override month.",
      ),

  revenue:
    nonNegativeMoney(
      "Revenue override",
    ),

  marketing:
    nonNegativeMoney(
      "Marketing override",
    ),

  salaries:
    nonNegativeMoney(
      "Salary override",
    ),

  rent:
    nonNegativeMoney(
      "Rent override",
    ),

  cogs:
    nonNegativeMoney(
      "COGS override",
    ),

  cac:
    optionalNumber(
      "CAC override",
      {
        exclusiveMin:
          0,

        max:
          1_000_000_000_000_000,
      },
    ),

  churnRate:
    optionalNumber(
      "Churn override",
      {
        min:
          0,

        max:
          100,
      },
    ),

  arpu:
    nonNegativeMoney(
      "ARPU override",
    ),

  note:
    z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .max(
        240,
        "Override note must contain at most 240 characters.",
      ),
};

function withAtLeastOneOverride<
  T extends z.ZodRawShape,
>(
  schema: z.ZodObject<T>,
) {
  return schema.superRefine(
    (
      data,
      context,
    ) => {
      const candidate =
        data as Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >;

      const overrideFields = [
        "revenue",
        "marketing",
        "salaries",
        "rent",
        "cogs",
        "cac",
        "churnRate",
        "arpu",
      ];

      const anyConfigured =
        overrideFields.some(
          (
            field,
          ) =>
            typeof candidate[
              field
            ] ===
              "string" &&
            (
              candidate[
                field
              ] as string
            ).trim() !==
              "",
        );

      if (
        !anyConfigured
      ) {
        context.addIssue({
          code:
            "custom",

          path: [
            "revenue",
          ],

          message:
            "Configure at least one monthly override value.",
        });
      }
    },
  );
}

export const createMonthlyOverrideSchema =
  withAtLeastOneOverride(
    z.object(
      fields,
    ),
  );

export const updateMonthlyOverrideSchema =
  withAtLeastOneOverride(
    z.object({
      ...fields,

      overrideId:
        z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .min(
            1,
            "Override identifier is required.",
          ),
    }),
  );

export const deleteMonthlyOverrideSchema =
  z.object({
    projectId:
      fields.projectId,

    overrideId:
      z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(
          1,
          "Override identifier is required.",
        ),
  });

import {
  FINAL_MIGRATION_COUNT,
  FINAL_RELEASE_CHECKLIST,
  FINAL_RELEASE_STAGE_COUNT,
  PORTFOLIO_STORYBOARD,
  PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES,
  PRODUCT_GOVERNANCE_CONTROLS,
} from "@/lib/product-readiness/catalog";

import type {
  ProductReadinessSummary,
} from "@/lib/product-readiness/types";


export function buildProductReadinessSummary():
  ProductReadinessSummary {
  const featureComplete =
    PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES.every(
      (
        capability,
      ) =>
        capability.status ===
          "COMPLETE" ||
        capability.status ===
          "FOUNDATION",
    );


  const governanceComplete =
    PRODUCT_GOVERNANCE_CONTROLS.every(
      (
        control,
      ) =>
        control.status ===
        "ENFORCED",
    );


  const checklistComplete =
    FINAL_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.every(
      (
        item,
      ) =>
        item.status ===
        "READY",
    );


  if (
    !featureComplete ||
    !governanceComplete ||
    !checklistComplete
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Product readiness catalog contains an incomplete final-release item.",
    );
  }


  return {
    capabilityCount:
      PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES.length,

    governanceControlCount:
      PRODUCT_GOVERNANCE_CONTROLS.length,

    storyboardCount:
      PORTFOLIO_STORYBOARD.length,

    migrationCount:
      FINAL_MIGRATION_COUNT,

    releaseStageCount:
      FINAL_RELEASE_STAGE_COUNT,

    paidApiCount:
      0,

    status:
      "FEATURE_COMPLETE",
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/project-access.ts #####
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { cache } from "react";

import { prisma } from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  getWorkspacePermission,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/access";

import {
  hasWorkspacePermission,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/permissions";


export const getOwnedProject = cache(
  async (
    userId: string,
    projectId: string,
  ) => {
    return prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,

        OR: [
          {
            userId:
              userId,
          },

          {
            workspace: {
              is: {
                ownerId:
                  userId,
              },
            },
          },

          {
            workspace: {
              is: {
                members: {
                  some: {
                    userId:
                      userId,
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        ],
      },

      select: {
        id: true,
        userId: true,
        name: true,
        industry: true,
        currency: true,
        startMonth: true,
        horizonMonths: true,
        revenueMode: true,
        modelVersion: true,
        baseAssumptions: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,

        scenarios: {
          orderBy: {
            createdAt: "asc",
          },

          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
            modifiers: true,
            createdAt: true,
            updatedAt: true,
          },
        },

        _count: {
          select: {
            financingEvents: true,
            monthlyOverrides: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
  },
);

export async function requireOwnedProject(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
) {
  const project =
    await getOwnedProject(
      userId,
      projectId,
    );

  if (!project) {
    notFound();
  }

  return project;
}

type OwnedProjectArguments =
  Parameters<
    typeof getOwnedProject
  >;

type AccessibleProject =
  NonNullable<
    Awaited<
      ReturnType<
        typeof getOwnedProject
      >
    >
  >;



async function workspacePermissionForAccessibleProject(
  userId:
    string,
  project:
    AccessibleProject,
) {
  const access =
    await prisma.project.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          project.id,
      },

      select: {
        workspaceId:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !access?.workspaceId
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return getWorkspacePermission(
    access.workspaceId,
    userId,
  );
}


async function canEditAccessibleProject(
  userId:
    string,
  project:
    AccessibleProject,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (
    project.userId ===
    userId
  ) {
    return true;
  }


  const permission =
    await workspacePermissionForAccessibleProject(
      userId,
      project,
    );


  return (
    permission !==
      null &&
    hasWorkspacePermission(
      permission,
      "EDITOR",
    )
  );
}


async function ownsAccessibleProject(
  userId:
    string,
  project:
    AccessibleProject,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (
    project.userId ===
    userId
  ) {
    return true;
  }


  return (
    await workspacePermissionForAccessibleProject(
      userId,
      project,
    )
  ) ===
    "OWNER";
}


export const getProjectForEditor =
  cache(
    async (
      ...args:
        OwnedProjectArguments
    ) => {
      const project =
        await getOwnedProject(
          ...args
        );


      if (
        !project
      ) {
        return null;
      }


      const userId =
        args[0] as
          string;


      if (
        !await canEditAccessibleProject(
          userId,
          project,
        )
      ) {
        return null;
      }


      return project;
    },
  );


export async function requireProjectEditor(
  ...args:
    OwnedProjectArguments
) {
  const project =
    await getProjectForEditor(
      ...args
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  return project;
}


export const getProjectForOwner =
  cache(
    async (
      ...args:
        OwnedProjectArguments
    ) => {
      const project =
        await getOwnedProject(
          ...args
        );


      if (
        !project
      ) {
        return null;
      }


      const userId =
        args[0] as
          string;


      if (
        !await ownsAccessibleProject(
          userId,
          project,
        )
      ) {
        return null;
      }


      return project;
    },
  );


export async function requireProjectOwner(
  ...args:
    OwnedProjectArguments
) {
  const project =
    await getProjectForOwner(
      ...args
    );


  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  return project;
}


##### FILE: ./lib/projects/project-dates.ts #####
export function monthInputToUtcDate(
  value: string,
): Date {
  const [
    yearValue,
    monthValue,
  ] = value.split("-");

  const year = Number(yearValue);
  const month = Number(monthValue);

  return new Date(
    Date.UTC(
      year,
      month - 1,
      1,
    ),
  );
}

export function dateToMonthInput(
  date: Date,
): string {
  const year =
    date.getUTCFullYear();

  const month = String(
    date.getUTCMonth() + 1,
  ).padStart(
    2,
    "0",
  );

  return `${year}-${month}`;
}

export function formatProjectStartMonth(
  date: Date,
): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en",
    {
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
      timeZone: "UTC",
    },
  ).format(date);
}

export function formatProjectUpdatedAt(
  date: Date,
): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    "en",
    {
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
    },
  ).format(date);
}

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/project-formatting.ts #####
export function formatRevenueMode(
  revenueMode: string,
): string {
  switch (revenueMode) {
    case "DIRECT":
      return "Direct revenue";

    case "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN":
      return "Customer-driven";

    default:
      return revenueMode;
  }
}

export function formatScenarioType(
  type: string,
): string {
  switch (type) {
    case "BASE":
      return "Base";

    case "BULL":
      return "Bull";

    case "BEAR":
      return "Bear";

    case "CUSTOM":
      return "Custom";

    default:
      return type;
  }
}

export function countScenarioModifiers(
  modifiers: unknown,
): number {
  if (
    !modifiers ||
    typeof modifiers !== "object" ||
    Array.isArray(modifiers)
  ) {
    return 0;
  }

  return Object.keys(
    modifiers,
  ).length;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/project-validation.ts #####
import { z } from "zod";

import {
  PROJECT_CURRENCY_VALUES,
  PROJECT_HORIZONS,
  REVENUE_MODE_VALUES,
} from "@/lib/projects/project-options";

const projectNameSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(
    2,
    "Company name must contain at least 2 characters.",
  )
  .max(
    100,
    "Company name must contain at most 100 characters.",
  );

const projectIdSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(
    1,
    "Project identifier is required.",
  );

const startMonthSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .regex(
    /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/,
    "Select a valid forecast start month.",
  );

export const createProjectSchema = z.object({
  name: projectNameSchema,

  industry: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(
      100,
      "Industry must contain at most 100 characters.",
    )
    .transform((value) =>
      value.length === 0
        ? null
        : value,
    ),

  currency: z.enum(
    PROJECT_CURRENCY_VALUES,
  ),

  startMonth: startMonthSchema,

  horizonMonths: z.coerce
    .number()
    .int()
    .refine(
      (value) =>
        PROJECT_HORIZONS.includes(
          value as (typeof PROJECT_HORIZONS)[number],
        ),
      {
        message:
          "Forecast horizon must be 12, 24, 36, 48 or 60 months.",
      },
    ),

  revenueMode: z.enum(
    REVENUE_MODE_VALUES,
  ),
});

export const renameProjectSchema = z.object({
  projectId: projectIdSchema,
  name: projectNameSchema,
});

export const projectIdentifierSchema =
  projectIdSchema;

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/scenario-comparison/comparison.ts #####
import {
  compareRevisionSnapshots,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/diff";

import type {
  JsonValue,
  RevisionDiffView,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/types";

import type {
  ScenarioComparisonResult,
  ScenarioComparisonSummary,
  ScenarioComparisonView,
  ScenarioDecisionMatrixRow,
  ScenarioDivergence,
  ScenarioNumericChange,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-comparison/types";


function scenarioRevision(
  scenario:
    ScenarioComparisonView,
  version:
    number,
): RevisionDiffView {
  const scenarioObject =
    scenario.snapshot;


  const wrapped:
    JsonValue = {
      scenarios: [
        {
          id:
            "comparison",

          config:
            scenarioObject,
        },
      ],
    };


  return {
    id:
      scenario.id,

    version,

    label:
      scenario.name,

    reason:
      null,

    sourceRevisionId:
      null,

    createdAt:
      "1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",

    snapshot:
      wrapped,
  };
}


function relativeRate(
  before:
    number,
  delta:
    number,
): number |
  null {
  if (
    before ===
    0
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  return (
    delta /
    Math.abs(
      before,
    )
  );
}


function numericChanges(
  changes:
    ReturnType<
      typeof compareRevisionSnapshots
    >[
      "changes"
    ],
): ScenarioNumericChange[] {
  return changes.flatMap(
    (
      change,
    ) => {
      if (
        typeof change.before !==
          "number" ||
        typeof change.after !==
          "number"
      ) {
        return [];
      }


      const delta =
        change.after -
        change.before;


      if (
        delta ===
        0
      ) {
        return [];
      }


      return [
        {
          path:
            change.path,

          before:
            change.before,

          after:
            change.after,

          delta,

          relativeRate:
            relativeRate(
              change.before,
              delta,
            ),

          direction:
            delta >
              0
              ?
                "INCREASED" as const
              :
                "DECREASED" as const,
        },
      ];
    },
  );
}


function divergence(
  totalChanges:
    number,
): ScenarioDivergence {
  if (
    totalChanges ===
    0
  ) {
    return "IDENTICAL";
  }


  if (
    totalChanges <=
    2
  ) {
    return "LOW";
  }


  if (
    totalChanges <=
    5
  ) {
    return "MODERATE";
  }


  return "HIGH";
}


function summary(
  result:
    ReturnType<
      typeof compareRevisionSnapshots
    >,
  numerics:
    ScenarioNumericChange[],
): ScenarioComparisonSummary {
  const structuralChanges =
    result.changes.filter(
      (
        change,
      ) =>
        change.kind ===
          "ADDED" ||
        change.kind ===
          "REMOVED" ||
        change.kind ===
          "TYPE_CHANGED",
    ).length;


  return {
    totalChanges:
      result.summary
        .total,

    added:
      result.summary
        .added,

    removed:
      result.summary
        .removed,

    changed:
      result.summary
        .changed,

    typeChanged:
      result.summary
        .typeChanged,

    numericIncreases:
      numerics.filter(
        (
          numeric,
        ) =>
          numeric.direction ===
          "INCREASED",
      ).length,

    numericDecreases:
      numerics.filter(
        (
          numeric,
        ) =>
          numeric.direction ===
          "DECREASED",
      ).length,

    structuralChanges,

    divergence:
      divergence(
        result.summary
          .total,
      ),
  };
}


export function compareScenarios(
  reference:
    ScenarioComparisonView,
  target:
    ScenarioComparisonView,
): ScenarioComparisonResult {
  const result =
    compareRevisionSnapshots(
      scenarioRevision(
        reference,
        1,
      ),
      scenarioRevision(
        target,
        2,
      ),
    );


  const numerics =
    numericChanges(
      result.changes,
    );


  return {
    reference,

    target,

    changes:
      result.changes,

    numericChanges:
      numerics,

    summary:
      summary(
        result,
        numerics,
      ),
  };
}


export function buildScenarioDecisionMatrix(
  reference:
    ScenarioComparisonView,
  scenarios:
    ScenarioComparisonView[],
): ScenarioDecisionMatrixRow[] {
  return scenarios.map(
    (
      scenario,
    ) => {
      if (
        scenario.id ===
        reference.id
      ) {
        return {
          scenarioId:
            scenario.id,

          scenarioName:
            scenario.name,

          isReference:
            true,

          isBase:
            scenario.isBase,

          totalChanges:
            0,

          added:
            0,

          removed:
            0,

          changed:
            0,

          typeChanged:
            0,

          numericIncreases:
            0,

          numericDecreases:
            0,

          structuralChanges:
            0,

          divergence:
            "IDENTICAL",
        };
      }


      const comparison =
        compareScenarios(
          reference,
          scenario,
        );


      return {
        scenarioId:
          scenario.id,

        scenarioName:
          scenario.name,

        isReference:
          false,

        isBase:
          scenario.isBase,

        ...comparison.summary,
      };
    },
  );
}


export function cleanScenarioChangePath(
  path:
    string,
): string {
  const prefix =
    "$.scenarios[id:comparison].config";


  if (
    path ===
    prefix
  ) {
    return "$";
  }


  if (
    path.startsWith(
      `${prefix}.`,
    )
  ) {
    return `$${path.slice(
      prefix.length,
    )}`;
  }


  if (
    path.startsWith(
      `${prefix}[`,
    )
  ) {
    return `$${path.slice(
      prefix.length,
    )}`;
  }


  return path;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/scenario-comparison/normalize.ts #####
import type {
  JsonValue,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/types";

import type {
  ScenarioComparisonView,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-comparison/types";


type UnknownRecord =
  Record<
    string,
    unknown
  >;


const PREFERRED_SCENARIO_KEYS = [
  "scenarios",
  "scenarioDefinitions",
  "scenarioConfigs",
  "scenarioConfigurations",
] as const;


const TOP_LEVEL_METADATA_KEYS =
  new Set([
    "id",
    "projectId",
    "createdAt",
    "updatedAt",
    "createdByUserId",
    "name",
    "label",
    "title",
    "scenarioName",
    "isBase",
    "isDefault",
    "selected",
    "active",
  ]);


function isRecord(
  value:
    unknown,
): value is
  UnknownRecord {
  return (
    typeof value ===
      "object" &&
    value !==
      null &&
    !Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  );
}


function looksLikeScenarioArray(
  value:
    unknown,
): value is
  unknown[] {
  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return false;
  }


  if (
    value.length ===
    0
  ) {
    return true;
  }


  return value.every(
    (
      item,
    ) =>
      isRecord(
        item,
      ),
  );
}


export function extractScenarioCollection(
  project:
    unknown,
): unknown[] {
  if (
    Array.isArray(
      project,
    )
  ) {
    return project;
  }


  if (
    !isRecord(
      project,
    )
  ) {
    return [];
  }


  for (
    const key
    of PREFERRED_SCENARIO_KEYS
  ) {
    const candidate =
      project[
        key
      ];


    if (
      looksLikeScenarioArray(
        candidate,
      )
    ) {
      return candidate;
    }
  }


  for (
    const [
      key,
      candidate,
    ]
    of Object.entries(
      project,
    )
  ) {
    if (
      key
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(
          "scenario",
        ) &&
      looksLikeScenarioArray(
        candidate,
      )
    ) {
      return candidate;
    }
  }


  return [];
}


function primitiveJson(
  value:
    unknown,
):
  | string
  | number
  | boolean
  | null
  | undefined {
  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  if (
    typeof value ===
      "string" ||
    typeof value ===
      "boolean"
  ) {
    return value;
  }


  if (
    typeof value ===
    "number"
  ) {
    if (
      !Number.isFinite(
        value,
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Scenario contains a non-finite numeric value.",
      );
    }


    return value;
  }


  return undefined;
}


function scenarioJsonValue(
  value:
    unknown,
  seen:
    WeakSet<
      object
    >,
): JsonValue {
  const primitive =
    primitiveJson(
      value,
    );


  if (
    primitive !==
    undefined
  ) {
    return primitive;
  }


  if (
    value instanceof Date
  ) {
    return value.toISOString();
  }


  if (
    Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    if (
      seen.has(
        value,
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Scenario contains a circular array.",
      );
    }


    seen.add(
      value,
    );


    const normalized =
      value.map(
        (
          child,
        ) =>
          scenarioJsonValue(
            child,
            seen,
          ),
      );


    seen.delete(
      value,
    );


    return normalized;
  }


  if (
    !isRecord(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Scenario contains an unsupported value.",
    );
  }


  if (
    seen.has(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Scenario contains a circular object.",
    );
  }


  const toNumber =
    value[
      "toNumber"
    ];


  if (
    typeof toNumber ===
    "function"
  ) {
    const numeric =
      (
        toNumber as
          () => unknown
      ).call(
        value,
      );


    if (
      typeof numeric ===
        "number" &&
      Number.isFinite(
        numeric,
      )
    ) {
      return numeric;
    }
  }


  const toJSON =
    value[
      "toJSON"
    ];


  if (
    typeof toJSON ===
    "function"
  ) {
    const json =
      (
        toJSON as
          () => unknown
      ).call(
        value,
      );


    if (
      json !==
      value
    ) {
      return scenarioJsonValue(
        json,
        seen,
      );
    }
  }


  seen.add(
    value,
  );


  const normalized =
    Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(
        value,
      )
        .filter(
          (
            [
              ,
              child,
            ],
          ) =>
            child !==
              undefined &&
            typeof child !==
              "function" &&
            typeof child !==
              "symbol",
        )
        .sort(
          (
            left,
            right,
          ) =>
            left[
              0
            ].localeCompare(
              right[
                0
              ],
            ),
        )
        .map(
          (
            [
              key,
              child,
            ],
          ) => [
            key,
            scenarioJsonValue(
              child,
              seen,
            ),
          ],
        ),
    );


  seen.delete(
    value,
  );


  return normalized;
}


function scenarioId(
  record:
    UnknownRecord,
  index:
    number,
): string {
  const value =
    record[
      "id"
    ];


  if (
    typeof value ===
      "string" ||
    typeof value ===
      "number"
  ) {
    return String(
      value,
    );
  }


  return `scenario-${index + 1}`;
}


function scenarioName(
  record:
    UnknownRecord,
  index:
    number,
): string {
  for (
    const key
    of [
      "name",
      "label",
      "title",
      "scenarioName",
    ]
  ) {
    const value =
      record[
        key
      ];


    if (
      typeof value ===
        "string" &&
      value.trim()
    ) {
      return value.trim();
    }
  }


  return `Scenario ${index + 1}`;
}


function explicitBase(
  record:
    UnknownRecord,
): boolean {
  for (
    const key
    of [
      "isBase",
      "isDefault",
    ]
  ) {
    if (
      record[
        key
      ] ===
      true
    ) {
      return true;
    }
  }


  return false;
}


function scenarioSnapshot(
  record:
    UnknownRecord,
): JsonValue {
  const filtered =
    Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(
        record,
      )
        .filter(
          (
            [
              key,
            ],
          ) =>
            !TOP_LEVEL_METADATA_KEYS.has(
              key,
            ),
        )
        .sort(
          (
            left,
            right,
          ) =>
            left[
              0
            ].localeCompare(
              right[
                0
              ],
            ),
        ),
    );


  return scenarioJsonValue(
    filtered,
    new WeakSet(),
  );
}


export function normalizeScenarioCollection(
  projectOrScenarios:
    unknown,
): ScenarioComparisonView[] {
  const collection =
    extractScenarioCollection(
      projectOrScenarios,
    )
      .slice(
        0,
        20,
      );


  const candidates =
    collection.flatMap(
      (
        value,
        index,
      ) => {
        if (
          !isRecord(
            value,
          )
        ) {
          return [];
        }


        const name =
          scenarioName(
            value,
            index,
          );


        return [
          {
            id:
              scenarioId(
                value,
                index,
              ),

            name,

            isBase:
              explicitBase(
                value,
              ) ||
              name
                .trim()
                .toLowerCase() ===
                "base",

            snapshot:
              scenarioSnapshot(
                value,
              ),
          },
        ];
      },
    );


  if (
    candidates.length >
      0 &&
    !candidates.some(
      (
        candidate,
      ) =>
        candidate.isBase,
    )
  ) {
    return candidates.map(
      (
        candidate,
        index,
      ) => ({
        ...candidate,

        isBase:
          index ===
          0,
      }),
    );
  }


  return candidates;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/version-diff/diff.ts #####
import type {
  JsonValue,
  ModelChange,
  ModelChangeCategory,
  ModelChangeKind,
  ModelChangeMateriality,
  ModelDiffSummary,
  ModelVersionDiff,
  RevisionDiffView,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/types";


function isObject(
  value:
    JsonValue,
): value is
  {
    [
      key:
        string
    ]:
      JsonValue;
  } {
  return (
    typeof value ===
      "object" &&
    value !==
      null &&
    !Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  );
}


function valueType(
  value:
    JsonValue,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return "null";
  }


  if (
    Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return "array";
  }


  return typeof value;
}


function categoryForPath(
  path:
    string,
): ModelChangeCategory {
  const normalized =
    path.toLowerCase();


  if (
    normalized.includes(
      "baseassumptions",
    ) ||
    normalized.includes(
      ".assumptions",
    )
  ) {
    return "ASSUMPTIONS";
  }


  if (
    normalized.includes(
      "scenarios",
    )
  ) {
    return "SCENARIOS";
  }


  if (
    normalized.includes(
      "financing",
    )
  ) {
    return "FINANCING";
  }


  if (
    normalized.includes(
      "monthlyoverrides",
    ) ||
    normalized.includes(
      "overrides",
    )
  ) {
    return "OVERRIDES";
  }


  const projectPaths = [
    "$.name",
    "$.industry",
    "$.currency",
    "$.startmonth",
    "$.horizonmonths",
    "$.revenuemode",
    "$.modelversion",
  ];


  if (
    projectPaths.some(
      (
        projectPath,
      ) =>
        normalized.startsWith(
          projectPath,
        ),
    )
  ) {
    return "PROJECT";
  }


  return "OTHER";
}


function materialityForChange({
  path,
  category,
  kind,
}: {
  path:
    string;

  category:
    ModelChangeCategory;

  kind:
    ModelChangeKind;
}): ModelChangeMateriality {
  if (
    kind ===
    "TYPE_CHANGED"
  ) {
    return "HIGH";
  }


  if (
    category ===
      "FINANCING" ||
    category ===
      "ASSUMPTIONS" ||
    category ===
      "OVERRIDES"
  ) {
    return "HIGH";
  }


  if (
    category ===
    "SCENARIOS"
  ) {
    return "MEDIUM";
  }


  const normalized =
    path.toLowerCase();


  if (
    category ===
      "PROJECT" &&
    (
      normalized.includes(
        "currency",
      ) ||
      normalized.includes(
        "startmonth",
      ) ||
      normalized.includes(
        "horizonmonths",
      ) ||
      normalized.includes(
        "revenuemode",
      )
    )
  ) {
    return "HIGH";
  }


  if (
    category ===
    "PROJECT"
  ) {
    return "MEDIUM";
  }


  return "LOW";
}


function change({
  path,
  kind,
  before,
  after,
}: {
  path:
    string;

  kind:
    ModelChangeKind;

  before:
    JsonValue |
    null;

  after:
    JsonValue |
    null;
}): ModelChange {
  const category =
    categoryForPath(
      path,
    );


  return {
    path,

    kind,

    category,

    materiality:
      materialityForChange({
        path,

        category,

        kind,
      }),

    before,

    after,
  };
}


function identityForArrayValue(
  value:
    JsonValue,
): string |
  null {
  if (
    !isObject(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  for (
    const key
    of [
      "id",
      "period",
      "name",
    ]
  ) {
    const candidate =
      value[
        key
      ];


    if (
      typeof candidate ===
        "string" ||
      typeof candidate ===
        "number"
    ) {
      return `${key}:${String(
        candidate,
      )}`;
    }
  }


  return null;
}


function identityMap(
  values:
    JsonValue[],
): Map<
  string,
  JsonValue
> |
  null {
  const map =
    new Map<
      string,
      JsonValue
    >();


  for (
    const value
    of values
  ) {
    const identity =
      identityForArrayValue(
        value,
      );


    if (
      !identity ||
      map.has(
        identity,
      )
    ) {
      return null;
    }


    map.set(
      identity,
      value,
    );
  }


  return map;
}


function diffArray({
  before,
  after,
  path,
  changes,
}: {
  before:
    JsonValue[];

  after:
    JsonValue[];

  path:
    string;

  changes:
    ModelChange[];
}) {
  const beforeByIdentity =
    identityMap(
      before,
    );


  const afterByIdentity =
    identityMap(
      after,
    );


  if (
    beforeByIdentity &&
    afterByIdentity
  ) {
    const identities =
      [
        ...new Set([
          ...beforeByIdentity.keys(),
          ...afterByIdentity.keys(),
        ]),
      ].sort();


    for (
      const identity
      of identities
    ) {
      const beforeValue =
        beforeByIdentity.get(
          identity,
        );


      const afterValue =
        afterByIdentity.get(
          identity,
        );


      const childPath =
        `${path}[${identity}]`;


      if (
        beforeValue ===
        undefined
      ) {
        changes.push(
          change({
            path:
              childPath,

            kind:
              "ADDED",

            before:
              null,

            after:
              afterValue ??
              null,
          }),
        );

        continue;
      }


      if (
        afterValue ===
        undefined
      ) {
        changes.push(
          change({
            path:
              childPath,

            kind:
              "REMOVED",

            before:
              beforeValue,

            after:
              null,
          }),
        );

        continue;
      }


      diffValue({
        before:
          beforeValue,

        after:
          afterValue,

        path:
          childPath,

        changes,
      });
    }


    return;
  }


  const length =
    Math.max(
      before.length,
      after.length,
    );


  for (
    let index =
      0;
    index <
      length;
    index +=
      1
  ) {
    const beforeExists =
      index <
      before.length;


    const afterExists =
      index <
      after.length;


    const childPath =
      `${path}[${index}]`;


    if (
      !beforeExists
    ) {
      changes.push(
        change({
          path:
            childPath,

          kind:
            "ADDED",

          before:
            null,

          after:
            after[
              index
            ] ??
            null,
        }),
      );

      continue;
    }


    if (
      !afterExists
    ) {
      changes.push(
        change({
          path:
            childPath,

          kind:
            "REMOVED",

          before:
            before[
              index
            ] ??
            null,

          after:
            null,
        }),
      );

      continue;
    }


    diffValue({
      before:
        before[
          index
        ] ?? null,

      after:
        after[
          index
        ] ?? null,

      path:
        childPath,

      changes,
    });
  }
}


function diffObject({
  before,
  after,
  path,
  changes,
}: {
  before:
    {
      [
        key:
          string
      ]:
        JsonValue;
    };

  after:
    {
      [
        key:
          string
      ]:
        JsonValue;
    };

  path:
    string;

  changes:
    ModelChange[];
}) {
  const keys =
    [
      ...new Set([
        ...Object.keys(
          before,
        ),
        ...Object.keys(
          after,
        ),
      ]),
    ].sort();


  for (
    const key
    of keys
  ) {
    const beforeExists =
      Object.prototype
        .hasOwnProperty
        .call(
          before,
          key,
        );


    const afterExists =
      Object.prototype
        .hasOwnProperty
        .call(
          after,
          key,
        );


    const childPath =
      `${path}.${key}`;


    if (
      !beforeExists
    ) {
      changes.push(
        change({
          path:
            childPath,

          kind:
            "ADDED",

          before:
            null,

          after:
            after[
              key
            ] ?? null,
        }),
      );

      continue;
    }


    if (
      !afterExists
    ) {
      changes.push(
        change({
          path:
            childPath,

          kind:
            "REMOVED",

          before:
            before[
              key
            ] ?? null,

          after:
            null,
        }),
      );

      continue;
    }


    diffValue({
      before:
        before[
          key
        ] ?? null,

      after:
        after[
          key
        ] ?? null,

      path:
        childPath,

      changes,
    });
  }
}


function diffValue({
  before,
  after,
  path,
  changes,
}: {
  before:
    JsonValue;

  after:
    JsonValue;

  path:
    string;

  changes:
    ModelChange[];
}) {
  if (
    Object.is(
      before,
      after,
    )
  ) {
    return;
  }


  const beforeType =
    valueType(
      before,
    );


  const afterType =
    valueType(
      after,
    );


  if (
    beforeType !==
    afterType
  ) {
    changes.push(
      change({
        path,

        kind:
          "TYPE_CHANGED",

        before,

        after,
      }),
    );

    return;
  }


  if (
    Array.isArray(
      before,
    ) &&
    Array.isArray(
      after,
    )
  ) {
    diffArray({
      before,

      after,

      path,

      changes,
    });

    return;
  }


  if (
    isObject(
      before,
    ) &&
    isObject(
      after,
    )
  ) {
    diffObject({
      before,

      after,

      path,

      changes,
    });

    return;
  }


  changes.push(
    change({
      path,

      kind:
        "CHANGED",

      before,

      after,
    }),
  );
}


function summary(
  changes:
    ModelChange[],
): ModelDiffSummary {
  return {
    total:
      changes.length,

    high:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.materiality ===
          "HIGH",
      ).length,

    medium:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.materiality ===
          "MEDIUM",
      ).length,

    low:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.materiality ===
          "LOW",
      ).length,

    added:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.kind ===
          "ADDED",
      ).length,

    removed:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.kind ===
          "REMOVED",
      ).length,

    changed:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.kind ===
          "CHANGED",
      ).length,

    typeChanged:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.kind ===
          "TYPE_CHANGED",
      ).length,

    assumptions:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.category ===
          "ASSUMPTIONS",
      ).length,

    scenarios:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.category ===
          "SCENARIOS",
      ).length,

    financing:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.category ===
          "FINANCING",
      ).length,

    overrides:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.category ===
          "OVERRIDES",
      ).length,

    project:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.category ===
          "PROJECT",
      ).length,

    other:
      changes.filter(
        (
          item,
        ) =>
          item.category ===
          "OTHER",
      ).length,
  };
}


const MATERIALITY_ORDER = {
  HIGH:
    0,

  MEDIUM:
    1,

  LOW:
    2,
} as const;


export function compareRevisionSnapshots(
  from:
    RevisionDiffView,
  to:
    RevisionDiffView,
): ModelVersionDiff {
  const changes:
    ModelChange[] =
      [];


  diffValue({
    before:
      from.snapshot,

    after:
      to.snapshot,

    path:
      "$",

    changes,
  });


  changes.sort(
    (
      left,
      right,
    ) => {
      const materiality =
        MATERIALITY_ORDER[
          left.materiality
        ] -
        MATERIALITY_ORDER[
          right.materiality
        ];


      if (
        materiality !==
        0
      ) {
        return materiality;
      }


      return left.path.localeCompare(
        right.path,
      );
    },
  );


  return {
    fromVersion:
      from.version,

    toVersion:
      to.version,

    changes,

    summary:
      summary(
        changes,
      ),
  };
}

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/version-diff/json.ts #####
import type {
  JsonValue,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/types";


export function normalizeJsonValue(
  value:
    unknown,
): JsonValue {
  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  switch (
    typeof value
  ) {
    case "string":
      return value;


    case "boolean":
      return value;


    case "number":
      if (
        !Number.isFinite(
          value,
        )
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          "Model revision contains a non-finite numeric value.",
        );
      }


      return value;


    case "object":
      if (
        Array.isArray(
          value,
        )
      ) {
        return value.map(
          normalizeJsonValue,
        );
      }


      return Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(
          value as
            Record<
              string,
              unknown
            >,
        ).map(
          (
            [
              key,
              child,
            ],
          ) => [
            key,
            normalizeJsonValue(
              child,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );


    default:
      throw new Error(
        "Model revision contains an unsupported JSON value.",
      );
  }
}


export function summarizeJsonValue(
  value:
    JsonValue |
    null,
  maximumLength =
    140,
): string {
  const serialized =
    JSON.stringify(
      value,
    );


  if (
    serialized.length <=
    maximumLength
  ) {
    return serialized;
  }


  return `${serialized.slice(
    0,
    Math.max(
      0,
      maximumLength -
        1,
    ),
  )}…`;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/versioning/serialization.ts #####
import {
  PROJECT_REVISION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  type ProjectRevisionSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/projects/versioning/types";


type JsonRecord =
  Record<
    string,
    unknown
  >;


function isRecord(
  value:
    unknown,
): value is
  JsonRecord {
  return (
    typeof value ===
      "object" &&
    value !==
      null &&
    !Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  );
}


function cloneSerializable(
  value:
    unknown,
): unknown {
  return JSON.parse(
    JSON.stringify(
      value,
    ),
  ) as
    unknown;
}


function recordArray(
  value:
    unknown,
  name:
    string,
): JsonRecord[] {
  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid revision snapshot: ${name} is not an array.`,
    );
  }


  return value.map(
    (
      row,
    ) => {
      if (
        !isRecord(
          row,
        )
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          `Invalid revision snapshot: ${name} contains a non-object row.`,
        );
      }


      return row;
    },
  );
}


export function parseProjectRevisionSnapshot(
  value:
    unknown,
): ProjectRevisionSnapshot {
  if (
    !isRecord(
      value,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid project revision snapshot.",
    );
  }


  if (
    value.schemaVersion !==
    PROJECT_REVISION_SCHEMA_VERSION
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Unsupported project revision schema version.",
    );
  }


  if (
    typeof value.capturedAt !==
    "string"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid revision capture timestamp.",
    );
  }


  if (
    !isRecord(
      value.project,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid revision project state.",
    );
  }


  const project =
    value.project;


  if (
    typeof project.name !==
      "string" ||
    (
      project.industry !==
        null &&
      typeof project.industry !==
        "string"
    ) ||
    typeof project.currency !==
      "string" ||
    typeof project.startMonth !==
      "string" ||
    typeof project.horizonMonths !==
      "number" ||
    typeof project.revenueMode !==
      "string"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid revision project settings.",
    );
  }


  return {
    schemaVersion:
      PROJECT_REVISION_SCHEMA_VERSION,

    capturedAt:
      value.capturedAt,

    project: {
      name:
        project.name,

      industry:
        project.industry,

      currency:
        project.currency,

      startMonth:
        project.startMonth,

      horizonMonths:
        project.horizonMonths,

      revenueMode:
        project.revenueMode,

      baseAssumptions:
        cloneSerializable(
          project.baseAssumptions,
        ),
    },

    scenarios:
      recordArray(
        value.scenarios,
        "scenarios",
      ),

    financingEvents:
      recordArray(
        value.financingEvents,
        "financingEvents",
      ),

    monthlyOverrides:
      recordArray(
        value.monthlyOverrides,
        "monthlyOverrides",
      ),
  };
}


export function prepareRelationRows(
  rows:
    JsonRecord[],
  projectId:
    string,
): JsonRecord[] {
  return rows.map(
    (
      row,
    ) => {
      const prepared:
        JsonRecord =
          {};


      for (
        const [
          key,
          value,
        ]
        of Object.entries(
          row,
        )
      ) {
        if (
          key ===
            "projectId" ||
          key ===
            "createdAt" ||
          key ===
            "updatedAt"
        ) {
          continue;
        }


        prepared[
          key
        ] =
          cloneSerializable(
            value,
          );
      }


      prepared.projectId =
        projectId;


      return prepared;
    },
  );
}

##### FILE: ./lib/projects/versioning/service.ts #####
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  logProjectVersionEvent,
} from "@/lib/projects/versioning/audit";

import {
  parseProjectRevisionSnapshot,
  prepareRelationRows,
} from "@/lib/projects/versioning/serialization";

import {
  PROJECT_REVISION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  type ProjectRevisionSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/projects/versioning/types";


function serialize(
  value:
    unknown,
): unknown {
  return JSON.parse(
    JSON.stringify(
      value,
    ),
  ) as
    unknown;
}


function snapshotFromProject(
  project: {
    name:
      string;

    industry:
      string |
      null;

    currency:
      string;

    startMonth:
      Date;

    horizonMonths:
      number;

    revenueMode:
      unknown;

    baseAssumptions:
      unknown;

    scenarios:
      unknown[];

    financingEvents:
      unknown[];

    monthlyOverrides:
      unknown[];
  },
): ProjectRevisionSnapshot {
  return parseProjectRevisionSnapshot(
    serialize({
      schemaVersion:
        PROJECT_REVISION_SCHEMA_VERSION,

      capturedAt:
        new Date()
          .toISOString(),

      project: {
        name:
          project.name,

        industry:
          project.industry,

        currency:
          project.currency,

        startMonth:
          project.startMonth,

        horizonMonths:
          project.horizonMonths,

        revenueMode:
          project.revenueMode,

        baseAssumptions:
          project.baseAssumptions,
      },

      scenarios:
        project.scenarios,

      financingEvents:
        project.financingEvents,

      monthlyOverrides:
        project.monthlyOverrides,
    }),
  );
}


export async function createProjectRevision({
  projectId,
  actorUserId,
  label,
  reason,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  label:
    string |
    null;

  reason:
    string |
    null;
}) {
  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        const state =
          await transaction.project.findUnique({
            where: {
              id:
                projectId,
            },

            select: {
              name:
                true,

              industry:
                true,

              currency:
                true,

              startMonth:
                true,

              horizonMonths:
                true,

              revenueMode:
                true,

              baseAssumptions:
                true,

              scenarios:
                true,

              financingEvents:
                true,

              monthlyOverrides:
                true,
            },
          });


        if (
          !state
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Project not found.",
          );
        }


        const snapshot =
          snapshotFromProject(
            state,
          );


        const project =
          await transaction.project.update({
            where: {
              id:
                projectId,
            },

            data: {
              revisionSequence: {
                increment:
                  1,
              },
            },

            select: {
              revisionSequence:
                true,
            },
          });


        const revision =
          await transaction.projectRevision.create({
            data: {
              projectId,

              version:
                project.revisionSequence,

              label,

              reason,

              snapshot:
                snapshot as never,

              createdByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              version:
                true,
            },
          });


        return revision;
      },
    );


  logProjectVersionEvent(
    "project.revision.created",
    {
      actorUserId,

      projectId,

      version:
        result.version,

      revisionId:
        result.id,
    },
  );


  return result;
}


export async function restoreProjectRevision({
  projectId,
  revisionId,
  actorUserId,
  reason,
}: {
  projectId:
    string;

  revisionId:
    string;

  actorUserId:
    string;

  reason:
    string |
    null;
}) {
  const revision =
    await prisma.projectRevision.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          revisionId,

        projectId,
      },

      select: {
        id:
          true,

        version:
          true,

        snapshot:
          true,
      },
    });


  if (
    !revision
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Revision not found.",
    );
  }


  const snapshot =
    parseProjectRevisionSnapshot(
      revision.snapshot,
    );


  const scenarios =
    prepareRelationRows(
      snapshot.scenarios,
      projectId,
    );


  const financingEvents =
    prepareRelationRows(
      snapshot.financingEvents,
      projectId,
    );


  const monthlyOverrides =
    prepareRelationRows(
      snapshot.monthlyOverrides,
      projectId,
    );


  const result =
    await prisma.$transaction(
      async (
        transaction,
      ) => {
        /*
         * Remove dependent overrides before scenarios because
         * scenario-specific overrides may reference scenario IDs.
         */
        await transaction.monthlyOverride.deleteMany({
          where: {
            projectId,
          },
        });


        await transaction.financingEvent.deleteMany({
          where: {
            projectId,
          },
        });


        await transaction.scenario.deleteMany({
          where: {
            projectId,
          },
        });


        const project =
          await transaction.project.update({
            where: {
              id:
                projectId,
            },

            data: {
              name:
                snapshot.project.name,

              industry:
                snapshot.project.industry,

              currency:
                snapshot.project.currency,

              startMonth:
                new Date(
                  snapshot.project.startMonth,
                ),

              horizonMonths:
                snapshot.project.horizonMonths,

              revenueMode:
                snapshot.project.revenueMode as never,

              baseAssumptions:
                snapshot.project.baseAssumptions as never,

              revisionSequence: {
                increment:
                  1,
              },
            },

            select: {
              revisionSequence:
                true,
            },
          });


        if (
          scenarios.length >
          0
        ) {
          await transaction.scenario.createMany({
            data:
              scenarios as never,
          });
        }


        if (
          financingEvents.length >
          0
        ) {
          await transaction.financingEvent.createMany({
            data:
              financingEvents as never,
          });
        }


        if (
          monthlyOverrides.length >
          0
        ) {
          await transaction.monthlyOverride.createMany({
            data:
              monthlyOverrides as never,
          });
        }


        /*
         * Restoring old state never modifies the historical source.
         * A new immutable revision is appended instead.
         */
        const restoredRevision =
          await transaction.projectRevision.create({
            data: {
              projectId,

              version:
                project.revisionSequence,

              label:
                `Restored from v${revision.version}`,

              reason,

              snapshot:
                snapshot as never,

              sourceRevisionId:
                revision.id,

              createdByUserId:
                actorUserId,
            },

            select: {
              id:
                true,

              version:
                true,
            },
          });


        return restoredRevision;
      },
    );


  logProjectVersionEvent(
    "project.revision.restored",
    {
      actorUserId,

      projectId,

      version:
        result.version,

      revisionId:
        result.id,

      sourceRevisionId:
        revision.id,
    },
  );


  return result;
}

import {
  countCompletedAssumptionSections,
  parseStoredFinancialAssumptions,
} from "@/lib/finance/assumptions/storage";
import {
  generateScenarioComparison,
} from "@/lib/finance/comparison";
import {
  generateFinancialForecast,
} from "@/lib/finance/engine";
import {
  buildFinancialModelInput,
  mapPersistedScenario,
} from "@/lib/finance/project-input";
import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

export async function loadReportContext(
  userId: string,
  projectId: string,
  scenarioId?: string,
) {
  const project =
    await prisma.project.findFirst({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,

        userId,
      },

      include: {
        scenarios: {
          orderBy: {
            createdAt:
              "asc",
          },
        },

        financingEvents: {
          orderBy: {
            month:
              "asc",
          },
        },

        monthlyOverrides: {
          orderBy: [
            {
              month:
                "asc",
            },
            {
              createdAt:
                "asc",
            },
          ],
        },
      },
    });

  if (!project) {
    return null;
  }

  const assumptions =
    parseStoredFinancialAssumptions(
      project.baseAssumptions,
    );

  const completedSections =
    countCompletedAssumptionSections(
      assumptions,
    );

  const missingSections:
    Array<
      | "general"
      | "revenue"
      | "expenses"
    > = [];

  if (
    !assumptions.completion
      .general
  ) {
    missingSections.push(
      "general",
    );
  }

  if (
    !assumptions.completion
      .revenue
  ) {
    missingSections.push(
      "revenue",
    );
  }

  if (
    !assumptions.completion
      .expenses
  ) {
    missingSections.push(
      "expenses",
    );
  }

  const baseScenario =
    project.scenarios.find(
      (
        scenario,
      ) =>
        scenario.type ===
        "BASE",
    ) ??
    project.scenarios[0];

  const requestedScenario =
    scenarioId
      ? project.scenarios.find(
          (
            scenario,
          ) =>
            scenario.id ===
            scenarioId,
        )
      : undefined;

  const selectedScenario =
    requestedScenario ??
    baseScenario;

  if (
    completedSections !==
    3
  ) {
    return {
      ready:
        false as const,

      project,

      assumptions,

      missingSections,

      completedSections,

      selectedScenario,

      baseScenario,
    };
  }

  const selectedInput =
    buildFinancialModelInput(
      project,
      selectedScenario,
    );

  const forecast =
    generateFinancialForecast(
      selectedInput,
    );

  const baseInput =
    buildFinancialModelInput(
      project,
      baseScenario,
    );

  const scenarioInputs =
    project.scenarios.map(
      (
        scenario,
      ) =>
        mapPersistedScenario(
          scenario,
        ),
    );

  const comparison =
    generateScenarioComparison(
      baseInput,
      scenarioInputs,
    );

  return {
    ready:
      true as const,

    project,

    assumptions,

    missingSections,

    completedSections,

    selectedScenario,

    baseScenario,

    selectedInput,

    forecast,

    comparison,
  };
}

export type ReportContext =
  Awaited<
    ReturnType<
      typeof loadReportContext
    >
  >;

export type ReadyReportContext =
  Extract<
    NonNullable<
      ReportContext
    >,
    {
      ready: true;
    }
  >;

import type {
  ReadyReportContext,
} from "@/lib/reports/context";

function csvCell(
  value:
    | string
    | number
    | null
    | undefined,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value ===
      null ||
    value ===
      undefined
      ? ""
      : String(
          value,
        );

  if (
    normalized.includes(
      ",",
    ) ||
    normalized.includes(
      "\"",
    ) ||
    normalized.includes(
      "\n",
    ) ||
    normalized.includes(
      "\r",
    )
  ) {
    return `"${normalized.replace(
      /"/g,
      "\"\"",
    )}"`;
  }

  return normalized;
}
