##### FILE: ./lib/reports/filename.ts #####
export function safeReportFilenamePart(
  value: string,
): string {
  const normalized =
    value
      .normalize(
        "NFKD",
      )
      .replace(
        /[\u0300-\u036f]/g,
        "",
      )
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(
        /[^a-z0-9]+/g,
        "-",
      )
      .replace(
        /^-+|-+$/g,
        "")
      .slice(
        0,
        70,
      );

  return normalized ||
    "report";
}

export function reportFilename(
  projectName: string,
  scenarioName: string,
  extension:
    | "csv"
    | "pdf",
): string {
  return [
    "venturescope",
    safeReportFilenamePart(
      projectName,
    ),
    safeReportFilenamePart(
      scenarioName,
    ),
    "forecast",
  ].join(
    "-",
  ) + `.${extension}`;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/reports/pdf.ts #####
import {
  PDFDocument,
  PDFFont,
  PDFPage,
  StandardFonts,
  rgb,
} from "pdf-lib";

import {
  decimal,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import {
  formatLongMonthKey,
  formatRunway,
} from "@/lib/finance/formatting";
import type {
  ReadyReportContext,
} from "@/lib/reports/context";
import {
  buildExecutiveSummary,
} from "@/lib/reports/summary";
import {
  scenarioModifiersToFormValues,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/modifiers";

const PAGE_WIDTH =
  595.28;

const PAGE_HEIGHT =
  841.89;

const MARGIN =
  44;

const CONTENT_WIDTH =
  PAGE_WIDTH -
  MARGIN *
    2;

const COLOR_TEXT =
  rgb(
    0.10,
    0.12,
    0.16,
  );

const COLOR_MUTED =
  rgb(
    0.39,
    0.43,
    0.50,
  );

const COLOR_BORDER =
  rgb(
    0.84,
    0.86,
    0.89,
  );

const COLOR_ACCENT =
  rgb(
    0.10,
    0.22,
    0.38,
  );

type Writer = {
  pdf:
    PDFDocument;

  regular:
    PDFFont;

  bold:
    PDFFont;

  page:
    PDFPage;

  y:
    number;
};

function safePdfText(
  value:
    | string
    | number
    | null
    | undefined,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
      null ||
    value ===
      undefined
  ) {
    return "";
  }

  return String(
    value,
  )
    .normalize(
      "NFKD",
    )
    .replace(
      /[\u0300-\u036f]/g,
      "",
    )
    .replace(
      /[\u2013\u2014]/g,
      "-",
    )
    .replace(
      /[\u2018\u2019]/g,
      "'",
    )
    .replace(
      /[\u201C\u201D]/g,
      "\"",
    )
    .replace(
      /[^\x20-\x7E]/g,
      "?",
    );
}

function money(
  value: string,
  currency: string,
): string {
  const amount =
    decimal(
      value,
    ).toNumber();

  const safeAmount =
    Number.isFinite(
      amount,
    )
      ? amount
      : 0;

  return `${currency} ${new Intl.NumberFormat(
    "en-US",
    {
      maximumFractionDigits:
        0,

      minimumFractionDigits:
        0,
    },
  ).format(
    safeAmount,
  )}`;
}

function percentage(
  value:
    | string
    | null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return "-";
  }

  const parsed =
    Number(
      value,
    );

  return `${Number.isFinite(
    parsed,
  )
    ? parsed.toFixed(
        1,
      )
    : "0.0"}%`;
}

function customers(
  value:
    | string
    | null,
): string {
  if (
    value ===
    null
  ) {
    return "-";
  }

  const parsed =
    Number(
      value,
    );

  return Number.isFinite(
    parsed,
  )
    ? Math.round(
        parsed,
      ).toLocaleString(
        "en-US",
      )
    : "0";
}

function newPage(
  writer: Writer,
): void {
  writer.page =
    writer.pdf.addPage([
      PAGE_WIDTH,
      PAGE_HEIGHT,
    ]);

  writer.y =
    PAGE_HEIGHT -
    MARGIN;
}

function ensureSpace(
  writer: Writer,
  required: number,
): void {
  if (
    writer.y -
      required <
    MARGIN
  ) {
    newPage(
      writer,
    );
  }
}

function wrapText(
  text: string,
  font: PDFFont,
  size: number,
  maxWidth: number,
): string[] {
  const safe =
    safePdfText(
      text,
    );

  const words =
    safe.split(
      /\s+/,
    );

  const lines: string[] =
    [];

  let current =
    "";

  for (
    const word
    of words
  ) {
    const candidate =
      current
        ? `${current} ${word}`
        : word;

    const width =
      font.widthOfTextAtSize(
        candidate,
        size,
      );

    if (
      width <=
      maxWidth
    ) {
      current =
        candidate;
      continue;
    }

    if (
      current
    ) {
      lines.push(
        current,
      );
    }

    current =
      word;
  }

  if (
    current
  ) {
    lines.push(
      current,
    );
  }

  return lines.length
    ? lines
    : [
        "",
      ];
}

function drawText(
  writer: Writer,
  text: string,
  options: {
    size?: number;

    bold?: boolean;

    color?: ReturnType<
      typeof rgb
    >;

    maxWidth?: number;

    lineHeight?: number;

    gapAfter?: number;
  } = {},
): void {
  const size =
    options.size ??
    10;

  const font =
    options.bold
      ? writer.bold
      : writer.regular;

  const maxWidth =
    options.maxWidth ??
    CONTENT_WIDTH;

  const lineHeight =
    options.lineHeight ??
    size *
      1.35;

  const lines =
    wrapText(
      text,
      font,
      size,
      maxWidth,
    );

  ensureSpace(
    writer,
    lines.length *
      lineHeight +
      (
        options.gapAfter ??
        0
      ),
  );

  for (
    const line
    of lines
  ) {
    writer.page.drawText(
      line,
      {
        x:
          MARGIN,

        y:
          writer.y,

        size,

        font,

        color:
          options.color ??
          COLOR_TEXT,
      },
    );

    writer.y -=
      lineHeight;
  }

  writer.y -=
    options.gapAfter ??
    0;
}

function drawHeading(
  writer: Writer,
  title: string,
): void {
  ensureSpace(
    writer,
    42,
  );

  writer.y -=
    4;

  drawText(
    writer,
    title,
    {
      size:
        15,

      bold:
        true,

      color:
        COLOR_ACCENT,

      gapAfter:
        8,
    },
  );

  writer.page.drawLine({
    start: {
      x:
        MARGIN,

      y:
        writer.y +
        3,
    },

    end: {
      x:
        PAGE_WIDTH -
        MARGIN,

      y:
        writer.y +
        3,
    },

    thickness:
      0.8,

    color:
      COLOR_BORDER,
  });

  writer.y -=
    8;
}

function drawKeyValueRows(
  writer: Writer,
  rows: Array<
    [
      string,
      string,
    ]
  >,
): void {
  const rowHeight =
    22;

  for (
    const [
      label,
      value,
    ]
    of rows
  ) {
    ensureSpace(
      writer,
      rowHeight,
    );

    writer.page.drawText(
      safePdfText(
        label,
      ),
      {
        x:
          MARGIN,

        y:
          writer.y,

        size:
          9,

        font:
          writer.regular,

        color:
          COLOR_MUTED,
      },
    );

    const safeValue =
      safePdfText(
        value,
      );

    const valueWidth =
      writer.bold.widthOfTextAtSize(
        safeValue,
        9,
      );

    writer.page.drawText(
      safeValue,
      {
        x:
          Math.max(
            MARGIN +
              220,
            PAGE_WIDTH -
              MARGIN -
              valueWidth,
          ),

        y:
          writer.y,

        size:
          9,

        font:
          writer.bold,

        color:
          COLOR_TEXT,
      },
    );

    writer.y -=
      rowHeight;

    writer.page.drawLine({
      start: {
        x:
          MARGIN,

        y:
          writer.y +
          8,
      },

      end: {
        x:
          PAGE_WIDTH -
          MARGIN,

        y:
          writer.y +
          8,
      },

      thickness:
        0.35,

      color:
        COLOR_BORDER,
    });
  }

  writer.y -=
    6;
}

function drawTable(
  writer: Writer,
  headers: string[],
  rows: string[][],
  widths: number[],
): void {
  const headerHeight =
    22;

  const rowHeight =
    19;

  const drawHeader =
    () => {
      ensureSpace(
        writer,
        headerHeight +
        rowHeight,
      );

      let x =
        MARGIN;

      writer.page.drawRectangle({
        x:
          MARGIN,

        y:
          writer.y -
          5,

        width:
          CONTENT_WIDTH,

        height:
          headerHeight,

        color:
          rgb(
            0.94,
            0.95,
            0.97,
          ),
      });

      for (
        let index =
          0;
        index <
        headers.length;
        index +=
          1
      ) {
        writer.page.drawText(
          safePdfText(
            headers[
              index
            ],
          ),
          {
            x:
              x +
              3,

            y:
              writer.y +
              2,

            size:
              7.5,

            font:
              writer.bold,

            color:
              COLOR_TEXT,
          },
        );

        x +=
          widths[
            index
          ];
      }

      writer.y -=
        headerHeight;
    };

  drawHeader();

  for (
    const row
    of rows
  ) {
    if (
      writer.y -
        rowHeight <
      MARGIN
    ) {
      newPage(
        writer,
      );

      drawHeader();
    }

    let x =
      MARGIN;

    for (
      let index =
        0;
      index <
      row.length;
      index +=
        1
    ) {
      const cell =
        safePdfText(
          row[
            index
          ],
        );

      const maxCellWidth =
        Math.max(
          10,
          widths[
            index
          ] -
          6,
        );

      let clipped =
        cell;

      while (
        clipped.length >
          1 &&
        writer.regular.widthOfTextAtSize(
          clipped,
          7.2,
        ) >
          maxCellWidth
      ) {
        clipped =
          clipped.slice(
            0,
            -1,
          );
      }

      if (
        clipped !==
        cell &&
        clipped.length >
        3
      ) {
        clipped =
          `${clipped.slice(
            0,
            -3,
          )}...`;
      }

      writer.page.drawText(
        clipped,
        {
          x:
            x +
            3,

          y:
            writer.y,

          size:
            7.2,

          font:
            writer.regular,

          color:
            COLOR_TEXT,
        },
      );

      x +=
        widths[
          index
        ];
    }

    writer.y -=
      rowHeight;

    writer.page.drawLine({
      start: {
        x:
          MARGIN,

        y:
          writer.y +
          7,
      },

      end: {
        x:
          PAGE_WIDTH -
          MARGIN,

        y:
          writer.y +
          7,
      },

      thickness:
        0.25,

      color:
        COLOR_BORDER,
    });
  }

  writer.y -=
    8;
}

function drawLineChart(
  writer: Writer,
  title: string,
  values: number[],
  labels: string[],
  currency: string,
): void {
  const height =
    145;

  ensureSpace(
    writer,
    height +
    55,
  );

  drawText(
    writer,
    title,
    {
      size:
        11,

      bold:
        true,

      gapAfter:
        6,
    },
  );

  const chartX =
    MARGIN +
    42;

  const chartY =
    writer.y -
    height +
    10;

  const chartWidth =
    CONTENT_WIDTH -
    58;

  const chartHeight =
    height -
    24;

  const safeValues =
    values.length
      ? values
      : [
          0,
        ];

  const minimum =
    Math.min(
      ...safeValues,
      0,
    );

  let maximum =
    Math.max(
      ...safeValues,
      0,
    );

  if (
    minimum ===
    maximum
  ) {
    maximum +=
      1;
  }

  const range =
    maximum -
    minimum;

  writer.page.drawLine({
    start: {
      x:
        chartX,

      y:
        chartY,
    },

    end: {
      x:
        chartX,

      y:
        chartY +
        chartHeight,
    },

    thickness:
      0.6,

    color:
      COLOR_BORDER,
  });

  writer.page.drawLine({
    start: {
      x:
        chartX,

      y:
        chartY,
    },

    end: {
      x:
        chartX +
        chartWidth,

      y:
        chartY,
    },

    thickness:
      0.6,

    color:
      COLOR_BORDER,
  });

  if (
    minimum <
      0 &&
    maximum >
      0
  ) {
    const zeroY =
      chartY +
      (
        (
          0 -
          minimum
        ) /
        range
      ) *
        chartHeight;

    writer.page.drawLine({
      start: {
        x:
          chartX,

        y:
          zeroY,
      },

      end: {
        x:
          chartX +
          chartWidth,

        y:
          zeroY,
      },

      thickness:
        0.5,

      color:
        COLOR_BORDER,
    });
  }

  for (
    let index =
      1;
    index <
    safeValues.length;
    index +=
      1
  ) {
    const previous =
      safeValues[
        index -
        1
      ];

    const current =
      safeValues[
        index
      ];

    const previousX =
      chartX +
      (
        (
          index -
          1
        ) /
        Math.max(
          1,
          safeValues.length -
            1,
        )
      ) *
        chartWidth;

    const currentX =
      chartX +
      (
        index /
        Math.max(
          1,
          safeValues.length -
            1,
        )
      ) *
        chartWidth;

    const previousY =
      chartY +
      (
        (
          previous -
          minimum
        ) /
        range
      ) *
        chartHeight;

    const currentY =
      chartY +
      (
        (
          current -
          minimum
        ) /
        range
      ) *
        chartHeight;

    writer.page.drawLine({
      start: {
        x:
          previousX,

        y:
          previousY,
      },

      end: {
        x:
          currentX,

        y:
          currentY,
      },

      thickness:
        1.5,

      color:
        COLOR_ACCENT,
    });
  }

  writer.page.drawText(
    safePdfText(
      money(
        String(
          maximum,
        ),
        currency,
      ),
    ),
    {
      x:
        MARGIN,

      y:
        chartY +
        chartHeight -
        2,

      size:
        6.5,

      font:
        writer.regular,

      color:
        COLOR_MUTED,
    },
  );

  writer.page.drawText(
    safePdfText(
      money(
        String(
          minimum,
        ),
        currency,
      ),
    ),
    {
      x:
        MARGIN,

      y:
        chartY -
        1,

      size:
        6.5,

      font:
        writer.regular,

      color:
        COLOR_MUTED,
    },
  );

  if (
    labels.length >
    0
  ) {
    writer.page.drawText(
      safePdfText(
        labels[0],
      ),
      {
        x:
          chartX,

        y:
          chartY -
          13,

        size:
          6.5,

        font:
          writer.regular,

        color:
          COLOR_MUTED,
      },
    );

    const last =
      safePdfText(
        labels[
          labels.length -
            1
        ],
      );

    const width =
      writer.regular.widthOfTextAtSize(
        last,
        6.5,
      );

    writer.page.drawText(
      last,
      {
        x:
          chartX +
          chartWidth -
          width,

        y:
          chartY -
          13,

        size:
          6.5,

        font:
          writer.regular,

        color:
          COLOR_MUTED,
      },
    );
  }

  writer.y =
    chartY -
    26;
}

export async function buildExecutivePdf(
  context: ReadyReportContext,
): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const pdf =
    await PDFDocument.create();

  const regular =
    await pdf.embedFont(
      StandardFonts.Helvetica,
    );

  const bold =
    await pdf.embedFont(
      StandardFonts.HelveticaBold,
    );

  pdf.setTitle(
    safePdfText(
      `${context.project.name} - VentureScope Financial Report`,
    ),
  );

  pdf.setAuthor(
    "VentureScope",
  );

  pdf.setSubject(
    "Financial Planning and Scenario Simulation Report",
  );

  pdf.setCreator(
    "VentureScope",
  );

  const writer: Writer =
    {
      pdf,

      regular,

      bold,

      page:
        pdf.addPage([
          PAGE_WIDTH,
          PAGE_HEIGHT,
        ]),

      y:
        PAGE_HEIGHT -
        MARGIN,
    };

  titlePage(
    writer,
    context,
  );

  newPage(
    writer,
  );

  drawHeading(
    writer,
    "Executive Summary",
  );

  for (
    const paragraph
    of buildExecutiveSummary(
      context,
    )
  ) {
    drawText(
      writer,
      paragraph,
      {
        size:
          10,

        lineHeight:
          14,

        gapAfter:
          7,
      },
    );
  }

  drawHeading(
    writer,
    "Key Financial Metrics",
  );

  drawKeyValueRows(
    writer,
    [
      [
        "First-year revenue",
        money(
          context.forecast
            .metrics
            .firstYearRevenue,
          context.forecast
            .currency,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "First-year EBITDA",
        money(
          context.forecast
            .metrics
            .firstYearEbitda,
          context.forecast
            .currency,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "Gross margin",
        percentage(
          context.forecast
            .metrics
            .grossMarginPercentage,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "EBITDA margin",
        percentage(
          context.forecast
            .metrics
            .ebitdaMarginPercentage,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "Ending cash",
        money(
          context.forecast
            .metrics
            .endingCash,
          context.forecast
            .currency,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "Runway",
        formatRunway(
          context.forecast
            .metrics
            .runway,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "Ending MRR",
        money(
          context.forecast
            .metrics
            .endingMrr,
          context.forecast
            .currency,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "Ending ARR",
        money(
          context.forecast
            .metrics
            .endingArr,
          context.forecast
            .currency,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "Sustained break-even",
        context.forecast
          .metrics
          .breakEven
          .sustainedBreakEvenMonth
          ? formatLongMonthKey(
              context.forecast
                .metrics
                .breakEven
                .sustainedBreakEvenMonth,
            )
          : "Not reached",
      ],
    ],
  );

  drawLineChart(
    writer,
    "Revenue Forecast",
    context.forecast
      .months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          Number(
            month.revenue,
          ),
      ),
    context.forecast
      .months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          month.month,
      ),
    context.forecast
      .currency,
  );

  drawLineChart(
    writer,
    "Ending Cash Forecast",
    context.forecast
      .months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          Number(
            month.endingCash,
          ),
      ),
    context.forecast
      .months.map(
        (
          month,
        ) =>
          month.month,
      ),
    context.forecast
      .currency,
  );

  drawHeading(
    writer,
    "Annual Forecast",
  );

  drawTable(

    [
      "Year",

      "Net Income",
      "End Cash",
      "End MRR",
    ],
    context.forecast
      .annual.map(
        (
          year,
        ) => [
          String(
            year.year,
          ),

          money(
            year.revenue,
            context.forecast
              .currency,
          ),

          money(
            year.grossProfit,
            context.forecast
              .currency,
          ),

          money(
            year.ebitda,
            context.forecast
              .currency,
          ),

          money(
            year.netIncome,
            context.forecast
              .currency,
          ),

          money(
            year.endingCash,
            context.forecast
              .currency,
          ),

          money(
            year.endingMrr,
            context.forecast
              .currency,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    [
      42,
      79,
      79,
      72,
      72,
      80,
      80,
    ],
  );

  drawHeading(

  );

  drawTable(

    ],
  );

  drawHeading(

  drawKeyValueRows(

        money(
          assumptions.expenses

          context.project
            .currency,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "Monthly rent",
        money(
          assumptions.expenses
            .rent
            .monthlyAmount,
          context.project
            .currency,
        ),
      ],

      [
        "Monthly marketing",
        money(
          assumptions.expenses
            .marketing
            .monthlyAmount,
          context.project
            .currency,
        ),
      ],

      [

        assumptions.expenses
          .cogs.method,

  if (

            month.ebitda,

              .currency,
          ),

              .currency,

            .months.length -
            1
        ];

    drawKeyValueRows(
      writer,
      [
        [
          "Ending customers",
          customers(
            lastMonth
              .endingCustomers,
          ),
        ],

          "Ending ARPU",
          money(
            lastMonth.arpu ??
            "0",
            context.forecast
              .currency,
          ),
        ],

        [
          "Ending MRR",
          money(
            lastMonth.mrr,
            context.forecast
              .currency,
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  return pdf.save();

##### FILE: ./lib/reports/summary.ts #####
import {
  formatCompactCurrencyValue,
  formatLongMonthKey,
  formatPercentageValue,
  formatRunway,
} from "@/lib/finance/formatting";
import type {
  ReadyReportContext,
} from "@/lib/reports/context";

export function buildExecutiveSummary(
  context: ReadyReportContext,
): string[] {
  const {
    forecast,
  } = context;

  const result: string[] =
    [];

  result.push(
    `${forecast.projectName} is forecast to generate ${formatCompactCurrencyValue(
      forecast.metrics
        .firstYearRevenue,
      forecast.currency,
    )} of revenue in the first forecast calendar year under the ${forecast.scenario.name} scenario.`,
  );

  result.push(
    `First-year EBITDA is ${formatCompactCurrencyValue(
      forecast.metrics
        .firstYearEbitda,
      forecast.currency,
    )}, while the full-horizon EBITDA margin is ${formatPercentageValue(
      forecast.metrics
        .ebitdaMarginPercentage,
    )}.`,
  );

  result.push(
    `Projected ending cash is ${formatCompactCurrencyValue(
      forecast.metrics
        .endingCash,
      forecast.currency,
    )}, with runway reported as ${formatRunway(
      forecast.metrics
        .runway,
    )}.`,
  );

  if (
    forecast.metrics
      .breakEven
      .sustainedBreakEvenMonth
  ) {
    result.push(
      `Sustained EBITDA break-even is reached in ${formatLongMonthKey(
        forecast.metrics
          .breakEven
          .sustainedBreakEvenMonth,
      )}.`,
    );
  } else {
    result.push(
      "Sustained EBITDA break-even is not reached during the current forecast horizon.",
    );
  }

  result.push(
    `Ending monthly recurring revenue is ${formatCompactCurrencyValue(
      forecast.metrics
        .endingMrr,
      forecast.currency,
    )}, equivalent to ${formatCompactCurrencyValue(
      forecast.metrics
        .endingArr,
      forecast.currency,
    )} annualized recurring revenue.`,
  );

  return result;
}

import type {
  ZodError,
} from "zod";

export type ScenarioActionState = {
  status?:
    | "success"
    | "error";

  message?: string;

  errors?: Record<
    string,
    string[] | undefined
  >;
};

export const initialScenarioActionState: ScenarioActionState =
  {};

export function scenarioFieldErrors(
  error: ZodError,
): Record<
  string,
  string[] | undefined
> {
  return error
    .flatten()
    .fieldErrors as Record<
      string,
      string[] | undefined
    >;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/scenarios/modifiers.ts #####
import {
  decimal,
  toFinancialString,
} from "@/lib/finance/math";
import type {
  RevenueMode,
} from "@/lib/finance/types";
import type {
  ScenarioModifierFormValues,
  ScenarioStorageModifiers,
  ScenarioViewModel,
} from "@/lib/scenarios/types";

const NEUTRAL_MULTIPLIER =
  "1";

const ZERO =
  "0";

function readModifier(
  modifiers: unknown,
  key: string,
  fallback: string,
): string {
  if (
    !modifiers ||
    typeof modifiers !==
      "object" ||
    Array.isArray(
      modifiers,
    )
  ) {
    return fallback;
  }

  const value =
    (
      modifiers as Record<
        string,
        unknown
      >
    )[key];

  if (
    typeof value !==
      "number" &&
    typeof value !==
      "string"
  ) {
    return fallback;
  }

  return toFinancialString(
    decimal(
      value,
    ),
  );
}

function multiplierToAdjustment(
  multiplier: string,
): string {
  return toFinancialString(
    decimal(
      multiplier,
    )
      .minus(
        1,
      )
      .mul(
        100,
      ),
  );
}

function deltaRateToPercentagePoints(
  value: string,
): string {
  return toFinancialString(
    decimal(
      value,
    ).mul(
      100,
    ),
  );
}

export function neutralScenarioModifierFormValues(): ScenarioModifierFormValues {
  return {
    growthAdjustmentPercentage:
      "0",

    arpuAdjustmentPercentage:
      "0",

    cacAdjustmentPercentage:
      "0",

    churnDeltaPercentagePoints:
      "0",

    cogsDeltaPercentagePoints:
      "0",
  };
}

export function scenarioModifiersToFormValues(
  modifiers: unknown,
  revenueMode: RevenueMode,
): ScenarioModifierFormValues {
  const revenueGrowthMultiplier =
    readModifier(
      modifiers,
      "revenueGrowthMultiplier",
      NEUTRAL_MULTIPLIER,
    );

  const acquisitionGrowthMultiplier =
    readModifier(
      modifiers,
      "customerAcquisitionGrowthMultiplier",
      NEUTRAL_MULTIPLIER,
    );

  const growthMultiplier =
    revenueMode ===
    "DIRECT"
      ? revenueGrowthMultiplier
      : acquisitionGrowthMultiplier;

  return {
    growthAdjustmentPercentage:
      multiplierToAdjustment(
        growthMultiplier,
      ),

    arpuAdjustmentPercentage:
      multiplierToAdjustment(
        readModifier(
          modifiers,
          "arpuMultiplier",
          NEUTRAL_MULTIPLIER,
        ),
      ),

    cacAdjustmentPercentage:
      multiplierToAdjustment(
        readModifier(
          modifiers,
          "cacMultiplier",
          NEUTRAL_MULTIPLIER,
        ),
      ),

    churnDeltaPercentagePoints:
      deltaRateToPercentagePoints(
        readModifier(
          modifiers,
          "churnPercentagePointDelta",
          ZERO,
        ),
      ),

    cogsDeltaPercentagePoints:
      deltaRateToPercentagePoints(
        readModifier(
          modifiers,
          "cogsPercentagePointDelta",
          ZERO,
        ),
      ),
  };
}

function adjustmentToMultiplier(
  value: string,
): string {
  return toFinancialString(
    decimal(
      value,
    )
      .div(
        100,
      )
      .plus(
        1,
      ),
  );
}

function percentagePointsToDeltaRate(
  value: string,
): string {
  return toFinancialString(
    decimal(
      value,
    ).div(
      100,
    ),
  );
}

export function scenarioFormValuesToStorageModifiers(
  values: ScenarioModifierFormValues,
): ScenarioStorageModifiers {
  const growthMultiplier =
    adjustmentToMultiplier(
      values.growthAdjustmentPercentage,
    );

  return {
    revenueGrowthMultiplier:
      growthMultiplier,

    customerAcquisitionGrowthMultiplier:
      growthMultiplier,

    arpuMultiplier:
      adjustmentToMultiplier(
        values.arpuAdjustmentPercentage,
      ),

    cacMultiplier:
      adjustmentToMultiplier(
        values.cacAdjustmentPercentage,
      ),

    churnPercentagePointDelta:
      percentagePointsToDeltaRate(
        values.churnDeltaPercentagePoints,
      ),

    cogsPercentagePointDelta:
      percentagePointsToDeltaRate(
        values.cogsDeltaPercentagePoints,
      ),
  };
}

export function serializeScenarioForManagement(
  scenario: {
    id: string;

    name: string;

    type: string;

    modifiers: unknown;
  },
  revenueMode: RevenueMode,
): ScenarioViewModel {
  if (
    scenario.type !==
      "BASE" &&
    scenario.type !==
      "BULL" &&
    scenario.type !==
      "BEAR" &&
    scenario.type !==
      "CUSTOM"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Unsupported scenario type: ${scenario.type}`,
    );
  }

  return {
    id:
      scenario.id,

    name:
      scenario.name,

    type:
      scenario.type,

    modifiers:
      scenarioModifiersToFormValues(
        scenario.modifiers,
        revenueMode,
      ),
  };
}

import {
  z,
} from "zod";

function numericAdjustment(
  label: string,
  minimum: number,
  maximum: number,
) {
  return z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(
      1,
      `${label} is required.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        /^-?(?:\d+|\d+\.\d+|\.\d+)$/.test(
          value,
        ) &&
        Number.isFinite(
          Number(
            value,
          ),
        ),
      `${label} must be a valid number.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        Number(
          value,
        ) >=
        minimum,
      `${label} must be at least ${minimum}.`,
    )
    .refine(
      (
        value,
      ) =>
        Number(
          value,
        ) <=
        maximum,
      `${label} must not exceed ${maximum}.`,
    );
}

const scenarioId =

    )
    .max(
      80,
      "Scenario name must contain at most 80 characters.",

##### FILE: ./lib/security/headers.ts #####
export type SecurityHeader = {
  key: string;

  value: string;
};

export function buildContentSecurityPolicy(
  production: boolean,
): string {
  const scriptSource =
    production
      ? "'self' 'unsafe-inline'"
      : "'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'";

  const connectSource =
    production
      ? "'self'"
      : "'self' ws: wss:";

  return [
    "default-src 'self'",
    "base-uri 'self'",
    "object-src 'none'",
    "frame-ancestors 'none'",
    "frame-src 'none'",
    "form-action 'self'",
    `script-src ${scriptSource}`,
    "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'",
    "img-src 'self' data: blob:",
    "font-src 'self' data:",
    `connect-src ${connectSource}`,
    "worker-src 'self' blob:",
    "media-src 'self' blob:",
    "manifest-src 'self'",
  ].join(
    "; ",
  );
}

export function buildSecurityHeaders(
  production: boolean,
): SecurityHeader[] {
  const headers: SecurityHeader[] =
    [
      {
        key:
          "Content-Security-Policy",

        value:
          buildContentSecurityPolicy(
            production,
          ),
      },

      {
        key:
          "Referrer-Policy",

        value:
          "strict-origin-when-cross-origin",
      },

      {
        key:
          "X-Content-Type-Options",

        value:
          "nosniff",
      },

      {
        key:
          "X-Frame-Options",

        value:
          "DENY",
      },

      {
        key:
          "X-DNS-Prefetch-Control",

        value:
          "off",
      },

      {
        key:
          "Permissions-Policy",

        value:
          [
            "camera=()",
            "microphone=()",
            "geolocation=()",
            "payment=()",
            "usb=()",
            "browsing-topics=()",
          ].join(
            ", ",
          ),
      },

      {
        key:
          "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy",

        value:
          "same-origin",
      },

      {
        key:
          "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy",

        value:
          "same-origin",
      },
    ];

  if (
    production
  ) {
    headers.push({
      key:
        "Strict-Transport-Security",

      value:
        "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload",
    });
  }

  return headers;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/security/rate-limit.ts #####
type RateLimitBucket = {
  count: number;

  resetAt: number;
};

type RateLimitStore = {
  buckets:
    Map<
      string,
      RateLimitBucket
    >;
};

const globalRateLimit =
  globalThis as unknown as {
    venturescopeRateLimit?:
      RateLimitStore;
  };

const store =
  globalRateLimit
    .venturescopeRateLimit ??
  {
    buckets:
      new Map(),
  };

globalRateLimit.venturescopeRateLimit =
  store;

export type RateLimitResult = {
  allowed: boolean;

  remaining: number;

  retryAfterSeconds: number;

  resetAt: number;
};

function pruneExpired(
  now: number,
): void {
  if (
    store.buckets.size <
    5000
  ) {
    return;
  }

  for (
    const [
      key,
      bucket,
    ]
    of store.buckets
  ) {
    if (
      bucket.resetAt <=
      now
    ) {
      store.buckets.delete(
        key,
      );
    }
  }
}

export function checkRateLimit({
  key,
  limit,
  windowMs,
  now = Date.now(),
}: {
  key: string;

  limit: number;

  windowMs: number;

  now?: number;
}): RateLimitResult {
  pruneExpired(
    now,
  );

  const existing =
    store.buckets.get(
      key,
    );

  if (
    !existing ||
    existing.resetAt <=
      now
  ) {
    const next = {
      count:
        1,

      resetAt:
        now +
        windowMs,
    };

    store.buckets.set(
      key,
      next,
    );

    return {
      allowed:
        true,

      remaining:
        Math.max(
          0,
          limit -
          1,
        ),

      retryAfterSeconds:
        Math.ceil(
          windowMs /
          1000,
        ),

      resetAt:
        next.resetAt,
    };
  }

  if (
    existing.count >=
    limit
  ) {
    return {
      allowed:
        false,

      remaining:
        0,

      retryAfterSeconds:
        Math.max(
          1,
          Math.ceil(
            (
              existing.resetAt -
              now
            ) /
            1000,
          ),
        ),

      resetAt:
        existing.resetAt,
    };
  }

  existing.count +=
    1;

  store.buckets.set(
    key,
    existing,
  );

  return {
    allowed:
      true,

    remaining:
      Math.max(
        0,
        limit -
        existing.count,
      ),

    retryAfterSeconds:
      Math.max(
        1,
        Math.ceil(
          (
            existing.resetAt -
            now
          ) /
          1000,
        ),
      ),

    resetAt:
      existing.resetAt,
  };
}

export function resetRateLimitStoreForTests(): void {
  store.buckets.clear();
}

import { z } from "zod";

const emailSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(1, "Email is required.")
  .email("Enter a valid email address.")
  .transform((value) => value.toLowerCase());

const loginPasswordSchema = z
  .string()
  .min(1, "Password is required.")
  .max(72, "Password is too long.");

const registrationPasswordSchema = z
  .string()
  .min(8, "Password must contain at least 8 characters.")
  .max(72, "Password must contain at most 72 characters.")
  .regex(/[a-z]/, "Password must contain a lowercase letter.")
  .regex(/[A-Z]/, "Password must contain an uppercase letter.")
  .regex(/[0-9]/, "Password must contain a number.");

export const loginSchema = z.object({
  email: emailSchema,
  password: loginPasswordSchema,
});

export const registerSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .min(2, "Name must contain at least 2 characters.")
      .max(80, "Name must contain at most 80 characters."),

    email: emailSchema,

    password: registrationPasswordSchema,

    confirmPassword: z
      .string()
      .min(1, "Please confirm your password."),
  })
  .superRefine((data, context) => {
    if (data.password !== data.confirmPassword) {
      context.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["confirmPassword"],
        message: "Passwords do not match.",
      });
    }
  });

export type LoginInput = z.infer<typeof loginSchema>;
export type RegisterInput = z.infer<typeof registerSchema>;

##### FILE: ./lib/workspaces/access.ts #####
import {
  notFound,
} from "next/navigation";

import {
  prisma,
} from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  hasWorkspacePermission,
  type WorkspacePermission,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/permissions";


export async function getWorkspacePermission(
  workspaceId:
    string,
  userId:
    string,
): Promise<
  WorkspacePermission |
  null
> {
  const workspace =
    await prisma.workspace.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          workspaceId,
      },

      select: {
        ownerId:
          true,

        members: {
          where: {
            userId,
          },

          select: {
            role:
              true,
          },

          take:
            1,
        },
      },
    });


  if (
    !workspace
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  if (
    workspace.ownerId ===
    userId
  ) {
    return "OWNER";
  }


  return (
    workspace.members[
      0
    ]?.role ??
    null
  );
}


export async function requireWorkspacePermission(
  workspaceId:
    string,
  userId:
    string,
  required:
    WorkspacePermission =
      "VIEWER",
): Promise<
  WorkspacePermission
> {
  const actual =
    await getWorkspacePermission(
      workspaceId,
      userId,
    );


  if (
    !actual ||
    !hasWorkspacePermission(
      actual,
      required,
    )
  ) {
    notFound();
  }


  return actual;
}

import {
  createHash,
  randomBytes,
} from "node:crypto";


export function normalizeInvitationEmail(
  email:
    string,
): string {
  return email
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
}


export function createInvitationToken(): string {
  return randomBytes(
    32,
  ).toString(
    "base64url",
  );
}


export function hashInvitationToken(
  token:
    string,
): string {
  return createHash(
    "sha256",
  )
    .update(
      token,
      "utf8",
    )
    .digest(
      "hex",
    );
}


export function invitationExpiry(
  now:
    Date =
      new Date(),
): Date {
  const expires =
    new Date(
      now,
    );


  expires.setUTCDate(
    expires.getUTCDate() +
      7,
  );


  return expires;
}

##### FILE: ./lib/workspaces/permissions.ts #####
export type WorkspacePermission =
  | "OWNER"
  | "EDITOR"
  | "VIEWER";


const PERMISSION_RANK:
  Record<
    WorkspacePermission,
    number
  > = {
    VIEWER:
      1,

    EDITOR:
      2,

    OWNER:
      3,
  };


export function hasWorkspacePermission(
  actual:
    WorkspacePermission,
  required:
    WorkspacePermission,
): boolean {
  return (
    PERMISSION_RANK[
      actual
    ] >=
    PERMISSION_RANK[
      required
    ]
  );
}


export type ProjectPermissionInput = {
  userId:
    string;

  personalOwnerId:
    string;

  workspace:
    | {
        ownerId:
          string;

        memberRole?:
          WorkspacePermission |
          null;
      }
    | null;
};


export function resolveProjectPermission({
  userId,
  personalOwnerId,
  workspace,
}: ProjectPermissionInput): WorkspacePermission | null {
  if (
    personalOwnerId ===
    userId
  ) {
    return "OWNER";
  }


  if (
    !workspace
  ) {
    return null;
  }


  if (
    workspace.ownerId ===
    userId
  ) {
    return "OWNER";
  }


  return (
    workspace.memberRole ??
    null
  );
}

import {

  } from "next/navigation";

import {

  } from "@/lib/db/prisma";

import {
  hasWorkspacePermission,
  resolveProjectPermission,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/permissions";

async function projectWithPermission(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  const project =
    await prisma.project.findUnique({
      where: {
        id:
          projectId,
      },

      include: {
        workspace: {
          include: {
            members: {
              where: {
                userId,
              },

              select: {
                role:
                  true,
              },

              take:
                1,
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

  if (
    !project
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const permission =
    resolveProjectPermission({
      userId,

      personalOwnerId:
        project.userId,

      workspace:
        project.workspace
          ?
            {
              ownerId:
                project.workspace
                  .ownerId,

              memberRole:
                project.workspace
                  .members[
                    0
                  ]?.role ??
                null,
            }
          :
            null,
    });

  if (
    !permission
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    project,

    permission,
  };
}

export async function getProjectForViewer(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  const result =
    await projectWithPermission(
      userId,
      projectId,
    );

  return (
    result?.project ??
    null
  );
}

export async function getProjectForEditor(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  const result =
    await projectWithPermission(
      userId,
      projectId,
    );

  if (
    !result ||
    !hasWorkspacePermission(
      result.permission,
      "EDITOR",
    )
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return result.project;
}

export async function requireProjectEditor(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  const project =
    await getProjectForEditor(
      userId,
      projectId,
    );

  if (
    !project
  ) {
    notFound();
  }

  return project;
}

export async function requireProjectOwner(
  userId:
    string,
  projectId:
    string,
) {
  const result =
    await projectWithPermission(
      userId,
      projectId,
    );

  if (
    !result ||
    !hasWorkspacePermission(
      result.permission,
      "OWNER",
    )
  ) {
    notFound();
  }

  return result.project;
}

##### FILE: ./proxy.ts #####
import {
  NextRequest,
  NextResponse,
} from "next/server";

import {
  checkRateLimit,
} from "@/lib/security/rate-limit";

import {
  createRequestId,
  normalizeRequestId,
} from "@/lib/observability/request-id";


const STATE_CHANGING_METHODS =
  new Set([
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "PATCH",
    "DELETE",
  ]);

function firstHeaderValue(
  value:
    | string
    | null,
): string | null {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    value
      .split(
        ",",
      )[0]
      ?.trim() ??
    null
  );
}

function trustProxyHeaders(): boolean {
  return (
    process.env
      .TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS ===
    "true"
  );
}

function expectedOrigin(
  request: NextRequest,
): string | null {
  const trustProxy =
    trustProxyHeaders();

  const host =
    firstHeaderValue(
      trustProxy
        ? request.headers.get(
            "x-forwarded-host",
          ) ??
          request.headers.get(
            "host",
          )
        : request.headers.get(
            "host",
          ),
    );

  if (!host) {
    return null;
  }

  const forwardedProtocol =
    trustProxy
      ? firstHeaderValue(
          request.headers.get(
            "x-forwarded-proto",
          ),
        )
      : null;

  const protocol =
    forwardedProtocol ??
    request.nextUrl.protocol.replace(
      ":",
      "",
    );

  return `${protocol}://${host}`;
}

function rateLimitIdentity(
  request: NextRequest,
): string {
  const trustProxy =
    trustProxyHeaders();

  if (
    trustProxy
  ) {
    const forwarded =
      firstHeaderValue(
        request.headers.get(
          "x-forwarded-for",
        ),
      );

    if (
      forwarded
    ) {
      return `ip:${forwarded}`;
    }

    const realIp =
      request.headers.get(
        "x-real-ip",
      );

    if (
      realIp
    ) {
      return `ip:${realIp}`;
    }
  }

  const userAgent =
    request.headers.get(
      "user-agent",
    ) ??
    "unknown";

  const language =
    request.headers.get(
      "accept-language",
    ) ??
    "unknown";

  return `client:${userAgent.slice(
    0,
    100,
  )}:${language.slice(
    0,
    40,
  )}`;
}

function tooManyRequests(
  result: {
    remaining: number;

    retryAfterSeconds: number;

    resetAt: number;
  },
) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      error:
        "Too many requests. Please try again later.",
    },
    {
      status:
        429,

      headers: {
        "Retry-After":
          String(
            result.retryAfterSeconds,
          ),

        "X-RateLimit-Remaining":
          String(
            result.remaining,
          ),

        "X-RateLimit-Reset":
          String(
            Math.ceil(
              result.resetAt /
              1000,
            ),
          ),

        "Cache-Control":
          "private, no-store",
      },
    },
  );
}

export function proxy(
  request: NextRequest,
) {

  /*
   * Establish one request correlation identifier at ingress.
   *
   * Safe caller-provided IDs are preserved. Missing or malformed
   * identifiers are generated once here and forwarded explicitly
   * to downstream Route Handlers.
   */
  const correlationId =
    normalizeRequestId(
      request.headers.get(
        "x-request-id",
      ),
    ) ??
    createRequestId();


  const forwardedRequestHeaders =
    new Headers(
      request.headers,
    );


  forwardedRequestHeaders.set(
    "x-request-id",
    correlationId,
  );


  const continueWithCorrelationId =
    () => {
      const response =
        NextResponse.next({
          request: {
            headers:
              forwardedRequestHeaders,
          },
        });


      response.headers.set(
        "X-Request-Id",
        correlationId,
      );


      return response;
    };

  const requestId =
    correlationId;

  if (
    STATE_CHANGING_METHODS.has(
      request.method,
    )
  ) {
    const suppliedOrigin =
      request.headers.get(
        "origin",
      );

    const requiredOrigin =
      expectedOrigin(
        request,
      );

    if (
      suppliedOrigin &&
      requiredOrigin &&
      suppliedOrigin !==
        requiredOrigin
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error:
            "Cross-origin state-changing request rejected.",
        },
        {
          status:
            403,

          headers: {
            "Cache-Control":
              "private, no-store",

            "X-Request-Id":
              requestId,
          },
        },
      );
    }
  }

  const identity =
    rateLimitIdentity(
      request,
    );

  if (
    request.method ===
      "POST" &&
    request.nextUrl.pathname ===
      "/register"
  ) {
    const result =
      checkRateLimit({
        key:
          `register:${identity}`,

        limit:
          10,

        windowMs:
          60 *
          60 *
          1000,
      });

    if (
      !result.allowed
    ) {
      return tooManyRequests(
        result,
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    request.method ===
      "POST" &&
    request.nextUrl.pathname ===
      "/api/auth/callback/credentials"
  ) {
    const result =
      checkRateLimit({
        key:
          `credentials:${identity}`,

        limit:
          30,

        windowMs:
          15 *
          60 *
          1000,
      });

    if (
      !result.allowed
    ) {
      return tooManyRequests(
        result,
      );
    }
  }

  const response =
    continueWithCorrelationId();

  response.headers.set(
    "X-Request-Id",
    requestId,
  );

  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    "/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$).*)",
  ],
};

##### FILE: ./scripts/db-backup.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

COMPOSE_FILE="${VENTURESCOPE_DB_COMPOSE_FILE:-compose.production.yaml}"

DB_SERVICE="${VENTURESCOPE_DB_SERVICE:-postgres}"

DB_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-venturescope}"

DB_NAME="${POSTGRES_DB:-venturescope}"

OUTPUT="${1:-backups/venturescope-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).dump}"


if ! command -v \
  docker \
  >/dev/null 2>&1
then

  echo "[ERROR] Docker is required."

  exit 1

fi


if [[ ! -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Compose file not found:"
  echo "  ${COMPOSE_FILE}"

  exit 1

fi


mkdir -p \
  "$(
    dirname \
      "${OUTPUT}"
  )"


TEMP_OUTPUT="${OUTPUT}.partial"

rm -f \
  "${TEMP_OUTPUT}"


cleanup() {
  rm -f \
    "${TEMP_OUTPUT}"
}

trap cleanup EXIT


echo "============================================================"
echo "VENTURESCOPE — POSTGRESQL BACKUP"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "COMPOSE_FILE=${COMPOSE_FILE}"
echo "DB_SERVICE=${DB_SERVICE}"
echo "DB_NAME=${DB_NAME}"
echo "OUTPUT=${OUTPUT}"
echo


docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  exec \
  -T \
  "${DB_SERVICE}" \
  pg_dump \
    --username="${DB_USER}" \
    --dbname="${DB_NAME}" \
    --format=custom \
    --no-owner \
    --no-privileges \
  > "${TEMP_OUTPUT}"


if [[ ! -s "${TEMP_OUTPUT}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] PostgreSQL backup is empty."

  exit 1

fi


mv \
  "${TEMP_OUTPUT}" \
  "${OUTPUT}"


BYTES="$(
  wc \
    -c \
    < "${OUTPUT}" \
    | tr \
        -d \
        ' '
)"


echo
echo "[PASS] PostgreSQL backup created"
echo "BACKUP=${OUTPUT}"
echo "BYTES=${BYTES}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

COMPOSE_FILE="compose.e2e.yaml"

DATABASE_URL="postgresql://venturescope_e2e:venturescope_e2e@127.0.0.1:55438/venturescope_e2e?schema=public"

DB_USER="venturescope_e2e"
DB_NAME="venturescope_e2e"

BACKUP="/tmp/venturescope-step17-db-selftest.dump"


if [[ ! -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] E2E Compose file not found."

  exit 1

fi


DB_SERVICE="$(
  docker compose \
    -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
    config \
    --services \
    | sed -n \
        '1p' 
)"


if [[ -z "${DB_SERVICE}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Could not discover disposable PostgreSQL service."

  exit 1

fi


cleanup() {
  rm -f \
    "${BACKUP}"

  docker compose \
    -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
    down \
    -v \
    --remove-orphans \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || true
}

trap cleanup EXIT


echo "============================================================"
echo "VENTURESCOPE — DATABASE OPERATIONS SELF-TEST"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "DB_SERVICE=${DB_SERVICE}"


docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  down \
  -v \
  --remove-orphans \
  >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || true


docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  up \
  -d \
  --wait


DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL}" \
pnpm exec prisma db push \
  --force-reset


docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  exec \
  -T \
  "${DB_SERVICE}" \
  psql \
    --username="${DB_USER}" \
    --dbname="${DB_NAME}" \
    --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \
    --command='
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Step17BackupProbe" (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      TRUNCATE TABLE "Step17BackupProbe";

      INSERT INTO "Step17BackupProbe" (
        id,
        value
      )
      VALUES (
        17,
        '\''backup-restore-ok'\''
      );
    '


VENTURESCOPE_DB_COMPOSE_FILE="${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
VENTURESCOPE_DB_SERVICE="${DB_SERVICE}" \
POSTGRES_USER="${DB_USER}" \
POSTGRES_DB="${DB_NAME}" \
bash scripts/db-backup.sh \
  "${BACKUP}"


VENTURESCOPE_DB_COMPOSE_FILE="${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
VENTURESCOPE_DB_SERVICE="${DB_SERVICE}" \
bash scripts/db-verify-backup.sh \
  "${BACKUP}"


docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  exec \
  -T \
  "${DB_SERVICE}" \
  psql \
    --username="${DB_USER}" \
    --dbname="${DB_NAME}" \
    --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \
    --command='
      DROP TABLE "Step17BackupProbe";
    '


VENTURESCOPE_ALLOW_RESTORE="YES" \
VENTURESCOPE_DB_COMPOSE_FILE="${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
VENTURESCOPE_DB_SERVICE="${DB_SERVICE}" \
POSTGRES_USER="${DB_USER}" \
POSTGRES_DB="${DB_NAME}" \
bash scripts/db-restore.sh \
  "${BACKUP}"


RESTORED_VALUE="$(
  docker compose \
    -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
    exec \
    -T \
    "${DB_SERVICE}" \
    psql \
      --username="${DB_USER}" \
      --dbname="${DB_NAME}" \
      --tuples-only \
      --no-align \
      --command='
        SELECT value
        FROM "Step17BackupProbe"
        WHERE id = 17;
      ' \
    | tr \
        -d \
        '\r[:space:]'
)"


if [[ "${RESTORED_VALUE}" != "backup-restore-ok" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Restored database probe does not match."

  echo "VALUE=${RESTORED_VALUE}"

  exit 1

fi


echo
echo "[PASS] Backup created"
echo "[PASS] Backup archive verified"
echo "[PASS] Disposable database modified"
echo "[PASS] Backup restored"
echo "[PASS] Restored data verified"
echo
echo "DATABASE_OPERATIONS_SELFTEST=PASS"

##### FILE: ./scripts/db-restore.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

BACKUP="${1:-${VENTURESCOPE_BACKUP_FILE:-}}"

COMPOSE_FILE="${VENTURESCOPE_DB_COMPOSE_FILE:-compose.production.yaml}"

DB_SERVICE="${VENTURESCOPE_DB_SERVICE:-postgres}"

DB_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-venturescope}"

DB_NAME="${POSTGRES_DB:-venturescope}"


if [[ -z "${BACKUP}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Backup file is required."

  exit 1

fi


if [[ ! -s "${BACKUP}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Backup file does not exist or is empty:"
  echo "  ${BACKUP}"

  exit 1

fi


if [[ "${VENTURESCOPE_ALLOW_RESTORE:-NO}" != "YES" ]]; then

  echo "============================================================"
  echo "RESTORE BLOCKED"
  echo "============================================================"
  echo
  echo "Database restore is destructive."
  echo
  echo "To authorize an intentional restore, run:"
  echo
  echo "  VENTURESCOPE_ALLOW_RESTORE=YES \\"
  echo "    pnpm db:restore -- ${BACKUP}"
  echo
  echo "No database changes were made."

  exit 1

fi


echo "============================================================"
echo "VENTURESCOPE — POSTGRESQL RESTORE"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "COMPOSE_FILE=${COMPOSE_FILE}"
echo "DB_SERVICE=${DB_SERVICE}"
echo "DB_NAME=${DB_NAME}"
echo "BACKUP=${BACKUP}"
echo


docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  exec \
  -T \
  "${DB_SERVICE}" \
  pg_restore \
    --username="${DB_USER}" \
    --dbname="${DB_NAME}" \
    --clean \
    --if-exists \
    --no-owner \
    --no-privileges \
    --exit-on-error \
  < "${BACKUP}"


echo
echo "[PASS] PostgreSQL restore completed"

##### FILE: ./scripts/deploy-production.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail


ROOT="$(
  cd \
    "$(
      dirname \
        "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
    )/.." \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && pwd
)"

cd "${ROOT}"


source \
  scripts/lib/deployment-common.sh


COMPOSE_FILE="${VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_COMPOSE_FILE:-compose.production.yaml}"

RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE="${VENTURESCOPE_RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE:-compose.release.yaml}"

APP_SERVICE="${VENTURESCOPE_APP_SERVICE:-app}"

MIGRATION_SERVICE="${VENTURESCOPE_MIGRATION_SERVICE:-migrate}"

STATE_DIR="$(
  deployment_state_dir
)"

PRODUCTION_URL="${VENTURESCOPE_PRODUCTION_URL:-}"

DRY_RUN="${VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_DRY_RUN:-NO}"


RELEASE_ID="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "${RELEASE_ID}" ]]; then

  RELEASE_ID="$(
    git rev-parse \
      --short=12 \
      HEAD
  )"

fi


validate_release_id \
  "${RELEASE_ID}"


if [[ "${VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_CONFIRM:-NO}" != "YES" ]]; then

  echo "============================================================"
  echo "PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT BLOCKED"
  echo "============================================================"
  echo
  echo "An explicit production deployment confirmation is required."
  echo
  echo "Run:"
  echo
  echo "  VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_CONFIRM=YES \\"
  echo "  VENTURESCOPE_PRODUCTION_URL=https://your-domain.com \\"
  echo "  pnpm deploy:production -- ${RELEASE_ID}"
  echo
  echo "No production changes were made."

  exit 1

fi


if [[ -z "${PRODUCTION_URL}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] VENTURESCOPE_PRODUCTION_URL is required."

  exit 1

fi


GIT_SHA="$(
  git rev-parse \
    HEAD
)"


RELEASE_IMAGE="${VENTURESCOPE_RELEASE_IMAGE:-venturescope:${RELEASE_ID}}"

TIMESTAMP="$(
  deployment_timestamp
)"

BACKUP_FILE="${VENTURESCOPE_PREDEPLOY_BACKUP:-backups/predeploy-${RELEASE_ID}-${TIMESTAMP}.dump}"


echo "============================================================"
echo "VENTURESCOPE — PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "RELEASE_ID=${RELEASE_ID}"
echo "GIT_SHA=${GIT_SHA}"
echo "RELEASE_IMAGE=${RELEASE_IMAGE}"
echo "PRODUCTION_URL=${PRODUCTION_URL}"
echo "COMPOSE_FILE=${COMPOSE_FILE}"
echo "APP_SERVICE=${APP_SERVICE}"
echo "MIGRATION_SERVICE=${MIGRATION_SERVICE}"
echo "BACKUP_FILE=${BACKUP_FILE}"
echo


if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" == "YES" ]]; then

  echo "DEPLOYMENT_MODE=DRY_RUN"
  echo
  echo "[PLAN] acquire deployment lock"
  echo "[PLAN] run authoritative release gate"
  echo "[PLAN] ensure production PostgreSQL is running"
  echo "[PLAN] create pre-deployment PostgreSQL backup"
  echo "[PLAN] capture currently deployed image/version"
  echo "[PLAN] build and execute Prisma migration service"
  echo "[PLAN] deploy ${RELEASE_IMAGE}"
  echo "[PLAN] verify /api/version == ${RELEASE_ID}"
  echo "[PLAN] run complete production smoke test"
  echo "[PLAN] persist deployment state"
  echo "[PLAN] automatically restore previous app image if smoke fails"
  echo "[PLAN] never automatically restore database backup"

  exit 0

fi


if [[ ! -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Production Compose file not found:"
  echo "  ${COMPOSE_FILE}"

  exit 1

fi


if [[ ! -f "${RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Release Compose override not found:"
  echo "  ${RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE}"

  exit 1

fi


acquire_deployment_lock \
  "${STATE_DIR}" \
  "deploy:${RELEASE_ID}"


trap '
  status=$?
  release_deployment_lock
  exit "${status}"
' EXIT


echo
echo "[DEPLOY 1/10] Validating production Compose configuration..."

docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  config \
  >/dev/null


VENTURESCOPE_APP_IMAGE="${RELEASE_IMAGE}" \
docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  -f "${RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  config \
  >/dev/null


echo "[PASS] Production Compose configuration valid"


echo
echo "[DEPLOY 2/10] Running authoritative release gate..."

VENTURESCOPE_RELEASE_IMAGE="${RELEASE_IMAGE}" \
pnpm release:gate


echo
echo "[DEPLOY 3/10] Ensuring production database is running..."

docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  up \
  -d \
  postgres


echo
echo "[DEPLOY 4/10] Creating pre-deployment database backup..."

VENTURESCOPE_DB_COMPOSE_FILE="${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
pnpm db:backup -- \
  "${BACKUP_FILE}"


VENTURESCOPE_DB_COMPOSE_FILE="${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
pnpm db:backup:verify -- \
  "${BACKUP_FILE}"


echo
echo "[DEPLOY 5/10] Capturing currently deployed application state..."

  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  run \
  --rm \
  "${MIGRATION_SERVICE}"


echo "[PASS] Production migrations applied"

VENTURESCOPE_APP_IMAGE="${RELEASE_IMAGE}" \

pnpm ops:smoke -- \
  "${PRODUCTION_URL}"

set -e


if [[ "${SMOKE_STATUS}" -ne 0 ]]; then

  echo
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "NEW RELEASE SMOKE TEST FAILED"
  echo "============================================================"

  if [[ -n "${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}" ]]; then

    echo
    echo "[ROLLBACK] Restoring previous application image:"
    echo "  ${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}"
    echo
    echo "[IMPORTANT] Database is NOT automatically restored."

    APP_VERSION="${PREVIOUS_VERSION:-rollback}" \
    VENTURESCOPE_APP_IMAGE="${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}" \
    docker compose \
      -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
      -f "${RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE}" \
      up \
      -d \
      --no-build \
      --wait \
      "${APP_SERVICE}"


    if [[ -n "${PREVIOUS_VERSION}" ]]; then

      VENTURESCOPE_EXPECTED_VERSION="${PREVIOUS_VERSION}" \
      pnpm ops:smoke -- \
        "${PRODUCTION_URL}"

    else

      pnpm ops:smoke -- \
        "${PRODUCTION_URL}"

    fi


    echo "[PASS] Previous application image restored"

  else

    echo
    echo "[WARN] No previous application image exists."
    echo "[WARN] Automatic application rollback is unavailable."

  fi


  mv \
    "${PENDING_STATE}" \
    "${STATE_DIR}/releases/${RELEASE_ID}.failed.env"


  exit \
    "${SMOKE_STATUS}"

fi


echo "[PASS] Production smoke test passed"


echo
echo "[DEPLOY 10/10] Promoting release state..."

FINAL_STATE="${STATE_DIR}/releases/${RELEASE_ID}.env"


mv \
  "${PENDING_STATE}" \
  "${FINAL_STATE}"


cp \
  "${FINAL_STATE}" \
  "${STATE_DIR}/current.env"


printf '%s\n' \
  "${RELEASE_ID}" \
  > "${STATE_DIR}/current-release"


echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT COMPLETE"
echo "============================================================"

echo "RELEASE_IMAGE=${RELEASE_IMAGE}"
echo "STATE=${FINAL_STATE}"

echo
echo "APPLICATION_ROLLBACK_AVAILABLE=$(
  if [[ -n "${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}" ]]; then
    printf 'YES'
  else
    printf 'NO'
  fi
)"
echo
echo "DATABASE_ROLLBACK_AUTOMATIC=NO"

##### FILE: ./scripts/deployment-selftest.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail


ROOT="$(
  cd \
    "$(
      dirname \
        "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
    )/.." \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && pwd
)"

cd "${ROOT}"


source \
  scripts/lib/deployment-common.sh


TMP_ROOT="$(
  mktemp \
    -d \
    "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/venturescope-deployment-selftest.XXXXXX"
)"


cleanup() {
  release_deployment_lock \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || true

  rm -rf \
    "${TMP_ROOT}"
}

trap cleanup EXIT


STATE_DIR="${TMP_ROOT}/state"


echo "============================================================"
echo "VENTURESCOPE — DEPLOYMENT CONTROL SELF-TEST"
echo "============================================================"
echo


echo "[SELFTEST 1/7] Release ID validation..."

validate_release_id \
  "release-2026.09.08"

set +e

validate_release_id \
  '../../bad release' \
  >/dev/null 2>&1

STATUS=$?

set -e


if [[ "${STATUS}" -eq 0 ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Invalid release ID was accepted."

  exit 1

fi


echo "[PASS] Release ID validation"


echo
echo "[SELFTEST 2/7] Atomic deployment lock..."

acquire_deployment_lock \
  "${STATE_DIR}" \
  "selftest-primary"


set +e

(
  unset VENTURESCOPE_ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT_LOCK

  acquire_deployment_lock \
    "${STATE_DIR}" \
    "selftest-conflict"
) \
  >/dev/null 2>&1

STATUS=$?

set -e


if [[ "${STATUS}" -eq 0 ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Concurrent deployment lock was accepted."

  exit 1

fi


release_deployment_lock


echo "[PASS] Concurrent deployment prevented"


echo
echo "[SELFTEST 3/7] Release-state round trip..."

STATE_FILE="${STATE_DIR}/current.env"


write_release_state \
  "${STATE_FILE}" \
  "release-next" \
  "venturescope:release-next" \
  "venturescope:release-prev" \
  "release-prev" \
  "backups/predeploy.dump" \
  "https://example.invalid" \
  "abc123" \
  "20260908T190000Z"


[[ "$(
  state_value \
    RELEASE_ID \
    "${STATE_FILE}"
)" == "release-next" ]]


[[ "$(
  state_value \
    PREVIOUS_IMAGE \
    "${STATE_FILE}"
)" == "venturescope:release-prev" ]]


[[ "$(
  state_value \
    PREVIOUS_VERSION \
    "${STATE_FILE}"
)" == "release-prev" ]]


echo "[PASS] Release state read/write"


echo
echo "[SELFTEST 4/7] Deployment confirmation lock..."

set +e

VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_STATE_DIR="${STATE_DIR}" \
VENTURESCOPE_PRODUCTION_URL="https://example.invalid" \
bash scripts/deploy-production.sh \
  "selftest-release" \
  >/dev/null 2>&1

STATUS=$?

set -e


if [[ "${STATUS}" -eq 0 ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Deployment ran without explicit confirmation."

  exit 1

fi


echo "[PASS] Production deployment blocked by default"


echo
echo "[SELFTEST 5/7] Deployment dry-run plan..."

DEPLOY_PLAN="$(
  VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_CONFIRM="YES" \
  VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_DRY_RUN="YES" \
  VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_STATE_DIR="${STATE_DIR}" \
  VENTURESCOPE_PRODUCTION_URL="https://example.invalid" \
  bash scripts/deploy-production.sh \
    "selftest-release"
)"


printf '%s\n' \
  "${DEPLOY_PLAN}" \
  | grep -F \
      "DEPLOYMENT_MODE=DRY_RUN" \
      >/dev/null


printf '%s\n' \
  "${DEPLOY_PLAN}" \
  | grep -F \
      "never automatically restore database backup" \
      >/dev/null


echo "[PASS] Safe deployment plan generated"


echo
echo "[SELFTEST 6/7] Rollback confirmation lock..."

set +e

VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_STATE_DIR="${STATE_DIR}" \
bash scripts/rollback-production.sh \
  >/dev/null 2>&1

STATUS=$?

set -e


if [[ "${STATUS}" -eq 0 ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Rollback ran without explicit confirmation."

  exit 1

fi


echo "[PASS] Production rollback blocked by default"


echo
echo "[SELFTEST 7/7] Rollback dry-run plan..."

ROLLBACK_PLAN="$(
  VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_CONFIRM="YES" \
  VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_DRY_RUN="YES" \
  VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_STATE_DIR="${STATE_DIR}" \
  bash scripts/rollback-production.sh
)"


printf '%s\n' \
  "${ROLLBACK_PLAN}" \
  | grep -F \
      "ROLLBACK_MODE=DRY_RUN" \
      >/dev/null


printf '%s\n' \
  "${ROLLBACK_PLAN}" \
  | grep -F \
      "database remains untouched" \
      >/dev/null


echo "[PASS] Safe application rollback plan generated"


echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "DEPLOYMENT CONTROL SELF-TEST PASSED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "RELEASE_ID_VALIDATION=PASS"
echo "ATOMIC_LOCK=PASS"
echo "STATE_ROUNDTRIP=PASS"
echo "DEPLOY_CONFIRMATION=PASS"
echo "DEPLOY_DRY_RUN=PASS"
echo "ROLLBACK_CONFIRMATION=PASS"

##### FILE: ./scripts/diagnostics-smoke.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail


BASE_URL="${1:-${VENTURESCOPE_BASE_URL:-}}"

TOKEN="${2:-${VENTURESCOPE_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN:-}}"


if [[ -z "${BASE_URL}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Diagnostics base URL is required."
  echo
  echo "Usage:"
  echo "  pnpm ops:diagnostics -- https://your-domain.com TOKEN"

  exit 1

fi


if [[ "${TOKEN}" == "" || "${#TOKEN}" -lt 32 ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Diagnostics token must contain at least 32 characters."

  exit 1

fi


BASE_URL="${BASE_URL%/}"

REQUEST_ID="diagnostics-$(
  date \
    -u \
    +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ
)-$$"


TMP_DIR="$(
  mktemp \
    -d \
    "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/venturescope-diagnostics.XXXXXX"
)"


cleanup() {
  rm -rf \
    "${TMP_DIR}"
}

trap cleanup EXIT


HEADERS="${TMP_DIR}/headers"

BODY="${TMP_DIR}/body"


STATUS="$(
  curl \
    --silent \
    --show-error \
    --max-time 20 \
    --connect-timeout 8 \
    --dump-header "${HEADERS}" \
    --output "${BODY}" \
    --write-out '%{http_code}' \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
    --header "X-Request-Id: ${REQUEST_ID}" \
    "${BASE_URL}/api/diagnostics"
)"


if [[ "${STATUS}" != "200" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Diagnostics endpoint failed."
  echo "HTTP=${STATUS}"

  exit 1

fi


if ! grep -Ei \
  "^x-request-id:[[:space:]]*${REQUEST_ID}" \
  "${HEADERS}" \
  >/dev/null
then

  echo "[ERROR] Diagnostics response did not preserve correlation ID."

  exit 1

fi


python3 \
  - "${BODY}" \
  <<'PY'
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


payload = json.loads(
    Path(
        sys.argv[1]
    ).read_text()
)


if (
    payload.get(
        "status"
    ) !=
    "ok"
):
    raise SystemExit(
        "[ERROR] Diagnostics status is not ok."
    )


diagnostics = payload.get(
    "diagnostics"
)

if not isinstance(
    diagnostics,
    dict,
):
    raise SystemExit(
        "[ERROR] Diagnostics payload missing."
    )


database = diagnostics.get(
    "database"
)

if (
    not isinstance(
        database,
        dict,
    )
    or
    database.get(
        "status"
    ) !=
    "ready"
):
    raise SystemExit(
        "[ERROR] Database diagnostics are not ready."
    )


serialized = json.dumps(
    payload
)


for forbidden in [
    "AUTH_SECRET",
    "DATABASE_URL",
    "VENTURESCOPE_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN",
]:
    if forbidden in serialized:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"[ERROR] Sensitive field exposed: {forbidden}"
        )


print(
    "[PASS] Diagnostics endpoint healthy"
)

print(
    "[PASS] Database probe healthy"
)

print(
    "[PASS] Diagnostics payload contains no configured secret names"
)
PY


echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "PRODUCTION DIAGNOSTICS PASSED"
echo "============================================================"

  echo "[ERROR] Next standalone server was not generated."

##### FILE: ./scripts/lib/deployment-common.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail


deployment_timestamp() {
  date \
    -u \
    +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ
}


deployment_state_dir() {
  printf '%s\n' \
    "${VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_STATE_DIR:-.venturescope/deploy}"
}


validate_release_id() {
  local release_id="$1"

  if [[ -z "${release_id}" ]]; then

    echo "[ERROR] Release ID cannot be empty."

    return 1

  fi

  if [[ ! "${release_id}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,79}$ ]]; then

    echo "[ERROR] Invalid release ID:"
    echo "  ${release_id}"
    echo
    echo "Allowed:"
    echo "  letters"
    echo "  numbers"
    echo "  dot"
    echo "  underscore"
    echo "  hyphen"

    return 1

  fi
}


acquire_deployment_lock() {
  local state_dir="$1"
  local operation="$2"

  local lock_dir="${state_dir}/deployment.lock"

  mkdir -p \
    "${state_dir}"


  if mkdir \
    "${lock_dir}" \
    2>/dev/null
  then

    printf '%s\n' \
      "$$" \
      > "${lock_dir}/pid"

    printf '%s\n' \
      "${operation}" \
      > "${lock_dir}/operation"

    printf '%s\n' \
      "$(
        deployment_timestamp
      )" \
      > "${lock_dir}/created_at"

    export VENTURESCOPE_ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT_LOCK="${lock_dir}"

    echo "[PASS] Deployment lock acquired"

    return 0

  fi


  if [[ "${VENTURESCOPE_FORCE_UNLOCK:-NO}" == "YES" ]]; then

    echo "[WARN] Removing deployment lock because VENTURESCOPE_FORCE_UNLOCK=YES"

    rm -rf \
      "${lock_dir}"

    mkdir \
      "${lock_dir}"

    printf '%s\n' \
      "$$" \
      > "${lock_dir}/pid"

    printf '%s\n' \
      "${operation}" \
      > "${lock_dir}/operation"

    printf '%s\n' \
      "$(
        deployment_timestamp
      )" \
      > "${lock_dir}/created_at"

    export VENTURESCOPE_ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT_LOCK="${lock_dir}"

    echo "[PASS] Deployment lock forcibly reacquired"

    return 0

  fi


  echo "[ERROR] Another deployment/rollback operation appears active."
  echo
  echo "Lock:"
  echo "  ${lock_dir}"

  if [[ -f "${lock_dir}/pid" ]]; then

    echo
    echo "PID:"
    cat \
      "${lock_dir}/pid"

  fi

  if [[ -f "${lock_dir}/operation" ]]; then

    echo
    echo "Operation:"
    cat \
      "${lock_dir}/operation"

  fi

  echo
  echo "If the lock is known to be stale, explicitly use:"
  echo "  VENTURESCOPE_FORCE_UNLOCK=YES"

  return 1
}


release_deployment_lock() {
  local lock_dir="${VENTURESCOPE_ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT_LOCK:-}"

  if [[ -n "${lock_dir}" ]]; then

    rm -rf \
      "${lock_dir}"

    unset VENTURESCOPE_ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT_LOCK

    echo "[PASS] Deployment lock released"

  fi
}


state_value() {
  local key="$1"
  local file="$2"

  awk \
    -F= \
    -v wanted="${key}" \
    '
      $1 == wanted {
        sub(/^[^=]*=/, "", $0)
        print
        exit
      }
    ' \
    "${file}"
}


write_release_state() {
  local file="$1"
  local release_id="$2"
  local release_image="$3"
  local previous_image="$4"
  local previous_version="$5"
  local backup_file="$6"
  local production_url="$7"
  local git_sha="$8"
  local deployed_at="$9"

  mkdir -p \
    "$(
      dirname \
        "${file}"
    )"

  {
    printf 'RELEASE_ID=%s\n' \
      "${release_id}"

    printf 'RELEASE_IMAGE=%s\n' \
      "${release_image}"

    printf 'PREVIOUS_IMAGE=%s\n' \
      "${previous_image}"

    printf 'PREVIOUS_VERSION=%s\n' \
      "${previous_version}"

    printf 'BACKUP_FILE=%s\n' \
      "${backup_file}"

    printf 'PRODUCTION_URL=%s\n' \
      "${production_url}"

    printf 'GIT_SHA=%s\n' \
      "${git_sha}"

    printf 'DEPLOYED_AT=%s\n' \
      "${deployed_at}"

  } > "${file}"
}


current_application_image() {
  local compose_file="$1"
  local app_service="$2"

  local container_id

  container_id="$(
    docker compose \
      -f "${compose_file}" \
      ps \
      -q \
      "${app_service}" \
      2>/dev/null \
      || true
  )"


  if [[ -z "${container_id}" ]]; then

    return 0

  fi


  docker inspect \
    "${container_id}" \
    --format '{{.Config.Image}}' \
    2>/dev/null \
    || true
}


current_remote_version() {
  local production_url="$1"

  curl \
    --silent \
    --show-error \
    --max-time 8 \
    --connect-timeout 4 \
    "${production_url%/}/api/version" \
    2>/dev/null \
  | python3 \
      -c '
import json
import sys

try:
    payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    raise SystemExit(0)

version = payload.get(
    "version"
)

if isinstance(
    version,
    str,
):
    print(
        version
    )
' \
    2>/dev/null \
    || true
}

##### FILE: ./scripts/migration-selftest.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail


ROOT="$(
  cd \
    "$(
      dirname \
        "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
    )/.." \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && pwd
)"

cd "${ROOT}"


COMPOSE_FILE="${VENTURESCOPE_MIGRATION_TEST_COMPOSE_FILE:-compose.e2e.yaml}"

DATABASE_URL="${VENTURESCOPE_MIGRATION_TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://venturescope_e2e:venturescope_e2e@127.0.0.1:55438/venturescope_e2e?schema=public}"

EXPECTED_MIGRATIONS="${VENTURESCOPE_EXPECTED_MIGRATION_COUNT:-17}"


cleanup() {
  docker compose \
    -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
    down \
    -v \
    --remove-orphans \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || true
}

trap cleanup EXIT


echo "============================================================"
echo "VENTURESCOPE — PRISMA MIGRATION CHAIN SELF-TEST"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "COMPOSE_FILE=${COMPOSE_FILE}"
echo "EXPECTED_MIGRATIONS=${EXPECTED_MIGRATIONS}"
echo


docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  down \
  -v \
  --remove-orphans \
  >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || true


docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  up \
  -d \
  --wait


DB_SERVICE="$(
  docker compose \
    -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
    config \
    --services \
    | sed -n \
        '1p'
)"


if [[ -z "${DB_SERVICE}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Could not discover disposable PostgreSQL service."

  exit 1

fi


echo
echo "[1/5] Applying complete migration chain to an empty PostgreSQL database..."

DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL}" \
pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy


echo
echo "[2/5] Checking Prisma migration status..."

DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL}" \
pnpm exec prisma migrate status


echo
echo "[3/5] Verifying migration history count..."

MIGRATION_COUNT="$(
  docker compose \
    -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
    exec \
    -T \
    "${DB_SERVICE}" \
    psql \
      --username=venturescope_e2e \
      --dbname=venturescope_e2e \
      --tuples-only \
      --no-align \
      --command='
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM "_prisma_migrations"
        WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL
          AND rolled_back_at IS NULL;
      ' \
    | tr \
        -d \
        '[:space:]'
)"


if [[ "${MIGRATION_COUNT}" != "${EXPECTED_MIGRATIONS}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Unexpected applied migration count."
  echo "EXPECTED=${EXPECTED_MIGRATIONS}"
  echo "ACTUAL=${MIGRATION_COUNT}"

  exit 1

fi


echo "[PASS] MIGRATION_COUNT=${MIGRATION_COUNT}"


echo
echo "[4/5] Verifying Step 20 account-security columns..."

COLUMN_COUNT="$(
  docker compose \
    -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
    exec \
    -T \
    "${DB_SERVICE}" \
    psql \
      --username=venturescope_e2e \
      --dbname=venturescope_e2e \
      --tuples-only \
      --no-align \
      --command="
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'User'
          AND column_name IN (
            'authVersion',
            'passwordChangedAt'
          );
      " \
    | tr \
        -d \
        '[:space:]'
)"


if [[ "${COLUMN_COUNT}" != "2" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Step 20 security columns missing."
  echo "COLUMN_COUNT=${COLUMN_COUNT}"

  exit 1

fi


echo "[PASS] authVersion present"
echo "[PASS] passwordChangedAt present"


echo
echo "[5/5] Checking migrated database for Prisma-schema drift..."

DIFF_LOG="$(
  mktemp \
    "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/venturescope-migration-diff.XXXXXX"
)"


set +e

DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL}" \
pnpm exec prisma migrate diff \
  --exit-code \
  --from-config-datasource \
  --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma \
  > "${DIFF_LOG}" \
  2>&1

DIFF_STATUS=$?

set -e


if [[ "${DIFF_STATUS}" -ne 0 ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Migrated database does not match prisma/schema.prisma."
  echo "DIFF_EXIT=${DIFF_STATUS}"
  echo

  cat \
    "${DIFF_LOG}"

  rm -f \
    "${DIFF_LOG}"

  exit 1

fi


rm -f \
  "${DIFF_LOG}"


echo "[PASS] Migration history matches Prisma schema"

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "PRISMA MIGRATION CHAIN SELF-TEST PASSED"
echo "============================================================"
echo
