##### FILE: ./scripts/production-smoke.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

BASE_URL="${1:-${VENTURESCOPE_BASE_URL:-}}"

if [[ -z "${BASE_URL}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Production base URL is required."
  echo
  echo "Usage:"
  echo "  pnpm ops:smoke -- https://venturescope.example.com"
  echo
  echo "Or:"
  echo "  VENTURESCOPE_BASE_URL=https://venturescope.example.com pnpm ops:smoke"

  exit 1

fi

BASE_URL="${BASE_URL%/}"


TMP_DIR="$(
  mktemp \
    -d \
    "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/venturescope-smoke.XXXXXX"
)"


cleanup() {
  rm -rf \
    "${TMP_DIR}"
}

trap cleanup EXIT


request() {
  local path="$1"
  local headers="$2"
  local body="$3"

  curl \
    --silent \
    --show-error \
    --max-time 20 \
    --connect-timeout 8 \
    --dump-header "${headers}" \
    --output "${body}" \
    --write-out '%{http_code}' \
    "${BASE_URL}${path}"
}


expect_status() {
  local actual="$1"
  local expected="$2"
  local label="$3"

  if [[ "${actual}" != "${expected}" ]]; then

    echo "[ERROR] ${label}"
    echo "Expected HTTP ${expected}; received ${actual}."

    exit 1

  fi
}


echo "============================================================"
echo "VENTURESCOPE — PRODUCTION SMOKE TEST"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "TARGET=${BASE_URL}"
echo


for route in \
  "/" \
  "/demo" \
  "/robots.txt" \
  "/sitemap.xml"
do

  route_id="$(
    printf '%s' \
      "${route}" \
      | tr '/.' '__'
  )"

  HEADERS="${TMP_DIR}/${route_id}.headers"
  BODY="${TMP_DIR}/${route_id}.body"

  STATUS="$(
    request \
      "${route}" \
      "${HEADERS}" \
      "${BODY}"
  )"

  expect_status \
    "${STATUS}" \
    "200" \
    "Public route failed: ${route}"

  echo "[PASS] ${route} -> HTTP 200"

done


for route in \
  "/api/health" \
  "/api/ready" \
  "/api/version"
do

  route_id="$(
    printf '%s' \
      "${route}" \
      | tr '/.' '__'
  )"

  HEADERS="${TMP_DIR}/${route_id}.headers"
  BODY="${TMP_DIR}/${route_id}.body"

  STATUS="$(
    request \
      "${route}" \
      "${HEADERS}" \
      "${BODY}"
  )"

  expect_status \
    "${STATUS}" \
    "200" \
    "Operational endpoint failed: ${route}"

  python3 \
    - "${BODY}" \
    <<'PY'
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    sys.argv[1]
)

try:
    json.loads(
        path.read_text()
    )
except Exception as exc:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"[ERROR] Operational endpoint did not return valid JSON: {exc}"
    )
PY

  echo "[PASS] ${route} -> HTTP 200 JSON"

done


VERSION_BODY="${TMP_DIR}/_api_version.body"

python3 \
  - "${VERSION_BODY}" "${VENTURESCOPE_EXPECTED_VERSION:-}" \
  <<'PY'
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

payload = json.loads(
    Path(
        sys.argv[1]
    ).read_text()
)

expected_version = (
    sys.argv[2].strip()
    if len(
        sys.argv
    ) > 2
    else ""
)

if (
    payload.get(
        "service"
    )
    !=
    "venturescope"
):
    raise SystemExit(
        "[ERROR] /api/version returned unexpected service identity."
    )

version = payload.get(
    "version"
)

if not version:
    raise SystemExit(
        "[ERROR] /api/version returned an empty version."
    )

if (
    expected_version
    and
    version !=
    expected_version
):
    raise SystemExit(
        "[ERROR] Deployed version mismatch: "
        f"expected {expected_version!r}, received {version!r}."
    )

if not payload.get(
    "environment"
):
    raise SystemExit(
        "[ERROR] /api/version returned an empty environment."
    )

for forbidden in [
    "AUTH_SECRET",
    "DATABASE_URL",
    "password",
    "secret",
]:
    if forbidden in payload:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"[ERROR] /api/version exposed forbidden field: {forbidden}"
        )

print(
    "[PASS] /api/version payload is operational and non-secret"
)

if expected_version:
    print(
        f"[PASS] Expected release version is active: {expected_version}"
    )
PY


PROTECTED_HEADERS="${TMP_DIR}/protected.headers"
PROTECTED_BODY="${TMP_DIR}/protected.body"

PROTECTED_STATUS="$(
  curl \
    --silent \
    --show-error \
    --max-time 20 \
    --connect-timeout 8 \
    --dump-header "${PROTECTED_HEADERS}" \
    --output "${PROTECTED_BODY}" \
    --write-out '%{http_code}' \
    "${BASE_URL}/dashboard"
)"


case "${PROTECTED_STATUS}" in

  302|303|307|308)
    ;;

  *)
    echo "[ERROR] Anonymous /dashboard did not redirect."
    echo "HTTP=${PROTECTED_STATUS}"

    exit 1
    ;;

esac


if ! grep -Ei \
  '^location:.*\/login' \
  "${PROTECTED_HEADERS}" \
  >/dev/null
then

  echo "[ERROR] /dashboard redirect does not point to /login."

  exit 1

fi


if ! grep -Ei \
  '^x-robots-tag:.*noindex' \
  "${PROTECTED_HEADERS}" \
  >/dev/null
then

  echo "[ERROR] Protected redirect is missing X-Robots-Tag noindex."

  exit 1

fi


echo "[PASS] Anonymous dashboard access redirects safely"
echo "[PASS] Protected route advertises noindex"


PUBLIC_HEADERS="${TMP_DIR}/public-security.headers"
PUBLIC_BODY="${TMP_DIR}/public-security.body"

PUBLIC_STATUS="$(
  request \
    "/" \
    "${PUBLIC_HEADERS}" \
    "${PUBLIC_BODY}"
)"

expect_status \
  "${PUBLIC_STATUS}" \
  "200" \
  "Landing page security-header verification failed"


for header in \
  "content-security-policy" \
  "x-content-type-options" \
  "referrer-policy"
do

  if ! grep -Ei \
    "^${header}:" \
    "${PUBLIC_HEADERS}" \
    >/dev/null
  then

    echo "[ERROR] Missing required browser security header:"
    echo "  ${header}"

    exit 1

  fi

done


echo "[PASS] Browser security headers present"

echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "PRODUCTION SMOKE TEST PASSED"
echo "============================================================"

##### FILE: ./scripts/rollback-production.sh #####
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail


ROOT="$(
  cd \
    "$(
      dirname \
        "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
    )/.." \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && pwd
)"

cd "${ROOT}"


source \
  scripts/lib/deployment-common.sh


COMPOSE_FILE="${VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_COMPOSE_FILE:-compose.production.yaml}"

RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE="${VENTURESCOPE_RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE:-compose.release.yaml}"

APP_SERVICE="${VENTURESCOPE_APP_SERVICE:-app}"

STATE_DIR="$(
  deployment_state_dir
)"

CURRENT_STATE="${STATE_DIR}/current.env"

DRY_RUN="${VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_DRY_RUN:-NO}"


if [[ "${VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_CONFIRM:-NO}" != "YES" ]]; then

  echo "============================================================"
  echo "PRODUCTION ROLLBACK BLOCKED"
  echo "============================================================"
  echo
  echo "An explicit rollback confirmation is required."
  echo
  echo "Application-only rollback:"
  echo
  echo "  VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_CONFIRM=YES \\"
  echo "  pnpm deploy:rollback"
  echo
  echo "Database restore is NEVER automatic."

  exit 1

fi


if [[ ! -f "${CURRENT_STATE}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Current deployment state is missing:"
  echo "  ${CURRENT_STATE}"

  exit 1

fi


CURRENT_RELEASE="$(
  state_value \
    RELEASE_ID \
    "${CURRENT_STATE}"
)"

CURRENT_IMAGE="$(
  state_value \
    RELEASE_IMAGE \
    "${CURRENT_STATE}"
)"

PREVIOUS_IMAGE="$(
  state_value \
    PREVIOUS_IMAGE \
    "${CURRENT_STATE}"
)"

PREVIOUS_VERSION="$(
  state_value \
    PREVIOUS_VERSION \
    "${CURRENT_STATE}"
)"

BACKUP_FILE="$(
  state_value \
    BACKUP_FILE \
    "${CURRENT_STATE}"
)"

PRODUCTION_URL="$(
  state_value \
    PRODUCTION_URL \
    "${CURRENT_STATE}"
)"


if [[ -z "${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] No previous application image was recorded."
  echo
  echo "Current release:"
  echo "  ${CURRENT_RELEASE}"

  exit 1

fi


if [[ -z "${PRODUCTION_URL}" ]]; then

  echo "[ERROR] Current deployment state has no production URL."

  exit 1

fi


echo "============================================================"
echo "VENTURESCOPE — PRODUCTION ROLLBACK"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "CURRENT_RELEASE=${CURRENT_RELEASE}"
echo "CURRENT_IMAGE=${CURRENT_IMAGE}"
echo "TARGET_IMAGE=${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}"
echo "TARGET_VERSION=${PREVIOUS_VERSION:-UNKNOWN}"
echo "PRODUCTION_URL=${PRODUCTION_URL}"
echo "DATABASE_RESTORE=${VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_DATABASE:-NO}"
echo


if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" == "YES" ]]; then

  echo "ROLLBACK_MODE=DRY_RUN"
  echo
  echo "[PLAN] acquire deployment lock"
  echo "[PLAN] switch application to ${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}"

  if [[ "${VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_DATABASE:-NO}" == "YES" ]]; then

    echo "[PLAN] stop application"
    echo "[PLAN] explicitly restore ${BACKUP_FILE}"
    echo "[PLAN] restart previous application image"

  else

    echo "[PLAN] database remains untouched"

  fi

  echo "[PLAN] run expected-version production smoke"
  echo "[PLAN] persist rollback release state"

  exit 0

fi


acquire_deployment_lock \
  "${STATE_DIR}" \
  "rollback:${CURRENT_RELEASE}"


trap '
  status=$?
  release_deployment_lock
  exit "${status}"
' EXIT


if [[ "${VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_DATABASE:-NO}" == "YES" ]]; then

  if [[ "${VENTURESCOPE_ALLOW_RESTORE:-NO}" != "YES" ]]; then

    echo "[ERROR] Database rollback requires BOTH:"
    echo
    echo "  VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_DATABASE=YES"
    echo "  VENTURESCOPE_ALLOW_RESTORE=YES"

    exit 1

  fi


  if [[ -z "${BACKUP_FILE}" || ! -f "${BACKUP_FILE}" ]]; then

    echo "[ERROR] Required pre-deployment backup is unavailable:"
    echo "  ${BACKUP_FILE}"

    exit 1

  fi


  echo
  echo "[ROLLBACK 1/4] Stopping application before database restore..."

  docker compose \
    -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
    stop \
    "${APP_SERVICE}"


  echo
  echo "[ROLLBACK 2/4] Restoring pre-deployment PostgreSQL backup..."

  VENTURESCOPE_ALLOW_RESTORE="YES" \
  VENTURESCOPE_DB_COMPOSE_FILE="${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  pnpm db:restore -- \
    "${BACKUP_FILE}"


  echo "[PASS] Database restored"

else

  echo
  echo "[ROLLBACK] Database restore intentionally skipped."

fi


echo
echo "[ROLLBACK 3/4] Restoring previous application image..."

APP_VERSION="${PREVIOUS_VERSION:-rollback}" \
VENTURESCOPE_APP_IMAGE="${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}" \
docker compose \
  -f "${COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  -f "${RELEASE_COMPOSE_FILE}" \
  up \
  -d \
  --no-build \
  --wait \
  "${APP_SERVICE}"


echo "[PASS] Previous application image started"


echo
echo "[ROLLBACK 4/4] Running production smoke verification..."

if [[ -n "${PREVIOUS_VERSION}" ]]; then

  VENTURESCOPE_EXPECTED_VERSION="${PREVIOUS_VERSION}" \
  pnpm ops:smoke -- \
    "${PRODUCTION_URL}"

else

  pnpm ops:smoke -- \
    "${PRODUCTION_URL}"

fi


ROLLBACK_ID="rollback-$(
  deployment_timestamp
)"


ROLLBACK_STATE="${STATE_DIR}/releases/${ROLLBACK_ID}.env"


write_release_state \
  "${ROLLBACK_STATE}" \
  "${ROLLBACK_ID}" \
  "${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}" \
  "${CURRENT_IMAGE}" \
  "${CURRENT_RELEASE}" \
  "${BACKUP_FILE}" \
  "${PRODUCTION_URL}" \
  "$(
    git rev-parse \
      HEAD
  )" \
  "$(
    deployment_timestamp
  )"


cp \
  "${ROLLBACK_STATE}" \
  "${STATE_DIR}/current.env"


printf '%s\n' \
  "${ROLLBACK_ID}" \
  > "${STATE_DIR}/current-release"


echo
echo "============================================================"
echo "PRODUCTION ROLLBACK COMPLETE"
echo "============================================================"
echo
echo "ROLLBACK_ID=${ROLLBACK_ID}"
echo "APPLICATION_IMAGE=${PREVIOUS_IMAGE}"
echo "DATABASE_RESTORED=$(
  if [[ "${VENTURESCOPE_ROLLBACK_DATABASE:-NO}" == "YES" ]]; then
    printf 'YES'
  else
    printf 'NO'
  fi
)"

##### FILE: ./tests/accessibility/seo.test.ts #####
import {
  afterEach,
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  getPublicSiteUrl,
  SITE_DESCRIPTION,
  SITE_NAME,
} from "@/lib/seo/site";

describe(
  "public product metadata",
  () => {
    const original =
      process.env
        .NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL;

    afterEach(
      () => {
        if (
          original ===
          undefined
        ) {
          delete process.env
            .NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL;
        }
        else {
          process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL =
            original;
        }
      },
    );

    it(
      "has a stable public product identity",
      () => {
        expect(
          SITE_NAME,
        ).toBe(
          "VentureScope",
        );

        expect(
          SITE_DESCRIPTION.length,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          30,
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "uses configured production origin",
      () => {
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL =
          "https://venturescope.example.com";

        expect(
          getPublicSiteUrl()
            .toString(),
        ).toBe(
          "https://venturescope.example.com/",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  actualPeriodKey,
  parseActualMonth,
  parseActualsCsv,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals";


describe(
  "Actuals CSV import",
  () => {
    it(
      "parses monthly financial actuals",
      () => {
        const rows =
          parseActualsCsv(
            [
              "Month,Revenue,COGS,Operating Expenses,EBITDA,Cash Balance,Customers",
              "2027-01,10000,3000,5000,2000,42000,100",
              "2027-02,12000,3500,5500,3000,45000,112",
            ].join(
              "\n",
            ),
          );


        expect(
          rows,
        ).toHaveLength(
          2,
        );


        expect(
          rows[
            0
          ].revenue,
        ).toBe(
          10000,
        );


        expect(
          actualPeriodKey(
            rows[
              1
            ].period,
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "2027-02",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "normalizes readable month values",
      () => {
        expect(
          actualPeriodKey(
            parseActualMonth(
              "Jan 2027",
            ),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "2027-01",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects duplicate months",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            parseActualsCsv(
              [
                "Month,Revenue",
                "2027-01,100",
                "2027-01,200",
              ].join(
                "\n",
              ),
            ),
        ).toThrow(
          /duplicate month/i,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects fractional customer counts",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            parseActualsCsv(
              [
                "Month,Customers",
                "2027-01,10.5",
              ].join(
                "\n",
              ),
            ),
        ).toThrow(
          /non-negative integer/i,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/actuals/month.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  formatMonthKey,
  parseMonthKey,
  parseMonthStartUtc,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/month";


describe(
  "timezone-independent month normalization",
  () => {
    it.each([
      [
        "Jan 2027",
        "2027-01",
      ],

      [
        "January 2027",
        "2027-01",
      ],

      [
        "2027 Jan",
        "2027-01",
      ],

      [
        "2027 January",
        "2027-01",
      ],

      [
        "2027-01",
        "2027-01",
      ],

      [
        "2027/01",
        "2027-01",
      ],

      [
        "01/2027",
        "2027-01",
      ],

      [
        "2027-01-31",
        "2027-01",
      ],
    ])(
      "normalizes %s",
      (
        input,
        expected,
      ) => {
        expect(
          parseMonthKey(
            input,
          ),
        ).toBe(
          expected,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "creates month starts explicitly in UTC",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseMonthStartUtc(
            "Jan 2027",
          )?.toISOString(),
        ).toBe(
          "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "round-trips UTC month keys",
      () => {
        const date =
          parseMonthStartUtc(
            "Jan 2027",
          );


        expect(
          date
            ?
              formatMonthKey(
                date,
              )
            :
              null,
        ).toBe(
          "2027-01",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects invalid months deterministically",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseMonthKey(
            "2027-13",
          ),
        ).toBeNull();


        expect(
          parseMonthKey(
            "NotAMonth 2027",
          ),
        ).toBeNull();
      },
    );
  },
);

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  calculateVarianceReport,
  metricVariance,
  normalizeForecastPeriodKey,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics";


function forecast(
  period:
    string,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  return {
    period,

    revenue:
      100,

    cogs:
      40,

    grossProfit:
      60,

    operatingExpenses:
      30,

    ebitda:
      30,

    netIncome:
      20,

    cashFlow:
      15,

    cashBalance:
      1000,

    mrr:
      80,

    customers:
      10,

    cac:
      null,

    churnRate:
      null,
  };
}


describe(
  "Actuals vs forecast variance",
  () => {
    it(
      "treats higher revenue as favorable",
      () => {
        const result =
          metricVariance(
            "revenue",
            120,
            100,
          );


        expect(
          result.variance,
        ).toBe(
          20,
        );


        expect(
          result.varianceRate,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.2,
        );


        expect(
          result.favorable,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "treats lower COGS as favorable",
      () => {
        expect(
          metricVariance(
            "cogs",
            30,
            40,
          ).favorable,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          metricVariance(
            "cogs",
            50,
            40,
          ).favorable,
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "matches readable forecast periods to actual month keys",
      () => {
        expect(
          normalizeForecastPeriodKey(
            "Jan 2027",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "2027-01",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "aggregates matched revenue and EBITDA",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateVarianceReport(
            [
              {
                period:
                  "2027-01",

                revenue:
                  120,

                cogs:
                  35,

                operatingExpenses:
                  30,

                ebitda:
                  55,

                netIncome:
                  40,

                cashFlow:
                  30,

                cashBalance:
                  1100,

                mrr:
                  90,

                customers:
                  11,
              },
            ],
            [
              forecast(
                "2027-01",
              ),
            ],
          );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .matchedPeriods,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .revenueVariance,
        ).toBe(
          20,
        );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .ebitdaVariance,
        ).toBe(
          25,
        );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .latestCashVariance,
        ).toBe(
          100,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/alerts/fingerprint.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  deterministicAlertFingerprint,
} from "@/lib/notifications/fingerprint";


describe(
  "alert fingerprints",
  () => {
    it(
      "creates deterministic 16-character fingerprints",
      () => {
        const first =
          deterministicAlertFingerprint(
            "risk|critical|95",
          );


        const second =
          deterministicAlertFingerprint(
            "risk|critical|95",
          );


        expect(
          first,
        ).toBe(
          second,
        );


        expect(
          first,
        ).toMatch(
          /^[a-f0-9]{16}$/u,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "changes when underlying alert content changes",
      () => {
        expect(
          deterministicAlertFingerprint(
            "capital|500",
          ),
        ).not.toBe(
          deterministicAlertFingerprint(
            "capital|750",
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/alerts/receipts.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  resolveProjectAlertInbox,
} from "@/lib/notifications/receipts";

import type {
  ProjectAlert,
  ProjectAlertReceiptView,
} from "@/lib/notifications/types";


function alert(
  fingerprint =
    "0123456789abcdef",
): ProjectAlert {
  return {
    key:
      "CAPITAL_NEED",

    fingerprint,

    category:
      "CAPITAL",

    severity:
      "WARNING",

    title:
      "Capital need",

    detail:
      "Funding required",

    sourceHref:
      "/capital",

    sourceLabel:
      "Capital",

    createdAt:
      null,
  };
}


function receipt({
  fingerprint =
    "0123456789abcdef",
  readAt =
    "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  dismissedAt =
    null,
  snoozedUntil =
    null,
}: {
  fingerprint?:
    string;

  readAt?:
    string |
    null;

  dismissedAt?:
    string |
    null;

  snoozedUntil?:
    string |
    null;
} = {}): ProjectAlertReceiptView {
  return {
    id:
      "receipt-1",

    alertKey:
      "CAPITAL_NEED",

    fingerprint,

    readAt,

    dismissedAt,

    snoozedUntil,

    updatedAt:
      "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  };
}


describe(
  "alert receipt resolution",
  () => {
    const now =
      new Date(
        "2027-01-02T00:00:00.000Z",
      );


    it(
      "marks matching receipt as read",
      () => {
        const inbox =
          resolveProjectAlertInbox({
            alerts: [
              alert(),
            ],

            receipts: [
              receipt(),
            ],

            now,
          });


        expect(
          inbox.visible[
            0
          ].read,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          inbox.summary
            .unread,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "reactivates changed alert fingerprints",
      () => {
        const inbox =
          resolveProjectAlertInbox({
            alerts: [
              alert(
                "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
              ),
            ],

            receipts: [
              receipt({
                fingerprint:
                  "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
              }),
            ],

            now,
          });


        expect(
          inbox.visible[
            0
          ].read,
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );


        expect(
          inbox.visible[
            0
          ].changedSinceReceipt,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "separates dismissed alerts",
      () => {
        const inbox =
          resolveProjectAlertInbox({
            alerts: [
              alert(),
            ],

            receipts: [
              receipt({
                dismissedAt:
                  "2027-01-01T12:00:00.000Z",
              }),
            ],

            now,
          });


        expect(
          inbox.visible,
        ).toHaveLength(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          inbox.dismissed,
        ).toHaveLength(
          1,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "separates active snoozes",
      () => {
        const inbox =
          resolveProjectAlertInbox({
            alerts: [
              alert(),
            ],

            receipts: [
              receipt({
                snoozedUntil:
                  "2027-01-03T00:00:00.000Z",
              }),
            ],

            now,
          });


        expect(
          inbox.visible,
        ).toHaveLength(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          inbox.snoozed,
        ).toHaveLength(
          1,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "returns expired snoozes to visible inbox",
      () => {
        const inbox =
          resolveProjectAlertInbox({
            alerts: [
              alert(),
            ],

            receipts: [
              receipt({
                snoozedUntil:
                  "2027-01-01T12:00:00.000Z",
              }),
            ],

            now,
          });


        expect(
          inbox.visible,
        ).toHaveLength(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          inbox.visible[
            0
          ].snoozed,
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/alerts/schema-source.test.ts #####
import {
  readFileSync,
} from "node:fs";

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";


const schema =
  readFileSync(
    "prisma/schema.prisma",
    "utf8",
  );


describe(
  "ProjectAlertReceipt schema",
  () => {
    it(
      "persists per-user project alert state",
      () => {
        expect(
          schema,
        ).toContain(
          "model ProjectAlertReceipt",
        );


        expect(
          schema,
        ).toMatch(
          /projectId\s+String/,
        );


        expect(
          schema,
        ).toMatch(
          /userId\s+String/,
        );


        expect(
          schema,
        ).toMatch(
          /alertKey\s+String/,
        );


        expect(
          schema,
        ).toMatch(
          /fingerprint\s+String/,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "enforces one receipt per user project and alert key",
      () => {
        expect(
          schema,
        ).toContain(
          "@@unique([userId, projectId, alertKey])",
        );
      },
    );


    it(

          schema,
        ).toMatch(

        );

          schema,
        ).toMatch(

        );


        expect(
          schema,
        ).toMatch(
          /snoozedUntil\s+DateTime\?/,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "cascades personal state when user or project is removed",
      () => {
        expect(
          schema,
        ).toContain(
          'relation("ProjectAlertReceiptProject"',
        );


        expect(
          schema,
        ).toContain(
          'relation("ProjectAlertReceiptUser"',
        );


        const receiptModel =
          schema
            .split(
              "model ProjectAlertReceipt",
            )[
              1
            ]
            ?.split(
              "\n}",
            )[
              0
            ] ??
          "";


        expect(
          receiptModel.match(

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  normalizeForecastCsv,
  parseCsvTable,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics";


describe(
  "analytics forecast CSV parsing",
  () => {
    it(
      "parses quoted CSV values",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseCsvTable(
            'Month,Revenue\n"Jan, 2027","1,200"\n',
          ),
        ).toEqual([
          [
            "Month",
            "Revenue",
          ],

          [
            "Jan, 2027",
            "1,200",
          ],
        ]);
      },
    );


    it(
      "discovers the financial table after report preamble rows",
      () => {
        const rows =
          normalizeForecastCsv(
            [
              "VentureScope Export",
              "Project,Orbit Analytics",
              "",
              "Month,Revenue,COGS,EBITDA,Cash Balance,MRR,Customers,CAC,Churn Rate",
              "2027-01,10000,3000,1500,50000,8000,100,250,2%",
              "2027-02,12000,3600,2000,52000,9500,110,240,1.5%",
            ].join(
              "\n",
            ),
          );


        expect(
          rows,
        ).toHaveLength(
          2,
        );


        expect(
          rows[
            0
          ].revenue,
        ).toBe(
          10000,
        );


        expect(
          rows[
            0
          ].churnRate,
        ).toBe(
          0.02,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "parses parenthesized negatives",
      () => {
        const rows =
          normalizeForecastCsv(
            [
              "Month,Revenue,Cash Flow",
              "2027-01,1000,(250)",
            ].join(
              "\n",
            ),
          );


        expect(
          rows[
            0
          ].cashFlow,
        ).toBe(
          -250,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/analytics/dcf.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  calculateDcf,
  calculateDcfSensitivity,
  type ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics";


function row(
  month:
    number,
  cashFlow:
    number,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  return {
    period:
      `M${month}`,

    revenue:
      1000,

    cogs:
      300,

    grossProfit:
      700,

    operatingExpenses:
      500,

    ebitda:
      200,

    netIncome:
      150,

    cashFlow,

    cashBalance:
      10000,

    mrr:
      1000,

    customers:
      100,

    cac:
      100,

    churnRate:
      0.02,
  };
}


const rows =
  Array.from(
    {
      length:
        60,
    },
    (
      _,
      index,
    ) =>
      row(
        index +
          1,
        100 +
          index,
      ),
  );


describe(
  "DCF analytics",
  () => {
    it(
      "produces five annual forecast periods",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateDcf(
            rows,
            {
              discountRate:
                0.15,

              terminalGrowthRate:
                0.03,
            },
          );


        expect(
          result?.annualCashFlows,
        ).toHaveLength(
          5,
        );


        expect(
          result?.enterpriseValue,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects terminal growth equal to or above discount rate",
      () => {
        expect(
          calculateDcf(
            rows,
            {
              discountRate:
                0.03,

              terminalGrowthRate:
                0.03,
            },
          ),
        ).toBeNull();
      },
    );


    it(
      "reduces valuation as the discount rate increases",
      () => {
        const low =
          calculateDcf(
            rows,
            {
              discountRate:
                0.1,

              terminalGrowthRate:
                0.02,
            },
          );


        const high =
          calculateDcf(
            rows,
            {
              discountRate:
                0.2,

              terminalGrowthRate:
                0.02,
            },
          );


        expect(
          low?.enterpriseValue ??
          0,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          high?.enterpriseValue ??
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "creates a deterministic sensitivity matrix",
      () => {
        const matrix =
          calculateDcfSensitivity(
            rows,
            {
              discountRate:
                0.15,

              terminalGrowthRate:
                0.03,
            },
          );


        expect(
          matrix.discountRates.length,
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
          5,
        );


        expect(
          matrix.terminalGrowthRates.length,
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
          5,
        );


        expect(
          matrix.cells,
        ).toHaveLength(
          matrix.discountRates.length *
          matrix.terminalGrowthRates.length,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/analytics/operating.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  calculateAdvancedAnalytics,
  calculateOperatingAnalytics,
  calculateUnitEconomics,
  type ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics";


function forecastRow(
  revenue:
    number,
  mrr:
    number,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  return {
    period:
      "month",

    revenue,

    cogs:
      revenue *
      0.3,

    grossProfit:
      revenue *
      0.7,

    operatingExpenses:
      revenue *
      0.55,

    ebitda:
      revenue *
      0.15,

    netIncome:
      revenue *
      0.1,

    cashFlow:
      revenue *
      0.08,

    cashBalance:
      50000,

    mrr,

    customers:
      100,

    cac:
      200,

    churnRate:
      0.02,
  };
}


const rows = [
  ...Array.from(
    {
      length:
        12,
    },
    () =>
      forecastRow(
        10000,
        5000,
      ),
  ),

  ...Array.from(
    {
      length:
        12,
    },
    (
      _,
      index,
    ) =>
      forecastRow(
        12000,
        6000 +
          index *
          100,
      ),
  ),
];


describe(
  "operating analytics",
  () => {
    it(
      "calculates revenue growth and EBITDA margin",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateOperatingAnalytics(
            rows,
          );


        expect(
          result.revenueGrowthRate,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.2,
        );


        expect(
          result.ebitdaMarginRate,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.15,
        );


        expect(
          result.ruleOf40,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.35,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "calculates gross-margin unit economics",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateUnitEconomics(
            rows,
          );


        expect(
          result.grossMarginRate,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.7,
        );


        expect(
          result.monthlyArpu,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.lifetimeValue,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          result.cac ??
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "returns one deterministic analytics result",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateAdvancedAnalytics(
            rows,
            {
              discountRate:
                0.15,

              terminalGrowthRate:
                0.03,
            },
          );


        expect(
          result.rowCount,
        ).toBe(
          24,
        );


        expect(
          result.unitEconomics.ltvToCac,
        ).not.toBeNull();
      },
    );
  },
);

} from "@/lib/approvals/validation";


describe(

            "FINANCIAL_PERIOD_REOPEN",

        );

            parseApprovalRequestType(
              "DELETE_DATABASE",
            ),
        ).toThrow(
          /request type/i,
        );
      },
    );

      "validates lifecycle statuses",

        expect(
          parseApprovalRequestStatus(
            "PENDING",
          ),

          "PENDING",
        );

          parseApprovalRequestStatus(

          ),
        ).toBe(
          "APPROVED",
        );
      },
    );

      "maps owner decisions to terminal statuses",

          approvalStatusFromDecision(
            parseApprovalDecision(
              "APPROVE",
            ),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "APPROVED",
        );


        expect(
          approvalStatusFromDecision(
            parseApprovalDecision(
              "REJECT",
            ),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "REJECTED",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "only permits pending requests to transition",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            assertApprovalPending(
              "PENDING",
            ),
        ).not.toThrow();


        expect(
          () =>
            assertApprovalPending(
              "APPROVED",
            ),
        ).toThrow(
          /pending/i,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "supports generic subject references",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseApprovalSubjectValue(
            "FinancialPeriod",
            "Subject type",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "FinancialPeriod",
        );


        expect(
          parseApprovalSubjectValue(
            "",
            "Subject ID",
          ),
        ).toBeNull();
      },
    );
  },
);

function snapshot({
  risk =
    "LOW",
  riskScore =
    10,
  capitalNeed =
    0,
  accuracy =
    0.95,
  exhaustion =
    null,
}: {
  risk?:
    "LOW" |
    "MODERATE" |
    "HIGH" |
    "CRITICAL";

  riskScore?:
    number;

  capitalNeed?:
    number;

  accuracy?:
    number |
    null;

  exhaustion?:
    string |
    null;
} = {}): ExecutiveReviewSnapshot {
  return {
    schemaVersion:
      1,

    capturedAt:
      "2027-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",

    kpis: {
      actualPeriods:
        3,

      matchedPeriods:
        3,

      revenueVarianceRate:
        0,

      ebitdaVarianceRate:
        0,

      forecastAccuracyScore:
        accuracy,

      forecastWape:
        accuracy ===
          null
          ?
            null
          :
            1 -
            accuracy,

      liquidityRiskLevel:
        risk,

      liquidityRiskScore:
        riskScore,

      minimumForecastCash:
        1000,

      minimumDownsideCash:
        500,

      downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
        exhaustion,

      capitalNeed,
    },

    actions: {
      open:
        0,

      criticalOpen:
        0,

      overdue:
        0,

      done:
        0,
    },

    signals:
      [],
  };
}


function scorecard(
  offTrack =
    0,
): ManagementScorecard {
  return {
    rows:
      [],

    summary: {
      total:
        offTrack,

      onTrack:
        0,

      atRisk:
        0,

      offTrack,

      unavailable:
        0,

      trackedPeriods:
        offTrack >
          0
          ?
            1
          :
            0,
    },
  };
}


function variance(
  unexplained =
    0,
): VarianceReview {
  return {
    rows:
      [],

    summary: {
      totalRows:
        unexplained,

      material:
        unexplained,

      materialUnexplained:
        unexplained,

      unfavorable:
        unexplained,

      openCommentaries:
        0,

      monitoringCommentaries:
        0,

      resolvedCommentaries:
        0,

      acceptedCommentaries:
        0,

      reviewedPeriods:
        0,
    },
  };
}


function register(
  status:
    "OPEN" |
    "CLOSED" =
      "CLOSED",
): FinancialPeriodRegister {
  return {
    rows: [
      {
        periodKey:
          "2027-02",

        status,

        closeSequence:
          status ===
            "CLOSED"
            ?
              1
            :
              0,

        closedAt:
          null,

        closedByUserId:
          null,

        reopenedAt:
          null,

        reopenedByUserId:
          null,

        revenue:
          100,

        ebitda:
          20,

        cashBalance:
          500,
      },
    ],

    summary: {
      totalPeriods:
        1,

      openPeriods:
        status ===
          "OPEN"
          ?
            1
          :
            0,

      closedPeriods:
        status ===
          "CLOSED"
          ?
            1
          :
            0,

      closeCycles:
        status ===
          "CLOSED"
          ?
            1
          :
            0,
    },
  };
}

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  compareExecutiveReview,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/comparison";

import type {
  ExecutiveReviewSnapshot,
} from "@/lib/finance/board-room/types";


function snapshot({
  revenueVariance,
  forecastAccuracy,
  riskScore,
  capitalNeed,
  openActions,
}: {
  revenueVariance:
    number;

  forecastAccuracy:
    number;

  riskScore:
    number;

  capitalNeed:
    number;

  openActions:
    number;
}): ExecutiveReviewSnapshot {
  return {
    schemaVersion:
      1,

    capturedAt:
      "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",

    kpis: {
      actualPeriods:
        1,

      matchedPeriods:
        1,

      revenueVarianceRate:
        revenueVariance,

      ebitdaVarianceRate:
        0,

      forecastAccuracyScore:
        forecastAccuracy,

      forecastWape:
        1 -
        forecastAccuracy,

      liquidityRiskLevel:
        "LOW",

      liquidityRiskScore:
        riskScore,

      minimumForecastCash:
        100,

      minimumDownsideCash:
        50,

      downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
        null,

      capitalNeed,
    },

    actions: {
      open:
        openActions,

      criticalOpen:
        0,

      overdue:
        0,

      done:
        0,
    },

    signals:
      [],
  };
}


describe(
  "executive review comparison",
  () => {
    it(
      "calculates live movement from frozen review",
      () => {
        const frozen =
          snapshot({
            revenueVariance:
              -0.10,

            forecastAccuracy:
              0.80,

            riskScore:
              20,

            capitalNeed:
              100,

            openActions:
              4,
          });


        const live =
          snapshot({
            revenueVariance:
              -0.05,

            forecastAccuracy:
              0.90,

            riskScore:
              35,

            capitalNeed:
              150,

            openActions:
              2,
          });


        const result =
          compareExecutiveReview(
            frozen,
            live,
          );


        expect(
          result.revenueVarianceRate
            .delta,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.05,
        );


        expect(
          result.forecastAccuracyScore
            .delta,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.10,
        );


        expect(
          result.liquidityRiskScore
            .delta,
        ).toBe(
          15,
        );


        expect(
          result.capitalNeed
            .delta,
        ).toBe(
          50,
        );


        expect(
          result.openActions
            .delta,
        ).toBe(
          -2,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

const riskPolicy:
  ProjectRiskPolicy = {
    minimumCash:
      100,

    minimumRunwayMonths:
      6,

    minimumEbitdaMargin:
      null,

    maximumMonthlyBurn:
      null,

    downsideRevenueShock:
      0.20,

    downsideCostInflation:
      0.10,
  };


const forecast:
  ForecastAnalyticsRow = {
    period:
      "2027-01",

    revenue:
      1000,

    cogs:

describe(

            .done,
        ).toBe(

        );
      },

          buildExecutiveReviewSnapshot({
            capturedAt:
              "2027-02-15T00:00:00.000Z",

            actuals: [
              actual,
            ],

            forecasts: [
              forecast,
            ],

            riskPolicy,

              "2027-01",

              950,

            actions:
              [],
          });


        expect(
          snapshot.kpis
            .revenueVarianceRate,
        ).toBeCloseTo(

##### FILE: ./tests/capital-planning/financing-math.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,

  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  amortizedMonthlyPayment,
  equityDilution,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/calculations";


describe(
  "capital financing mathematics",
  () => {
    it(
      "amortizes zero-interest debt evenly",
      () => {
        expect(
          amortizedMonthlyPayment({
            principal:
              1200,

            annualRate:
              0,

            termMonths:
              12,
          }),
        ).toBe(
          100,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "includes interest in positive-rate debt service",
      () => {
        const payment =
          amortizedMonthlyPayment({
            principal:
              1200,

            annualRate:
              0.12,

            termMonths:
              12,
          });


        expect(
          payment,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          100,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "calculates post-money equity dilution",
      () => {
        expect(
          equityDilution({
            equityAmount:
              20,

            preMoneyValuation:
              80,
          }),
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.20,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "returns zero dilution when no equity is issued",
      () => {
        expect(
          equityDilution({
            equityAmount:
              0,

            preMoneyValuation:
              100,
          }),
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/capital-planning/report.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  buildCapitalSourceCashPath,
  calculateCapitalPlanningReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/calculations";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";


const policy:
  ProjectRiskPolicy = {
    minimumCash:
      100,

    minimumRunwayMonths:
      6,

    minimumEbitdaMargin:
      null,

    maximumMonthlyBurn:
      null,

    downsideRevenueShock:
      0.20,

    downsideCostInflation:
      0.10,
  };


function row(
  month:
    number,
  cashBalance:
    number,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  return {
    period:
      `2027-${month
        .toString()
        .padStart(
          2,
          "0",
        )}`,

    revenue:
      1000,

    cogs:
      300,

    grossProfit:
      700,

    operatingExpenses:
      500,

    ebitda:
      200,

    netIncome:
      100,

    cashFlow:
      100,

    cashBalance,

    mrr:
      500,

    customers:
      50,

    cac:
      null,

    churnRate:
      null,
  };
}


describe(
  "capital planning report",
  () => {
    const rows = [
      row(
        1,
        500,
      ),

      row(
        2,
        400,
      ),

      row(
        3,
        300,
      ),
    ];


    it(
      "builds the base cash source from forecast balances",
      () => {
        const path =
          buildCapitalSourceCashPath({
            basis:
              "BASE",

            rows,

            riskPolicy:
              policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              null,
          });


        expect(
          path.map(
            (
              point,
            ) =>
              point.cashBalance,
          ),
        ).toEqual([
          500,
          400,
          300,
        ]);
      },
    );


    it(
      "builds a more conservative downside cash path",
      () => {
        const base =
          buildCapitalSourceCashPath({
            basis:
              "BASE",

            rows,

            riskPolicy:
              policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              500,
          });


        const downside =
          buildCapitalSourceCashPath({
            basis:
              "DOWNSIDE",

            rows,

            riskPolicy:
              policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              500,
          });


        expect(
          Math.min(
            ...downside.map(
              (
                point,
              ) =>
                point.cashBalance,
            ),
          ),
        ).toBeLessThan(
          Math.min(
            ...base.map(
              (
                point,
              ) =>
                point.cashBalance,
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "returns all three capital strategies",
      () => {
        const report =
          calculateCapitalPlanningReport({
            basis:
              "BASE",

            rows,

            riskPolicy:
              policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              null,

            inputs: {
              targetCashFloor:
                500,

              raisePeriodIndex:
                0,

              capitalAmount:
                200,

              preMoneyValuation:
                1000,

              annualDebtRate:
                0.10,

              debtTermMonths:
                24,

              hybridEquityShare:
                0.50,
            },
          });


        expect(
          report.strategies.map(
            (
              strategy,
            ) =>
              strategy.kind,
          ),
        ).toEqual([
          "EQUITY",
          "DEBT",
          "HYBRID",
        ]);
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/capital-planning/strategies.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  calculateCapitalStrategy,
} from "@/lib/finance/capital-planning/calculations";


const path = [
  {
    period:
      "2027-01",

    cashBalance:
      100,
  },

  {
    period:
      "2027-02",

    cashBalance:
      50,
  },

  {
    period:
      "2027-03",

    cashBalance:
      0,
  },

  {
    period:
      "2027-04",

    cashBalance:
      -50,
  },
];


const inputs = {
  targetCashFloor:
    0,

  raisePeriodIndex:
    0,

  capitalAmount:
    200,

  preMoneyValuation:
    800,

  annualDebtRate:
    0.12,

  debtTermMonths:
    12,

  hybridEquityShare:
    0.50,
};


describe(
  "capital structure comparison",
  () => {
    it(
      "equity creates dilution without debt service",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateCapitalStrategy({
            kind:
              "EQUITY",

            path,

            inputs,
          });


        expect(
          result.debtAmount,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.monthlyDebtService,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.dilution,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.20,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "debt creates debt service without dilution",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateCapitalStrategy({
            kind:
              "DEBT",

            path,

            inputs,
          });


        expect(
          result.equityAmount,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.dilution,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.monthlyDebtService,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "hybrid splits capital between equity and debt",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateCapitalStrategy({
            kind:
              "HYBRID",

            path,

            inputs,
          });


        expect(
          result.equityAmount,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          100,
        );


        expect(
          result.debtAmount,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          100,
        );


        expect(
          result.dilution,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.monthlyDebtService,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "debt produces lower cash than equity after debt service begins",
      () => {
        const equity =
          calculateCapitalStrategy({
            kind:
              "EQUITY",

            path,

            inputs,
          });


        const debt =
          calculateCapitalStrategy({
            kind:
              "DEBT",

            path,

            inputs,
          });


        expect(
          debt.endingCash,
        ).toBeLessThan(
          equity.endingCash ??
          Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  createInvitationToken,
  hashInvitationToken,
  invitationExpiry,
  normalizeInvitationEmail,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/invitations";


describe(
  "workspace invitations",
  () => {
    it(
      "normalizes invitation email addresses",
      () => {
        expect(
          normalizeInvitationEmail(
            " Person@Example.COM ",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "person@example.com",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "generates high-entropy invitation tokens",
      () => {
        const first =
          createInvitationToken();

        const second =
          createInvitationToken();


        expect(
          first.length,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          32,
        );

        expect(
          first,
        ).not.toBe(
          second,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "stores only deterministic token hashes",
      () => {
        const token =
          "private-invitation-token";


        const hash =
          hashInvitationToken(
            token,
          );


        expect(
          hash,
        ).toHaveLength(
          64,
        );

        expect(
          hash,
        ).not.toContain(
          token,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "expires invitations seven days later",
      () => {
        const start =
          new Date(
            "2026-09-08T12:00:00.000Z",
          );


        expect(
          invitationExpiry(
            start,
          ).toISOString(),
        ).toBe(
          "2026-09-15T12:00:00.000Z",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  hasWorkspacePermission,
  resolveProjectPermission,
} from "@/lib/workspaces/permissions";


describe(
  "workspace permission hierarchy",
  () => {
    it(
      "allows Owner to perform every workspace permission",
      () => {
        expect(
          hasWorkspacePermission(
            "OWNER",
            "OWNER",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );

        expect(
          hasWorkspacePermission(
            "OWNER",
            "EDITOR",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );

        expect(
          hasWorkspacePermission(
            "OWNER",
            "VIEWER",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "allows Editor to edit but not manage ownership",
      () => {
        expect(
          hasWorkspacePermission(
            "EDITOR",
            "EDITOR",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );

        expect(
          hasWorkspacePermission(
            "EDITOR",
            "OWNER",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "keeps Viewer read-only",
      () => {
        expect(
          hasWorkspacePermission(
            "VIEWER",
            "VIEWER",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );

        expect(
          hasWorkspacePermission(
            "VIEWER",
            "EDITOR",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);


describe(
  "project collaboration permission resolution",
  () => {
    it(
      "keeps personal project owners authoritative",
      () => {
        expect(
          resolveProjectPermission({
            userId:
              "owner",

            personalOwnerId:
              "owner",

            workspace:
              null,
          }),
        ).toBe(
          "OWNER",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "allows workspace owner access",
      () => {
        expect(
          resolveProjectPermission({
            userId:
              "workspace-owner",

            personalOwnerId:
              "different-owner",

            workspace: {
              ownerId:
                "workspace-owner",

              memberRole:
                null,
            },
          }),
        ).toBe(
          "OWNER",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "resolves workspace Editor and Viewer membership",
      () => {
        expect(
          resolveProjectPermission({
            userId:
              "editor",

            personalOwnerId:
              "owner",

            workspace: {
              ownerId:
                "workspace-owner",

              memberRole:
                "EDITOR",
            },
          }),
        ).toBe(
          "EDITOR",
        );


        expect(
          resolveProjectPermission({
            userId:
              "viewer",

            personalOwnerId:
              "owner",

            workspace: {
              ownerId:
                "workspace-owner",

              memberRole:
                "VIEWER",
            },
          }),
        ).toBe(
          "VIEWER",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects unrelated users",
      () => {
        expect(
          resolveProjectPermission({
            userId:
              "outsider",

            personalOwnerId:
              "owner",

            workspace: {
              ownerId:
                "workspace-owner",

              memberRole:
                null,
            },
          }),
        ).toBeNull();
      },
    );
  },

      "has distinct viewer, editor and owner project boundaries",
      () => {
        expect(
          access,
        ).toContain(
          "getProjectForViewer",
        );

        expect(
          access,
        ).toContain(
          "getProjectForEditor",
        );

        expect(
          access,
        ).toContain(
          "requireProjectOwner",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "requires workspace owner permission for member governance",
      () => {
        expect(
          actions,
        ).toContain(
          '"OWNER"',
        );

        expect(
          actions,
        ).toContain(
          "updateWorkspaceMemberRoleAction",
        );

        expect(
          actions,
        ).toContain(
          "removeWorkspaceMemberAction",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "only lets personal owners assign their project",
      () => {
        expect(
          actions,
        ).toContain(
          `userId:
          user.id`,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "requires Editor permission to share a project into a workspace",
      () => {
        const assignmentStart =
          actions.indexOf(
            "assignProjectToWorkspaceAction",
          );

        const assignmentEnd =
          actions.indexOf(
            "removeProjectFromWorkspaceAction",
          );


        expect(
          assignmentStart,
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
          0,
        );

        expect(
          assignmentEnd,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          assignmentStart,
        );


        const assignment =
          actions.slice(
            assignmentStart,
            assignmentEnd,
          );


        expect(
          assignment,
        ).toContain(
          `"EDITOR"`,
        );

        expect(
          assignment,
        ).not.toContain(
          `"VIEWER"`,
        );
      },
    );
  },

        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          start,
        );


        const assignment =
          actions.slice(
            start,
            end,
          );


        expect(
          assignment,
        ).toContain(
          '"EDITOR"',
        );


        expect(
          assignment,
        ).not.toContain(
          '"VIEWER"',
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "keeps Viewer below Editor permission",
      async () => {
        const {
          hasWorkspacePermission,
        } =
          await import(
            "@/lib/workspaces/permissions"
          );


        expect(
          hasWorkspacePermission(
            "VIEWER",
            "EDITOR",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

describe(

            ],

            projects: [
              {
                projectId:
                  "eur",

                name:
                  "EUR Project",

                industry:
                  "Software",

                currency:
                  "EUR",

                latestActualPeriod:
                  "2027-02",

                latestActualCash:
                  1000,

                capitalNeed:

                forecastAvailable:
                  true,

                latestActualPeriod:

                capitalNeed:
                  220,

                forecastAvailable:
                  true,
              },

          2000,

##### FILE: ./tests/consolidation/fx.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  convertCurrencyAmount,
  resolveWorkspaceFxRate,
} from "@/lib/finance/consolidation/fx";


const rates = [
  {
    id:
      "old",

    baseCurrency:
      "EUR" as const,

    quoteCurrency:
      "USD" as const,

    rate:
      1.05,

    effectiveDate:
      "2027-01-01",

    sourceLabel:
      "Old planning rate",

    createdBy:
      null,

    createdAt:
      "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  },

  {
    id:
      "new",

    baseCurrency:
      "EUR" as const,

    quoteCurrency:
      "USD" as const,

    rate:
      1.10,

    effectiveDate:
      "2027-02-01",

    sourceLabel:
      "New planning rate",

    createdBy:
      null,

    createdAt:
      "2027-02-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  },
];


describe(
  "workspace FX resolution",
  () => {
    it(
      "uses identity rate for same currency",
      () => {
        expect(
          resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
            sourceCurrency:
              "EUR",

            reportingCurrency:
              "EUR",

            asOfDate:
              "2027-02-28",

            rates,
          })?.rate,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "uses latest direct rate as of date",
      () => {
        const result =
          resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
            sourceCurrency:
              "EUR",

            reportingCurrency:
              "USD",

            asOfDate:
              "2027-02-28",

            rates,
          });


        expect(
          result?.rate,
        ).toBe(
          1.10,
        );


        expect(
          result?.effectiveDate,
        ).toBe(
          "2027-02-01",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "does not use a future rate",
      () => {
        expect(
          resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
            sourceCurrency:
              "EUR",

            reportingCurrency:
              "USD",

            asOfDate:
              "2027-01-15",

            rates,
          })?.rate,
        ).toBe(
          1.05,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "supports inverse conversion",
      () => {
        const result =
          resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
            sourceCurrency:
              "USD",

            reportingCurrency:
              "EUR",

            asOfDate:
              "2027-02-28",

            rates,
          });


        expect(
          result?.direction,
        ).toBe(
          "INVERSE",
        );


        expect(
          result?.rate,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          1 /
          1.10,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "returns null when no direct or inverse rate exists",
      () => {
        expect(
          resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
            sourceCurrency:
              "GBP",

            reportingCurrency:
              "TND",

            asOfDate:
              "2027-02-28",

            rates,
          }),
        ).toBeNull();
      },
    );


    it(
      "converts using decimal arithmetic",
      () => {
        const fx =
          resolveWorkspaceFxRate({
            sourceCurrency:
              "EUR",

            reportingCurrency:
              "USD",

            asOfDate:
              "2027-02-28",

            rates,
          });


        if (
          !fx
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            "Rate missing.",
          );
        }


        expect(
          convertCurrencyAmount({
            amount:
              100,

            fx,
          }),
        ).toBe(
          110,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/data-import/csv.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  csvRecords,
  parseCsvMatrix,
} from "@/lib/data-import/csv";


describe(
  "dependency-free CSV parser",
  () => {
    it(
      "parses ordinary CSV",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseCsvMatrix(
            "a,b\n1,2",
          ),
        ).toEqual([
          [
            "a",
            "b",
          ],
          [
            "1",
            "2",
          ],
        ]);
      },
    );


    it(
      "parses quoted commas",
      () => {
        const result =
          csvRecords(
            'name,note\nAlice,"Hello, world"',
          );


        expect(
          result.records[
            0
          ].note,
        ).toBe(
          "Hello, world",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "parses escaped quotes",
      () => {
        const result =
          csvRecords(
            'name,note\nAlice,"He said ""hello"""',
          );


        expect(
          result.records[
            0
          ].note,
        ).toBe(
          'He said "hello"',
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects duplicate headers",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            csvRecords(
              "a,a\n1,2",
            ),
        ).toThrow(
          /duplicate headers/i,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

        );


        expect(
          service,
        ).toContain(
          "transaction.projectAuditEvent.create",
        );
      },
    );


    it(

      () => {
        expect(

        ).toContain(

          service,

          'status:\n              "FAILED"',

        expect(

    );


    it(

##### FILE: ./tests/data-import/validation.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  validateDataImportCsv,
} from "@/lib/data-import/validation";


describe(
  "Data Import validation",
  () => {
    it(
      "validates Actuals CSV",
      () => {
        const result =
          validateDataImportCsv({
            importType:
              "ACTUALS",

            csv:
              "period,revenue,cashBalance,customers\n2027-01,1000,5000,10",
          });


        expect(
          result.issues,
        ).toHaveLength(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.rows[
            0
          ],
        ).toMatchObject({
          kind:
            "ACTUALS",

          periodKey:
            "2027-01",

          revenue:
            1000,

          cashBalance:
            5000,

          customers:
            10,
        });
      },
    );


    it(
      "normalizes KPI percentage target values",
      () => {
        const result =
          validateDataImportCsv({
            importType:
              "KPI_TARGETS",

            csv:
              "periodKey,metricCode,targetValue\n2027-01,EBITDA_MARGIN,20",
          });


        expect(
          result.issues,
        ).toHaveLength(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.rows[
            0
          ],
        ).toMatchObject({
          kind:
            "KPI_TARGETS",

          targetValue:
            0.20,
        });
      },
    );


    it(
      "validates Variance Commentary CSV",
      () => {
        const result =
          validateDataImportCsv({
            importType:
              "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY",

            csv:
              "periodKey,metricCode,causeCode,varianceNature,explanation,status\n2027-01,REVENUE,VOLUME,RECURRING,Sales volume below plan,MONITORING",
          });


        expect(
          result.issues,
        ).toHaveLength(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.rows[
            0
          ],
        ).toMatchObject({
          kind:
            "VARIANCE_COMMENTARY",

          metricCode:
            "REVENUE",

          causeCode:
            "VOLUME",

          status:
            "MONITORING",
        });
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects missing required headers",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            validateDataImportCsv({
              importType:
                "KPI_TARGETS",

              csv:
                "periodKey,targetValue\n2027-01,100",
            }),
        ).toThrow(
          /missing required csv headers/i,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "detects duplicate import identities",
      () => {
        const result =
          validateDataImportCsv({
            importType:
              "KPI_TARGETS",

            csv: [
              "periodKey,metricCode,targetValue",
              "2027-01,REVENUE,100",
              "2027-01,REVENUE,200",
            ].join(
              "\n",
            ),
          });


        expect(
          result.issues.some(
            (
              issue,
            ) =>
              issue.field ===
              "duplicate",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          result.rows,
        ).toHaveLength(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects invalid customer values",
      () => {
        const result =
          validateDataImportCsv({
            importType:
              "ACTUALS",

            csv:
              "period,customers\n2027-01,10.5",
          });


        expect(
          result.issues.some(
            (
              issue,
            ) =>
              issue.field ===
              "customers",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/decision-center/signals.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  buildExecutiveDecisionSignals,
} from "@/lib/finance/decision-center/signals";


describe(
  "Executive Decision Center signals",
  () => {
    it(
      "prioritizes critical liquidity and capital signals",
      () => {
        const signals =
          buildExecutiveDecisionSignals({
            actualPeriods:
              6,

            revenueVarianceRate:
              -0.12,

            ebitdaVarianceRate:
              -0.05,

            forecastAccuracyScore:
              0.82,

            forecastBiasCount:
              2,

            liquidityRiskLevel:
              "CRITICAL",

            downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
              "2027-08",

            requiredCapital:
              250000,
          });


        expect(
          signals[
            0
          ].severity,
        ).toBe(
          "CRITICAL",
        );


        expect(
          signals.some(
            (
              signal,
            ) =>
              signal.code ===
              "CAPITAL_GAP",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          signals.some(
            (
              signal,
            ) =>
              signal.code ===
              "DOWNSIDE_EXHAUSTION",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "flags materially weak revenue performance",
      () => {
        const signals =
          buildExecutiveDecisionSignals({
            actualPeriods:
              3,

            revenueVarianceRate:
              -0.15,

            ebitdaVarianceRate:
              null,

            forecastAccuracyScore:
              0.95,

            forecastBiasCount:
              0,

            liquidityRiskLevel:
              "LOW",

            downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
              null,

            requiredCapital:
              0,
          });


        expect(
          signals.find(
            (
              signal,
            ) =>
              signal.code ===
              "REVENUE_VARIANCE",
          )?.severity,
        ).toBe(
          "CRITICAL",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "flags weak forecast reliability",
      () => {
        const signals =
          buildExecutiveDecisionSignals({
            actualPeriods:
              6,

            revenueVarianceRate:
              null,

            ebitdaVarianceRate:
              null,

            forecastAccuracyScore:
              0.70,

            forecastBiasCount:
              0,

            liquidityRiskLevel:
              "LOW",

            downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
              null,

            requiredCapital:
              0,
          });


        expect(
          signals.find(
            (
              signal,
            ) =>
              signal.code ===
              "FORECAST_ACCURACY",
          )?.severity,
        ).toBe(
          "CRITICAL",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "requests Actuals when no observed periods exist",
      () => {
        const signals =
          buildExecutiveDecisionSignals({
            actualPeriods:
              0,

            revenueVarianceRate:
              null,

            ebitdaVarianceRate:
              null,

            forecastAccuracyScore:
              null,

            forecastBiasCount:
              0,

            liquidityRiskLevel:
              "LOW",

            downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
              null,

            requiredCapital:
              0,
          });


        expect(
          signals.some(
            (
              signal,
            ) =>
              signal.code ===
              "NO_ACTUALS",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

  "management action validation",
  () => {

      "validates priority and status",
      () => {
