const bullScenario =
  {
    id:
      "bull",

    name:
      "Bull Case",

    type:
      "BULL" as const,

    modifiers: {
      revenueGrowthMultiplier:
        "1.2",

      customerAcquisitionGrowthMultiplier:
        "1.2",

      arpuMultiplier:
        "1.05",

      cacMultiplier:
        "0.9",

      churnPercentagePointDelta:
        "-0.01",

      cogsPercentagePointDelta:
        "-0.02",
    },
  };

describe(
  "scenario engine",
  () => {
    it(
      "does not mutate persisted Base assumptions",
      () => {
        const original =
          createDirectAssumptions();

        const before =
          structuredClone(
            original,
          );

        applyScenarioToAssumptions(
          original,
          "DIRECT",
          bullScenario,
        );

        expect(
          original,
        ).toEqual(
          before,
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "adjusts direct revenue growth and COGS",
      () => {
        const result =
          applyScenarioToAssumptions(
            createDirectAssumptions(),
            "DIRECT",
            bullScenario,
          );

        expect(
          result.directRevenue
            .monthlyGrowthRate,
        ).toBe(
          "12",
        );

        expect(
          result.expenses.cogs
            .percentage,
        ).toBe(
          "8",
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "adjusts customer economics using relative and percentage-point semantics",
      () => {
        const result =
          applyScenarioToAssumptions(
            createCustomerAssumptions(),
            "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN",
            bullScenario,
          );

        expect(
          result.customerRevenue
            .arpu,
        ).toBe(
          "21",
        );

        expect(
          result.customerRevenue
            .cac,
        ).toBe(
          "90",
        );

        expect(
          result.customerRevenue
            .monthlyChurnRate,
        ).toBe(
          "9",
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "leaves Base Case assumptions unchanged",
      () => {
        const assumptions =
          createCustomerAssumptions();

        expect(
          applyScenarioToAssumptions(
            assumptions,
            "CUSTOMER_DRIVEN",
            {
              name:
                "Base Case",

              type:
                "BASE",

              modifiers:
                {},
            },

      },
    );

);

##### FILE: ./tests/forecast-accuracy/calculations.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  calculateAccuracyStatistics,
  classifyBias,
  classifyTrend,
  forecastObservation,
} from "@/lib/finance/forecast-accuracy/calculations";


describe(
  "forecast accuracy mathematics",
  () => {
    it(
      "calculates WAPE and accuracy",
      () => {
        const statistics =
          calculateAccuracyStatistics([
            forecastObservation(
              "2027-01",
              100,
              110,
            ),

            forecastObservation(
              "2027-02",
              200,
              180,
            ),
          ]);


        expect(
          statistics.absoluteError,
        ).toBe(
          30,
        );


        expect(
          statistics.wape,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.1,
        );


        expect(
          statistics.accuracyScore,
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.9,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "uses forecast minus actual as signed bias",
      () => {
        const statistics =
          calculateAccuracyStatistics([
            forecastObservation(
              "2027-01",
              100,
              120,
            ),

            forecastObservation(
              "2027-02",
              100,
              120,
            ),
          ]);


        expect(
          statistics.signedError,
        ).toBe(
          40,
        );


        expect(
          classifyBias(
            statistics,
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "OVER_FORECASTING",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "classifies persistent under-forecasting",
      () => {
        const statistics =
          calculateAccuracyStatistics([
            forecastObservation(
              "2027-01",
              100,
              80,
            ),

            forecastObservation(
              "2027-02",
              100,
              80,
            ),
          ]);


        expect(
          classifyBias(
            statistics,
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "UNDER_FORECASTING",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "detects improving forecast accuracy",
      () => {
        const observations = [
          forecastObservation(
            "2027-01",
            100,
            140,
          ),

          forecastObservation(
            "2027-02",
            100,
            140,
          ),

          forecastObservation(
            "2027-03",
            100,
            140,
          ),

          forecastObservation(
            "2027-04",
            100,
            105,
          ),

          forecastObservation(
            "2027-05",
            100,
            105,
          ),

          forecastObservation(
            "2027-06",
            100,
            105,
          ),
        ];


        expect(
          classifyTrend(
            observations,
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "IMPROVING",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/forecast-accuracy/report.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  calculateForecastAccuracyReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/forecast-accuracy/calculations";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";


function actual(
  month:
    number,
  revenue:
    number,
): ActualFinancialPeriod {
  return {
    period:
      `2027-${month
        .toString()
        .padStart(
          2,
          "0",
        )}`,

    revenue,

    cogs:
      30,

    operatingExpenses:
      50,

    ebitda:
      20,

    netIncome:
      15,

    cashFlow:
      10,

    cashBalance:
      1000,

    mrr:
      80,

    customers:
      10,
  };
}


function forecast(
  month:
    number,
  revenue:
    number,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  return {
    period:
      `2027-${month
        .toString()
        .padStart(
          2,
          "0",
        )}`,

    revenue,

    cogs:
      30,

    grossProfit:
      revenue -
      30,

    operatingExpenses:
      50,

    ebitda:
      20,

    netIncome:
      15,

    cashFlow:
      10,

    cashBalance:
      1000,

    mrr:
      80,

    customers:
      10,

    cac:
      null,

    churnRate:
      null,
  };
}


describe(
  "forecast accuracy report",
  () => {
    it(
      "builds 3/6/12-month windows",
      () => {
        const actuals =
          Array.from(
            {
              length:
                12,
            },
            (
              _,
              index,
            ) =>
              actual(
                index +
                  1,
                100,
              ),
          );


        const forecasts =
          Array.from(
            {
              length:
                12,
            },
            (
              _,
              index,
            ) =>
              forecast(
                index +
                  1,
                110,
              ),
          );


        const report =
          calculateForecastAccuracyReport(
            actuals,
            forecasts,
          );


        const revenue =
          report.metrics.find(
            (
              metric,
            ) =>
              metric.metric ===
              "revenue",
          );


        expect(
          revenue?.rolling3
            .observations,
        ).toBe(
          3,
        );


        expect(
          revenue?.rolling6
            .observations,
        ).toBe(
          6,
        );


        expect(
          revenue?.rolling12
            .observations,
        ).toBe(
          12,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "creates management flags for high forecast error",
      () => {
        const actuals = [
          actual(
            1,
            100,
          ),

          actual(
            2,
            100,
          ),

          actual(
            3,
            100,
          ),
        ];


        const forecasts = [
          forecast(
            1,
            150,
          ),

          forecast(
            2,
            150,
          ),

          forecast(
            3,
            150,
          ),
        ];


        const report =
          calculateForecastAccuracyReport(
            actuals,
            forecasts,
          );


        expect(
          report.flags.some(
            (
              flag,
            ) =>
              flag.metric ===
                "revenue" &&
              flag.code ===
                "HIGH_FORECAST_ERROR",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          report.flags.some(
            (
              flag,
            ) =>
              flag.metric ===
                "revenue" &&
              flag.code ===
                "PERSISTENT_OVER_FORECAST",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "preserves latest actual period",
      () => {
        const report =
          calculateForecastAccuracyReport(
            [
              actual(
                1,
                100,
              ),

              actual(
                2,
                100,
              ),
            ],
            [
              forecast(
                1,
                100,
              ),

              forecast(
                2,
                100,
              ),
            ],
          );


        expect(
          report.latestPeriod,
        ).toBe(
          "2027-02",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/observability/diagnostics-auth.test.ts #####
import {
  afterEach,
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  diagnosticsEnabled,
  isDiagnosticsAuthorized,
} from "@/lib/observability/diagnostics";


const ORIGINAL =
  process.env
    .VENTURESCOPE_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN;


afterEach(
  () => {
    if (
      ORIGINAL ===
      undefined
    ) {
      delete process.env
        .VENTURESCOPE_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN;
    }
    else {
      process.env.VENTURESCOPE_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN =
        ORIGINAL;
    }
  },
);


describe(
  "diagnostics authorization",
  () => {
    it(
      "stays disabled without a sufficiently strong token",
      () => {
        delete process.env
          .VENTURESCOPE_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN;


        expect(
          diagnosticsEnabled(),
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "requires the exact bearer token",
      () => {
        process.env.VENTURESCOPE_DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN =
          "1234567890123456789012345678901234567890";


        expect(
          diagnosticsEnabled(),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          isDiagnosticsAuthorized(
            new Headers({
              Authorization:
                "Bearer wrong-token-value-that-is-long-enough-1234",
            }),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );


        expect(
          isDiagnosticsAuthorized(
            new Headers({
              Authorization:
                "Bearer 1234567890123456789012345678901234567890",
            }),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

import {
  readFileSync,
} from "node:fs";

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";


const source =
  readFileSync(
    "proxy.ts",
    "utf8",
  );


describe(
  "proxy correlation boundary",
  () => {
    it(
      "establishes one authoritative correlation identifier at ingress",
      () => {
        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          "normalizeRequestId",
        );

        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          "createRequestId",
        );

        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          "const correlationId =",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "binds the existing security request identifier to the correlation identifier",
      () => {
        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          `const requestId =
    correlationId;`,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "forwards the authoritative identifier to Route Handlers",
      () => {
        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          "forwardedRequestHeaders",
        );

        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          `"x-request-id",
    correlationId`,
        );

        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          "NextResponse.next({",
        );

        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          "request: {",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "returns the authoritative identifier to the client",
      () => {
        expect(
          source,
        ).toContain(
          `"X-Request-Id",
        correlationId`,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "does not redeclare requestId at ingress",
      () => {
        const declarations =
          source.match(
            /const requestId\s*=/g,
          ) ??
          [];


        expect(
          declarations,
        ).toHaveLength(
          1,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

  "request correlation identifiers",
  () => {
    it(
      "preserves safe inbound request identifiers",
      () => {
        expect(
          normalizeRequestId(
            "request-12345678",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "request-12345678",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects malformed inbound identifiers",
      () => {
        expect(
          normalizeRequestId(
            "../../bad request",
          ),
        ).toBeNull();

        expect(
          normalizeRequestId(
            "tiny",
          ),
        ).toBeNull();
      },
    );


    it(
      "generates an identifier when none is supplied",
      () => {
        const requestId =
          resolveRequestId(
            new Headers(),
          );


        expect(
          requestId.length,
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
          8,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

    "utf8",
  );

  "production deployment safety contract",
  () => {

      "requires explicit production deployment confirmation",
      () => {
        expect(
          deploy,
        ).toContain(
          'VENTURESCOPE_DEPLOY_CONFIRM:-NO',
        );

          deploy,
        ).toContain(
          '!= "YES"',
        );
      },
    );

        );

        );

} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/register";


describe(
  "financial-period register",
  () => {
    it(
      "treats periods without state records as OPEN",
      () => {
        const register =
          buildFinancialPeriodRegister({
            actuals: [
              {
                periodKey:
                  "2027-01",

                revenue:
                  100,

                ebitda:
                  20,

                cashBalance:
                  500,
              },
            ],

            states:
              [],
          });


        expect(
          register.rows[
            0
          ].status,
        ).toBe(
          "OPEN",
        );


        expect(
          register.summary
            .openPeriods,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "reflects CLOSED state and close cycles",
      () => {
        const register =
          buildFinancialPeriodRegister({
            actuals: [
              {
                periodKey:
                  "2027-01",

                revenue:
                  100,

                ebitda:
                  20,

                cashBalance:
                  500,
              },

              {
                periodKey:
                  "2027-02",

                revenue:
                  110,

                ebitda:
                  25,

                cashBalance:
                  550,
              },
            ],

            states: [
              {
                id:
                  "state-1",

                periodKey:
                  "2027-01",

                status:
                  "CLOSED",

                closeSequence:
                  2,

                closedAt:
                  "2027-02-10T00:00:00.000Z",

                closedByUserId:
                  "user-1",

                reopenedAt:
                  null,

                reopenedByUserId:
                  null,
              },
            ],
          });


        expect(
          register.summary
            .closedPeriods,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          register.summary
            .openPeriods,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          register.summary
            .closeCycles,
        ).toBe(
          2,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "sorts periods newest first",
      () => {
        const register =
          buildFinancialPeriodRegister({
            actuals: [
              {
                periodKey:
                  "2027-01",

                revenue:
                  null,

                ebitda:
                  null,

                cashBalance:
                  null,
              },

              {
                periodKey:
                  "2027-03",

                revenue:
                  null,

                ebitda:
                  null,

                cashBalance:
                  null,
              },
            ],

            states:
              [],
          });


        expect(
          register.rows.map(
            (
              row,
            ) =>
              row.periodKey,
          ),
        ).toEqual([
          "2027-03",
          "2027-01",
        ]);
      },
    );
  },

##### FILE: ./tests/period-close/validation.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  financialPeriodDate,
  financialPeriodKeyFromDate,
  parseFinancialPeriodEventAction,
  parseFinancialPeriodKey,
  parseFinancialPeriodStatus,
  validateCloseConfirmation,
  validateReopenConfirmation,
} from "@/lib/finance/period-close/validation";


describe(
  "financial-period validation",
  () => {
    it(
      "normalizes month keys",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseFinancialPeriodKey(
            "Jan 2027",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "2027-01",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "uses UTC first-of-month dates",
      () => {
        expect(
          financialPeriodDate(
            "2027-03",
          ).toISOString(),
        ).toBe(
          "2027-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        );


        expect(
          financialPeriodKeyFromDate(
            new Date(
              "2027-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
            ),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "2027-03",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "requires exact CLOSE confirmation",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            validateCloseConfirmation({
              periodKey:
                "2027-03",

              confirmation:
                "CLOSE 2027-03",
            }),
        ).not.toThrow();


        expect(
          () =>
            validateCloseConfirmation({
              periodKey:
                "2027-03",

              confirmation:
                "close 2027-03",
            }),
        ).toThrow(
          /exactly match/i,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "requires exact REOPEN confirmation",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            validateReopenConfirmation({
              periodKey:
                "2027-03",

              confirmation:
                "REOPEN 2027-03",
            }),
        ).not.toThrow();
      },
    );


    it(
      "validates persisted status and event actions",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseFinancialPeriodStatus(
            "CLOSED",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "CLOSED",
        );


        expect(
          parseFinancialPeriodEventAction(
            "REOPENED",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "REOPENED",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/planning-cycle/calculations.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  buildRollingReforecast,
  calculatePlanningCycleReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-cycle/calculations";

import type {
  ActualFinancialPeriod,
} from "@/lib/finance/actuals/types";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";


function forecast(
  period:
    string,
  revenue:
    number,
): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  return {
    period,

    revenue,

    cogs:
      30,

    grossProfit:
      revenue -
      30,

    operatingExpenses:
      50,

    ebitda:
      20,

    netIncome:
      15,

    cashFlow:
      10,

    cashBalance:
      1000,

    mrr:
      80,

    customers:
      10,

    cac:
      null,

    churnRate:
      null,
  };
}


function actual(
  period:
    string,
  revenue:
    number,
): ActualFinancialPeriod {
  return {
    period,

    revenue,

    cogs:
      28,

    operatingExpenses:
      48,

    ebitda:
      24,

    netIncome:
      18,

    cashFlow:
      12,

    cashBalance:
      1050,

    mrr:
      82,

    customers:
      11,
  };
}


describe(
  "rolling reforecast",
  () => {
    it(
      "uses Actuals when the month has observed performance",
      () => {
        const rows =
          buildRollingReforecast(
            [
              actual(
                "2027-01",
                120,
              ),
            ],
            [
              forecast(
                "2027-01",
                100,
              ),

              forecast(
                "2027-02",
                110,
              ),
            ],
          );


        expect(
          rows[
            0
          ].source,
        ).toBe(
          "ACTUAL",
        );


        expect(
          rows[
            0
          ].revenue,
        ).toBe(
          120,
        );


        expect(
          rows[
            1
          ].source,
        ).toBe(
          "FORECAST",
        );


        expect(
          rows[
            1
          ].revenue,
        ).toBe(
          110,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "does not mutate future forecast periods",
      () => {
        const current = [
          forecast(
            "2027-01",
            100,
          ),

          forecast(
            "2027-02",
            110,
          ),
        ];


        const original =
          JSON.stringify(
            current,
          );


        buildRollingReforecast(
          [
            actual(
              "2027-01",
              120,
            ),
          ],
          current,
        );


        expect(
          JSON.stringify(
            current,
          ),
        ).toBe(
          original,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "compares baseline, current forecast and rolling reforecast",
      () => {
        const report =
          calculatePlanningCycleReport(
            [
              forecast(
                "2027-01",
                100,
              ),

              forecast(
                "2027-02",
                100,
              ),
            ],
            [
              forecast(
                "2027-01",
                110,
              ),

              forecast(
                "2027-02",
                120,
              ),
            ],
            [
              actual(
                "2027-01",
                130,
              ),
            ],
          );


        expect(
          report.metrics
            .revenue
            .baseline,
        ).toBe(
          200,
        );


        expect(
          report.metrics
            .revenue
            .currentForecast,
        ).toBe(
          230,
        );


        expect(
          report.metrics
            .revenue
            .rollingReforecast,
        ).toBe(
          250,
        );


        expect(
          report.actualPeriodsUsed,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          report.forecastPeriodsUsed,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "uses the final cash balance rather than summing cash balances",
      () => {
        const report =
          calculatePlanningCycleReport(
            [
              {
                ...forecast(
                  "2027-01",
                  100,
                ),

                cashBalance:
                  900,
              },

              {
                ...forecast(
                  "2027-02",
                  100,
                ),

                cashBalance:
                  1000,
              },
            ],
            [
              {
                ...forecast(
                  "2027-01",
                  100,
                ),

                cashBalance:
                  950,
              },

              {
                ...forecast(
                  "2027-02",
                  100,
                ),

                cashBalance:
                  1100,
              },
            ],
            [],
          );


        expect(
          report.metrics
            .cashBalance
            .baseline,
        ).toBe(
          1000,
        );


        expect(
          report.metrics
            .cashBalance
            .currentForecast,
        ).toBe(
          1100,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/catalog";

import {
  buildPlanningTemplateBrief,
  comparePlanningTemplates,
} from "@/lib/finance/planning-templates/comparison";


function template(
  id:
    string,
) {
  const result =
    planningTemplateById(
      id,
    );


  if (
    !result
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `Template ${id} missing.`,
    );
  }


  return result;
}


describe(
  "planning template comparison",
  () => {
    it(
      "creates union of assumption keys",
      () => {
        const rows =
          comparePlanningTemplates(
            template(
              "b2b-saas",
            ),
            template(
              "ecommerce",
            ),
          );


        expect(
          rows.length,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          5,
        );


        expect(
          rows.some(
            (
              row,
            ) =>
              row.key ===
              "monthly_arpu",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          rows.some(
            (
              row,
            ) =>
              row.key ===
              "average_order_value",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "builds management planning brief",
      () => {
        const brief =
          buildPlanningTemplateBrief(
            template(
              "b2b-saas",
            ),
          );


        expect(
          brief.title,
        ).toContain(
          "B2B SaaS",
        );


        expect(
          brief.revenueFocus.length,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          20,
        );


        expect(
          brief.kpiFocus,
        ).toContain(
          "MRR",
        );
      },
    );
  },

        expect(

        ).toBe(
          "local-retail",

      () => {
        const ranked =
          rankPlanningTemplates(
            "Online e-commerce store",
          );


        expect(
          ranked[
            0
          ].template.id,
        ).toBe(
          "ecommerce",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "keeps unknown industries exploratory",

          planningTemplateById(
            "b2b-saas",

          !template

          throw new Error(
            "Template missing.",
          );

        const match =
          scorePlanningTemplate({
            industry:
              "deep sea mineral logistics",

            template,

        expect(
          match.fit,
        ).toBe(
          "EXPLORATORY",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "produces deterministic rankings",
      () => {
        expect(
          rankPlanningTemplates(
            "consulting agency",
          ).map(
            (
              item,
            ) => [
              item.template.id,
              item.score,
            ],
          ),
        ).toEqual(
          rankPlanningTemplates(
            "consulting agency",
          ).map(
            (
              item,
            ) => [
              item.template.id,

          ),

function snapshot({

    "LOW",
  riskScore =
    10,
  capitalNeed =
    0,
  criticalOpen =
    0,
  accuracy =
    0.95,
}: {
  risk?:
    "LOW" |
    "MODERATE" |
    "HIGH" |
    "CRITICAL";

  riskScore?:
    number;

  capitalNeed?:
    number;

  criticalOpen?:
    number;

  accuracy?:
    number |
    null;

    schemaVersion:
      1,

    capturedAt:
      "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",

    kpis: {
      actualPeriods:
        1,

      matchedPeriods:
        1,

      revenueVarianceRate:
        0,

      ebitdaVarianceRate:
        0,

      forecastAccuracyScore:
        accuracy,

      forecastWape:
        accuracy ===
          null
          ?
            null
          :
            1 -
            accuracy,

      liquidityRiskLevel:
        risk,

      liquidityRiskScore:
        riskScore,

      minimumForecastCash:
        100,

      minimumDownsideCash:
        50,

      downsideCashExhaustionPeriod:
        null,

      capitalNeed,
    },

    actions: {
      open:
        criticalOpen,

      criticalOpen,

      overdue:
        0,

      done:
        0,
    },

    signals:
      [],
  };
}


function analytics({
  snapshotValue =
    snapshot(),
  forecastAvailable =
    true,
  closeStatus =
    "CLOSED",
  offTrack =
    0,
}: {
  snapshotValue?:
    ExecutiveReviewSnapshot |
    null;

  forecastAvailable?:
    boolean;

  closeStatus?:
    "OPEN" |
    "CLOSED" |
    "NO_ACTUALS";

  offTrack?:
    number;
} = {}): PortfolioProjectAnalytics {
  return {
    project: {
      id:
        "project-1",

      name:
        "Project",

      industry:
        "Software",

      currency:
        "EUR",

      role:
        "OWNER",

      isCurrentProject:
        true,

      actuals:
        [],

      riskPolicy: {
        minimumCash:
          100,

        minimumRunwayMonths:
          6,

        minimumEbitdaMargin:
          null,

        maximumMonthlyBurn:
          null,

        downsideRevenueShock:
          0.20,

        downsideCostInflation:
          0.10,
      },

      latestActualPeriod:
        "2027-01",

      latestActualCash:
        1000,

      latestPeriodCloseStatus:
        closeStatus,

      targets:
        [],

      actions:
        [],
    },

    forecastAvailable,

    liveSnapshot:
      snapshotValue,

    scorecardSummary: {
      total:
        offTrack,

      onTrack:
        0,

      atRisk:
        0,

      offTrack,

      unavailable:
        0,

      trackedPeriods:
        offTrack >
          0
          ?
            1
          :
            0,
    },
  };
}


describe(
  "portfolio attention score",
  () => {
    it(
      "keeps stable low-risk projects low",
      () => {
        expect(
          portfolioAttentionScore(
            analytics(),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "raises attention for critical liquidity",
      () => {
        expect(
          portfolioAttentionScore(
            analytics({
              snapshotValue:
                snapshot({
                  risk:
                    "CRITICAL",

                  riskScore:
                    95,
                }),
            }),
          ),
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
          45,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "adds capital need and critical-action attention",
      () => {
        const score =
          portfolioAttentionScore(
            analytics({
              snapshotValue:
                snapshot({
                  capitalNeed:
                    500000,

                  criticalOpen:
                    2,
                }),
            }),
          );


        expect(
          score,
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
          40,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "adds attention when reporting period remains open",
      () => {
        expect(
          portfolioAttentionScore(
            analytics({
              closeStatus:
                "OPEN",
            }),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          5,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "adds data-readiness attention when forecast is unavailable",
      () => {
        const result =
          analytics({
            snapshotValue:
              null,

            forecastAvailable:
              false,
          });


        expect(
          portfolioAttentionScore(
            result,
          ),
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
          10,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "caps attention score at 100",
      () => {
        expect(
          portfolioAttentionScore(
            analytics({
              snapshotValue:
                snapshot({
                  risk:
                    "CRITICAL",

                  capitalNeed:
                    1_000_000,

                  criticalOpen:
                    10,

                  accuracy:
                    0.40,
                }),

              closeStatus:
                "OPEN",

              offTrack:
                10,
            }),
          ),
        ).toBe(
          100,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

describe(
  "portfolio currency isolation",
  () => {
    it(
      "keeps EUR and USD financial amounts separate",
      () => {
        const dashboard =
          buildPortfolioExecutiveDashboard([
            input({
              id:
                "eur",

              currency:
                "EUR",

              cash:
                1000,

              capitalNeed:
                500,
            }),

            input({
              id:
                "usd",

              currency:
                "USD",

              cash:
                2000,

              capitalNeed:
                700,
            }),
          ]);


        expect(
          dashboard.currencies,
        ).toHaveLength(
          2,
        );


        expect(
          dashboard.currencies.find(
            (
              item,
            ) =>
              item.currency ===
              "EUR",
          ),
        ).toMatchObject({
          latestActualCash:
            1000,

          capitalNeed:
            500,
        });


        expect(
          dashboard.currencies.find(
            (
              item,
            ) =>
              item.currency ===
              "USD",
          ),
        ).toMatchObject({
          latestActualCash:
            2000,

          capitalNeed:
            700,
        });
      },
    );


    it(
      "does not create a portfolio-wide money total",
      () => {
        const dashboard =
          buildPortfolioExecutiveDashboard([
            input({
              id:
                "eur",

              currency:
                "EUR",

              cash:
                1000,

              capitalNeed:
                500,
            }),

            input({
              id:
                "usd",

              currency:
                "USD",

              cash:
                2000,

              capitalNeed:
                700,
            }),
          ]);


        expect(
          dashboard.summary,
        ).not.toHaveProperty(
          "totalCash",
        );


        expect(
          dashboard.summary,
        ).not.toHaveProperty(
          "totalCapitalNeed",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/product-readiness/migration-source.test.ts #####
import {
  existsSync,
  readdirSync,
} from "node:fs";

import {
  join,
} from "node:path";

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";


function migrationCount():
  number {
  const root =
    "prisma/migrations";


  return readdirSync(
    root,
    {
      withFileTypes:
        true,
    },
  ).filter(
    (
      entry,
    ) =>
      entry.isDirectory() &&
      existsSync(
        join(
          root,
          entry.name,
          "migration.sql",
        ),
      ),
  ).length;
}


describe(
  "final migration authority",
  () => {
    it(
      "locks the roadmap migration count at seventeen",
      () => {
        expect(
          migrationCount(),
        ).toBe(
          17,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/risk-center/calculations.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  buildDownsideCashScenario,
  calculateLiquidityRiskReport,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/calculations";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";


const policy:
  ProjectRiskPolicy = {
    minimumCash:
      200,

    minimumRunwayMonths:
      6,

    minimumEbitdaMargin:
      0.10,

    maximumMonthlyBurn:
      100,

    downsideRevenueShock:
      0.20,

    downsideCostInflation:
      0.10,
  };


function row({
  month,
  revenue =
    1000,
  cogs =
    300,
  operatingExpenses =
    500,
  ebitda =
    200,
  cashFlow =
    100,
  cashBalance =
    1000,
}: {
  month:
    number;

  revenue?:
    number;

  cogs?:
    number;

  operatingExpenses?:
    number;

  ebitda?:
    number;

  cashFlow?:
    number;

  cashBalance?:
    number;
}): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  return {
    period:
      `2027-${month
        .toString()
        .padStart(
          2,
          "0",
        )}`,

    revenue,

    cogs,

    grossProfit:
      revenue -
      cogs,

    operatingExpenses,

    ebitda,

    netIncome:
      ebitda,

    cashFlow,

    cashBalance,

    mrr:
      500,

    customers:
      50,

    cac:
      null,

    churnRate:
      null,
  };
}


describe(
  "Liquidity risk calculations",
  () => {
    it(
      "reports low risk for healthy cash generation",
      () => {
        const report =
          calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
            rows: [
              row({
                month:
                  1,

                cashBalance:
                  1000,
              }),

              row({
                month:
                  2,

                cashBalance:
                  1100,
              }),

              row({
                month:
                  3,

                cashBalance:
                  1200,
              }),
            ],

            policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              null,
          });


        expect(
          report.level,
        ).toBe(
          "LOW",
        );


        expect(
          report.firstCashExhaustionPeriod,
        ).toBeNull();
      },
    );


    it(
      "detects cash-floor and exhaustion breaches",
      () => {
        const report =
          calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
            rows: [
              row({
                month:
                  1,

                cashFlow:
                  -150,

                cashBalance:
                  250,
              }),

              row({
                month:
                  2,

                cashFlow:
                  -150,

                cashBalance:
                  100,
              }),

              row({
                month:
                  3,

                cashFlow:
                  -150,

                cashBalance:
                  -50,
              }),
            ],

            policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              400,
          });


        expect(
          report.firstMinimumCashBreachPeriod,
        ).toBe(
          "2027-02",
        );


        expect(
          report.firstCashExhaustionPeriod,
        ).toBe(
          "2027-03",
        );


        expect(
          report.score,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "detects EBITDA-margin guardrail breaches",
      () => {
        const report =
          calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
            rows: [
              row({
                month:
                  1,

                revenue:
                  1000,

                ebitda:
                  50,
              }),
            ],

            policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              null,
          });


        expect(
          report.guardrails.find(
            (
              guardrail,
            ) =>
              guardrail.code ===
              "EBITDA_MARGIN",
          )?.state,
        ).toBe(
          "BREACH",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "applies revenue and cost stress to cash flow",
      () => {
        const downside =
          buildDownsideCashScenario(
            [
              row({
                month:
                  1,

                revenue:
                  1000,

                cogs:
                  300,

                operatingExpenses:
                  500,

                cashFlow:
                  100,

                cashBalance:
                  1000,
              }),
            ],
            policy,
            null,
            1000,
          );


        /*
         * 100 baseline cash flow
         * - 200 revenue shock
         * - 80 extra cost
         * = -180 stressed flow
         */
        expect(
          downside[
            0
          ].stressedCashFlow,
        ).toBe(
          -180,
        );


        expect(
          downside[
            0
          ].stressedCashBalance,
        ).toBe(
          820,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "uses only forecast months after the latest actual month when available",
      () => {
        const report =
          calculateLiquidityRiskReport({
            rows: [
              row({
                month:
                  1,
              }),

              row({
                month:
                  2,
              }),

              row({
                month:
                  3,
              }),
            ],

            policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              "2027-01",

            latestActualCash:
              900,
          });


        expect(
          report.forecastPeriods,
        ).toBe(
          2,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  parseProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/policy";


describe(
  "Project risk policy",
  () => {
    it(
      "normalizes percentage inputs",
      () => {
        const policy =
          parseProjectRiskPolicy({
            minimumCash:
              "50000",

            minimumRunwayMonths:
              "9",

            minimumEbitdaMarginPercent:
              "10",

            maximumMonthlyBurn:
              "25000",

            downsideRevenueShockPercent:
              "20",

            downsideCostInflationPercent:
              "12",
          });


        expect(
          policy.minimumCash,
        ).toBe(
          50000,
        );


        expect(
          policy.minimumRunwayMonths,
        ).toBe(
          9,
        );


        expect(
          policy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
        ).toBe(
          0.10,
        );


        expect(
          policy.downsideRevenueShock,
        ).toBe(
          0.20,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "allows optional financial guardrails",
      () => {
        const policy =
          parseProjectRiskPolicy({
            minimumCash:
              "",

            minimumRunwayMonths:
              "6",

            minimumEbitdaMarginPercent:
              "",

            maximumMonthlyBurn:
              "",

            downsideRevenueShockPercent:
              "20",

            downsideCostInflationPercent:
              "10",
          });


        expect(
          policy.minimumCash,
        ).toBeNull();


        expect(
          policy.minimumEbitdaMargin,
        ).toBeNull();


        expect(
          policy.maximumMonthlyBurn,
        ).toBeNull();
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects invalid runway values",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            parseProjectRiskPolicy({
              minimumCash:
                "0",

              minimumRunwayMonths:
                "0",

              minimumEbitdaMarginPercent:
                "",

              maximumMonthlyBurn:
                "",

              downsideRevenueShockPercent:
                "20",

              downsideCostInflationPercent:
                "10",
            }),
        ).toThrow(
          /runway/i,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects excessive downside shocks",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            parseProjectRiskPolicy({
              minimumCash:
                "0",

              minimumRunwayMonths:
                "6",

              minimumEbitdaMarginPercent:
                "",

              maximumMonthlyBurn:
                "",

              downsideRevenueShockPercent:
                "95",

              downsideCostInflationPercent:
                "10",
            }),
        ).toThrow(
          /revenue downside/i,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/scenario-comparison/divergence.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  compareScenarios,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-comparison/comparison";

import type {
  ScenarioComparisonView,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-comparison/types";


function view(
  id:
    string,
  snapshot:
    ScenarioComparisonView[
      "snapshot"
    ],
): ScenarioComparisonView {
  return {
    id,

    name:
      id,

    isBase:
      id ===
      "base",

    snapshot,
  };
}


describe(
  "scenario divergence",
  () => {
    it(
      "classifies identical scenarios",
      () => {
        expect(
          compareScenarios(
            view(
              "base",
              {
                a:
                  1,
              },
            ),
            view(
              "same",
              {
                a:
                  1,
              },
            ),
          ).summary.divergence,
        ).toBe(
          "IDENTICAL",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "classifies low divergence",
      () => {
        expect(
          compareScenarios(
            view(
              "base",
              {
                a:
                  1,

                b:
                  2,
              },
            ),
            view(
              "other",
              {
                a:
                  2,

                b:
                  2,
              },
            ),
          ).summary.divergence,
        ).toBe(
          "LOW",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "classifies high divergence for many driver changes",
      () => {
        const before = {
          a:
            1,

          b:
            1,

          c:
            1,

          d:
            1,

          e:
            1,

          f:
            1,
        };


        const after = {
          a:
            2,

          b:
            2,

          c:
            2,

          d:
            2,

          e:
            2,

          f:
            2,
        };


        expect(
          compareScenarios(
            view(
              "base",
              before,
            ),
            view(
              "other",
              after,
            ),
          ).summary.divergence,
        ).toBe(
          "HIGH",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  extractScenarioCollection,
  normalizeScenarioCollection,
} from "@/lib/projects/scenario-comparison/normalize";


describe(
  "scenario normalization",
  () => {
    it(
      "extracts preferred scenarios collection",
      () => {
        const scenarios = [
          {
            id:
              "base",

            name:
              "Base",
          },
        ];


        expect(
          extractScenarioCollection({
            scenarios,
          }),
        ).toBe(
          scenarios,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "normalizes scenario metadata and drivers",
      () => {
        const result =
          normalizeScenarioCollection({
            scenarios: [
              {
                id:
                  "base",

                projectId:
                  "project-1",

                name:
                  "Base",

                isBase:
                  true,

                growth:
                  0.10,

                nested: {
                  churn:
                    0.03,
                },
              },
            ],
          });


        expect(
          result,
        ).toHaveLength(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          result[
            0
          ].id,
        ).toBe(
          "base",
        );


        expect(
          result[
            0
          ].name,
        ).toBe(
          "Base",
        );


        expect(
          result[
            0
          ].isBase,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          result[
            0
          ].snapshot,
        ).toEqual({
          growth:
            0.10,

          nested: {
            churn:
              0.03,
          },
        });
      },
    );


    it(
      "supports Decimal-like values",
      () => {
        const result =
          normalizeScenarioCollection([
            {
              id:
                "bull",

              name:
                "Bull",

              growth: {
                toNumber: () =>
                  0.25,
              },
            },
          ]);


        expect(
          result[
            0
          ].snapshot,
        ).toEqual({
          growth:
            0.25,
        });
      },
    );


    it(
      "uses the first scenario as Base fallback",
      () => {
        const result =
          normalizeScenarioCollection([
            {
              id:
                "a",

              name:
                "Scenario A",

              growth:
                0.1,
            },

            {
              id:
                "b",

              name:
                "Scenario B",

              growth:
                0.2,
            },
          ]);


        expect(
          result[
            0
          ].isBase,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );


        expect(
          result[
            1
          ].isBase,
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

const policy:
  ProjectRiskPolicy = {
    minimumCash:
      100,

    minimumRunwayMonths:
      6,

    minimumEbitdaMargin:
      null,

    maximumMonthlyBurn:
      null,

    downsideRevenueShock:
      0.20,

    downsideCostInflation:
      0.10,
  };


function target(
  metricCode:
    KpiMetricCode,
  targetValue:
    number,
  periodKey =
    "2027-01",
): KpiTargetView {
  return {
    id:
      `${periodKey}-${metricCode}`,

    periodKey,

    metricCode,

    targetValue,

    ownerName:
      null,

    note:
      null,

    createdAt:
      "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",

    updatedAt:
      "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",

    createdBy:
      null,
  };
}


const forecast:
  ForecastAnalyticsRow = {
    period:
      "2027-01",

    revenue:
      1000,

    cogs:
      300,

    grossProfit:
      700,

    operatingExpenses:
      500,

    ebitda:
      200,

    netIncome:
      150,

    cashFlow:
      100,

    cashBalance:
      1000,

    mrr:
      500,

    churnRate:
      null,

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  parseKpiMetricCode,
  parseKpiTargetPeriod,
  parseKpiTargetValue,
  targetValueForInput,
} from "@/lib/finance/scorecard/metrics";


describe(
  "KPI target metrics",
  () => {
    it(
      "validates KPI codes",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseKpiMetricCode(
            "REVENUE",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "REVENUE",
        );


        expect(
          () =>
            parseKpiMetricCode(
              "INVALID",
            ),
        ).toThrow(
          /KPI metric/i,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "normalizes percentage targets",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseKpiTargetValue(
            "EBITDA_MARGIN",
            "20",
          ),
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.20,
        );


        expect(
          parseKpiTargetValue(
            "FORECAST_ACCURACY",
            "92",
          ),
        ).toBeCloseTo(
          0.92,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "converts percentage targets back to form values",
      () => {
        expect(
          targetValueForInput({
            metric:
              "FORECAST_ACCURACY",

            value:
              0.90,
          }),
        ).toBe(
          90,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "validates whole-number customer targets",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseKpiTargetValue(
            "CUSTOMERS",
            "250",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          250,
        );


        expect(
          () =>
            parseKpiTargetValue(
              "CUSTOMERS",
              "10.5",
            ),
        ).toThrow(
          /whole number/i,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "normalizes target periods",
      () => {
        expect(
          parseKpiTargetPeriod(
            "Jan 2027",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          "2027-01",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

      "rejects missing database configuration",

        expect(
          () =>
            parseServerEnvironment({
              NODE_ENV:
                "production",

              AUTH_SECRET:
                "12345678901234567890123456789012",
            }),
        ).toThrow(
          /DATABASE_URL/,
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "rejects a short authentication secret",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            parseServerEnvironment({
              NODE_ENV:
                "production",

              DATABASE_URL:
                "postgresql://user:password@database:5432/venturescope",

              AUTH_SECRET:
                "too-short",
            }),
        ).toThrow(
          /AUTH_SECRET/,
        );
      },
    );

        expect(

            parseServerEnvironment({
              NODE_ENV:
                "production",

              DATABASE_URL:
                "mysql://user:password@database/db",

                "12345678901234567890123456789012",

##### FILE: ./tests/security/rate-limit.test.ts #####
import {
  beforeEach,
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  checkRateLimit,
  resetRateLimitStoreForTests,
} from "@/lib/security/rate-limit";

describe(
  "process-local abuse rate limiter",
  () => {
    beforeEach(
      () => {
        resetRateLimitStoreForTests();
      },
    );

    it(
      "allows requests inside the configured limit",
      () => {
        const first =
          checkRateLimit({
            key:
              "client-a",

            limit:
              2,

            windowMs:
              1000,

            now:
              100,
          });

        const second =
          checkRateLimit({
            key:
              "client-a",

            limit:
              2,

            windowMs:
              1000,

            now:
              200,
          });

        expect(
          first.allowed,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );

        expect(
          second.allowed,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );

        expect(
          second.remaining,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "blocks requests after the limit",
      () => {
        checkRateLimit({
          key:
            "client-a",

          limit:
            1,

          windowMs:
            1000,

          now:
            100,
        });

        const blocked =
          checkRateLimit({
            key:
              "client-a",

            limit:
              1,

            windowMs:
              1000,

            now:
              200,
          });

        expect(
          blocked.allowed,
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );

        expect(
          blocked.retryAfterSeconds,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          0,
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "opens a new bucket after expiration",
      () => {
        checkRateLimit({
          key:
            "client-a",

          limit:
            1,

          windowMs:
            1000,

          now:
            100,
        });

        const reset =
          checkRateLimit({
            key:
              "client-a",

            limit:
              1,

            windowMs:
              1000,

            now:
              1101,
          });

        expect(
          reset.allowed,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );

        expect(
          reset.remaining,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "isolates independent rate-limit identities",
      () => {
        checkRateLimit({
          key:
            "client-a",

          limit:
            1,

          windowMs:
            1000,

          now:
            100,
        });

        const other =
          checkRateLimit({
            key:
              "client-b",

            limit:
              1,

            windowMs:
              1000,

            now:
              200,
          });

        expect(
          other.allowed,
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/security/security-headers.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  buildContentSecurityPolicy,
  buildSecurityHeaders,
} from "@/lib/security/headers";

describe(
  "production security headers",
  () => {
    it(
      "prevents framing and object embedding",
      () => {
        const policy =
          buildContentSecurityPolicy(
            true,
          );

        expect(
          policy,
        ).toContain(
          "frame-ancestors 'none'",
        );

        expect(
          policy,
        ).toContain(
          "object-src 'none'",
        );

        expect(
          policy,
        ).toContain(
          "form-action 'self'",
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "does not allow eval in production scripts",
      () => {
        const policy =
          buildContentSecurityPolicy(
            true,
          );

        expect(
          policy,
        ).not.toContain(
          "'unsafe-eval'",
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "allows dev tooling only outside production",
      () => {
        expect(
          buildContentSecurityPolicy(
            false,
          ),
        ).toContain(
          "'unsafe-eval'",
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "includes HSTS only in production",
      () => {
        const production =
          buildSecurityHeaders(
            true,
          );

        const development =
          buildSecurityHeaders(
            false,
          );

        expect(
          production.some(
            (
              header,
            ) =>
              header.key ===
              "Strict-Transport-Security",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          true,
        );

        expect(
          development.some(
            (
              header,
            ) =>
              header.key ===
              "Strict-Transport-Security",
          ),
        ).toBe(
          false,
        );
      },
    );

    it(
      "disables browser features VentureScope does not need",
      () => {
        const permissions =
          buildSecurityHeaders(
            true,
          ).find(
            (
              header,
            ) =>
              header.key ===
              "Permissions-Policy",
          );

        expect(
          permissions
            ?.value,
        ).toContain(
          "camera=()",
        );

        expect(
          permissions
            ?.value,
        ).toContain(
          "microphone=()",
        );

        expect(
          permissions
            ?.value,
        ).toContain(
          "geolocation=()",
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

##### FILE: ./tests/sensitivity-lab/cell.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  calculateSensitivityCell,
} from "@/lib/finance/sensitivity-lab/calculations";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";


const basePolicy:
  ProjectRiskPolicy = {
    minimumCash:
      100,

    minimumRunwayMonths:
      6,

    minimumEbitdaMargin:
      null,

    maximumMonthlyBurn:
      null,

    downsideRevenueShock:
      0.20,

    downsideCostInflation:
      0.10,
  };


function row({
  month,
  revenue =
    1000,
  cogs =
    300,
  operatingExpenses =
    500,
  cashFlow =
    200,
  cashBalance =
    1000,
}: {
  month:
    number;

  revenue?:
    number;

  cogs?:
    number;

  operatingExpenses?:
    number;

  cashFlow?:
    number;

  cashBalance?:
    number;
}): ForecastAnalyticsRow {
  return {
    period:
      `2027-${month
        .toString()
        .padStart(
          2,
          "0",
        )}`,

    revenue,

    cogs,

    grossProfit:
      revenue -
      cogs,

    operatingExpenses,

    ebitda:
      revenue -
      cogs -
      operatingExpenses,

    netIncome:
      100,

    cashFlow,

    cashBalance,

    mrr:
      500,

    customers:
      50,

    cac:
      null,

    churnRate:
      null,
  };
}


describe(
  "sensitivity cell",
  () => {
    const rows = [
      row({
        month:
          1,
      }),

      row({
        month:
          2,
      }),

      row({
        month:
          3,
      }),
    ];


    it(
      "keeps healthy zero-stress case resilient",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateSensitivityCell({
            rows,

            basePolicy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              1000,

            targetCashFloor:
              100,

            revenueShock:
              0,

            costInflation:
              0,
          });


        expect(
          result.state,
        ).toBe(
          "RESILIENT",
        );


        expect(
          result.capitalNeed,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "reduces cash as stress increases",
      () => {
        const mild =
          calculateSensitivityCell({
            rows,

            basePolicy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              1000,

            targetCashFloor:
              100,

            revenueShock:
              0.10,

            costInflation:
              0.05,
          });


        const severe =
          calculateSensitivityCell({
            rows,

            basePolicy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              1000,

            targetCashFloor:
              100,

            revenueShock:
              0.40,

            costInflation:
              0.20,
          });


        expect(
          severe.minimumCash,
        ).toBeLessThan(
          mild.minimumCash ??
          Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "detects cash exhaustion",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateSensitivityCell({
            rows,

            basePolicy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              200,

            targetCashFloor:
              100,

            revenueShock:
              0.50,

            costInflation:
              0.30,
          });


        expect(
          result.state,
        ).toBe(
          "CASH_EXHAUSTION",
        );


        expect(
          result.cashExhaustionPeriod,
        ).not.toBeNull();


        expect(
          result.capitalNeed,
        ).toBeGreaterThan(
          0,
        );
      },
    );
  },
);

import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  calculateSensitivitySurface,
} from "@/lib/finance/sensitivity-lab/calculations";

import type {
  ForecastAnalyticsRow,
} from "@/lib/finance/analytics/types";

import type {
  ProjectRiskPolicy,
} from "@/lib/finance/risk-center/types";


const policy:
  ProjectRiskPolicy = {
    minimumCash:
      100,

    minimumRunwayMonths:
      6,

    minimumEbitdaMargin:
      null,

    maximumMonthlyBurn:
      null,

    downsideRevenueShock:
      0.20,

    downsideCostInflation:
      0.10,
  };


const rows:
  ForecastAnalyticsRow[] = [
    {
      period:
        "2027-01",

      revenue:
        1000,

      cogs:
        300,

      grossProfit:
        700,

      operatingExpenses:
        500,

      ebitda:
        200,

      netIncome:
        150,

      cashFlow:
        150,

      cashBalance:
        1000,

      mrr:
        500,

      customers:
        50,

      cac:
        null,

      churnRate:
        null,
    },

    {
      period:
        "2027-02",

      revenue:
        1000,

      cogs:
        300,

      grossProfit:
        700,

      operatingExpenses:
        500,

      ebitda:
        200,

      netIncome:
        150,

      cashFlow:
        150,

      cashBalance:
        1150,

      mrr:
        500,

      customers:
        50,

      cac:
        null,

      churnRate:
        null,
    },
  ];


describe(
  "sensitivity surface",
  () => {
    it(
      "creates complete Cartesian grid",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateSensitivitySurface({
            rows,

            basePolicy:
              policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              1000,

            targetCashFloor:
              100,

            revenueShocks: [
              0,
              0.20,
              0.40,
            ],

            costInflations: [
              0,
              0.10,
              0.20,
            ],
          });


        expect(
          result.cells,
        ).toHaveLength(
          9,
        );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .totalCells,
        ).toBe(
          9,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "creates one funding boundary row per revenue shock",
      () => {
        const result =
          calculateSensitivitySurface({
            rows,

            basePolicy:
              policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              1000,

            targetCashFloor:
              100,

              0,
              0.20,
              0.40,
            ],

            ],
          });


        expect(
          result.boundary,
        ).toHaveLength(

        );
      },
    );


    it(

        const result =
          calculateSensitivitySurface({
            rows,

            basePolicy:
              policy,

            latestActualPeriod:
              null,

            latestActualCash:
              400,

            targetCashFloor:
              200,

            revenueShocks: [
              0,
              0.40,
              0.80,
            ],

            costInflations: [
              0,
              0.20,
              0.40,
            ],
          });


        expect(
          result.summary
            .maximumCapitalNeed,
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
          0,
        );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .resilientCells +
          result.summary
            .floorBreachCells +
          result.summary
            .cashExhaustionCells,
        ).toBe(
          9,
        );
      },
    );
  },

describe(

      "normalizes registration email addresses",

            email:
              "  ALICE@EXAMPLE.COM ",

            password:
              "Secure123",

            confirmPassword:
              "Secure123",
          });

        expect(
          result.success,
        ).toBe(

        );

        if (
          result.success
        ) {
          expect(
            result.data.email,
          ).toBe(
            "alice@example.com",
          );
        }
      },
    );

    it(

            password:
              "Secure123",

          });

          false,
        );
      },
    );

  JsonValue,

} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/types";


function revision(
  version:
    number,
  snapshot:
    JsonValue,
): RevisionDiffView {
  return {
    id:
      String(
        version,
      ),

    version,

    label:
      null,

    reason:
      null,

    sourceRevisionId:
      null,

    createdAt:
      "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",

    snapshot,
  };
}


describe(
  "model change intelligence",
  () => {
    it(
      "categorizes scenarios",
      () => {
        const diff =
          compareRevisionSnapshots(

              {
                scenarios: [

                    modifiers: {
                      growth:
                        1,
                    },
                  },
                ],

            ),

              2,
              {
                scenarios: [

                    id:

                  },
                ],
              },
            ),
          );


        expect(
          diff.summary
            .scenarios,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          diff.changes[
            0

        ).toBe(

        );

    );

                monthlyOverrides:
                  [],

            ),
            revision(
              2,
              {
                monthlyOverrides: [
                  {
                    id:
                      "o1",

                    period:
                      "2027-03",

                    value:
                      500,
                  },
                ],
              },
            ),
          );


        expect(
          diff.summary
            .overrides,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          diff.changes[
            0
          ].materiality,
        ).toBe(
          "HIGH",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "treats structural currency changes as high materiality",

        const diff =
          compareRevisionSnapshots(

              1,

                currency:
                  "EUR",
              },
            ),

        );

            0
          ].materiality,
        ).toBe(
          "HIGH",
        );
      },
    );

##### FILE: ./tests/version-diff/diff.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  compareRevisionSnapshots,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/diff";

import type {
  JsonValue,
  RevisionDiffView,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/types";


function revision(
  version:
    number,
  snapshot:
    JsonValue,
): RevisionDiffView {
  return {
    id:
      `revision-${version}`,

    version,

    label:
      null,

    reason:
      null,

    sourceRevisionId:
      null,

    createdAt:
      "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",

    snapshot,
  };
}


describe(
  "model version diff",
  () => {
    it(
      "detects assumption changes as high materiality",
      () => {
        const result =
          compareRevisionSnapshots(
            revision(
              1,
              {
                baseAssumptions: {
                  revenueGrowth:
                    0.10,
                },
              },
            ),
            revision(
              2,
              {
                baseAssumptions: {
                  revenueGrowth:
                    0.15,
                },
              },
            ),
          );


        expect(
          result.changes,
        ).toHaveLength(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          result.changes[
            0
          ].category,
        ).toBe(
          "ASSUMPTIONS",
        );


        expect(
          result.changes[
            0
          ].materiality,
        ).toBe(
          "HIGH",
        );


        expect(
          result.changes[
            0
          ].path,
        ).toBe(
          "$.baseAssumptions.revenueGrowth",
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "detects additions and removals",
      () => {
        const result =
          compareRevisionSnapshots(
            revision(
              1,
              {
                financingEvents: [
                  {
                    id:
                      "f1",

                    amount:
                      100,
                  },
                ],
              },
            ),
            revision(
              2,
              {
                financingEvents: [
                  {
                    id:
                      "f2",

                    amount:
                      200,
                  },
                ],
              },
            ),
          );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .added,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .removed,
        ).toBe(
          1,
        );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .financing,
        ).toBe(
          2,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "does not treat stable identity-array reordering as a model change",
      () => {
        const before = {
          scenarios: [
            {
              id:
                "a",

              name:
                "Base",
            },

            {
              id:
                "b",

              name:
                "Bull",
            },
          ],
        };


        const after = {
          scenarios: [
            {
              id:
                "b",

              name:
                "Bull",
            },

            {
              id:
                "a",

              name:
                "Base",
            },
          ],
        };


        const result =
          compareRevisionSnapshots(
            revision(
              1,
              before,
            ),
            revision(
              2,
              after,
            ),
          );


        expect(
          result.summary
            .total,
        ).toBe(
          0,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "detects type changes explicitly",
      () => {
        const result =
          compareRevisionSnapshots(
            revision(
              1,
              {
                baseAssumptions: {
                  customers:
                    100,
                },
              },
            ),
            revision(
              2,
              {
                baseAssumptions: {
                  customers:
                    "100",
                },
              },
            ),
          );


        expect(
          result.changes[
            0
          ].kind,
        ).toBe(
          "TYPE_CHANGED",
        );


        expect(
          result.changes[
            0
          ].materiality,
        ).toBe(
          "HIGH",
        );
      },
    );
  },

##### FILE: ./tests/version-diff/immutability.test.ts #####
import {
  describe,
  expect,
  it,
} from "vitest";

import {
  compareRevisionSnapshots,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/diff";

import {
  normalizeJsonValue,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/json";

import type {
  RevisionDiffView,
} from "@/lib/projects/version-diff/types";


describe(
  "version diff immutability",
  () => {
    it(
      "does not mutate either revision snapshot",
      () => {
        const beforeSnapshot =
          normalizeJsonValue({
            baseAssumptions: {
              growth:
                0.10,
            },

            scenarios: [
              {
                id:
                  "base",

                name:
                  "Base",
              },
            ],
          });


        const afterSnapshot =
          normalizeJsonValue({
            baseAssumptions: {
              growth:
                0.15,
            },

            scenarios: [
              {
                id:
                  "base",

                name:
                  "Base",
              },
            ],
          });


        const beforeSerialized =
          JSON.stringify(
            beforeSnapshot,
          );


        const afterSerialized =
          JSON.stringify(
            afterSnapshot,
          );


        const from:
          RevisionDiffView = {
            id:
              "1",

            version:
              1,

            label:
              null,

            reason:
              null,

            sourceRevisionId:
              null,

            createdAt:
              "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",

            snapshot:
              beforeSnapshot,
          };


        const to:
          RevisionDiffView = {
            ...from,

            id:
              "2",

            version:
              2,

            snapshot:
              afterSnapshot,
          };


        compareRevisionSnapshots(
          from,
          to,
        );


        expect(
          JSON.stringify(
            beforeSnapshot,
          ),
        ).toBe(
          beforeSerialized,
        );


        expect(
          JSON.stringify(
            afterSnapshot,
          ),
        ).toBe(
          afterSerialized,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "normalizes nested valid JSON values",
      () => {
        expect(
          normalizeJsonValue({
            a:
              1,

            b: [
              true,
              null,
              "x",
            ],
          }),
        ).toEqual({
          a:
            1,

          b: [
            true,
            null,
            "x",
          ],
        });
      },
    );


    it(
      "rejects unsupported undefined values",
      () => {
        expect(
          () =>
            normalizeJsonValue({
              broken:
                undefined,
            }),
        ).toThrow(
          /unsupported JSON/i,
        );
      },
    );
  },

    "lib/projects/versioning/service.ts",
    "utf8",
  );


describe(
  "modelVersion and revisionSequence separation",
  () => {
    it(
      "retains the existing modelVersion field",
      () => {
        expect(
          schema,
        ).toMatch(
          /^\s*modelVersion\s+/m,
        );
      },
    );


    it(
      "uses revisionSequence as immutable history counter",
      () => {
        expect(
          service,
        ).toContain(
          "revisionSequence: {",
        );
